strings.text: 大智「よし、こんなもんかな」
strings.translated: Daichi「Alright, that should do it.」

strings.text: ダンボール箱に詰め込まれていた荷物を片付けて、大きく息を吐く。
strings.translated: Finishing up the last of the boxes, I let out a long breath.

strings.text: 窓からは明るい日差しが差し込んでいて、真新しいフローリングの床に反射している。
strings.translated: Bright sunlight streams in through the window, reflecting off the brand-new hardwood floor.

strings.text: 箱はまだ山ほどあるけど、ひとまず落ち着いてくつろげる程度のスペースは確保することができた。
strings.translated: There are still mountains of boxes left, but at least I've managed to clear enough space to sit back and relax.

strings.text: 新しい街。
strings.translated: A new town.

strings.text: 新しい家。
strings.translated: A new home.

strings.text: 今日からここで、俺たちの新しい生活が始まる。
strings.translated: Starting today, our new life begins here.

strings.text: 窓から吹き込む春の風のおかげもあって、何だか清々しい気分だ。
strings.translated: Maybe it's the spring breeze drifting in through the window, but I feel strangely refreshed.

strings.text: 久しぶりに、少しだけ……心のモヤが晴れていくような気がする。
strings.translated: For the first time in a while, just a little... it feels like the fog in my chest is starting to lift.

strings.text: それだけでも、この家に引越してきた価値はあったと思う。
strings.translated: That alone makes moving to this place worth it.

strings.text: できればそれ以上の価値があることを願いたい。
strings.translated: I'd like to hope it turns out to be worth even more than that.

strings.text: そう考えるのは……贅沢だろうか
strings.translated: Is it... greedy to think that way?

strings.text: 大智「そろそろ部屋も片付けるか…」
strings.translated: Daichi「I should start cleaning up my room...」

strings.text: 早速明日から学校だ。
strings.translated: School starts tomorrow, first thing.

strings.text: 最低限必要なものは取り出しておかないといけないんだけど……あのダンボールの山を思い出すと、少し憂鬱な気分になってきた。
strings.translated: I need to get the bare essentials unpacked, but... thinking about that mountain of cardboard boxes is already making me feel a little gloomy.

strings.text: 姉さんや母さんが荷造りをしたリビングですら、午前中いっぱいかけてまだ終わっていない。
strings.translated: Even the living room, where Sis and Mom did the packing, still isn't done after a whole morning's worth of work.

strings.text: 俺が適当に箱詰めした荷物をほどくのに、どれだけかかるやら…。
strings.translated: Who knows how long it'll take to unpack the stuff I threw together so haphazardly...

strings.text: おまけに急な引越しだったせいで、どれに何が入っているかもいまいちわからない
strings.translated: On top of that, since it was such a sudden move, I barely even know what's in which box.

strings.text: 大智「…まあ、先は長いんだ」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Well, it's a long road ahead.」

strings.text: ゆっくりやっていくことにしよう。
strings.translated: I'll just take it slow.

strings.text: 母さんも「適当でいい」
strings.translated: Mom said「don't worry about it」

strings.text: って言ってたし、重いものの移動は夜、父さんが帰ってきてから一緒にやればいい。
strings.translated: -- and for the heavy stuff, I can wait until Dad gets home tonight and do it together.

strings.text: ……二人が仕事に戻れて、本当によかった。
strings.translated: I'm really glad the two of them were able to get back to work.

strings.text: 数日休んで引越し作業をする、と言った両親に、仕事を優先するようにすすめたのは俺自身だ
strings.translated: It was me who encouraged my parents to put work first, after they said they'd take a few days off to help with the move.
Daichi「......」

strings.text: となると、やっぱりもうちょっと頑張っておいた方が
strings.translated: Which means maybe I should push myself a little harder after all--

strings.text: ／美桜「大智、終わった？
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, are you done?」

strings.text: 大智「あー…大体は……」
strings.translated: Daichi「Uh... more or less...」

strings.text: リビングに顔を出した≪美桜／姉さん≫が、さっと室内を見回す。
strings.translated: Sis -- Mio -- poked her head into the living room and quickly scanned the space.

strings.text: その表情をみるかぎり…どうやら、一応合格らしい
strings.translated: Judging by her expression... it seems like I've passed, at least for now.

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃあ、そろそろご飯にする？
strings.translated: Mio「In that case, want to eat soon?

strings.text: お腹すいてない？
strings.translated: "Not hungry?"

strings.text: 大智「いいけど…、どうする？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sure, but... what do you want to do?」

strings.text: 引越し初日。
strings.translated: First day in the new place.

strings.text: 当然、冷蔵庫の中は空っぽだ。
strings.translated: The fridge is completely empty, obviously.

strings.text: 朝食は皆で途中のファミレスでとった。
strings.translated: We all had breakfast together at a family restaurant on the way here.

strings.text: 夕飯の食材は母さんが買って来るって言ってたけど
strings.translated: Mom said she'd pick up groceries for dinner, but--

strings.text: 美桜「そうねぇ…」
strings.translated: Mio「Hmm, let me think...」

strings.text: 姉さんが、顎に手を当てて考えるような仕草を見せる。
strings.translated: Sis rests her hand on her chin in a thoughtful gesture.

strings.text: 料理はすごく上手い人だけど、材料が何もなかったらさすがにどうしようもない。
strings.translated: She's an incredibly good cook, but if there are no ingredients at all, even she can't do much.

strings.text: でも引越してきた初日、しかも荷解きの最中に料理をしろって言うのも、何だか酷な話な気がする。
strings.translated: Still, asking her to cook on the very first day after moving in, right in the middle of unpacking -- that feels a bit cruel somehow.

strings.text: 近くのコンビニまで、何か買い出しにでも行くか。
strings.translated: Maybe I'll head to the nearest convenience store and grab something.

strings.text: サンドイッチとか、おにぎりとか…そんなもので十分だろう。
strings.translated: A sandwich, some rice balls... that should be more than enough.

strings.text: …って言っても、どこにコンビニがあるのか知らないんだけど。
strings.translated: Though I don't actually know where any convenience stores are around here.

strings.text: まあ、田舎じゃないんだし、適当に歩いてれば見つかるだろう
strings.translated: Well, it's not like we're out in the countryside -- if I just walk around a bit, I'm sure I'll find one.

strings.text: ／芽生「お姉ちゃん、終わったよ～」
strings.translated: Mei「Sis, I'm done~」

strings.text: 明るい声でリビングに入って来たのは芽生だった。
strings.translated: It was Mei who came bounding into the living room with a cheerful voice.

strings.text: 姉さんと一緒に２階の片付けをしていたはずなんだけど、どうやら作業が終わったみたいだ
strings.translated: She'd been upstairs helping Sis with the unpacking -- looks like they finished their part.

strings.text: 美桜「あら、もう終わったの？
strings.translated: Mio「Oh, already?

strings.text: 芽生、ご苦労様
strings.translated: "Good work, Mei."

strings.text: 芽生「えへへへへっ」
strings.translated: Mei「Ehehehehe~」

strings.text: 姉さんに頭を撫でられて、芽生が嬉しそうに笑う。
strings.translated: Mio ruffles Mei's hair, and Mei laughs, looking absolutely delighted.

strings.text: 製薬会社の研究職に就いている母さんは多忙で、芽生が学校に上がって復職してからは、俺や姉さんが芽生の世話係だった。
strings.translated: Mom works as a researcher at a pharmaceutical company and is always busy -- once Mei started school and Mom went back to work, it was me and Sis who took care of her.

strings.text: 去年母さんが仕事を辞めてからも、姉さんのことで手一杯で…芽生はさびしいのを我慢していたと思う。
strings.translated: Even after Mom quit her job last year, she was so caught up with Sis's situation... I think Mei had been holding back how lonely she felt.

strings.text: 今日だって、本当は家族揃って片付けをしたかっただろうに、そんなそぶりをなるべく見せないようにしている。
strings.translated: Today too, she probably really wanted the whole family to do the unpacking together, but she's been trying her best not to let that show.

strings.text: 年上の俺が自分の感情だけで二人に仕事を優先させて……悪いことをしたかもしれない
strings.translated: I'm the older one, and I let my own feelings push the two of them to put work first... I may have done something wrong.

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃ、このあたりで休憩して、お昼ご飯のお買い物に行きましょうか？
strings.translated: Mio「Well then, shall we take a break and go out to pick up something for lunch?」

strings.text: 芽生「お買い物っ！
strings.translated:
Mei「Shopping~!
 Can we buy snacks too?

strings.text: おやつも買っていい？
strings.translated: What are you talking about.」

strings.text: 美桜「ん～っ、今日は頑張ってるし、ひとつだけならいいかな
strings.translated: Mio「Hmm~, you've been working hard today, so just one thing, okay?」

strings.text: 芽生「やったー！
strings.translated: Mei「Yay~!」

strings.text: まぁ、そうだな。
strings.translated: Well, fair enough.

strings.text: せっかくだし、３人で買い物に行くのもいいか
strings.translated: Since we're going out anyway, the three of us heading out together sounds nice.

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃあ、大智はお留守番、お願いね
strings.translated: Mio「So, Daichi, you stay here and watch the place, okay?」

strings.text: 大智「は？
strings.translated: Daichi「Huh?

strings.text: 何言ってんの。
strings.translated: What are you talking about.」

strings.text: 俺も行くよ
strings.translated: I'm coming too.」

strings.text: 美桜「大丈夫よ。
strings.translated: Mio「It's fine.

strings.text: 大した荷物にはならないし
strings.translated: We won't have that much to carry.」

strings.text: 大智「そういう問題じゃないよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not the point.

strings.text: 俺だけのけ者って寂しいだろ
strings.translated: It'd be lonely being left out on my own.」

strings.text: 美桜「のけ者って……じゃあ、すぐに出るから支度してね
strings.translated: Mio「Left out... fine, we're heading out soon, so get ready.」

strings.text: 大智「了解
strings.translated: Daichi「Got it.」

strings.text: このありきたりな幸せを二度と壊さないように……。
strings.translated: So that I never destroy this ordinary happiness again...

strings.text: そのためなら、俺はどんなことでもするつもりだ
strings.translated: For that, I'm prepared to do whatever it takes.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん、コンビニでいいんじゃないか？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis, wouldn't a convenience store be fine?」

strings.text: とりあえず、コンビニはすぐに見つけたけど、姉さんは芽生の手を引いてそれを素通りしている
strings.translated: We found one pretty quickly, but Sis is pulling Mei right past it without stopping.

strings.text: 美桜「こっちのほうに安くて良いスーパーがあるんですって
strings.translated: Mio「Apparently there's a good, affordable supermarket a little further this way.」

strings.text: 大智「来たばっかなのによく知ってるな
strings.translated: Daichi「You sure know your way around for someone who just got here.」

strings.text: 美桜「自分で決めた街なのよ。
strings.translated: Mio「It's a town I chose myself.

strings.text: そういう情報はちゃんと集めたの
strings.translated: I made sure to gather that kind of information properly.」

strings.text: 芽生「お姉ちゃん、すごーい
strings.translated: Mei「Sis, you're amazing~!」

strings.text: そう言って、芽生が楽しそうに笑う。
strings.translated: Mei laughs, looking genuinely delighted.

strings.text: 実際、すごいと思う。
strings.translated: And honestly, I think it's amazing too.

strings.text: …いや、ネットで少し調べれば済むことだけど、以前の姉さんを考えるとすごい事だ。
strings.translated: ...Well, it only takes a quick search online, but thinking about how Sis used to be, it really is something.

strings.text: この街に引越したいって言ったのは姉さんだけど、ちゃんと下調べとかしてたんだな
strings.translated: She's the one who said she wanted to move to this town -- and she'd actually done her research beforehand.

strings.text: こういう姿を見ると、本当に元気になったんだなって思う
strings.translated: Seeing her like this, I really do feel like she's gotten better.

strings.text: 十数年、住み慣れた場所を離れるのは、勇気の要る決断だった。
strings.translated: Leaving a place we'd lived in for over a decade -- that took real courage.

strings.text: 俺達には学校が、両親には仕事がある。
strings.translated: We kids had school; our parents had work.

strings.text: 学校のほうはまだしも、仕事はすぐに次が見つかるわけじゃない。
strings.translated: School was one thing, but a new job isn't something you find right away.

strings.text: 特に母さんが休職している状況で、父さんが職を失うリスクを負うのは辛かったと思う。
strings.translated: Especially with Mom on leave, I think it must have been hard for Dad to take on the risk of losing his job.

strings.text: それでも、誰も反対はしなかった。
strings.translated: Even so, no one objected.

strings.text: 大変だってわかってたけど、１日でも早く引越しができるようにみんなで頑張った。
strings.translated: We all knew it would be tough, but we worked together to make the move happen as quickly as possible.

strings.text: 父さんは仕事を辞める覚悟で会社にかけあって、幸い転勤が決まった。
strings.translated: Dad was ready to quit his job and went to negotiate with his company -- and luckily, a transfer came through.

strings.text: 芽生も近所の友達と別れることを了承してくれた。
strings.translated: Mei agreed to say goodbye to her friends in the neighborhood.

strings.text: 姉さんのためになるなら…。
strings.translated: If it would help Sis...

strings.text: たとえ口に出さなくても、みんなの胸の内にはそれがあった。
strings.translated: Even if no one said it out loud, that feeling was in everyone's heart.

strings.text: 姉さんのために、新しい生活をスタートさせたかった。
strings.translated: We wanted to start a new life -- for Sis's sake.

strings.text: 俺が両親に仕事を優先してもらったのも似たような理由だ。
strings.translated: The reason I had our parents put work first was similar.

strings.text: 二人には早く元の生活に……仕事に追われて、でも仕事が好きで、子供みたいに生き生きしている二人に戻ってほしかった。
strings.translated: I wanted the two of them to go back to the life they had before... chasing after work, but loving it, alive and bright-eyed like a couple of kids.

strings.text: 新しい街で、みんなで、昔みたいに
strings.translated: In this new town, all of us together, like we used to be.

strings.text: 芽生「お兄ちゃんどこ行くの？
strings.translated: Mei「Where are you going, big brother?」

strings.text: 美桜「こっちよ
strings.translated: Mio「It's over here.」

strings.text: 大智「えっ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Huh?

strings.text: あ、ごめん
strings.translated: Oh, sorry.

strings.text: 考え事をしていたら、目的地の店を通り過ぎてたみたいだ。
strings.translated: I'd been so lost in thought that I'd walked right past the store we were heading to.

strings.text: 気付けば俺の真横にスーパーが建っていた
strings.translated: When I came back to myself, there was a supermarket right beside me.

strings.text: 美桜「ここが、安くて品揃えも豊富なの
strings.translated: Mio「This is the one -- affordable and well-stocked.」

strings.text: 大智「へぇ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Huh...」

strings.text: スーパーなんかの立地くらいならすぐわかりそうだけど、品ぞろえまで調べるのって難しいんじゃないか？
strings.translated: I'd think you could figure out where a supermarket is pretty quickly, but researching the selection they carry -- that seems like a lot of work.

strings.text: 引越しが楽しみで、家の周りの情報集めでもしたんだろうか
strings.translated: Maybe she was excited about the move and had been gathering info about the neighborhood.

strings.text: 美桜「ほら、行きましょう
strings.translated: Mio「Come on, let's go in.」

strings.text: 姉さんが芽生の手を引いて店に入って行く。
strings.translated: Sis takes Mei's hand and heads inside.

strings.text: 俺もその後を追おうとしたけど、その直前に思わず足を止めた
strings.translated: I moved to follow them, but stopped in my tracks just before I did.

strings.text: 大智「ん…？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Hm...?」

strings.text: 感じたのは視線。
strings.translated: I felt a gaze.

strings.text: 誰かが俺のことをじっと見ていた…ような気がした
strings.translated: Someone was staring at me... or at least, that's how it felt.

strings.text: 女の子だった。
strings.translated: It was a girl.

strings.text: 長い黒髪の…思わず目を止めてしまうような綺麗な子だ。
strings.translated: Long black hair... the kind of girl you couldn't help but look twice at.

strings.text: 俺のほうを見てたような気がしたけど、実際は全然違うところを見ていた
strings.translated: I thought she'd been looking my way, but she was actually staring at something else entirely.

strings.text: 道路の向こう側に顔を向けて、何をするでもなくじっと立っている
strings.translated: She was facing the other side of the road, standing perfectly still, not doing anything in particular.

strings.text: 大智「何してるんだろ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「What's she doing...」

strings.text: なんとなく気になって見ていたけど、女の子は全然動く様子がない。
strings.translated: Something about it caught my attention and I kept watching, but the girl showed no sign of moving at all.

strings.text: 道に迷って困ってる…って感じじゃないな。
strings.translated: She didn't look like she was lost or in trouble.

strings.text: 何ていうか、静かで、動きのない……でも不自然な感じはしない、不思議な雰囲気の子だ
strings.translated: How to put it -- she was quiet, perfectly still... and yet there was nothing unnatural about her. A strangely mysterious kind of girl.

strings.text: 大智「あ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Oh...」

strings.text: 女の子が振り向いて、思いきり目が合ってしまった
strings.translated: The girl turned around, and we locked eyes completely.

strings.text: 慌てて目を逸らす。
strings.translated: I quickly looked away.

strings.text: 変か？
strings.translated: Was that weird?

strings.text: 変じゃないよな？
strings.translated: That's not weird, right?

strings.text: 俺は買い物に来ただけで…通りすがりの女の子とたまたま目があっただけだよな。
strings.translated: I just came here to shop... and I just happened to make eye contact with some girl passing by. That's all.

strings.text: でも、女の子はゆっくりと俺のほうに近付いてきて
strings.translated: But the girl slowly walked toward me, and--

strings.text: ／愛「どうかした？」
strings.translated: Ai「Is something wrong?」

strings.text: いきなり話しかけられた
strings.translated: She spoke to me out of nowhere.

strings.text: …何が？
strings.translated: Like what?

strings.text: ／愛「見られてるような気がしたから
strings.translated: Ai「I had the feeling someone was watching me.」

strings.text: 大智「いや、別に
strings.translated: Daichi「No, not really.」

strings.text: ／愛「そう。
strings.translated: Ai「I see.」

strings.text: じゃあ、私の勘違いね。
strings.translated: Then it must have been my imagination.

strings.text: ごめんなさい
strings.translated: I'm sorry.

strings.text: それだけ言って、女の子はお店の中に入っていく。
strings.translated: With just that, the girl walked into the store.

strings.text: なんだ。
strings.translated: Huh.

strings.text: やっぱりこの店に用があったのか。
strings.translated: So she did have business here after all.

strings.text: 視線を感じたから目を向けたんだけど、結果的には俺のほうが見つめていたことになってしまった。
strings.translated: I'd looked her way because I felt her gaze on me, but in the end, I was the one who'd been staring.

strings.text: まあ、実際しばらく見てたわけだし、否定はできないんだけど
strings.translated: Well, I had been watching her for a while, so I couldn't really deny it.

strings.text: 美桜「大智、まだこんなところにいたの
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, you're still out here?」

strings.text: ああ、ごめん。
strings.translated: Ah, sorry.

strings.text: すぐ行くよ
strings.translated: I'll be right in.」

strings.text: 美桜「もうっ…ぼーっとしないでよ」
strings.translated: Mio「Honestly... stop spacing out like that.」

strings.text: 店から出てきた姉さんに怒られてしまった。
strings.translated: Sis came out of the store and scolded me.

strings.text: 何のためについて来たんだか。
strings.translated: What did I even come along for?

strings.text: しっかりしないと
strings.translated: I need to pull myself together.

strings.text: 美桜「大智、晩ご飯の買い物も一緒にしちゃうけど、食べたいものある？
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, I'm going to pick up groceries for dinner too -- is there anything you want to eat?」

strings.text: 大智「食べたいものか…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Something I want to eat, huh...」

strings.text: あるにはあるけど、まだ荷物も片付いてない状態だし、あまり手の込んだものは難しいだろう
strings.translated: There are things I want, but with the luggage still not unpacked, anything too elaborate would probably be difficult.

strings.text: 大智「何でもいいよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「Anything's fine.

strings.text: 作りやすいので
strings.translated: Whatever's easy to make.」

strings.text: 美桜「遠慮しなくていいのに
strings.translated: Mio「You don't have to hold back, you know.」

strings.text: 美桜「芽生は、何か食べたいものある？
strings.translated: Mio「Mei, is there anything you want to eat?」

strings.text: 芽生「う～んとね、う～んと…」
strings.translated: Mei「Hmm, let me think, hmm...」

strings.text: 夕食のリクエストを考えるようにしながら、芽生の視線は棚のお菓子に向けられていた
strings.translated: While pretending to think about what to request for dinner, Mei's gaze had drifted toward the snacks on the shelf.

strings.text: たぶん、頭の中はどれを買ってもらおうかって考えてるんだろうな。
strings.translated: She was probably running through which ones to ask for in her head.

strings.text: 姉さんもそれがわかってるみたいで、苦笑いしながら芽生を見下ろしていた
strings.translated: Sis seemed to know that too -- she was looking down at Mei with a wry smile.

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃあ、２人が好きなものにしようかしらね
strings.translated: Mio「Well then, let's just get what you two like.」

strings.text: 姉さんがそう言って、店の中を回って行く。
strings.translated: Sis said that and made her way through the store.

strings.text: カゴの中に食材を突っ込んでいって、ついでに芽生の欲しがったお菓子も入れてレジへと向かった。
strings.translated: She loaded ingredients into the basket, tossed in the snacks Mei had been eyeing, and headed for the register.

strings.text: こういうのも懐かしいな。
strings.translated: This feels nostalgic.

strings.text: 前に３人で買い物に行ったのはいつだっけ…やっと普通の生活ができるようになったんだって思うと、涙がでそうになるくらい嬉しかった
strings.translated: When was the last time the three of us went shopping together...? Knowing that we could finally live a normal life again made me so happy I almost cried.

strings.text: 大智「…っと」
strings.translated: Daichi「...ah」

strings.text: 本当に泣きそうになってしまって、慌てて目元を拭う。
strings.translated: I was on the verge of actually crying, and hurriedly wiped at the corners of my eyes.

strings.text: こんなところで泣いたりしたら、ものすごく恥ずかしい。
strings.translated: Crying in a place like this would be incredibly embarrassing.

strings.text: 姉さんにだって何て言われるかわからないし、あまり感情的になるようなことは考えないようにしよう
strings.translated: I had no idea what Sis might say either, so I decided not to think about anything that might make me too emotional.

strings.text: 大智「お、重い…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Ugh, heavy...」

strings.text: 左右の手に大きな買い物袋を提げて、前を歩く姉さんと芽生の背中を追う。
strings.translated: With large shopping bags hanging from both hands, I followed the backs of Sis and Mei walking ahead of me.

strings.text: 確かに商品は安かったけど、その分かなり買い込んだみたいだ。
strings.translated: The products were certainly cheap, but it seemed like we'd bought quite a lot to make up for it.

strings.text: 今日の夕食の材料以外にも、米袋や根菜の袋詰め、洗剤なんかが容赦なく入っている。
strings.translated: On top of the ingredients for tonight's dinner, there were bags of rice, bags of root vegetables, and detergent packed in without mercy.

strings.text: かさばる割に軽いトイレットペーパーやボックスティッシュは、２人に持ってもらっている。
strings.translated: The toilet paper and box tissues -- bulky but light -- I had the two of them carry.

strings.text: 格好つけて重いものは全部引き受けたけど…これはさすがに失敗だったかもしれないな…。
strings.translated: I'd played it cool and taken all the heavy things myself, but... this might have been a mistake after all...

strings.text: ビニル袋が手のひらに食い込んで痛い。
strings.translated: The plastic bags were cutting into my palms and it hurt.

strings.text: 前を行く姉さんは、母さんに買い物を済ませたことをメール中だ。
strings.translated: Sis, walking ahead, was in the middle of sending Mom a message that the shopping was done.

strings.text: 母さん、「今日は早く帰って、夕飯は自分で作る」
strings.translated: Mom had said "I'll be home early today and make dinner myself,"

strings.text: っていってたけど……正直、母さんより姉さんの方が料理が上手いんだよな…研究者だし、料理なんて理科の実験なんかとそう変わらない気がするんだけど…なんでなんだろう
strings.translated: but... honestly, Sis is a better cook than Mom. She's a researcher, and cooking doesn't feel all that different from a science experiment to me... so why is that, I wonder.

strings.text: 美桜「ちょっと、大智。
strings.translated: Mio「Hey, Daichi.

strings.text: フラフラしてるけど大丈夫なの？
strings.translated: You're wobbling -- are you okay?」

strings.text: 大智「大丈夫大丈夫。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm fine, I'm fine.

strings.text: このくらい何でもないから
strings.translated: This is nothing.」

strings.text: 芽生「お兄ちゃん、フラフラしてる
strings.translated: Mei「Big brother's wobbling~.」

strings.text: 大智「こういう歩き方が健康にいいんだ
strings.translated: Daichi「This is just how I walk. It's good for your health.」

strings.text: ごまかすように笑いながら、自宅への道を歩き続ける
strings.translated: I laughed it off and kept walking the road home.

strings.text: 芽生「ねえお姉ちゃん、学校行くときもこの道通るの？
strings.translated: Mei「Hey, Sis, do we go this way to school too?」

strings.text: 美桜「そうね。
strings.translated: Mio「That's right.

strings.text: 途中までは３人一緒ね
strings.translated: The three of us walk together partway.」

strings.text: 芽生「友達いっぱいできるかな？
strings.translated: Mei「I wonder if I'll make lots of friends?」

strings.text: 美桜「芽生なら大丈夫よ。
strings.translated: Mio「You'll be fine, Mei.

strings.text: きっといっぱいできるから
strings.translated: I'm sure you'll make plenty.」

strings.text: 美桜「お姉ちゃんもいっぱい友達作るつもりでいるから、どっちのほうが多いか競争しよっか？
strings.translated: Mio「I'm planning to make lots of friends myself, so should we have a competition to see who makes more?」

strings.text: 芽生「うんっ！
strings.translated: Mei「Yeah!

strings.text: 私、負けないよ」
strings.translated: "I won't lose."

strings.text: 姉さんと話しながら、芽生が両手で握り拳を作る。
strings.translated: Mei pumped both fists while talking with Sis.

strings.text: それを後ろから眺めながら、俺はこの街で始まる新しい生活に安堵の思いを抱いていた
strings.translated: Watching them from behind, I held a feeling of relief in my heart for the new life beginning in this town.

strings.text: 大智「いただきます
strings.translated: Daichi「Let's eat.」

strings.text: 芽生「いただきま～す
strings.translated: Mei「Let's eat~!」

strings.text: 美桜「はい、召し上がれ。
strings.translated: Mio「There you go.

strings.text: お代わりあるから、足りなかったら言ってね
strings.translated: There's more, so just say the word if you want seconds.」

strings.text: 昼食は姉さんが作ってくれたスパゲティだった。
strings.translated: Lunch was spaghetti that Sis had made.

strings.text: ３人でテーブルを囲んで、テレビのニュースなんかを見ながら食事を始める
strings.translated: The three of us gathered around the table and started eating while watching the news on TV.

strings.text: 芽生「おいし～っ！
strings.translated: Mei「This is so good~!

strings.text: これ、おいし～っ！
strings.translated: This is so good~!

strings.text: 美桜「そう？
strings.translated: Mio「Really?

strings.text: 良かった」
strings.translated: I'm glad.」

strings.text: スパゲティを頬張る芽生を見ながら、姉さんが嬉しそうに目を細める。
strings.translated: Sis narrowed her eyes happily as she watched Mei stuff her cheeks with spaghetti.

strings.text: そんな姉さんの表情を見るたびに、心の中で幸せを噛み締める。
strings.translated: Every time I saw that expression on her face, I savored the happiness quietly inside.

strings.text: 平穏な幸せこそが一番大切なもの。
strings.translated: Peaceful happiness is the most precious thing there is.

strings.text: 油断すれば、幸せなんて簡単に壊れてしまう。
strings.translated: Let your guard down, and happiness can shatter so easily.

strings.text: そんな体験をしたからこそ、今という瞬間が本当に、涙が出るほど嬉しかった
strings.translated: Having lived through something like that was exactly why this moment -- right now -- felt so genuinely, tearfully wonderful.

strings.text: 色々な物が壊れたのは、１年くらい前のことだ。
strings.translated: It was about a year ago that so many things fell apart.

strings.text: 直接被害に遭ったのは姉さんだった。
strings.translated: Sis was the one who was directly victimized.

strings.text: とても辛い目に遭って……そのあとしばらくは誰とも話そうとせず、部屋に引きこもってしまったほどだ。
strings.translated: She went through something truly terrible... and for a while afterward, she refused to speak to anyone and shut herself away in her room.

strings.text: 強姦事件。
strings.translated: Rape.

strings.text: ニュースや小説、ドラマ、映画なんかではそう珍しくない言葉だけど、実際に自分の家族がその被害に遭うなんて夢にも思っていなかった。
strings.translated: It's not an uncommon word in the news, in novels, dramas, or movies -- but I had never once imagined that something like that could actually happen to my own family.

strings.text: 何で？
strings.translated: Why?

strings.text: どうして？
strings.translated: Why?

strings.text: 話を聞いたときは、頭の中にそんな言葉ばかりが浮かんだ。
strings.translated: When I heard about it, that was all that kept surfacing in my mind.

strings.text: 何かの間違いなんじゃないかって、そんなふうに思わずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but feel like it had to be some kind of mistake.

strings.text: 詳しい話は聞かされていない。
strings.translated: I wasn't told the details.

strings.text: 俺が知っているのは、学校からの帰り道に姉さんが複数の男に暴行され、意識を失っている所を通りすがりの人に発見されて通報された、と言う事だけだ。
strings.translated: All I know is that on her way home from school, Sis was assaulted by multiple men, and was found unconscious by a passerby who called the police.

strings.text: それも事件が起きてしばらくして、姉さんが入院中の病院から家に戻ってくる時に初めて両親から打ち明けられた話だ。
strings.translated: Even that much wasn't told to me until some time after the incident, when Sis was finally coming home from the hospital -- that was the first time my parents confided in me.

strings.text: それまでは交通事故だと聞かされていた。
strings.translated: Up until then, I had been told it was a traffic accident.

strings.text: 芽生は今でもそう思っている。
strings.translated: Mei still believes that to this day.

strings.text: 実際、車に轢かれたような酷い怪我だった。
strings.translated: In truth, her injuries really were bad enough to look like she'd been hit by a car.

strings.text: 駆け付けた病室で眠っている姉さんを見た時も驚いたし、憤りを感じたけれど、それでもどこかに希望があった。
strings.translated: When I rushed to the hospital room and saw Sis lying there asleep, I was shocked and filled with rage -- and yet, somewhere, there was still hope.

strings.text: 目立つ傷跡や障害は残らないという話だったから、むしろ命に別条がなくて良かったと思いすらした。
strings.translated: They said she wouldn't be left with any visible scars or lasting disabilities, so I even found myself thinking it was a relief that her life hadn't been in danger.

strings.text: でも、姉さんを襲ったのは不慮の事故なんかじゃなかった。
strings.translated: But what had attacked Sis was no accidental mishap.

strings.text: 両親の様子がおかしいような気はしていた。
strings.translated: I had sensed that something was off about my parents.

strings.text: 事故のショックで精神的に不安定だから、お見舞いにはいかなくていいと言われたことも不自然に思いはした。
strings.translated: I did find it strange when they told me not to visit her at the hospital, saying she was emotionally unstable from the shock of the accident.

strings.text: それでも、まさか
strings.translated: Even so, I never could have imagined that----

strings.text: 大智「何だよ、それ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「What the hell is that...」

strings.text: 他人のもののようにしわがれた自分の声を、俺は今でも覚えている。
strings.translated: I can still see Dad's face, eyes downcast, frozen in that strange rigid expression.

strings.text: 目を伏せた父さんの奇妙に硬直した表情も、顔を覆って泣きだした母さんの姿も。
strings.translated: Mom, covering her face and breaking into tears.

strings.text: あの光景と衝撃は、一生忘れることはないだろう。
strings.translated: That sight, that shock -- I will never forget it for the rest of my life.

strings.text: 警察は捜査してくれたみたいだけれど、結局犯人は見つかっていない。
strings.translated: The police apparently investigated, but in the end no one was ever caught.

strings.text: どこの誰がやったのか。
strings.translated: Who did it, and where they came from.

strings.text: どうしてそんな酷い事ができるのか。
strings.translated: How anyone could do something so cruel.

strings.text: なぜ姉さんだったのか。
strings.translated: Why it had to be Sis.

strings.text: 様々な疑問を残したまま、俺達は住み慣れた街を離れてここに移ってきた。
strings.translated: Leaving those questions unanswered, we left the town we'd lived in all our lives and came here.

strings.text: この街で、みんなでやり直すために
strings.translated: To start over, together, in this new town.

strings.text: 美桜「大智、どうしたの？
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, what's wrong?」

strings.text: 考え事をして食事の手が止まってたから、姉さんに声をかけられてしまった
strings.translated: I'd gotten so lost in thought that I'd stopped eating, so Sis called out to me.

strings.text: 美桜「もしかして、口に合わなかった？
strings.translated: Mio「Did it not suit your taste?」

strings.text: 大智「いや、そんなことないよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「No, nothing like that.

strings.text: すごく美味しい
strings.translated: It's really good.」

strings.text: 美桜「それならいいけど
strings.translated: Mio「Well, that's a relief.」

strings.text: 大智「明日から学校だし、ちゃんと食っておかないとな
strings.translated: Daichi「School starts tomorrow, so I'd better eat properly.」

strings.text: そう言って、口の中にスパゲティを押し込むように食べる。
strings.translated: I said that and shoveled spaghetti into my mouth.

strings.text: 過去を引きずっても仕方ない。
strings.translated: There's no point dragging the past around with me.

strings.text: 姉さんがそれを乗り越えようとしてるんだから、俺はサポートに徹するだけだ。
strings.translated: Sis is trying to move past it, so all I need to do is be there to support her.

strings.text: 心の傷が完全に癒えることはないかもしれないけど、辛い思いをした姉さんのために出来得る限りのことをしてやりたかった
strings.translated: The wounds in our hearts may never fully heal, but I wanted to do everything I possibly could for Sis, after everything she'd been through.

strings.text: 大智「ん～っ、いい朝だ」
strings.translated: Daichi「Mmm~, what a nice morning.」

strings.text: 翌朝。
strings.translated: The next morning.

strings.text: 窓の外には青空が広がっていて、俺は窓のそばで大きく伸びをした。
strings.translated: A clear blue sky spread outside the window, and I stretched out wide beside it.

strings.text: 新しい家といってもベッドは持って来たものだから、当然寝心地は変わらない。
strings.translated: Even if the house was new, the bed was the one I'd brought with me, so of course the comfort was the same.

strings.text: ぐっすりと安眠することができて、気分はすごく爽快だ
strings.translated: I'd slept soundly and felt completely refreshed.

strings.text: 美桜「大智、起きてる？
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, are you awake?

strings.text: 転校初日から遅刻なんてみっともないわよ
strings.translated: Being late on your first day at a new school would be embarrassing, you know.

strings.text: 大智「起きてる。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm up.

strings.text: わかってるよ」
strings.translated: I know.」

strings.text: 自宅から学校までは歩いて１５分くらいの距離だ。
strings.translated: It's about a fifteen-minute walk from home to school.

strings.text: 今から支度すれば十分に間に合うはずだけど、初日くらいは余裕をもって行きたい
strings.translated: If I start getting ready now I should have plenty of time, but I'd like to leave with some room to spare on the first day at least.

strings.text: 大智「おはよう
strings.translated: Daichi「Morning.」

strings.text: 美桜「おはよう。
strings.translated: Mio「Morning.

strings.text: 朝食、できてるから
strings.translated: Breakfast is ready.」

strings.text: 大智「父さんと母さんは？
strings.translated: Daichi「Where are Dad and Mom?」

strings.text: 美桜「もう出たわよ
strings.translated: Mio「They already left.」

strings.text: 大智「そっか」
strings.translated: Daichi「I see.」

strings.text: 俺達よりも両親のほうが大変みたいだ。
strings.translated: It sounds like our parents have it harder than we do.

strings.text: だからこそ、協力できることは協力し合わないといけない。
strings.translated: That's exactly why we need to cooperate and help each other where we can.

strings.text: もう子供じゃないんだし、自分達のことくらい自分達でやらないとな
strings.translated: We're not kids anymore -- we have to handle our own affairs ourselves.

strings.text: 美桜「新しい学校…楽しみね
strings.translated: Mio「A new school... I'm looking forward to it.」

strings.text: 大智「ああ
strings.translated: Daichi「Yeah.」

strings.text: 美桜「大智、ありがとね。
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, thank you.

strings.text: 私のために、学校まで変わってくれて
strings.translated: For transferring schools for my sake.」

strings.text: 大智「別に…」
strings.translated: Daichi「It's nothing...」

strings.text: 家族のためだ。
strings.translated: It's for my family.

strings.text: 転校くらいどうってことない。
strings.translated: Transferring schools is no big deal.

strings.text: それに、俺にも多少…前の学校から離れたい気持ちはあった。
strings.translated: Besides, I had my own reasons... I wanted to get away from my old school too, at least a little.

strings.text: でもそれを姉さんに言うわけにはいかなくて、返事は曖昧なものになった
strings.translated: But I couldn't say that to Sis, so my answer came out vague.

strings.text: 美桜「うん、本当にありがとう。
strings.translated: Mio「Yeah, I really mean it -- thank you.

strings.text: 私、頑張るからね」
strings.translated: I'm going to do my best.」

strings.text: そう言って、姉さんがにっこりと笑顔を浮かべる。
strings.translated: She said that, and Sis broke into a warm smile.

strings.text: 少し後ろめたいものを感じながらも、その笑顔にはほっとさせられた
strings.translated: I felt a small pang of guilt, but that smile still put me at ease.

strings.text: 芽生「お兄ちゃん、まだ～？
strings.translated: Mei「Big brother, are you ready yet~?」

strings.text: 美桜「大智、もう行くわよ
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, we're leaving now.」

strings.text: 大智「ごめん。
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry.

strings.text: お待たせ
strings.translated: Thanks for waiting.」

strings.text: 家を出る時間になって、俺達は３人揃って玄関をくぐった。
strings.translated: When it was time to leave the house, the three of us walked out the front door together.

strings.text: 初日くらいはみんなで一緒に出たかったのと、芽生だけ学校が違って、そこまで送ってゆく必要があったからだ。
strings.translated: We wanted to all head out as one on the first day, and since Mei goes to a different school, we needed to walk her there.

strings.text: 俺と姉さんは少し遠回りになるから、本来よりも１５分くらい早い登校になっていた。
strings.translated: It made the route a bit out of the way for Sis and me, so we were leaving about fifteen minutes earlier than we normally would.

strings.text: 芽生が１日で道を覚えられるかどうかわからないし、しばらくはこの時間に出ることになるだろう
strings.translated: We weren't sure if Mei could memorize the way in a single day, so we'd probably be keeping this schedule for a while.

strings.text: 美桜「芽生、忘れ物してない？
strings.translated: Mio「Mei, did you forget anything?」

strings.text: 芽生「大丈夫～」
strings.translated: Mei「It'll be fine~」

strings.text: 登校中、芽生はすごく元気だった。
strings.translated: On the way to school, Mei was full of energy.

strings.text: 新しい学校に行くのがとても楽しみらしい。
strings.translated: She seemed really excited about going to a new school.

strings.text: 転校が決まった当初は「姉さんのために我慢してる」
strings.translated: At first, when the transfer was decided, it felt like she was "putting up with it for Sis's sake" --

strings.text: って感じだったけど、それから時間も経ったし、新しい家に引越しをすませたせいもあるだろう。
strings.translated: but time had passed since then, and moving into the new house probably had something to do with it too.

strings.text: でも、姉さんは逆に不安そうで、芽生がちゃんとやっていけるのかって、それを心配してるらしかった
strings.translated: Sis, on the other hand, seemed anxious -- she was apparently worried about whether Mei would manage all right.

strings.text: 美桜「いい？
strings.translated: Mio「Listen --

strings.text: 何かあったら携帯に連絡するのよ？
strings.translated: if anything happens, you call me on my phone, okay?

strings.text: 芽生「はーい
strings.translated: Mei「Yes, yes~.」

strings.text: 美桜「家の鍵、落としちゃダメよ？
strings.translated: Mio「Don't lose your house key, all right?

strings.text: 芽生のほうが、帰りは早いんだから
strings.translated: You get out earlier than us, after all --

strings.text: 美桜「それから、１人で寄り道したら絶対ダメだからね？
strings.translated: Mio「And absolutely no wandering off by yourself after school, okay?」

strings.text: 芽生「はーい」
strings.translated: Mei「Yes, yes~.」

strings.text: 多分、自分の身に起きたことも影響しているんだろう。
strings.translated: What happened to Sis was probably part of why she worried so much.

strings.text: 心配する姉さんに対して、芽生の返事はすごく軽い。
strings.translated: Mei's responses were breezy and light compared to how seriously Sis was fussing.

strings.text: 学校が終わったら、ちゃんと真っ直ぐに帰って家にいるといいんだけど…。
strings.translated: I just hoped Mei would come straight home after school and stay there... She might get curious about the new neighborhood and wander off on her own somewhere.

strings.text: 新しい街だから探検したくなって、自分だけでどこかに行ってしまわないかって、俺もちょっと心配だ
strings.translated: I was a little worried about that too.

strings.text: 美桜「芽生も同じ学校だったら安心なんだけどね
strings.translated: Mio「I'd feel so much better if Mei were at the same school as us.」

strings.text: 大智「そんな無茶な。
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not realistic.

strings.text: 歳が違うんだし
strings.translated: She's a different age.」

strings.text: 美桜「だって、心配じゃない
strings.translated: Mio「But I can't help worrying.」

strings.text: 大智「そういうわけだから、姉ちゃんに心配かけちゃダメだぞ？
strings.translated: Daichi「That's why you can't go making Sis worry, okay?」

strings.text: 俺が言っても、芽生の返事の仕方は変わらない。
strings.translated: Even when I said it, Mei's response didn't change one bit.

strings.text: 本当にわかってるのかって疑いたくなる態度だ。
strings.translated: It was the kind of attitude that made you wonder if she really understood.

strings.text: まあ、携帯があるんだから、何かあればすぐに連絡はくれると思うけど
strings.translated: Well, she has her cell phone, so I figured she'd contact us right away if anything came up.

strings.text: 美桜「着いたわね
strings.translated: Mio「Here we are.」

strings.text: 芽生を学校に送り届けてから、俺達は自分の学校にやって来た。
strings.translated: After dropping Mei off at her school, we made our way to our own.

strings.text: 今日からここに通うんだな。
strings.translated: So this is where we'll be going from now on.

strings.text: これといって特別な感じはしないけど、何だか緊張感が増して来ていた。
strings.translated: It didn't feel particularly special, but I could feel the tension building inside me.

strings.text: この時期の転校生だし、結構目立ったりするんだろうか。
strings.translated: Transferring in at this point in the year -- would we stand out a lot?

strings.text: 普通なら新学年が始まるタイミングで引越すもんな
strings.translated: Normally you'd move at the start of a new school year.

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃあ、まずは職員室に行きましょうか
strings.translated: Mio「All right then, let's head to the staff room first.」

strings.text: 美桜「…ここからは別々に行動する？
strings.translated: Mio「...Should we go separately from here?」

strings.text: 大智「いや、一緒に行くよ
strings.translated: Daichi「No, I'll go with you.」

strings.text: 美桜「もう…私は１人でも大丈夫よ
strings.translated: Mio「Oh, honestly... I'm fine on my own, you know.」

strings.text: 大智「そんなんじゃないよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「It's not like that.

strings.text: 俺だって行くんだから、一緒でいいだろ
strings.translated: We're both going there anyway, so we might as well go together.」

strings.text: どうせ二人とも職員室に行くんだし、ここまで来て寄り道する当てがあるでもないし、２人で行くのが当然だ。
strings.translated: We were both heading to the staff room anyway, and it wasn't like either of us had somewhere else to stop along the way -- going together was the obvious choice.

strings.text: それは本心だったけど、姉さんのことが心配な気持ちもあった。
strings.translated: That was my honest reason, but I was also genuinely worried about Sis.

strings.text: 正直、芽生よりも心配だ。
strings.translated: Honestly, I was more worried about her than I was about Mei.

strings.text: 今はすごく元気に見えるけど、１人にして大丈夫だろうか。
strings.translated: She seemed perfectly fine right now, but would she really be okay on her own?

strings.text: １年近く引きこもっていて、部屋の外に出てくるようになったのはここ２、３ヶ月の話なのに、いきなり１人で、知らない人間ばかりの教室に取り残されて平気だろうか。
strings.translated: She'd been shut in her room for nearly a year, and it had only been two or three months since she'd started coming out -- could she really be all right, suddenly left alone in a classroom full of strangers?

strings.text: もちろん、俺のそんな心配を姉さんは感じ取っている。
strings.translated: Of course, Sis had already picked up on my concern.

strings.text: 苦笑いの表情からも、そのあたりのことは察せられる。
strings.translated: I could tell as much from the wry smile on her face.

strings.text: でも、初日くらいはいいじゃないか。
strings.translated: But come on -- at least on the first day, it was fine to worry.

strings.text: いつも一緒にいられるわけじゃないんだし、家族の心配をして何が悪いって言うんだ
strings.translated: It's not like I could always be by her side, and what was wrong with worrying about family?

strings.text: 心の中でそんなことを思いながら、姉さんとともに職員室へと向かった
strings.translated: Turning those thoughts over in my mind, I walked with Sis toward the staff room.

strings.text: 大智「白坂大智です。
strings.translated: Daichi「My name is Daichi Shiraka.

strings.text: 宜しくお願いします」
strings.translated: It's a pleasure to meet you.」

strings.text: 学校ではお決まりの自己紹介をさせられた。
strings.translated: The school had us do the standard self-introduction.

strings.text: 周りは知らない顔ぶればかりだから、正直かなり緊張する。
strings.translated: Everyone around me was a stranger, so I was honestly pretty nervous.

strings.text: あまり目立つのは好きじゃないから、こういうのは苦手だった。
strings.translated: I've never liked standing out, so this kind of thing was always hard for me.

strings.text: まあ、それでも子供じゃないんだし、時間が経てばクラスメイトらしい無難な関係が築けるとは思うけど…。
strings.translated: Still, I'm not a kid anymore -- I figured that with time I'd be able to build the usual comfortable relationships with my classmates... Teacher: "All right, Shiraka -- go ahead and take that empty seat over there.

strings.text: 先生「それじゃあ、白坂は…あそこの空いてる席に座ってくれ
大智「はい
strings.translated: Daichi「Yes, sir.」

strings.text: 自己紹介が終わって、指定された席へと向かう。
strings.translated: The self-introduction was over, and I made my way to the assigned seat.

strings.text: なるべく視線を合わさないようにしたけど、みんなの注目を浴びているのがわかった。
strings.translated: I tried not to make eye contact with anyone, but I could feel everyone's attention on me.

strings.text: とてもじゃないけど、周りを見回す勇気はない。
strings.translated: There was no way I had the nerve to look around the room.

strings.text: 誰かと視線が合ったりしたら、どんな反応をしたらいいのかわからなかった。
strings.translated: If I accidentally met someone's gaze, I wouldn't have known how to react.

strings.text: 初日だけだとは思うけど、やっぱりこういう空気は苦手だ。
strings.translated: I knew it would only be like this on the first day, but I still hated this kind of atmosphere.

strings.text: できることなら、早めに話ができる友達の１人くらい作りたかった
strings.translated: If I could, I wanted to make at least one friend I could talk to, and soon.

strings.text: 大智「ふぅ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Phew...」

strings.text: 自分の席に着いて、小さく吐息を漏らす。
strings.translated: I settled into my seat and let out a quiet breath.

strings.text: これから授業が始まるから、必要以上に視線を向けられることはないだろう。
strings.translated: Classes were about to start, so at least no one would be staring at me more than necessary.

strings.text: 幸いにして一番後ろの席だし、どんな生徒がいるのか彼らの後頭部くらいは見ることができた。
strings.translated: Fortunately, I'd been given a seat in the very back row, and I could make out the backs of my classmates' heads from there.

strings.text: 当然といえば当然だけど、本当にごく普通のクラスだ。
strings.translated: It was exactly what you'd expect -- a perfectly ordinary class.

strings.text: ひとまず、俺のほうは問題なし。
strings.translated: For now, at least, things on my end seemed fine.

strings.text: こうなってくると、気になるのは姉さんのことだった。
strings.translated: With that settled, my thoughts drifted back to Sis.

strings.text: 上手くやってるだろうか。
strings.translated: Was she managing okay?

strings.text: 辛い思いをしていないだろうか。
strings.translated: Was she having a hard time?

strings.text: あり得ないとは思うけど、事件のことを知ってるような奴がいたりしないだろうか。
strings.translated: It seemed unlikely, but -- was there anyone here who might know about what had happened?

strings.text: 授業をする先生が来るまでの間、そんなことばかり考えてしまった。
strings.translated: Until the teacher arrived to start class, those were the only thoughts running through my head.

strings.text: もしも…もしもだけど、姉さんのことを知ってる奴がいたりしたら、この街で静かに暮らすのは難しいだろう。
strings.translated: If -- just if -- there was someone here who knew about what had happened with Sis, living quietly in this town would be difficult.

strings.text: そうなったら、またどこかに引越すことも考えないといけないんだろうか。
strings.translated: If it came to that, would we have to think about moving somewhere else again?

strings.text: 両親は戸建てを購入してるから簡単にはいかないだろうけど、最悪そういった展開も考えないといけないだろう。
strings.translated: Our parents had already bought a house, so it wouldn't be easy -- but in the worst case, that might be something we'd have to consider.

strings.text: まあ、転校初日でこんな事を考えても仕方ないか
strings.translated: Well, there's no point thinking about all this on my very first day at a new school.

strings.text: ぼんやりとそんなことを思いながら、俺は何気なく教室の中を見回した。
strings.translated: Drifting through those thoughts, I absently let my gaze wander around the classroom.

strings.text: ほとんどのクラスメイトが後ろ姿しか見えなかったけど、ある人物を見たとき俺は小さく声を漏らした
strings.translated: Most of my classmates were only visible from behind, but when I spotted one particular person, a small sound escaped me.

strings.text: 大智「あれ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Huh?」

strings.text: 教室の中に１人だけ知った顔がいた。
strings.translated: There was one face in the classroom I recognized.

strings.text: 正確には顔はほとんど見えなかったけど、その後ろ姿には見覚えがあった。
strings.translated: Technically I could barely see her face, but I recognized her from behind.

strings.text: 髪の長い女の子。
strings.translated: A girl with long hair.

strings.text: 昨日、３人で買い物に行ったスーパーの前で会った女の子によく似た後ろ姿だった。
strings.translated: Her silhouette looked just like the girl we'd run into in front of the supermarket yesterday when the three of us went shopping.

strings.text: 長い髪の女の子なんていっぱいいるはずなのに、何故だか俺には昨日の女の子だってわかってしまった
strings.translated: There must be plenty of girls with long hair, and yet somehow I just knew -- it was the girl from yesterday.

strings.text: 大智「えっ」
strings.translated: Daichi「Huh?」

strings.text: マジで？
strings.translated: Seriously?

strings.text: 思わず声に出してしまう。
strings.translated: The words slipped out before I could stop them.

strings.text: よく似た別人なんじゃないかって思ったけど、彼女は間違いなく昨日の女の子だった。
strings.translated: I'd thought maybe it was just someone who looked like her, but she was unmistakably the girl from yesterday.

strings.text: いや、間違いなくって言うのは言い過ぎじゃないか？
strings.translated: Well -- "unmistakably" might be putting it a bit strongly.

strings.text: 単純に似てるだけかもしれないし、俺の記憶違いかもしれない。
strings.translated: She could simply look similar, or my memory could be off.

strings.text: でも、俺の位置からだとちょっとだけ横顔も見ることができて…あの顔は、どう見ても昨日の
strings.translated: But from where I was sitting, I could just barely make out her profile... and that face was, no matter how I looked at it, the same as yesterday's --

strings.text: ／愛
strings.translated: Ai

strings.text: 女の子がこっちを見た。
strings.translated: The girl looked over at me.

strings.text: 本当に一瞬だけだったけど、確かに俺のほうを見た。
strings.translated: It was only for an instant, but she definitely looked my way.

strings.text: やっぱりだ。
strings.translated: That confirmed it.

strings.text: 間違いない。
strings.translated: No mistake.

strings.text: 昨日会った女の子だ。
strings.translated: It was the girl I'd met yesterday.

strings.text: 人目を惹く整った顔立ちは見間違えようがなかった
strings.translated: Those striking, well-defined features were impossible to misremember.

strings.text: 大智「俺の事なんて、覚えてないかな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「I wonder if she even remembers me...」

strings.text: 彼女のことは気になるけど、今は声をかけられる状況じゃない。
strings.translated: I was curious about her, but now wasn't the right moment to go say something.

strings.text: それに昨日会ったからって、転校初日から話し掛けられるほど度胸があるわけでもない。
strings.translated: Besides, just because we'd met yesterday didn't mean I had the nerve to walk up and talk to someone on my very first day as a transfer student.

strings.text: …考えてみれば、多分たまたま近くに住んでいた同い年の女の子がクラスメイトだった、ってだけで、それほど特別な事じゃないのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, it was probably just a coincidence -- a girl around my age who happened to live nearby turned out to be in my class. Maybe that wasn't so special after all.

strings.text: でも…こんなに綺麗な女の子と引越し初日に出会って、しかも同じクラスだなんて……運命のようなものを期待しそうになる気持ちを押さえて、授業に集中することにした
strings.translated: But... meeting such a beautiful girl on the very first day I moved here, and then finding out she was in the same class... I pushed down the feeling that made me want to believe in something like fate, and decided to focus on class.

strings.text: 大智「はぁ…終わった
strings.translated: Daichi「Haah... finally over.」

strings.text: 午前の授業が終わった。
strings.translated: Morning classes were done.

strings.text: これといった問題もなく、無難に終えることができた。
strings.translated: Nothing had gone wrong -- I'd gotten through it without any trouble.

strings.text: 先生に指名されることもなかったし、ひとまずは安心といったところだ。
strings.translated: The teacher hadn't called on me either, so I was relieved for now.

strings.text: そんなに学力が低いってわけでもないけど、転校初日に指名されて答えられなかったりしたら、やっぱり格好悪い。
strings.translated: It wasn't like my grades were terrible, but getting called on and not knowing the answer on my very first day would have been embarrassing.

strings.text: とりあえず、昼休みになったわけだし落ち着いて食事でもしたいところなんだけど
strings.translated: Anyway, it was lunch break now, and I just wanted to sit back and eat in peace -- but.

strings.text: さて、これからどうしよう。
strings.translated: So, what now?

strings.text: クラスメイトのみんなは、教室で弁当の準備をしたり、友達と一緒に学食へ行ったりしている。
strings.translated: My classmates were getting their lunches ready at their desks or heading off to the cafeteria with friends.

strings.text: 遠巻きに俺を探っているような気配は時々感じたけど、俺も相手も、自分から話しかけるまでには至らなかった。
strings.translated: I occasionally got the sense that some of them were sizing me up from a distance, but neither they nor I had gotten as far as actually speaking to each other.

strings.text: ちょっと寂しいような気もするけど、１人で食べよう。
strings.translated: It felt a little lonely, but I'd eat by myself.

strings.text: 俺は姉さんの作ってくれた弁当があるから、学食に行く必要はない
strings.translated: I had the bento Sis made for me, so there was no need to go to the cafeteria.
Daichi「......Hm?」

strings.text: 弁当箱を鞄から取り出していると、誰かの視線を感じた。
strings.translated: I was pulling my bento box out of my bag when I felt someone's eyes on me.

strings.text: その方向を見てみると、あの女の子が俺のほうを見ていた
strings.translated: I looked in that direction, and the girl was watching me.

strings.text: 俺…だよな？
strings.translated: Me...right?

strings.text: 違う人を見てるわけじゃないよな？
strings.translated: She's not looking at someone else, right?

strings.text: もしかして、あの子も俺のことを覚えてくれてるんだろうか
strings.translated: Could it be that she remembers me too?

strings.text: これって、どうしたらいいんだ？
strings.translated: What am I supposed to do here?

strings.text: 俺のほうから声をかけてもいいのか？
strings.translated: Was it okay for me to be the one to say something?

strings.text: でも俺の勘違いだったりしたら恥ずかしいしな。
strings.translated: But if it turned out I was just imagining things, that would be pretty embarrassing.

strings.text: 気づかなかったふりをするのが無難だとは思うんだけど
strings.translated: I figured playing dumb and pretending not to notice was the safer move --

strings.text: 大智
strings.translated: Daichi

strings.text: 頭ではそんなことを考えながら、俺はゆっくりと席を立った
strings.translated: Even as those thoughts ran through my head, I slowly stood up from my seat.

strings.text: 女の子と目を合わせて彼女のほうへ近づいていく。
strings.translated: I held her gaze and walked toward her.

strings.text: すごく緊張する。
strings.translated: My heart was pounding.

strings.text: これで覚えてなかったり、俺を見ていたわけじゃなかったら、相当格好悪いことになりそうだ。
strings.translated: If it turned out she didn't remember me, or she hadn't been looking at me at all, this was going to be incredibly embarrassing.

strings.text: 彼女が覚えてくれてるといいんだけど
strings.translated: I really hoped she remembered.

strings.text: 大智「あの……昨日、会ったりしなかったっけ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Um... didn't we meet yesterday, by any chance?」

strings.text: ／愛「ええ、会ったと思う
strings.translated: /Ai「Yes, I think we did meet.

strings.text: 大智「ああ、やっぱり！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Ah, I knew it!」

strings.text: 良かった。
strings.translated: Thank goodness.

strings.text: 昨日の子だったんだ。
strings.translated: It really was the girl from yesterday.

strings.text: 彼女も覚えてくれてるみたいだし、俺は思わず安堵の息を漏らした
strings.translated: She seemed to remember me too, and I let out a quiet breath of relief.

strings.text: 大智「同じ学校で同じクラスになるなんて、すごい偶然だな
strings.translated: Daichi「What are the odds -- ending up at the same school and in the same class.」

strings.text: ／愛「そうね。
strings.translated: /Ai「That's right.

strings.text: すごい偶然ね」
strings.translated: What a coincidence.」

strings.text: 女の子は、少し笑った。
strings.translated: The girl smiled, just a little.

strings.text: 俺との再会を喜んでるってほどではないけど、鬱陶しく思ってる様子もない。
strings.translated: It wasn't quite the look of someone overjoyed to run into me again, but she didn't seem annoyed either.

strings.text: 本当に偶然だって思ってる程度の反応だ
strings.translated: It was just the kind of reaction you'd have when you genuinely think something is a coincidence.

strings.text: 大智「あ、俺…自己紹介の時にも言ったけど、白坂大智
strings.translated: Daichi「Oh, I... I mentioned it during my self-introduction too, but I'm Daichi Shiraka.」

strings.text: 愛「私は、神村愛
strings.translated: Ai「I'm Ai Kamimura.」

strings.text: 大智「神村さんな。
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura, got it.

strings.text: よし、覚えた」
strings.translated: Memorized.」

strings.text: やった。
strings.translated: Yes.

strings.text: 名前を教えてもらえた。
strings.translated: She told me her name.

strings.text: ……って、何浮かれてるんだ俺は。
strings.translated: ...Wait, why am I getting so worked up?

strings.text: こんな可愛い女の子が俺なんか相手にするわけないだろ。
strings.translated: There's no way a girl this cute would bother with someone like me.

strings.text: いや、そうじゃない。
strings.translated: No -- that's not the point.

strings.text: 俺は引越してきたばかりで、姉さんの事で手一杯で、いろいろ大変なんだ。
strings.translated: I just moved here, I've got my hands full with Sis, and things are complicated enough.

strings.text: 女の子相手に浮かれてる場合じゃないんだ
strings.translated: This is no time to be getting flustered over a girl.

strings.text: 大智「ええと…これからよろしく
strings.translated: Daichi「Um... I hope we can get along from here on.」

strings.text: 愛「ええ、よろしく
strings.translated: Ai「Yes, likewise.」

strings.text: 可愛い。
strings.translated: She was cute.

strings.text: ふっと口元を緩めた表情はお世辞抜きに可愛くて、それでいてどこか消え入りそうに儚い感じがして……俺は不本意ながら動揺する内心を押し隠して席に戻った。
strings.translated: The way her expression softened into a small smile was genuinely, no-flattery-about-it cute -- and yet there was something fragile about it, like she might fade away at any moment... Against my better judgment, I buried the flutter in my chest and returned to my seat.

strings.text: 自分に自制を課しながらも、しばらくは神村さんのことで頭がいっぱいだった
strings.translated: Even as I tried to keep myself in check, my thoughts were full of Kamimura for a good while after.

strings.text: 大智「ご馳走様でした」
strings.translated: Daichi「Thanks for the meal.」

strings.text: 結局、自分の席で弁当を食べて、俺は昼食の時間を終えた。
strings.translated: In the end, I ate my bento at my own desk and finished lunch alone.

strings.text: １人の食事になったけど、転校初日なんてこんなものだろう。
strings.translated: It was a lonely meal, but I guess that's just how the first day at a new school goes.

strings.text: 普通に暮らしてれば、そのうち話せるようになる奴も出てくるよな。
strings.translated: If I live normally, sooner or later there'll be people I can talk to.

strings.text: 友達作りとかあまり積極的なほうじゃないけど、ちょっとくらい頑張ってみるか。
strings.translated: I'm not exactly the type to go out of my way to make friends, but maybe I can try just a little.

strings.text: 姉さんだって頑張ってるだろうし
strings.translated: Sis is doing her best too, after all.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん、大丈夫かな」
strings.translated: Daichi「I wonder if Sis is doing okay.」

strings.text: 時間ができると、姉さんのことを考えてしまう。
strings.translated: Whenever I had a free moment, my thoughts drifted to Sis.

strings.text: 初日から友達ができて楽しく過ごせるとは思ってないけど、変な男に絡まれたり、昔のことを根掘り葉掘り訊かれたりしてないだろうか。
strings.translated: I didn't expect her to make friends on the first day and have a great time, but I couldn't help worrying -- had some weird guy bothered her, or had someone started prying into her past?

strings.text: 俺は普段は楽天的なほうのはずなんだけど、姉さんのことに関してはつい悪い方向に考えてしまいがちになっている。
strings.translated: I'm usually the optimistic type, but when it comes to Sis, I tend to let my mind go to dark places.

strings.text: もっと姉さんを信じないとダメだってわかってるんだけど、時間が解決してくれるのを待つしかないみたいだ。
strings.translated: I know I need to trust her more, but it seems like all I can do is wait for time to sort things out.

strings.text: …帰りも一緒でいいよな。
strings.translated: It's fine if we walk home together again, right?

strings.text: 授業が終わったら、姉さんのクラスまで迎えに行ってみようか。
strings.translated: Once classes are over, maybe I'll go to her classroom to pick her up.

strings.text: それとも逆に姉さんにプレッシャーを与えることになるだろうか
strings.translated: Or would it end up putting pressure on her instead?

strings.text: 大智「メールくらい送ってみるか
strings.translated: Daichi「Maybe I'll send her a message.」

strings.text: 今は昼休みだし、メールの一通くらいはいいだろう。
strings.translated: It was lunch break, so one message couldn't hurt.

strings.text: 携帯を取り出すと、俺は素早く短い文面を作った
strings.translated: I took out my phone and quickly typed something short.

strings.text: 調子はどう？
strings.translated: "How's it going?

strings.text: 何か問題ない？
strings.translated: "How's it going?

strings.text: 』たぶん大丈夫だと思うけど、どうしても不安が募ってしまう。
strings.translated: " I was probably worrying for nothing, but the anxiety kept piling up.

strings.text: 何か嫌なことが起きてないかって不安もあるけど、あまり構いすぎて姉さんに鬱陶しく思われるのも怖い。
strings.translated: I was scared something bad might have happened -- but I was also scared that hovering too much would make Sis find me annoying.

strings.text: …難しいな
strings.translated: ...This is hard.

strings.text: なんてことを考えていると、すぐに姉さんから返信が来た
strings.translated: As I was thinking all that, a reply from Sis came back almost immediately.

strings.text: 大丈夫。
strings.translated: I'll be fine.

strings.text: 普通に過ごせてるから』ニコニコ笑ってる絵文字まで入ったメールだった。
strings.translated: I've been doing fine.' The message even had a little smiling emoji in it.

strings.text: 文面を見る限り、特に問題はないらしい。
strings.translated: Judging by the message, it seemed like there wasn't any particular problem.

strings.text: すぐにメールが返ってきたことを考えても、嘘をついてる感じはしなかった
strings.translated: The fact that she'd replied so quickly made it hard to think she was lying.

strings.text: 俺は一人で昼飯。
strings.translated: I'm eating lunch alone.

strings.text: ちょっと寂しい
strings.translated: A little lonely.

strings.text: 手持無沙汰であることをアピールするように、そんな文面を送ってみた。
strings.translated: I sent that, as if advertising that I had nothing to do.

strings.text: わざとらしかったかな。
strings.translated: Was that too obvious?

strings.text: …いや、そんなことをいちいち気にする時点でおかしいんだ。
strings.translated: ...No, it's weird to even overthink something like that.

strings.text: 別に普通の会話だろ
strings.translated: It's just normal conversation.

strings.text: でも
strings.translated: But then --

strings.text: 転校初日だものね。
strings.translated: It is your first day at a new school, after all.

strings.text: 大智ならきっとすぐに友達ができるから大丈夫』うん。
strings.translated: I'm sure Daichi will make friends right away, so don't worry.' Yeah.

strings.text: 気にしてなさそう…かな。
strings.translated: She didn't seem too concerned... I think.

strings.text: こんなところでいいだろう。
strings.translated: That should do it.

strings.text: あまり長くはならないようにして、姉さんとのメールを終える。
strings.translated: I kept it from going on too long and wrapped up the exchange with Sis.

strings.text: 過剰に心配する必要はなさそうだけど、今日をどんなふうに過ごしたのかは下校のときにでも聞いてみよう
strings.translated: It didn't seem like I needed to worry too much, but I'd ask her how the day went when she got home.

strings.text: 大智「…何だか夢みたいだな」
strings.translated: Daichi「...It all feels like a dream somehow.」

strings.text: こんなふうに普通の学校生活が送れるなんて、一時期は完全に諦めてしまっていた。
strings.translated: Living a normal school life like this -- there was a time when I'd completely given up on it.

strings.text: 事件以来、姉さんは部屋に引きこもってしまったし、俺に対するクラスメイト達の接し方も変わっていった。
strings.translated: Ever since the incident, Sis had shut herself in her room, and the way my classmates treated me had changed too.

strings.text: いじめられたわけじゃないけど、何だか距離を置かれたような感じで…俺もだんだん話をしなくなっていった。
strings.translated: It wasn't bullying exactly, but there was this distance, like they were keeping me at arm's length... and gradually I stopped talking to people too.

strings.text: こういった事件を完全に隠し通すのは難しかったらしい。
strings.translated: It turned out to be impossible to keep something like that completely hidden.

strings.text: 姉さんの身に起きたことは、少しずつだけど学校や家の近所に広まっていったみたいだった。
strings.translated: What had happened to Sis slowly spread through school and around the neighborhood.

strings.text: 慰めてくれる人もいたけど、逆にそれが辛かったりもする。
strings.translated: Some people tried to comfort me, but that almost made it harder.

strings.text: こんな悲しいことが現実に起こったんだって、それを実感せずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: It forced me to feel the reality of it -- that something this terrible had actually happened.

strings.text: だから、姉さんがこの街に引越したいって言ったとき、動揺もしたけどすごく嬉しかった。
strings.translated: So when Sis said she wanted to move to this city, I was shaken, but also genuinely happy.

strings.text: 何かをやる気になったんだって、何かの一歩を踏み出したんだって、そう思うことができた。
strings.translated: I thought it meant she wanted to do something, that she was taking a step forward.

strings.text: それに、俺自身もやり直せるって。
strings.translated: And that I could start over too.

strings.text: もっとも、ここまで急に、普通の生活に戻れるとは思ってなかったんだけど
strings.translated: Though I hadn't expected it to happen this fast -- to be back to something like a normal life so suddenly.

strings.text: 大智「本当に明るくなったよな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「She really has gotten brighter...」

strings.text: いったい何が姉さんをあんなに強くしたんだろう。
strings.translated: I wonder what made Sis so strong.

strings.text: まだそのあたりのことを聞いたことはなかったけど、今なら少しくらい触れてみてもいいだろうか。
strings.translated: I hadn't asked her about any of that yet -- but maybe now it would be okay to touch on it a little.

strings.text: それとも、もう少しそっとしておいた方がいいのか…。
strings.translated: Or maybe I should leave it alone a bit longer...

strings.text: 何にせよ、いい兆しだ
strings.translated: Either way, it's a good sign.

strings.text: 大智「…うん」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Yeah.」

strings.text: 明るい希望が見えてきた。
strings.translated: A bright hope was coming into view.

strings.text: 姉さんが立ち直ってくれれば、家族全体が元の関係に戻ることができる。
strings.translated: If Sis could get back on her feet, the whole family could return to what we used to be.

strings.text: 父さんも母さんも、そのために頑張って働いてくれてるんだし、俺も自分にできる精一杯のことをやりたかった
strings.translated: Dad and Mom were both working hard for exactly that, and I wanted to do everything I could on my end too.

strings.text: 大智「さてと…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Well then...」

strings.text: 今日の授業が終わって、俺はすぐに廊下に出た。
strings.translated: When class ended for the day, I stepped out into the hallway right away.

strings.text: 向かう場所は姉さんの教室。
strings.translated: My destination was Sis's classroom.

strings.text: メールを読む限りでは元気そうだけど、様子を見に行くくらいは良いだろう。
strings.translated: Judging from her messages, she seemed to be doing fine -- but it couldn't hurt to stop by and check on her.

strings.text: どうせ姉さんも用事はないだろうし、一緒に帰っても
strings.translated: Sis probably didn't have anything going on anyway, so walking home together would be

strings.text: 大智「ん…？
strings.translated: Daichi「Hm...?」

strings.text: ３年生の教室の前まで行くと、ちょうど姉さんが出てきたところだった。
strings.translated: When I got to the third-year classrooms, Sis was just coming out.

strings.text: 知らない女の子と一緒に歩いている。
strings.translated: She was walking with a girl I didn't recognize.

strings.text: 誰だろう？
strings.translated: Who was that?

strings.text: 同じクラスの人か？
strings.translated: Someone from the same class?

strings.text: もしかして、もう友達ができたってこと？
strings.translated: Could it be that she'd already made a friend?

strings.text: さすがに、それは早いと思うんだけど
strings.translated: That seemed fast, even for her.

strings.text: 美桜「大智？
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi?

strings.text: こんなところでどうしたの？」
strings.translated: What are you doing all the way over here?」

strings.text: 声をかけるより先に、姉さんが俺に気づいた
strings.translated: Before I could say anything, Sis noticed me.

strings.text: 大智「いや…どうしてるかなって思って
strings.translated: Daichi「Oh... I was just wondering how you were doing.」

strings.text: 美桜「もしかして、迎えに来てくれたの？
strings.translated: Mio「Did you come to walk me home?」

strings.text: 大智「まあ、そんな感じ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Well... something like that.」

strings.text: 面と向かって言われると、ちょっと恥ずかしい
strings.translated: Hearing it said to my face made me feel a little embarrassed.

strings.text: 大智「…友達？
strings.translated: Daichi「...A friend?」

strings.text: 美桜「あ、うん。
strings.translated: Mio「Ah, yeah.

strings.text: こちら、小野田友佳さん
strings.translated: This is Yuka Onoda.」

strings.text: 友佳「初めまして。
strings.translated: Yuka「It's so nice to meet you.

strings.text: 私、小野田友佳。
strings.translated: I'm Yuka Onoda.

strings.text: ２年Ｃ組。
strings.translated: Class 2-C.

strings.text: 大智君の隣だね。
strings.translated: You're right next to Daichi, aren't you.

strings.text: お姉ちゃん迎えに来るなんて、優しいんだ
strings.translated: Coming to pick up your big sister -- that's so sweet

strings.text: 大智「いや、そんなんじゃ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「No, it's not like that...」

strings.text: 思わず言葉を濁した。
strings.translated: I fumbled for words without thinking.

strings.text: 言葉どおりの意味にしても、暗にシスコンだとか、一人じゃ何もできない奴だとか言われたのだとしても、どう反応したらいいのかわからなかった
strings.translated: Whether she meant it literally, or was subtly calling me a sister-obsessed guy who couldn't do anything on his own, I had no idea how to respond.

strings.text: 大智「それじゃあ、小野田さんと一緒に帰る？
strings.translated: Daichi「So, are you heading home with Onoda-san?」

strings.text: 美桜「うん、そうする」
strings.translated: Mio「Yeah, I will.」

strings.text: 意外だったけど、友達と一緒なら俺がいない方がいいだろうし、ついていくわけにもいかない
strings.translated: It was unexpected, but if she was with a friend, I'd only be in the way -- there was no reason for me to tag along.

strings.text: 大智「わかった。
strings.translated: Daichi「Got it.

strings.text: じゃあ……気を付けて
strings.translated: Then... be careful.」

strings.text: 美桜「了解。
strings.translated: Mio「Will do.

strings.text: 友佳と少し遊んでいくけど、あまり遅くはならないと思うから。
strings.translated: Yuka and I are going to hang out for a bit, but I don't think I'll be too late.

strings.text: 心配しないで」
strings.translated: Don't worry.」

strings.text: 姉さんが楽しそうな表情で笑う。
strings.translated: Sis smiled, looking genuinely happy.

strings.text: 辛い事なんか何もなかったって感じだ。
strings.translated: Like there was nothing painful in her life at all.

strings.text: もちろん、実際はそうじゃないんだろうけど、元気にしてる姉さんを見ているとやっぱり安心する
strings.translated: Of course, that wasn't really true -- but seeing her like this, cheerful and at ease, I felt relieved all the same.

strings.text: 大智「じゃ、先に帰ってる
strings.translated: Daichi「Okay, I'll head home first then.」

strings.text: 美桜「ええ、大智も気を付けてね
strings.translated: Mio「Sure. You be careful too, Daichi.」

strings.text: 姉さんに軽く手を振って、昇降口のほうへと引き返す。
strings.translated: I gave Sis a small wave and turned back toward the shoe lockers.

strings.text: あの様子だと、過度に心配する必要はなさそうだ。
strings.translated: From the look of things, there was no need to worry too much.

strings.text: どこか寄り道するっていうのは、それだけの精神的な余裕があるってことだしな。
strings.translated: Going out of her way to hang out somewhere meant she had that much mental breathing room.

strings.text: もしかすると、俺が思ってるよりもずっと姉さんは立ち直ってるのかもしれない
strings.translated: Maybe Sis had recovered even more than I'd realized.

strings.text: 大智「それにしても、まさか初日から友達ができるなんて…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Still, I never thought she'd make a friend on the very first day...」

strings.text: 驚きはしたものの、その一方で納得することもできる。
strings.translated: I was surprised, and yet at the same time it made a certain kind of sense.

strings.text: 冷静に考えてみれば、事件前の姉さんは、おっとりしてはいるけど社交的な人だった。
strings.translated: Thinking about it calmly, before the incident, Sis had been easygoing but sociable.

strings.text: クラスで友達は多かったし、先生達からの評判も良かった。
strings.translated: She'd had plenty of friends in class, and the teachers all spoke well of her.

strings.text: 家のこともあって夜遊びみたいなことはしなかったけど、それでも時間があれば友達と一緒にどこかへ遊びに行っていたように思う。
strings.translated: Because of things at home she never really went out at night, but even so, whenever she had free time, I think she'd go out somewhere with her friends.

strings.text: 昔の姉さんに戻ってきてるんだな…。
strings.translated: She's coming back... back to the way Sis used to be.

strings.text: そのことを実感すると、何だか目頭が熱くなってきた。
strings.translated: Feeling that truth sink in, I found my eyes growing hot.

strings.text: こんなところで泣くわけにはいかないのに、少し上を向いてないと涙がこぼれてしまいそうだった。
strings.translated: I couldn't let myself cry here -- but if I didn't tilt my head up a little, the tears were going to spill over.

strings.text: 父さんと母さんが聞いたらきっと喜ぶだろう。
strings.translated: Dad and Mom would be so happy to hear this.

strings.text: ２人の笑顔を思い浮かべると、俺もとても嬉しくなってしまった
strings.translated: Picturing their smiling faces, I felt a warmth welling up inside me too.

strings.text: 大智「よし、帰るか」
strings.translated: Daichi「All right, time to head home.」

strings.text: 姉さんと一緒に帰るつもりだったけど、大人しく１人で帰ることにしよう。
strings.translated: I'd planned to walk back with Sis, but I'd just go home quietly on my own.

strings.text: それとも、俺もどこか寄り道して、この街のことを知るのもいいかもしれないな。
strings.translated: Or maybe I could wander around a bit and get to know this city better.

strings.text: これから長く住んでいくんだし、少しでも早くここに慣れるように頑張ろう
strings.translated: I'm going to be living here for a long time, so I should try to get comfortable here as soon as I can.

strings.text: 大智「ただいま
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm home.」

strings.text: 芽生「お帰りなさ～い」
strings.translated: Mei「Welcome baaack~.」

strings.text: 街を見るのに多少の寄り道はしたものの、あまり遅くならないうちに俺は家に帰った
strings.translated: I'd taken a small detour to look around the neighborhood, but I made it home before it got too late.

strings.text: 大智「ごめんな。
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry.

strings.text: 遅くなって
strings.translated: I took a while.」

strings.text: 芽生「どこか行って来たの？
strings.translated: Mei「Did you go somewhere?」

strings.text: 大智「ちょっとだけ寄り道して来たかな。
strings.translated: Daichi「Just a little detour.

strings.text: …芽生は真っ直ぐ帰って来たのか？
strings.translated: ...Did you come straight home, Mei?」

strings.text: 芽生「うん
strings.translated: Mei「Yep.」

strings.text: 大智「そうか。
strings.translated: Daichi「Good girl.

strings.text: 偉いぞ」
strings.translated: Well done.」

strings.text: 俺や姉さんの言いつけを守って、芽生はちゃんと真っ直ぐに下校したようだった。
strings.translated: It seemed Mei had listened to what Sis and I told her and come straight home from school.

strings.text: 今はリビングにあるソファーに座って、たぶん姉さんが用意しておいたお菓子を発見して１人で食べてるところだ。
strings.translated: Right now she was sitting on the living room sofa, having apparently discovered the snacks Sis had probably left out, and was eating them by herself.

strings.text: 特に普段と変わらない様子だし、学校では問題なく過ごせたみたいだ
strings.translated: She seemed perfectly normal, so it looked like she'd gotten through the school day without any trouble.

strings.text: 大智「どうだった？
strings.translated: Daichi「So, how was it?

strings.text: 学校は
strings.translated: School was

strings.text: 楽しかったよ
strings.translated: fun.

strings.text: 大智「それなら良かった。
strings.translated: Daichi「Glad to hear it.

strings.text: 友達できそうか？
strings.translated: Think you'll make any friends?」

strings.text: 芽生「まだわかんないけど、できたらいいなぁ
strings.translated: Mei「I'm not sure yet, but I hope so~.」

strings.text: 大智「芽生なら大丈夫だよ」
strings.translated: Daichi「You'll be fine, Mei.」

strings.text: 人懐っこい性格をしてる芽生のことだ。
strings.translated: That's Mei for you -- she's got a naturally friendly personality.

strings.text: たぶん、数日もすれば新しい友達ができるだろう。
strings.translated: She'd probably have new friends within a few days.

strings.text: 姉さんにもできたみたいだし、一番問題なのは俺のような気がしてきた
strings.translated: Sis seemed to have made one already, so if anything, I was starting to think I was the one with the most to worry about.

strings.text: 芽生「お兄ちゃんは？
strings.translated: Mei「What about you, big brother?」

strings.text: 大智「俺も普通に過ごせたよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「I got through the day fine too.

strings.text: まだ、友達はできてないけど
strings.translated: I haven't made any friends yet, though.」

strings.text: 芽生「お姉ちゃん、大丈夫だったかな？
strings.translated: Mei「I wonder if Sis is doing okay?」

strings.text: 大智「姉ちゃんはもう友達ができたみたいで、その人とちょっと寄り道してくるって
strings.translated: Daichi「Looks like she already made a friend, actually. She said she's going to hang out with them for a bit on the way home.」

strings.text: 芽生「そうなんだ」
strings.translated: Mei「Oh, really.」

strings.text: 姉さんの様子を聞いて、芽生もとても嬉しそうだった。
strings.translated: Hearing about how Sis was doing, Mei looked genuinely happy.

strings.text: 芽生には姉さんの事件の事は詳しく知らせていない。
strings.translated: We hadn't told Mei the details of what happened to Sis.

strings.text: でも、その後の引き篭もり生活は把握している。
strings.translated: But she did know about the months of shutting herself in her room afterward.

strings.text: 明るかった姉さんが部屋から出て来なくなったことに、当時は不安と戸惑いを感じていたようだった。
strings.translated: She'd seemed anxious and confused back then, watching the once-bright Sis stop coming out of her room.

strings.text: だからこそ、新しい街に引越して新しい生活をスタートさせることを、芽生も了承してくれたわけなんだけど
strings.translated: That was part of why Mei had agreed to the move -- a new town, a fresh start.

strings.text: 大智「父さんと母さんにもメールしとくか
strings.translated: Daichi「I should send Dad and Mom an email.」

strings.text: 仕事が忙しい２人だけど、子供のことはすごく気にしてくれてる。
strings.translated: The two of them were busy with work, but they worried a lot about us kids.

strings.text: 特に姉さんのことは心配してるだろうし、少しでも早く安心させてやりたかった。
strings.translated: They'd be especially worried about Sis, and I wanted to put their minds at ease as soon as I could.

strings.text: 初日から友達ができたって知ったら、嬉しいだろうし安心もするだろうな
strings.translated: If they heard she'd already made a friend on the very first day, they'd be happy -- and relieved.

strings.text: 大智「さて、俺はもう少し昨日の続きをするか」
strings.translated: Daichi「All right, I guess I'll get back to what I was doing yesterday.」

strings.text: 引越してきたばかりだから、まだまだ部屋のあちこちに片付いていない荷物が残っている。
strings.translated: We'd only just moved in, so there were still boxes and bags scattered all over the place.

strings.text: こういうのは、少しずつでもやっていくクセを付けないと、そのままになったりするんだよな。
strings.translated: If I didn't get into the habit of chipping away at it little by little, it would just sit there forever.

strings.text: 自分の部屋だってゴチャついてるし、気合いを入れて頑張らないと
strings.translated: My room was still a mess, and I was going to have to buckle down and push through it.

strings.text: 大智「ふぅ…。
strings.translated: Daichi「Phew...」

strings.text: 少し休憩するか
strings.translated: I should take a little break.

strings.text: 自分の部屋の片付けを中断して、俺はベッドの上に寝転がった。
strings.translated: I stopped unpacking my room and flopped down on the bed.

strings.text: 荷物の半分くらいは整理したけど、何だか疲れてしまった。
strings.translated: I'd sorted through about half the boxes, but somehow I was already exhausted.

strings.text: 急ぐことはないんだし、続きは明日に回すとしよう
strings.translated: There was no rush, so I'd leave the rest for tomorrow.

strings.text: 大智「天井高けぇな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Man, the ceiling's high...」

strings.text: 新しい家は、前の家よりも天井が高かった。
strings.translated: The new house had higher ceilings than the old one.

strings.text: 新築だから壁や床も綺麗で、それだけでテンションが上がってしまう。
strings.translated: It was brand new, so the walls and floors were clean too -- just that alone was enough to lift my spirits.

strings.text: これから、この部屋で過ごすことが多くなる。
strings.translated: From now on, I'd be spending a lot of time in this room.

strings.text: 学校での生活が順調だった分、これから先の生活もすごく明るくなるんじゃないかって、俺は大きな期待を胸に抱いてしまっていた
strings.translated: Things had been going well at school, and I found myself holding onto a big, bright hope that the rest of my life here was going to be just as good.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん、大丈夫かな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「I wonder if Sis is okay...」

strings.text: 期待が大きくなると、その分だけ不安も大きくなってしまったりする。
strings.translated: The bigger your hopes get, the bigger your worries tend to get right along with them.

strings.text: 学校での様子を見て大丈夫だと思ったけど、もう日も沈んできた。
strings.translated: Seeing how she'd been at school, I thought she was fine -- but the sun was already going down.

strings.text: さすがに心配だ。
strings.translated: I couldn't help worrying.

strings.text: メールしてみようか？
strings.translated: Should I send her a message?

strings.text: それとも、流石に鬱陶しいだろうか
strings.translated: Or would that just be annoying at this point?

strings.text: 大智「まあ、一通くらいなら
strings.translated: Daichi「Well... one message can't hurt.」

strings.text: 軽く心配する程度の文面を作って、姉さんのアドレスに送信する
strings.translated: I put together something casual -- just enough to show I was a little worried -- and sent it to Sis's address.

strings.text: 返事が来るまでしばらくかかるかと思ったけど、意外にもすぐに返って来た
strings.translated: I thought it might take a while to hear back, but her reply came surprisingly fast.

strings.text: 今、友佳に色々案内してもらってるの。
strings.translated: "Yuka's been showing me around.

strings.text: 話が弾んで遅くなっちゃって。
strings.translated: We got to talking and it ran late.

strings.text: もう少ししたら帰ります』笑顔の絵文字が入っていたりして、楽しんでる様子が伝わってくる。
strings.translated: I'll be home soon." There was a little smiley face emoji in there too -- I could tell she was having a good time.

strings.text: この分だと、本当に心配する必要はないみたいだ。
strings.translated: At this rate, it seemed like I really didn't need to worry.

strings.text: 姉さんは立ち直ったんだって、それが実感できるメールだった
strings.translated: It was a message that made it real -- Sis had gotten back on her feet.

strings.text: 大智「良かった…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Thank goodness...」

strings.text: 姉さんの笑顔を想像して、安堵の吐息を漏す。
strings.translated: I pictured Sis's smile and let out a quiet sigh of relief.

strings.text: 全ての心配が拭えたわけじゃないけど、これからの生活は楽しいものになりそうだった。
strings.translated: Not every worry had been swept away, but it felt like the life ahead of us was going to be a good one.

strings.text: 事件以来、姉さんのことを心配しない日はなかったけど、それもだんだん過去のものになっていくのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Since the incident, there hadn't been a single day I hadn't worried about Sis -- but maybe that was slowly becoming a thing of the past.

strings.text: 新しい生活が始まったのは俺も同じなんだし、もっと自分のことを中心に考えてもいいのかもしれない。
strings.translated: A new life was starting for me too, and maybe it was okay to start thinking a little more about myself.

strings.text: たとえば…気になる女の子のこととか
strings.translated: Like, for instance... a certain girl I couldn't stop thinking about.

strings.text: 大智「神村愛
strings.translated: Daichi「Ai Kamimura.」

strings.text: 名前は一発で覚えてしまった。
strings.translated: I'd memorized her name instantly.

strings.text: ほんの少しだけど、話すことができたのもすごく嬉しかった。
strings.translated: It made me genuinely happy that we'd been able to talk, even if only for a moment.

strings.text: 考えてみれば、クラスの中で唯一まともに会話ができた人だ
strings.translated: Come to think of it, she was the only person in the whole class I'd had any kind of real conversation with.

strings.text: 大智「仲良くできるといいんだけど…」
strings.translated: Daichi「It'd be nice if we could get along...」

strings.text: 前の学校では、特別仲の良い女友達はいなかった。
strings.translated: At my old school, I'd never had any close girl friends.

strings.text: だからどう接したらいいのかよく判らない。
strings.translated: So I really didn't know how to go about it.

strings.text: 偶然、会話するきっかけは生まれたけど、仲良くなるためにはいったい何をすればいいんだろう。
strings.translated: We'd stumbled into a conversation by chance, but what exactly was I supposed to do to actually become friends with her?

strings.text: 積極的に話しかける？
strings.translated: Make the effort to talk to her?

strings.text: それとも、最初は挨拶程度にとどめる？
strings.translated: Or keep it to just a greeting at first?

strings.text: 急に仲良くしようとすると、下心があるんじゃないかって疑われて引かれそうな気がする。
strings.translated: If I tried to get close too fast, I had a feeling she'd suspect I had ulterior motives and pull away.

strings.text: 第一、まだ仲の良い男友達もいないのに、先に女の子に声をかけてたら軽い奴だって思われるんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Besides, I didn't even have any close guy friends yet -- if I was already going out of my way to talk to a girl, wouldn't people think I was some kind of player?

strings.text: いや、あれだけ可愛ければ男が寄って来るのも無理はないか。
strings.translated: Well, if she was that cute, it wasn't exactly surprising that guys would flock to her.

strings.text: …そう考えると、相当競争率が……いや、そもそも俺なんて相手にされない可能性の方が
strings.translated: Which meant the competition was probably pretty fierce... no, wait -- the more likely problem was that she wouldn't even look twice at someone like me.

strings.text: 大智「…って、馬鹿か俺は」
strings.translated: Daichi「...God, what is wrong with me.」

strings.text: たった２回会っただけで、どうしてこんなにおめでたい思考になれるんだ。
strings.translated: I've only met her twice and I'm already thinking like this?

strings.text: あまり変なことは考えないようにしよう。
strings.translated: I need to stop letting my imagination run away with me.

strings.text: 浮かれたことをして恥を掻くのは自分なんだし
strings.translated: If I do something embarrassing because I got carried away, I'm the one who'll have to live with it.

strings.text: 大智「神村さんか…どんな女の子なんだろう」
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san, huh... I wonder what kind of girl she is.」

strings.text: 部屋の天井を見つめながら、神村さんのことを考える。
strings.translated: Staring up at the ceiling of my room, I found myself thinking about Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 会ったばかりなのに、何故だか……容姿の綺麗さ以上に惹かれてしまっていた
strings.translated: We'd only just met, and yet, for some reason... I was drawn to her beyond just her looks.

strings.text: 大智「こんな話ができる友達も、いたらいいんだけどな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「It'd be nice if I had a friend I could talk to like this...」

strings.text: 日常の事や女の子の事で、下らない話をして笑いあったり…そんな友達がまたできるだろうか
