strings.translated: Laughing over stupid stuff -- everyday things, girls -- the kind of friend you could just shoot the breeze with... would I ever find someone like that again?

strings.text: …平和だ。
strings.translated: Peaceful.

strings.text: 日々の生活が穏やかじゃないと、こんなことは考えられない。
strings.translated: You can't think about things like this unless your daily life is calm.

strings.text: 姉さんの心の傷も癒えてきたからこそ、他のことを考える余裕が出てきたんだろうな。
strings.translated: I guess it's because Nee-san's wounds have started to heal that I finally have the room to think about other things.

strings.text: 本当に良かった
strings.translated: I'm really glad.

strings.text: 美桜
strings.translated: Mio

strings.text: 自分の身に何が起こるのか、はっきりと理解できたのは、服の上から胸を揉まれたときだった。
strings.translated: I didn't fully understand what was happening to me until they groped my chest through my clothes.

strings.text: 手足を押さえつけられ、自由を奪われた中で、私は自分の体が穢されることを本能的に理解した。
strings.translated: Pinned down, my arms and legs held, my freedom gone -- I understood instinctively that my body was being defiled.

strings.text: 男達の興奮した声。
strings.translated: The men's excited voices.

strings.text: ねっとりとした熱い吐息。
strings.translated: Hot, wet breath.

strings.text: 服の中に入り込んで来るたくさんの手。
strings.translated: Countless hands pushing under my clothes.

strings.text: 耳の奥では、笑い声とか口笛とか、とにかく色々な音が響いていた。
strings.translated: Deep in my ears, laughter and whistling and all kinds of sounds echoed together.

strings.text: 殺されるかもしれない。
strings.translated: I might be killed.

strings.text: 犯される中で、私はそんなことさえ考えていた。
strings.translated: Even as I was being violated, I was thinking that.

strings.text: 何人もの男の性器を受け入れながら、死にたくないと願い続けていた
strings.translated: Even as I took one man after another inside me, I kept praying that I didn't want to die.

strings.text: 命が助かったことを、良かったと思ったことはなかった。
strings.translated: I never once felt glad that I had survived.

strings.text: 精液まみれで捨てられていた私は、現場近くの住人に発見されて病院へと搬送された。
strings.translated: I had been left behind, covered in semen, and was found by a resident near the scene and taken to the hospital.

strings.text: だから、私がレイプされたという話はすぐに広まったし、それに対する嫌がらせも始まった。
strings.translated: So word spread quickly that I had been raped, and the harassment began just as fast.

strings.text: 自宅に届く手紙は両親が処分してたみたいだけど、個人のメールアドレスに届くほうはどうしようもない。
strings.translated: Letters sent to the house were apparently disposed of by my parents, but there was nothing they could do about my personal email address.

strings.text: 犯された私を嘲笑うようなメールが、１日の間に何通も届いていた
strings.translated: Messages mocking me for what had been done to me arrived one after another throughout the day.

strings.text: 美桜「もう…死にたい…」
strings.translated: Mio「I just... want to die...」

strings.text: 部屋の隅で膝を抱えながら、私は毎日死ぬことばかりを考えていた。
strings.translated: Hugging my knees in the corner of my room, I spent every day thinking about nothing but death.

strings.text: この苦しみから逃れる方法は、それしか思いつかなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't think of any other way to escape this pain.

strings.text: 生きているから苦しい。
strings.translated: Being alive was what hurt.

strings.text: 死ねば楽になれる。
strings.translated: If I died, I could finally rest.

strings.text: そんな短絡的な思考にとらわれた私は、どうすれば楽に…そして、せめて家族に迷惑をかけずに死ねるのかを探し求めるようになった。
strings.translated: Trapped in that kind of simplistic thinking, I began searching for a way to die -- easily, and without burdening my family if I could help it.

strings.text: 方法は至って単純で、インターネットの自殺サイト巡り。
strings.translated: The method was simple enough: browsing suicide sites on the internet.

strings.text: どんなふうにすれば死ぬことができるのか。
strings.translated: What did you have to do in order to die?

strings.text: どう言った方法であれば、楽に命を絶つことができるのか。
strings.translated: What method would let you end your life without suffering?

strings.text: 全く知識のなかった私にとって、そういったサイトでの会話はまるで別世界の言葉だった。
strings.translated: For someone like me who had known nothing about any of this, the conversations on those sites felt like words from another world entirely.

strings.text: 悲しみに暮れていて、明日にだって死にそうな人。
strings.translated: People drowning in grief, who looked like they might die the very next day.

strings.text: 自殺したいはずなのに、やけに陽気な書き込みをする人。
strings.translated: People who, despite claiming to want to die, wrote with a strangely cheerful tone.

strings.text: 本当に死にたいのかどうか怪しいくらい、周りを挑発するだけの人。
strings.translated: People who seemed so doubtful about whether they really wanted to die that all they did was provoke everyone around them.

strings.text: 世の中には、こんなにも多くの人が死にたいって思ってるんだってことを、私はこの時初めて知った。
strings.translated: It was the first time I truly understood that there were this many people in the world who wanted to die.

strings.text: そして、今や私もその中の１人なんだってことを、自覚せずにはいられなかった
strings.translated: And I couldn't help but become aware that I was now one of them.

strings.text: 美桜「こんな方法があるんだ…」
strings.translated: Mio「So there are methods like this...」

strings.text: 簡単にできる自殺の方法も様々なものがあった。
strings.translated: There were all kinds of methods for dying that were supposedly easy to carry out.

strings.text: 苦しくないものもあれば、逆にとても苦しい方法も紹介されていた。
strings.translated: Some were said to be painless; others, on the contrary, were described as extremely agonizing.

strings.text: 正直、本当に自分が死ぬために情報を集めてるのかって思うようなものもあったけど、私には関係のないことだった。
strings.translated: Honestly, some of it made me wonder if I was really gathering information to actually kill myself -- but that wasn't something I had the luxury of worrying about.

strings.text: 果たして、どの方法なら私にもできるのか
strings.translated: Which method, if any, was something I could actually go through with?

strings.text: 毎日、インターネットで検索しながら、私は一番楽な死に方を探した。
strings.translated: Every day I searched online, looking for the easiest way to die.

strings.text: あえて苦しみたいとは思わないし、死体の処理なんかで両親に迷惑をかけたいとも思わない。
strings.translated: I didn't want to suffer unnecessarily, and I didn't want to burden my parents with having to deal with my body.

strings.text: 誰にも迷惑をかけずに死ぬことができるのなら、それが一番良かった
strings.translated: If I could die without causing trouble for anyone, that would be best.

strings.text: 美桜「富士の樹海…入水…練炭…」
strings.translated: Mio「Aokigahara... drowning... charcoal briquettes...」

strings.text: 簡単にできそうだったのは薬物を使用する方法だったけど、それを入手するのが大変だった。
strings.translated: I didn't have money, and if my family received the package before I did, they might figure out what I was planning.

strings.text: お金だってあるわけじゃないし、私より先に家族が荷物を受け取ってしまったら、そこから自殺の事がバレてしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: And dying at home would still cause them a significant amount of trouble.

strings.text: それに、自宅で死んだらやっぱり相応の迷惑がかかってしまう。
strings.translated: To avoid putting them through that, I would need to slip out of the house quietly and die somewhere no one would find me.

strings.text: そういった苦労をかけないようにするのなら、こっそりと家を抜け出して誰にも見つからない場所で死ぬべきだった。
strings.translated: But at the time, I didn't even have the energy to travel to Aokigahara -- and beyond that, I was afraid in a way that had nothing to do with dying.

strings.text: でも、その時の私には樹海に行く気力すらなくて、それに死ぬのとは別の意味で怖くもあった。
strings.translated: If something like that happened to me again... It sounds strange, but when you're searching for a way to die, you apparently start to get picky about it.

strings.text: もし、また、あんな目に遭ったら……変な話だけど、死ぬ方法を探していると、それはそれで贅沢になってしまうものらしかった。
strings.translated: Maybe because I couldn't make up my mind like that, I stumbled one day onto something called a "Suicide Rescue Site.

strings.text: そんなふうに決断ができなかったからだろう、私はある時『自殺救済サイト』と言うものにたどり着いた
美桜「何これ？」
strings.translated: Mio「What is this?」

strings.text: 最初は意味がわからなかった。
strings.translated: At first I didn't understand what they meant.

strings.text: 自殺救済の意味を、自殺を手助けしてくれるサイトだと勘違いした。
strings.translated: I misunderstood "suicide rescue" -- I thought it was a site that would help you carry out a suicide.

strings.text: でも、サイトの文面を読んでみると、私が望んでいるのとは全く逆のことを行おうとしているところだと気づいた。
strings.translated: But when I actually read the text on the site, I realized it was trying to do the exact opposite of what I wanted.

strings.text: 最初はすぐにページを閉じた。
strings.translated: At first, I closed the page right away.

strings.text: そんなサイトは私には意味がないって、はなから決め付けていた。
strings.translated: I had decided from the start that a site like that was meaningless to me.

strings.text: 自殺したい人にはそれぞれの理由があるのに、偽善的な精神でそれを邪魔しようとしてる人達。
strings.translated: People who wanted to die each had their own reasons -- and yet here were people trying to interfere with that out of some self-righteous, hypocritical spirit.

strings.text: そんなふうにしか思うことができなかった。
strings.translated: That was the only way I could see it.

strings.text: だけど、ほんの少しだけ興味がわいたのも事実だった。
strings.translated: But it was also true that I felt just a tiny bit curious.

strings.text: 他にどんな人が自殺しようとしてるのか、どんな苦しみを抱いてるのか、それを知りたかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to know what other kinds of people were trying to kill themselves, what kinds of suffering they carried.

strings.text: 私みたいな人がいて、何をどんなふうに感じてるのか…。
strings.translated: Whether there were people like me, and what they felt and how they felt it...

strings.text: 私よりも楽なのか、私よりも苦しいのか…。
strings.translated: Whether they had it easier than me, or suffered more than me...

strings.text: 私は何番目くらいに苦しい人なのか…。
strings.translated: Where I ranked among the most suffering people...

strings.text: そんな…くだらない思考に、当時の私は一種の救いを求めてしまっていたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe I was seeking a kind of salvation in those... worthless thoughts back then.

strings.text: 助けてなんて書き込むつもりはなかったけど、私は何となくそのサイトの掲示板に一言のコメントを残した
strings.translated: I hadn't intended to write anything like "help me," but I left a brief comment on that site's message board almost without thinking.

strings.text: 誰か私を救ってくれませんか？
strings.translated: "Won't someone save me?

strings.text: 』それは、遊びのようなものだったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: " It might have been something like a game.

strings.text: 本当に救ってほしいなんて思ってるわけじゃなくて、そういった活動をしてる人をからかいたいだけだったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe I didn't really want to be saved at all -- maybe I just wanted to mock the people who did that kind of work.

strings.text: だから、誰かからの回答が来るなんて期待してなかったし、回答があったとしてもまともに取り合う気なんてなかった。
strings.translated: So I wasn't expecting anyone to respond, and even if someone did, I had no intention of taking them seriously.

strings.text: 救えるはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no way anyone could save me.

strings.text: 私のことなんて誰もわかるはずがない。
strings.translated: No one could possibly understand what I was going through.

strings.text: わかる人は…もう既に自殺してしまってるはずだ
strings.translated: Anyone who could understand... had probably already killed themselves.

strings.text: そんなふうに思っていたのに、数日後コメントに対するレスポンスがあったときは、自分の目を疑った。
strings.translated: Even though I had felt that way, when a response to my comment appeared a few days later, I couldn't believe my own eyes.

strings.text: 『私にあなたを救わせてください』最初は、シンプルな書き込みだった。
strings.translated: "Please let me save you." It was a simple message at first.

strings.text: 単なるイタズラとしか思えないような回答だった。
strings.translated: It was the kind of reply that could only seem like a prank.

strings.text: 無視するべきだろうか。
strings.translated: Should I ignore it?

strings.text: それとも、話は合わせてみる方が良いのだろうか。
strings.translated: Or would it be better to play along?

strings.text: 本当に救われるなんて思ってなかったから、私にとってはどうでも良かった。
strings.translated: Since I never truly believed I could be saved, it didn't really matter to me either way.

strings.text: 自殺するまでの間、相手をしてやるべきかどうか、そんなふうに考えてしまっていた。
strings.translated: I found myself thinking about whether I should humor this person until the time came for me to die.

strings.text: 『どうやって救ってくれるんですか？
strings.translated: "How exactly are you going to save me?

strings.text: 』会話は数日置きに交わされていった。
strings.translated: " The exchanges continued every few days.

strings.text: 私達以外の会話もあったから、最初の書き込みなんてすぐに後ろのほうに追いやられてしまった。
strings.translated: There were other conversations besides ours, so the original post got pushed back quickly.

strings.text: だから、程なくして会話はメールに切り替えられた
strings.translated: So before long, the conversation was moved to email.

strings.text: 美桜「なに…これ…？」
strings.translated: Mio「What... is this...?」

strings.text: 掲示板ではシンプルな書き込みしかしなかったのに、メールになると相手は急に長文になり始めた。
strings.translated: On the message board they had only written brief messages, but once we switched to email, the other person suddenly started writing at length.

strings.text: しかも、その内容が私には挑発にしか感じられなかった。
strings.translated: And on top of that, the content felt like nothing but provocation to me.

strings.text: あなたのことはわかってる。
strings.translated: I understand you.

strings.text: 私にも苦しみが理解できる。
strings.translated: I can understand your suffering too.

strings.text: 必ず救ってあげる。
strings.translated: I will definitely save you.

strings.text: そんな文面が、うんざりするほどの長文で送られてきた。
strings.translated: Messages like that came in unbearably long walls of text.

strings.text: でも、そんなの信じられるわけがない。
strings.translated: But there was no way I could believe any of it.

strings.text: 本当に救ってくれるなんて思えるはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no way I could ever think they would truly save me.

strings.text: この人は、自殺しようとしてる私をからかってるんだって、そんなふうにしか考えることができなかった。
strings.translated: All I could think was that this person was mocking me -- someone who was trying to die.

strings.text: 最初は無視した。
strings.translated: At first, I ignored it.

strings.text: 何通のメールが来ても無視し続けた。
strings.translated: No matter how many emails came, I kept ignoring them.

strings.text: こんなのに関わった自分が馬鹿だった。
strings.translated: I was a fool for getting involved in something like this.

strings.text: 期待もしてないのに、メールでのやりとりなんかしようって思うんじゃなかった。
strings.translated: I shouldn't have thought about exchanging emails when I had no expectations to begin with.

strings.text: 軽率な行動を後悔して、私はサイトを見るのもやめた。
strings.translated: Regretting my careless actions, I stopped visiting the site altogether.

strings.text: 誰にも迷惑をかけず自殺できる方法を早く見つけようって、そんなふうに考えていた。
strings.translated: I had been thinking that I needed to find a way to kill myself soon -- one that wouldn't cause trouble for anyone.

strings.text: でも、送信者はめげなかった。
strings.translated: But the sender didn't give up.

strings.text: 私を励ます言葉と、自分の体験を少しずつ語ってくれた。
strings.translated: She shared words of encouragement and, little by little, told me about her own experiences.

strings.text: 自分も強姦事件の被害者であることを、本名さえ知らない私に教えてくれた
strings.translated: She told me -- someone who didn't even know her real name -- that she too had been a victim of rape.

strings.text: 美桜「この人…本当に…？」
strings.translated: Mio「This person... really...?」

strings.text: メールに書かれている彼女の体験談は、とても創作物とは思えなかった。
strings.translated: The account of her experiences written in those emails didn't seem like something anyone could have made up.

strings.text: 本当にレイプされた人にしかわからないことが、メールの文面には綴られていた。
strings.translated: The emails contained things that only someone who had truly been raped could know.

strings.text: さらには、そんな身の上を話してくれた上で、自分の本名、住所、そして連絡先まで記載してくれていた
strings.translated: And on top of sharing something so personal, she had also included her real name, address, and contact information.

strings.text: 美桜「小野田…友佳…」
strings.translated: Mio「Onoda... Yuka...」

strings.text: 動揺せずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but be shaken.

strings.text: 彼女の言うことが嘘とは思えなかったし、だからといって救われたという言葉を安易に信じることはできなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't believe she was lying, but at the same time, I couldn't bring myself to easily believe the word "saved" either.

strings.text: どこまでが本当なのか、嘘はひとつもないのか、友佳のメールを私は何度も読み返した。
strings.translated: How much of it was true, was there even a single lie -- I read Yuka's emails over and over again.

strings.text: そして、私と同じ境遇に遭った人が救われているのなら、私も救われる方法があるんじゃないかって、心の片隅でそんなふうに考え始めていた
strings.translated: And I had begun to think, somewhere in a corner of my heart, that if someone who had gone through the same thing as me could be saved, then maybe there was a way for me to be saved too.

strings.text: 本当に私も救われますか？
strings.translated: Will I truly be saved too?

strings.text: 』『私が必ず救ってみせるよ』レイプ被害に遭った人間とは思えないほど、友佳のメールは自信に満ち溢れていた。
strings.translated: 』『I'll definitely save you』 -- Yuka's emails were brimming with confidence, to a degree that seemed impossible for someone who had been a victim of rape.

strings.text: 必ず私のことを救うって、まるで何かに誓ったように書いてくれていた。
strings.translated: She wrote that she would absolutely save me, as though she had sworn it on something.

strings.text: この言葉を信じてもいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it alright for me to believe these words?

strings.text: まだ、私にも救いの道は残されてるって考えていいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it alright for me to think that there was still a path to salvation left for me?

strings.text: 自殺を決意していた心が、友佳とメールを繰り返すたびに少しずつ揺れていった。
strings.translated: With every exchange of emails with Yuka, my heart -- which had resolved itself to suicide -- began to waver, little by little.

strings.text: 『本当に救われるのなら、救われたいかもしれない』私は少しずつ、友佳に心を開いていった。
strings.translated: 『If I could truly be saved, then perhaps I want to be saved』 -- little by little, I began to open my heart to Yuka.

strings.text: 彼女なら理解してくれると期待して、心の内に隠していたものを告白していった。
strings.translated: Hoping that she would understand, I began to confess the things I had kept hidden deep inside.

strings.text: 怖くなかったと言えば嘘になる。
strings.translated: It would be a lie to say I wasn't afraid.

strings.text: 会ったこともない人に希望を託すのは、一種の賭けのようなものだった。
strings.translated: Entrusting my hope to someone I had never even met was a kind of gamble.

strings.text: もしも…もしも、友佳が私を騙していて、最後に馬鹿にするような言葉をかけてきたとしたら…。
strings.translated: If... if Yuka was deceiving me, and at the end she said something to mock me...

strings.text: 私は、その日のうちに自殺を決行していたと思う。
strings.translated: I think I would have gone through with my suicide that very same day.

strings.text: 『私が救われた話を聞いてくれる？
strings.translated: 『Would you like to hear the story of how I was saved?

strings.text: 』やがて、友佳は自分が救われたときの話をメールに綴ってくれた。
strings.translated: 』Before long, Yuka wrote out in an email the story of when she herself had been saved.

strings.text: 最初は辛かったこと。
strings.translated: How it had been painful at first.

strings.text: 自分も自殺を考えていたこと。
strings.translated: How she too had contemplated suicide.

strings.text: その時、ある人に出会ったこと。
strings.translated: How, at that time, she had met a certain person.

strings.text: 全てをそのまま受け入れるのは難しかったけど、それでも友佳が辛い経験を乗り越えて今に至っていると言うことは、私にも信じることができた。
strings.translated: It was hard to accept everything as it was, but even so, I was able to believe that Yuka had overcome her painful experiences and arrived at where she was now.

strings.text: この人なら信用してもいいのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe this person was someone I could trust.

strings.text: この人を信用して、私も救われたい。
strings.translated: I wanted to trust this person, and be saved myself.

strings.text: 交流の頻度を増していくうちに、私の中で友佳の存在はいつしか家族よりも大きなものになっていった。
strings.translated: As the frequency of our exchanges grew, Yuka's presence within me had, before I knew it, come to mean more to me than even my own family.

strings.text: 家族に対しても言えなかったことを、友佳にだけは打ち明けることができるようになっていった
strings.translated: Things I hadn't been able to say even to my family, I gradually became able to confide only to Yuka.

strings.text: 美桜「どんな人なんだろう…」
strings.translated: Mio「I wonder what kind of person she is...」

strings.text: 友佳と話すたびに、私の意識は彼女自身への興味に繋がっていった。
strings.translated: Each time I talked with Yuka, my thoughts kept leading me toward curiosity about her as a person.

strings.text: 強姦事件の被害者。
strings.translated: A victim of rape.

strings.text: 救いを得ることができた人物。
strings.translated: Someone who had managed to find salvation.

strings.text: まだ、メールでしか話したことがなかったけど、文章の書き方からして私よりも年上の女性をイメージしていた。
strings.translated: We had only ever spoken through email, but from the way she wrote, I imagined her to be an older woman than me.

strings.text: 電話で話してみたい。
strings.translated: I wanted to talk with her on the phone.

strings.text: 直接会ってみたい。
strings.translated: I wanted to meet her in person.

strings.text: そんなふうに思う頃には、私の中で死のうという気持ちはほとんどなくなっていた。
strings.translated: By the time I was feeling that way, the desire to die had almost completely faded from within me.

strings.text: あるいは、自殺するまでの間に、友佳のことをもっと知りたいって思っていた
strings.translated: Or perhaps -- I had wanted to know more about Yuka before the time came for me to end my life.

strings.text: 大智「姉さんっ！
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis!」

strings.text: 芽生「お姉ちゃんっ！
strings.translated: Mei「Sis!

strings.text: ある夜、部屋から出てリビングに行くと、大智と芽生にとても驚いた顔をされた。
strings.translated: One night, I came out of my room and went to the living room, and Daichi and Mei stared at me like they'd seen a ghost.

strings.text: 当然だろう。
strings.translated: Of course they did.

strings.text: 私が部屋を出るなんて、何ヶ月ぶりかわからないほどだったから。
strings.translated: I had no idea how many months it had been since I'd last left my room.

strings.text: いつも食事は部屋の前に置かれていたし、唯一出るのはトイレと、たまのお風呂の時くらいだったんだから
strings.translated: My meals had always been left outside my door, and the only times I ever came out were to use the bathroom, and occasionally to take a bath.

strings.text: 美桜「お腹…空いちゃった」
strings.translated: Mio「I got... hungry」

strings.text: 私の言葉を聞いて、大智は「母さんは寝ているから」
strings.translated: Hearing my words, Daichi said "Mom is asleep, so--"

strings.text: と自分で食事を用意してくれた。
strings.translated: and prepared a meal for me himself.

strings.text: 多分、私の事で疲れている母親を気遣って。
strings.translated: Probably out of consideration for our mother, who was exhausted from worrying about me.

strings.text: それに、何か変化をもたらすことで私がまた部屋に戻ってしまうことを恐れて。
strings.translated: And out of fear that any disruption might cause me to retreat back into my room.

strings.text: 大智はそういう子だった。
strings.translated: That was the kind of person Daichi was.

strings.text: 料理なんてほとんどできないはずなのに、頑張って卵焼きやサラダを用意してくれた。
strings.translated: He could barely cook at all, yet he worked hard to prepare tamagoyaki and a salad for me.

strings.text: 最初は、何だか恥ずかしかった。
strings.translated: At first, I felt somehow embarrassed.

strings.text: 弟妹なのに、何を話せばいいのかわからなかった。
strings.translated: Even though they were my younger siblings, I didn't know what to say to them.

strings.text: ２人はもちろん、両親にだってすごく心配をかけた。
strings.translated: I had caused so much worry to the two of them, and to our parents as well.

strings.text: 申し訳ない気持ちでいっぱいだったし、私に対して怒ってないかって不安もあった。
strings.translated: I was filled with guilt, and I was anxious about whether they were angry with me.

strings.text: 強姦されたとは言え何ヶ月も部屋にこもるなんて、情けない姉だって思われてないかって、ちょっとだけ怖かった
strings.translated: I was a little afraid that they might think me a pathetic older sister -- locking herself in her room for months, even if she had been raped.

strings.text: 大智「あのさ…無理しないで、ゆっくり食べて…いいからな
strings.translated: Daichi「Hey... don't push yourself. Take your time eating... okay?」

strings.text: 美桜「ええ」
strings.translated: Mio「Yes」

strings.text: 大智は優しかった。
strings.translated: Daichi was kind.

strings.text: 芽生も優しかった。
strings.translated: Mei was kind too.

strings.text: 気配に気づいて起きてきた母さんも、帰って来た父さんも、すごく優しくしてくれた。
strings.translated: Mom, who had woken up sensing something, and Dad, who came home -- they were both so kind to me.

strings.text: 以前とは違う。
strings.translated: It was different from before.

strings.text: みんなが私を刺激しないように気を配っているのを感じた。
strings.translated: I could feel everyone being careful not to upset me.

strings.text: でも、だからこそ私は安心することができた。
strings.translated: But that was exactly why I was able to feel at ease.

strings.text: まだこの家族の中に私の居場所はあるんだって、そう思うことができた
strings.translated: I could tell myself that I still had a place in this family.

strings.text: 家族との交流を取り戻し始めると、友佳はそれをとても喜んでくれた。
strings.translated: When I began to reconnect with my family, Yuka was truly delighted for me.

strings.text: 自分の部屋を出た私の勇気を、丁寧な文面で褒めてくれた。
strings.translated: She praised my courage in stepping out of my room, in carefully chosen words.

strings.text: 『家族のみんなはすごく優しくしてくれると思うから、甘えたい時に甘えて、そうじゃないときはちゃんと距離を取ってね』『家族の優しさに気を遣いすぎたら、逆効果になっちゃうから』メールで会話するたびに、友佳も本当に強姦事件の被害者なんだって感じることが増えていった。
strings.translated: 『I think everyone in your family will be very kind to you, so lean on them when you want to, and make sure to keep your distance when you don't』『If you worry too much about your family's kindness, it'll end up having the opposite effect』 -- with every exchange over email, I increasingly felt that Yuka really was a victim of rape herself.

strings.text: まるで、どこかで覗いているかのように、私の心の中を感じ取ってくれていた。
strings.translated: It was as though she were peering in from somewhere, sensing exactly what was inside my heart.

strings.text: 家族は優しいし信頼できるけど、それ以上に友佳のことは信頼できる。
strings.translated: My family is kind and trustworthy, but I trust Yuka even more than that.

strings.text: 私のことを本当に、誰よりも一番理解してくれる人だって、そのことが実感としてわいてきていた。
strings.translated: The feeling was growing inside me -- that she was the one person who truly understood me better than anyone else.

strings.text: もっと話したい。
strings.translated: I wanted to talk more.

strings.text: もっと友佳の事が知りたい。
strings.translated: I wanted to know more about Yuka.

strings.text: 彼女がどうやって救われたのか、それを私にも教えてほしい。
strings.translated: I wanted her to tell me how she had found her own salvation -- and to share that with me too.

strings.text: 自殺をする気がなくなっても、全てが解決したわけじゃない。
strings.translated: Even if the urge to die had faded, that didn't mean everything was resolved.

strings.text: 部屋から出ることはできても、家から出るなんてとてもじゃないけど当時の私には無理だった。
strings.translated: I could manage to leave my room, but leaving the house entirely was something I simply couldn't do back then.

strings.text: 外の世界には、たくさんの男がいる。
strings.translated: Out in the world, there are so many men.

strings.text: 良い男もいれば、悪い男もいる。
strings.translated: Some are good, and some are bad.

strings.text: そして、悪い男の中でも特に悪い男が、女を捕まえて犯し、傷つけ、時には命を奪いさえするのだ。
strings.translated: And among the bad ones, the worst of them catch women, violate them, hurt them -- sometimes even take their lives.

strings.text: そのことを考えると、家の外に出るなんて怖くてできなかった。
strings.translated: When I thought about that, I was too afraid to step outside.

strings.text: 『一度、電話で話してみる？
strings.translated: 「Want to try talking on the phone sometime?

strings.text: 』友佳からそんなメールが届いたのは、私がそんな悩みを抱いている時だった。
strings.translated: 」That was the message Yuka sent me, right when I was struggling with exactly those worries.

strings.text: 電話。
strings.translated: The phone.

strings.text: 友佳と直接話す。
strings.translated: Talking to Yuka directly.

strings.text: 彼女の声が聞ける。
strings.translated: I could hear her voice.

strings.text: 期待と不安を感じながらも、私はすぐに返事をした。
strings.translated: With a mix of anticipation and anxiety, I replied right away.

strings.text: 友佳と直接話して、もっと色々なことを聞いてみたかった
strings.translated: I had wanted to talk to Yuka directly and ask her so many more things.

strings.text: 友佳「もしもし、小野田友佳です。
strings.translated: Yuka「Hello, this is Yuka Onoda.

strings.text: 白坂美桜さんですか？」
strings.translated: Is this Mio Shirasaka?」

strings.text: 電話から聞こえてきた友佳の声は、私が想像してたよりもずっと若い声だった
strings.translated: The voice I heard through the phone was much younger than I had imagined.

strings.text: 美桜「はい。
strings.translated: Mio「Yes.

strings.text: 白坂美桜です。
strings.translated: I'm Mio Shirasaka.

strings.text: あの…いつもありがとうございます
strings.translated: Um... thank you so much for everything.

strings.text: 友佳「ふふっ、もっと楽に話してくれていいのに。
strings.translated: Yuka「Hehe, you don't have to be so formal.

strings.text: メールの時みたいにさ」
strings.translated: Talk to me like you do in your emails.」

strings.text: 友佳は、とてもかわいらしい女の子だった。
strings.translated: Yuka was a very cute girl.

strings.text: 話を聞いてみると私の一つ下、大智と同い年だった。
strings.translated: When I heard more about her, she was one year below me -- the same age as Daichi.

strings.text: すごく明るくて、はきはきと物を喋って、何だか人を引っ張っていくような雰囲気を感じ取ることができた
strings.translated: She was incredibly cheerful, spoke with energy and confidence, and I could sense a kind of magnetism about her, like she could pull people along with her.

strings.text: 友佳「どう？
strings.translated: Yuka「How are you doing?

strings.text: 最近は無理してない？
strings.translated: Are you not pushing yourself too hard lately?

strings.text: ちゃんと、自分のことを第一に考えないとダメだよ？
strings.translated: You have to make sure you put yourself first, okay?

strings.text: 友佳「大丈夫。
strings.translated: Yuka「It's okay.

strings.text: まだまだ時間はかかるけど、きっと乗り越えることができるから。
strings.translated: It'll still take time, but I know you'll get through it.

strings.text: 私がそうだったみたいに、自分にとっての救いの形を知れば、ものの見方が変わるから
strings.translated: Just like I did -- once you find what salvation looks like for you, the way you see things will change.

strings.text: 美桜「自分にとっての…救いの形
strings.translated: Mio「What salvation looks like... for me.

strings.text: 友佳「そのあたりのことも、追々話してあげるね。
strings.translated: Yuka「I'll tell you more about that as we go.

strings.text: たぶん…すぐには信じられない話も多くなると思うから
strings.translated: I think... there's probably a lot you won't be able to believe right away.

strings.text: 友佳とは何度も電話をした。
strings.translated: I called Yuka many times.

strings.text: だんだんメールよりも電話の回数のほうが多くなっていった。
strings.translated: Gradually, the phone calls became more frequent than the emails.

strings.text: 話しやすい女の子だった。
strings.translated: She was an easy girl to talk to.

strings.text: 自分のことをたくさん話してくれたし、私のこともたくさん聞いてきた。
strings.translated: She shared a lot about herself, and she asked me a lot about myself too.

strings.text: 『救い』に関係する話もあれば、全然関係ないたわいもない話で終わる時もあった。
strings.translated: Sometimes we talked about things related to "salvation," and other times we'd end up chatting about nothing in particular.

strings.text: 学校で何があったとか、どんなテレビを観たとか、芸能人では誰が好きとか
strings.translated: What happened at school, what shows she'd been watching, which celebrities she liked --

strings.text: そんな話を聞かされると、私もリビングに出てテレビを観ることが増えていった。
strings.translated: Hearing about those things made me start coming out to the living room more often to watch TV myself.

strings.text: 友佳との話題を増やしたいって気持ちが、私を少しずつ元の日常に戻していった。
strings.translated: The desire to have more things to talk about with Yuka slowly drew me back toward my old everyday life.

strings.text: 両親はとても喜んでくれた。
strings.translated: My parents were so happy.

strings.text: 特に母親は、あんなに好きだった仕事をやめていて、できるだけ私と一緒にいるようにしてくれた。
strings.translated: My mother in particular had quit the job she had loved so much, and she made sure to be with me as much as she could.

strings.text: ソファーに座って母親と一緒にバラエティ番組を観て笑っていると、何だか懐かしい気持ちに浸ることができた。
strings.translated: Sitting on the sofa, laughing together with my mother while watching a variety show, I found myself sinking into a kind of nostalgic warmth.

strings.text: このまま変わることができるかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe I could actually change, just like this.

strings.text: 辛い記憶を乗り越えて、新しい生活をスタートさせることができるかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe I could get past the painful memories and start a new life.

strings.text: そんなふうに思うこともあったけど、いざ窓の外に目をやると体がすくんでしまった。
strings.translated: There were moments when I thought that -- but the moment I glanced out the window, my body would freeze up.

strings.text: たくさんの人がいる外の世界は、私にとってはまだ怖い場所だった。
strings.translated: The outside world, full of so many people, was still a frightening place for me.

strings.text: 男の人だけじゃない。
strings.translated: It wasn't just men.

strings.text: 近所の人は、みんな知っている。
strings.translated: Everyone in the neighborhood knew.

strings.text: 私が強姦されたことを、たくさんの人が知ってしまっている。
strings.translated: So many people already knew that I had been raped.

strings.text: 仮にもう二度と男の人に襲われないとしても、近所の人達がどんなふうに接してくるかわからなかった。
strings.translated: Even if I could be sure I'd never be attacked by a man again, I had no idea how the people around here would treat me.

strings.text: 同情してくるのか、嫌悪感を向けてくるのか、それとも…人の不幸を面白がってるような人もいるだろうか。
strings.translated: Would they pity me, look at me with disgust, or -- would some of them even find amusement in someone else's misfortune?

strings.text: いずれにしても、そういったことを考えていると外に出るのは怖くてたまらなかった
strings.translated: Either way, thinking about all of that made the idea of going outside absolutely terrifying.

strings.text: 友佳「そうだよね。
strings.translated: Yuka「Right?

strings.text: いっそ遠い場所に移っちゃったほうが気楽だよね」
strings.translated: It'd probably be so much easier if you just moved somewhere far away.」

strings.text: 私の不安を、友佳は全部受け止めてくれた。
strings.translated: Yuka accepted every one of my fears.

strings.text: 私が求めている答えを、まるで心の中を読んだかのように返してくれた。
strings.translated: She gave me back exactly the answers I was looking for, as if she could read my mind.

strings.text: 遠い場所。
strings.translated: Somewhere far away.

strings.text: そこに移れるのなら、私も変われるかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I could move there, maybe I could change too.

strings.text: 周りの目を気にせずに済めば、今よりも気持ちが楽になるかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I didn't have to worry about the eyes of people around me, maybe I'd feel so much lighter than I do now.

strings.text: でも、そんなことは不可能だ。
strings.translated: But that was impossible.

strings.text: どこか遠くへ引越すなんて無理だって、当時の私はそう決め付けていた。
strings.translated: Moving somewhere far away was out of the question -- that's what I told myself back then.

strings.text: だって、引越しをすると言うことは、家族がバラバラになるか、みんなが仕事や学校を変わらなければならない。
strings.translated: Because moving would mean either the family splitting up, or everyone having to change their jobs and schools.

strings.text: いくら私のためでも、そこまでできるはずがなかった。
strings.translated: No matter how much it was for my sake, something like that couldn't be done.

strings.text: だけど、そんな思考さえも友佳は打ち砕いてくれた
strings.translated: But even that line of thinking, Yuka shattered.

strings.text: 友佳「ちゃんと家族と話し合ってみた？
strings.translated: Yuka「Have you actually tried talking it over with your family?

strings.text: できるかどうかはわかんないけど、美桜が何を望んでるかわかるだけでも…ううん、何か話してくれるだけで、皆安心すると思うよ」
strings.translated: I don't know if it's possible or not, but just knowing what Mio wants... no, just having her talk to us about anything -- I think that alone would put everyone at ease.」

strings.text: それは私にはない発想だった。
strings.translated: That was a thought I'd never had.

strings.text: 私が何かを望んでるとわかるだけで家族が安心するかもしれないなんて、今まで考えたこともなかった。
strings.translated: That my family might feel relieved just from knowing what I wanted -- I had never once considered that.

strings.text: でも、友佳は教えてくれた。
strings.translated: But Yuka told me.

strings.text: 家族は、私が考えていることを伝えるだけでも喜ぶものなんだって。
strings.translated: That family members are happy just to know what you're thinking.

strings.text: 友佳の時がそうだったって…自分の実体験を踏まえて教えてくれた
strings.translated: That's how it had been for her... she told me from her own experience.

strings.text: 友佳「もし引越しできそうなら、こっちに来るといいよ」
strings.translated: Yuka「If you think you might be able to move, you should come here.」

strings.text: 冗談混じりに、友佳はそんなことを言った。
strings.translated: She said it half-jokingly.

strings.text: 無理に誘われたわけじゃない。
strings.translated: It wasn't like she was pressuring me.

strings.text: もしもそうなったらって話を２人で色々と想像した。
strings.translated: The two of us just let our imaginations wander -- what if that actually happened?

strings.text: 一緒に街を歩いて、一緒に喫茶店で甘いものを食べて、一緒に男の子の話なんかをして…。
strings.translated: Walking through the city together, eating sweets at a cafe together, talking about boys together... The more I let myself imagine it, the more I desperately wanted to go to the city where Yuka lived.

strings.text: そんな想像を膨らませていると、だんだん友佳の住んでいる街に行きたくて仕方なくなってしまった。
strings.translated: If I was with Yuka, maybe I could change... maybe I could be saved too.

strings.text: 友佳と一緒なら変われるんじゃないかって…私も救われるんじゃないかって、そんなふうに思い始めていた
strings.translated: That was how I was starting to feel.

strings.text: 美桜「あの…話があるんだけど…」
strings.translated: Mio「Um... there's something I want to talk about...」

strings.text: お願いするときは、すごく怖かった。
strings.translated: When I asked, I was terrified.

strings.text: 何を馬鹿な事を言ってるんだって、お母さんに怒られるんじゃないかって思っていた。
strings.translated: I was afraid my mother would get angry at me for saying something so foolish.

strings.text: もちろん、最初から引越しなんて考えてたわけじゃない。
strings.translated: Of course, I hadn't been thinking about moving from the very start.

strings.text: ただ、友佳に会いたいって、そう思っただけだった。
strings.translated: I had simply wanted to see Yuka -- that was all.

strings.text: だけど、具体的なイメージが膨らんでいくと、それを実行せずにはいられなくなっていった。
strings.translated: But as the image grew more and more concrete in my mind, I couldn't help but act on it.

strings.text: 会いたいなら会いに行けばいい。
strings.translated: If I wanted to see her, I could go see her.

strings.text: 今の私が言えば、きっと家族は願いを聞いてくれる。
strings.translated: If I said something now, my family would surely grant my wish.

strings.text: そんな期待感を込めて、私は自分の望んでいる事を母親に伝えた
strings.translated: With that hope in my heart, I told my mother what I wanted.

strings.text: 芽生「わぁ～っ、ここが新しいおうちなんだぁ」
strings.translated: Mei「Wow, so this is our new home!」

strings.text: 新しい家に着いたとき、大智や芽生は純粋に嬉しそうだった。
strings.translated: When we arrived at the new house, Daichi and Mei were genuinely, purely happy.

strings.text: 学校が変わったり友達と別れたりしたのに、そんな様子はおくびにも出さなかった
strings.translated: Even though their school had changed and they'd had to say goodbye to their friends, they didn't show a hint of it.

strings.text: 大智「やっぱり新築はいいな。
strings.translated: Daichi「A brand-new house really is something.

strings.text: 綺麗だし、広いし
strings.translated: It's so clean, and so spacious.

strings.text: 美桜「そうね」
strings.translated: Mio「It is.」

strings.text: 新しい生活のために、両親がどれだけの苦労を重ねたかはわからない。
strings.translated: I had no idea how much hardship my parents had gone through for our new life.

strings.text: 職場が変わる一方で、新しい住まいとして新築の家を購入したのだから、私なんかが想像できないほどに頑張ってくれたはずだった。
strings.translated: They had changed workplaces and on top of that purchased a brand-new home -- they must have worked harder than I could ever imagine.

strings.text: 多分そのせいもあって、引越し初日から２人とも仕事に出なければならなかったけど、私を含めて誰も不満なんか口にしなかった。
strings.translated: That was probably part of why both of them had to go to work from the very first day after we moved in, but none of us, including me, said a word of complaint.

strings.text: 新しい生活の場所を用意してくれた両親に、不満なんてあるはずがなかった
strings.translated: There was no room for complaints toward parents who had prepared a new place for us to live.

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃあ、少しずつ片付けていきましょうか」
strings.translated: Mio「Well then, shall we start unpacking little by little?」

strings.text: 片付けはみんなで協力してやることにした。
strings.translated: We all decided to work on it together.

strings.text: １日で全て終わる量じゃなかったけど、自分達の居場所を少しずつ作っていく感覚が楽しかった。
strings.translated: It wasn't an amount we could finish in a single day, but there was something enjoyable about the feeling of slowly carving out our own space.

strings.text: この街のことは何も知らない。
strings.translated: We knew nothing about this town.

strings.text: だから、誰も私達のことを知らない。
strings.translated: And so, no one here knew anything about us.

strings.text: そのことが、とても安心できた。
strings.translated: That was deeply reassuring.

strings.text: 新しくやり直せるってことが、ものすごく幸せだった
strings.translated: The fact that we could start over felt incredibly, genuinely happy.

strings.text: 美桜「ここから始まるんだ…」
strings.translated: Mio「This is where it begins...」

strings.text: 多くの期待があった。
strings.translated: There was so much to look forward to.

strings.text: もう一度、自分の人生を歩めるような、そんな不思議な気分だった。
strings.translated: It was a strange feeling -- as though I could walk my own life again, one more time.

strings.text: みんなが笑顔なのは嬉しかったし、私も釣られるようにして笑うことができた。
strings.translated: Seeing everyone smiling made me happy, and I found myself smiling along with them.

strings.text: 何よりもこの街のどこかに友佳がいるってことが、私にとっては本当に大きな希望だった。
strings.translated: More than anything, knowing that Yuka was somewhere in this city was a truly enormous source of hope for me.

strings.text: 明日には学校で会えるはずで、その瞬間がとても待ち遠しかった
strings.translated: I was supposed to be able to meet her at school tomorrow, and I could hardly wait for that moment.

strings.text: 友佳のことを考えると、心臓が高鳴った。
strings.translated: Just thinking about Yuka made my heart race.

strings.text: 直接会える日なんて来ないだろうって思ってたのに、明日にはそれが実現しようとしている。
strings.translated: I had thought a day where we could meet in person would never come, and yet tomorrow that was actually going to happen.

strings.text: 今の私にとって、唯一の友達と呼べる存在。
strings.translated: Right now, she was the only person I could call a friend.

strings.text: 同じ苦しみを知っていて、私の知らない救いを知っている女の子。
strings.translated: A girl who knew the same suffering I did, and who knew a salvation I had yet to find.

strings.text: 彼女に会えば、私も救われるだろうか。
strings.translated: If I met her, would I be saved too?

strings.text: 友佳のように、もっと明るくて優しい人間になれるだろうか。
strings.translated: Could I become a brighter, kinder person -- like Yuka?

strings.text: たとえば…自分と同じように強姦事件に遭った被害者を助けてあげられるような、そんな人間になることができるだろうか
strings.translated: Could I become someone who could help others -- victims of rape, just like me -- the way she had?

strings.text: 美桜「真の…救い、か…」
strings.translated: Mio「True... salvation, huh...」

strings.text: 友佳の言っていた救いを私が見出せるのかどうかはわからないけど、この街に来たことは大きな一歩だった。
strings.translated: I didn't know whether I could find the salvation Yuka had spoken of, but coming to this city had been a huge step forward.

strings.text: 大切で重要な最初の一歩だった。
strings.translated: It was an important, precious first step.

strings.text: まだまだ不安はあるけど、自分にできる精一杯の事をやっていこうって、今はそう思うことができた
strings.translated: There was still so much I was anxious about, but right now I was able to tell myself I would do everything I possibly could.

strings.text: 本当に来てくれてすっごく嬉しい！
strings.translated: I'm so, so happy you really came!

strings.text: 美桜「私も…会えてすごく嬉しい」
strings.translated: Mio「I'm... really happy to meet you too.」

strings.text: 翌日の学校で、私は本当に友佳と会うことができていた。
strings.translated: The next day at school, I was actually able to meet Yuka in person.

strings.text: あらかじめメールでやりとりして、待ち合わせ場所を決めていたから、驚くほどすんなりと会えた。
strings.translated: We had arranged everything by email beforehand and agreed on a meeting spot, so we found each other with surprising ease.

strings.text: 想像していた通りの女の子。
strings.translated: She was exactly the girl I had imagined.

strings.text: 明るくて、自信に満ちていて……何だかオーラみたいなものを感じる子だった
strings.translated: Bright, full of confidence... and there was something almost like an aura about her.

strings.text: 友佳「私、この日が来るのをずっと待ってたの！
strings.translated: Yuka「I've been waiting so long for this day!

strings.text: 美桜「私も…こんな日が来るなんて夢みたい」
strings.translated: Mio「Me too... it feels like a dream that a day like this could come.」

strings.text: 話をしている声は、電話のそれと同じだった。
strings.translated: Her speaking voice was the same as the one I knew from the phone.

strings.text: 会話を重ねるたびに、この子が友佳だって確信を持つことができた。
strings.translated: With every exchange, I grew more and more certain that this girl was really Yuka.

strings.text: 誰よりも私のことをわかってくれる存在。
strings.translated: The one person who understood me better than anyone.

strings.text: 同じ体験をしたからこそ、私の辛さをわかってくれる少女
strings.translated: A girl who had been through the same experience, and who understood my pain because of it.

strings.text: あまり人がいない場所に移って、彼女は私がもっとも知りたいことを話してくれた
strings.translated: We moved somewhere with fewer people around, and she told me the thing I most wanted to know.

strings.text: 友佳「早速だけど、美桜の一番知りたいことを教えてあげる」
strings.translated: Yuka「I'll get right to it -- let me tell you the thing you want to know most.」

strings.text: 学校の屋上に上がって、友佳はそう切り出してきた。
strings.translated: Up on the school rooftop, Yuka opened with that.

strings.text: 私が一番知りたいこと。
strings.translated: The thing I wanted to know most.

strings.text: それは、もちろん自分が救われるにはどうすればいいかだ。
strings.translated: That was, of course, what I needed to do to be saved.

strings.text: そのための方法を、友佳は知っているはずだった。
strings.translated: She was supposed to know the way.

strings.text: 友佳と出会ってある意味では救われたけれど、残念ながらそれは根本的な救いではなかった。
strings.translated: Meeting Yuka had saved me in one sense, but unfortunately that wasn't a fundamental salvation.

strings.text: 友佳自身がそう教えてくれたし、私もそう感じていた
strings.translated: Yuka herself had told me so, and I felt it too.

strings.text: 友佳「電話でも話したけど、私はもう救われたの。
strings.translated: Yuka「Like I mentioned on the phone -- I've already been saved.

strings.text: 救ってもらったの
strings.translated: Someone saved me.

strings.text: 美桜「友佳の言ってたクラブで…？
strings.translated: Mio「Through the Club you mentioned...?

strings.text: 友佳「そう。
strings.translated: Yuka「Is that so.

strings.text: 私達は『友愛クラブ』って呼んでる。
strings.translated: We call it the "Friendship Club."

strings.text: 自分が何のために生きてるか、本当に救われるって言うのはどういうことなのか…それを教えてくれるの」
strings.translated: It teaches you what you're living for, and what it truly means to be saved.

strings.text: 友佳は私の知らない救いを知っていた。
strings.translated: Yuka knew a salvation I had never known.

strings.text: 自分が辛い体験をして絶望に打ちひしがれている時、とあるクラブによって救ってもらったらしかった。
strings.translated: It seemed that when she had been crushed by despair after her own painful experience, a certain club had saved her.

strings.text: それが、どんなところなのかは、まだメールでしか訊いたことがない。
strings.translated: I had only ever heard about what kind of place it was through emails.

strings.text: 簡単な概要は教えてもらったことがあったけど、私の中ではまだ明確なイメージはできていなかった
strings.translated: She had given me a brief overview, but I still couldn't form a clear picture of it in my mind.

strings.text: 友佳「クラブって言っても、そんなに難しいところじゃないの。
strings.translated: Yuka「It's called a club, but it's not some complicated thing.

strings.text: 簡単に言えば…塾みたいなものっていうか…皆は『友愛クラブ』って呼んでるけど、実際正式には塾なんだ
strings.translated: Simply put... it's kind of like a cram school... everyone calls it the "Friendship Club," but officially it's actually registered as a cram school.

strings.text: 美桜「塾？
strings.translated: Mio「A cram school?

strings.text: みんなで勉強するの？
strings.translated: Do you all study together?

strings.text: 友佳「勉強はするんだけど、学校のとは違うし、決まった時間に決まった何かを習うわけじゃないの。
strings.translated: Yuka「There is studying, but it's nothing like school, and it's not like you learn something specific at a set time.

strings.text: みんな好きなことをして過ごして、その中で自然と学んでいくの
strings.translated: Everyone spends their time doing what they like, and through that, they naturally learn.

strings.text: 美桜「好きなことをして…自然と学んでいく？」
strings.translated: Mio「Doing what you like... and naturally learning?」

strings.text: クラブについては、友佳の説明を聞いても想像するのが難しかった。
strings.translated: Even after hearing Yuka's explanation, the Club was hard to picture.

strings.text: 好きなことをしているだけで、自分の救いが見つけ出せるなんて、そんなのおかしいって思っていた。
strings.translated: I thought it was strange -- that just doing what you liked could lead you to find your own salvation.

strings.text: でも、友佳が嘘をついてるとは思えない。
strings.translated: But I couldn't believe Yuka was lying.

strings.text: 私の理解や想像力が足りないのは明白だった。
strings.translated: It was obvious that my own understanding and imagination were falling short.

strings.text: 自分の好きなことをして過ごして、その中で救いを見出せる場所。
strings.translated: A place where you spend your time doing what you love, and find salvation through it.

strings.text: クラブに対して、私の興味が向かないはずがなかった
strings.translated: There was no way I wouldn't be drawn to the Club.

strings.text: 友佳「今日、学校が終わったら行ってみる？
strings.translated: Yuka「Do you want to go today, after school?

strings.text: 美桜「私なんかが、いきなり行ってもいいの？
strings.translated: Mio「Is it really okay for someone like me to just show up out of nowhere?

strings.text: 救いを求める資格は十分あるもん
strings.translated: You more than qualify as someone who needs saving.

strings.text: 友佳「美桜も、あそこならきっと救われるよ。
strings.translated: Yuka「I'm sure you'll find salvation there too, Mio.

strings.text: 私がそうだったんだから、絶対大丈夫！」
strings.translated: It worked for me, so I know you'll be okay!」

strings.text: 断る理由はなかった。
strings.translated: There was no reason to refuse.

strings.text: だって、私は自分が救われるためにこの街に来たんだから…。
strings.translated: After all, I had come to this town to find my own salvation...

strings.text: 友佳に会って、クラブに行くために、わざわざ引越してきたんだから…。
strings.translated: I had gone out of my way to move here -- just to meet Yuka and go to the Club...

strings.text: 不安がないと言えば嘘になるけど、友佳の言葉は本当だって信じたかった。
strings.translated: I'd be lying if I said I had no anxiety, but I wanted to believe that what Yuka said was true.

strings.text: 私を救ってくれる場所があるって信じたかった
strings.translated: I wanted to believe there was a place out there that could save me.

strings.text: 友佳「こっちこっち」
strings.translated: Yuka「This way, this way.」

strings.text: 放課後になって、私は友佳と一緒にクラブへと向かった。
strings.translated: After school, I headed to the Club together with Yuka.

strings.text: 彼女と肩を並べて街を歩きながら、本当に新しい生活が始まったことを実感した。
strings.translated: Walking through the streets side by side with her, I felt it for real -- that a new life had truly begun.

strings.text: 街を歩いている間、友佳は色々なことを教えてくれた。
strings.translated: While we walked through town, Yuka told me all kinds of things.

strings.text: どこのお店が安いとか、どこのお店が品揃えが良いとか、楽しそうに話しながら案内してくれた
strings.translated: Which shops were cheap, which shops had the best selection -- she guided me along, chatting happily as she went.

strings.text: 友佳「そういえば、クラブのことって家族の人は知ってるの？
strings.translated: Yuka「Oh, by the way -- does your family know about the Club?

strings.text: 美桜「ううん、言ってないけど…言ったほうが良かった？
strings.translated: Mio「No, I haven't told them... should I have?

strings.text: 友佳「逆。
strings.translated: Yuka「The opposite.

strings.text: 言わないほうがいいと思う。
strings.translated: I think it's better not to say anything.

strings.text: こういうのって、当事者じゃないとわからない事もあるから
strings.translated: There are things about this that you can only understand if you're directly involved.

strings.text: 友佳「救われるためとは言っても、まだよく知らない所に行ったなんて話したら、止められちゃうかもしれないしね
strings.translated: Yuka「Even if it's for the sake of being saved, if you told them you went somewhere you didn't know much about, they might try to stop you.

strings.text: 美桜「そうね…」
strings.translated: Mio「I suppose so...」

strings.text: 正直、その不安はあった。
strings.translated: Honestly, that anxiety was there.

strings.text: 私自身がちゃんと説明できないクラブのことなんて、家族が理解してくれるはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no way my family could understand the Club when I couldn't even explain it properly myself.

strings.text: それこそ、大智なんかは自分も付いて来るって言い出しかねなかった。
strings.translated: Daichi especially -- he might well have said he'd come along too.

strings.text: でも、友佳が言うにはそのクラブに通う人は何かしら救いを求めてる人達で、幸せな生活を送ってる普通の人達には理解できない場所かもしれないとのことだった。
strings.translated: But according to Yuka, the people who came to the Club were all seeking some kind of salvation, and it might be a place that ordinary people living happy lives simply couldn't understand.

strings.text: もちろん、私だって理解できるかどうかはわからない。
strings.translated: Of course, I had no idea whether I would be able to understand it either.

strings.text: クラブに行ってみても、私には合わない場所かもしれない。
strings.translated: Even if I went to the Club, it might turn out to be a place that wasn't right for me.

strings.text: だけど、それならそれでクラブに関わらずに自分の救いを探せばいいだけの話なんだから、今のところ家族に言うつもりはなかった
strings.translated: But if that was the case, I could simply look for my own salvation without getting involved with the Club -- so for now, I had no intention of telling my family.

strings.text: 友佳「怖い？」
strings.translated: Yuka「Are you scared?」

strings.text: 歩道を歩いている最中、友佳が何気ない様子でそう尋ねてきた
strings.translated: She asked me that casually, in the middle of walking down the sidewalk.

strings.text: 美桜「全然怖くないって言えば…嘘になるかもしれないけど…でも、友佳のことは信頼してる
strings.translated: Mio「I'd be lying if I said I wasn't scared at all... but... I trust you, Yuka.

strings.text: 友佳「そっか。
strings.translated: Yuka「I see.

strings.text: ありがと。
strings.translated: Thank you.

strings.text: でも、大丈夫だよ。
strings.translated: But it'll be okay.

strings.text: 美桜なら絶対自分の救いを見出せるから」
strings.translated: I know Mio will find her own salvation.」

strings.text: 友佳の明るい言葉に、私は自然と笑みを返していた。
strings.translated: I found myself smiling back naturally at Yuka's bright words.

strings.text: 彼女のことを信頼しているからこそ、家族揃ってこの街に引越してきたのだ。
strings.translated: It was precisely because I trusted her that my whole family had moved to this town.

strings.text: 未知なるものに対しての不安はあるけど、友佳に対しての疑念なんかあるはずもなかった
strings.translated: I had anxiety about the unknown, but there was no room for doubt about Yuka herself.

strings.text: 友佳「美桜、こっち
strings.translated: Yuka「Over here, Mio.

strings.text: 友佳「ここ。
strings.translated: Yuka「Here.

strings.text: このビルの中にあるの
strings.translated: It's inside this building.

strings.text: 友佳に連れて行かれた先は、それほど大きくはない雑居ビルの前だった。
strings.translated: Yuka led me to a modest mixed-use office building.

strings.text: もっとお屋敷みたいなところに連れて行かれるのかと思ってたけど、想像してたのとは全然違っていた。
strings.translated: I had half-expected to be taken somewhere more like a mansion, so it was nothing like what I'd imagined.

strings.text: 友佳の説明によれば、このビルのフロアひとつを貸し切っているらしい。
strings.translated: According to Yuka, they had rented out an entire floor of this building.

strings.text: それほど大きいとは言えないけど、小さいとも言えない規模のようだった
strings.translated: It wasn't exactly large, but it wasn't small either, from the sound of it.

strings.text: 美桜「ここで…塾、みたいなことやってるの？」
strings.translated: Mio「Is this... like a cram school or something?」

strings.text: 見上げたビルの３階の窓には、確かに『誠信明輝塾』の文字が見える
strings.translated: Looking up at the third-floor windows of the building, I could clearly make out the characters reading "Seishin Meiki Juku."

strings.text: 友佳「そういう事。
strings.translated: Yuka「Exactly.

strings.text: でも、前にも説明した通り、みんな好きなように過ごしてるの」
strings.translated: But, like I explained before, everyone just spends their time however they like.」

strings.text: クラブの建物の前まで来ても、やっぱり意味がわからなかった。
strings.translated: Even standing in front of the Club's building, I still couldn't make sense of it.

strings.text: 塾なのに、みんな好きなことをして過ごしてるってどういう事だろう。
strings.translated: It was supposed to be a cram school, yet everyone just did whatever they wanted -- what did that even mean?

strings.text: 本当に好きなことだけをしてたら、救いなんて見出せないと思うんだけど…。
strings.translated: If you only ever did what you felt like doing, I couldn't see how you'd ever find any kind of salvation...

strings.text: それとも、本当に自由に過ごすことによって、今まで見えなかったものが見えてきたりするんだろうか
strings.translated: Or maybe, by truly spending your time freely, you'd start to see things that had been invisible to you before?

strings.text: 様々な疑問を抱えたまま、私は友佳に連れられてビルの中へと入って行った
strings.translated: Still full of questions, I let Yuka lead me inside the building.

strings.text: 友佳「こんにちはー
strings.translated: Yuka「Hello there~」

strings.text: 受付の女性／静子「こんにちは
strings.translated: Receptionist (Shizuko)「Hello.」

strings.text: 受付の女性／静子「…あら、小野田さん。
strings.translated: Receptionist (Shizuko)「...Oh, Onoda-san.

strings.text: 新しいお友達？
strings.translated: A new friend?」

strings.text: 友佳「はい。
strings.translated: Yuka「Yes.

strings.text: 園田先生はいらっしゃいますか？
strings.translated: Is Sonoda-sensei in?」

strings.text: 受付の女性／静子「ええ、向こうにいるから呼んでくるわね」
strings.translated: Receptionist (Shizuko)「Yes, he's over there -- I'll go get him for you.」

strings.text: 部屋に入ると、友佳は慣れた様子で年上の女性の人と会話を交わした
strings.translated: Once we were inside, Yuka chatted with the older woman there like she'd done it a hundred times before.

strings.text: 受付の女性はすぐに出て行って、私は近くの椅子に座るように促された
strings.translated: The receptionist stepped out right away, and I was guided to a nearby chair to sit down.

strings.text: 肩を縮こまらせながらも、部屋の中をぐるりと見回してしまう。
strings.translated: I hunched my shoulders and let my eyes wander around the room.

strings.text: 街中にある小さな雑居ビル。
strings.translated: A small mixed-use building in the middle of the city.

strings.text: 外から見た３階にある一室が、友佳が言うクラブの部屋みたいだった。
strings.translated: One of the rooms on the third floor, visible from outside, seemed to be the Club's room that Yuka had mentioned.

strings.text: 部屋は背の高いパーティションで区切られていて、受付のすぐ横の広めな区画にはいくつかの机と椅子があり、私と同じくらいの年頃の男女が数人くつろいでいた。
strings.translated: The room was divided by tall partitions, and in the wider section right beside the reception area there were several desks and chairs, where a handful of boys and girls around my age were relaxing.

strings.text: 本を読んだり、ゲームで遊んだり、勉強みたいなことをしたり…みんな、自由に過ごしている…。
strings.translated: Some were reading books, some were playing games, some were doing what looked like studying... everyone was spending their time freely...

strings.text: これが、友佳の言うところの自由に過ごすって意味なんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was this what Yuka meant by spending your time however you liked?

strings.text: 私には、単に遊んでるだけにしか見えないけど、これで何かが変わるんだろうか。
strings.translated: To me it just looked like they were playing around -- could something really change from this?

strings.text: 部屋の中の人達も私には興味がないみたいで、挨拶どころか目を合わせようともしなかった
strings.translated: The people in the room didn't seem interested in me at all; they didn't even try to make eye contact, let alone say hello.

strings.text: 友佳「気楽にしてて。
strings.translated: Yuka「Just relax.

strings.text: 皆美桜と同じで、まだクラブに入ったばかりだし
strings.translated: Everyone here is the same as you, Mio -- they've only just joined the Club.」

strings.text: 美桜「じゃあ、クラブに入って長い人は別の部屋にいるの？
strings.translated: Mio「So the people who've been in the Club longer are in a different room?」

strings.text: 友佳「皆は奥の部屋にいるの
strings.translated: Yuka「Everyone else is in the back room.」

strings.text: 友佳「ここは…クラブの本当の姿に慣れるまでの、控え室みたいなものかな」
strings.translated: Yuka「This place is... kind of like a waiting room, I guess -- somewhere to get used to things before you see what the Club is really like.」

strings.text: 友佳の説明だけではよくわからないけど、つまり優秀な成績か何かを収めたら、別の部屋に入ることができるってことなんだろうか。
strings.translated: I couldn't quite grasp it from Yuka's explanation alone, but did it mean that once you achieved some kind of good results or something, you'd be allowed into a different room?

strings.text: でも、自由に遊んでたりするだけでは、優秀も何も判断しようがないと思うんだけど
strings.translated: But if all you were doing was playing around freely, I couldn't see how anyone could judge whether you were doing well or not.

strings.text: 男性／園田「やあ、いらっしゃい。
strings.translated: Man (Sonoda)「Well, welcome.

strings.text: 小野田君の紹介だそうだね
strings.translated: I hear you were referred by Onoda-kun.」

strings.text: しばらく待っていると、部屋に１人の男性が入ってきた。
strings.translated: After waiting a little while, a man walked into the room.

strings.text: 年齢は４０歳から５０歳くらいの間。
strings.translated: Somewhere between forty and fifty years old.

strings.text: 優しそうな目と柔和な表情が、私の緊張を少しだけほぐしてくれた
strings.translated: His gentle eyes and soft expression eased my nerves just a little.

strings.text: 男性／園田「ああ……大変な目に遭ったようだね
strings.translated: Man (Sonoda)「Ah... it sounds like you've been through quite a lot.」

strings.text: 美桜「は、はい。
strings.translated: Mio「Y-yes.

strings.text: 宜しくお願いします
strings.translated: It's nice to meet you.」

strings.text: 男性／園田「そんなに緊張しなくても平気だよ。
strings.translated: Man (Sonoda)「No need to be so tense.

strings.text: ひとまず、私の部屋で話をしよう
strings.translated: For now, let's go talk in my room.」

strings.text: 男性に言われるままに、私は別の部屋に移り、ソファに腰を下ろした。
strings.translated: Following the man's lead, I moved to another room and settled onto a sofa.

strings.text: 友佳は隣に座ってくれて、正面に男性…つまり、先生と呼ばれている人物が座った。
strings.translated: Yuka sat down beside me, and across from us sat the man -- the one they called "sensei.

strings.text: もしかして、この人がクラブで一番偉い人なんだろうか。
strings.translated: " Was he the person in charge of the whole Club?

strings.text: 今まで深く考えてなかったけど、これって入会の誘いとかされるパターンなんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: I hadn't thought about it much until now, but wasn't this exactly the kind of situation where they'd try to get you to join something?

strings.text: 大きな不安が押し寄せてきた。
strings.translated: A wave of anxiety washed over me.

strings.text: 友佳のことは信じていたつもりだけど、もしかしてこのために親身になってくれたんじゃないかって、そんなふうにも思ってしまった。
strings.translated: I thought I trusted Yuka, but I couldn't help wondering if she'd been so kind to me just to bring me here.

strings.text: たとえばすごく月謝が高かったりしたら、とてもじゃないけど私の家に払う余裕はない。
strings.translated: If the fees turned out to be really high, there was no way my family could afford them.

strings.text: 両親に話せば捻出してくれるかもしれないけど、さすがにそんなことはさせたくなかった。
strings.translated: My parents might scrape the money together if I asked, but I absolutely didn't want to put that on them.

strings.text: 私の不安をどの程度感じ取っているのか、園田と言う男性は優しい笑顔のまま話し始めた
strings.translated: I had no idea how much of my anxiety he could sense, but the man called Sonoda kept his gentle smile as he began to speak.

strings.text: 園田「初めまして。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Nice to meet you.

strings.text: 私は園田和男といいます。
strings.translated: My name is Kazuo Sonoda.

strings.text: 先生なんて偉そうな呼び方をされているけど、要するにこの塾の経営者だね
strings.translated: People call me "sensei," which sounds rather grand, but in short, I'm just the one who runs this cram school.」

strings.text: 園田「『誠信明輝塾』なんて御大層な看板を掲げてはいるが、学校や学習塾のように、勉強を教えているわけじゃないんだ
strings.translated: Sonoda「We hang a rather impressive sign out front -- "Seishin Meiki Juku" -- but we're not teaching academics here the way a school or tutoring center would.」

strings.text: 園田「私は若い人たちに、もっと大切なものに気づいて、学んでほしくて、この塾を開いたんだよ
strings.translated: Sonoda「I opened this place because I wanted young people to notice and learn something more important than that.」

strings.text: 美桜「大切なもの
strings.translated: Mio「Something more important...」

strings.text: 園田「愛…というと少し気恥ずかしいが…。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Love... that word feels a little embarrassing to say...

strings.text: 友愛の気持ち…隣人と助け合う精神だね。
strings.translated: The feeling of brotherly love... the spirit of helping one another as neighbors.

strings.text: 人を助け、人を救える人間になってほしくて、この場所を提供しているんだ
strings.translated: I provide this place because I want people to grow into the kind of human beings who can help others and save others.

strings.text: 園田「実際ここには、君と同じように心に傷を負った人達が大勢いてね。
strings.translated: Sonoda「In fact, there are many people here who, just like you, carry wounds in their hearts.

strings.text: 自分が救われる方法を探し求めているんだ。
strings.translated: They're all searching for a way to be saved.

strings.text: そして救いを見出した者が、今度は救う側にまわる
strings.translated: And those who find their salvation then turn around and become the ones who save others.」

strings.text: 園田「こういう話は、小野田君から聞いてるかな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Has Onoda-kun told you about any of this?」

strings.text: 美桜「はい…簡単にですけど、聞かせてもらいました
strings.translated: Mio「Yes... briefly, she did.」

strings.text: 園田「『友愛を学ぶ場所』『救われる方法を探す場所』なんて言うと、抽象的で分かりにくいだろうから、『君と同じ痛みを知っている仲間がいる場所』だと考えればいい
strings.translated: Sonoda「Saying it's "a place to learn friendship" or "a place to search for salvation" might sound too abstract and hard to grasp, so think of it instead as "a place where there are people who know the same pain you do."」

strings.text: 園田「塾、という言葉もきっと君たちには堅苦しいんだろうね。
strings.translated: Sonoda「The word "cram school" probably sounds stiff to you all.

strings.text: 皆には『友愛クラブ』と呼ばれているそうだ。
strings.translated: I hear everyone calls it the "Friendship Club.

strings.text: もちろん君も、そう呼んで構わないよ」
strings.translated: " Of course, you're welcome to call it that too.」

strings.text: クラブについての話は、先生から詳しく聞かせてもらうことができた。
strings.translated: The sensei was able to tell me quite a bit about the Club.

strings.text: でも、ほとんど友佳から聞いていた内容と同じで、簡単に言えば来たい時に来ればいい場所ってことだった。
strings.translated: But most of it was the same as what Yuka had already told me -- in short, it was a place you could come to whenever you felt like it.

strings.text: 来るのも自由。
strings.translated: Coming was up to you.

strings.text: 来ないのも自由。
strings.translated: Not coming was up to you.

strings.text: 何をするのも自由。
strings.translated: What you did there was up to you.

strings.text: 全て自分の思った通りにやっていいらしい。
strings.translated: Everything was left entirely to your own judgment.

strings.text: 園田先生はあくまで場所を提供しているだけで、それ以上のことは本人達に任せているとのことだった
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei said he simply provided the space, and beyond that, everything was left to the individuals themselves.

strings.text: 園田「誰かと話したい時、１人になりたくないとき、困っている仲間を救ってあげたい時。
strings.translated: Sonoda「When you want to talk to someone, when you don't want to be alone, when you want to help a friend who's struggling -- any reason is fine.

strings.text: 理由は何でもよくて、本当に来たい時に来ればいい
strings.translated: Just come when you truly want to come.」

strings.text: 園田「さすがに、クラブに迷惑をかけるような行為は慎んでもらいたいが、それ以外は自分で考えて自分で行動するんだ
strings.translated: Sonoda「I would ask that you refrain from anything that causes trouble for the Club, but beyond that, you think for yourself and act for yourself.」

strings.text: 園田「そうすれば、自分の求めてるものが自然とわかってくるからね
strings.translated: Sonoda「Do that, and what you're really looking for will naturally become clear to you.」

strings.text: 園田「もちろん、私達も放置するわけじゃない。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Of course, we won't just leave you to your own devices.

strings.text: 何か話を聞いてほしい時はちゃんと聞くし、必要であれば私達なりのアドバイスもするつもりだよ
strings.translated: When you want someone to listen, we'll listen properly -- and if it's needed, we'll offer our own advice as well.」

strings.text: 美桜「あの…本当に自由なんですか？
strings.translated: Mio「Um... is it really that free?

strings.text: いつ来てもいいんですか？
strings.translated: "Can I come whenever I want?"

strings.text: 園田「ああ。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Yes.

strings.text: その気があれば毎日だって来て構わないよ。
strings.translated: If you feel like it, you can come every day.

strings.text: 学校にはできれば通ってほしいが…それが辛い時は無理しなくてもいい。
strings.translated: I'd prefer you still go to school when you can, but... if that's too hard, you don't have to push yourself.

strings.text: 休むことが必要な時もあるからね
strings.translated: Sometimes you need to rest.」

strings.text: 園田「もちろん学校そのものに問題があるようなら、いつでも相談に乗るよ
strings.translated: Sonoda「And of course, if there's a problem with school itself, you can always come talk to me about it.」

strings.text: 美桜「私、そんなにお金とか持ってないんですけど
strings.translated: Mio「I don't really have much money...」

strings.text: 園田「ああ……お金はもらっていないんだよ。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Ah... we don't take money here.

strings.text: そんなつもりでやってる場所じゃないんだ
strings.translated: That's not what this place is about.」

strings.text: 園田「私も過去に色々あってね…。
strings.translated: Sonoda「I've been through a lot in my past, you see...

strings.text: ある意味……自分が救われる場所がほしくて、こういう場所を作ったのかもしれないな…」
strings.translated: In a way... perhaps I created this place because I wanted somewhere I myself could be saved...」

strings.text: ちょっとだけ苦笑いのような表情を浮かべて、園田先生がそう言った。
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei said that with a faint, self-deprecating smile.

strings.text: 自分が救われる場所がほしかった。
strings.translated: He had wanted a place where he himself could be saved.

strings.text: だから、こんなクラブを作った。
strings.translated: That's why he created a Club like this.

strings.text: 園田先生の過去に何があったのかはわからないけど、少なくとも悪い人ではなさそうだった
strings.translated: I didn't know what had happened in Sonoda-sensei's past, but at the very least, he didn't seem like a bad person.

strings.text: 園田「ここに来るかどうかは、君が自由に決めていいんだ
strings.translated: Sonoda「Whether you come here or not is entirely your decision.」

strings.text: 園田「ただ、ここに君の苦しみをわかってくれる仲間がいることは確かだから、是非彼らと話をして、救いのきっかけだけでも掴んでいってほしい
strings.translated: Sonoda「But there are people here who truly understand your pain -- that much is certain. So please, talk to them, and take away at least some small spark of hope for your salvation.」

strings.text: 美桜「救いの…きっかけ
strings.translated: Mio「A spark... of salvation...」

strings.text: 園田「少し厳しいことを言わせてもらえば、このクラブに通ったからって必ず救われるわけじゃない。
strings.translated: Sonoda「To be a little blunt -- coming to this Club doesn't guarantee you'll be saved.

strings.text: 救われるかどうかは、最終的には君次第なんだ
strings.translated: Whether you find salvation or not ultimately depends on you.」

strings.text: 園田「私も、小野田君も、結局は手助けしかできない。
strings.translated: Sonoda「I can only help, and so can Onoda-kun.

strings.text: 本当に救われるためには、君自身が変わる必要があるってことは覚えておいてほしい
strings.translated: Please remember that in order to truly be saved, you yourself have to change.」

strings.text: 美桜「私自身が…変わる…」
strings.translated: Mio「I myself... have to change...」

strings.text: 強制するような雰囲気は感じなかった。
strings.translated: I didn't sense any kind of pressure or coercion in his words.

strings.text: ここに来るかどうかは、私自身が選べばいい。
strings.translated: Whether I came here or not was something I could decide for myself.

strings.text: その言葉を聞けただけでも、私は胸が軽くなるのを感じた。
strings.translated: Just hearing those words was enough to make my chest feel lighter.

strings.text: クラブという存在に対する不安が、少しだけ払拭された気がした
strings.translated: It felt as though some of the anxiety I had toward the Club had been swept away.

strings.text: 園田「それじゃあ、ごゆっくり
strings.translated: Sonoda「Well then, take your time.」

strings.text: 園田先生は、見た目よりもずっと気さくな人だった。
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei was far more easygoing than he appeared.

strings.text: 優しい笑顔が印象的な、まるで父親の理想像のような感じがする。
strings.translated: His warm smile left a strong impression -- he felt like the very image of an ideal father.

strings.text: 多分、私の過去に「何か」
strings.translated: He had probably sensed that something had happened in my past --

strings.text: が起きたことを、その「何か」
strings.translated: that there was some "something" --

strings.text: もきっと察しているのに、安易に触れてくることもなかった。
strings.translated: and yet he never pried into it carelessly.

strings.text: その気遣いがありがたかったし、だからこそ信用してみてもいいのかなって思うことができた
strings.translated: I was grateful for that consideration, and it was precisely because of it that I found myself thinking maybe I could trust him.

strings.text: 友佳「じゃあ、あっちの椅子でゆっくり話そ。
strings.translated: Yuka「Okay, let's go sit over there and talk for a while.

strings.text: 個室っていうか、二人掛けの席なんかもあるから
strings.translated: There are some two-person seats -- kind of like private little spots.」

strings.text: 友佳「とりあえず今日はそっちで話したいな。
strings.translated: Yuka「I really want to talk over there today.

strings.text: いっぱい話したいこともあるし
strings.translated: There's so much I want to say.」

strings.text: 友佳「あ、帰りたいなら正直に言ってね。
strings.translated: Yuka「Oh, and if you want to go home, just say so honestly.

strings.text: 雰囲気が合わないとか、今日は予定があるとか、色々あるだろうし
strings.translated: Maybe the atmosphere doesn't suit you, or you have plans -- there are all kinds of reasons, and that's fine.」

strings.text: 美桜「大丈夫。
strings.translated: Mio「It's fine.

strings.text: 雰囲気はいいと思うし、予定なんか全然ないから
strings.translated: I like the atmosphere here, and I don't have any plans at all.」

strings.text: 良かった」
strings.translated: I'm glad.」

strings.text: 友佳はホッとしたように笑った。
strings.translated: Yuka smiled with what looked like relief.

strings.text: 決して無理強いすることなく、私の意志を尊重してくれた。
strings.translated: She never pushed me into anything, and she respected my wishes.

strings.text: こんなに安心できる空間は、もしかすると自分の家でもなかったかもしれない。
strings.translated: A space this comfortable -- I'm not sure I had ever felt it even in my own home.

strings.text: 同じ経験をした友佳と話をするだけで、私の心は久しぶりの穏やかさに浸ることができた
strings.translated: Just talking with Yuka, who had been through the same experience, allowed my heart to sink into a calm it hadn't felt in a long time.

strings.text: 美桜「今日は、本当にありがとう
strings.translated: Mio「Thank you so much for today.」

strings.text: 友佳「ううん。
strings.translated: Yuka「Don't mention it.

strings.text: 私も美桜と会って話せて楽しかった
strings.translated: I had a great time seeing you and talking with you, Mio.」

strings.text: クラブで数時間過ごして、私は家に帰ることにした。
strings.translated: After spending a few hours at the Club, I decided to head home.

strings.text: 本当はもっと友佳と話したかったけど、これ以上遅くなると家族に心配をかけてしまう。
strings.translated: I really wanted to keep talking with Yuka, but staying any later would worry my family.

strings.text: クラブのことを話すのはまだ早すぎると思うし、何より私自身がまだ全容を理解できないでいる。
strings.translated: I thought it was still too soon to tell them about the Club, and more than anything, I still didn't fully understand it myself.

strings.text: あの場所が、本当に私を救ってくれるのかどうかはわからないけど、それを確かめるためにもしばらく通ってみたかった
strings.translated: I didn't know whether that place would truly save me, but I wanted to keep going for a while to find out.

strings.text: 友佳「それじゃ、私はこっちだから
strings.translated: Yuka「Well, I'm heading this way.」

strings.text: 美桜「うん。
strings.translated: Mio「Yeah.

strings.text: 今日は本当にありがとう。
strings.translated: Thank you so much for today.

strings.text: あなたのおかげで、私、ここまで立ち直れた
strings.translated: Because of you, I've been able to come this far.」

strings.text: 友佳「そう言ってくれるのは嬉しいけど、まだ無理してるでしょ
strings.translated: Yuka「I'm glad you feel that way, but you're still pushing yourself, aren't you.」

strings.text: 友佳「無理できるくらい元気になったとも言えるけど、私の前では頑張らなくてもいいからね
strings.translated: Yuka「You could say you've gotten strong enough to push yourself -- but you don't have to try so hard in front of me, okay?」

strings.text: 美桜「…うん」
strings.translated: Mio「...Yeah.」

strings.text: まるで、心の中を見透かされているような言葉。
strings.translated: It was as if she could see right through my heart.

strings.text: でも、それを不快には感じなかった。
strings.translated: But I didn't find it unpleasant.

strings.text: やっぱり、友佳だけが私のことを本当に理解してくれてるって、そんなふうにしか思えなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but feel that Yuka, and only Yuka, truly understood me.

strings.text: 彼女に出会えたことを、私は心の中で深く感謝した
strings.translated: I was deeply grateful in my heart that I had been able to meet her.

strings.text: 美桜「ただいま。
strings.translated: Mio「I'm home.

strings.text: ごめんね、遅くなって
strings.translated: Sorry I'm so late.」

strings.text: 大智「お帰り。
strings.translated: Daichi「Welcome back.

strings.text: こんなに遅くなるんだったら、迎えに行ったのに」
strings.translated: If I'd known you'd be this late, I would've come to pick you up.」

strings.text: 玄関に入ると、すぐに大智が出迎えてくれた。
strings.translated: When I stepped into the entryway, Daichi came to greet me right away.

strings.text: 何度か携帯電話のメールで連絡は入れてたけど、それでもやっぱり心配をかけてしまったらしい。
strings.translated: I had sent him a few texts along the way, but it seemed I'd worried him all the same.

strings.text: 転校初日にこんなに遅くなってしまったのは、さすがに反省しなきゃいけない。
strings.translated: Being this late on my very first day at the new school -- I really had to reflect on that.

strings.text: クラブのことを話すわけにはいかないし、もう少し周りに気を遣って行動すべきだった
strings.translated: I couldn't tell him about the Club, and I should have been more considerate of the people around me.

strings.text: 美桜「待っててね。
strings.translated: Mio「Wait just a bit.

strings.text: すぐご飯にするから
strings.translated: I'll have dinner ready soon.」

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃあ、いただきます
strings.translated: Mio「Okay then -- let's eat.」

strings.text: 芽生「いただきま～す」
strings.translated: Mei「Let's eat!」

strings.text: 夜の時間は、昔通りだった。
strings.translated: The evening hours were just like old times.

strings.text: 私が夕食を作って、大智と芽生がそれを食べる。
strings.translated: I cooked dinner, and Daichi and Mei ate it.

strings.text: ２人とも笑顔で今日一日のことを話しながら、私の作った食事を美味しいって褒めてくれた。
strings.translated: Both of them smiled as they talked about their day, praising my cooking and saying it was delicious.

strings.text: でも、気を遣ってくれてるのはわかってる。
strings.translated: But I could tell they were being considerate of me.

strings.text: 特に大智のほうが、私のことを常に心配してくれていた。
strings.translated: Daichi especially was always worrying about me.

strings.text: 最近は、だいぶ元気になったから安心してるみたいだけど、私が本当は何をどう思ってるかはわかってないみたいだった
strings.translated: Lately I'd been feeling much better, so he seemed relieved -- but it didn't seem like he really understood what I was truly thinking or feeling.

strings.text: 食事を終えて自分の部屋に戻ってからは、友佳にメールを出した。
strings.translated: After finishing dinner and returning to my room, I sent Yuka an email.

strings.text: 今日のことのお礼と、クラブのことについての質問。
strings.translated: A thank-you for today, and some questions about the Club.

strings.text: それから、まだまだ話しきれていなかったことを、３０分くらいかけて文章にまとめた。
strings.translated: Then I spent about thirty minutes putting into words everything I hadn't been able to say yet.

strings.text: 私が、救われるためにはどうすればいいのか。
strings.translated: What I needed to do in order to be saved.

strings.text: クラブでは、どんなふうに過ごせばいいのか。
strings.translated: How I should spend my time at the Club.

strings.text: ちょっと疑問に思ったことも全て、彼女に尋ねてみることにした
strings.translated: I decided to ask her about every little thing that had been on my mind.

strings.text: 美桜「他にどんな人がいるんだろう…」
strings.translated: Mio「I wonder what other kinds of people are there...」

strings.text: 私や友佳のような人が他にもいるのか。
strings.translated: Were there others like me and Yuka?

strings.text: それとも、もっと過酷な人生を歩んできた人もいるのか。
strings.translated: Or were there people who had walked even harsher paths in life?

strings.text: 友佳に訊きたいことは山ほどあった
strings.translated: There was no end to the things I wanted to ask Yuka.

strings.text: 美桜「ふふっ、もうきた」
strings.translated: Mio「Hehe, already got a reply.」

strings.text: 友佳のメールの返事は早い
strings.translated: Yuka was quick to respond.

strings.text: 私は、様々な期待を込めながらそれを開いた。
strings.translated: I opened it, filled with all kinds of anticipation.

strings.text: 彼女との会話やメールだけが、今の私の救いだった
strings.translated: Her conversations and emails were my only salvation right now.

strings.text: 友佳
strings.translated: Yuka

strings.text: 今日は素晴らしい日だった。
strings.translated: Today had been a wonderful day.

strings.text: 私が、救ってあげたいと思っていた子と、ようやく会うことができた。
strings.translated: I had finally been able to meet the girl I had wanted to save.

strings.text: 白坂美桜。
strings.translated: Mio Shirasaka.

strings.text: 私と同じで、強姦事件の被害者。
strings.translated: Like me, a victim of rape.

strings.text: 彼女の悲しみや苦しみ。
strings.translated: Her grief and her suffering.

strings.text: これからの人生に対する苦悩。
strings.translated: The anguish she felt toward the life still ahead of her.

strings.text: 私には全て理解することができた。
strings.translated: I was able to understand all of it.

strings.text: もしかすると、全ては運命のようなものだったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps everything had been something like fate.

strings.text: 私達は、こうなるのが必然だったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps it had been inevitable that things would come to this between us.

strings.text: だって、全く別の場所で生まれて、全く別の人生を歩んできた私達が、強姦されたという経験からこうして繋がることができたんだから…。
strings.translated: Because the two of us -- born in completely different places, having lived completely different lives -- were able to connect through the shared experience of being raped...

strings.text: こんなのって普通はありえない。
strings.translated: Something like this doesn't normally happen.

strings.text: 本来なら、絶対接点なんてなかったのに、今はこうして直接会うこともできた。
strings.translated: Under ordinary circumstances, we never would have had any connection at all, and yet here we were, able to meet face to face.

strings.text: これが運命でなくて何だと言うのだろう
strings.translated: If this wasn't fate, then what could it possibly be?

strings.text: 友佳「こんな出会いもあるんだ
strings.translated: Yuka「So meetings like this can happen too.」

strings.text: 絶望したのは私も同じだった。
strings.translated: I had known despair too -- the same as her.

strings.text: あの日、学校から帰る途中で、突然知らない男の人に襲われた。
strings.translated: That day, on my way home from school, I was suddenly attacked by a man I didn't know.

strings.text: 近くの公園に連れ込まれて、さらにトイレの中に運び込まれて、私はほとんど抵抗もできないままに犯された。
strings.translated: He dragged me into a nearby park, then into a public restroom, and I was raped -- barely able to resist at all.

strings.text: 意味がわからなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't make sense of it.

strings.text: どうして、自分の身にこんな事が起こるのかって、現実を受け入れることができなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't accept the reality of it -- why had something like this happened to me?

strings.text: だって、昨日まで普通に暮らしてたのに、翌日からはそんな気持ちにはなれないのだ。
strings.translated: Because just the day before I had been living a normal life, and yet from the very next day I couldn't feel that way anymore.

strings.text: 自分の部屋に閉じこもって、これからどうなるのか、誰に話せばいいのか、誰にも話してはいけないのか…様々な事を考えていた。
strings.translated: I shut myself in my room, turning over all kinds of thoughts -- what would happen to me from here, who I could tell, whether I was allowed to tell anyone at all...

strings.text: 最終的には両親には話したけど、彼らは戸惑うばかりで私を救ってはくれなかった。
strings.translated: In the end I did tell my parents, but they were only bewildered -- they couldn't save me.

strings.text: どうやって救えばいいのか、全然わからないようだった。
strings.translated: They seemed to have no idea at all how to go about saving someone.

strings.text: 怖くて、悲しくて、これからどうすればいいのかわからなくて、私は何かを探し求めるように部屋を抜け出した
strings.translated: Frightened, heartbroken, with no idea what to do next, I slipped out of my room as if searching for something -- anything.

strings.text: 誰かに助けてほしくて、夜の街をフラフラと出歩いた。
strings.translated: I wandered the streets at night, wanting someone to help me.

strings.text: 冷静に考えてみれば、そんなことをすればまた誰かに犯されてしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I had thought about it calmly, doing something like that might have gotten me violated again.

strings.text: むしろ、普通に考えればそっちのほうが可能性は高かっただろう。
strings.translated: In fact, rationally speaking, that was probably the more likely outcome.

strings.text: でも、神様は私を見捨てていなかった。
strings.translated: But God had not abandoned me.

strings.text: その夜出会ったのは新しい強姦魔じゃなくて、秘密のクラブを運営する園田先生だった。
strings.translated: The person I encountered that night was not a new rapist -- it was Sonoda-sensei, who ran a secret Club.

strings.text: 園田先生は、全てを受け入れてくれた。
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei accepted everything.

strings.text: 私のことを理解して、クラブで過ごすことを勧めてくれた。
strings.translated: He understood me and encouraged me to spend time at the Club.

strings.text: もちろん、最初は戸惑った。
strings.translated: Of course, at first I was bewildered.

strings.text: そんな場所に、何の意味があるのかって、心の中でそう思っていた
strings.translated: I wondered what the point of a place like that could possibly be.

strings.text: でも、クラブで過ごしているうちに、私には理解できるようになっていった。
strings.translated: But as I spent time at the Club, I came to understand.

strings.text: 心を解放することの意味や、様々な愛と、幸せの形。
strings.translated: The meaning of freeing one's heart, the many forms of love, the many shapes of happiness.

strings.text: 理解が深まっていくと、心にも余裕が生まれてくる。
strings.translated: As my understanding deepened, a sense of ease grew in my heart as well.
