strings.text: 周りの人達と笑顔で話したり、お互いの境遇を理解し合ったり…そんなふうにして、私は救いを見出すことができた。
strings.translated: Talking and smiling with the people around me, understanding each other's circumstances... That was how I found my salvation.

strings.text: 求められること。
strings.translated: Being needed.

strings.text: それに応じること。
strings.translated: Responding to that need.

strings.text: 心と心の繋がりを感じられたとき、私は生まれて初めて味わう充足感を得られた。
strings.translated: When I felt the connection of heart to heart, I experienced a sense of fulfillment I had never known before in my life.

strings.text: 結局のところ、人間は１人では生きていけないのだ。
strings.translated: In the end, human beings cannot live alone.

strings.text: 誰かと支え合って生きていかなければ、寂しいし悲しいのだ。
strings.translated: Without someone to lean on, life is lonely and sad.

strings.text: でも、真の意味でそれを理解している人は少ない。
strings.translated: But few people truly understand that in any meaningful sense.

strings.text: 日々を生きるのに精一杯で、自分の幸せを探すこともできないのが実情みたいだった。
strings.translated: The reality seemed to be that most people were too busy just getting through each day to even search for their own happiness.

strings.text: 本当はこんなに素晴らしいのに…人と人とが繋がりあえることは、何にも勝る幸せなのに
strings.translated: And yet it's so wonderful... The ability to connect with another person is a happiness that surpasses everything else.

strings.text: だから、この幸せを誰かに伝えたかった。
strings.translated: That was why I wanted to share this happiness with someone.

strings.text: もっと誰かと共有したかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to share it with more people.

strings.text: そして、苦しんでいる人を私の手で助けたかった。
strings.translated: And I wanted to help those who were suffering with my own hands.

strings.text: そんな時に思いついたのが、私と同じような強姦事件の被害者を救済することだった。
strings.translated: What came to mind then was the idea of saving victims of rape -- people who had been through the same thing as me.

strings.text: インターネットは便利だった。
strings.translated: The internet was useful.

strings.text: 良い情報も悪い情報も入ってくるけど、強姦事件の被害者の集まる場所も簡単に発見することができた。
strings.translated: Good information and bad information both flowed through it, but I was able to easily find places where victims of rape gathered.

strings.text: もちろん、全ての被害者がそこに集まるわけじゃないけど、少なくとも誰かと接点を持つことはできる。
strings.translated: Of course, not every victim would be there, but at least I could make contact with someone.

strings.text: 私は様々なサイトを回りながら、特に共感できそうな人を探した。
strings.translated: I browsed through various sites, searching for people I felt I could especially connect with.

strings.text: 理解し合えて、救ってあげられるかもしれない人を探した
strings.translated: People I might be able to understand, and perhaps save.

strings.text: そうやって見つけたのが、美桜だった。
strings.translated: The one I found that way was Mio.

strings.text: 彼女の最初の書き込みはたった一言。
strings.translated: Her first post was just a single line.

strings.text: 『誰か私を救ってくれませんか？
strings.translated: 『Won't someone save me?

strings.text: 』言葉では説明しづらいけど、その書き込みを見たとき私はピンときた。
strings.translated: 』It's hard to put into words, but when I saw that post, something clicked.

strings.text: 彼女こそ真の救いが必要な人物だと…。
strings.translated: She was someone who truly needed saving...

strings.text: 私の体験が、彼女の助けになるかもしれないと…。
strings.translated: That my own experience might be able to help her...

strings.text: 最初は少しずつ交流を持つようにした。
strings.translated: At first, I tried to build a connection little by little.

strings.text: いきなりクラブのことなんかは話さず、まずは美桜と少しでも理解し合う事を目指した。
strings.translated: Rather than bringing up the Club right away, I focused first on reaching even a small degree of mutual understanding with Mio.

strings.text: どうなるかわからなかった。
strings.translated: I didn't know how it would go.

strings.text: 私だって、こんな事をするのは初めてだ。
strings.translated: Even for me, this was the first time doing something like this.

strings.text: 本当に救ってあげたいって気持ちはあるけど、それを理解してもらえるかどうかはわからなかった。
strings.translated: I genuinely wanted to save her, but I had no idea whether she would understand that.

strings.text: あるいは、彼女の心の傷をさらに広げてしまうような事になるんじゃないかって、内心それが怖くてたまらなかった。
strings.translated: Or perhaps I might end up tearing her emotional wounds open even wider -- deep down, I was terrified of that.

strings.text: でも、美桜とは少しずつ話ができるようになっていった。
strings.translated: But little by little, Mio and I were able to talk more.

strings.text: お互いの経験を話して聞かせて、家族にだって言えないような事を話すようになっていった。
strings.translated: We shared our experiences with each other, and came to talk about things we couldn't even tell our own families.

strings.text: とても嬉しかった。
strings.translated: I was so happy.

strings.text: 美桜が私を求めてくれて、私がそれに応じている関係をひしひしと感じることができた。
strings.translated: I could feel it keenly -- the connection of Mio reaching out to me, and me responding to her.

strings.text: 無駄ではなかったのだ。
strings.translated: It had not been in vain.

strings.text: 私の辛い体験も、今はこうして人のために役立てることができるのだ。
strings.translated: Even my painful experiences could now be put to use for someone else's sake.

strings.text: これからの人生、私は救う側に立たなければならないのだと言うことを、美桜との会話の中で感じていた
strings.translated: Through my conversations with Mio, I felt it -- that for the rest of my life, I had to be the one who saves others.

strings.text: 友佳「本当に会えた…」
strings.translated: Yuka「We really met...」

strings.text: 話をしている当初、美桜がこの街に引越して来るとまでは思っていなかった。
strings.translated: When we first started talking, I never imagined Mio would actually move to this city.

strings.text: いくら何でも、そこまでのことはできないって思っていた。
strings.translated: I thought that was simply too much to ask, no matter what.

strings.text: 一人暮らしならまだしも、美桜の家族は弟や妹までいるのだ。
strings.translated: Even if she lived alone it might be one thing, but Mio's family included younger siblings.

strings.text: さすがに引越すなんてことは不可能だと考えていた。
strings.translated: I had assumed moving was simply out of the question.

strings.text: でも、美桜と電話で話すようになってから、私の中である思いが芽生えていた。
strings.translated: But after Mio and I started talking on the phone, a certain feeling had begun to grow inside me.

strings.text: この街に来れば、クラブに連れて行ってあげられるのに…。
strings.translated: If she came to this city, I could bring her to the Club...

strings.text: 私だけの力で救おうとするよりも、美桜もクラブに通ったほうがずっと早く真の救いを見出せるはずだった。
strings.translated: Rather than trying to save her with my strength alone, it would surely be far faster for Mio to find true salvation by coming to the Club herself.

strings.text: 私がそうだったように、あの場所に来れば幸せを感じることができるはず。
strings.translated: Just as it had been for me -- if she came to that place, she would be able to feel happiness too.

strings.text: ダメで元々。
strings.translated: Nothing to lose.

strings.text: でも、少しだけ背中を押してみようか。
strings.translated: But maybe I could give her just a little push.

strings.text: 私はそんなことを思いながら、美桜がこの街に来たくなるように会話を誘導した。
strings.translated: With that thought in mind, I steered our conversations to make Mio want to come to this city.

strings.text: もちろん、私自身が美桜と一緒に過ごしたいって言う気持ちもあった。
strings.translated: Of course, I also had my own desire to spend time together with Mio.

strings.text: 強姦事件の被害者同士。
strings.translated: Both victims of rape.

strings.text: そんな関係だからこそ、理解し合えるものがある。
strings.translated: It was precisely because of that shared bond that there were things only we could understand about each other.

strings.text: 美桜がこの街に来てくれれば、クラブに通うようになってくれれば、他の誰よりも心を許せる親友になれると思えた。
strings.translated: If Mio came to this city, if she started coming to the Club, I believed she could become a closer friend than anyone else -- someone I could open my heart to completely.

strings.text: その判断が良かったのだろう。
strings.translated: That decision must have been the right one.

strings.text: 美桜は本当にこの街に来てくれた。
strings.translated: Mio really did come to this city.

strings.text: 自分の想いを家族に話して、それを受け入れてもらうことができたようだった。
strings.translated: It seemed she had spoken her feelings to her family, and they had accepted them.

strings.text: 本当に優しい家族。
strings.translated: Truly a kind family.

strings.text: 素晴らしい家族。
strings.translated: A wonderful family.

strings.text: 彼らが、美桜のことを本当に思ってるんだってことが、私にも十分に理解できた。
strings.translated: Even I could understand perfectly well how much they truly cared for Mio.

strings.text: だからこそ、美桜の家族のためにも私は頑張らなければならない。
strings.translated: That was precisely why I had to do my best -- for Mio's family as well.

strings.text: 彼らが笑って暮らせるように、本当の意味で美桜を救ってあげなければならない。
strings.translated: So that they could live with smiles on their faces, I had to save Mio in the truest sense.

strings.text: そしたらきっと、みんなが笑顔で暮らせるから…。
strings.translated: Because then, surely, everyone would be able to live with smiles...

strings.text: 幸せな生活を送ることができるから
strings.translated: Because they would be able to lead happy lives.

strings.text: 友佳「これから頑張らなくちゃ」
strings.translated: Yuka「I have to do my best from here on.」

strings.text: 両手を握り締めて気合いを入れた。
strings.translated: She clenched both hands and steeled herself.

strings.text: 本当の意味で大変なのはここからだ。
strings.translated: The truly hard part started now.

strings.text: だって、私が救われたように、美桜が救われるかどうかはまだわからない。
strings.translated: Because even though I had been saved, there was no guarantee that Mio would be saved the same way.

strings.text: 私が園田先生からしてもらったように、彼女にしてあげられるかどうかもわからない。
strings.translated: There was no guarantee I could do for her what Sonoda-sensei had done for me.

strings.text: 今は全力を尽くすしかないけど、不安がないと言えば嘘になった。
strings.translated: All I could do now was give it everything I had -- but I would be lying if I said I had no anxiety.

strings.text: 私には責任があって、それを全うすることができるかどうか、大きなプレッシャーに襲われていた
strings.translated: I had a responsibility, and I was gripped by enormous pressure over whether I could see it through.

strings.text: 友佳「まずは、クラブに慣れてもらわないとね
strings.translated: Yuka「First, she needs to get used to the Club.」

strings.text: 友佳「園田先生には会うことができたけど、今日だけで受け入れられるとは思えないし」
strings.translated: Yuka「She was able to meet Sonoda-sensei, but I don't think one day is enough for her to really accept it.」

strings.text: 美桜の感じてることは手に取るようにわかった。
strings.translated: I could read Mio's feelings as clearly as if I were holding them in my hands.

strings.text: かつて私がそうだったように、クラブに対する理解を簡単に深められるとは思ってなかった。
strings.translated: Just as I had once been, I didn't think she would be able to deepen her understanding of the Club so easily.

strings.text: 強姦事件の被害者を救うなんて、本当はとても難しいことだ。
strings.translated: Truly saving a victim of rape is incredibly difficult.

strings.text: 心に負った傷は一生癒えることはないし、何をきっかけとして傷口が広がらないとも限らない。
strings.translated: The wounds on the heart never fully heal, and there's no telling what might cause them to tear open again.

strings.text: でも、だからこそ、私達のような人間は理解しないといけない。
strings.translated: But that is precisely why people like us have to understand.

strings.text: いったい何が自分の心に傷を付けたのか。
strings.translated: What was it that wounded our hearts in the first place?

strings.text: 傷を癒すために必要なものは何なのか。
strings.translated: What is needed to heal those wounds?

strings.text: それがわからなければ、他人はもちろん、自分を救うことだってできるはずがなかった
strings.translated: Without knowing that, there was no way to save others -- or even ourselves.

strings.text: 友佳「あ、美桜からだ」
strings.translated: Yuka「Oh, it's from Mio.」

strings.text: 私の個人アドレスに届いたのは、美桜からのメールだった。
strings.translated: What arrived at my personal address was an email from Mio.

strings.text: 今日の感謝とか、クラブについてとか、彼女なりに今の気持ちを必死にまとめたメールになっていた。
strings.translated: Thanks for today, questions about the Club -- she had done her best to put her current feelings into words in her own way.

strings.text: これだけでも、美桜が強く救いを求めてることがわかる。
strings.translated: Even just this much told me how desperately Mio was seeking salvation.

strings.text: 彼女なりに努力していることが、私には理解できる。
strings.translated: I could understand that she was trying her hardest in her own way.

strings.text: だから、美桜からのメールには極力早く返信することにしていた。
strings.translated: That was why I had decided to reply to Mio's emails as quickly as possible.

strings.text: 少しでも彼女の心の支えになるために、私にできる最大限の努力をするつもりだった
strings.translated: I intended to make every effort I could to be even a small support for her heart.

strings.text: 友佳「これで良しと…」
strings.translated: Yuka「There, that should do it...」

strings.text: メールを書いて、すぐに返信する。
strings.translated: I wrote the email and sent my reply right away.

strings.text: 美桜は、メールを書くのがあまり得意じゃないみたいだから、もしかすると今日のうちには返事はないかもしれない。
strings.translated: Mio didn't seem to be very good at writing emails, so she might not reply today.

strings.text: でも、それで問題なかった。
strings.translated: But that was fine.

strings.text: 詳しいことは、明日教えてあげればいい。
strings.translated: I could fill her in on the details tomorrow.

strings.text: クラブについて知りたければ、クラブに行って教えてあげればいい。
strings.translated: If she wanted to know more about the Club, I could take her there and explain it to her.

strings.text: 今は通うこと。
strings.translated: For now, the important thing was to keep coming.

strings.text: それを続けた先に、きっと新しい何かが見えるはず。
strings.translated: If she kept at it, surely something new would come into view.

strings.text: 私がそうだったように、美桜にもきっと新しい生き方がわかるはずだった
strings.translated: Just as it had been for me, Mio would surely find a new way to live.

strings.text: 友佳「そうだ。
strings.translated: Yuka「Oh right.

strings.text: 今日のこと、園田先生にお礼言っておかないと
strings.translated: I need to thank Sonoda-sensei for today.」

strings.text: 友佳「園田先生。
strings.translated: Yuka「Sonoda-sensei.

strings.text: どうか美桜のことをお救いください」
strings.translated: Please save Mio.」

strings.text: 祈るような想いを込めて、園田先生宛てにメールを書く。
strings.translated: With a feeling like a prayer, I wrote an email addressed to Sonoda-sensei.

strings.text: あの人なら、きっと美桜も救ってくれるって私は信じていた。
strings.translated: I believed that he would surely save Mio, just as he had saved me.

strings.text: 私に教えてくれたように、美桜にも新しい世界を教えてあげて欲しかった
strings.translated: I wanted him to show her a new world, just as he had shown me.

strings.text: 新しい街に引越して来てから数日が経過した。
strings.translated: Several days had passed since we moved to the new town.

strings.text: 俺の日常はいたって平穏で、学校にも少しずつ慣れていった。
strings.translated: My daily life was perfectly peaceful, and I was gradually getting used to school.

strings.text: 姉さんは日増しに明るくなっていくし、芽生も毎日楽しそうだ。
strings.translated: My sister was growing brighter with each passing day, and Mei seemed to be having fun every day too.

strings.text: 両親の仕事も徐々に落ち着いてきてるみたいだし、この街に引越して来て良かったって心から思うことができた
strings.translated: It seemed like our parents' work was settling down little by little as well, and I could say from the bottom of my heart that I was glad we had moved to this town.

strings.text: 神村さんとのその後は、特に進展無し。
strings.translated: As for things with Kamimura-san -- no real progress.

strings.text: 色々と期待した部分もあったけど、やっぱりそんなに上手くはいかないみたいだ。
strings.translated: I had my hopes, but it seemed like things just weren't going to go that smoothly.

strings.text: それでも、朝に登校したら挨拶できるくらいの仲ではあるし、これからの努力次第では何かあるかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: Even so, we were at least on terms where we could say good morning when I arrived at school, and depending on how much effort I put in from here, maybe something would come of it.

strings.text: もっとも、俺自身がこれまで女の子と仲良くした経験がない。
strings.translated: That said, I had no experience getting close to a girl.

strings.text: どの程度の距離で接すればいいのか、まだまだそれを計りかねている状況だった。
strings.translated: I still couldn't quite gauge what kind of distance was appropriate.

strings.text: せっかく接点ができたんだし、必要以上に馴れ馴れしくして嫌われるのは避けたい。
strings.translated: We had managed to make a connection, and the last thing I wanted was to come on too strong and be disliked.

strings.text: ゆっくりとでもいいから、普通に話ができるような関係になりたかった
strings.translated: Even if it took time, I wanted to reach a point where we could talk normally.

strings.text: 自分の机で頬杖を付きながら、誰にも気づかれないように神村さんのことを見つめる。
strings.translated: I rested my cheek on my hand at my desk and watched Kamimura-san, careful not to let anyone notice.

strings.text: 初日から可愛い子だって思ってたけど、同じクラスメイトになると彼女の新しい一面が次々と見えてきた。
strings.translated: I had thought she was cute from the very first day, but now that we were in the same class, new sides of her kept revealing themselves one after another.

strings.text: 冷静で物静か。
strings.translated: Calm and quiet.

strings.text: 仲の良い友達はそれほど多くはないみたいで、基本的には特定の女の子とよく話している。
strings.translated: She didn't seem to have that many close friends -- for the most part, she talked mainly with a specific girl.

strings.text: まあ、そういうのは誰でも同じで、俺だっていまだに話のできるクラスメイトは限られていた。
strings.translated: Well, that was the same for everyone; even I still had only a limited number of classmates I could actually talk to.

strings.text: 他には…登校時間がいつも同じだから、すごく規則正しい生活をしてるのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Other things I'd noticed... she always arrived at school at the same time, so maybe she lived a very regimented life.

strings.text: もしかすると、寝る時間とか、起きる時間とか、家を出る時間まで全部決まってたり…。
strings.translated: Maybe she had set times for going to bed, waking up, even leaving the house...

strings.text: そんなことはないか。
strings.translated: Or maybe not.

strings.text: こんな観察をしていると自分でもストーカーみたいだって思うけど、同じクラスにいるとどうしても目が行ってしまう。
strings.translated: Observing her like this made even me feel like some kind of stalker, but when you're in the same class, your eyes just naturally drift that way.

strings.text: そういう女の子だ
strings.translated: She was just that kind of girl.

strings.text: ／瑛「白坂君、今日はお弁当？」
strings.translated: Akira「Shirasaka-kun, did you bring a lunch today?」

strings.text: 教材を片付けていると、クラスメイトの桧垣瑛が話し掛けてきた。
strings.translated: As I was putting away my things, my classmate Akira Higaki struck up a conversation with me.

strings.text: 今のところ、一番話ができる男友達だ。
strings.translated: He was the male friend I could talk to most easily at this point.

strings.text: 面倒見のいい奴で、最初はなかなかクラスの連中に話し掛けられないでいる俺を見かねて、声をかけてくれたらしかった。
strings.translated: He was a caring guy -- apparently, when he first noticed me struggling to approach anyone in class, he'd taken it upon himself to reach out.

strings.text: 今では気楽に接することができて、時々食事も一緒にする仲になっていた
strings.translated: By now we were comfortable enough around each other that we'd sometimes eat together too.

strings.text: 大智「いや、今日は学食
strings.translated: Daichi「No, I'm doing the cafeteria today.」

strings.text: 瑛「じゃあ一緒に食べよう
strings.translated: Akira「Then let's eat together.」

strings.text: 桧垣と一緒に学食へと移動する。
strings.translated: I headed to the school cafeteria with Higaki.

strings.text: この学校の学食は、かなり大きめでメニューも豊富。
strings.translated: The cafeteria at this school was pretty large, with a wide variety of menu options.

strings.text: 味も十分に美味しいから、最近は姉さんに弁当を作ってもらう回数も減って来ていた。
strings.translated: The food was good enough that I'd been asking my sister to pack me a lunch less and less often lately.

strings.text: もちろん、姉さんの弁当に飽きたってわけでもなければ、学食のメニューのほうが美味しいってわけでもない。
strings.translated: Not that I'd gotten tired of her lunches, or that the cafeteria food was better, of course.

strings.text: ただ、姉さんにはもっと自分の時間を持ってもらいたかったし、何よりも甘え過ぎるのは良くないと考えての事だった
strings.translated: I just wanted her to have more time for herself -- and more than anything, I figured it wasn't good to keep depending on her so much.

strings.text: 瑛「どう？
strings.translated: Akira「So?

strings.text: 学校にはもう慣れた？
strings.translated: "So, have you gotten used to school yet?"

strings.text: 大智「もうすっかり…ってわけにはいかないけど、だいぶ慣れてきた気がするな
strings.translated: Daichi「Not completely... but I feel like I've gotten pretty used to it.」

strings.text: 瑛「それは良かった。
strings.translated: Akira「That's good.

strings.text: でも、何か困った事があったらいつでも言ってね」
strings.translated: But if anything's giving you trouble, just say the word.」

strings.text: そう言って、桧垣がにっこりと笑う。
strings.translated: She says that, and Higaki smiles brightly.

strings.text: この顔立ちで、成績はトップクラスで、とても優しい。
strings.translated: With looks like his, top-of-the-class grades, and a genuinely kind personality --

strings.text: しかも弓道部の部長の上、生徒会の副会長まで務めてたりするものだから、女の子に人気が出ないわけがなかった。
strings.translated: On top of that, he was captain of the archery club and vice president of the student council, so there was no way the girls weren't going to be all over him.

strings.text: こうして学食で食事をしている間も、周りの女の子からの視線を感じたりする。
strings.translated: Even now, eating here in the cafeteria, I could feel the gazes of the girls around us.

strings.text: 問題なのは、そういうのに本人が疎いのか、全く気にしてない事だった。
strings.translated: The thing was, he either didn't notice or simply didn't care at all.

strings.text: もしも俺が女だったりして、それでも桧垣が善意で今と同じように接してくれていたら、周りの女の子達から嫉妬の目を向けられたんだろうな。
strings.translated: If I were a girl, and Higaki was still treating me the same way out of pure goodwill, I'd probably be drawing jealous stares from every girl around us.

strings.text: そう考えると、男で良かったって内心安堵していた
strings.translated: Thinking about it that way, I felt a quiet sense of relief that I was a guy.

strings.text: 瑛「あれ？
strings.translated: Akira「Hmm?

strings.text: 今日は水曜日だったっけ？
strings.translated: "Wait, is today Wednesday?"

strings.text: 大智「いや、火曜日だけど
strings.translated: Daichi「No, it's Tuesday.」

strings.text: 瑛「ああ、良かった。
strings.translated: Akira「Oh, good.

strings.text: 水曜日は打ち合わせが入ってたから、一瞬すっぽかしたかと思ったよ
strings.translated: I had a meeting on Wednesday, and for a second I thought I'd missed it.」

strings.text: 大智「生徒会、忙しそうだよな
strings.translated: Daichi「Student council sounds like a lot of work.」

strings.text: 瑛「忙しいけど、やり甲斐は感じてるよ。
strings.translated: Akira「It's busy, but I find it rewarding.

strings.text: みんなの役に立ててるって実感もあるしね
strings.translated: I get a real sense that I'm being useful to everyone.」

strings.text: 瑛「それに、生徒会長がしっかりしてるから、僕のやることはあまりないんだ
strings.translated: Akira「Besides, the student council president is so capable that there isn't actually that much for me to do.」

strings.text: ／紗英子「あら、嬉しいこと言ってくれるじゃない
strings.translated: Saeko「My, aren't you sweet to say that.

strings.text: 桧垣と話していると、それに割り込む声があった
strings.translated: As Higaki and I were talking, a voice cut into our conversation.

strings.text: 視線を向けると、話題に上った生徒会長の菱木紗英子さんが立っている
strings.translated: I looked over to see student council president Saeko Hishiki standing there -- the very person we had just been talking about.

strings.text: 紗英子「しっかりしてるのは、桧垣さんのほうだと思うけど
strings.translated: Saeko「I think you're the capable one, Higaki-san.」

strings.text: 瑛「そうかな？
strings.translated: Akira「You think so?

strings.text: 僕は、よく注意力散漫だって言われるけど
strings.translated: "People tell me I'm scatterbrained a lot, though --"

strings.text: 紗英子「誰が言ってるのよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「Who on earth is saying that?

strings.text: あなたが散漫だったら、ほかの人は痴呆じゃない」
strings.translated: If you're scatterbrained, everyone else must be senile.」

strings.text: それは言えてる。
strings.translated: That was a fair point.

strings.text: しっかり者の桧垣が注意力散漫だったら、俺なんか注意力皆無と言っていい。
strings.translated: If someone as dependable as Higaki was scatterbrained, then I might as well be called completely oblivious.

strings.text: 本当に同じ年齢なのかって疑うほど、優秀な奴だった
strings.translated: He was so sharp it made me genuinely wonder if we were really the same age.

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたは白坂さん、だったわよね？
strings.translated: Saeko「You're Shirasaka-kun, right?

strings.text: 学校には慣れた？
strings.translated: "Have you gotten used to school?"

strings.text: 大智「はい。
strings.translated: Daichi「Yes.

strings.text: …うん、だいぶ」
strings.translated: ...Yeah, pretty much.」

strings.text: どうも菱木さんは苦手だ。
strings.translated: Hishiki-san made me nervous for some reason.

strings.text: 同い年だからため口でいい筈なのに、うっかり敬語になる
strings.translated: Since we were the same age, I should have been speaking casually, but I kept slipping into formal speech without thinking.

strings.text: 紗英子「桧垣さんがいるから大丈夫だと思うけど、何かあったらいつでも頼ってね
strings.translated: Saeko「I think you'll be fine with Higaki-san around, but feel free to rely on me anytime if something comes up.」

strings.text: 大智「ありがとう
strings.translated: Daichi「Thank you.」

strings.text: 紗英子「それじゃあ、私はあっちの席の子達と食べるから
strings.translated: Saeko「Well then, I'm going to eat with the girls over there.」

strings.text: そう言って、菱木さんが少し離れた席へと歩いていく。
strings.translated: With that, Hishiki-san walked off toward a table a little ways away.

strings.text: そこには、クラスメイトらしき数人の女の子が先に座っていた。
strings.translated: A few girls who looked like her classmates were already seated there.

strings.text: 生徒会長でも、友達と一緒に食堂でご飯を食べたりするんだな。
strings.translated: Even the student council president eats lunch in the cafeteria with her friends, huh.

strings.text: …当たり前か。
strings.translated: ...Well, of course she does.

strings.text: 生徒会長って言っても、学校の生徒であることに変わりはないんだし。
strings.translated: Even if she's student council president, she's still a student at this school.

strings.text: 仲の良い友達がいたり、誰か好きな人がいたりしても不思議じゃないんだよな。
strings.translated: It's not strange at all for her to have close friends, or even someone she likes.

strings.text: でも、前の学校では生徒会長と話す機会なんてなかったし、学年も上だったから、やっぱり俺にとってはすごく偉い人って印象が強かった
strings.translated: But at my old school I never had a chance to talk to the student council president, and she was an upperclassman too, so I still had a strong impression of her as someone very important.

strings.text: 大智「ふぅ…緊張した
strings.translated: Daichi「Phew... that was nerve-wracking.」

strings.text: 瑛「えっ？
strings.translated: Akira「Huh?

strings.text: なんで？
strings.translated: Why?

strings.text: 大智「いや、生徒会長だし。
strings.translated: Daichi「I mean, she's the student council president.

strings.text: 何ていうか…失礼みたいなのがあったりしたらヤバイだろ
strings.translated: Like... it'd be bad if I said something rude or whatever.」

strings.text: 瑛「同い年だし、そんなの気にする人じゃないよ
strings.translated: Akira「She's the same age as us, and she's not the type to care about that stuff.」

strings.text: 大智「俺が気にするんだよ
strings.translated: Daichi「I care about it.」

strings.text: 桧垣と話しながら食事を続ける。
strings.translated: I continued eating while chatting with Higaki.

strings.text: 菱木さんとは桧垣が副会長って縁で話すようになったけど、正直まだ慣れていない。
strings.translated: I started talking to Hishiki-san through the connection of Higaki being vice president, but honestly I still wasn't used to it.

strings.text: 見た目も少しキツそうな感じの、しかもかなりの美人だから、話をする時どうしても体が硬くなってしまう。
strings.translated: She had a slightly sharp look about her, and on top of that she was quite a beauty, so my body would stiffen up whenever I talked to her.

strings.text: 優しい人だっていうのはわかってるんだけど、学校生活よりもこっちのほうが慣れが必要だ
strings.translated: I knew she was a kind person, but this was something I needed to get used to even more than school life itself.

strings.text: 大智「ふぅっ、やっと終わった」
strings.translated: Daichi「Phew, finally done.」

strings.text: 今日の授業が終わって、俺は小さく吐息を漏らした。
strings.translated: When today's classes ended, I let out a small sigh.

strings.text: 学校にも慣れてきたから、その分だけ授業を真面目に受ける余裕が出て来ている。
strings.translated: Now that I'd gotten used to school, I had enough breathing room to actually pay attention in class.

strings.text: 姉さんのことも気にならないわけじゃないけど、初日ほど不安に思うこともなかった。
strings.translated: I wasn't completely free from worrying about my sister, but I wasn't as anxious as I had been on the first day.

strings.text: 毎日、こうやって暮らせるといいな。
strings.translated: I hope I can keep living like this every day.

strings.text: 大きな不安がなくて、小さな期待があって、こうやって暮らしていけたらいいと思う
strings.translated: No big anxieties, just small hopes -- I'd like to keep living that way.

strings.text: 大智「さて、今日はどうするかな」
strings.translated: Daichi「So, what should I do today?」

strings.text: 鞄の中に教材を突っ込みながら、これからのことを考える。
strings.translated: I thought about what to do next as I stuffed my things into my bag.

strings.text: まだ家の片付けは残ってるけど、それもだいぶ落ち着いてきた。
strings.translated: There was still some unpacking left at home, but that had mostly settled down.

strings.text: たまになら、街のほうに遊びに行ってブラつくのもアリだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe it would be okay to go wander around town once in a while.

strings.text: でも、１人で行くのもつまらない気がする。
strings.translated: But going alone felt kind of boring.

strings.text: せっかくなら、桧垣でも誘ってみようかと思ったけど
strings.translated: I thought about inviting Higaki, but --

strings.text: 大智「もういないし…」
strings.translated: Daichi「He's already gone...」

strings.text: 既に教室内に桧垣の姿はなかった。
strings.translated: Higaki was no longer anywhere to be seen in the classroom.

strings.text: たぶん部活か、生徒会の仕事が忙しいんだろう。
strings.translated: He was probably busy with club activities or student council work.

strings.text: 俺も前の学校ではサッカー部に入っていたけど、姉さんの一件があってやめてしまった。
strings.translated: I had been in the soccer club at my old school too, but I quit after what happened with my sister.

strings.text: 俺たちの事を知らない新しい学校に来たんだし、やり直すことは可能だけど…まだ踏ん切りはついていなかった
strings.translated: I'd come to a new school where no one knew about us, so starting over was possible, but... I still hadn't made up my mind.

strings.text: ／円夏「白坂君、ちょっといい？」
strings.translated: Madoka「Shiraka-kun, do you have a moment?」

strings.text: ぼんやりと考えていると、隣のクラスの星野円夏さんが声をかけてきた
strings.translated: I was lost in thought when Hoshino Madoka from the next class over called out to me.

strings.text: 円夏「これ、昨日話してた漫画、『田中英雄』。
strings.translated: Madoka「Here -- the manga I was talking about yesterday, "Tanaka Hideo.

strings.text: 良かったら読んでみて
strings.translated: " Give it a read if you'd like.」

strings.text: 大智「持って来てくれたのか。
strings.translated: Daichi「You actually brought it.

strings.text: ありがとう」
strings.translated: Thanks.」

strings.text: 星野さんが差し出してきた本を受け取る。
strings.translated: I took the book Hoshino-san held out to me.

strings.text: ちょうど興味のあるやつだったから、貸してもらえるのはありがたい。
strings.translated: It happened to be one I was interested in, so I was glad to borrow it.

strings.text: でも、読み終わったら持ってくるとは言ってたけど、まさか次の日に持って来てくれるなんて
strings.translated: She had said she'd bring it once she was done reading, but I never expected her to bring it the very next day.

strings.text: 円夏「お兄ちゃんが買ってる雑誌に載ってたんだけど、すっごく面白かったの。
strings.translated: Madoka「It was running in a magazine my brother buys, and it was so good.

strings.text: 読み終わったら感想聞かせて
strings.translated: Tell me what you think when you're done.」

strings.text: なるべく早く読むよ
strings.translated: I'll read it as soon as I can.」

strings.text: 円夏「あっ、急かしてるわけじゃないから。
strings.translated: Madoka「Oh, I'm not trying to rush you.

strings.text: ゆっくりじっくり読んでみてね」
strings.translated: Take your time and really get into it.」

strings.text: 星野さんは神村さんの友達で、神村さんと挨拶するうちに話をするようになった。
strings.translated: Hoshino-san was a friend of Kamimura-san's, and we started talking as I got to know Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 気さくな女の子で、転校してきたばかりの俺にもよく声をかけてくれる。
strings.translated: She was an easygoing girl who often talked to me even though I had just transferred in.

strings.text: 時々は、神村さんを含めて３人で昼食をとったりすることもあって、仲の良い同級生の１人だった
strings.translated: Sometimes the three of us, including Kamimura-san, would have lunch together, and she had become one of my closer classmates.

strings.text: 円夏「これ、愛にも貸したんだけど、反応イマイチだったんだ
strings.translated: Madoka「I lent this to Ai too, but her reaction was pretty lukewarm.」

strings.text: 大智「そうなのか。
strings.translated: Daichi「Really?

strings.text: 面白そうだけど
strings.translated: It looks interesting though.」

strings.text: 円夏「まあ、あの子はだいたい何でもそんな感じなんだけど。
strings.translated: Madoka「Well, she's kind of like that with most things.

strings.text: って、そもそも女子向けの漫画じゃないしね」
strings.translated: And I mean, it's not really a manga for girls to begin with.」

strings.text: 星野さんが、肩をすくめながら苦笑いを浮かべる
strings.translated: Hoshino-san shrugged with a wry smile.

strings.text: 大智「悪いな。
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry.

strings.text: なんか色々借りまくってて
strings.translated: I keep borrowing all kinds of stuff from you.」

strings.text: 円夏「いいのいいの。
strings.translated: Madoka「Don't worry about it.

strings.text: 私も、こういうのに共感してくれる友達ができたら嬉しいから
strings.translated: I'm happy to have a friend who can appreciate this kind of thing.」

strings.text: 大智「まだ箱から出してない本も多いし、ありがたいよ
strings.translated: Daichi「I still have a lot of books I haven't unpacked yet, so this really helps.」

strings.text: 円夏「引越しって大変だもんね」
strings.translated: Madoka「Moving is such a hassle, isn't it.」

strings.text: 話のできる人が増えていくと、学校生活も楽しさが増していった。
strings.translated: As I got to know more people to talk to, school life became more enjoyable.

strings.text: この学校に来て良かったって、そう思うことも増えた
strings.translated: I found myself thinking more and more that I was glad I came to this school.

strings.text: 円夏「そう言えば、白坂君ってどうしてこの街に引越してきたの？
strings.translated: Madoka「By the way, Shirasaka-kun, why did you move to this town?」

strings.text: 大智「色々あるんだけど…親の仕事の都合で引越すことになって、姉貴が調べて……俺たちの学校も、妹の学校も近くにあるし、ここがいいって
strings.translated: Daichi「There were various reasons... my parents needed to move for work, and my sister looked into it... our school and my little sister's school are both nearby, so she said this was the place.」

strings.text: 円夏「へぇ～っ、お姉さんが来たいって言ったんだ？
strings.translated: Madoka「Oh wow, your older sister was the one who wanted to come here?

strings.text: 確かに、『若者の街！
strings.translated: It's true, it had that whole "City of Youth!" vibe.

strings.text: 』って感じだもんね
strings.translated: ' kind of vibe.」

strings.text: 大智「星野さんも若いだろ」
strings.translated: Daichi「You're young too, Hoshino-san.」

strings.text: 俺達一家が引越してきた理由については、適当にごまかしながら説明することが多かった。
strings.translated: I often gave vague, evasive explanations when it came to why my family moved here.

strings.text: 本当の理由なんて話せないし、聞かされたほうだって反応に困るのは間違いない。
strings.translated: I couldn't tell anyone the real reason, and whoever heard it would definitely not know how to react.

strings.text: 姉さんの身にあったことは、俺達家族だけの秘密だ。
strings.translated: What happened to my sister was a secret for our family alone.

strings.text: 決して誰にも言うわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: There was no way I could ever tell anyone.

strings.text: もしも…もしも、誰かに知られてしまったら、そこから今の生活が崩れる可能性も十分に考えられた
strings.translated: If someone found out... if someone found out, there was every chance it could unravel the life we had now.

strings.text: 大智「まあ、とにかくありがとう。
strings.translated: Daichi「Anyway, thanks.

strings.text: 読んでみるよ
strings.translated: I'll give it a read.」

strings.text: 円夏「うん。
strings.translated: Madoka「Yeah.

strings.text: 気に入ったら他にもいろいろあるから
strings.translated: If you like it, I've got plenty more.」

strings.text: 円夏「あ、愛ーっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Oh, Ai!」

strings.text: 俺との話を打ち切って、星野さんが神村さんのほうへと近づいていく。
strings.translated: Cutting off our conversation, Hoshino-san headed over toward Kamimura-san.

strings.text: それじゃあ俺は
strings.translated: Well then, I guess I'll --

strings.text: 大智「帰るか」
strings.translated: Daichi「Head home.」

strings.text: せっかく本を借りたんだし、忙しそうな桧垣を呼び出すのも何だ。
strings.translated: I'd just borrowed a book, and it felt wrong to drag out a busy-looking Higaki.

strings.text: 今日は帰って借りた本を読もう。
strings.translated: I'd go home and read the manga I borrowed today.

strings.text: どんな内容なのか楽しみだったし、神村さんも読んだみたいだから少しは話題にできるかもしれない。
strings.translated: I was looking forward to seeing what it was about, and since Kamimura-san had read it too, maybe it could be a conversation starter.

strings.text: 色々な期待を胸に秘めて、俺は教室を後にした
strings.translated: Holding all kinds of little hopes in my chest, I left the classroom.

strings.text: 何の問題もない平和な学校生活。
strings.translated: A peaceful school life with no problems whatsoever.

strings.text: これが、長く続いてくれることだけが、俺の細やかな望みだった。
strings.translated: That it would last a long time -- that was my one modest wish.

strings.text: もうあんな悪夢は体験したくない。
strings.translated: I never wanted to go through that nightmare again.

strings.text: みんなが笑っていられるのが一番いい。
strings.translated: It was best when everyone could smile.

strings.text: １日１日が過ぎて行く毎に、そんなことを考える機会すら減っていった
strings.translated: As each day passed, I found myself thinking about such things less and less.

strings.text: 大智「星野さん」
strings.translated: Daichi「Hoshino-san.」

strings.text: 数日後、放課後になって俺は星野さんのクラスに行った。
strings.translated: A few days later, after school, I went to Hoshino-san's classroom.

strings.text: 借りていた本を読んだから、それを返すためだ。
strings.translated: I had finished reading the manga she lent me and was returning it.

strings.text: 幸いにして星野さんはまだ教室にいて、俺の姿に気づくとすぐに寄って来てくれた
strings.translated: Fortunately she was still in the classroom, and when she noticed me she came right over.

strings.text: 大智「これ、ありがとう
strings.translated: Daichi「Here, thanks for this.」

strings.text: 円夏「もう読んだの？
strings.translated: Madoka「You finished already?

strings.text: もっとゆっくりでも良かったのに
strings.translated: You didn't have to rush through it, you know.

strings.text: 大智「いや、面白かったから一気に読めた
strings.translated: Daichi「No, it was so good I read it all in one go.」

strings.text: 円夏「でしょ？
strings.translated: Madoka「Right?

strings.text: よかったー！
strings.translated: I'm so glad!

strings.text: 愛もだけど、女の子だとああいうの読んでくれる人いないんだ」
strings.translated: Same with Ai, but there's just nobody among the girls who'll read that kind of stuff with me.」

strings.text: 星野さんに借りた本は本当に面白かった。
strings.translated: The book I borrowed from Hoshino-san was genuinely interesting.

strings.text: 笑えるシーンもあれば泣けるシーンもあって、何よりテンポがいいっていうか、とにかくつい読んでしまう内容だった。
strings.translated: There were scenes that made me laugh and scenes that made me tear up, and above all the pacing was great -- it was just the kind of story you can't put down.

strings.text: 星野さんが勧めるのもよくわかる。
strings.translated: I can totally see why Hoshino-san recommends it.

strings.text: 難点があるとしたら、まだ完結していないってことくらいだ。
strings.translated: If there's one downside, it's that it still hasn't finished yet.

strings.text: それから暫く借りた漫画について話をしていたら、何気なく時計を見た星野さんが唐突に声を上げた
strings.translated: After that we talked for a while about the manga I'd borrowed, until Hoshino-san happened to glance at the clock and suddenly cried out --

strings.text: 円夏「あっ、ヤバッ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Oh, shoot!

strings.text: 部活いかなきゃ！
strings.translated: I have to get to club!

strings.text: 円夏「それじゃ、また別のおススメ、持ってくるね
strings.translated: Madoka「Okay, I'll bring you some more recommendations next time.」

strings.text: 大智「俺も何か持って来るよ
strings.translated: Daichi「I'll bring something for you next time too.」

strings.text: 立ち話を切り上げて、俺は自分の教室へと戻った。
strings.translated: I wrapped up our chat and headed back to my own classroom.

strings.text: 星野さんと話すのは楽しいけど、何となく周りの視線を感じてしまう。
strings.translated: Talking with Hoshino-san is fun, but I can't help feeling the eyes of people around us.

strings.text: こういうのって、時間が経てば慣れるものなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Is that the kind of thing you get used to over time?

strings.text: 俺が気にしすぎてるだけなんだろうか
strings.translated: Or am I just overthinking it?

strings.text: 愛「白坂君
strings.translated: Ai「Shirasaka-kun.」

strings.text: 教室入ると神村さんに声をかけられた。
strings.translated: When I walked into the classroom, Kamimura-san called out to me.

strings.text: 何だろう
strings.translated: What's up?

strings.text: 大智「何？
strings.translated: Daichi「What is it?」

strings.text: 愛「円夏から借りた本、全部読んだの？
strings.translated: Ai「Did you read all of the manga you borrowed from Madoka?」

strings.text: ああ…」
strings.translated: Oh... right.」

strings.text: 予想外の質問をされて、思わず曖昧な返事をしてしまう。
strings.translated: The unexpected question caught me off guard and I gave a vague answer without thinking.

strings.text: 神村さんのほうから話をしてくれるなんて珍しいな
strings.translated: It's unusual for Kamimura-san to be the one to start a conversation.

strings.text: 愛「あの本…やっぱり、面白かった？
strings.translated: Ai「That manga... was it actually interesting to you?」

strings.text: 大智「ああ、面白かったよ
strings.translated: Daichi「Yeah, it was interesting.」

strings.text: 愛「どの辺が面白かったの？
strings.translated: Ai「What parts did you find interesting?」

strings.text: 大智「どの辺がって言われても…色々あるけど…。
strings.translated: Daichi「What parts, you ask... there's a lot, but...

strings.text: 話の運び方とか…あのはじまり方でゾンビものとは思わなかったし……あとはやっぱり、１巻の終わり方かな
strings.translated: The way the story unfolds... I never would have guessed it was a zombie story from the opening... and then there's the way volume one ends, I guess.」

strings.text: 大智「神村さんは、面白くなかったんだっけ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san, you said you didn't really enjoy it, right?」

strings.text: 愛「面白くなかったっていうより……よくわからなくて
strings.translated: Ai「It's not that I didn't enjoy it... more that I just didn't understand it.」

strings.text: 大智「そっか…。
strings.translated: Daichi「Is that so...

strings.text: そんなに捻った話じゃなかったと思うけど
strings.translated: I didn't think the story was all that convoluted, though.」

strings.text: 愛「内容は理解できるつもり。
strings.translated: Ai「I think I understood the content.

strings.text: でも、読み終わった後に、自分が何を思えばいいのかわからなかったの
strings.translated: But after I finished reading, I didn't know what I was supposed to feel.」

strings.text: 大智「自分が何を思えばいいか…」
strings.translated: Daichi「What you're supposed to feel...」

strings.text: 何だか妙な言葉だった。
strings.translated: That was a strange way to put it.

strings.text: 何を思えばいいのかなんて決まってるわけじゃないんだし、読み終わったときに感じたことが自分の感想でいいと思うんだけどな。
strings.translated: It's not like there's a right answer for what you're supposed to feel -- whatever you felt when you finished reading is your own honest reaction, and that should be enough.

strings.text: それとも、神村さんにとっては感想を抱くほどでもなかったってことなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Or maybe it just meant that, for Kamimura-san, it hadn't been enough to stir any feelings at all.

strings.text: 内容は理解できても感想がないってことは、つまりつまらなかったって事なんだろうな
strings.translated: Being able to follow the content but having no reaction to it -- I guess that just means it was boring to her.

strings.text: 大智「神村さん、好きな本ってある？
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san, is there a book you actually like?

strings.text: 漫画でも小説でも」
strings.translated: Whether it's manga or novels.」

strings.text: 俺の持っているものの中にあれば、貸してみるのもいいかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I have something in my collection she might enjoy, it might be worth lending it to her.

strings.text: 少女漫画はさすがに守備範囲外だけど…姉さんが持ってるだろうか
strings.translated: Shoujo manga is a bit out of my range... though maybe my sister has some.

strings.text: 愛「好きな本…」
strings.translated: Ai「A book I like...」

strings.text: 神村さんが、顎に手を当てて考え始める。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san brought a hand to her chin and began to think.

strings.text: そんなに難しい質問をしたつもりはないんだけど、変に悩ませてしまったみたいだ。
strings.translated: I hadn't meant to ask such a difficult question, but it seemed I'd gotten her oddly worked up over it.

strings.text: こういうのを、すごく真面目に考える性格なんだろうか
strings.translated: Maybe she's just the type who takes these things very seriously.

strings.text: 大智「深く考えなくていいよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「You don't have to think too hard about it.

strings.text: そんなに難しいこと言ったつもりないし
strings.translated: I didn't mean it as a difficult question.」

strings.text: 愛「私には…少し難しいことだったかもしれない
strings.translated: Ai「For me... it might have been a little difficult.」

strings.text: 大智「神村さんって、あまり本を読まないほう？
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san, do you not read much?」

strings.text: 愛「本は読むけど、楽しいって感じたことがないの
strings.translated: Ai「I do read, but I've never felt like I enjoyed it.」

strings.text: 大智「それじゃあ…ドラマとか、映画とかは？
strings.translated: Daichi「Then... what about dramas, or movies?」

strings.text: 愛「そういうのもよくわからないの。
strings.translated: Ai「I don't really understand those either.

strings.text: みんなが楽しいと思っていても、私にはそう感じられなくて
strings.translated: Even when everyone else seems to be enjoying something, I just can't feel it the same way.」

strings.text: 愛「私がおかしいのかな
strings.translated: Ai「Maybe there's something wrong with me.」

strings.text: 大智「そんなことないと思うけど…」
strings.translated: Daichi「I don't think that's really the case, though...」

strings.text: 口ではそう言いつつも、神村さんはちょっと変わってるのかもしれないと思ってしまっていた。
strings.translated: Even as I said that, I couldn't help thinking that Kamimura-san might just be a little unusual.

strings.text: もしかすると、感受性が弱いっていうか、あんまり何かに共感したりすることが少ないのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe she had a weak sense of empathy -- like she didn't often find herself relating to things.

strings.text: でも、世の中そういう人だっているだろうし、神村さんの感覚がおかしいとまでは思わなかった。
strings.translated: But there are people like that in the world, and I didn't think Kamimura-san's sensibilities were off, exactly.

strings.text: そもそもがなんていうか……茫洋とした、雰囲気のある女の子だ。
strings.translated: She was just... how to put it -- a girl with a kind of hazy, drifting quality about her.

strings.text: むしろ神村さんらしいとすら感じる
strings.translated: If anything, it felt very much like her.

strings.text: 愛「…ごめんなさい。
strings.translated: Ai「...I'm sorry.

strings.text: 私、そろそろ帰るね
strings.translated: I should be heading home soon.」

strings.text: 大智「うん、また明日
strings.translated: Daichi「Sure, see you tomorrow.」

strings.text: 愛「また明日
strings.translated: Ai「See you tomorrow.」

strings.text: 神村さんと別れの挨拶を交わす。
strings.translated: I exchanged goodbyes with Kamimura-san.

strings.text: あまり会話は弾まなかったけど、話ができただけマシだと思うべきだろう。
strings.translated: The conversation hadn't really taken off, but I figured I should be glad we talked at all.

strings.text: できれば、神村さんの好みのひとつもわかれば、そこから更に話を広げることができたかもしれないんだけど
strings.translated: If only I'd been able to find out even one thing she liked, I might have been able to build on that.

strings.text: 大智「神村さんが、好きになれそうな本か…何かあったかな」
strings.translated: Daichi「A book Kamimura-san might actually enjoy... do I have anything like that?」

strings.text: まだ整理してない荷物のことを思い出して、神村さんが楽しめそうなものがあったかどうかを思い出す。
strings.translated: I thought back to the boxes I still hadn't unpacked, trying to remember if there was anything she might get something out of.

strings.text: 漫画より小説なんかの方がいいのかもしれないな。
strings.translated: Novels might work better than manga for her.

strings.text: …となると、俺にはやっぱり難しそうだ。
strings.translated: ...In that case, I'm probably not the best person to ask.

strings.text: 姉さんなら持ってるだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe my sister would have something.

strings.text: 他には……意外と菱木さんとなら話が合ったりするのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Or... come to think of it, maybe she and Higaki-san would actually get along.

strings.text: ２人とも存在感のある美人だし。
strings.translated: They're both striking women with a strong presence.

strings.text: いや、容姿は関係ないけど、なんていうか……人並み外れていて、近寄りがたい感じは似ている気がする。
strings.translated: Well, looks have nothing to do with it, but there's something about them -- the way they both seem a cut above everyone else, a little hard to approach.

strings.text: とりあえずは、もう少し話ができる関係になってから、どんなものなら興味がわくのか訊いてみることにしよう
strings.translated: Anyway, I'll get to know her a little better first, then ask what kinds of things she might be interested in.

strings.text: 大智「俺も帰るか」
strings.translated: Daichi「Guess I'll head home too.」

strings.text: これといってやることもないし、さっさと家に帰ることにした。
strings.translated: There wasn't anything in particular I needed to do, so I decided to just go home.

strings.text: 神村さんに向きそうな本は難しいけど、星野さんにもお返しをしたいし、いまだに段ボール箱の中にあるものを整理しなければいけない。
strings.translated: Finding something for Kamimura-san was going to be tough, but I also wanted to return the favor to Hoshino-san, and I still had to sort through all those cardboard boxes.

strings.text: 心当たりはいくつかあった。
strings.translated: I had a few ideas.

strings.text: 何か良さそうなものが見つかったら学校に持って来てみよう
strings.translated: If I found something good, I'd bring it to school.

strings.text: クラスの奴と少し話して、さて帰ろうと思ったら、職員室の前で先生に捕まって美術室に教材を運び込むのを手伝わされてしまった。
strings.translated: I chatted with a few classmates, and just as I was about to leave, a teacher caught me in front of the faculty room and had me help carry teaching materials into the art room.

strings.text: 大した量じゃなかったし、別にかまわないけど、何となく損したような気分だ
strings.translated: It wasn't a huge amount, and I didn't really mind, but I still felt vaguely cheated somehow.

strings.text: 気を取り直して昇降口へと向かう
strings.translated: I shook it off and headed toward the shoe lockers.

strings.text: 大智「あれ？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Huh?」

strings.text: その途中で、視界の隅のほうに妙なものを見つけた
strings.translated: On the way, something odd caught the corner of my eye.

strings.text: 最初は、本当にそれが何なのかわからなかった。
strings.translated: At first, I genuinely couldn't tell what it was.

strings.text: 何だか黒くて丸いものがあるって、不思議に思った程度だった。
strings.translated: Just something dark and round -- I thought it was strange, nothing more.

strings.text: でも、それはよく見ると人間で、うずくまった１人の女の子だった。
strings.translated: But looking closer, it was a person: a girl, crouched down.

strings.text: お腹でも痛いんだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe she had a stomachache.

strings.text: 女の子がうずくまってるのはトイレの前で、そんなことをする理由は他に浮かばなかった。
strings.translated: She was huddled in front of the bathroom, and I couldn't think of any other reason for it.

strings.text: 声をかけたほうがいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Should I say something?

strings.text: それとも、変に話し掛けたりしたら恥ずかしがらせたりしてしまうんだろうか。
strings.translated: Or would I just embarrass her if I did?

strings.text: こういった経験は初めてだから、どうすればいいのかわからない。
strings.translated: I'd never been in a situation like this before, so I didn't know what to do.

strings.text: だけど、一度見てしまった以上、状況を確認せずに帰るのは何となくすっきりしなかった。
strings.translated: But now that I'd seen her, I couldn't just walk away without checking.

strings.text: 嫌な顔をされてもいいじゃないか。
strings.translated: Even if she gave me a dirty look, that was fine.

strings.text: 大したことじゃないってわかれば、それで俺のほうはすっきりするんだし。
strings.translated: If it turned out to be nothing, I'd feel better.

strings.text: 逆にすごく体調が悪かったりしたら、やっぱり助けないとマズいもんな。
strings.translated: And if she was actually really sick, I couldn't just leave her.

strings.text: 俺は意を決すると、ごくりと息を呑んで女の子に近づいて行った
strings.translated: I steeled myself, swallowed hard, and walked toward her.

strings.text: 大智「あの…大丈夫？
strings.translated: Daichi「Um... are you okay?」

strings.text: ／心音「えっ？」
strings.translated: Kokone「Eh?」

strings.text: 女の子が顔を上げると、左右の目が真っ赤に腫れ上がっていた。
strings.translated: When the girl raised her face, both her eyes were swollen bright red from crying.

strings.text: 見ない顔だ。
strings.translated: I didn't recognize her.

strings.text: 下の学年だろうか。
strings.translated: She was probably from a lower grade.

strings.text: 予想外の表情に、俺は戸惑うしかない。
strings.translated: Her unexpected expression left me at a loss.

strings.text: まさか、こんな場所で泣いてるとは思わなかった。
strings.translated: I never imagined I'd find someone crying in a place like this.

strings.text: もしかして、泣くほどお腹が痛かったりするのか？
strings.translated: Could she be in so much stomach pain that it made her cry?

strings.text: そうだとしたら、急いで保健室に運ばないと…いや、この時間あいてるのか？
strings.translated: If that was it, I'd have to rush her to the nurse's office... wait, would it even be open at this hour?

strings.text: っていうか救急車か？
strings.translated: Or did she need an ambulance?

strings.text: ／心音「あ、あの…大丈夫、です」
strings.translated: Kokone「U-um... I'm fine.」

strings.text: 女の子は怯えたように視線を外した。
strings.translated: The girl averted her gaze as if frightened.

strings.text: とても悲しげな表情をしていて、濡れた髪が頬に張り付いていた
strings.translated: Her expression was deeply sorrowful, and her wet hair clung to her cheeks.

strings.text: 何か…これ、変じゃないか？
strings.translated: Something... wasn't this wrong?

strings.text: 彼女、顔だけじゃなくて全身が濡れてないか？
strings.translated: Wait -- it wasn't just her face. Wasn't her whole body soaked?

strings.text: 髪の毛とか、制服とか…頭から足先までずぶ濡れじゃないか。
strings.translated: Her hair, her uniform... she was drenched from head to toe.

strings.text: ずぶ濡れで、泣いてたのか？
strings.translated: Soaking wet, and crying?

strings.text: 水を滴らせながら歩いたような跡が、トイレの中から続いていた。
strings.translated: A trail of dripping water led out from inside the restroom.

strings.text: ちょっと覗き込んでみると、女子トイレの床が水浸しになっていた。
strings.translated: When I peeked in, the floor of the girls' bathroom was completely flooded.

strings.text: こんなの普通じゃない。
strings.translated: This isn't normal.

strings.text: 普通に考えて起こることじゃない。
strings.translated: This wasn't something that happened under normal circumstances.

strings.text: 明らかに人の手によって、水が撒かれた跡だった
strings.translated: It was clearly the work of someone who had deliberately poured water everywhere.

strings.text: 大智「どうしたんだよ？
strings.translated: Daichi「What happened?

strings.text: 何かあったのか？」
strings.translated: Did something happen to you?」

strings.text: 戸惑った声しか漏らすことができない。
strings.translated: All I could manage was a flustered, uncertain voice.

strings.text: 体調が悪いとか、そんな状況じゃないことは俺にもわかってしまった。
strings.translated: Even I could tell this was nothing as simple as her feeling sick.

strings.text: ずぶ濡れの状態でトイレから出てくる。
strings.translated: Coming out of the bathroom completely soaked.

strings.text: そこから連想できるものなんてひとつしかなかった
strings.translated: There was only one thing that could bring to mind.

strings.text: 大智「誰かに…何かされたのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Did someone... do something to you?」

strings.text: ／心音「う、う、うぅっ…うううぅっ…！
strings.translated: Kokone「Uu, u, uugh... uuuugh...!

strings.text: 大智「泣くなよ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Don't cry...」

strings.text: 正直に言って、動揺せずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: Honestly, I couldn't help but be shaken.

strings.text: 前の学校でもいじめの現場なんて見たことなかったのに、転校して１ヶ月もしないうちにこんな光景を見てしまうなんて
strings.translated: I'd never witnessed bullying firsthand at my old school, and yet here I was, not even a month into transferring, already seeing something like this.

strings.text: 大智「えっと……名前…名前は？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Um...... your name... what's your name?」

strings.text: 混乱してたせいか、名前を尋ねてしまった。
strings.translated: Maybe because I was flustered, I ended up asking for her name.

strings.text: そんなことをしても、何の意味もないってわかってるのに、他に女の子にかけるべき言葉が見つからなかった
strings.translated: I knew it wasn't going to help anything, but I couldn't find any other words to say to her.

strings.text: 心音「心音…戸田、心音です」
strings.translated: Kokone「Kokone... Toda, Kokone.」

strings.text: 女の子はそう答えてくれた。
strings.translated: The girl answered me.

strings.text: 戸田心音。
strings.translated: Toda Kokone.

strings.text: それが、彼女の名前らしい
strings.translated: That was apparently her name.

strings.text: 大智「とにかく……濡れてるのを何とかしないと
strings.translated: Daichi「Anyway...... we have to do something about you being soaked.」

strings.text: 大智「拭くもの…何か拭くものが
strings.translated: Daichi「Something to dry off with... something to dry off...」

strings.text: 心音「大丈夫、です。
strings.translated: Kokone「I'm fine.

strings.text: 鞄の中に、バスタオル…ありますから
strings.translated: I have a bath towel... in my bag.」

strings.text: 大智「あるのかよ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「You actually have one...」

strings.text: 普通、学校にバスタオルなんか持って来ないと思うんだけどな。
strings.translated: Normally, you wouldn't bring a bath towel to school.

strings.text: …って、つまりこうなることがわかってたから、わざわざ持って来ているのか。
strings.translated: Which means she brought it on purpose because she knew this would happen.

strings.text: もしかして、こんな酷い事を何度もされてるんだろうか
strings.translated: Could it be that she's had something this awful done to her, over and over?

strings.text: 心音「すいません。
strings.translated: Kokone「I'm sorry.

strings.text: こんなところ見せてしまって
strings.translated: For making you see something like this.」

strings.text: 大智「いや、それは別にいいんだけど
strings.translated: Daichi「No, that's not what matters here...」

strings.text: 心音「失礼します
strings.translated: Kokone「Excuse me.」

strings.text: 弱々しく頭を下げて、鞄を手に取り、戸田さんが走り去る。
strings.translated: She gave a feeble bow, picked up her bag, and Toda-san ran off.

strings.text: あまりに酷い光景だったけど、俺にはどうすることもできない。
strings.translated: It was a truly awful sight, but there was nothing I could do.

strings.text: でも、見て見ぬふりをするのも気分が悪くて、胸の奥に言いようのない苛立ちがわき上がっていた
strings.translated: Still, looking the other way didn't sit right with me either, and an indescribable frustration welled up deep in my chest.

strings.text: 大智「やっぱり、この学校にもいじめってあるんだな」
strings.translated: Daichi「So there really is bullying at this school too.」

strings.text: 何だかショックだ。
strings.translated: It was a shock, somehow.

strings.text: 良い場所だって思えてたからこそ、それの裏側を見てしまったような気分だ。
strings.translated: Maybe because I'd come to think of it as a good place -- now I felt like I'd seen the other side of that.

strings.text: どうして、こんな事をする奴等がいるんだろう。
strings.translated: Why are there people who do things like this?

strings.text: 人が悲しんでるのを見ても、何も感じないんだろうか。
strings.translated: Can they really feel nothing when they see someone in pain?

strings.text: どこの誰がやってるかわからないけど、見つけたら１発くらいぶん殴ってやりたい気分だった
strings.translated: I didn't know who it was, but if I ever found out, I felt like I wanted to punch them at least once.

strings.text: 大智「はぁ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Hah...」

strings.text: 家に帰っても、俺の気分は晴れなかった。
strings.translated: Even after I got home, my mood wouldn't lift.

strings.text: 戸田さんのことを思い出しては、暗く沈んだ気持ちになってしまっていた。
strings.translated: Every time I thought of Toda-san, I sank back into that dark, heavy feeling.

strings.text: 彼女は、あれからどうしたんだろう。
strings.translated: I wondered what had become of her after that.

strings.text: ちゃんと体を拭いて、家に帰り着くことができたんだろうか。
strings.translated: Had she managed to dry herself off properly and make it home okay?

strings.text: あそこで別れてしまったから、その後のことが気になって仕方なかった
strings.translated: We'd parted ways right there, and I couldn't stop worrying about what happened next.

strings.text: 大智「誰かに報告したほうがいいのかな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Should I report this to someone...」

strings.text: 助けてあげたいとは思うけど、俺に何ができるとも思えない。
strings.translated: I wanted to help her, but I couldn't think of anything I could actually do.

strings.text: それよりも、先生や菱木さんに話したほうがいい気がする。
strings.translated: It felt like it would be better to talk to a teacher or Hishiki-san instead.

strings.text: ただ、いじめって慎重にしないと、かえって被害を増やしそうだからな…。
strings.translated: Still, bullying is the kind of thing you have to handle carefully, or you risk making things worse...

strings.text: どうするべきか、もう少し考えてみないと
strings.translated: I'd have to think a little more about what to do.

strings.text: 美桜「ふ～ん♪　ふ～ん♪　ふふ～ん♪」
strings.translated: Mio「Hm~m♪ Hm~m♪ Hmm~m♪」

strings.text: 俺の悩みを知る由もなく、姉さんが台所に立って鼻歌を歌っている。
strings.translated: Blissfully unaware of my worries, my sister stood in the kitchen humming to herself.

strings.text: 夕飯の支度をしてくれてるのはいつものことだけど、鼻歌まで歌うのは珍しいな。
strings.translated: Her making dinner was nothing unusual, but humming while she did it -- that was rare.

strings.text: あの事件があってからだと、初めてなんじゃないだろうか
strings.translated: I think it might have been the first time since that incident.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん、ご機嫌みたいだけど何かいいことでもあった？
strings.translated: Daichi「You seem to be in a good mood, sis -- did something nice happen?」

strings.text: 美桜「そういうわけじゃないけど、毎日が楽しいから
strings.translated: Mio「Not anything in particular, I just feel like every day is fun.」

strings.text: 大智「そっか
strings.translated: Daichi「Is that so.」

strings.text: 姉さんが元気なのは喜ばしいことだ
strings.translated: My sister being in good spirits was something to be glad about.

strings.text: でも、元気すぎるように見えるのは俺の気のせいだろうか。
strings.translated: But I wondered if it was just my imagination that she seemed almost too cheerful.

strings.text: 事件の傷が完全に癒えるとも思えないのに、何だかそれがなかった事になってしまっているような、そんな雰囲気さえ感じ取れた
strings.translated: I couldn't believe the wounds from that incident had fully healed, yet there was an atmosphere about her that made it feel as though it had never happened at all.

strings.text: 大智「最近帰り遅いけど、友達とどこか行ってるとか？
strings.translated: Daichi「You've been coming home late lately -- are you going out with friends?

strings.text: 小野田さん、だっけ？
strings.translated: Onoda-san, was it?

strings.text: 友佳がいろいろ案内してくれるの
strings.translated: Yuka's been showing me all kinds of places.」

strings.text: 大智「仲の良い友達ができて良かったな」
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm glad you've made a good friend.」

strings.text: 口ではそう言いつつも、なんとなく違和感を感じていた。
strings.translated: Even as I said it, I felt a vague sense of unease.

strings.text: 引越しする直前までは完全な引きこもり状態だったのに、どうしてこんなにも変わってしまったんだろう
strings.translated: Right up until just before we moved, she'd been completely shut in -- how could she have changed this much?

strings.text: 大智「どんな所？
strings.translated: Daichi「What kind of places?

strings.text: 店とか？
strings.translated: Shops and things?

strings.text: 美桜「ん～？
strings.translated: Mio「Hmm~?

strings.text: 色々だけど、何で？
strings.translated: All kinds of places, but -- why do you ask?

strings.text: 大智「いや、ただ気になったっていうか…俺は一緒に遊びに行くほどの友達ってまだいないから
strings.translated: Daichi「No, I was just curious... I don't have any friends yet that I'd go out and hang around with.」

strings.text: 美桜「そうね…。
strings.translated: Mio「That's true...

strings.text: 雑貨屋とか、喫茶店とか、ケーキ屋さんとか…。
strings.translated: Like little shops, cafes, cake places...

strings.text: カラオケで歌ったり、安くてカットの上手な美容院を教えてもらったり、色
strings.translated: We sang karaoke, she showed me a cheap salon with a really good stylist, all kinds of things.

strings.text: 大智「そっか。
strings.translated: Daichi「I see.

strings.text: いいよな、いろいろ連れてってもらえて」
strings.translated: That sounds nice, getting taken to all those places.」

strings.text: そう言えば最近、辺りが暗くなってから帰ってくることも増えてきたけど、夜道を１人で歩くのが怖かったりしないんだろうか
strings.translated: Come to think of it, she's been coming home after dark more often lately -- I wonder if she's not scared walking alone at night.

strings.text: 大智「何か面白いものとかあった？
strings.translated: Daichi「Was there anything interesting?」

strings.text: 美桜「面白いもの？
strings.translated: Mio「Interesting?」

strings.text: 大智「俺が行っても面白そうな場所とか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Like somewhere that might be fun for me to go too?」

strings.text: 美桜「そうね……ほとんど友佳と話してるばかりだから
strings.translated: Mio「Hmm... we spend most of the time just talking with Yuka, so...」

strings.text: 美桜「何て言うのかな。
strings.translated: Mio「How do I put it.

strings.text: 友佳と一緒だったら、どんなところでもすごく落ち着くの。
strings.translated: When I'm with Yuka, I feel really at ease no matter where we are.

strings.text: 私のことを理解してくれてて、話してるだけで安心できるっていうか
strings.translated: She understands me, and just talking with her makes me feel calm, I guess.」

strings.text: 大智「親友とか、そんな感じ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Like a best friend, or something like that?」

strings.text: 美桜「そういう言い方すると恥ずかしいけど、そういうことなのかもしれないわね」
strings.translated: Mio「It's embarrassing when you put it that way, but maybe that's what it is.」

strings.text: 夕食の支度をしながら、姉さんが笑いながら答えてくれる。
strings.translated: She answered with a laugh while continuing to prepare dinner.

strings.text: でも、そこに妙な違和感を覚えたのは、俺が神経質になってるからだろうか
strings.translated: But I couldn't help feeling a strange sense of unease -- or maybe I was just being oversensitive.

strings.text: 親友。
strings.translated: A best friend.

strings.text: 引越してきたばかりなのに、誰かをそんなふうに信頼できるものなんだろうか。
strings.translated: We'd only just moved here, and yet she could trust someone that much already?

strings.text: 小野田さんは、どうやってここまで姉さんの心を開いたんだろう。
strings.translated: How had Onoda-san managed to open my sister's heart this far?

strings.text: 変な疑いは持ちたくないんだけど、なんとなく不安を覚えずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: I didn't want to be suspicious, but I couldn't help feeling a little anxious.

strings.text: それとも、この感情は俺以外の人が姉さんを理解してるってことに、少なからず嫉妬のようなものを覚えているからなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Or maybe this feeling came from a touch of jealousy -- that someone other than me understood my sister.

strings.text: シスコンのつもりはないけど、自分でも説明のつかない不安を覚えていると、そんなふうに考えずにはいられなかった
strings.translated: I didn't think of myself as having a sister complex, but when I found myself feeling an unease I couldn't explain even to myself, I couldn't help thinking along those lines.

strings.text: 美桜「大智こそ何かあった？
strings.translated: Mio「What about you, Daichi?

strings.text: 帰って来てから表情が暗いけど
strings.translated: You looked kind of down when you came home, though.

strings.text: そうかな？
strings.translated: Did I?

strings.text: 美桜「学校で嫌なことでもあったんじゃないの？
strings.translated: Mio「Didn't something unpleasant happen at school?

strings.text: 何かあったら、ちゃんとお姉ちゃんに言いなさいよ
strings.translated: If something's wrong, make sure you tell your big sis, okay.

strings.text: 大智「大丈夫だよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm fine.

strings.text: 俺が…何かされたわけじゃないから」
strings.translated: It's not like anything happened to me.」

strings.text: 不意に戸田さんの事を思い出して、そんなふうに言ってしまった。
strings.translated: Toda-san had suddenly crossed my mind, and that's what slipped out.

strings.text: 自覚はなかったけど、姉さんのことや戸田さんのことを考えていたのが、表情に出ていたらしい
strings.translated: I hadn't realized it, but apparently my thoughts about my sister and Toda-san had shown on my face.

strings.text: 美桜「誰かに何かあったの？
strings.translated: Mio「Did something happen to someone else?」

strings.text: 大智「いや、知らない女の子なんだけど……こう、ちょっと…あまり良くないところ見ちゃって
strings.translated: Daichi「No, it's a girl I don't really know... it's just, I kind of... saw something not so great.」

strings.text: 美桜「何それ？
strings.translated: Mio「What do you mean?

strings.text: その子の…何か見たの？
strings.translated: Did you see something... about that girl?

strings.text: 大智「あ、変な意味じゃないから。
strings.translated: Daichi「Oh, not in a weird way.

strings.text: 良くないところって言うのは…たぶん……」
strings.translated: When I say "not so great," I mean... probably...」

strings.text: そこまで言って、何となく口を噤んでしまった。
strings.translated: I trailed off there and found myself going quiet.

strings.text: この話を姉さんにしてもいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it okay to tell my sister about this?

strings.text: 軽々しく誰かに話してしまってもいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it okay to just casually tell someone?

strings.text: 悩んだけど、ここまで話しておきながらやっぱりやめるって言うのも変だ。
strings.translated: I went back and forth on it, but it would be strange to back out now after having said this much.

strings.text: 姉さんは料理の手を止めて俺のほうを見てるし、変に誤魔化すよりは正直に話しておいたほうが良さそうだった
strings.translated: My sister had stopped cooking and was looking at me, so it seemed better to be honest than to make up some awkward excuse.

strings.text: 大智「学校から帰るとき、トイレの前でうずくまってる女の子がいてさ…ずぶ濡れだったんだ
strings.translated: Daichi「When I was heading home from school, there was a girl crouched in front of the bathroom... she was completely soaked.」

strings.text: 美桜「ずぶ濡れ？
strings.translated: Mio「Soaked?

strings.text: トイレで？
strings.translated: In the bathroom?

strings.text: 大智「トイレの床も水浸しになってた
strings.translated: Daichi「The bathroom floor was flooded too.」

strings.text: 美桜「それって…いじめ？
strings.translated: Mio「That's... bullying, isn't it?」

strings.text: 大智「そうなのかなって思って…」
strings.translated: Daichi「That's what I thought...」

strings.text: 姉さんもすぐにピンと来たようだった。
strings.translated: My sister seemed to catch on right away too.

strings.text: トイレでずぶ濡れになってるなんて、他に想像がつかない。
strings.translated: I couldn't think of any other reason she'd be soaking wet in the bathroom like that.

strings.text: 戸田さんが誰かにいじめられてるのは、たぶん間違いないだろう
strings.translated: Toda-san was being bullied by someone -- that much seemed pretty certain.

strings.text: 大智「…どうしたらいいのかな？
strings.translated: Daichi「...What should I do?」

strings.text: 美桜「大智は、その子の事をどうにかしたいの？
strings.translated: Mio「Do you want to do something for that girl, Daichi?」

strings.text: 大智「いじめられてるって知ってるのに、何もしないってのも気分が良くないし
strings.translated: Daichi「Knowing she's being bullied and doing nothing about it doesn't sit right with me.」

strings.text: 美桜「大智は優しいわね。
strings.translated: Mio「You're kind, Daichi.

strings.text: そんなの、見て見ぬふりをしてる人はいっぱいいるのに
strings.translated: There are so many people who would just look the other way.」

strings.text: 大智「何で誰も助けないんだろうな
strings.translated: Daichi「Why doesn't anyone help her?」

strings.text: 美桜「自分も巻き込まれたくないからでしょう」
strings.translated: Mio「Because they don't want to get dragged into it themselves.」

strings.text: 姉さんの回答は淡々としていた。
strings.translated: My sister's answer was matter-of-fact.

strings.text: 実際、そうなのかもしれないけど、何だか感情のない言葉のように聞こえてしまった。
strings.translated: It might actually be true, but somehow it sounded like words stripped of any feeling.

strings.text: 俺はそんなふうに割り切れない。
strings.translated: I couldn't be that detached about it.

strings.text: 今も戸田さんの事を思い出して、そのたびに気分が悪くなってしまう。
strings.translated: Even now, every time Toda-san crossed my mind, it left me feeling sick.

strings.text: 詳しい話は聞かなかったけど、あれは同じ学校の生徒にやられたんだよな。
strings.translated: I didn't hear the details, but it had to be students from the same school who did that to her.

strings.text: そうじゃないと説明がつかないよな。
strings.translated: There was no other explanation that made sense.

strings.text: 彼女のクラスの担任は、この事を知ってるんだろうか。
strings.translated: Did her homeroom teacher even know about this?

strings.text: 知らないなら、まずはそれを報せたほうがいいんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: If they didn't, shouldn't the first step be to let them know?

strings.text: でも、部外者の俺がそこまでしていいのかどうかがわからない。
strings.translated: But I wasn't sure whether it was my place, as an outsider, to go that far.

strings.text: 下手なことをすれば、さらにいじめが酷くなる可能性もある。
strings.translated: If I handled it badly, there was a chance the bullying could get even worse.

strings.text: 短絡的な行動は慎むべきだろう
strings.translated: I should be careful not to act too hastily.

strings.text: 大智「姉さんは、このまま見なかったことにしたほうがいいと思う？
strings.translated: Daichi「Do you think I should just pretend I never saw it, sis?」

strings.text: 美桜「何とも言えないわね。
strings.translated: Mio「It's hard to say.

strings.text: 大智のやろうとしてることは正しいと思うけど、それで大智に被害が及ぶようならやっぱり考えちゃうし
strings.translated: I think what you're trying to do is right, but if it ends up causing harm to you, then I'd have to think twice about it.」

strings.text: 大智「俺もいじめられるってこと？
strings.translated: Daichi「You mean I'd get bullied too?」

strings.text: 美桜「いじめって言うか、嫌がらせって言うか…そういうのがないとも限らないでしょう？
strings.translated: Mio「Bullying, harassment... you can't say for sure it wouldn't happen, right?」

strings.text: 大智「それは…まあ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Well... I mean...」

strings.text: 姉さんの言ってることは間違いじゃない。
strings.translated: My sister wasn't wrong.

strings.text: どんな奴らがいじめてるのかわからない以上、俺にどんな被害があるか想像もつかない。
strings.translated: Without knowing what kind of people were doing the bullying, I had no way of imagining what they might do to me.

strings.text: いや、嫌がらせが俺だけに留まればいいんだけど、家族にまで及んだりしたら……最悪の場合、俺達がどうしてここへ引越して来たのか、その理由を知られてしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: Well, it would be one thing if the harassment stayed directed at just me -- but if it spread to my family too... in the worst case, they might find out why we moved here in the first place.

strings.text: そうなったとしたら、せっかく明るくなった姉さんがまた以前の様子に逆戻りしてしまう可能性さえ考えられた。
strings.translated: If that happened, there was even a chance that my sister, who had finally started to seem brighter, might slip back into how she used to be.

strings.text: それだけは絶対に避けたい
strings.translated: That was the one thing I absolutely had to avoid.

strings.text: 大智「もう少し方法を考えてみるよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'll think a little more about how to go about it.

strings.text: 俺だって、嫌がらせを受けたいわけじゃないし
strings.translated: It's not like I want to get harassed either.」

strings.text: 美桜「それがいいと思うわ。
strings.translated: Mio「I think that's the right call.

strings.text: 焦らずじっくりとね
strings.translated: Take your time and don't rush.」

strings.text: 美桜「そういえば、生徒会の友達がいるんじゃなかった？
strings.translated: Mio「Come to think of it, don't you have a friend in the student council?

strings.text: その人に相談してみたらどう？
strings.translated: Why not try talking to that person?

strings.text: 大智「生徒会…」
strings.translated: Daichi「The student council...」

strings.text: 姉さんの言葉に、ハッと目を見開いた。
strings.translated: My sister's words made me blink in sudden realization.

strings.text: 確かにそうだ。
strings.translated: She was right.

strings.text: 俺のクラスには、生徒会の副会長がいるんじゃないか。
strings.translated: There was a vice president of the student council in my class, wasn't there.

strings.text: 学校に関する問題だし、相談するのはむしろ自然なことかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: It was a school-related problem, so consulting them might actually be the natural thing to do.

strings.text: 桧垣は賢いし、信用できる奴だ。
strings.translated: Higaki was smart, and someone I could trust.

strings.text: いきなり菱木さんに話を持ち込むよりは気安いし、安心できる
strings.translated: It felt a lot easier and safer than going straight to Hishiki-san with it.

strings.text: 大智「ありがとう。
strings.translated: Daichi「Thanks.

strings.text: そうしてみるよ
strings.translated: I'll try that.」

strings.text: 美桜「うまくいくといいわね
strings.translated: Mio「I hope it works out.」

strings.text: 大智「ああ」
strings.translated: Daichi「Yeah.」

strings.text: 姉さんの言葉にうなずいて、俺は戸田さんの事を思い出した
strings.translated: I nodded at my sister's words and thought of Toda-san.

strings.text: びしょ濡れでうずくまっていた彼女が、二度とあんな目に遭うことがなくなればいいんだけどな
strings.translated: I just hoped she'd never have to go through something like that again -- crouched there, soaking wet.

strings.text: 瑛「いじめ？」
strings.translated: Akira「Bullying?」

strings.text: 翌日の放課後、俺は戸田さんの一件について桧垣に話を通すことにした
strings.translated: The following afternoon after school, I decided to bring up the matter of Toda-san with Higaki.

strings.text: 大智「たぶん、１年生の子だと思うんだけど、結構陰湿みたいで
strings.translated: Daichi「I think she's probably a first-year, but it sounds pretty nasty...」

strings.text: 瑛「それは、放置できない問題だね
strings.translated: Akira「That's not something we can just leave alone.」

strings.text: 大智「こういうのって、生徒会の仕事なのかわからないけど、他に相談できる奴がいなくて
strings.translated: Daichi「I wasn't sure if this kind of thing was the student council's job, but you were the only one I could think to talk to.」

strings.text: 瑛「いや、十分生徒会の問題だよ。
strings.translated: Akira「No, this is absolutely a student council matter.

strings.text: 学校内のいじめを放置してたら、何のために生徒会があるのかわからない
strings.translated: If we just ignore bullying happening inside the school, what's the point of having a student council at all?」

strings.text: 瑛「あとで菱木さんにも話を通しておくよ
strings.translated: Akira「I'll fill Hishiki-san in on it later too.」

strings.text: 大智「悪いけど、宜しく頼む」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry to put this on you, but I'm counting on you.」

strings.text: 戸田さんのことは、生徒会に任せることにした。
strings.translated: I decided to leave Toda-san's situation in the student council's hands.

strings.text: 桧垣の仕事を増やしてしまったけど、彼が快く受け入れてくれたのは本当にありがたい
strings.translated: I'd added to Higaki's workload, but I was genuinely grateful that he'd taken it on so willingly.

strings.text: 瑛「それじゃあ、僕は生徒会の仕事があるから
strings.translated: Akira「Well then, I've got student council work to get to.」

strings.text: 生徒会に向かう桧垣を見送って、俺はホッと安堵の息を漏らした。
strings.translated: I watched Higaki head off toward the student council room and let out a quiet breath of relief.

strings.text: 人に押し付けた形になったけど、桧垣なら悪いようにはしないだろう。
strings.translated: It had ended up being a matter of passing it off to someone else, but Higaki wouldn't handle it badly.

strings.text: そう思うと、俺の気持ちも少し楽になった
strings.translated: Thinking that, my own feelings eased up a little.

strings.text: 大智「良かった」
strings.translated: Daichi「Good.」

strings.text: 思わずそんな言葉が漏れてしまう。
strings.translated: The words slipped out before I could stop them.

strings.text: ほとんど他人も同然だけど、やっぱりいじめられてるのをそのままにしておくのは気分が悪い。
strings.translated: She was practically a stranger to me, but still -- knowing someone was being bullied and just leaving it alone didn't sit right.

strings.text: 本当に生徒会が解決してくれるのかどうかはわからないが、桧垣なら全力で問題に取り組んでくれるだろう。
strings.translated: I had no idea whether the student council would actually resolve it, but Higaki would throw himself into the problem with everything he had.

strings.text: 俺にも何かできることがあるなら、協力するんだけど
strings.translated: If there was anything I could do to help, I'd cooperate.

strings.text: 大智「あ……」
strings.translated: Daichi「Ah...」

strings.text: 何気なく窓から校門のほうを見て、俺は小さく声を漏らした。
strings.translated: I happened to glance out the window toward the school gate and let out a small sound.

strings.text: 視線の先に見つけたのは姉さんの姿。
strings.translated: What I spotted in my line of sight was my sister.

strings.text: 隣には小野田さんらしき女の子も見える。
strings.translated: Next to her, I could also make out a girl who looked like Onoda-san.

strings.text: 仲の良い友達がいるのはいいんだけど、転校してきてからと言うもの姉さんはずっと帰りが遅い。
strings.translated: It was good that she had close friends, but ever since she transferred here, my sister had been coming home late every single day.

strings.text: 本当に大丈夫なのかって、逆に心配になってしまう
strings.translated: If anything, it made me worry whether she was really okay.

strings.text: 大智「いつもどこに行ってるんだろう…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Where does she keep going...」

strings.text: 街を見て回ってるって言ってたけど、そんなに何日も、毎日のように出歩くものだろうか。
strings.translated: She'd said she was exploring the town, but would anyone really go out like that day after day, practically every single day?

strings.text: 小野田さんのことを疑ってるわけじゃないけど、２人がどこに行くのか知っておきたい。
strings.translated: It wasn't that I suspected Onoda-san of anything, but I wanted to know where the two of them were going.

strings.text: シスコンだって言われようがどうでもいい。
strings.translated: People could call me a sister-con for all I cared.

strings.text: 何かあってからじゃ遅いんだ。
strings.translated: It would be too late if something happened.

strings.text: 気が引ける部分もあるけど…ちょっとだけ姉さんのあとを尾けてみることにしよう
strings.translated: Part of me felt bad about it, but... I decided to follow my sister for just a little while.

strings.text: 大智「何だここ…？」
strings.translated: Daichi「What is this place...?」

strings.text: 姉さんと小野田さんのあとを尾行してみると、予想もしていなかった場所にたどり着いた。
strings.translated: Following my sister and Onoda-san led me to a place I never would have expected.

strings.text: 大通りから外れて狭い路地を進み、その先にあった小さな雑居ビル。
strings.translated: They had turned off the main road, gone down a narrow alley, and arrived at a small mixed-use building at the end of it.

strings.text: 古い建物で壁も汚れているけど、２人は確かにここに入っていった
strings.translated: It was an old building with dirty walls, but the two of them had definitely gone inside.

strings.text: 大智「誠信明輝塾……」
strings.translated: Daichi「Seishin Meiki Juku...」

strings.text: 見上げたビルの窓、３階の部分には、そう書かれた紙が貼ってある。
strings.translated: Looking up at the building's windows, there was a piece of paper with those words stuck to the third-floor pane.

strings.text: 学習塾か…？
strings.translated: A cram school...?

strings.text: それとも、小野田さんがここに住んでるとか？
strings.translated: Or maybe Onoda-san lived here?

strings.text: 外観を見る限り、マンションやアパートには見えないけど、案外人が住んでたりするんだろうか。
strings.translated: From the outside it didn't look like an apartment or a condo, but maybe someone actually lived here -- you never know.

strings.text: しばらく建物の周りをウロウロしてみたけど、それ以上の情報を得ることはできなかった。
strings.translated: I wandered around the building for a while, but I couldn't get any more information than that.

strings.text: 普通に考えれば、単なる雑居ビル。
strings.translated: Thinking about it normally, it was just an ordinary mixed-use building.

strings.text: 俺達のような学生が関わりそうなものは、塾くらいしかなさそうだ。
strings.translated: The only thing that seemed like it would involve students like us was maybe a cram school.

strings.text: それとも、もしかして……若い女の子向けの店でも入ってるんだろうか
strings.translated: Or then again, maybe... could there be some kind of shop aimed at young girls inside?

strings.text: 大智「個人経営のアクセサリーショップとか…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Like a small independent accessory shop or something...」

strings.text: とりあえず、俺自身の行動を決めなければならない。
strings.translated: Either way, I had to decide what to do next.

strings.text: ビルの中に入るのか、外で待ってみるのか、あるいは帰ってしまうか
strings.translated: Whether to go inside the building, wait outside, or just head home.

strings.text: 待つ
strings.translated: Wait.

strings.text: 帰らない
strings.translated: Don't go home.

strings.text: そうだな。
strings.translated: Right.

strings.text: 少し様子を見てみよう
strings.translated: Let me watch and see for a bit.

strings.text: １０分ほど待ってみたけれど、２人が出てくる様子はなかった。
strings.translated: I waited about ten minutes, but there was no sign of the two of them coming out.

strings.text: ということは、ただ立ち寄っただけでなく、中に用事があるってことだろうか。
strings.translated: Which meant they hadn't just stopped by -- they had some business inside.

strings.text: どうする？
strings.translated: What should I do?

strings.text: 中に喫茶店や雑貨屋なんかがあるとしたら……女の子二人だ。
strings.translated: If there were a cafe or a general goods store inside... and with two girls, that would make sense.

strings.text: ヘタすると数時間は出てこない可能性がある。
strings.translated: There was a real chance they might not come out for hours.

strings.text: もう暫く待ってみるか、いっそ中に入ってみるか、それとも
strings.translated: Should I wait a little longer, or just go in, or...

strings.text: 見た感じ、ただの雑居ビルだ。
strings.translated: From the look of it, it was just an ordinary mixed-use building.

strings.text: 女子校生が二人で入って問題のあるような場所には見えない。
strings.translated: It didn't look like the kind of place two high school girls couldn't walk into without issue.

strings.text: それに、こんな狭い建物の中に入って姉さんと鉢合わせでもしたら、俺が二人をつけてきたことがバレてしまう。
strings.translated: Besides, if I went into such a narrow building and ran into my sister, she'd know I'd been following them.

strings.text: 言い逃れるのはかなり苦しいだろう。
strings.translated: Talking my way out of that would be pretty rough.

strings.text: せっかく明るくなってきた姉さんの反感を買ったり、傷つけてしまうかもしれない
strings.translated: I might end up turning her against me -- or hurting her -- just when she'd finally started to brighten up.

strings.text: 大智「…帰ろう」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Let's go home.」

strings.text: 姉さんが俺に嘘をつく理由もないし、きっと「隠れ家的名店」
strings.translated: My sister had no reason to lie to me.

strings.text: だとか、女子の好きそうな店でも入っているんだろう。
strings.translated: It was probably some "hidden gem" kind of place, or a shop that girls would like.

strings.text: 大体、楽しそうに毎日を過ごしていて何が悪いんだ。
strings.translated: Besides, what was wrong with her enjoying her days and going out?

strings.text: あんなことがあったからって、流石に心配しすぎだ。
strings.translated: After everything that happened, I was clearly worrying too much.

strings.text: 姉さんを信じて、そっとしておこう
strings.translated: I'd trust my sister and leave her be.

strings.text: そう結論付けて、俺は来た道を引き返した
strings.translated: With that conclusion reached, I turned and headed back the way I came.

strings.text: それから何事もなく日々は過ぎて、姉さんは日増しに明るさを取り戻し──次第に、あの忌まわしい事件は皆にとって、過去の出来事になっていった。
strings.translated: After that, the days passed without incident, and my sister grew brighter with each passing day -- and gradually, that awful event became something in the past for everyone.

strings.text: そして数カ月後
strings.translated: And then, a few months later --

strings.text: 姉さんは唐突に姿を消した
strings.translated: My sister vanished without warning.

strings.text: 大智「帰る、ってのもな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「But just going home doesn't sit right either...」

strings.text: ここまで来て、真相を確かめずに引き返すわけにもいかない。
