strings.translated: Daichi「Are you going, Kamimura-san?」

strings.text: 愛「多分
strings.translated: Ai「Probably.」

strings.text: 大智「神村さん自身はどう思ってるんだ？
strings.translated: Daichi「What do you yourself think, Kamimura-san?

strings.text: 小野田さんが言ったことは正しいって思ってるのか？
strings.translated: Did I actually believe what Onoda-san said was right?

strings.text: 愛「私は…よくわからない。
strings.translated: Ai「I... don't really know.

strings.text: みんなが言ってる救いが、本当に救いになっているのかどうか
strings.translated: Whether the salvation everyone talks about is truly becoming salvation or not.」

strings.text: 大智「つまり、クラブが救いの場所になるって、まだ本気で信じることはできてないんだな？
strings.translated: Daichi「So you're saying you still can't genuinely believe that the Club is a place of salvation?」

strings.text: 愛「努力はしてるつもりだけど…今のところ、白坂君の言う通りかもしれない」
strings.translated: Ai「I'm trying to, but... at this point, you might be right, Shirasaka-kun.」

strings.text: その言葉を聞けただけでも、本気で安心した。
strings.translated: Just hearing those words was a genuine relief.

strings.text: まだ、神村さんは染まりきってはいない。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san hadn't been completely dyed by it yet.

strings.text: 手遅れなところまではいっていない。
strings.translated: She hadn't reached the point of no return.

strings.text: それなら、姉さん以上に助け出せる確率は高いのかもしれない。
strings.translated: If that was the case, the odds of pulling her out might be higher than with Sis.

strings.text: こうして俺と一緒にクラブの実態を暴いていけば、あんなところに関わっていたのは間違いだったって思ってくれるかもしれない。
strings.translated: If we worked together like this to expose the Club's true nature, she might come to believe that getting involved with a place like that had been a mistake.

strings.text: それ以前に
strings.translated: And before that --

strings.text: 大智「力を借りておいて何だけど…あそこには関わらない方がいいんじゃないか？」
strings.translated: Daichi「I know I'm the one asking for your help, but... wouldn't it be better not to get involved with that place?」

strings.text: あそこのやり方についていけないなら、無理に関わる必要はないんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Couldn't she just not force herself to stay involved if she couldn't keep up with their ways?

strings.text: もちろん、姉さんを助けるために協力してもらえるのは助かる。
strings.translated: Of course, having her cooperate to help Sis was a big help.

strings.text: でも、これ以上深入りしなくても、協力してもらうことはできるんじゃないんだろうか
strings.translated: But couldn't she cooperate without getting any deeper into it than she already had?

strings.text: 愛「…私には、あそこが必要なの
strings.translated: Ai「...I need that place.」

strings.text: 大智「神村さんは、何から救われたいんだ？」
strings.translated: Daichi「What is it you want to be saved from, Kamimura-san?」

strings.text: …そうだ。
strings.translated: ...Right.

strings.text: 当たり前の話だけど、彼女にも何かあるんだ。
strings.translated: It goes without saying, but she has something going on too.

strings.text: 何か理由があるから、あんなクラブに関わってしまっているんだ。
strings.translated: There's some reason she got involved with a club like that.

strings.text: その理由がわかれば……俺にも何か、力になれないだろうか
strings.translated: If I could understand that reason... maybe I could do something to help her too.

strings.text: 愛「…救われたいわけじゃないの。
strings.translated: Ai「...It's not that I want to be saved.

strings.text: ただ
strings.translated: It's just --」

strings.text: そう言って、神村さんは目を伏せる
strings.translated: Kamimura-san said that and cast her eyes downward.

strings.text: 大智「ただ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Just?」

strings.text: 話せないの」
strings.translated: I can't talk about it.」

strings.text: まだ俺の事が信用できないんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it that she still couldn't trust me?

strings.text: それとも、他の理由があるのか…わからないけど、確かに俺たちは出会って間もない、ただのクラスメイトなんだ。
strings.translated: Or was there some other reason... I didn't know, but it was true that we had only just met -- we were nothing more than classmates.

strings.text: 無理強いはしない方がいいだろう
strings.translated: I figured I shouldn't push her.

strings.text: 大智「…わかった。
strings.translated: Daichi「...Alright.

strings.text: 無理には聞かないけど…俺にできることがあったら、言ってほしい
strings.translated: I won't force you to tell me, but... if there's anything I can do, please let me know.」

strings.text: 愛「白坂君…もしかして、私を助けようとしてくれてるの？
strings.translated: Ai「Shirasaka-kun... are you maybe trying to help me?」

strings.text: 大智「協力してもらってるお礼、ってわけじゃないけど……。
strings.translated: Daichi「It's not exactly a thank-you for helping me out, but...

strings.text: 神村さんはまだ、まともに見えるっていうか
strings.translated: Kamimura-san still seemed... normal, I guess -- like she hadn't lost herself yet.

strings.text: 大智「あんなところに関わらないですむ方法があるなら、俺も手を貸すから
strings.translated: Daichi「If there's a way for you to get by without being involved in a place like that, I'll lend a hand.」

strings.text: 視線を伏せて、神村さんが考えるような仕草を見せた。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san cast her eyes downward, as if mulling something over.

strings.text: とにかく、今は協力者が必要だ。
strings.translated: Regardless, what I needed right now was an ally.

strings.text: クラブのことを知っていて、それに染まっていない協力者がいなければ、姉さんを助け出すことは難しい。
strings.translated: Without someone who knew about the Club but hadn't been absorbed into it, rescuing my sister would be difficult.

strings.text: そういう意味で神村さんはうってつけだし、可能ならその過程で彼女自身も救いたい。
strings.translated: In that sense, Kamimura-san was the perfect fit -- and if possible, I wanted to save her herself in the process.

strings.text: 必要なのは信頼。
strings.translated: What was needed was trust.

strings.text: まずは、俺達が信頼し合わなければ、あのクラブに対抗することなんてできないだろう。
strings.translated: Unless we could trust each other first, there was no way we could stand against that Club.

strings.text: だからこそ、お互いのことをしっかりと話して、理解して、共通の目的を持ちたかった
strings.translated: That was precisely why I wanted us to talk openly about ourselves, understand each other, and share a common purpose.

strings.text: 愛「考えてみる」
strings.translated: Ai「I'll think about it.」

strings.text: 俺の言葉をどう思ったのか、神村さんは静かにそう言った。
strings.translated: That was what Kamimura-san said quietly, whatever she made of my words.

strings.text: 今の時点で、俺のことをどの程度信頼してくれてるのかは全くわからなかった
strings.translated: At this point, I had absolutely no idea how much she trusted me.

strings.text: でも、それは仕方ない。
strings.translated: But that couldn't be helped.

strings.text: 俺との付き合いよりも、クラブに通ってる時間のほうが長いんだから。
strings.translated: She had spent far more time at the Club than she had with me.

strings.text: 園田のことだって相応に信頼してるかもしれないし、それを覆すのは簡単なことじゃないだろう。
strings.translated: She might well have placed considerable trust in Sonoda too, and overturning that wouldn't be easy.

strings.text: 焦らずじっくりと、しかし迅速に…細心の注意を払いながら、自分にやれることを全力でやるしかなかった。
strings.translated: Without rushing, yet thoroughly -- and swiftly -- with the utmost care, all I could do was give everything I had to what was within my power.

strings.text: 姉さんを助けるために…神村さんも助けるために…今はあのクラブのことを調べるしかなかった
strings.translated: To save my sister... to save Kamimura-san... for now, all I could do was investigate that Club.

strings.text: 大智「神村さんは、あの場所…クラブのことどう思ってるんだ？」
strings.translated: Daichi「What do you think about that place... the Club, Kamimura-san?」

strings.text: ある日、クラスメイトの白坂君が私にそう言ってきた。
strings.translated: One day, my classmate Shirasaka-kun said that to me.

strings.text: クラブのことを知りたい。
strings.translated: He wanted to know about the Club.

strings.text: お姉さんのことを助け出したい。
strings.translated: He wanted to rescue his sister.

strings.text: そんな思いが、彼の行動力になっているみたいだった
strings.translated: That desire seemed to be the driving force behind his actions.

strings.text: みんなの前であんなこと……セックスするような場所なのに…！
strings.translated: Doing something like that... in front of everyone... and it's a place where they have sex...!

strings.text: 大智「人前でセックスすることが、何で救われることになるんだよ」
strings.translated: Daichi「How does having sex in front of people count as being saved?」

strings.text: 白坂君の言いたいことは理解できた。
strings.translated: I could understand what Shirasaka-kun was trying to say.

strings.text: 私も、なぜセックスが救いになるのか、あのクラブにいる人たちが幸せそうなのか、心から理解できているとは言えない。
strings.translated: I couldn't claim to truly understand either -- why sex could be salvation, why the people at that Club seemed so happy.

strings.text: でも、クラブにいる白坂先輩は毎日とても楽しそうに過ごしている。
strings.translated: But Shirasaka-senpai, who was at the Club, spent every day looking like she was having a wonderful time.

strings.text: セックスのときだって気持ち良さそうにしている。
strings.translated: Even during sex, she seemed to feel so good.

strings.text: それなら…間違っているのは私の方なのかもしれない。
strings.translated: If that was the case... maybe I was the one who was wrong.

strings.text: 少なくとも、私達がとやかく言う事ではないような気がする
strings.translated: At the very least, it didn't feel like something for us to be criticizing.

strings.text: 愛「クラブのことは…私にはあまり話せないの。
strings.translated: Ai「About the Club... I can't really talk about it much.

strings.text: 私は出来が悪くて……よく理解していないし、先生の覚えも悪いから
strings.translated: I'm a poor student... I don't understand it well, and I'm not in good standing with the teacher.」

strings.text: 愛「それに、お姉さんの事も、直接は協力できない。
strings.translated: Ai「And as for your sister -- I can't help with that directly either.

strings.text: 私は無理だと思うし、賛成できないから
strings.translated: I don't think I'm capable of it, and I can't agree with it.」

strings.text: 愛「それでも何かしたいなら…小野田さんに話を聞いてみたら？
strings.translated: Ai「Even so, if you want to do something... why not try talking to Onoda-san?

strings.text: 彼女ならお姉さんのすぐそばにいるし、先生の教えをよく理解しているから
strings.translated: She's right there by his sister's side, and she understands the teacher's teachings well.

strings.text: こうして、私達は小野田さんの話を聞くことになった
strings.translated: So it was that we ended up hearing what Onoda-san had to say.

strings.text: 私の提案通りに白坂君が「自分も救われたいのだ」
strings.translated: Just as I had suggested, when Shirasaka-kun said 「I want to be saved too」

strings.text: と話をあわせると、小野田さんはとても喜んだ様子で、白坂君と私にクラブのことを丁寧に教えてくれた。
strings.translated: When Shirasaka-kun played along and said that, just as I had suggested, Onoda-san seemed very pleased and carefully explained everything about the Club to both of us.

strings.text: クラブは救いの場所で、私達は迷える子羊。
strings.translated: The Club was a place of salvation, and we were lost lambs.

strings.text: そんな表現を用いながら、クラブでどんなことをしているのか説明してくれた
strings.translated: Using expressions like that, she explained what kind of things went on at the Club.

strings.text: もっとも、決まりごとがあるわけじゃないから、要約すると『みんな自由に過ごしている』と言うことになる。
strings.translated: That said, since there were no fixed rules, the summary amounted to "everyone does as they please.

strings.text: だからこそ、勉強したり、本を読む人もいれば、ゲームで遊ぶ人もいて、セックスする人もいるのだった
strings.translated: " That was precisely why some people studied or read books, others played games, and others had sex.

strings.text: この日はクラブに行かないということだったから、私は学校が終わってから真っ直ぐ家に帰った。
strings.translated: Since I had decided not to go to the Club that day, I went straight home after school.

strings.text: 本当はクラブによるつもりだったけど、色々考えたいことができたから帰宅することにした
strings.translated: I had actually planned to stop by, but there were things I wanted to think over, so I headed home instead.

strings.text: 家に帰って、着替えを済ませて、夕食の支度をしているうちに外は暗くなった。
strings.translated: By the time I got home, changed my clothes, and started preparing dinner, it had grown dark outside.

strings.text: 辺りは静かで、遠くのほうから虫の声くらいしか聞こえない。
strings.translated: The surroundings were quiet, and the only sound that reached me from the distance was the chirping of insects.

strings.text: 両親の帰りは遅い。
strings.translated: My parents would be home late.

strings.text: 家の中には私１人だから、食事も入浴も就寝も、自分で自由に決めることができる。
strings.translated: Since I was alone in the house, I could freely decide for myself when to eat, bathe, and go to bed.

strings.text: 白坂君は今頃どうしているんだろう。
strings.translated: I wonder what Shirasaka-kun is doing right now.

strings.text: 珍しく長く人と喋ったせいか、ふと彼のことを考えてしまった。
strings.translated: Perhaps because I had talked with someone for an unusually long time, I found myself thinking about him.

strings.text: 普通の家庭なら、今頃家族と一緒に楽しい食事の時間を過ごしているはずだ。
strings.translated: In a normal household, he'd probably be spending a pleasant dinnertime with his family right about now.

strings.text: でも、今彼を取り巻く環境は、果たしてそれを許しているのだろうか。
strings.translated: But does the situation surrounding him right now truly allow for that?

strings.text: 白坂先輩がクラブに関わっていること。
strings.translated: The fact that Shirasaka-senpai is involved with the Club.

strings.text: 弟である白坂君とセックスしたこと。
strings.translated: The fact that she slept with her younger brother, Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: そういったことが彼らの両親に伝わっている可能性は低いと思う。
strings.translated: I think it's unlikely that any of this has reached their parents.

strings.text: クラブに傾倒している先輩はもちろん、白坂君自身もよほどのことはない限り、両親には打ち明けられないだろう。
strings.translated: Not only senpai, who is deeply devoted to the Club, but Shirasaka-kun himself would probably never open up to their parents unless something truly drastic happened.

strings.text: そもそも、それが伝わっていたら学校にも来ていないだろうし、クラブにも白坂先輩自身か、憤った両親、あるいは警察から何らかの接触があるはず。
strings.translated: In the first place, if it had gotten through to them, he probably wouldn't even be coming to school, and the Club would surely have received some kind of contact by now -- from Shirasaka-senpai herself, from outraged parents, or from the police.

strings.text: そう言う事は今までに何度かあったけれど、あそこは一応、そのための対策は練っている。
strings.translated: Things like that had happened a few times before, but that place has, at least, prepared countermeasures for such situations.

strings.text: 残念だけど、一介の男子校生にどうにかできる場所じゃない。
strings.translated: Unfortunate as it is, it's not a place that an ordinary male high school student can do anything about.

strings.text: 白坂君もそのうち、お姉さんの事は諦めてしまうか、お姉さんと同じように、クラブに呑みこまれてしまうだろう。
strings.translated: Shirasaka-kun will probably end up giving up on his sister before long, or else get swallowed up by the Club just like she was.

strings.text: そういう人も何度か見てきた。
strings.translated: I've seen that happen with people more than once.

strings.text: それでも白坂君が諦めずに、お姉さんを救おうとするなら………なら、どうだっていうんだろう？
strings.translated: Even so, if Shirasaka-kun refuses to give up and keeps trying to save his sister... then what? What would that even mean?

strings.text: 私はなぜ彼に協力しているんだろう。
strings.translated: Why am I helping him?

strings.text: 彼に何を期待しているんだろう。
strings.translated: What am I expecting from him?

strings.text: ……期待しているの？
strings.translated: ......Am I expecting something?

strings.text: わからない。
strings.translated: I don't know.

strings.text: 自分の事すら理解できない私には、あのクラブや、あそこにいる人達の事も理解できなくて当然なのかもしれない
strings.translated: Perhaps it was only natural that someone like me, who couldn't even understand herself, would be unable to understand that Club or the people there.

strings.text: 小野田さんに話を聞いてから数日が経った。
strings.translated: Several days had passed since we heard what Onoda-san had to say.

strings.text: 「クラブの事を調べる」
strings.translated: "Investigate the Club" --

strings.text: なんていっても、具体的な行動については何も浮かばない。
strings.translated: -- that was all well and good to say, but when it came to concrete action, nothing came to mind.

strings.text: 毎日のように悩む日々が続いて、姉さんのことを考えるだけで軽く頭痛を覚えるほどだった。
strings.translated: The days of agonizing continued, one after another, until just thinking about my sister was enough to bring on a dull headache.

strings.text: やっぱりクラブに行ってみるしかないのかもしれないけど、その勇気もわかない。
strings.translated: Maybe the only option is to actually go to the Club, but I can't even work up the courage for that.

strings.text: 姉さんはほぼ連日クラブに通ってるみたいだった。
strings.translated: It seemed like my sister was going to the Club almost every single day.

strings.text: たぶん、姉さんはもう何人もの男とやったんだろう。
strings.translated: She's probably already slept with several men by now.

strings.text: クラブの男の何人かは、姉さんの感触を知ってるんだろう。
strings.translated: Some of the men at the Club must know what she feels like.

strings.text: そう考えると怒るべきなのか悲しむべきなのか、よくわからなかった。
strings.translated: When I thought about it that way, I couldn't figure out whether I should be angry or sad.

strings.text: 元気になっていく姉さんを見るたびに、俺はもどかしい思いに駆られていた
strings.translated: Every time I saw my sister growing more and more cheerful, I was overcome with a helpless, frustrated feeling.

strings.text: 大智「いい街だと思ったのにな……」
strings.translated: Daichi「I thought it was such a good town...」

strings.text: どうしてこんなことになってしまったんだろう
strings.translated: How did things end up like this?

strings.text: 瑛「白坂君？
strings.translated: Akira「Shirasaka-kun?

strings.text: どうかした？
strings.translated: Something wrong?

strings.text: …ああ……いや、何でもない
strings.translated: Ah... no, it's nothing.

strings.text: 瑛「そう？
strings.translated: Akira「Really?

strings.text: 何だか悩んでるように見えたけど…。
strings.translated: You just looked like you had something weighing on you...

strings.text: 僕で良ければ相談に乗るよ」
strings.translated: If you want, I'm happy to listen.」

strings.text: 桧垣が心配そうに言ってくれる。
strings.translated: Higaki said it with a look of concern.

strings.text: 本当にいい奴だ。
strings.translated: He really is a good guy.

strings.text: 常に誰かのことを考えていて、生徒会の仕事にも全力で当たっている。
strings.translated: He's always thinking about others, and he throws himself completely into his student council work.

strings.text: でも、そんな奴だからこそ、本当のことなんて話せない。
strings.translated: But that's exactly why I couldn't tell him the truth.

strings.text: 下手をすれば、桧垣まで巻き込んでしまうかもしれないって考えると、あのクラブのことを口に出すことはできなかった
strings.translated: The thought that one wrong move might drag Higaki into this too -- that was enough to keep me from ever saying a word about the Club.

strings.text: 大智「大丈夫。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm fine.

strings.text: ちょっと……寝不足で。
strings.translated: Just... a little sleep-deprived.

strings.text: 心配かけてごめんな
strings.translated: Sorry for worrying you.」

strings.text: 瑛「それならいいけど
strings.translated: Akira「If that's all it is, okay.」

strings.text: 大智「困った事があったら、相談するから
strings.translated: Daichi「If something comes up that I need help with, I'll come to you.」

strings.text: 瑛「うん、何かあったらいつでも言って
strings.translated: Akira「Sure, just say the word anytime.」

strings.text: 桧垣はそう言ってくれたけど、俺の身の回りで相談できることは基本的にはない。
strings.translated: Higaki said that, but there was basically nothing going on in my life that I could actually consult him about.

strings.text: クラブのことを話すわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: I couldn't talk about the Club.

strings.text: でも、それ以外のことでだったら、ひとつだけ気にかかることがあった。
strings.translated: But there was one other thing -- apart from that -- that had been nagging at me.

strings.text: 一応、桧垣に頼んではいたはずだけど、心配なことがひとつだけあった
strings.translated: I had asked Higaki to look into it, but there was one thing I was still worried about.

strings.text: ある日の放課後、俺はまたあの光景に出会ってしまった
strings.translated: One afternoon after school, I stumbled upon that same sight again.

strings.text: 心音「う、うぅっ…く、ううぅぅぅっ…！」
strings.translated: Kokone「Ugh, uuu...h, uuuuu...!」

strings.text: トイレの前でうずくまる１人の女の子。
strings.translated: A girl, crumpled on the floor in front of the restroom.

strings.text: 戸田さんが、また泣いていた。
strings.translated: Toda-san was crying again.

strings.text: 全身をずぶ濡れにして、呻くような声で泣いていた。
strings.translated: She was soaked to the bone, crying in a low, groaning voice.

strings.text: まだ、いじめは続いてるらしい。
strings.translated: The bullying was apparently still going on.

strings.text: 桧垣に相談はしておいたけど、やっぱり簡単にはなくならないんだな
strings.translated: I had talked to Higaki about it, but I guess it's not the kind of thing that just goes away easily.

strings.text: 大智「…大丈夫？」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Are you okay?」

strings.text: どうしようかと迷ったけど、見て見ぬふりをするわけにもいかない。
strings.translated: I hesitated over what to do, but I couldn't just look the other way.

strings.text: 周りにも誰もいないし、とりあえず声をかけてみることにした
strings.translated: There was no one else around, so I decided to at least say something.

strings.text: 心音「あ…」
strings.translated: Kokone「Ah...」

strings.text: 俺の姿に気づいて、戸田さんが顔を上げた。
strings.translated: She noticed me and lifted her face.

strings.text: 小さく声を漏らすと、途端に悲しげな表情を浮かべた。
strings.translated: A small sound escaped her lips, and her expression immediately turned to one of grief.

strings.text: 今日も酷いいじめにあったらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed she had been through another terrible round of bullying today.

strings.text: 頭からずぶ濡れで、妙な臭いもした。
strings.translated: She was drenched from head to toe, and there was a strange smell about her.

strings.text: どうしてこんな事ができるんだろう。
strings.translated: How could anyone do something like this?

strings.text: いじめてる連中は、自分のやってることを本当に理解してるんだろうか
strings.translated: Do the ones doing the bullying actually understand what it is they're doing?

strings.text: 大智「立てる？
strings.translated: Daichi「Can you stand?」

strings.text: 心音「はい
strings.translated: Kokone「Yes.」

strings.text: 戸田さんがゆっくりと立ち上がる
strings.translated: Toda-san slowly got to her feet.

strings.text: 大智「…保健室、行くか？
strings.translated: Daichi「...Want to go to the nurse's office?」

strings.text: 心音「いえ…いいです。
strings.translated: Kokone「No... it's fine.

strings.text: 大丈夫ですから…」
strings.translated: I'm okay on my own...」

strings.text: 確かに怪我はなさそうだけど…、一人にして大丈夫だろうか
strings.translated: She didn't seem to be physically hurt, but... was it really alright to leave her alone?

strings.text: 大智「先生には言ってるの？
strings.translated: Daichi「Have you told a teacher?」

strings.text: 心音「言っても無駄だから…。
strings.translated: Kokone「There's no point in saying anything...

strings.text: 皆、私の事なんてどうでもいいんです
strings.translated: Nobody cares about me anyway.」

strings.text: 大智「そんな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not...」

strings.text: そんなことはない、とは言い切れなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't bring myself to say "that's not true."

strings.text: 放っておきたくはない。
strings.translated: I didn't want to just leave her.

strings.text: でも、深く立ち入る覚悟があるかと聞かれたら、俺には頷けなかった
strings.translated: But if someone asked whether I was ready to get deeply involved -- I couldn't honestly say yes.

strings.text: 心音「放っておいてください。
strings.translated: Kokone「Please leave me alone.

strings.text: 私は…ひとりでも平気だから
strings.translated: I'm... fine on my own.」

strings.text: 大智「でも
strings.translated: Daichi「But--」

strings.text: 心音「あなたに何ができるっていうんですか！
strings.translated: Kokone「What could you possibly do for me?!

strings.text: 私の事なんて何も知らないくせに！
strings.translated: You don't know anything about me!

strings.text: 心音「誰にも私を救う事なんてできないんです！
strings.translated: Kokone「Nobody can save me!

strings.text: だから放っておいてください！
strings.translated: So just leave me alone!」

strings.text: 戸田さんは逃げるように走り去ってしまった。
strings.translated: Toda-san ran off as if she were fleeing.

strings.text: 生徒会の人達は彼女に何かしてくれたんだろうか。
strings.translated: Had the student council done anything for her?

strings.text: もう一度くらい、状況を確認しておいたほうがいいだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe I should check in one more time to see how things stood.

strings.text: そんなことをしている場合じゃないとわかっていながら、俺は自分が抱えている問題から逃げるように、生徒会室に向かった
strings.translated: Knowing full well I had my own problems to deal with, I headed to the student council room -- as if running away from them.

strings.text: 瑛「そうか。
strings.translated: Akira「I see.

strings.text: また…」
strings.translated: Again...」

strings.text: 俺の話を聞いて、桧垣は「やっぱり」
strings.translated: After hearing me out, Higaki let out a sigh that seemed to say "just as I thought."

strings.text: と言いたげなため息を吐いた
strings.translated: as if to say "just as I thought."

strings.text: 瑛「実は…本人に直接話を聞いてみたんだけどね、「いじめられてなんかいない」
strings.translated: Akira「Actually... I tried talking to her directly, but she denied it -- said she "wasn't being bullied" --

strings.text: って否定されちゃって、誰が彼女をいじめているのかまだわかっていないんだ
strings.translated: so we still don't know who's doing it to her.」

strings.text: 大智「それで大人しく引き下がったのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「And you just backed off after that?」

strings.text: 瑛「ひとまずその場はね。
strings.translated: Akira「For now, we left it at that.

strings.text: 事を荒立てると事態が悪化する可能性もあるし…。
strings.translated: If we make too big a scene, things could get worse...

strings.text: もちろん、これで終わりにするつもりはないよ
strings.translated: Of course, I don't intend to just let it end there.」

strings.text: 大智「先生には？
strings.translated: Daichi「What about the teachers?」

strings.text: 瑛「報告と相談はした。
strings.translated: Akira「I did report it and consult with people.

strings.text: 担任の先生にも「注意してみる」
strings.translated: The homeroom teacher said they'd「keep an eye out」--

strings.text: とは言ってもらえたけど、いろんな意味で難しいね
strings.translated: but it's difficult in a lot of ways.」

strings.text: 桧垣の言いたいことはわかる。
strings.translated: I understood what Higaki was getting at.

strings.text: 過敏な対応をするといじめがエスカレートする可能性もある。
strings.translated: An overly heavy-handed response could make the bullying escalate.

strings.text: ベタなドラマじゃあるまいし、学級会で熱弁をふるって解決する問題とも思えない。
strings.translated: This wasn't some cheesy TV drama -- I couldn't imagine it being solved by a passionate speech at a class meeting.

strings.text: それに「色んな意味で」
strings.translated: And「in a lot of ways」--

strings.text: ってのは、大人の事情とかそういう意味だろう。
strings.translated: that probably meant adult politics and all that sort of thing.

strings.text: 教師は聖人でも超人でもない。
strings.translated: Teachers are neither saints nor superhumans.

strings.text: こんな面倒な問題にはできれば関わりたくないはずだ。
strings.translated: They'd rather not get tangled up in messy problems like this if they can help it.

strings.text: そういう「現実」
strings.translated: That kind of「reality」--

strings.text: は姉さんの一件で嫌と言うほど思い知った
strings.translated: I'd learned it all too painfully from what happened with my sister.

strings.text: 瑛「一応僕らで調査っていうか、表沙汰にならない程度にそれとなく探りは入れてみたんだ。
strings.translated: Akira「We did do a bit of our own investigating -- discreetly, nothing that would cause a scene. We managed to get a rough idea of who's been bullying her.」

strings.text: それで、彼女をいじめているのが誰か、大体の目星はついたんだけど
strings.translated: And, we have a pretty good idea of who's been bullying her --

strings.text: 瑛「それがまた、ちょっと厄介な子でね……」
strings.translated: Akira「It's just... the person involved is a bit of a tricky one...」

strings.text: その先を目で促すと、桧垣は少し困ったような顔をした
strings.translated: When I urged him with my eyes to go on, Higaki made a slightly troubled face.

strings.text: 瑛「証拠があるわけじゃないし、名前は言えない。
strings.translated: Akira「We don't have proof, so I can't say a name.

strings.text: …って、調べればわかっちゃうだろうけど
strings.translated: ...Though I suppose you could figure it out if you looked into it yourself.」

strings.text: 大智「誰にも言わないよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「I won't tell anyone.

strings.text: 勝手に調べたりもしない
strings.translated: And I won't go digging around on my own.」

strings.text: 瑛「うん
strings.translated: Akira「Yeah.」

strings.text: 瑛「彼女…戸田さんはあまり仲のいい友達がいないみたいなんだ。
strings.translated: Akira「She... Toda-san doesn't seem to have many close friends.

strings.text: でも時々、不自然に仲良くしている３人がいるらしくて、そのリーダー格のお母さんがＰＴＡの会長で
strings.translated: But apparently there are three girls who act unnaturally friendly with her at times, and the mother of the ringleader is the PTA chairwoman.」

strings.text: 瑛「おまけにお父さんも社会的に地位のある人物でね。
strings.translated: Akira「On top of that, his father is someone with considerable social standing.

strings.text: 本人もかなりの優等生だし……。
strings.translated: The boy himself is quite the model student, too...

strings.text: 先生たちからしてみたら、相当やりにくい相手だよね
strings.translated: From the teachers' perspective, he's a pretty difficult opponent to deal with.」

strings.text: 大智「何か考えはあるのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Do you have any ideas?」

strings.text: 瑛「うーん…。
strings.translated: Akira「Hmm...

strings.text: 正直、僕たちも困ってて
strings.translated: Honestly, we're at a loss too.」

strings.text: 紗英子「あら、白坂さん
strings.translated: Saeko「Oh, Shirashaka-san.」

strings.text: 菱木さんが生徒会室に入ってきた。
strings.translated: Saeko had come into the student council room.

strings.text: あれ以来、学校で何度か顔は合わせたけど…いつも菱木さんの態度は変わらなかった。
strings.translated: We'd crossed paths at school a few times since then, but... her demeanor never changed.

strings.text: 自信に満ち溢れて、揺るぎなく、隙がない。
strings.translated: Confident, unshakeable, without a crack.

strings.text: あんなクラブに出入りして、あんなふうに…奔放に男にまたがっているとはとても思えない態度だ。
strings.translated: It was hard to believe she was someone who frequented a place like that Club and... freely straddled men like that.

strings.text: 菱木さんの態度を見ていると、あのクラブであったことが夢みたいに思えてくる。
strings.translated: Watching her, everything that happened at the Club started to feel like a dream.

strings.text: …むしろ、夢だったらよかったんだけどな
strings.translated: ...If only it actually had been a dream.

strings.text: 紗英子「戸田さんの話？
strings.translated: Saeko「About Toda-san?」

strings.text: 瑛「うん」
strings.translated: Akira「Yeah.」

strings.text: 桧垣は…彼女の秘密を知ったらどんな顔をするだろう。
strings.translated: I wondered -- if Higaki found out her secret, what kind of face would he make?

strings.text: 俺と同じように、菱木さんをあんな所から引き離そうとするだろうか。
strings.translated: Would he try to pull Saeko away from a place like that, just like I had?

strings.text: それとも、そこまで深い仲ではないんだろうか。
strings.translated: Or maybe they weren't close enough for that.

strings.text: 少なくとも今俺から話すつもりはなかった。
strings.translated: At least, I had no intention of telling him right now.

strings.text: 俺だって、あんなところに関わっていることは、桧垣には知られたくない
strings.translated: I didn't want Higaki to know I was mixed up in a place like that either.

strings.text: 大智「あの…ごめん。
strings.translated: Daichi「Um... sorry.

strings.text: 部外者が勝手に…」
strings.translated: An outsider getting involved on their own like this...」

strings.text: ひとまずいつも通りに接するにしても、そもそも彼女は少し苦手だった。
strings.translated: Even setting aside how to act around her normally, I'd never been entirely comfortable with her to begin with.

strings.text: …いや、むしろそのおかげで、煮え切らない俺の態度を桧垣に怪しまれずにすむかもしれない
strings.translated: Actually, maybe that was a blessing -- it might mean Higaki wouldn't find my awkward attitude toward her suspicious.

strings.text: 瑛「今日も同じ場所で彼女をみかけたらしいんだ
strings.translated: Akira「Apparently he spotted her in the same place again today.」

strings.text: 紗英子「いいわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「That's fine.

strings.text: そもそも白坂さんが報告してくれたのだし、情報を共有しておいた方が行き違いもなくなるでしょう
strings.translated: Shirashaka-san was the one who reported it in the first place, and sharing information will help us avoid any crossed wires.」

strings.text: 紗英子「それで、どこまで話したの？
strings.translated: Saeko「So, how much did you tell him?」

strings.text: 瑛「一通り。
strings.translated: Akira「Everything, basically.

strings.text: 大体の目星はついたけど、今はまだそこまで、って
strings.translated: We have a rough idea of who it is, but we're not ready to move yet.」

strings.text: 紗英子「そう
strings.translated: Saeko「I see.」

strings.text: 大智「これからどうするつもりなのか…聞いてもいいかな？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Can I ask... what you plan to do from here?」

strings.text: なんとなく及び腰になる俺とは正反対に、菱木さんは冷静に頷いた
strings.translated: In contrast to my own hesitance, Saeko calmly nodded.

strings.text: 紗英子「まずは証拠を掴むつもり。
strings.translated: Saeko「First, we intend to gather evidence.

strings.text: その結果、どの程度の行為が行われているかにもよるけど、まずは本人にいじめを認めさせるところから、かしらね
strings.translated: Depending on how serious the conduct turns out to be, I suppose the first step would be getting the person to admit to the bullying.」

strings.text: 大智「証拠を掴む、って…どうやって？
strings.translated: Daichi「Gather evidence... how?」

strings.text: 紗英子「それは私たちに任せてもらえるかしら？
strings.translated: Saeko「Could you leave that to us?

strings.text: いじめが毎回、あなたの言う特別教室棟の女子トイレで行われているとしたら、監視カメラの類は設置できないし
strings.translated: If the bullying is always taking place in the girls' restroom in that special classroom building you mentioned, we can't install any kind of surveillance camera, and...

strings.text: 紗英子「気の長い話になってしまうかもしれないけど、私達に出来ることはするし、見過ごしたりはしないから」
strings.translated: Saeko「It may end up being a slow process, but we'll do what we can and we won't turn a blind eye.」

strings.text: 少なくとも学校にいる限り、彼女は有能な生徒会長だ。
strings.translated: At least while she was at school, she was a capable student council president.

strings.text: …と、思いたい
strings.translated: ...Or so I wanted to believe.

strings.text: 大智「面倒な話を押しつけてごめん
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry for dumping such a troublesome matter on you.」

strings.text: 瑛「気にしなくていいよ。
strings.translated: Akira「Don't worry about it.

strings.text: こういったことも僕たちの仕事だから
strings.translated: This kind of thing is part of our job.」

strings.text: 紗英子「そもそも、白坂さんが謝る事じゃないでしょう。
strings.translated: Saeko「In the first place, this isn't something you should be apologizing for, Shirashaka-san.

strings.text: あなたが悪いんじゃないもの
strings.translated: It's not your fault.」

strings.text: 大智「俺が言うのも変だけど…戸田さんのこと、宜しくお願いします
strings.translated: Daichi「I know it's a bit odd coming from me, but... please take care of Toda-san.」

strings.text: 紗英子「ええ」
strings.translated: Saeko「Of course.」

strings.text: 本当に解決してくれるかどうかはわからないけど…俺がどうこうするよりも、解決する可能性は遥かに高いだろう
strings.translated: I couldn't say for certain whether they'd actually resolve it... but the chances of it being resolved were far higher than if I tried to handle it myself.

strings.text: もちろん、これで絶対に大丈夫だって言うことはできないけど、今は菱木さんを信じるしかなかった。
strings.translated: Of course, I couldn't say everything would definitely be okay -- but for now, I had no choice but to trust Saeko.

strings.text: そして、戸田さんへのいじめがなくなることを祈るしかなかった
strings.translated: And all I could do was pray that the bullying against Toda-san would stop.

strings.text: 愛「そう…白坂君らしいことをしたのね」
strings.translated: Ai「I see... that sounds like something you would do, Shirashaka-kun.」

strings.text: 戸田さんのいじめについてと、生徒会での話を聞かせると、神村さんは静かな口調でそんなふうに言った
strings.translated: When I told Kamimura-san about the bullying and what had happened in the student council room, she said that in a quiet tone.

strings.text: 大智「なんとかなるといいんだけどな」
strings.translated: Daichi「I just hope it works out somehow.」

strings.text: まだ、どうなるかはわからない。
strings.translated: I still didn't know how things would turn out.

strings.text: 良かれと思って桧垣や菱木さんに話したけど、いじめがさらに悪化する可能性もゼロじゃない
strings.translated: I'd told Higaki and Saeko thinking it was for the best, but there was no guarantee the bullying wouldn't get even worse.

strings.text: 愛「白坂君は、本当に他人のことを真剣に考えるのね。
strings.translated: Ai「You really do think seriously about other people, Shirashaka-kun.

strings.text: 自分には、何の得にもならないのに
strings.translated: Even when there's nothing in it for you.」

strings.text: 大智「こういうのって、損得の話じゃないだろ。
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not the kind of thing you weigh against personal gain.

strings.text: いじめられてるのを見過ごすなんて、気分が悪いじゃないか
strings.translated: Turning a blind eye to someone being bullied just feels awful.」

strings.text: 愛「気分が悪いと感じるところが、私には信じられないことだから
strings.translated: Ai「The fact that you feel awful about it -- that's something I find hard to believe.」

strings.text: 愛「きっと…白坂君は幸せなのね」
strings.translated: Ai「I think... you must be happy, Shirashaka-kun.」

strings.text: ほんの少しだけ寂しそうに言って、神村さんは小さく吐息を漏らした。
strings.translated: She said it with just a hint of loneliness, and let out a small sigh.

strings.text: 彼女の周りにはまともな神経の持ち主がいないんだろうか。
strings.translated: Were there really no decent people around her?

strings.text: だから、あんなクラブに関わってしまってるんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was that why she'd gotten involved with a place like that Club?

strings.text: 神村さんの両親はクラブのことについて知ってるんだろうか？
strings.translated: Did Kamimura-san's parents even know about the Club?

strings.text: 愛「どうしたの？
strings.translated: Ai「What's wrong?

strings.text: そんなに怖い顔して
strings.translated: Why are you making such a scary face?

strings.text: 大智「いや、考え事してただけなんだけど…神村さんのお父さんとお母さんって、クラブのこと知ってるの？
strings.translated: Daichi「No, I was just thinking... do Kamimura-san's parents know about the Club?」

strings.text: 愛「両親は……いないの。
strings.translated: Ai「My parents... are gone.

strings.text: 子供の頃に事故で死んで…それからおじさんとおばさんの家でお世話になっていて……。
strings.translated: They died in an accident when I was little... and since then I've been living with my aunt and uncle......」

strings.text: ２人とは、あまり話をしないから
strings.translated: I don't really talk much with the two of them --

strings.text: 大智「それで、なのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Is that why?」

strings.text: 愛「…何が？
strings.translated: Ai「...Why what?」

strings.text: 大智「神村さんがあそこに通う理由」
strings.translated: Daichi「The reason Kamimura-san goes there.」

strings.text: 両親が死んで、おじさんやおばさんとは上手くいっていなくて、それが原因でクラブに通っているんだろうか？
strings.translated: Her parents were gone, things weren't going well with her aunt and uncle -- was that what drove her to the Club?

strings.text: 愛「…そうとも言えるし、違うとも言える
strings.translated: Ai「...You could say that, and you could say that's not it.」

strings.text: まだ俺には話せないってことだろうか
strings.translated: Maybe there were still things she couldn't tell me yet.

strings.text: 愛「ごめんなさい」
strings.translated: Ai「I'm sorry.」

strings.text: 俺の内心を読んだみたいに、神村さんは頭を下げた
strings.translated: As if she'd read my thoughts, Kamimura-san lowered her head.

strings.text: 円夏「あっ、２人ともまだいたんだ？
strings.translated: Madoka「Oh, you two are still here?」

strings.text: 円夏「何してるの？
strings.translated: Madoka「What are you doing?

strings.text: 帰らないの？
strings.translated: Aren't you heading home?

strings.text: 大智「ちょっと…もう帰ろうかと思ってたけど」
strings.translated: Daichi「Well... I was just about to leave.」

strings.text: 星野さんがいる前でクラブの話をするわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: I couldn't talk about the Club in front of Hoshino-san.

strings.text: 神村さんともっと話したかったけど、どうやら今日はここまでのようだ
strings.translated: I'd wanted to talk with Kamimura-san more, but it seemed today was as far as we'd get.

strings.text: 円夏「２人で何話してたの？
strings.translated: Madoka「What were you two talking about?

strings.text: もしかして、デートの打ち合わせ？
strings.translated: Could this be... a date planning session?

strings.text: 大智「違うよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「No.

strings.text: 授業でわからないところ教えてもらってただけ
strings.translated: She was just helping me with something I didn't understand in class.」

strings.text: 円夏「ふ～ん、今日はそういう理由にしますか」
strings.translated: Madoka「Sure, sure, that's your story for today, is it?」

strings.text: 俺の説明を聞いて、星野さんがニヤニヤと笑う。
strings.translated: Hoshino-san grinned at my explanation.

strings.text: 最近は特に神村さんとよく話してるから、それで何かを誤解してるらしい。
strings.translated: I'd been talking with Kamimura-san a lot lately, so she seemed to have gotten the wrong idea.

strings.text: 話に割って入って来ては、からかうことが増えていた。
strings.translated: She'd been cutting into our conversations more and more, teasing us.

strings.text: まあ、俺としては構わないんだけど、神村さんにどう思われてるかがちょっと心配だ。
strings.translated: Well, I didn't really mind -- but I was a little worried about what Kamimura-san thought.

strings.text: これで逆に距離を置かれたりしたら、元も子もないんだけどな
strings.translated: If it ended up pushing her away instead, that would defeat the whole purpose.

strings.text: 円夏「ふふっ、初めてだよね。
strings.translated: Madoka「Hehe, it's the first time, isn't it?

strings.text: 愛が、男の子とこんなに話すなんて
strings.translated: Ai talking this much with a boy.」

strings.text: 愛「そう？
strings.translated: Ai「Is it?」

strings.text: 円夏「白坂君、愛のこと宜しくね」
strings.translated: Madoka「Shiraka-kun, please take care of Ai for me.」

strings.text: 曖昧に頷きながら、事情を知らない人はいい気なもんだ…なんてことを思ってしまう。
strings.translated: I gave a vague nod, thinking to myself... people who don't know the situation really have it easy.

strings.text: でも、それを星野さんに言うわけにはいかないし、星野さんが悪いわけでもない
strings.translated: But I couldn't say that to Hoshino-san, and it wasn't her fault either.

strings.text: 円夏「おっと、これ以上邪魔しちゃ悪いよね。
strings.translated: Madoka「Oops, I shouldn't intrude any longer.

strings.text: ２人とも、また明日ね
strings.translated: See you both tomorrow!」

strings.text: 大智「またな
strings.translated: Daichi「See you.」

strings.text: 元気良く手を振って、星野さんが昇降口のほうへと歩いていく。
strings.translated: She waved cheerfully and headed off toward the shoe lockers.

strings.text: あんなふうに笑って生活できたら、きっと毎日が幸せなんだろうな。
strings.translated: If I could smile like that and just live my life, every day would probably be a happy one.

strings.text: 当の本人は気付いてないと思うけど、今の俺にはよくわかる。
strings.translated: I don't think she realizes it herself, but I understood it clearly now.

strings.text: 普通でいられることが一番幸せなんだって、本当に真剣に思うことができた
strings.translated: I could say with genuine sincerity that being able to live an ordinary life is the greatest happiness of all.

strings.text: 愛「それで…どうするの？
strings.translated: Ai「So... what are you going to do?」

strings.text: ……あ、クラブのことか
strings.translated: Oh, right -- the Club.

strings.text: 愛「行ってみる？
strings.translated: Ai「Are you going to go?」

strings.text: 大智「今日は…いいや。
strings.translated: Daichi「Today... I'll pass.

strings.text: 違った方法がないか家でゆっくり考えてみるよ
strings.translated: I'll go home and take my time thinking about whether there's another way.」

strings.text: 愛「そう…じゃあ、今日は私も帰るから
strings.translated: Ai「I see... then I'll be heading home too.」

strings.text: 大智「うん、それがいいと思う
strings.translated: Daichi「Yeah, I think that's for the best.」

strings.text: 愛「さようなら
strings.translated: Ai「Goodbye.」

strings.text: 大智「さよなら。
strings.translated: Daichi「Bye.

strings.text: また明日な
strings.translated: See you tomorrow.」

strings.text: クラブに行かなければ、一緒にいる理由もない。
strings.translated: If I wasn't going to the Club, there was no reason for us to stay together.

strings.text: わかってたことだけど、神村さんがあっさりと帰ってしまうことに、多少の寂しさを感じずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: I'd known that, but I couldn't help feeling a slight pang of loneliness when Kamimura-san left so easily.

strings.text: 姉さんのこととか、自分の気持ちとか、神村さんの人生とか、何も犠牲にせずに問題を解決したかった
strings.translated: I wanted to solve everything -- my sister's situation, my own feelings, Kamimura-san's life -- without sacrificing any of it.

strings.text: 紗英子
strings.translated: Saeko

strings.text: 紗英子「戸田心音さんね。
strings.translated: Saeko「Kokone Toda.

strings.text: １年Ｃ組
strings.translated: Class 1-C.」

strings.text: 心音「はい…」
strings.translated: Kokone「Yes...」

strings.text: その声は控え目で怯えているような印象を与えるものだったけど、かといって緊張は感じられない。
strings.translated: Her voice gave the impression of being timid and frightened, yet there was no sense of nervousness in it.

strings.text: どうしても怯えるような声になってしまうのは、彼女の性格や境遇からなんだろう。
strings.translated: The way her voice inevitably came out sounding fearful was probably just a product of her personality and circumstances.

strings.text: でも、普通なら接する機会もないはずの私との、突然の対面に緊張している様子がない、ということが少し気にかかった
strings.translated: But what caught my attention was that she showed no sign of nervousness at this sudden face-to-face meeting with me -- someone she would normally have no occasion to interact with.

strings.text: 紗英子「突然呼び出したりしてごめんなさい。
strings.translated: Saeko「I'm sorry for calling you out so suddenly.

strings.text: 驚いたでしょう？」
strings.translated: You must have been surprised.」

strings.text: 人づてにそっと送ったメモで呼び出すという回りくどいやり方をして、今、こうやって戸田さんと話す機会を得ている私には、それなりの気苦労がなかった訳じゃない。
strings.translated: Having gone through the roundabout method of summoning her with a quietly passed note, and now sitting here with the opportunity to speak with Toda-san, I'd had my share of anxieties.

strings.text: 戸田さんには時間と場所…この生徒会室と、できる限り人目を忍んでくるように、と伝えておいたのだ。
strings.translated: I had told Toda-san the time and place -- this student council room -- and asked her to come as discreetly as possible.

strings.text: …もし、戸田さんが生徒会に呼び出されたのを、彼女をいじめている子達が知ったとしたら？
strings.translated: ...What if the girls who were bullying her found out she'd been called to the student council?

strings.text: それが戸田さんにとって不利なことに繋がるかもしれないとも考えていた。
strings.translated: I had also been considering that this might work against Toda-san in some way.

strings.text: ただ、ここで私が待っている、とは伝えていなかった。
strings.translated: However, I hadn't told her that I would be the one waiting here.

strings.text: だから、戸田さんがここで待っていた私を見て驚いたり緊張したりしていないのが、不思議にも感じられる
strings.translated: So it struck me as strange that Toda-san showed neither surprise nor nervousness upon finding me waiting for her.

strings.text: 私は戸田さんの声を聞きながら、その表情を観察した。
strings.translated: As I listened to Toda-san's voice, I observed her expression.

strings.text: その瞳には、声から感じられるような怯えの影はなかった。
strings.translated: In her eyes, there was none of the fearful shadow that her voice suggested.

strings.text: 不思議…というか、意外と神経が太くできているのかもしれない、という印象を覚える。
strings.translated: Strange... or rather, I got the impression that she might actually have stronger nerves than expected.

strings.text: そして、それをあからさまにしようとはしないけれど、私のことを目上の人間としては扱っていない、ということも感じ取れた。
strings.translated: And though she made no effort to show it openly, I could also sense that she was not treating me as someone above her.

strings.text: 別にそれは構いはしない。
strings.translated: That didn't particularly bother me.

strings.text: 今、それを気にかける必要もない
strings.translated: There was no need to concern myself with it right now.

strings.text: 紗英子「回りくどいやり方は嫌いだから、単刀直入に話すわね
strings.translated: Saeko「I dislike beating around the bush, so I'll get straight to the point.」

strings.text: 紗英子「生徒会に相談があったの。
strings.translated: Saeko「There was something I wanted to consult the student council about.」

strings.text: あなたがクラスメイトにいじめられているみたいだ、って」
strings.translated: that you're being bullied by your classmates.」

strings.text: 私はあえて知らされていたことと違うこと…クラスメイトにいじめられているというブラフを織り交ぜておく。
strings.translated: I deliberately mixed in something different from what I'd actually been told -- the bluff that she was being bullied by her classmates.

strings.text: こうすれば、誰から戸田さんがいじめられているという情報が私にもたらされたかはぼやけてしまうだろう。
strings.translated: This way, it would be harder to trace exactly who had brought me the information about Toda-san being bullied.

strings.text: これは、その「誰か」
strings.translated: This was a consideration for Toda-san,

strings.text: に気づかうかもしれない戸田さんへの配慮と、このことを教えてくれた白坂さんが不利にならないための配慮だった
strings.translated: who might worry about that "someone" -- and also a precaution to make sure Shiraka-san, who had told me about this, wouldn't be put in a disadvantageous position.

strings.text: 心音「あ……」
strings.translated: Kokone「Ah...」

strings.text: 戸田さんは悲しそうに表情を曇らせた。
strings.translated: Toda-san's expression clouded over with what looked like sadness.

strings.text: その表情に不自然に作られたような印象を覚える。
strings.translated: That expression gave me the impression of being artificially constructed.

strings.text: それ以前に、顔の絆創膏がいかにもあからさまだ
strings.translated: And before that, the bandage on her face was all too conspicuous.

strings.text: 紗英子「この事はまだ誰にも話していないわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「I haven't told anyone else about this yet.

strings.text: 先生にも詳しい事情は話していないから、安心して」
strings.translated: I haven't gone into detail with the teachers either, so you can relax.」

strings.text: 確かに戸田さんの担任や生活指導の先生にはまだこの話はしていない。
strings.translated: It was true that I hadn't yet spoken to Toda-san's homeroom teacher or the guidance counselor about any of this.

strings.text: …もっとも、戸田さんの担任がいじめの事実に気付いて、それを看過している可能性は考えられる。
strings.translated: Though it was conceivable that Toda-san's homeroom teacher had noticed the bullying and was simply turning a blind eye to it.

strings.text: 彼女の態度が素なのか演技なのかはわからないけど、「いじめられているかわいそうな女の子」
strings.translated: Whether her attitude was genuine or an act, I couldn't say -- but the impression of "a poor girl being bullied"

strings.text: という印象はわかりやすい。
strings.translated: was easy enough to read.

strings.text: だとすれば、そのことに戸田さんの担任が気付かない、というのは不自然なことに思える
strings.translated: If that was the case, it seemed strange to think that Toda-san's homeroom teacher wouldn't have noticed.

strings.text: 紗英子「私たちはあなたを助けたいの。
strings.translated: Saeko「We want to help you.

strings.text: あなたがこれ以上辛い目に遭わないよう配慮はするから、正直に話してもらえないかしら？
strings.translated: I'll make sure you don't have to suffer any more than you already have, so would you be willing to tell me honestly what's been going on?」

strings.text: 心音「いじめだなんて、そんな……湯沢さんも、なっちゃん…藤原さんも、大切なお友達ですから……」
strings.translated: Kokone「Bullying? That's not... Yuzawa-san, and Nacchan... and Fujiwara-san too -- they're all dear friends of mine...」

strings.text: 誰が、と聞いた訳でもないのに戸田さんは３人の名前を挙げてくる。
strings.translated: Without even being asked who, Toda-san volunteered three names.

strings.text: その中に、私にも覚えのある名前があった。
strings.translated: Among them was a name I recognized.

strings.text: 湯沢舞子。
strings.translated: Maiko Yuzawa.

strings.text: 彼女は生徒会で書記を務めている。
strings.translated: She served as secretary on the student council.

strings.text: 多分、順当に行けば彼女が次の生徒会長だろう。
strings.translated: In all likelihood, she was the natural choice to be the next student council president.

strings.text: 人当たりもよく、成績も優秀で、言動も完璧といっていいほどの優等生。
strings.translated: She was personable, academically excellent, and her conduct was so impeccable you could almost call her a model student.

strings.text: そんな彼女になにか裏があるような気はしていた。
strings.translated: I had always had a feeling that someone like her must be hiding something beneath the surface.

strings.text: 完璧な人間なんていやしないってことは私が一番よく知っている。
strings.translated: I know better than anyone that there's no such thing as a perfect person.

strings.text: 完璧そうに見える人間の方が裏に秘密を抱えているものだ。
strings.translated: The ones who appear perfect are precisely the ones who tend to carry secrets in the shadows.

strings.text: 私も、瑛さんも…。
strings.translated: Me, and Akira-san too...

strings.text: だから、多分、湯沢さんにもそんな裏があるのだろうと思っていたけど、それがこんな形で露見するとは少し予想外でもあった。
strings.translated: So I had suspected that Yuzawa-san must have some hidden side to her as well -- but I hadn't quite expected it to come to light in a form like this.

strings.text: あの子はもう少し賢い子だと思っていたのだけど
strings.translated: I had thought she was a smarter girl than that.

strings.text: 心音「私は……平気ですから…。
strings.translated: Kokone「I'm... fine.

strings.text: 全部私がいけないんです…。
strings.translated: It's all my fault...

strings.text: 私が鈍いから…皆にはいつも迷惑をかけて
strings.translated: I'm so slow... I'm always causing trouble for everyone.

strings.text: 心音「だから……藤原さん達を責めないであげて下さい」
strings.translated: Kokone「So please... don't blame Fujiwara-san and the others.」

strings.text: 自分を苛めている相手をかばい立てするようでいて、上から目線の尊大な態度。
strings.translated: She seemed to be defending the very people who were tormenting her, yet there was an air of condescension and self-importance about it.

strings.text: 「いじめられる側にも原因がある」
strings.translated: There's a saying that "the bullied party also bears some responsibility,"

strings.text: という言葉があるけど、彼女の言動を見るに、おそらくこの件はそう言ったパターンだろう。
strings.translated: and looking at her words and behavior, this situation was probably that kind of pattern.

strings.text: だからといっていじめる側に非がないとはいわないけれど
strings.translated: That said, I wouldn't go so far as to say the bullies bore no fault.

strings.text: 紗英子「そう…」
strings.translated: Saeko「I see...」

strings.text: 彼女の言葉で、いじめの有無とその加害者の言質はとれたようなものだった。
strings.translated: Her words had effectively given me confirmation of the bullying and the identities of those responsible.

strings.text: けれど、ただ当人に注意するわけにはいかないだろう。
strings.translated: Even so, I couldn't simply go and confront the parties involved directly.

strings.text: 注意すればいじめの手は止むか、緩むかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I did, the bullying might stop -- or at least ease up.

strings.text: 少なくとも、反動的に彼女へのいじめがエスカレートすることを防ぐ手段はあると思う。
strings.translated: I believed there were ways to prevent it from backfiring and causing the bullying to escalate against her.

strings.text: けれど問題は戸田さん自身だ。
strings.translated: But the real problem was Toda-san herself.

strings.text: 中途半端な対応では、彼女自身が問題を大きく、複雑にしてしまうかもしれない
strings.translated: A half-hearted response might cause her to make the situation even bigger and more complicated on her own.

strings.text: 紗英子「それではあなたは、いじめはないっていうのね？」
strings.translated: Saeko「So then, you're saying there is no bullying?」

strings.text: それが事実とは異なるということは、よくわかっていた。
strings.translated: I knew perfectly well that wasn't the truth.

strings.text: でも、もう少し戸田さんの真意を引き出すために、あえてその建前に乗ってみることにする
strings.translated: But to draw out a little more of Toda-san's real intentions, I decided to play along with her pretense for now.

strings.text: 心音「はい…。
strings.translated: Kokone「Yes...

strings.text: あれは……いじめなんかじゃありませんから……」
strings.translated: That was... it wasn't bullying or anything like that...」

strings.text: そういいながら戸田さんは、怪我をしていることを強調するように手首の包帯をさすってみせる。
strings.translated: As she said this, Toda-san stroked the bandage on her wrist, as if to emphasize that she was injured.

strings.text: …なるほど。
strings.translated: I see.

strings.text: これはやはり「いじめられる方にも問題がある」
strings.translated: 「...So you're saying the one being bullied is also at fault?」

strings.text: パターンらしい。
strings.translated: -- it seemed to be that pattern after all.

strings.text: だとすれば…一方的に湯沢さんを責めるのではなく、むしろ道理を説いたほうが上手く事が運ぶかもしれない
strings.translated: If that was the case... rather than placing all the blame on Yuzawa-san one-sidedly, it might go more smoothly if I reasoned with her instead.

strings.text: 紗英子「わかったわ、戸田さん。
strings.translated: Saeko「I understand, Toda-san.

strings.text: …あなたは優しいのね」
strings.translated: ...You're a kind person.」

strings.text: 内心、かみ合わないところを実感しつつも、私は戸田さんの話にまだ合わせておくことにした
strings.translated: Inwardly sensing how misaligned things were, I decided to keep going along with Toda-san's version of events for a little longer.

strings.text: 心音「そんな……わ、私は……そんなんじゃ……」
strings.translated: Kokone「That's not... n-no, I'm not... it's not like that...」

strings.text: 突然、戸田さんが泣き始めた。
strings.translated: Suddenly, Toda-san began to cry.

strings.text: ぽろぽろと彼女の目から涙がこぼれ落ちる。
strings.translated: Tears spilled from her eyes, one after another.

strings.text: 演技でしているとしたら大したものだけど、恐らく彼女の素だろう。
strings.translated: If she was doing it as an act, it was quite impressive -- but this was probably just who she was.

strings.text: これは筋金入りだこと
strings.translated: She was the real deal.

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたの優しさに免じて、彼女たちへの処分は穏便に済ませましょう
strings.translated: Saeko「In consideration of your kindness, I'll see to it that the punishment for them is handled quietly.」

strings.text: 私の言葉にうなずきはしたものの、その言葉の裏にはなんとなく残念そうな気配が感じられた
strings.translated: Though she nodded at my words, I could somehow sense a faint air of disappointment lurking beneath them.

strings.text: 紗英子「それじゃ、私は先に戻るわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「Well then, I'll head back first.

strings.text: あなたは涙を拭いて、落ち着いてから出なさい
strings.translated: Dry your tears and leave once you've calmed down.」

strings.text: とはいったものの、戸田さんは本当に落ち着いてからこの部屋を出るのだろうか？
strings.translated: But would Toda-san really wait until she had calmed down before leaving this room?

strings.text: もしかすると、その泣きはらした目もアピールの材料にするのでは…という考えが頭を過ぎっていく。
strings.translated: The thought crossed my mind that she might use her tear-reddened eyes as yet another tool for appeal.

strings.text: そんな彼女に、何かあったらいつでも相談しに来るように告げようかと迷ったけど、そういうと相談という名のアピールをしに来るような気がして…。
strings.translated: I hesitated over whether to tell her she could come to me for advice anytime something happened -- but I had a feeling that if I said that, she'd come under the guise of "advice" just to make her appeal.

strings.text: だから、その言葉を口にすることはやめておいた
strings.translated: So I kept those words to myself.

strings.text: 白坂さんにはああいったけど、やはり事実を把握しておくことは必要だと感じていた。
strings.translated: I had told Shiraka-san one thing, but I still felt it was necessary to get a proper grasp of the facts.

strings.text: 校内でいじめが行われていて、そのリーダー格が生徒会の書記でもあり次期生徒会長とも評される湯沢さん。
strings.translated: Bullying was taking place on school grounds, and the ringleader was none other than Yuzawa-san -- the student council secretary, widely regarded as the next student council president.

strings.text: だとすれば、ことは個人対個人の間のいじめという問題だけに収まらない可能性だってある。
strings.translated: If that was the case, there was a possibility this wouldn't remain a simple matter of bullying between two individuals.

strings.text: そう思った私は、辺りをつけた女子トイレに隠しカメラを設置して「それ」
strings.translated: With that in mind, I had installed a hidden camera in the girls' restroom I had my eye on, and waited for "it"

strings.text: が記録されるのを待っていた。
strings.translated: to be recorded.

strings.text: そして、「それ」
strings.translated: And "it"

strings.text: はそんなに待たずともカメラに収められることになった。
strings.translated: didn't take long to be captured on camera.

strings.text: しかし、これで湯沢さんに自重を促してみたところで、その行動が抑制されるかはわからなかった。
strings.translated: However, even if I used this to urge Yuzawa-san to restrain herself, I had no way of knowing whether her behavior would actually be curbed.

strings.text: わからない、というよりも習慣付いている快楽に捕らわれていたら…？
strings.translated: "No way of knowing" was putting it mildly -- what if she was already in the grip of a habit that had become a source of pleasure...?

strings.text: という考えが頭の中にどうしても残る。
strings.translated: That thought stubbornly lingered in my mind.

strings.text: もしかしたら、私がクラブにのめり込んでいるように、彼女が戸田さんをいじめることにのめり込んでいたら？
strings.translated: What if she was just as consumed by bullying Toda-san as I was consumed by the Club?

strings.text: それこそ、中毒めいた状態になっていたとしたら？
strings.translated: What if she had fallen into something like an addicted state?

strings.text: とはいっても、なにもせず放っておくという訳にもいかない。
strings.translated: Even so, I couldn't simply leave things alone and do nothing.

strings.text: そう踏ん切りを付けた私は、湯沢さんを生徒会室へと呼び出していた
strings.translated: Having steeled myself with that resolve, I had called Yuzawa-san to the student council room.

strings.text: 舞子「……どういうことですか？」
strings.translated: Maiko「...What is the meaning of this?」

strings.text: その動画を見せられた湯沢さんは、特に動揺する様子は見せなかった。
strings.translated: Yuzawa-san, having been shown the video, showed no sign of being shaken.

strings.text: こんな風にばれるようなことをしてしまっていることと、それを収められたことは浅はかだとしかいいようがない。
strings.translated: The fact that she'd done something so easily exposed, and that it had been recorded -- there was no other word for it but careless.

strings.text: けれども、ここで動揺しないのは大したものだと思った
strings.translated: And yet, I thought it was something to be impressed by that she didn't fall apart here.

strings.text: 紗英子「見ての通りよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「Exactly what it looks like.

strings.text: 匿名で生徒会に相談があったの。
strings.translated: An anonymous concern was brought to the student council.

strings.text: １年生の女の子がいじめられているみたいだ、って
strings.translated: That a first-year girl was apparently being bullied.」

strings.text: 紗英子「最初に本人に話を聞いたけど、認めなかったわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「I spoke to the girl herself first, but she wouldn't admit it.

strings.text: だから私たちが独自に調査してみたら、これが撮れた
strings.translated: So we conducted our own investigation, and this is what we captured.」

strings.text: 舞子
strings.translated: Maiko

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたも自分の立場はわかっているでしょう。
strings.translated: Saeko「You understand your own position.

strings.text: 将来のある身なんだから、馬鹿なことはやめなさい
strings.translated: You have a future ahead of you, so stop doing something so foolish.」

strings.text: 紗英子「万一こんな動画が流出したりしたら、お父さんも困るでしょう？
strings.translated: Saeko「If a video like this were ever to leak, your father would be in quite a difficult position, wouldn't he?

strings.text: 当然あなた自身の生活にも支障が出る」
strings.translated: And naturally, it would disrupt your own life as well.」

strings.text: 頭もいい湯沢さんのことだ。
strings.translated: Yuzawa-san is sharp, after all.

strings.text: 私がいっていることの意味くらいは簡単に理解するだろう。
strings.translated: She would easily understand the meaning of what I was saying.

strings.text: 彼女の父親は地方銀行の支店長。
strings.translated: Her father is the branch manager of a regional bank.

strings.text: その娘が悪質ないじめに荷担していたと世に知れ、騒ぎになったとしたら…？
strings.translated: If it became public knowledge that his daughter had been involved in malicious bullying, and a scandal erupted...?

strings.text: 恐らくは父親の出世にも相当響くだろう
strings.translated: It would likely deal a considerable blow to her father's career prospects as well.

strings.text: 湯沢さんは私のいわんとしたことを、しっかりと把握したようだった
strings.translated: It seemed Yuzawa-san had grasped precisely what I was getting at.

strings.text: 紗英子「…この映像を見たのは今のところあなたと私だけよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「...As of now, only you and I have seen this footage.

strings.text: できれば大事にはしたくないの
strings.translated: I'd prefer not to make a big deal of this if I can help it.」

strings.text: 舞子「生徒会長が……生徒会長ともあろうものがこんなことをしていいんですか？
strings.translated: Maiko「The student council president... is it really acceptable for someone in the position of student council president to do something like this?」

strings.text: 舞子「女子トイレに監視カメラなんて、それこそバレたら大変なことになるんじゃないですか？
strings.translated: Maiko「Setting up a surveillance camera in the girls' restroom -- wouldn't that itself be a huge problem if it came out?」

strings.text: 紗英子「これを私が撮ったという証拠はある？
strings.translated: Saeko「Is there any proof that I was the one who filmed this?

strings.text: たとえばあなたは今この会話を録音していたりするのかしら？
strings.translated: For instance -- are you recording this conversation right now?

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたがそう証言したとして…皆はここでクラスメイトを暴行しているあなたと、醜聞のない私、どちらを信じると思う？
strings.translated: Saeko「Even if you testified to that... do you think people would believe you -- someone caught on camera assaulting a classmate -- or me, with no scandal to my name?」

strings.text: 紗英子「それにこれ、ちゃんと個室は映らないようになっているの。
strings.translated: Saeko「Besides, this was set up so that the stalls themselves aren't visible.

strings.text: 多分、内容を考えたら、盗撮なんて些細な問題だと判断されるでしょうね」
strings.translated: I think, given the content, people would judge that a little voyeurism is a trivial concern.」

strings.text: 非難の言葉が向けられることは想定の範囲内だった。
strings.translated: The criticism directed at me was within the range of what I'd anticipated.

strings.text: でも、それを跳ね返し、覆すのに充分な材料が私の手元には存分にある
strings.translated: But I had more than enough material in hand to deflect it and turn it around.

strings.text: 紗英子「引き返すなら今のうちよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「If you're going to turn back, now is the time.

strings.text: 良く考えて
strings.translated: Think carefully.」

strings.text: 紗英子「話はこれでおしまい。
strings.translated: Saeko「That's all I have to say.

strings.text: 帰っていいわ
strings.translated: You can go.」

strings.text: 舞子「……失礼します
strings.translated: Maiko「...Excuse me.」

strings.text: 今日の作業を終えて、私は学校を出た。
strings.translated: With the day's work finished, I left the school.

strings.text: 毎日細かい作業があるから生徒会長も楽じゃない。
strings.translated: There's always some minor task or another to deal with every day -- being student council president is no easy thing.

strings.text: それも、誰にでもできるような些末な事務仕事ばかり。
strings.translated: And it's all trivial administrative work that anyone could handle.

strings.text: この実績が後に役立つことを知っているから続けているけど、正直私にとって、やりがいのある仕事とは言えなかった。
strings.translated: I keep at it because I know this track record will serve me later, but honestly, I couldn't call it fulfilling work.

strings.text: 特に今日のような話は二度と聞きたくない。
strings.translated: Especially conversations like today's -- I never want to have one of those again.

strings.text: いじめなんてくだらない行為は、本当にこれで終わってほしかった。
strings.translated: I truly hoped this would be the end of something as pathetic as bullying.

strings.text: 何だか身体が重かった。
strings.translated: My body felt strangely heavy.

strings.text: 足が前に進まなくて、このまままっすぐ家には帰りたくなかった。
strings.translated: My feet wouldn't carry me forward, and I had no desire to go straight home.

strings.text: 家に帰れば予習だのなんだのと、普通の日常に追われることになる。
strings.translated: Going home meant being swept up in the ordinary routine of prep work and whatever else.

strings.text: それが嫌いだというわけではないけど、私にだって気分の乗らない日はあった。
strings.translated: It wasn't that I disliked it, but even I had days when I just wasn't in the mood.

strings.text: こういう時は、そんなストレスを発散することが必要だ。
strings.translated: At times like these, I needed to let off steam.

strings.text: 身体と心に安らぎが必要だ。
strings.translated: My body and mind needed rest.

strings.text: そのための場所を、私は既に得ていた
strings.translated: I had already found a place for exactly that.

strings.text: 紗英子「今日は寄って行こうかしら」
strings.translated: Saeko「Maybe I'll stop by today.」

strings.text: 私に許された、ストレスを発散するための場所。
strings.translated: The place I was permitted -- a place where I could unwind and let off steam.

strings.text: そういう利用の仕方ができる場所が、今の私にあることが安らぎと癒しの根源にもなっていた
strings.translated: The very fact that I now had such a place was itself a source of comfort and healing.

strings.text: 紗英子「失礼します」
strings.translated: Saeko「Excuse me.」

strings.text: クラブの部屋に入って、私は誰にも目を合わせずに挨拶をした。
strings.translated: I stepped into the Club's room and offered a greeting without making eye contact with anyone.

strings.text: 普段、多忙な私が唯一安らげる場所。
strings.translated: The one place where I, perpetually busy, could truly relax.

strings.text: この場所を知らなければ、私の生活はもっと息の詰まるものになっていただろう
strings.translated: Without this place, my life would have been far more suffocating.

strings.text: 紗英子「ふぅ…」
strings.translated: Saeko「Huu...」

strings.text: 椅子に座って深い溜息をつく。
strings.translated: I sat down in a chair and let out a long sigh.

strings.text: 今日のことを思い出すだけで、身体がどっと疲れてしまった。
strings.translated: Just thinking back on today's events made my body feel utterly drained.

strings.text: こんな日は、クラブで静かに本を読むに限る。
strings.translated: On days like this, there's nothing better than sitting quietly in the Club and reading a book.

strings.text: そうしているうちに、きっと誰かが声をかけて来るだろう。
strings.translated: While I do that, someone will surely come and talk to me.

strings.text: そうすれば暇を潰すことができる。
strings.translated: That way I can pass the time.

strings.text: 無駄な時間を過ごさずに済む。
strings.translated: And I won't have to spend it wasted and alone.

strings.text: 私にとってクラブは、そうやって過ごせる場所になっていた。
strings.translated: The Club had become a place where I could spend my time that way.

strings.text: クラブ男性「紗英子、また難しい本読んでるのか？」
strings.translated: Club Man「Saeko, are you reading another difficult book?」

strings.text: 私が思っていた通り、１人の男が声をかけてきた。
strings.translated: Just as I had expected, one of the men came over to talk to me.

strings.text: 顔見知りの相手で、もう何度もセックスをしたことがある男だ
strings.translated: He was someone I recognized -- a man I had already slept with many times.

strings.text: 紗英子「難しくはないわよ」
strings.translated: Saeko「It's not difficult at all.」

strings.text: クラブ男性「本を読むのもいいけど、せっかくここに来たんだ。
strings.translated: Club Man「Reading is all well and good, but you came all the way here.

strings.text: 一緒に楽しまないか？」
strings.translated: Why not enjoy yourself with me?」

strings.text: 彼の言葉の意味はわかってる。
strings.translated: I understood what he meant by that.

strings.text: 私もそれを望んでいたから…。
strings.translated: And I wanted it too, so...

strings.text: ここでなら、私は本当の姿になれる。
strings.translated: Here, I could be my true self.

strings.text: 堅苦しい生徒会長じゃなくて、１人の女として扱ってもらえる。
strings.translated: Not the stiff student council president -- I could be treated as just one woman.

strings.text: 自らの身体を弄ばせ、また、私自身を弄び、淫らで卑しい快楽を求めても、誰にも咎められることはない。
strings.translated: Letting my body be toyed with, toying with myself in turn, chasing lewd and shameless pleasure -- no one here would fault me for it.

strings.text: だから、私はここに来るのだった
strings.translated: That was why I came here.

strings.text: 紗英子「いいわよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「All right.

strings.text: しましょうか
strings.translated: Shall we?」

strings.text: 紗英子「その代わり…ちゃんと満足させてね
strings.translated: Saeko「But in return... make sure you satisfy me properly.」

strings.text: 男との行為が終わって、私は短く溜息を漏らした。
strings.translated: When it was over with the man, I let out a short sigh.

strings.text: それなりに満足感は得てるはずなのに、行為が終わるといつも不満のようなものが残ってしまう。
strings.translated: I should have felt reasonably satisfied, yet whenever it ended, something like dissatisfaction always lingered.

strings.text: 新鮮味が薄れているというか、面白味がないというか…。
strings.translated: The novelty had worn thin, or perhaps it had simply lost its appeal...

strings.text: とにかく、最近は本当の意味で満足できることが減っていた。
strings.translated: In any case, lately the moments of true satisfaction had been growing fewer and fewer.

strings.text: なんともいえない満たされきれていない気持ちを抱いたまま、私はまた読書へと戻った。
strings.translated: Carrying that vague, unfulfilled feeling with me, I returned to my book.

strings.text: 実際のところ、最近は迷いが生じている。
strings.translated: Truth be told, I had been feeling uncertain lately.

strings.text: クラブに来るのは新鮮味があったけど、それも最初ほどのものではない。
strings.translated: Coming to the Club had once felt fresh, but it no longer held the same appeal it did at first.

strings.text: ここを知った当初は、楽しい遊び場を見つけたと思っていたけど、セックスの回数を重ねるたびに疑問が生じてきていた。
strings.translated: When I first learned of this place, I thought I had found a wonderful playground -- but with each time I had sex, doubts began to creep in.

strings.text: セックスは確かに気持ちいい。
strings.translated: Sex certainly feels good.

strings.text: 身体も心も満たされた時間を味わうことができる。
strings.translated: There are moments when both body and heart feel truly fulfilled.

strings.text: でも、最近は満たされたと思っても、すぐに渇きを感じるようになっていた。
strings.translated: But lately, even when I thought I was satisfied, I would feel thirsty again almost immediately.

strings.text: …私はどうすればいいのだろう？
strings.translated: What am I supposed to do?

strings.text: このまま…こんな気持ちのまま、クラブに通い続けていいのだろうか。
strings.translated: Is it really all right for me to keep coming to the Club... feeling like this?

strings.text: そんな疑問に対する答えは、もう何週間も見つからないままだった
strings.translated: An answer to that question had eluded me for weeks now.

strings.text: すべての始まりは１年ほど前だった。
strings.translated: It had all begun about a year ago.

strings.text: 当時の私は会長としての生徒会の活動も、学校の勉強もそつなくこなしながら、それでいて訳もなく満たされない感覚を覚えていた。
strings.translated: Back then, I was managing both my student council duties as president and my schoolwork without any trouble -- and yet, for no clear reason, I felt a persistent sense of emptiness.

strings.text: なにか気分転換でも…と思って色々なことを試してはみたけれど、どれもこれも今ひとつ私を満たしてくれるようなことではなかった。
strings.translated: Thinking I needed some kind of change of pace, I tried various things, but none of them quite filled me up.

strings.text: 平凡な日々の中、淡々と波風も立てず過ごしていることに退屈していたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps I had grown bored with drifting through ordinary days, keeping the waters calm, never stirring up a wave.

strings.text: 困難というほどの困難もなく、障害といえるような問題もなく、そんな日々が単調に繰り返されていくような、そんな変化のない日々。
strings.translated: No hardship worthy of the name, no problem that could be called an obstacle -- just the same monotonous days repeating themselves, one after another, with no change in sight.

strings.text: おかげさまで…とでもいったらいいのだろうか、学業の成績は常に優秀だったし、生徒会での信頼も厚かった。
strings.translated: Thanks to that -- if that's even the right way to put it -- my academic results were always excellent, and I had earned deep trust within the student council.

strings.text: そんな私に対する先生や周りの生徒達からの評判も悪いものではなかった。
strings.translated: The reputation I had among teachers and fellow students was not a bad one.

strings.text: ある種、周りの誰もが羨むような生活を送っていたともいえるかもしれない。
strings.translated: In a sense, I might have been living the kind of life anyone around me would have envied.

strings.text: でも…それが有り体にいえばつまらなかったし、もどかしくすらあった。
strings.translated: But... to put it plainly, it was dull, and even a little frustrating.

strings.text: そんな、ある日、私はなにをするでもなく、たださまようように街中を歩いていた
strings.translated: Then, one day, with nothing particular to do, I found myself wandering aimlessly through the city streets.

strings.text: 紗英子「くだらない…」
strings.translated: Saeko「How tedious...」

strings.text: 街には様々な人がいた。
strings.translated: The city was full of all kinds of people.

strings.text: 会社帰りのサラリーマン。
strings.translated: Salarymen on their way home from work.

strings.text: 夕食の買い物をしている主婦。
strings.translated: Housewives out shopping for dinner.

strings.text: 腕を組んで歩くカップル。
strings.translated: Couples walking arm in arm.

strings.text: みんな毎日が充実していそうに思えて、私はただただいらだっていた。
strings.translated: Everyone seemed to be living such fulfilling lives, and it only made me more and more irritated.

strings.text: 意識しようとしまいと、視界に入ってくる他人の姿に興味も持てず、なぜか不満げになってしまっていた。
strings.translated: Whether I tried to notice them or not, the strangers drifting into my field of vision held no interest for me -- and for some reason, I found myself growing resentful.

strings.text: あの会社員は、なにか満たされることがあるのだろうか？
strings.translated: Does that office worker have anything in his life that truly satisfies him?

strings.text: あの主婦は、どうしてあんなに穏やかにしてられるんだろうか？
strings.translated: How can that housewife look so at peace with herself?

strings.text: あのカップルは、どうしてあんなに幸せそうにしてられるんだろうか？
strings.translated: How can that couple look so happy?

strings.text: 仕事に充実感を覚え、それで満たされているのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps they find fulfillment in their work, and that is enough to satisfy them.

strings.text: 自分の家庭に安らぎと充実感を覚え、それで穏やかにしていられるのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps they find comfort and contentment in their home life, and that is what keeps them so calm.

strings.text: お互いに一緒に過ごす時間が楽しくて、それが幸せに感じられるのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps they simply enjoy the time they spend together, and that is what feels like happiness to them.

strings.text: でも、本当にそうなんだろうか？
strings.translated: But is that really true?

strings.text: やはり彼らも実は私のように満たされていないのではないのだろうか？
strings.translated: Surely, deep down, they are just as unfulfilled as I am -- aren't they?

strings.text: 満たされているのなら羨ましい、とは思いはしても、それが本当に満たされているという保証もなく、私にそれを確かめる術はない。
strings.translated: I might feel envious if they truly are fulfilled, but there is no guarantee that they really are, and I have no way of knowing for certain.

strings.text: 彼らのような平凡な人生…流れに身を任せるだけの、負け犬のような人生は送りたくない。
strings.translated: A life like theirs -- ordinary, adrift, just going along with the current -- a loser's life like that is not one I want to live.

strings.text: 内心、そんな他人の不幸を望むようなことを頭に過ぎらせてしまったことも、また別の苛立たしさを沸きあがらせてくる。
strings.translated: The fact that such thoughts had crossed my mind -- wishing misfortune on strangers -- stirred up yet another layer of irritation within me.

strings.text: もっと、誰にもできないような事をして、本当の意味での充実感を得たい。
strings.translated: I want to do something no one else could do, and find true fulfillment in the deepest sense of the word.

strings.text: と、そんなことをぼんやりと考えながら、宛もなく私は歩き続けていた
strings.translated: Turning those vague thoughts over in my mind, I kept walking with nowhere in particular to go.

strings.text: 男性「ねぇ、そこの君。
strings.translated: Man「Hey, you there.

strings.text: どこ行くの？
strings.translated: Where are you headed?」

strings.text: 人がいらだちを紛らわせようとしている最中、そんなことを思いも寄らないだろう誰かが私に話しかけてきた。
strings.translated: While I was trying to shake off my irritation, someone who could never have imagined what I was feeling spoke to me.

strings.text: 見るからに軽そうな男。
strings.translated: A man who looked frivolous at a glance.

strings.text: 優しく声をかけたふりをして、私の体を目的としているのが顔に滲み出ていた。
strings.translated: Pretending to speak to me kindly, his true intentions -- my body -- were written all over his face.

strings.text: 本当にくだらない生物。
strings.translated: What a truly pathetic creature.

strings.text: 私と同じ人間だなんて、とても思うことができない。
strings.translated: I cannot bring myself to believe he belongs to the same species as me.

strings.text: だから、私はかけられた声に応えることもせずに、そのまま歩みを進める。
strings.translated: So I gave no answer to his call and simply kept walking.

strings.text: 男性「あっ、ちょっと待ってよ」
strings.translated: Man「Hey, wait a moment.」

strings.text: 無視をして歩き出すと、男がしつこく寄って来た。
strings.translated: When I ignored him and started walking away, the man persistently came after me.

strings.text: 関わるつもりはないという意思表示のつもりだったのに、この人はそんなことさえわかってくれないのだろうか？
strings.translated: I had meant it as a clear signal that I wanted nothing to do with him -- could he really not even understand that much?

strings.text: ここで返事をしてしまうと、大なり小なりくだらない時間を過ごす羽目になるかもしれない、という思いから私はその人の声に応えようとはしなかった。
strings.translated: My reason for not responding to his voice was the thought that if I did, I might end up stuck wasting my time with him, to one degree or another.

strings.text: 男性「おいおい、話くらいしてくれてもいいだろ？
strings.translated: Man「Come on, is it really so hard to just talk to me?

strings.text: 一緒に遊ぼうぜぇ～」
strings.translated: Come hang out with me~」

strings.text: 遊び…？
strings.translated: Hang out...?

strings.text: いい歳したこの人と私が、なにをして遊ぶというのだろう？
strings.translated: What exactly did this grown man think he and I were going to do together?

strings.text: と、自問してみて心の中で溜め息を吐く。
strings.translated: I asked myself that, then let out a quiet sigh inside my heart.

strings.text: そんな答え、わかりきっているじゃない、と。
strings.translated: Because I already knew the answer perfectly well.

strings.text: すでに通り過ぎていた問題じゃない、と。
strings.translated: Wasn't this a problem I had already moved past?

strings.text: だとすれば、こんな男に易々と身体を許すほど、私は軽い女に見られたんだろうか？
strings.translated: If so, did he see me as the kind of woman who would so easily give her body to a man like this?

strings.text: そう思いいたると、ますます苛立ちが募ってきた。
strings.translated: The moment that thought hit me, my irritation only grew worse.

strings.text: もう、それは苦痛といっても差し支えがないほどだった。
strings.translated: By now, it was bad enough that calling it genuine pain would not have been an exaggeration.

strings.text: 男性「待てって。
strings.translated: Man「Wait up.

strings.text: マジで待てって
strings.translated: Seriously, wait up.

strings.text: 紗英子「…っ！」
strings.translated: Saeko「...!」

strings.text: 言葉だけで私が足を止めないことを理解すると、男は図々しくも肩に手をかけてきた。
strings.translated: When he realized words alone wouldn't stop me, the man brazenly reached out and put his hand on my shoulder.

strings.text: 汚らわしい。
strings.translated: Disgusting.

strings.text: こんな男に触れられるだけでも、不快感が募る
strings.translated: Just being touched by a man like this was enough to make my revulsion grow.

strings.text: 私は、仕方なく軽く手で払い、足早に歩いてその場を離れようとした。
strings.translated: I had no choice but to brush his hand away lightly and try to walk away quickly.

strings.text: しかし、男はそれでもしつこく追って来た
strings.translated: But the man persisted and followed after me.

strings.text: 男性「何だよ。
strings.translated: Man「What's your problem.

strings.text: お高く止まってんじゃねーよ
strings.translated: Don't act so high and mighty.」

strings.text: 紗英子「痛っ！」
strings.translated: Saeko「Ow!」

strings.text: 男が強く腕を握ってきた。
strings.translated: The man grabbed my arm hard.

strings.text: 顔には怒った表情が浮かんでいて、どうやら彼の本性が見えてきたようだった。
strings.translated: An angry expression had risen on his face -- it seemed his true nature was finally showing itself.

strings.text: こういうこともあるか…。
strings.translated: So this is how it goes...

strings.text: と、痛みを感じながらも諦観してしまう。
strings.translated: Even as the pain registered, I found myself resigning to it.

strings.text: でも、そうやって諦観しているだけでは、この場は収まりそうにもなかった
strings.translated: But simply resigning myself like that wasn't going to resolve the situation.

strings.text: 紗英子「放しなさい」
strings.translated: Saeko「Let go of me.」

strings.text: 男性「ちょっと付き合ってくれればいいんだよ。
strings.translated: Man「Just hang out with me for a bit.

strings.text: どうせ暇なんだろ？」
strings.translated: You're free anyway, right?」

strings.text: やっと私から言葉をかけられた男が、こっちの気分なんてまったく介さない言葉を発する。
strings.translated: The man, finally having gotten a word out of me, said something with no regard for how I felt whatsoever.

strings.text: 暇ではない、といえば嘘になるかもしれないけど、こんな男に割くような時間はもったいなく感じられた
strings.translated: Saying I wasn't free would have been a lie, perhaps -- but spending any time on a man like this felt like a waste.

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたほど暇じゃないわ
strings.translated: Saeko「I'm not nearly as free as you are.」

strings.text: 男性「うわっ！」
strings.translated: Man「Whoa!」

strings.text: 大きく腕を振って、男の手を再び払いのけた。
strings.translated: I swung my arm wide and knocked his hand away again.

strings.text: こういった生物には、どう言えば自分の行為が無駄だって理解してもらえるのか。
strings.translated: How does one explain to a creature like this that what he's doing is pointless?

strings.text: 果たして、この愚者の処遇をどうするべきか。
strings.translated: What was the right way to deal with this fool?

strings.text: 悲鳴でも上げて襲われた女を演じてみるか、それとも警察に突き出してみるか。
strings.translated: Should I scream and play the part of a woman being attacked, or drag him to the police?

strings.text: そんな風にどうすればいいかを考えていると、不意に私の背後から聞き覚えのある声が聞こえた
strings.translated: As I was turning over my options, I suddenly heard a familiar voice from behind me.

strings.text: 瑛「どうかした？
strings.translated: Akira「Something wrong?」

strings.text: 紗英子「あ…」
strings.translated: Saeko「Ah...」

strings.text: その声に振りかえると、そこには私がよく知っている姿があった
strings.translated: I turned toward that voice, and there stood a figure I knew well.

strings.text: 瑛「彼女のお知り合いですか？」
strings.translated: Akira「Are you acquainted with her?」

strings.text: そこに立っていたのは…幼なじみで、同じ生徒会の副会長をしている瑛さんだった。
strings.translated: Standing there was... Akira, my childhood friend and the vice president of the student council.

strings.text: そして、彼の隣には知らない男性が立っていて、静かな目で私と、私に絡んできた男のことを見つめていた
strings.translated: And beside him stood a man I didn't recognize, watching me and the man who had been harassing me with calm, quiet eyes.

strings.text: 園田「失礼。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Pardon the intrusion.

strings.text: どうやらお困りのようだが…そこの君、彼女とはどういう関係かな？
strings.translated: It looks like you're in some difficulty... You there -- what is your relationship with this young lady?」

strings.text: おっさんには関係ねーだろ」
strings.translated: Stay out of it.」

strings.text: ２人の男性に話し掛けられて、男は怯んだようだった。
strings.translated: Being addressed by the two men seemed to make him flinch.

strings.text: 睨むような表情は浮かべているものの、その場から数歩後ずさりした。
strings.translated: Though his face still wore a glaring expression, he took a few steps back.

strings.text: 強がっているつもりなのかもしれないけど、余裕がないのは明らかだ。
strings.translated: He might have thought he was putting on a brave front, but it was obvious he had no composure left.

strings.text: そんな男の怯んだ姿に、少しだけ私は安堵する
strings.translated: Seeing him falter like that, I felt just a small measure of relief.

strings.text: 瑛「僕は彼女の友達なんですけど、何か話があるのなら僕が聞きますよ」
strings.translated: Akira「I'm a friend of hers -- if you have something to say, I'll hear you out.」

strings.text: 男性「野郎に話なんかねーんだよ
strings.translated: Man「I've got nothing to say to some guy.」

strings.text: 園田「しかし、彼女は君と話すつもりはないようだ。
strings.translated: Sonoda「However, it appears she has no intention of speaking with you.

strings.text: ここは、大人しく別の相手を捜したほうが良いのではないかな？」
