strings.translated: Wouldn't it be wiser to quietly go and find someone else?」

strings.text: 男性「言われなくたってそーするってのっ！
strings.translated: Man「I was gonna do that anyway!」

strings.text: この状況で私を誘うのは無理だと判断したようで、男は小走りに人ごみの中に消えていった。
strings.translated: He seemed to have concluded that trying to pick me up in this situation was hopeless, and the man disappeared into the crowd at a half-run.

strings.text: 正直、助かった、と思った。
strings.translated: Honestly, I felt relieved.

strings.text: 瑛さんとこの男性が声をかけてくれなくても、どうにかできていたかもしれないけど、手間が省けたのには間違いない。
strings.translated: Even without Akira and this man stepping in, I might have managed on my own -- but there was no doubt they had saved me the trouble.

strings.text: それに、こうやって助けてもらえたことに、その善意に感謝できないほど、私も馬鹿ではなかった
strings.translated: And I wasn't foolish enough to be unable to feel grateful for the kindness of people who had helped me like this.

strings.text: 瑛「紗英子ちゃん、大丈夫？
strings.translated: Akira「Saeko-chan, are you all right?」

strings.text: 紗英子「ええ…」
strings.translated: Saeko「Yes...」

strings.text: 瑛さんと隣の男性に感謝はしていたけど、なんとなくそのことを素直に口に出せなかった。
strings.translated: I was grateful to Akira and the man beside him, but somehow I couldn't bring myself to say it plainly.

strings.text: そして、そんな私の頭にあったのは純粋な疑問だった。
strings.translated: And what occupied my mind then was a simple, genuine question.

strings.text: 瑛さんと一緒にいるこの男の人は誰なのだろう？
strings.translated: Who was this man standing alongside Akira?

strings.text: 学校の先生ではないし、瑛さんのお父さんでもない。
strings.translated: He wasn't a teacher from school, and he wasn't Akira's father either.

strings.text: 今まであったこともない男性だ
strings.translated: He was someone I had never met before.

strings.text: 瑛「こんなところにいるなんて珍しいね。
strings.translated: Akira「It's unusual to see you out here.

strings.text: いつも学校が終わったら真っ直ぐ帰るのに
strings.translated: You always go straight home after school.」

strings.text: 紗英子「別に…気分転換に散歩していただけよ
strings.translated: Saeko「It's nothing... I was just taking a walk to clear my head.」

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたこそ、こんなところで何をしているの？
strings.translated: Saeko「What about you -- what are you doing in a place like this?」

strings.text: そういいながら、隣にいた男性に目を向けた。
strings.translated: As she said that, she turned her gaze toward the man standing beside him.

strings.text: 瑛さんも寄り道をするタイプではないはずだから、こんなところにいるのは意外だった。
strings.translated: Akira wasn't the type to wander around, so seeing him in a place like this was unexpected.

strings.text: それに、隣にいる男性が誰なのか？
strings.translated: And then there was the question of who the man beside him was.

strings.text: そのことにも興味がない訳じゃなかった
strings.translated: I wasn't without curiosity about that, either.

strings.text: 瑛「こちらは僕がお世話になってる塾の先生で、園田さんって言うんだ」
strings.translated: Akira「This is a teacher from the cram school I've been attending -- his name is Sonoda-san.」

strings.text: 私の視線に気づいたようで、尋ねるより先に瑛さんが答えてくれた。
strings.translated: He seemed to notice where I was looking and answered before I even had to ask.

strings.text: でも、彼が塾に通ってるなんて話は初耳だったから、私はますます意外だった
strings.translated: But I had never heard anything about Akira going to a cram school, which made it all the more surprising.

strings.text: 園田と言います
strings.translated: My name is Sonoda.」

strings.text: 紗英子「…初めまして」
strings.translated: Saeko「...How do you do.」

strings.text: 園田という男性が手を差し出して来たので、私はとりあえず握手に応じてみせる。
strings.translated: The man named Sonoda extended his hand, so I went ahead and shook it.

strings.text: 流石に助けてくれた方に失礼はできない。
strings.translated: I couldn't very well be rude to someone who had just helped me.

strings.text: それにこれ位の社交性は身に備えているつもりだ。
strings.translated: And I like to think I have at least that much social grace.

strings.text: ましてや瑛さんがお世話になっている人でもあるんだったら、≪無碍／むげ≫に扱うこともできない
strings.translated: All the more so since this was someone Akira was indebted to -- I couldn't treat him dismissively.

strings.text: 園田「菱木紗英子さんだね。
strings.translated: Sonoda「You're Hishiki Saeko-san, aren't you.

strings.text: いつも瑛君から話は聞いているよ
strings.translated: I've heard about you from Akira-kun many times.」

strings.text: 紗英子「いつも…？」
strings.translated: Saeko「Always...?」

strings.text: 口には出さなかったが、不快感を覚える話だった。
strings.translated: I didn't say it aloud, but it was a story that left me feeling unsettled.

strings.text: 私の知らないところで、私の知らない男性に何を話していると言うのか…。
strings.translated: What on earth was he telling this man I didn't know, behind my back...

strings.text: でも、昔からの友達で、学校でも生徒会なんかで一緒にいる時間も長いから、自然と会話の中に私のことが話題として出ているだけかもしれない。
strings.translated: But we had been friends for a long time, and we spent a lot of time together at school through student council and the like, so perhaps my name simply came up naturally in conversation.

strings.text: だとしたら、それを一方的に悪し様に断ずるのもいいことではない、と少し反省する
strings.translated: If that was the case, it wasn't right of me to condemn it so one-sidedly -- I caught myself and reflected a little.

strings.text: 瑛「うん…。
strings.translated: Akira「Yeah...

strings.text: ごめんね。
strings.translated: Sorry.

strings.text: 園田先生にはいろいろと相談に乗っていただいてるんだ
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei has been kind enough to hear me out about a lot of things.」

strings.text: 瑛「でも、すごくいいところだし、信頼のおける方だから」
strings.translated: Akira「But it's a really good place, and he's someone you can trust.」

strings.text: 瑛さんが「相談したいこと」
strings.translated: When Akira said there was「something he wanted to talk about,」

strings.text: と言えば、私には一つしか思い浮かばない。
strings.translated: only one thing came to mind for me.

strings.text: まだ私にすら打ち明けてくれない瑛さんの秘密……。
strings.translated: Akira's secret -- the one he still hadn't confided even to me...

strings.text: それをこの男に打ち明けたというのだろうか？
strings.translated: Was he saying he had confided that to this man?

strings.text: 紗英子「塾の先生に？
strings.translated: Saeko「To a cram school teacher?

strings.text: …瑛さんが塾に通っているって話は初めて聞いたけど」
strings.translated: This is the first I've heard of Akira attending a cram school.」

strings.text: 思えば塾というところにも違和感を覚える。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, the cram school itself felt off to me.

strings.text: 瑛さんほどの学力だったら、あらためて塾に通うような必要はないだろうし、そんな必要があるのならご両親が家庭教師でも用意してくださるだろう。
strings.translated: With Akira's level of academic ability, there would be no need to attend a cram school, and if there were, his parents would surely arrange a private tutor.

strings.text: でも、ご両親にそんな様子もなかったし、瑛さんが塾に通うということも聞いてはいなかった。
strings.translated: But I had seen no sign of that from his parents, and I had never heard of Akira going to a cram school.

strings.text: なんだか、わざと隠し事をされたような気分になって、さっきの不信感に少しだけ不快感が上積みされてしまう。
strings.translated: I felt a vague sense of having been deliberately kept in the dark, and that feeling of distrust from before was now layered with a small additional irritation.

strings.text: 別に…そう、別に私に塾に通うということを話さなくてもよかったかもしれないけど、かといって教えてくれたってよかったのに、と
strings.translated: It wasn't that... no, it wasn't as though he had to tell me about going to a cram school -- but still, he could have mentioned it, I thought.

strings.text: 瑛「うん。
strings.translated: Akira「Okay.

strings.text: ちょっと…事情があってね。
strings.translated: There are... circumstances. It's a bit complicated.

strings.text: 塾って言っても、課外サークルみたいなものっていうか…。
strings.translated: It's called a cram school, but it's more like an extracurricular club, really...

strings.text: 費用もかからないし、詳しい事は二人には言ってないんだ」
strings.translated: There's no cost involved, and I haven't told either of you the details.」

strings.text: 費用のかからない課外サークル？
strings.translated: An extracurricular club with no cost?

strings.text: その在り方に怪しさを感じてしまう。
strings.translated: Something about the whole setup felt suspicious to me.

strings.text: でも、瑛さんが進んで通っているなら、そんなに怪しいところでもないのかもしれない。
strings.translated: But if Akira was attending of his own accord, maybe it wasn't so suspicious after all.

strings.text: そんな相反する思いが私の胸の内に交錯する
strings.translated: Those conflicting feelings swirled around inside my chest.

strings.text: 瑛「っていっても、怪しい所じゃないんだよ。
strings.translated: Akira「That said, it's not a shady place or anything.

strings.text: 本当に…園田先生に出会えてよかったって思ってて…」
strings.translated: Honestly... I'm really glad I got to meet Sonoda-sensei...」

strings.text: そういわれて、ふと、思ったことがあった。
strings.translated: Hearing that, something suddenly occurred to me.

strings.text: 最近の瑛さんは、ときおり見せていた悩んでいる様子をあまり見せなくなっていたし、ある種、吹っ切れたような感じすらしていた。
strings.translated: Lately, Akira had stopped showing the troubled expression he used to let slip from time to time -- in fact, he even seemed to have found some kind of resolution.

strings.text: そのことを気にしていた私にとっても、それはいい傾向だと思えていた。
strings.translated: For me, who had been worried about that, it seemed like a good sign.

strings.text: それが、その「塾」
strings.translated: And that was thanks to this "cram school" --

strings.text: のおかげだったとしたら…？
strings.translated: what if it was all thanks to that?

strings.text: 園田「もしよかったら、君も一度来てみてはどうかな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「If you'd like, why not come by once?

strings.text: 見学はいつでも歓迎するよ
strings.translated: Observers are always welcome.

strings.text: 瑛「えっ、紗英子ちゃんも…？
strings.translated: Akira「Eh, Saeko-chan too...?」

strings.text: 紗英子「私が行くと不都合なことでもあるのかしら？
strings.translated: Saeko「Is there something inconvenient about me coming?」

strings.text: 瑛「そういうわけじゃないけど…」
strings.translated: Akira「That's not really it, but...」

strings.text: 瑛さんが、言葉をにごしたのがはっきりとわかった
strings.translated: It was plain to see that Akira was being evasive.

strings.text: なにか瑛さんは、その「塾」
strings.translated: Was there something about that "tutoring session"

strings.text: に隠したいことでもあるのだろうか？
strings.translated: that Akira wanted to keep hidden?

strings.text: だったら
strings.translated: In that case --

strings.text: 紗英子「これからでも構いませんか？」
strings.translated: Saeko「Would it be all right if we went now?」

strings.text: 私は、瑛さんが言葉をにごした意味がなんだったのかも確かめたくて、園田という男の誘いに乗ることにした
strings.translated: I decided to take Sonoda up on his offer -- partly because I wanted to find out what Akira had meant by being evasive.

strings.text: 園田「ああ、もちろん。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Of course.

strings.text: 大歓迎だ
strings.translated: You're more than welcome.」

strings.text: そして、私達３人は、その塾へと向けて歩き出した。
strings.translated: And so the three of us set off toward the cram school.

strings.text: でも、なんだか瑛さんは居心地悪そうにしている。
strings.translated: But Akira looked distinctly uncomfortable.

strings.text: そんな瑛さんを見ていると、悪いことをしたかな、という気がしなくもなかった。
strings.translated: Watching him like that, I couldn't help feeling a little guilty.

strings.text: 特に会話もなく歩いて行く私達。
strings.translated: We walked in silence, none of us saying much.

strings.text: そんな中、瑛さんが意を決したように私へと耳打ちしてきた
strings.translated: Then, as if steeling himself, Akira leaned over and whispered in my ear.

strings.text: 瑛「今まで黙っていてごめんね。
strings.translated: Akira「I'm sorry for keeping this from you all this time.

strings.text: でも僕は園田先生に出会って…今まで誰にも言えなかった悩みを打ち明けることができて
strings.translated: But meeting Sonoda-sensei... I was finally able to open up about worries I couldn't tell anyone before.」

strings.text: 瑛「紗英子ちゃんに来てほしくないわけじゃないんだ。
strings.translated: Akira「It's not that I don't want you here, Saeko-chan.

strings.text: ただ…それを知られるのが少し、怖くて
strings.translated: It's just... I was a little scared of you finding out.」

strings.text: 瑛「…でも、紗英子ちゃんにも理解してもらえたら嬉しい
strings.translated: Akira「...But I'd be happy if you could understand too, Saeko-chan.」

strings.text: 紗英子「…ええ
strings.translated: Saeko「...Yes.」

strings.text: 瑛さんの悩み。
strings.translated: Akira's worries.

strings.text: 誰にも、私にもいえなかった悩み。
strings.translated: Worries he couldn't tell anyone -- not even me.

strings.text: それを私はしらないふりをしていた。
strings.translated: I had been pretending not to know.

strings.text: ずっと一緒にいて、そのことに気付いてしまっていても、それでも。
strings.translated: Even though we'd been together all this time, and I had noticed... even so.

strings.text: そして…その悩みを瑛さんが最初に打ち明けたのは私ではなかった。
strings.translated: And... when Akira finally opened up about those worries, it wasn't to me first.

strings.text: それは仕方ないことだったのかもしれないけど、でも、瑛さんが最初に打ち明けてくれなかったことが残念に思えて仕方なかった
strings.translated: Perhaps that couldn't be helped -- but I couldn't shake the feeling of disappointment that he hadn't come to me first.

strings.text: 園田「さあ、どうぞ。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Now then, please, come in.

strings.text: まずは私から説明しよう
strings.translated: Let me start with an explanation.」

strings.text: 私が案内された部屋は、ごく普通のビルの一室だった。
strings.translated: The room I was shown into was an ordinary office in an ordinary building.

strings.text: それほど大きくない雑居ビルだから、取り立てて目を引くものはない
strings.translated: It was a fairly small mixed-use building, so there was nothing particularly striking about it.

strings.text: 勧められるままにソファーに腰を下ろす。
strings.translated: Taking the offered seat, I settled onto the sofa.

strings.text: ソファーに腰を下ろしながら、私は部屋の中に漂うお香のようなにおいに違和感を覚えていた
strings.translated: As I did, I became aware of something off about the incense-like smell drifting through the room.

strings.text: 園田「瑛君は今日は課外授業の予定があったね
strings.translated: Sonoda「Akira-kun, you had an extracurricular session scheduled for today, didn't you.」

strings.text: 瑛「はい。
strings.translated: Akira「Yes.

strings.text: 園田「心配しなくても、君の事を勝手に話したりはしないよ。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Don't worry -- I won't go telling her your business without permission.

strings.text: その件は君自身から彼女に伝えたほうがいいだろう
strings.translated: That's something you should tell her yourself.」

strings.text: 瑛「いえ、そうじゃなくて
strings.translated: Akira「No, that's not what I...」

strings.text: 瑛「紗英子ちゃん、一人で平気？
strings.translated: Akira「Saeko-chan, will you be all right on your own?

strings.text: 僕も一緒にいようか？
strings.translated: Should I stay with him too?

strings.text: 紗英子「ちょっと話を聞くだけよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「I'm just going to listen for a bit.

strings.text: 取って食われるわけじゃないわ
strings.translated: It's not like he's going to eat me alive.」

strings.text: 園田「そうとも。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Quite right.

strings.text: ここがどういう場所かは君も良く知っているだろう。
strings.translated: You know well enough what kind of place this is.

strings.text: 私は無理強いをしたりはしないよ
strings.translated: I don't force anything on anyone.」

strings.text: 園田「まずはこの塾の理念を説明して、それに共感する人間だけが自由に利用してくれればいいと考えているんだ
strings.translated: Sonoda「My intention is simply to explain the philosophy of this school first, and then let those who find it meaningful make use of it freely.」

strings.text: 瑛「…はい。
strings.translated: Akira「...Yes.

strings.text: そうですね
strings.translated: That's right.」

strings.text: 瑛「それじゃあ紗英子ちゃん、僕はちょっと用事があるからいくね。
strings.translated: Akira「Well then, Saeko-chan, I have something to take care of, so I'll be going.

strings.text: あとで連絡するから
strings.translated: I'll contact you later.」

strings.text: 紗英子「ええ
strings.translated: Saeko「All right.」

strings.text: 私が応えると、瑛さんは一礼して部屋から出て行ってしまった
strings.translated: When I answered, Akira gave a small bow and left the room.

strings.text: 園田「さてと。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Well then.

strings.text: それじゃあ…何から話そうかな」
strings.translated: So, where should I begin?」

strings.text: 私の対面に腰を下ろした園田さんは、この塾について説明を始めた。
strings.translated: Sonoda settled down across from me and began explaining about this cram school.

strings.text: この塾が誠信明輝塾という名前だということ。
strings.translated: That this cram school was called Seishin Meiki Juku.

strings.text: 塾といっても勉強を教えているという訳ではないということ。
strings.translated: That despite being called a cram school, it wasn't a place where academics were taught.

strings.text: 最初はそんな感じだった。
strings.translated: It started out like that.

strings.text: 私が適当にそれを聞き流していると、園田さんはそのまま説明を続けた。
strings.translated: As I half-listened and let it wash over me, Sonoda continued his explanation.

strings.text: 勉強よりも大切な友愛の精神。
strings.translated: The spirit of fraternity -- more important than any studies.

strings.text: 愛。
strings.translated: Love.

strings.text: 人を助け、人を救える人間を育てていくこと…。
strings.translated: Raising people who could help others, who could save others...

strings.text: 聞けば聞くほど、それは怪しく、偽善者の戯言のようにしか思えないことが並べ立てられていった。
strings.translated: The more I heard, the more it all sounded suspicious -- nothing but the hollow platitudes of a hypocrite, piled one on top of another.

strings.text: …でも、もしかしたらそういう人が瑛さんには必要だったのかもしれない、とも思いいたる。
strings.translated: And yet, I found myself thinking that perhaps someone like that was exactly what Akira needed.

strings.text: そう、瑛さんのことを決して否定せずに受け入れてくれるような人が
strings.translated: Yes -- someone who would accept Akira without ever denying who he was.

strings.text: そんな話を聞いていると、なんだか自分が変調を来していることに気付いた。
strings.translated: As I listened to all of this, I noticed that something was off inside me.

strings.text: この感覚はなんだろう。
strings.translated: What was this feeling?

strings.text: 頭がふわふわするような浮遊感にも似た感覚。
strings.translated: A floating, drifting sensation, as though my head had gone light.

strings.text: しっかりしていないと浮遊感に乗ったまま流されて、意識が遠のいてしまいそうな
strings.translated: If I didn't hold myself together, I felt like I might be swept away on that current, my consciousness fading into the distance --

strings.text: 園田「どうかしたかね？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Is something the matter?」

strings.text: 紗英子「…いえ、何でも
strings.translated: Saeko「...No, it's nothing.」

strings.text: 園田「暑かったかな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Are you warm?

strings.text: エアコンは入っているんだが…少し温度を下げようか
strings.translated: The air conditioning is on, but... perhaps I should lower the temperature a little.

strings.text: 紗英子「いいえ、結構です。
strings.translated: Saeko「No, thank you.

strings.text: 今日はこれで
strings.translated: I think I'll be going now--」

strings.text: これで失礼します。
strings.translated: I'll excuse myself now.

strings.text: その一言の元にソファーから立ち上がろうとしたけれど、言葉も続けられず、身体にも力が入らなくなっていた
strings.translated: I tried to rise from the sofa on those words, but I couldn't finish the sentence, and my body had lost all its strength.

strings.text: 紗英子「っ……何？
strings.translated: Saeko「...Wh-what?

strings.text: 力が
strings.translated: My strength...

strings.text: 園田「大丈夫かい？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Are you all right?」

strings.text: 紗英子「くっ……！
strings.translated: Saeko「Ngh...!」

strings.text: 私は危険を感じながらなんとかソファーから立ち上がる。
strings.translated: I sensed danger and somehow managed to push myself up from the sofa.

strings.text: でも…すぐに身体が崩れるように落ち、また、ソファーへと座り込んでしまった
strings.translated: But... my body immediately crumpled, and I sank back down onto it again.

strings.text: 園田「具合が悪そうだね。
strings.translated: Sonoda「You don't look well.

strings.text: ……ああ、お香のせいかな？
strings.translated: ...Ah, could it be the incense?」

strings.text: 紗英子「お香…？
strings.translated: Saeko「The incense...?」

strings.text: 園田「いつもリラックス効果のあるハーブを焚いているんだが、初めての場合はたまにあるんだ。
strings.translated: Sonoda「I always burn herbs with a relaxing effect, but occasionally this happens with first-time visitors.

strings.text: 申し訳ない
strings.translated: My apologies.」

strings.text: 園田「じっとしていればじきによくなるからね。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Just stay still and you'll feel better soon.

strings.text: どれ…少し楽にしてあげよう
strings.translated: Here... let me help you get a little more comfortable.」

strings.text: そういいながら男が場所を移し、私の隣へと座ってくる。
strings.translated: As he said that, the man shifted and came to sit down beside me.

strings.text: そうなってようやく私は、この園田という男にしてやられたということに気付いた。
strings.translated: Only then did I finally realize -- I had been played by this man called Sonoda.

strings.text: なぜ、瑛さんが私がこの塾へと来ることを暗に拒もうとしたのか。
strings.translated: Why Akira had implicitly tried to stop me from coming to this cram school.

strings.text: その意味にようやく思いいたる。
strings.translated: The meaning of it finally came to me.

strings.text: そして、その考えが正しいのだとすれば…瑛さんは騙されている。
strings.translated: And if that understanding was correct... then Akira was being deceived.

strings.text: そうに違いない。
strings.translated: It had to be.

strings.text: しまった…っ！
strings.translated: Damn...!

strings.text: …と、そう思った時にはもう遅かった。
strings.translated: But by the time I thought that, it was already too late.

strings.text: 今はただ、気付けなかったことと騙されたことへの悔しさが胸中にあふれるばかりだ。
strings.translated: Now all that filled my chest was bitter frustration -- at having failed to notice, at having been deceived.

strings.text: そんな悔しさに苛まれている中、園田が私の身体へと腕を回してきて
strings.translated: Tormented by that frustration, Sonoda wrapped his arm around my body

strings.text: 紗英子「くっ……ぅっ……」
strings.translated: Saeko「Ngh... ugh...」

strings.text: 試しにもう一度、力をこめてみるものの、やっぱり完全に力が入らない。
strings.translated: I tried once more to put some strength into my limbs, but as expected, I couldn't manage it at all.

strings.text: それどころか、無理に身じろぎしようとすると……逆に全身の妙な痺れが強くなってしまうかのようだった。
strings.translated: Worse, whenever I tried to force myself to move... it was as though the strange numbness spreading through my entire body only grew stronger.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「安心しなさい。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「Don't worry.

strings.text: 悪いようにはしないから
strings.translated: I won't do anything to harm you

strings.text: 紗英子「……それは悪いようにする人間の常套句のようなものね。
strings.translated: Saeko「...That sounds exactly like the kind of thing someone who intends to harm you would say.

strings.text: あなたも大人なら下心はもっと隠すべきだと思うわ」
strings.translated: If you're going to call yourself an adult, you should do a better job of hiding your ulterior motives.」

strings.text: ぼうっとしてまとまらない思考のまま、園田の神経を逆撫でるような表情と言動を選び出そうとはしてみる。
strings.translated: With my thoughts hazy and scattered, I tried to choose expressions and words that would grate on Sonoda's nerves.

strings.text: ここでこの園田という男が逆上して騒ぎにでもなれば……という我ながら頼りない悪あがきのようなものだったが……。
strings.translated: If this man called Sonoda were to lose his temper and cause a scene... it was a desperate, feeble gambit even by my own estimation, but...

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「私はね、君も解放してあげようと言うのだよ」
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「I am telling you, I intend to set you free as well.」

strings.text: 園田は眉ひとつも動かさず、相変わらず、一見穏やかな表情を崩さない。
strings.translated: Sonoda didn't so much as twitch an eyebrow, maintaining that outwardly calm expression as always.

strings.text: すっと、彼の手が私の肩に優しげに触れる
strings.translated: Smoothly, his hand came to rest gently on my shoulder

strings.text: 紗英子「うっ……」
strings.translated: Saeko「Ugh...」

strings.text: 構えていたはずなのに、私は声を上げさせられてしまっていた。
strings.translated: I had braced myself, and yet he had still managed to draw a sound out of me.

strings.text: ただ軽く、撫でるように触れられただけだというのに、甘ったるい痺れがそこから波紋のように、急激に全身に広がってくる……。
strings.translated: He had only touched me lightly, like a caress, and yet a syrupy numbness radiated out from that point like ripples on water, spreading rapidly through my entire body...

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「リラックスしなさい。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「Relax.

strings.text: 抗おうとすれば余計につらくなるだけだよ
strings.translated: The more you resist, the harder it will only get for you

strings.text: 紗英子「こんな状況で……くつろげという方が、無理と思わないかしらね……っ！」
strings.translated: Saeko「In a situation like this... do you really think it's possible to just relax...?!」

strings.text: 強がりで発した言葉ではあったが、本心でもあった。
strings.translated: The words came out as bravado, but they were also my honest feelings.

strings.text: 園田の手が撫でるように……肩から二の腕に滑ると、痺れがまたたく間に広がってきていた。
strings.translated: As Sonoda's hand slid caressingly from my shoulder down to my upper arm, the numbness spread in an instant.

strings.text: 動悸が高まり、顔全体が熱を持ったように火照る。
strings.translated: My pulse quickened, and my entire face flushed as though burning with heat.

strings.text: 額から伝った汗が目に入りそうになってしまう。
strings.translated: Sweat tracing down from my forehead was about to drip into my eyes.

strings.text: 明らかに薬物の効果だ
strings.translated: It was unmistakably the effect of a drug.

strings.text: 紗英子「くぅっ……んっ……ふぅっ……」
strings.translated: Saeko「Ngh... mm... hah...」

strings.text: 食いしめた唇から、甘ったるい声が漏れるのを我慢しきれなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't hold back the sweet sounds that slipped from between my clenched lips.

strings.text: 体は完全に薬物の効果に染まってきてしまってはいるものの、できるだけ反応らしい反応は見せたくはなかった。
strings.translated: Though my body was becoming thoroughly saturated with the drug's effects, I wanted to show as little visible reaction as I possibly could.

strings.text: それこそ、園田の思う壺だと思えたから。
strings.translated: Because I knew that was exactly what Sonoda wanted.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「……そのまま、私に身をゆだねなさい。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「...Just like that. Surrender yourself to me.

strings.text: 瑛くんのように」
strings.translated: Like Akira.」

strings.text: 案の定、園田はわずかだが得意そうな響きを声に加えて、腕を撫でさするようにしてくる。
strings.translated: Just as I expected, Sonoda's voice carried a faint note of triumph as he stroked and rubbed along my arm.

strings.text: それにしたって、周りくどいやり方だ。
strings.translated: Even so, what a roundabout way to go about this.

strings.text: 既に……園田は私自身以上に、私がろくに抵抗はおろか身動きすら怪しいことを把握しているはず。
strings.translated: By now... Sonoda must know better than I do myself that I can barely resist, let alone move freely.

strings.text: だったら、こんな迂遠なやり方をせずに、すぐに事に及べばいい
strings.translated: If that's the case, there's no need for this drawn-out approach -- he could simply get on with it

strings.text: 紗英子「……瑛さんにもこんなことをしたの？」
strings.translated: Saeko「......Did you do this to Akira-san, too?」

strings.text: 言葉尻に乗るような形で、あえて口にしたのは、苛立ちがあったことも否めない。
strings.translated: I won't deny that there was irritation behind the words I deliberately chose to voice, riding the tail end of what had just been said.

strings.text: だけど……それを口にすることで、自分の中にある憤りを再燃させようというつもりもあった。
strings.translated: But... I also intended that by saying it aloud, I could reignite the outrage smoldering within me.

strings.text: 諦観だけで、このまま……されるがままにされるのは、性に合わない。
strings.translated: Simply resigning myself and letting things be done to me as they pleased -- that doesn't sit right with me.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「……きみは、瑛君の秘密を知っているんだね」
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「......You know Akira-kun's secret, don't you.」

strings.text: 私の言葉選びの流れから、そう感じたのだろう、園田は悪びれもせずにそう言ってみせた。
strings.translated: He must have sensed it from the way I had chosen my words -- Sonoda said it without a trace of shame.

strings.text: ゆらりと、胸の奥の種火が揺れるのを感じる。
strings.translated: I feel the ember deep in my chest flicker and sway.

strings.text: おそらく私は苛立ってる。
strings.translated: I'm probably angry.

strings.text: 『そのこと』を……この下衆な男も知っていて、そして当然のように言ってきたことを。
strings.translated: Angry that this vulgar man knows about *that* -- and brought it up as though it were the most natural thing in the world.

strings.text: もちろんそれが私に揺さぶりをかけるがため、わざとそうされた言葉であることだって、私は知っている。
strings.translated: Of course, I also know that those words were deliberately chosen to shake me.

strings.text: だから……せめて頭の奥、薬物にまだ侵されきっていないところだけでも、冷静であろうとしている。
strings.translated: So... I'm trying to stay calm, at least in the back of my mind -- in the part the drug hasn't yet fully consumed.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「心配しなくていい。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「You don't need to worry.

strings.text: 瑛くんは君を見捨てたわけでも、私に委ねたわけでもない。
strings.translated: Akira-kun didn't abandon you, nor did he hand you over to me.

strings.text: 私は普段、こんな性急なやりかたはしないんだ」
strings.translated: I don't usually go about things this hastily.」

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「でも君は賢い。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「But you're clever.

strings.text: 話が早い方がいいだろうと思ってね」
strings.translated: I thought it would be better to cut to the chase.」

strings.text: 瑛が……あの瑛がこんな男に黙って身を委ねるはずがない。
strings.translated: Akira... there's no way that Akira -- that Akira -- would silently surrender himself to a man like this.

strings.text: それは彼への信頼であり、私の確信でもある。
strings.translated: That is my trust in him, and my conviction.

strings.text: 彼は私よりも慎重なタイプであり、また優しくもあって、逆にそれゆえに実際に行動を起こすのが遅れる傾向はあるかもしれない。
strings.translated: He is more cautious than I am, and kinder too -- and perhaps precisely because of that, he tends to be slow to actually take action.

strings.text: だけど、その分……彼はどうあれ、肉体的には男性だ。
strings.translated: But then again... whatever else he may be, physically, he is male.

strings.text: おまけに弓道部で実績を上げているだけあって、体力もそれなりにある。
strings.translated: On top of that, having distinguished himself in the archery club, he has a fair amount of physical strength.

strings.text: その彼が、彼であっても園田やこのクラブの連中に黙ってされたと言うのなら……それはやはり、私に施された薬物などの卑劣なやり口に違いないと分かった
strings.translated: If even he -- even Akira -- had things done to him by Sonoda and the Club's people without a word of resistance... then it could only mean they used the same underhanded methods on him -- drugs and the like -- as they had on me.

strings.text: 紗英子「これは……強姦よ」
strings.translated: Saeko「This is... rape.」

strings.text: じりっ、と……思惑通り、胸の≪裡／うち≫で憤りの種火が再燃するのを感じた。
strings.translated: Deliberately, just as I had intended, I felt the ember of outrage reignite deep within my chest.

strings.text: 実際、園田の手指は次に私の太腿に添えられたが、私は覚悟していたほどには動揺を見せずに済んだと思う。
strings.translated: In fact, Sonoda's hand moved next to rest against my thigh, but I think I managed not to show as much distress as I had steeled myself for.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「最初は不安かもしれないが、最初だけだよ。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「You may feel anxious at first, but only at first.

strings.text: 最初のうちだけ……」
strings.translated: Only in the beginning...」

strings.text: 太腿を園田の体温が這いずるたび、全身が粟立ちそうになる。
strings.translated: Every time Sonoda's body heat crept along my thigh, my whole body threatened to break out in goosebumps.

strings.text: それは嫌悪感であったはずだ。
strings.translated: It should have been revulsion.

strings.text: そのはずなのに……そうでない感覚が脳に次々送り込まれてくる
strings.translated: It should have been -- and yet sensation after sensation that was anything but revulsion was being sent flooding into my mind.

strings.text: 紗英子「く……ぅっ……。
strings.translated: Saeko「Ngh... ugh...

strings.text: んっ……うっ……はぁっ……」
strings.translated: Mm... ugh... hah...」

strings.text: 吐息が漏れるのをとどめられない。
strings.translated: I couldn't stop the breath from escaping my lips.

strings.text: 本当の熱病の時（風邪で８度ほど出たことくらいしか記憶にないが）ですらも、こんな風にはならない……。
strings.translated: Even during a real fever -- the worst I could remember was a temperature of around 38 degrees from a cold -- I had never felt anything like this...

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「すぐに私の考えがわかるよ。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「You'll understand my thinking soon enough.

strings.text: すぐにね……」
strings.translated: Very soon...」

strings.text: 同じく、嫌悪感に満ち満ちていた園田の声そのものが、耳朶を通り鼓膜を震わせ……染みこむようになってきていることに、軽く戦慄を覚えた
strings.translated: I felt a faint shudder run through me at the realization that Sonoda's voice itself -- saturated as it was with contempt -- had begun to seep through my eardrums, vibrating my eardrum... and sinking in.

strings.text: 紗英子「な、何を……っ」
strings.translated: Saeko「Wh-what are you...!」

strings.text: 声が震えて聞こえる。
strings.translated: My voice sounds like it's trembling.

strings.text: こくりと口に溜まった唾液を飲むも、その……喉の震えさえもが、違った感覚となって伝わってくる。
strings.translated: I swallowed the saliva pooling in my mouth with a gulp, but even that... even the trembling of my throat was transmitting itself to me as something altogether different.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「私はね、君たちを救いたい……それだけなんだ
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「I want to save you all... that's all this is.

strings.text: 紗英子「く、薬を使う大人が……言うことですかっ……！」
strings.translated: Saeko「Using drugs on someone... and you call that saving them...!」

strings.text: 声が震えていることを悟られる危険も厭わず、私はそう返してしまっていた。
strings.translated: Heedless of the risk of letting him hear the tremor in my voice, I had already said it.

strings.text: そうせずにいられなかった……と言い換えてもいい。
strings.translated: I couldn't stop myself -- that's another way to put it.

strings.text: その、過分なリスクを背負った私の言葉さえも、園田はにこやかな笑みを崩さずにいるのが、悔しい。
strings.translated: What galled me was that even those words of mine, carrying such an excessive risk, failed to wipe the pleasant smile from Sonoda's face.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「それはね、最初は……どうにもみんな、受け入れがたいものだからね。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「That's because, at first... everyone finds it impossible to accept.

strings.text: 自らの本心や、弱さを≪詳／つまび≫らかにされることは」
strings.translated: Having one's true feelings and weaknesses laid bare.」

strings.text: おそらく、私はその時点で、かなり脳を、思考を侵されていたのじゃないかと思う。
strings.translated: I think by that point, my mind -- my very thoughts -- had been considerably invaded.

strings.text: ようやく、そこで……さっき自分が冷静に鑑みたはずのことの別の意味に考えが至ったほどなのだから。
strings.translated: It was only then that I finally arrived at another meaning behind what I had calmly considered just moments before.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「そういったことを、優しく……自然に受け入れられるため。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「So that such things can be accepted gently... naturally.

strings.text: そのためのやり方なんだよ。
strings.translated: That's what this method is for.

strings.text: 理解してもらえるかな？
strings.translated: Can you understand that?

strings.text: 紗英子「く……っ」
strings.translated: Saeko「Ngh...!」

strings.text: ――瑛は賢く、判断力もあり、心も強い。
strings.translated: -- Akira is sharp, with sound judgment and a strong will.

strings.text: そして、男性としての身体能力も備えている。
strings.translated: And he also has the physical capabilities of a man.

strings.text: その瑛も……結果、園田の手に落ちている。
strings.translated: Even Akira... had ultimately fallen into Sonoda's hands.

strings.text: そんな彼でさえも、だ。
strings.translated: Even someone like him.

strings.text: そこで初めて、明確な悪寒……ぞくっとするような自分の身に降りかかりつつある、到底忌避できぬ災厄に背筋が震える感覚を私は覚えてしまっていた。
strings.translated: It was then, for the first time, that I felt a distinct chill -- a shudder running down my spine at the calamity descending upon me, one I could not possibly escape, like a cold dread crawling over my skin.

strings.text: その私の微かな反応を、おそらく園田は敏感に感じ取ったのだろう。
strings.translated: Sonoda must have sensed that faint reaction of mine with keen perception.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「身を任せてくれれば、いいんだ」
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「All you have to do is surrender yourself to me.」

strings.text: 少しだけ余裕のようなものをみせ……また、その言葉を繰り返し、私の肌にその手を這わせていく
strings.translated: Showing just a hint of composure... he repeated those words again, and let his hand trail across my skin.

strings.text: 紗英子「ひぐっ……！
strings.translated: Saeko「Hgh...!

strings.text: んっ……うぅっ……！」
strings.translated: Mm... uugh...!」

strings.text: 声が明確にあがってしまったのは、先刻の最悪の未来予想が過ったせいもあったとは思うが
strings.translated: Part of the reason my voice escaped so clearly was that the worst-case vision I had just imagined flashed through my mind --

strings.text: 紗英子「くぅっ……はっ……はぁっ……。
strings.translated: Saeko「Ngh...! Hah... haah...

strings.text: んっ……うぅぅぅっ……！」
strings.translated: Mm... uuugh...!」

strings.text: それだけでなく、体そのものがその淡い刺激に敏感な反応を見せはじめてきていたせいだった。
strings.translated: But it wasn't only that -- my body itself had begun to respond with startling sensitivity to even those faint stimulations.

strings.text: 下半身に、鈍く……じんわりとした感覚を覚えた。
strings.translated: A dull... slowly spreading sensation crept through my lower body.

strings.text: 火照った顔以上に、熱く、疼くような感覚……。
strings.translated: A heat, a throbbing ache that burned even hotter than my already flushed face...

strings.text: あまり慣れ親しんだ感覚でこそないものの……これがいわゆる発情……興奮状態であることくらいは、わかる
strings.translated: It wasn't a sensation I was particularly familiar with... but I understood well enough that this was what they called arousal... an excited state.

strings.text: 紗英子「はぁっ……はぁっ……」
strings.translated: Saeko「Haah... haah...」

strings.text: さして敏感な……即物的な場所を刺激されているわけではなかった。
strings.translated: It wasn't as though he was stimulating any especially sensitive... overtly physical place.

strings.text: 太腿といえば、場所こそは……性器に近いとはいえ、それでも肌は肌だ。
strings.translated: The thigh, as a location, may be close to the genitals... but skin is still skin.

strings.text: それがこんなにも
strings.translated: And yet it was having this much of an effect --

strings.text: 紗英子「く……うぅっ……！」
strings.translated: Saeko「Ngh... uugh...!」

strings.text: 自然と、体が震えてしまう。
strings.translated: My body trembles on its own.

strings.text: そんな反応は、ますます園田を調子づかせてしまうことなどは、わかりきっているというのに……！
strings.translated: I know full well that such a reaction only emboldens Sonoda further...!

strings.text: 自慰――いわゆるオナニーという行為を試してみたことは、ある。
strings.translated: I have tried the act of self-pleasure -- what is commonly called masturbation.

strings.text: その時でさえ、歳相応であれば通過しておかねばならない儀礼のようなものなのかと、半ば義務感に近しいものであったと思う。
strings.translated: Even then, I think it was something close to a sense of obligation -- as though it were a rite of passage one must go through at the appropriate age.

strings.text: 確かに、相応の高揚感や、いわゆる快感と思しきものは感じた。
strings.translated: Certainly, I felt a corresponding sense of excitement, and what seemed to be so-called pleasure.

strings.text: しかし、それだって自分の身体反応がまずまず正常であるという認識を抱かせる程度のものであって……。
strings.translated: But even that was only enough to give me the recognition that my body's responses were more or less normal...

strings.text: 到底、楽しいものであるということは思えなかった。
strings.translated: I could not bring myself to think of it as something enjoyable in the least.

strings.text: 馬鹿馬鹿しい……汚らわしいという認識のほうが強く、結局、やめてしまった。
strings.translated: The stronger impression was one of foolishness... of filth, and in the end, I stopped.

strings.text: そもそも、自慰という字面そのものが気に入らない。
strings.translated: To begin with, I dislike the very word "self-pleasure" itself.

strings.text: 何を慰めるというのか。
strings.translated: What exactly is one supposed to be consoling?

strings.text: 心音

strings.text: 子供の頃は普通だった。
strings.translated: When I was a child, things were normal.

strings.text: 少ないけど友達もいたし、いじめてくるような子もいなかった。
strings.translated: I had friends, not many, but they were there, and there was no one who bullied me.

strings.text: 毎日が楽しかったから、学校に行くのも大好きだった。
strings.translated: Every day was fun, so I loved going to school.

strings.text: 勉強は好きではなかったけど成績が悪いと言うほどではないし、授業にはついていけてるつもりだった
strings.translated: I didn't like studying, but my grades weren't bad enough to call poor, and I thought I was keeping up with the lessons well enough.

strings.text: いじめを受け始めたのは、今の学校に入学してから
strings.translated: The bullying started after I entered my current school.

strings.text: 同じクラスの湯沢さん達は、執拗なまでに私を攻撃してきた
strings.translated: Yuzawa and her group, in the same class as me, attacked me with relentless persistence.

strings.text: 気持ち悪い。
strings.translated: Disgusting.

strings.text: むかつく。
strings.translated: Infuriating.

strings.text: イライラする
strings.translated: Irritating.

strings.text: 最初は、そんな事を言われた気がする。
strings.translated: At first, I think that's what they said to me.

strings.text: これといった理由はなくて、見た目や雰囲気で攻撃してきたらしかった。
strings.translated: There was no particular reason -- they seemed to attack based on looks and atmosphere alone.

strings.text: とても勝手な理由だとしか思えなかった。
strings.translated: I could only think of it as an utterly selfish reason.

strings.text: 私は何もしていないに、どうしてそんな勝手な理由で人を攻撃できるんだろう。
strings.translated: I hadn't done anything, so how could they attack someone for such a selfish reason?

strings.text: それとも、やっぱり私にも悪いところがあって、それを直さなければならないのだろうか。
strings.translated: Or perhaps, after all, there was something wrong with me too, and I needed to fix it.

strings.text: そんな事を考えている間にも、湯沢さん達の行動は本格的ないじめへと発展していった。
strings.translated: Even as I was thinking about such things, Yuzawa and her group's behavior escalated into full-blown bullying.

strings.text: なっちゃん……藤原さんは小さな頃は友達だったのに、私を助けてはくれなかった。
strings.translated: Nacchan... Fujiwara-san had been my friend when we were little, yet she never came to help me.

strings.text: 初めは教科書を隠された。
strings.translated: At first, my textbooks were hidden.

strings.text: 授業が始まる時に鞄の中にないことに気づいて、私の忘れ物扱いになった。
strings.translated: When class started, I noticed they weren't in my bag, and it was treated as if I had simply forgotten them.

strings.text: 本当に忘れたのかと思ったけど、後日私の机の中にビリビリに破られた教科書が放り込まれていた。
strings.translated: I thought maybe I really had forgotten, but later a textbook torn to shreds was thrown into my desk.

strings.text: どうして、こんな酷い事をするんだろう。
strings.translated: Why would anyone do something so terrible?

strings.text: 初めてのいじめに戸惑うことしかできなくて、私は破られた教科書を呆然と見ていた。
strings.translated: Bewildered by bullying for the first time, I could only stare blankly at the torn textbook.

strings.text: 誰がやったとかどうやって弁償させようとか、そんな事は全然頭に浮かばなかった。
strings.translated: It never even crossed my mind to figure out who did it or how to make them pay for it.

strings.text: あの時は、まだ事態の深刻さに気付いていなくて、破れた教科書を捨てていいのかどうかなんてことを呑気に考えていた。
strings.translated: Back then, I still hadn't grasped the seriousness of the situation, and I was naively wondering whether it was okay to throw away the torn textbook.

strings.text: でも、いじめは次第に陰湿さを増していった。
strings.translated: But the bullying gradually grew more and more insidious.

strings.text: 自分があの３人にいじめられていることに気づいたのは、昼休みに机の上に乗せていたお弁当を床にひっくり返されたときだった。
strings.translated: The moment I realized those three were bullying me was when my lunchbox, left on my desk during lunch break, was knocked to the floor.

strings.text: わざとだ。
strings.translated: It was on purpose.

strings.text: 偶然じゃなくてわざとだ。
strings.translated: Not an accident -- it was on purpose.

strings.text: 床に散らばったお弁当の中身を見下ろしながら、私は初めて味わう恐怖感に体を震えさせていた
strings.translated: Staring down at the contents of my lunchbox scattered across the floor, my body trembled with a fear I had never felt before.

strings.text: いじめは日増しにエスカレートしていった。
strings.translated: The bullying escalated with each passing day.

strings.text: 教科書を破るとか、お弁当を引っくり返すだけじゃなくて、トイレに入っていると上から水をかけられたりもした。
strings.translated: It wasn't just tearing textbooks or knocking over my lunchbox -- when I was in the bathroom stall, water was poured on me from above.

strings.text: びしょ濡れでトイレから出てきた私を、湯沢さん達は指を差して笑っていた。
strings.translated: As I came out of the bathroom soaking wet, Yuzawa and her group pointed at me and laughed.

strings.text: 同じクラスメイトをこんなにいじめて、いったい何が楽しいんだろう。
strings.translated: What on earth could be fun about bullying a classmate like this?

strings.text: 自分達のやっていることに、罪悪感を覚えたりしないんだろうか。
strings.translated: Did they feel no guilt at all about what they were doing?

strings.text: いじめられている身にも関わらず、私は湯沢さん達のことが不思議でならなかった。
strings.translated: Even as the one being bullied, I couldn't help but find Yuzawa and her group utterly baffling.

strings.text: 私とは全く違うタイプの人間。
strings.translated: They were a completely different type of person from me.

strings.text: それだけは理解できたけど、いじめに対する対抗策は何一つとして浮かばなかった。
strings.translated: That much I understood, but not a single idea for how to fight back against the bullying came to mind.

strings.text: そんな態度だったから、湯沢さん達の行為は次第に暴力的なものへと変貌していった。
strings.translated: Because of that attitude of mine, what Yuzawa and her group did to me gradually transformed into something violent.

strings.text: 彼女達は笑っていた。
strings.translated: They were laughing.

strings.text: 私にどんな酷い事をしても、心から楽しそうに笑っていた。
strings.translated: No matter how terrible the things they did to me, they laughed as if they were genuinely having fun.

strings.text: 信じられない。
strings.translated: Unbelievable.

strings.text: 人にこんな事をしておいて、それで笑える人間がいることが私には信じられなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't believe there were people in this world who could laugh after doing something like this to another person.

strings.text: 誰かに相談しようと思ったことはある。
strings.translated: There were times I thought about telling someone.

strings.text: 両親とか学校の先生とか、とにかく誰でもいいから助けてほしかった。
strings.translated: My parents, a teacher at school -- anyone, I didn't care who, I just wanted someone to help me.

strings.text: いじめられる学校生活なんて、私は望んでいなかった。
strings.translated: I never wanted a school life where I'd be bullied.

strings.text: でも、誰かに言ったらもっといじめられるんじゃないかって、それが怖くて誰にも言えなかった。
strings.translated: But I was afraid that if I told someone, the bullying would only get worse -- and that fear kept me from saying anything to anyone.

strings.text: クラスの人達も関わるのが嫌だったみたいで、誰も助けてはくれなかった。
strings.translated: The other students in my class seemed to want no part of it either, and not a single one of them helped me.

strings.text: 私と会話することさえ避けて、どんないじめでも見て見ぬふりをしていた。
strings.translated: They even avoided talking to me, turning a blind eye to whatever bullying took place.

strings.text: だから、湯沢さん達にはとても都合の良い環境が整ったのだろう。
strings.translated: So I suppose it created a very convenient environment for Yuzawa and her group.

strings.text: 私に対して何をしても誰も何も言わないから、彼女達はついにいじめとさえ呼べない行為にまで手を出し始めた
strings.translated: Because no one would say a word no matter what they did to me, they finally began to cross into acts that couldn't even be called bullying anymore.

strings.text: ある日の放課後、私はいつものトイレにつれていかれた。
strings.translated: One afternoon after school, I was taken to the usual bathroom.

strings.text: 逆らうことは許されなくて、酷いことをされるのはわかっていたけど、黙って３人について行った。
strings.translated: I knew I wasn't allowed to resist, and I knew something terrible would be done to me -- but I followed the three of them in silence.

strings.text: いったい何をされるんだろう。
strings.translated: What on earth were they going to do to me?

strings.text: 酷い暴力を振るわれたりするんだろうか。
strings.translated: Would they hurt me with some awful violence?

strings.text: 放課後、人通りの少ない特別教室棟のトイレに行くまでの間、私は恐怖に体を震えさせていた。
strings.translated: On the way to the bathroom in the special classroom building -- where few people passed after school -- my body trembled with fear.

strings.text: 早く帰れますように…。
strings.translated: Please let me go home soon...

strings.text: 何事も起こりませんように…。
strings.translated: Please let nothing happen...

strings.text: 明日は少しだけでいいから、幸せなことがありますように…。
strings.translated: Please let there be at least a little happiness tomorrow, even just a little...

strings.text: 私は、ある意味そんなおめでたいことを考えながら、女子トイレへと入って行った。
strings.translated: In a way, I walked into the girls' bathroom thinking such naive, foolish thoughts.

strings.text: その先にあるものが今まで以上の絶望だなんて、この時の私は全く想像もしていなかった。
strings.translated: I had absolutely no idea, at that moment, that what lay ahead would be a despair far greater than anything before.

strings.text: 自分の無知と、想像力の乏しさが招いた結果だった
strings.translated: It was the result brought about by my own ignorance and my own poverty of imagination.

strings.text: 心音「うぅっ……いやぁっ……」
strings.translated: Kokone「Uuu...! No...!」

strings.text: 達郎「ごめんね、戸田さんごめんね……」
strings.translated: Tatsuro「I'm sorry, Toda-san, I'm sorry...」

strings.text: 槇原くんはさっきからずっとそればっかり繰り返してる。
strings.translated: Makihara-kun had been repeating only that, over and over, since a moment ago.

strings.text: 私は彼の体と、トイレのじめっとした床の間で押しつぶされそうになって、必死でもがくのだけど……どうがんばってもちょっとの余裕もできないままでいる
strings.translated: Pinned between his body and the damp bathroom floor, I struggled desperately -- but no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get even a little room to breathe.

strings.text: 舞子「戸田さん、もうちょっと嬉しそうにしてあげなきゃ、槇原くんがかわいそうでしょう？
strings.translated: Maiko「Toda-san, you have to look a little happier for him -- don't you feel sorry for Makihara-kun?」

strings.text: 奈津美「そうよ、せっかく私たちが好き合ってる二人のために、こんな素敵な段取りをしてあげたのに
strings.translated: Natsumi「That's right, we went to all this trouble to set things up so nicely for you two lovebirds.」

strings.text: 心音「わ、私……」
strings.translated: Kokone「I... I...」

strings.text: 嘘――そんなの、ぜんぶ嘘――もともと私は槇原くんのことなんて、なんとも思ってなんか、ない。
strings.translated: A lie -- it's all a lie -- I never had any feelings for Makihara-kun to begin with, not even a little.

strings.text: それどころか……。
strings.translated: Instead...

strings.text: 達郎「はぁっ……はぁっ……はぁっ……」
strings.translated: Tatsuro「Hah...! Hah...! Hah...!」

strings.text: 覆いかぶさっている槇原くんは、こんな状況だっていうのに……自分も同じようにいじめられている状況だっていうのに、明らかに興奮していた。
strings.translated: Makihara-kun, pressing down on top of me -- even in a situation like this... even though he himself was in the same position of being bullied -- was clearly aroused.

strings.text: 気持ち悪い――！
strings.translated: Disgusting -- !

strings.text: 私は直感的にそう思ってしまってた。
strings.translated: That was my gut reaction before I could stop myself.

strings.text: 思ってしまいつつ、すぐに自分のそんな気持ちを非難する。
strings.translated: Even as I thought it, I immediately turned around and condemned myself for feeling that way.

strings.text: 人を軽々しく『気持ち悪い』なんて思っちゃいけない――達郎「はぁっ……と、戸田さぁん……」
strings.translated: I shouldn't so carelessly think of someone as "disgusting" -- Tatsuro「Hah...! T-Toda-saaan...」

strings.text: だめっ――！
strings.translated: No -- !

strings.text: やっぱり――無理――っ！
strings.translated: I knew it -- I can't -- !

strings.text: 見た目だけのことなら、ひょっとしたら私は……同じような境遇に晒されてる彼を、ちょっとは同情できたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: If it were only a matter of appearances, maybe I could have... felt at least a little sympathy for him, exposed as he was to the same kind of circumstances as me.

strings.text: だけど、彼は……やっぱりこんな状況で、どこか愉しんでいるような空気さえ、漂わせている。
strings.translated: But he... even so, even now, there was something in the air around him that almost seemed like he was enjoying this somewhere inside.

strings.text: 私と……性行為することに対して、明らかな性的興奮を抱いている。
strings.translated: Toward the act of... having sex with me, he harbored an unmistakable sexual excitement.

strings.text: だけど、そうでありながら、彼は私に対して一欠片の好意さえも抱いてない。
strings.translated: And yet, at the same time, he didn't hold even a single fragment of affection for me.

strings.text: もっと言えば、私のことさえ見ているかどうかさえ、怪しいくらいだ……。
strings.translated: More than that -- it was almost doubtful whether he was even looking at me at all...

strings.text: 達郎「ごめん……ほんとごめんね、戸田さん……」
strings.translated: Tatsuro「I'm sorry... I'm really sorry, Toda-san...」

strings.text: ぐっと、更に体重をかけてのしかかられる。
strings.translated: He pressed down harder, putting even more of his weight on me.

strings.text: そんなことしなくたって、私はとっくに逃げられないってことさえ、気づいてもない
strings.translated: He didn't even notice that I had long since been unable to escape, even without him doing that.

strings.text: 心音「いやぁっ……いやっ！
strings.translated: Kokone「No...! Stop!

strings.text: やめて……槇原くん……本当にやめてぇっ……！」
strings.translated: Stop it... Makihara-kun... please stop it...!」

strings.text: 鼻の奥のあたりが、じくっと傷んで……涙が知らないうちに溢れ出てしまっていた
strings.translated: A dull ache spread through the back of my nose... and before I knew it, tears were spilling out.

strings.text: 理恵「あははっ、槇原もうパンツ脱いでんのかよ
strings.translated: Rie「Ahaha! What, Makihara's already got his pants off?」

strings.text: 心音「ひっ！」
strings.translated: Kokone「Eek!」

strings.text: 菅谷さんの囃し立てる声で、私もその感触に気づいた
strings.translated: Sugaya-san's taunting voice made me notice the sensation too.

strings.text: 理恵「つーか、汚ねー尻っ！
strings.translated: Rie「Gross, what an ugly ass!

strings.text: オマケにもう勃起してんじゃん！」
strings.translated: On top of everything, he's already hard!」

strings.text: 明らかに、手とか足とか、そういう体の部位とはちがう……やけに熱いなにかが、太ももの辺りに押しあたっているのが
strings.translated: It was clearly something different from a hand or a foot or any normal body part... something strangely hot pressing against my thigh.

strings.text: 心音「いっ……いやあああああぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！
strings.translated: Kokone「N... noooooooooo----!

strings.text: 怯えた。
strings.translated: I was terrified.

strings.text: 私は、本気で怯えた。
strings.translated: I was genuinely, truly terrified.

strings.text: 性行為は学校で教わった以上に、漫画とか、映画とか……そういうのの知識で、よく知ってた。
strings.translated: I knew about sex beyond what they taught us in school -- from manga, movies... that kind of knowledge, I knew it well.

strings.text: 物語のなかの恋人同士がするような……甘ったるくてどきどきするような……キスのちょっと先にある行為としてのそれ……そして……サスペンスとかで乱暴にされる時の、ひどく痛々しくて……怖い行為としての、それ。
strings.translated: The kind that lovers in stories do... sweet and heart-pounding... the act that comes just a little past a kiss... and then... the kind in suspense stories where it's done violently, horribly painful... frightening.

strings.text: 前者については、私だってちょっとは憧れを持ってた。
strings.translated: As for the former, even I had harbored a little longing for it.

strings.text: それを期待しつつ、理想の男子を思い描いて相手をしてもらって……そんな想像しながら……１人でしたことだって、何度もあった。
strings.translated: Hoping for that, picturing an ideal boy doing it with me... imagining something like that... I had done things alone, more than once.

strings.text: 後者の乱暴な行為に怯えたことだって、あった。
strings.translated: I had been frightened of the violent kind too.

strings.text: だけど……暴力的な行為に怯えながらも、どこかで妙な興奮を覚えたことも、なくはなかった。
strings.translated: But... even while being frightened of the violent act, there were times I felt a strange excitement somewhere inside me too.

strings.text: そして、そのどちらの行為にも想像を巡らせながら……同じ行為でありつつ、あまりにも異なった印象に、戸惑っていたりもした。
strings.translated: And while letting my imagination wander over both kinds of acts... I had also been confused by how the same act could leave such completely different impressions.

strings.text: 性行為――セックスが、気持ちよくて、幸せなものなのか、痛くて苦しくて、恐ろしいものなのか、わからなくなったりした。
strings.translated: I didn't know anymore -- whether sex was something pleasurable and happy, or something painful and agonizing and terrifying.

strings.text: 前に菅谷さんが『最初のときは超痛かった』とか……そんなことを自慢気に話していたのを聞いたことがあったから、そういうものなのかな、と曖昧に納得したりも、した。
strings.translated: I'd heard Sugaya-san boasting before about how "the first time hurt like crazy"... so I had vaguely accepted that maybe that's just how it was.

strings.text: だけど――達郎「はぁっ……はぁっ……。
strings.translated: But -- Tatsuro「Hah... hah...

strings.text: と、戸田さんっ……し、仕方ないよね？
strings.translated: T-Toda-san... it can't be helped, right?

strings.text: 仕方ないもんね？
strings.translated: It can't be helped, can it?

strings.text: だって……しなくちゃ終わらないんだし……！」
strings.translated: Because... if we don't do it, it won't end...!」

strings.text: ぐっと……槇原くんの腕が私の足を押さえつけるように身体を……股間を押しつけてくる
strings.translated: With a push... Makihara-kun's arms pinned my legs down as his body... his crotch pressed against me----

strings.text: 心音「ひっ……ひいいいぃっ……！」
strings.translated: Kokone「Hh--! Hiiiiii...!」

strings.text: 着々と『そのため』の準備が成されていくことに、私は引き攣った悲鳴を漏らした。
strings.translated: As the preparations for "that" were steadily being made, I let out a strangled, convulsing scream.

strings.text: そして……ほとんど確信する。
strings.translated: And then... I became almost certain.

strings.text: セックスが――痛くて苦しくて、こわいもの――なのだと
strings.translated: That sex was -- something painful, and agonizing, and terrifying.

strings.text: 奈津美「ええー？
strings.translated: Natsumi「Eeh?

strings.text: 槙原くんのあれ……もうおっきくなってるの？
strings.translated: Makihara-kun's thing... it's already gotten big?

strings.text: 理恵「そーだよ、奈津美。
strings.translated: Rie「Yeah it has, Natsumi.

strings.text: こんな汚いちんぽもあんの！
strings.translated: Can you believe this filthy dick!

strings.text: せっかくだからベンキョーさせてもらいなよ。
strings.translated: Since you're here anyway, let her get herself an education.

strings.text: イメージすげぇ汚ねーけど、カエルの解剖みたいなアレでさ
strings.translated: The image is super gross, but think of it like dissecting a frog or whatever.」

strings.text: 奈津美「やだぁ、理恵……そんなこと言ったら二人が可哀そう。
strings.translated: Natsumi「Ugh, Rie... if you say that, I feel bad for those two.

strings.text: でも……言われてみると、いまの心音ちゃんってカエルさんみたいね、うふふっ」
strings.translated: But... now that you mention it, Kokone-chan right now does look just like a little frog, ufufu.」

strings.text: 下着をずらされ、足をいいように開かされて……藤原さんが言うように、今の私は解剖されるために貼り付けられた、カエルのようにさえ思えた
strings.translated: My underwear was pulled aside, my legs forced open however they pleased... and just as Fujiwara-san said, I felt like a frog pinned down to be dissected.

strings.text: 理恵「あっはっは！
strings.translated: Rie「Ahaha!

strings.text: なんだよ、戸田ァ……あんたもンな声あげてさ、けっこー準備できてんじゃん？
strings.translated: What's the matter, Toda... making a noise like that -- looks like you're pretty ready to go, huh?

strings.text: 舞子「……こんな場所でサカッちゃって、あなたたち、頭おかしいんじゃない？
strings.translated: Maiko「...Getting all worked up in a place like this -- are you two out of your minds?」

strings.text: 理恵「ほら、いいからさっさとヤッちゃえよ！
strings.translated: Rie「Come on, just hurry up and do it already!

strings.text: あたしら、あんたたちほどヒマじゃないんで
strings.translated: We're not as free as you two, so hurry it up.

strings.text: 心音「い……いやっ……ほんとに……いやぁっ……」
strings.translated: Kokone「N... no...! I really... don't want this...!」

strings.text: 涙がぼろぼろとこぼれ出るのを感じた。
strings.translated: I felt tears spilling out in a torrent.

strings.text: セックスが痛くて怖い行為だとしたって……ううん、それだからこそ、ちゃんとした形で……ちゃんと好きな人と――達郎「……戸田さん、処女だよね」
strings.translated: Even if sex is something painful and terrifying... no, that's exactly why it should happen properly... with someone you truly love -- Tatsuro「...Toda-san, you're a virgin, aren't you.」

strings.text: 耳元で、槇原くんがボソッと呟いた。
strings.translated: Makihara-kun murmured softly right next to my ear.

strings.text: それまでと全く違った……ぞっとするようなトーンだったせいもあって、私はしばらく、その言葉の意味がわからなかった
