strings.translated: What could I possibly do to help my sister.

strings.text: 頭の中で色々考えたけど、その答えが導き出されることはなかった。
strings.translated: I turned it over and over in my head, but no answer came.

strings.text: まだまだ情報も足りなければ、行動も足りていないだけだって…そう思いたかった
strings.translated: I wanted to believe it was just that I still didn't have enough information, still hadn't taken enough action...

strings.text: 愛「お疲れ様」
strings.translated: Ai「Good work out there.」

strings.text: 姉さん達と話を終えた後、神村さんがそう声をかけてきた。
strings.translated: After I finished talking with my sister and the others, Kamimura-san called out to me like that.

strings.text: 特に待ち合わせの約束をしてたわけじゃないんだけど、俺のことを気にかけてくれたらしい。
strings.translated: We hadn't made any plans to meet up, but it seemed she'd been keeping an eye on me.

strings.text: でも、顔に浮かぶ表情は淡々としている。
strings.translated: Still, the expression on her face was calm and detached.

strings.text: たぶん、俺も同じような表情をしていただろう。
strings.translated: I was probably wearing the same kind of expression.

strings.text: 神村さんと目を合わせても、不器用に笑うことしかできなかった
strings.translated: Even meeting Kamimura-san's eyes, all I could manage was an awkward smile.

strings.text: 愛「どうだった？
strings.translated: Ai「How did it go?

strings.text: 白坂先輩の気持ちは、少しは変えられた？
strings.translated: Were you able to change Shiraka-senpai's feelings, even a little?

strings.text: 大智「全然。
strings.translated: Daichi「Not at all.

strings.text: 今日もあのクラブに行っちゃったよ
strings.translated: She went to that Club again today.」

strings.text: 愛「そう…やっぱり…」
strings.translated: Ai「I see... just as I thought...」

strings.text: 疲労感を覚えずにはいられない。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but feel exhausted.

strings.text: こんなに言ってるのに、どうして姉さんはわかってくれないんだって、そう思うことも多くなっていた。
strings.translated: I'd been saying all of this, and yet I kept finding myself thinking -- why won't my sister understand?

strings.text: もちろん、頭ではわかっている。
strings.translated: Of course, I understood it in my head.

strings.text: これだけ説得してもわかってくれないくらい、姉さんはあのクラブにはまり込んでしまっているんだ。
strings.translated: The fact that she still wouldn't listen no matter how much I tried to convince her -- it meant my sister had fallen that deeply into that Club's grip.

strings.text: 俺の言うことよりも園田って男のほうの言うことを信じるんだろうし、もしかすると両親よりも園田を優先するかもしれない。
strings.translated: She'd probably believe what that man Sonoda said over anything I told her, and she might even put Sonoda ahead of our parents.

strings.text: これは完全に洗脳だ。
strings.translated: This was complete brainwashing.

strings.text: あの園田は口が上手い男で、きっとみんなを言葉巧みに惑わせているんだ。
strings.translated: That Sonoda was a smooth talker, and he was surely using clever words to lead everyone astray.

strings.text: 救いがどうとか言ってみんなの不安を煽って、自分の言葉を信じさせているんだろう
strings.translated: He was probably stoking everyone's anxieties with talk of salvation and the like, making them believe in his words.

strings.text: 愛「落ち込んでるの？
strings.translated: Ai「Are you feeling down?」

strings.text: 大智「落ち込んでないって言ったら…嘘になるかな
strings.translated: Daichi「If I said I wasn't... that would be a lie, I guess.」

strings.text: 大智「でも、今日は新しい話を聞けたよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「But I did hear something new today.

strings.text: クラブの運営についてだけど、あそこに通ってる人達が何か仕事をするらしい
strings.translated: About how the Club operates -- apparently the people who go there do some kind of work.」

strings.text: 愛「仕事……。
strings.translated: Ai「Work...

strings.text: 寄付してる人達がいるって話は訊いた事があるけど…。
strings.translated: I've heard that there are people who make donations, but...

strings.text: でもそれは私達みたいな学生のことじゃないと思う
strings.translated: But I don't think that applies to students like us.

strings.text: 大智「神村さんは、クラブにお金を払ったことはない？
strings.translated: Daichi「Have you ever paid money to the Club, Kamimura-san?」

strings.text: 愛「ええ。
strings.translated: Ai「No.

strings.text: 自由に出入りしていいって言われてるから」
strings.translated: They told me I'm free to come and go as I please.」

strings.text: どうやら、本当に会費みたいなものがあるわけじゃないらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed there really wasn't anything like a membership fee.

strings.text: でも、それならますます小野田さんの言っていた仕事の事が気になる。
strings.translated: But that made what Onoda-san had said about work all the more curious.

strings.text: 何だかんだでビルのフロアひとつを借りてるんだ。
strings.translated: When all was said and done, they were renting an entire floor of a building.

strings.text: 園田の負担は決して軽くないはずだった。
strings.translated: Sonoda's burden couldn't be light.

strings.text: あのクラブを維持するために、何らかの方法が用いられているはずだった
strings.translated: There had to be some method being used to keep that Club running.

strings.text: 大智「仕事って何だと思う？
strings.translated: Daichi「What do you think the work is?

strings.text: 違法なことだったりするのかな？
strings.translated: Could it be something illegal?

strings.text: 愛「どうかな…その可能性もあるかもしれないけど
strings.translated: Ai「I wonder... that possibility might exist, but...」

strings.text: 大智「もしかして…お金を盗んでくるとか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Maybe... stealing money?」

strings.text: 愛「それは…ないと思う。
strings.translated: Ai「That's... I don't think so.

strings.text: 園田先生の言葉を信じてると言っても、ほとんどの人がただの学生だし。
strings.translated: Even if they believe in Sonoda-sensei's words, most of them are just students.

strings.text: お金を盗んでくる技術なんてある？
strings.translated: Would they have the skills to steal money?」

strings.text: 大智「ああ、確かに…お金は盗めたとしても、誰かに捕まったらさすがに意味がないしな
strings.translated: Daichi「Ah, that's true... even if they could steal money, if someone got caught it would defeat the whole purpose.」

strings.text: 愛「１人くらいはそういう事が上手い人もいるのかもしれないけど、みんながあのクラブを維持するほどのお金を盗めるとは思えないし」
strings.translated: Ai「There might be one or two people who are good at that sort of thing, but I can't imagine everyone being able to steal enough money to keep the Club running.」

strings.text: 神村さんの指摘はもっともだった。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san's point was valid.

strings.text: クラブの維持をするためには相当なお金が必要なはずで、その全てを盗みで賄うなんて不可能だ。
strings.translated: Maintaining the Club must require a considerable amount of money, and it would be impossible to cover all of it through theft.

strings.text: そんな事をしているうちに、警察にバレるのは時間の問題だろう。
strings.translated: If they were doing something like that, it would only be a matter of time before the police caught on.

strings.text: あまりにも危険な方法を過ぎて、全く現実味がわかなかった
strings.translated: The method was far too dangerous -- it just didn't feel realistic at all.

strings.text: 大智「だったら、どんな方法があるのかな？
strings.translated: Daichi「Then what other methods could there be?」

strings.text: 愛「違法かどうかはわからないけど…たとえばバイトで稼いだお金を自主的にクラブに納めているとかはあるかもしれない
strings.translated: Ai「I don't know if it's illegal or not, but... for example, maybe some people voluntarily contribute money they've earned from part-time jobs to the Club.」

strings.text: 通ってる人達が、自分の稼げる方法で稼いで、それで園田に渡すのか
strings.translated: So the people who come here earn money however they can, and then hand it over to Sonoda.」

strings.text: 愛「もちろん、違法であっても安全で確実な方法があれば、それを選ぶ人もいるでしょうね」
strings.translated: Ai「Of course, even if it's illegal, if there's a method that's safe and reliable, some people would choose that.」

strings.text: 違法な仕事。
strings.translated: Illegal work.

strings.text: それが何なのかは、今のところ想像がつかない。
strings.translated: I couldn't imagine what that might be right now.

strings.text: でも、このままだと、いずれ姉さんはそういう事をやるかもしれないんだ。
strings.translated: But at this rate, my sister might end up doing something like that someday.

strings.text: とても危険なことに、手を出してしまうかもしれないんだ。
strings.translated: She might get involved in something truly dangerous.

strings.text: そんな未来は望めなかったし、絶対にさせるつもりもない。
strings.translated: I couldn't want that kind of future for her, and I had no intention of letting it happen.

strings.text: 姉さんのことはもっと注意深く見て、妙な動きがあったらすぐにやめさせるくらいの気構えが必要かもしれなかった
strings.translated: I might need to watch my sister more carefully, and be ready to put a stop to it the moment anything suspicious came up.

strings.text: 愛「それで、今日はどうするの？
strings.translated: Ai「So, what are you doing today?

strings.text: 何かする？
strings.translated: Should I do something?

strings.text: 大智「今日は…特には考えてないかな
strings.translated: Daichi「Today... I haven't really thought about it.」

strings.text: 愛「そう…それじゃあ私は、クラブに寄って行くから
strings.translated: Ai「I see... Well, I'm going to stop by the Club on my way home.」

strings.text: 大智「やっぱり行くのか
strings.translated: Daichi「You're still going, huh.」

strings.text: 愛「…ええ。
strings.translated: Ai「...Yes.

strings.text: 私には、あそこは必要な場所なの」
strings.translated: That place is somewhere I need.」

strings.text: …詳しいことはまだ話してもらえないんだろうな。
strings.translated: ...She probably still won't tell me the details.

strings.text: どちらにしても、神村さんをクラブに行かせるのはできるだけやめさせたかった
strings.translated: Either way, I wanted to stop Kamimura-san from going to the Club as much as possible.

strings.text: 愛「それじゃ
strings.translated: Ai「Well then.」

strings.text: 別れの挨拶をして、神村さんが廊下を歩いていく。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san said her goodbye and walked off down the hallway.

strings.text: このまま行かせたら、彼女は１人でクラブに行ってしまうんだろう。
strings.translated: If I let her go like this, she'd end up going to the Club alone.

strings.text: 果たして、それでいいのか。
strings.translated: Was that really okay?

strings.text: このまま、神村さんだけで行かせてしまっていいのか。
strings.translated: Was it really fine to let Kamimura-san go there by herself?

strings.text: まだ、クラブに染まりきってない彼女だからこそ、クラブとの関わりはできるだけ減らしたい
strings.translated: Precisely because she hadn't been completely absorbed into the Club yet, I wanted to minimize her involvement with it as much as possible.

strings.text: いつまでも逃げていても仕方ない。
strings.translated: There's no point in running away forever.

strings.text: このまま避け続けることはできない。
strings.translated: I can't keep avoiding this.

strings.text: 姉さんが何も話してくれない以上、いずれはあのクラブの中に入っていかなければならないんだ。
strings.translated: Since my sister won't tell me anything, I'm going to have to go inside that Club eventually.

strings.text: それなら、神村さんが行くこのタイミングで、俺も行ったほうがいいような気がしてきた。
strings.translated: If that's the case, it felt like I should go now, while Kamimura-san was heading there too.

strings.text: 神村さんがクラブで何をしているのか。
strings.translated: What was Kamimura-san doing at the Club?

strings.text: どんなふうに過ごしているのか。
strings.translated: How was she spending her time there?

strings.text: それも気になった
strings.translated: That was something I wanted to know as well.

strings.text: 大智「俺も行くよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'll go too.

strings.text: 俺も…神村さんと一緒に行く
strings.translated: I'll... go with you, Kamimura-san.」

strings.text: 愛「…本当にいいの？
strings.translated: Ai「...Are you sure?

strings.text: 取り返しのつかないことになるかもしれないけど
strings.translated: Even if it might lead to something I couldn't take back --

strings.text: 大智「一緒に行かなくても、取り返しのつかないことになるかもしれないから
strings.translated: Daichi「Even if I don't go with you, it might lead to something I can't take back.」

strings.text: 愛「そう…それなら、好きにしたら
strings.translated: Ai「I see... Then do as you like.」

strings.text: もう後戻りはできない。
strings.translated: There was no turning back now.

strings.text: ここまで来たら、前に突き進むしかない。
strings.translated: Having come this far, I had no choice but to push forward.

strings.text: たとえどんな未来が待っていようと、俺はもう逃げるつもりはなかった。
strings.translated: No matter what future awaited me, I had no intention of running anymore.

strings.text: 姉さんのためにも、立ち向かって打ち砕いてやるって、半ば自分に言い聞かせるようにして、クラブに向かった
strings.translated: I half talked myself into it -- telling myself I'd face it head-on and tear it apart, for my sister's sake -- and headed to the Club.

strings.text: 園田「やあ、よく来てくれたね」
strings.translated: Sonoda「Well, glad you could make it.」

strings.text: 神村さんと一緒にクラブへ行った俺を、園田は嬉しそうに歓迎してくれた。
strings.translated: Sonoda welcomed me warmly when I arrived at the Club with Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 俺がこのクラブに対してどんな印象を持ってるかはわかってるはずなのに、冷たく接したり追い返したりするような事はなかった
strings.translated: He must have known what kind of impression I had of this place, yet he didn't treat me coldly or try to turn me away.

strings.text: 愛「白坂君に、クラブのことを教えてあげたいんです
strings.translated: Ai「I'd like to tell Shirasaka-kun about the Club.」

strings.text: 園田「ああ、是非とも愛君から教えてあげてほしい。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Ah, please do -- I'd love for Ai-kun to be the one to explain it to him.

strings.text: 私としても、彼に正しく理解してもらいたいんだ
strings.translated: I want him to understand it properly too.」

strings.text: 愛「奥に通してもいいですか？
strings.translated: Ai「Is it alright if we go to the back?」

strings.text: 園田「本当は、しばらくこっちの部屋で慣れてから行くものなんだが…今回は特別だ
strings.translated: Sonoda「Normally, you'd spend some time in this room first to get used to things before going back there... but I'll make an exception this time.」

strings.text: 愛「ありがとうございます
strings.translated: Ai「Thank you very much.」

strings.text: 園田「白坂君。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: …いや、お姉さんと紛らわしいから、大智君と呼ばせてもらおう。
strings.translated: ...Actually, that's confusing with your sister, so let me call you Daichi-kun.

strings.text: できれば常識にとらわれず物事を正しく判断してほしい。
strings.translated: If possible, I'd like you to set aside conventional thinking and judge things for what they truly are.

strings.text: 君ならそれができると信じているよ
strings.translated: I believe you're capable of that.」

strings.text: 大智「どうも…」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Sure.」

strings.text: 園田の言葉に、俺は不機嫌そうな声を返した。
strings.translated: I replied to Sonoda's words in a sullen tone.

strings.text: 口ではどんな綺麗事だって言える。
strings.translated: Anyone can say pretty things with their mouth.

strings.text: でも、この男の本性はまだわからないんだ。
strings.translated: But I still didn't know this man's true nature.

strings.text: 油断することはできなかったし、信頼するつもりもなかった
strings.translated: I couldn't let my guard down, and I had no intention of trusting him.

strings.text: 愛「白坂君、こっちよ
strings.translated: Ai「Shirasaka-kun, this way.」

strings.text: 神村さんに先導されて、部屋の奥に向かう
strings.translated: Led by Kamimura-san, I headed toward the back of the room.

strings.text: 受付を過ぎて、小刻みに区切られたパーティションの間の、細い道を進んでいく。
strings.translated: We passed the reception area and made our way down a narrow path between the closely spaced partitions.

strings.text: 通り過ぎるパーティションの中にいるのは俺と同じくらいの年ごろの人間で、本を読んだり、ゲームをしたり、他の誰かとおしゃべりをしたり…今のところ、おかしなことをしている人間はいない。
strings.translated: The people inside the partitions we passed were around the same age as me -- reading books, playing games, chatting with someone else... so far, no one was doing anything strange.

strings.text: 果たして、姉さんはいるんだろうか。
strings.translated: I wondered if my sister was here.

strings.text: また、俺の知らない男とセックスしてるんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was she having sex with some man I didn't know again?

strings.text: そんな事を思いながら更に奥、細いパーティションの先の扉を過ぎた俺が目にしたものは、ある意味さらに衝撃的な光景だった
strings.translated: With that thought in my mind, I went further in, past the door beyond the narrow partitions -- and what I saw there was, in a sense, an even more shocking sight.

strings.text: 大智「え…？
strings.translated: Daichi「Wh...?」

strings.text: 奇妙なものが見えた。
strings.translated: Something strange came into view.

strings.text: いや、本当は奇妙じゃないのかもしれないけど、俺にはどうしてもそう見えてしまった。
strings.translated: Or maybe it wasn't strange at all -- but to me, it looked that way no matter what.

strings.text: 小さなパーティションの中で、俺と同じくらいの歳の男に口でしている女の子。
strings.translated: Inside a small partition, a girl was going down on a boy about my age.

strings.text: 俺と同じ学校の制服を着た彼女が、クラスメイトに見えた。
strings.translated: She was wearing the same school uniform as me, and she looked like a classmate.

strings.text: でも、あいつがこんな事をするはずがない。
strings.translated: But there was no way that person would do something like this.

strings.text: するはずがないのに、顔を見れば見るほどあいつのようにしか思えなかった
strings.translated: There was no way -- and yet, the more I looked at her face, the more she looked exactly like them.

strings.text: 大智「桧垣…？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Higaki...?」

strings.text: あまりにも衝撃的な光景だった。
strings.translated: It was an overwhelmingly shocking sight.

strings.text: すぐには、現実のものとして受け入れることができなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't immediately accept it as something real.

strings.text: 一番話しやすいと思っていたクラスメイト。
strings.translated: The classmate I thought would be the easiest to talk to.

strings.text: このまま仲良くなっていけそうだと思っていた男友達。
strings.translated: The guy friend I thought I could keep getting closer to.

strings.text: 信頼のできる生徒会副会長。
strings.translated: The reliable vice president of the student council.

strings.text: まさかそれが、こんなところで、こんな
strings.translated: And yet, here, in a place like this, doing something like this...

strings.text: 大智「嘘だろ
strings.translated: Daichi「No way.」

strings.text: 愛「知らなかったの？
strings.translated: Ai「You didn't know?」

strings.text: 大智「知るわけないだろ。
strings.translated: Daichi「How would I know.

strings.text: 神村さんは知ってたのか？
strings.translated: Did you know, Kamimura-san?」

strings.text: 愛「私は、ここに通ってるから
strings.translated: Ai「I come here, so...」

strings.text: 大智「いつから？
strings.translated: Daichi「Since when?」

strings.text: 桧垣は、いつからここに来てるんだ？
strings.translated: How long has Higaki been coming here?

strings.text: 愛「多分…去年の夏にはいたと思う」
strings.translated: Ai「Probably... I think he was here by last summer.」

strings.text: 悪い夢を見ているような気分だった。
strings.translated: It felt like I was having a bad dream.

strings.text: まさか、あの桧垣まで……こんな……ここって、そんなにいい場所なのか？
strings.translated: Even Higaki, of all people... like this... Is this place really that good?

strings.text: みんなが受け入れてるのに、受け入れられない俺が悪いのか？
strings.translated: Everyone else accepts it -- does that make me the one who's wrong for not being able to?

strings.text: 人前でこんなことをするのも、実は大したことじゃないのか？
strings.translated: Is doing something like this in front of people actually not a big deal?

strings.text: だんだん自分の考えに自信が持てなくなってくる
strings.translated: I was gradually losing confidence in my own way of thinking.

strings.text: 愛「あそこに座りましょう
strings.translated: Ai「Let's sit over there.」

strings.text: 神村さんに言われるまま、空いてるソファーに腰を下ろす。
strings.translated: Following Kamimura-san's suggestion, I sank down onto an open sofa.

strings.text: 自分がこんなところで何をやってるのか、わからなくなってしまった。
strings.translated: I no longer knew what I was doing in a place like this.

strings.text: これからどうすればいいんだろう。
strings.translated: What was I supposed to do from here?

strings.text: クラブには来たものの、俺は何をすればいいんだろう。
strings.translated: I'd come to the Club, but what was I supposed to do?

strings.text: どうすれば……いや、何のために来たんだった？
strings.translated: How should I... no, wait -- why had I come here in the first place?

strings.text: 全然考えがまとまらなくて、ただ呆然と部屋の中の様子を見つめていた
strings.translated: My thoughts were a complete mess, and I just sat there in a daze, staring blankly at the scene around me.

strings.text: 愛「白坂先輩、あそこにいるけど話してこなくていいの？
strings.translated: Ai「Shirasaka-senpai is over there -- don't you want to go talk to her?」

strings.text: 大智「ああ…うん、今はいい
strings.translated: Daichi「Ah... no, I'm fine for now.」

strings.text: 姉さんは小野田さんと一緒で、クラブの男達と楽しそうに話をしていた。
strings.translated: Sis was with Onoda-san, chatting cheerfully with some of the Club's men.

strings.text: 今のところ、セックスまではしてないみたいだけど、この後どうなるかはわからない。
strings.translated: For now it didn't look like they'd gone as far as sex, but I had no idea what would happen after this.

strings.text: みんな…とても楽しそうだ…。
strings.translated: Everyone... looks like they're having such a good time...

strings.text: こんな場所なのに勉強してるような子もいて、とにかく異様な空間が作り上げられていた
strings.translated: There were even people studying in a place like this -- it all added up to an utterly bizarre space.

strings.text: 体がだるい。
strings.translated: My body felt heavy.

strings.text: ソファーに座っているだけなのに、頭がクラクラしてきた。
strings.translated: I was just sitting on the sofa, and yet my head had started to spin.

strings.text: やっぱり、俺には受け入れられない。
strings.translated: I knew it -- I just can't accept this.

strings.text: みんなが楽しそうにしていても、これがまともな場所だとは思えない。
strings.translated: Even if everyone around me looked like they were having fun, I couldn't bring myself to think this was a normal place.

strings.text: 周りから聞こえてくる楽しそうな話し声でさえ、俺には不快なものとして感じられていた
strings.translated: Even the cheerful voices drifting in from around me felt like nothing but noise to my ears.

strings.text: ／紗英子「調子が悪そうね
strings.translated: /Saeko「You don't look so good.」

strings.text: 聞き覚えのある声がして、俺は緩慢に顔を上げた。
strings.translated: A familiar voice reached my ears, and I slowly raised my head.

strings.text: 声の主の顔を見るより前に、それが誰だかはわかっていた
strings.translated: Before I even saw the face of the person speaking, I already knew who it was.

strings.text: 大智「菱木さん…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Hishiki-san...」

strings.text: 学校では何度か顔を合せたけど、ここで会うのは２度目だ。
strings.translated: We'd run into each other a few times at school, but this was only the second time I'd seen her here.

strings.text: 桧垣もそうだけど、菱木さんのような真面目な生徒が、どうしてこんなところにいるんだろう。
strings.translated: Same as Higaki -- why would someone as serious as Hishiki-san be in a place like this?

strings.text: 菱木さんもやっぱり……桧垣の事を知っているんだろうか。
strings.translated: Did Hishiki-san also know about Higaki... of course she did.

strings.text: …当然、そうなんだろうな
strings.translated: Yeah, she must.

strings.text: 大智「菱木さんはどうしてここに？
strings.translated: Daichi「Why are you here, Hishiki-san?」

strings.text: 紗英子「日頃の疲れを癒したり、気分転換したり…そんなところかしら」
strings.translated: Saeko「To unwind from the daily grind, clear my head... something like that, I suppose.」

strings.text: 思わず口に出した言葉に、菱木さんは何でもない事のように答えた
strings.translated: She answered my impulsive question as if it were nothing at all.

strings.text: 大智「気分転換って…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Clearing your head, you said...」

strings.text: 頭がおかしくなりそうだった。
strings.translated: I felt like I was losing my mind.

strings.text: クラブの中を覗けば覗くほど、理解できないことが増えていった。
strings.translated: The more I looked around inside the Club, the more things I couldn't understand kept piling up.

strings.text: あまりにもショックが大きくて、次の言葉が出てこない
strings.translated: The shock was too great -- the next words wouldn't come.

strings.text: 紗英子「白坂さんも、何か救われたい事があって来たの？
strings.translated: Saeko「Did you come here because there's something you want to be saved from too, Shirasaka-san?」

strings.text: 大智「俺は…そうじゃなくて
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm... that's not it.」

strings.text: 紗英子「お姉さんのことが心配で来たとか？
strings.translated: Saeko「Or maybe you came because you're worried about your sister?」

strings.text: 大智「菱木さんは変だと思わないのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Don't you think this is strange, Hishiki-san?」

strings.text: 紗英子「何が？
strings.translated: Saeko「What do you mean?」

strings.text: 大智「だって、あんな…」
strings.translated: Daichi「I mean, that was...」

strings.text: そう言って、桧垣のほうに一瞬だけ視線を向ける。
strings.translated: As I said that, I glanced briefly in Higaki's direction.

strings.text: パーティションに隠れて、その姿はみえないけれど。
strings.translated: The partition hid him from view, so I couldn't actually see him.

strings.text: でも、菱木さんはそれだけで、俺の言わんとしてることを理解したみたいだった
strings.translated: But that alone seemed to be enough for Hishiki-san to understand what I was trying to say.

strings.text: 紗英子「ここではあんなの普通のことよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「What goes on here is perfectly normal.

strings.text: みんな自分が救われるための方法を探してるの
strings.translated: Everyone is looking for their own way to be saved.」

strings.text: 紗英子「自分が救われる方法がセックスなら、誰だってして当然でしょう
strings.translated: Saeko「If sex is the way someone finds salvation, then of course they're going to do it.」

strings.text: 大智「当然って…」
strings.translated: Daichi「"Of course"...」

strings.text: 菱木さんの言ってることの意味がわからなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't grasp what Hishiki-san was saying.

strings.text: こんな状況を当然だって受け入れられる彼女の思考が、俺には理解できなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't comprehend the mindset that let her accept a situation like this as perfectly normal.

strings.text: もうさっきからこればっかりだ。
strings.translated: That's all I'd been doing since I got here.

strings.text: わからないとか理解できないとか、そんなふうに思うことしかできない。
strings.translated: Thinking things like "I don't understand" or "I can't comprehend this" -- that was all I was capable of.

strings.text: これは現実なんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was this really reality?

strings.text: 本当に悪い夢を見てるんじゃないんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was I really not just having some terrible dream?

strings.text: 信じたくないことが連続して、俺はもうどうすればいいのか判断がつかなくなってしまっていた
strings.translated: Unbelievable thing after unbelievable thing kept piling up, and I had completely lost any sense of what I was supposed to do.

strings.text: 大智「ごめん…来たばっかりだけど、俺、やっぱり
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry... I just got here, but I think I need to...」

strings.text: 愛「帰るの？
strings.translated: Ai「You're leaving?」

strings.text: 大智「ごめん
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry.」

strings.text: それだけ言って、俺は部屋を出た。
strings.translated: With just those words, I left the room.

strings.text: こんなところになんか、１秒だって長くいたくなかった。
strings.translated: I didn't want to stay in a place like this for even one more second.

strings.text: この部屋の中にいる人達が怖い。
strings.translated: The people inside that room frightened me.

strings.text: こんな場所で笑顔を浮かべられる精神状態がわからない。
strings.translated: I couldn't understand the state of mind that let someone smile in a place like this.

strings.text: 唯一染まりきっていない神村さんだけが救いのように感じられていたけど、彼女とも大きな隔たりがあるってことが理解できてしまった
strings.translated: Kamimura-san had felt like the one saving grace -- the only one who hadn't been completely consumed by it -- but now I understood that even between her and me, there was a vast gulf.

strings.text: 大智「何なんだよ、これ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「What the hell is this...」

strings.text: 視界が涙で歪んだ。
strings.translated: My vision blurred with tears.

strings.text: さっきから頭の中はぐちゃぐちゃで、思いきり叫びたい気分だった。
strings.translated: My head had been a mess for a while now, and I felt like I wanted to scream at the top of my lungs.

strings.text: どうしてこんな事になってしまったんだろう。
strings.translated: How had things ended up like this?

strings.text: もっとありふれた、楽しい生活を目指していたはずなのに、どこで間違えてしまったんだろう。
strings.translated: I was supposed to be aiming for a more ordinary, happy life -- where had I gone wrong?

strings.text: 俺は無力だ。
strings.translated: I'm powerless.

strings.text: 何もできない。
strings.translated: There's nothing I can do.

strings.text: 姉さんを助けたいとか、神村さんも助けたいとか思っても、俺にできることなんて何一つないんだ
strings.translated: Even if I wanted to save my sister, even if I wanted to save Kamimura-san too, there wasn't a single thing I could actually do.

strings.text: クラブのビルを飛び出して、人通りの多いところまで走った。
strings.translated: I burst out of the Club's building and ran until I reached somewhere with more people around.

strings.text: 走って激しく呼吸をするたびに、身体の中の悪いものが吐きだされるような感覚を味わった
strings.translated: With every breath I gasped as I ran, I felt as though the poison inside me was being expelled from my body.

strings.text: 大智「はぁ…っ！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Hah...!」

strings.text: この場所とあの場所は空気が違う。
strings.translated: The air here was different from the air back there.

strings.text: いや、世界が違うって言っても過言じゃない。
strings.translated: No -- it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say the two places were entirely different worlds.

strings.text: あんなところにいたら、頭がおかしくなっても不思議じゃない。
strings.translated: It wouldn't be strange at all if someone lost their mind staying in a place like that.

strings.text: 姉さんがあんなふうになってしまった理由もわかったような気がする。
strings.translated: I felt like I finally understood why my sister had ended up the way she did.

strings.text: 大智「どうすりゃいいんだよ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「What am I supposed to do...」

strings.text: 打開策が見つからない。
strings.translated: I couldn't find a way out.

strings.text: 姉さん達を救う方法が見つからない。
strings.translated: I couldn't find a way to save my sister and the others.

strings.text: 本当にクラブから引き離すことができるのか、自信が持てない。
strings.translated: I had no confidence that I could actually pull them away from the Club.

strings.text: 姉さんはこのまま狂っていくしかないんじゃないかって、そう思うことしかできなかった
strings.translated: All I could do was think that my sister had no choice but to keep losing herself, little by little.

strings.text: 瑛
strings.translated: Akira

strings.text: 瑛君はいいよね」
strings.translated: "Akira's got it good.

strings.text: 「桧垣は恵まれてるから」
strings.translated: " "Higaki's so lucky.

strings.text: 子供の頃から、そんな言葉は何度もかけられてきた。
strings.translated: " Ever since I was a child, I'd heard those words countless times.

strings.text: でも僕にはとてもそうは思えなかった。
strings.translated: But I could never see it that way myself.

strings.text: できることなら、僕にそう言った相手と代わりたいと思ったことすらあった。
strings.translated: There were even times I wished I could trade places with the very people who said those things to me.

strings.text: そんな僕の気持ちを理解してくれたのは、唯一幼なじみの紗英子ちゃんだけだったと思う
strings.translated: The only one who ever understood how I felt, I think, was my childhood friend Saeko-chan.

strings.text: 瑛「お疲れ様でした」
strings.translated: Akira「Thank you for your hard work.」

strings.text: 弓道部の練習の後、生徒会の作業を終えて、僕は教室を出た。
strings.translated: After archery club practice and finishing up student council work, I left the classroom.

strings.text: 今日も忙しい１日だったから、気づけばもう夕方になってしまっている。
strings.translated: It had been another busy day, and before I knew it, evening had already come.

strings.text: 毎日、何らかの問題が発生するから気の休まる暇がない。
strings.translated: Something or other comes up every single day, so there's never a moment to rest.

strings.text: ストレスだって相応にかかるし、時々生徒会の仕事じゃない仕事まで持ち込まれることがあった。
strings.translated: The stress builds up accordingly, and sometimes work that has nothing to do with student council gets dumped on me too.

strings.text: でも、その一方で充実感も得ている。
strings.translated: But at the same time, I find real fulfillment in it.

strings.text: みんなの役に立てるってことが、本当に嬉しかった。
strings.translated: Being able to be useful to everyone -- that truly made me happy.

strings.text: 学校の先生達から頼られるのも悪い気分じゃなかったし、何よりも紗英子ちゃんはとても頼りになった。
strings.translated: Being relied on by the teachers wasn't a bad feeling either, and above all, Saeko-chan was an incredible support.

strings.text: 彼女の下で生徒会の仕事ができることは、本当に恵まれていることだった
strings.translated: Being able to do student council work under her was something I was truly fortunate for.

strings.text: 学校を出て街のほうへと歩く。
strings.translated: I left school and walked toward the city.

strings.text: 最近は忙しかったからこっちのほうには来れてなかったけど、今日は久しぶりに時間を作ることができた。
strings.translated: I'd been too busy lately to come this way, but today I managed to carve out some time for the first time in a while.

strings.text: 今日はとても暖かいから薄着の人も多くて、だんだん季節が夏に向かっていることを感じさせた。
strings.translated: It was very warm today, so there were plenty of people in light clothing, and you could feel the season slowly turning toward summer.

strings.text: お花見なんていく余裕もなく、あっという間に月日が経っていく。
strings.translated: The days had flown by without me even having time to go see the cherry blossoms.

strings.text: やりたいことはいくつもあったんだけど、生徒会や部活でほとんどが忙殺されてしまった。
strings.translated: There were so many things I'd wanted to do, but student council and club activities had swallowed almost all of it.

strings.text: もう少し時間を上手く使えるといいんだけど、まだまだ紗英子ちゃんのようにはいかない。
strings.translated: I wish I could manage my time a little better, but I'm still nowhere near Saeko-chan's level.

strings.text: 修行あるのみ。
strings.translated: Nothing but training.

strings.text: 格闘漫画のセリフじゃないけど、頭の中にそんなフレーズが浮かんだ。
strings.translated: Not quite a line from a fighting manga, but that phrase floated up in my mind.

strings.text: 街には多くの人が溢れていた。
strings.translated: The streets were overflowing with people.

strings.text: みんな忙しそうにして、何だか慌ただしい空気が伝わってくる。
strings.translated: Everyone looked busy, and a kind of restless energy seemed to fill the air.

strings.text: この中のどれだけの人が本当に幸せなんだろうか。
strings.translated: How many of these people were truly happy?

strings.text: 今の自分の生活に本当に満足しているんだろうか。
strings.translated: How many were genuinely satisfied with their lives right now?

strings.text: クラブに関わる以前はこんな事は考えなかったけど、最近は人を見るたびに幸せなのかどうかを考えるクセがついてしまっていた
strings.translated: Before I got involved with the Club, I never thought about things like this -- but lately, I'd developed a habit of wondering whether every person I saw was happy or not.

strings.text: 瑛「学校を卒業して、どこかに就職して、好きな人と結婚して、家庭を持って、子供を持って…」
strings.translated: Akira「Graduate from school, find a job somewhere, marry someone you love, start a family, have children...」

strings.text: 誰にも言ったことはなかったけど、そんなふうに生きられる人のことが羨ましかった。
strings.translated: I'd never told anyone, but I envied people who could live like that.

strings.text: 普通でいられることの幸せが、僕は誰よりも理解できてるつもりだった。
strings.translated: I believed I understood the happiness of being ordinary better than anyone.

strings.text: だって、僕は普通じゃない。
strings.translated: Because I'm not ordinary.

strings.text: 子供の頃から、周りのみんなとは違うって思って過ごしてきた。
strings.translated: Ever since I was a child, I'd lived with the feeling that I was different from everyone around me.

strings.text: でも、当時はそれを言葉で説明することができなくて、もどかしい思いばかりを抱えていた。
strings.translated: But back then, I couldn't put it into words, and I carried nothing but that frustrating, helpless feeling.

strings.text: 自分が何が違うのか、僕自身が正しく認識していなかった。
strings.translated: I hadn't properly understood myself what it was that made me different.

strings.text: 自分の中の違和感を理解できてきたのは、体が二次的な成長を終えた頃。
strings.translated: I began to grasp the sense of wrongness inside me around the time my body finished its secondary development.

strings.text: どうして僕は男なんだろうって、自然とそんな疑問がわいてきた。
strings.translated: Why am I a boy? -- that question arose in me naturally, without warning.

strings.text: 僕は本当は女の子だったのかもしれない…。
strings.translated: Maybe I was really a girl all along...

strings.text: それに気づいたときから、僕の苦悩は始まった。
strings.translated: From the moment I realized that, my suffering began.

strings.text: 自分という存在が不自然なものに思えて、毎日のように自分の部屋で泣いていた。
strings.translated: My own existence felt like something unnatural, and I cried in my room nearly every day.

strings.text: こんなの誰にも相談できるわけがない。
strings.translated: There was no way I could talk to anyone about something like this.

strings.text: 両親にも学校の先生にも友達にも、誰にも言えないまま生きていくしかなかった。
strings.translated: I had no choice but to go on living without telling anyone -- not my parents, not my teachers, not my friends.

strings.text: だって、どんな反応をされるかわかったものじゃない。
strings.translated: Because there was no telling how they would react.

strings.text: 両親は悲しむかもしれないし、学校の先生は呆れるかもしれないし、友達は馬鹿にするかもしれないし…。
strings.translated: My parents might grieve, my teachers might be appalled, my friends might mock me...

strings.text: 恐怖と不安にさいなまれるようにして、僕はいつしか自分を偽る術を身に付けていった。
strings.translated: Tormented by fear and anxiety, I had, before I knew it, learned the art of deceiving myself.

strings.text: だから、クラブの存在を知ったときは、まるで世界が変わったような衝撃を受けたものだった
strings.translated: So when I learned of the Club's existence, it hit me like the whole world had changed.

strings.text: 瑛「全て園田先生のおかげだ…」
strings.translated: Akira「It's all thanks to Sonoda-sensei...」

strings.text: これから、僕の向かうべき場所はひとつしかない。
strings.translated: From here on, there was only one place I needed to go.

strings.text: それは、食事をするレストランでもなく、買い物をするお店でもなく、もっと精神的な支えとなってくれる場所だった
strings.translated: Not a restaurant to eat at, not a shop to buy things in -- it was a place that offered something far more like spiritual support.

strings.text: クラブ。
strings.translated: The Club.

strings.text: みんながそう呼んでいる場所こそが、偽りに彩られた僕の人生を変えてくれた。
strings.translated: That place, as everyone called it, was what had changed my life -- a life painted over with falsehoods.

strings.text: 最初はネットで知り合った…同じ悩みを持つ知人の紹介で連れて行かれて、そこで真の救いを知った。
strings.translated: At first I'd met them online... a friend with the same troubles introduced me and took me there, and that was where I learned what true salvation was.

strings.text: 僕がどうやって生きていけばいいのか、それを教えてもらった。
strings.translated: They taught me how I was supposed to live.

strings.text: 自分を解放すればいい。
strings.translated: I just needed to set myself free.

strings.text: 僕の悩みを知らないうちから、園田先生はそう言ってくれた。
strings.translated: Even before she knew my troubles, Sonoda-sensei had said that to me.

strings.text: 僕が生きるべき道を、その時から指し示してくれた。
strings.translated: From that moment on, she had been pointing me toward the path I was meant to walk.

strings.text: 解放。
strings.translated: Liberation.

strings.text: それの意味するところを理解するのは、簡単なことではなかった。
strings.translated: Understanding what that word truly meant was not a simple thing.

strings.text: どんなふうにして自分を解放すればいいのか、僕はクラブに通いながらその方法を見出していった。
strings.translated: While continuing to visit the Club, I gradually found my own way to set myself free.

strings.text: まずは言葉。
strings.translated: First, it was words.

strings.text: できるだけ女の子のような喋り方をするように心がけてみた。
strings.translated: I made a conscious effort to speak as much like a girl as I could.

strings.text: もちろん、最初は抵抗があった。
strings.translated: Of course, at first I resisted.

strings.text: 喋り方にじゃない。
strings.translated: Not the way of speaking itself.

strings.text: 引かれてしまうんじゃないかって怖くて、なかなか女の子の言葉を使うことはできなかった
strings.translated: I was afraid of being rejected, and for a long time I couldn't bring myself to use the words a girl would use.

strings.text: でも、勇気を出して挑戦した。
strings.translated: But I worked up the courage and tried.

strings.text: 自分が変わるために必要な第一歩を踏み出した。
strings.translated: I took the first step I needed to take in order to change.

strings.text: クラブのみんなは…まるで、当たり前のように受け入れてくれた。
strings.translated: The people at the Club... accepted it as though it were the most natural thing in the world.

strings.text: 女の子の言葉を使う僕のことを、可愛いとまで言ってくれた。
strings.translated: They even told me I was cute for speaking like a girl.

strings.text: 幸せだった。
strings.translated: I was happy.

strings.text: 初めて本当の自分を出すことができたような気がした。
strings.translated: It felt like, for the first time, I had been able to show my true self.

strings.text: 僕のありのままの姿を受け入れてくれる人達がいるんだって、みんなのことを信じることができた。
strings.translated: I was able to believe in everyone -- to know that there were people who would accept me exactly as I was.

strings.text: それからは、少しずつ女の子らしく振舞えるように努力していった。
strings.translated: After that, I gradually worked to carry myself in a more feminine way.

strings.text: 男の身体を少しでも隠して、女の子らしく見えるように。
strings.translated: To hide my male body as much as possible, to look more like a girl.

strings.text: クラブの女の子達にも相談して、どんなふうにすれば僕が女の子になれるかアドバイスをもらったりもした。
strings.translated: I also consulted with the girls at the Club, asking for advice on how I could become a girl.

strings.text: インターネットで女の子の服を買うようになったのもその頃からだ。
strings.translated: It was around that time that I started buying girls' clothes online.

strings.text: 園田先生はクラブでそういった買い物を受け取ることを、快く許してくれた。
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei kindly allowed me to have those purchases delivered to the Club.

strings.text: 最初は地味なものを選んでいたけど、いくつか買っているうちに可愛らしいものも着たくなっていった。
strings.translated: At first I chose plain things, but as I bought more, I began wanting to wear cuter ones too.

strings.text: そうやって、自分に似合う服を選んでいくうちに、僕はいつしか…変わっていた…。
strings.translated: And as I went on choosing clothes that suited me... before I knew it... I had changed.

strings.text: ううん。
strings.translated: No.

strings.text: 本当の自分でいられるようになった
strings.translated: I had become able to be my true self.

strings.text: 瑛「失礼します」
strings.translated: Akira「Excuse me.」

strings.text: クラブの部屋には、何人かの男女がくつろいでいた。
strings.translated: In the Club's room, a number of men and women were relaxing.

strings.text: 紗英子「どうかしら。
strings.translated: Saeko「Hard to say.

strings.text: 何とも言えないわね
strings.translated: I really can't tell yet.」

strings.text: 瑛「そう
strings.translated: Akira「I see.

strings.text: 紗英子「今できる手は打ったから、ひとまず様子を見ましょう
strings.translated: Saeko「I've done what I can for now, so let's just watch and see how things go.

strings.text: いじめっ子達にも学校の先生達にも、憤りを感じずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but feel indignant toward both the bullies and the teachers at school.

strings.text: どうしてこんな事をするのか。
strings.translated: Why would they do something like this.

strings.text: どうして助けてあげないのか。
strings.translated: Why wouldn't they help her.

strings.text: そんな事を考えていると、戸田さんを助けられるのは尚のこと私達しかいないって思わされた。
strings.translated: Thinking about it that way only made me more convinced that we were the only ones who could help Toda-san.

strings.text: でも、学校の先生達に報告しても、もしも何もしてくれなかった場合はどうしたらいいのかしら？
strings.translated: But if I reported it to the teachers and they did nothing -- what would we do then?

strings.text: 学校の力を借りずに、私達にできることは何があるだろうか？
strings.translated: Without relying on the school, what could we do on our own?

strings.text: できれば、戸田さんにも明るい学校生活を楽しんでほしかったけど、今のままだとそれは難しい。
strings.translated: I wanted Toda-san to enjoy a bright school life if at all possible, but the way things stood now, that seemed difficult.

strings.text: せめて、ほんのわずかでも落ち着いて過ごせる場所があるといいんだけど
strings.translated: At the very least, I hoped there was somewhere she could spend even a little time in peace...

strings.text: 瑛「そうだ。
strings.translated: Akira「Oh, right.

strings.text: ここならどうかな？
strings.translated: What about here?

strings.text: 戸田さんもここなら落ち着いて過ごせるんじゃない？
strings.translated: Don't you think Toda-san could find some peace here too?

strings.text: 紗英子「ここって…彼女をこのクラブに連れてくるってこと？
strings.translated: Saeko「Here... you mean bringing her to this Club?

strings.text: 瑛「ここなら戸田さんをいじめるような人たちもいないでしょう？
strings.translated: Akira「There's no one here who would bully Toda-san, right?

strings.text: きっと彼女も安らいで時間を過ごせるんじゃない？
strings.translated: I'm sure she could spend her time here feeling at ease, don't you think?

strings.text: 紗英子「ここに来ている間はそうかもしれないけど、学校で過ごす時間が苦痛なことに変わりはないわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「While she's here, maybe -- but that doesn't change the fact that the time she spends at school is painful.

strings.text: そっちはどうするつもりなの？
strings.translated: What do you plan to do about that?」

strings.text: 瑛「それはそれ。
strings.translated: Akira「That's a separate matter.

strings.text: これはこれ。
strings.translated: This is something else entirely.

strings.text: 学校で問題がなくなって、ここが必要なくなったら来なくても構わないし
strings.translated: If the problems at school go away and she no longer needs this place, she doesn't have to come anymore --

strings.text: 紗英子「それもそうね」
strings.translated: Saeko「I suppose you're right.」

strings.text: 紗英子ちゃんは、私の話に納得したようにうなずいてくれた。
strings.translated: Saeko-chan nodded as though she'd accepted what I said.

strings.text: 彼女にも幸せな時間を味わってほしいし、是非このクラブの良さを体験してほしかった
strings.translated: I wanted her to experience happiness too, and I really hoped she'd get to feel what this Club had to offer.

strings.text: 瑛「私、明日にでも戸田さんに声をかけてみるね
strings.translated: Akira「I'll try reaching out to Toda-san tomorrow.

strings.text: 紗英子「そう上手くいくかしらね？
strings.translated: Saeko「Do you think it'll go that smoothly?

strings.text: 瑛「わからないけど…上手くいくように努めるのが、私達にできることだと思う
strings.translated: Akira「I don't know... but I think doing our best to make it work is what we can do.

strings.text: 私の話を聞いて、紗英子ちゃんは何かを考え込んでいた。
strings.translated: Listening to what I said, Saeko-chan seemed to be turning something over in her mind.

strings.text: 良い方法だと思うんだけど、何か問題でもあるのかしら？
strings.translated: I think it's a good idea, but is there some problem with it?

strings.text: 紗英子「戸田さんとは私が話してみるわ
strings.translated: Saeko「I'll be the one to talk to Toda-san.

strings.text: 瑛「大丈夫？
strings.translated: Akira「You okay?

strings.text: 紗英子ちゃん忙しいでしょう？
strings.translated: Saeko-chan must be busy, after all.

strings.text: 紗英子「それはあなたも一緒でしょう。
strings.translated: Saeko「That goes for you too, you know.

strings.text: それに、デリケートな問題だし、学校では男のあなたより女の私のほうが向いてるんじゃない？
strings.translated: Besides, it's a delicate matter -- at school, don't you think a woman like me is better suited for it than a man like you?」

strings.text: 紗英子「そもそもあなたが１年の女の子に声をかけたりしたら、大騒ぎになるわよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「In the first place, if you went around talking to first-year girls, it would cause a huge scene.

strings.text: 湯沢さんを悪い意味で刺激することにもなりそうだし
strings.translated: It would probably provoke Yuzawa-san in the worst possible way too.」

strings.text: 瑛「それは…確かにそうかもしれない」
strings.translated: Akira「That's... fair enough, I suppose.」

strings.text: 少し悲しくなる話だけど、紗英子ちゃんの言ってることは事実だった。
strings.translated: It was a bit of a sad thing to hear, but what Saeko-chan said was the truth.

strings.text: 自分を偽りながら生きてる私は、学校では男でいるしかない
strings.translated: Living a lie, I had no choice but to be a boy at school.

strings.text: 瑛「わかった。
strings.translated: Akira「Alright.

strings.text: 戸田さんのこと、よろしくね
strings.translated: I'll leave Toda-san in your hands.」

strings.text: 紗英子ちゃんがうなずいてくれたのを確認して、私はホッと胸を撫で下ろした。
strings.translated: I watched Saeko-chan nod, and let out a quiet breath of relief.

strings.text: 私の手で助けてあげられないのは残念だけど、紗英子ちゃんに任せておけばきっと大丈夫。
strings.translated: It was a shame I couldn't help her with my own hands, but if I left it to Saeko-chan, it would surely be all right.

strings.text: クラブ男性「瑛、ちょっといいか？
strings.translated: Club Man「Akira, got a minute?」

strings.text: 瑛「あっ、うん
strings.translated: Akira「Oh, yeah.

strings.text: 瑛「…紗英子ちゃん、またあとでね
strings.translated: Akira「...Saeko-chan, I'll see you later.

strings.text: その後、私はクラブの人達と楽しい時間を過ごした。
strings.translated: After that, I spent a pleasant time with the people at the Club.

strings.text: 戸田さんにもこんな時間をすごさせてあげられるといいんだけど
strings.translated: I hoped we could give Toda-san time like this too someday.

strings.text: 紗英子「こんな所ね」
strings.translated: Saeko「Right here.」

strings.text: 書類の束を片付けて、私は小さく溜息を漏らした。
strings.translated: I set aside the stack of documents and let out a small sigh.

strings.text: 今日の活動はこれで終わり。
strings.translated: Today's work was done.

strings.text: 細かい雑用が残ってるけど、それは明日にしよう。
strings.translated: There were still minor odds and ends left, but those could wait until tomorrow.

strings.text: 何だか身体が疲れてしまって、あまり頑張ろうという気力がわかなかった
strings.translated: My body was tired, and I couldn't quite summon the will to push any harder.

strings.text: 深い溜息が漏れる。
strings.translated: A deep sigh escaped me.

strings.text: 生徒会の活動を終えると、毎日がこんな感じだった。
strings.translated: Every day ended up like this once student council activities were over.

strings.text: 最近では、戸田さんのいじめについても考えているから、さらに疲労感が増してしまっていた
strings.translated: Lately, I had also been thinking about Toda-san's bullying situation, which only added to my exhaustion.

strings.text: 誰もいない生徒会室を出て、誰もいない廊下を歩く。
strings.translated: I left the empty student council room and walked down the empty hallway.

strings.text: だいぶ遅くなってしまったから、こんな時間でも校内に残ってるのは部活動をやってる人くらいだ。
strings.translated: It had gotten quite late, so the only people still in the building at this hour were those with club activities.

strings.text: もちろん、私は部活動なんてやっていない。
strings.translated: I, of course, had no club.

strings.text: 生徒会の活動をしてると、そんな暇はなかった。
strings.translated: Being in the student council left no time for that.

strings.text: もっとも、時間があってもやりたい部活動なんてなかったから、それを嫌だと感じたことはないのだけど
strings.translated: Though even if I'd had the time, there was no club I'd particularly wanted to join -- so I'd never resented it.

strings.text: 紗英子「何が面白いのかしら…」
strings.translated: Saeko「I wonder what's so fun about it...」

strings.text: 真面目に部活に取り組んでいる人達を見ると、どうしてそんなに熱中できるのか不思議でならなかった。
strings.translated: Watching people who seriously dedicate themselves to their clubs, I couldn't help but find it strange how they could be so absorbed in something like that.

strings.text: けど、それを人に理解してといってもわかってもらえるかどうかは疑問だ。
strings.translated: But even if I asked someone to understand that, I had my doubts as to whether they actually would.

strings.text: その理解をお互いにすること、させようとすることが私にとって無駄に感じるように、あの人達だって同じように無駄なことだと思うかもしれない。
strings.translated: Just as that mutual understanding -- trying to make each other understand -- felt pointless to me, those people might think the very same thing in return.

strings.text: それでも…機会があったら、あの人達は私に自分達がやっていることが如何に面白いかを語って聞かせ、理解させようとするだろう。
strings.translated: And yet... if given the chance, those people would surely tell me all about how fascinating what they do is, and try to make me understand.

strings.text: だったら、その時はその思いや考えを尊重して、許容するだけだ。
strings.translated: In that case, all I could do in those moments was respect their feelings and thoughts, and simply accept them.

strings.text: 例え、それが理解できなかったとしても。
strings.translated: Even if I couldn't truly understand them.

strings.text: また、私がやっている生徒会活動がなんで面白いのかを問われることがあったとしたら…それの答えを述べるのは簡単なことだろう。
strings.translated: And if I were ever asked why student council work was so interesting to me... answering that would be a simple enough thing.

strings.text: たとえ、それが相手に理解されなかったとしても。
strings.translated: Even if the other person couldn't understand it.

strings.text: 理解しようとしても理解できず、理解させようとしても理解してもらえず。
strings.translated: Trying to understand yet failing to, trying to make others understand yet failing at that too.

strings.text: そんなことは世の中には幾らでもある。
strings.translated: There's no shortage of things like that in this world.

strings.text: そして、それと同じように理解しようとする人間と、理解しようとしない人間がいる。
strings.translated: And just the same, there are people who try to understand, and people who don't.

strings.text: …ああ、理解できない人間、という見方もあるかもしれない。
strings.translated: Ah, though perhaps there's also the perspective of people who simply cannot understand.

strings.text: そういう意味では戸田さんは自分が置かれている境遇を他人に理解してもらうことを、その歪んだ承認欲求を満たして欲しいと考えている人間なんだろう
strings.translated: In that sense, Toda-san is probably the type of person who wants others to understand the circumstances she finds herself in -- someone who wants that warped need for validation satisfied.

strings.text: 不意に考えたことから戸田さんのことへとつい思い至ってしまい、そのことにも徒労感を覚えながら深々と溜息をついて、私は廊下の途中で足をとめた。
strings.translated: My thoughts drifted unbidden to Toda-san, and feeling the futility of that too, I let out a long, heavy sigh and stopped in the middle of the hallway.

strings.text: このまま家に帰っても、勉強する気にはなれないかもしれない。
strings.translated: Even if I went straight home, I probably wouldn't be able to bring myself to study.

strings.text: いや、確実になれないだろう。
strings.translated: No -- I was certain I wouldn't.

strings.text: それなら、このまま家に帰っても意味はないだろう。
strings.translated: If that was the case, there was no point in going straight home.

strings.text: だったら、もっと他に有意義に過ごせる方法があるんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe there was some other, more worthwhile way I could spend the time.

strings.text: そう考えた時、頭の中には２つの選択肢が浮かんだ。
strings.translated: When that thought crossed my mind, two options surfaced in my head.

strings.text: このまま家に帰るか、それともクラブに寄るか、という選択肢だ。
strings.translated: Go straight home, or stop by the Club -- those were my choices.

strings.text: 正直、身体は疲れてるから早く家に帰りたいんだけど、クラブに行けば少しは今のこの鬱屈した気持ちから解放されるような気もする。
strings.translated: Honestly, my body was tired and I wanted to get home soon, but I had a feeling that going to the Club might free me, at least a little, from this oppressive mood I was in.

strings.text: 普段、決して口には出せないけど、私はいつももがき苦しみながら生きているようにすら感じられていた
strings.translated: I would never say it aloud, but I always felt as though I were living while struggling and writhing in pain.

strings.text: 街中をふらふらと歩きながら、私の足は自然とクラブに向かっていた。
strings.translated: As I wandered aimlessly through the streets, my feet naturally carried me toward the Club.

strings.text: 結局、家に帰るのはやめにした。
strings.translated: In the end, I decided against going home.

strings.text: 帰ったところで、有意義に過ごせなければ意味はない。
strings.translated: There was no point in going back if I couldn't spend the time meaningfully.

strings.text: それならクラブで過ごした方が、なにかしら楽しめる出来事が起こるかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: If that was the case, spending it at the Club might lead to something enjoyable happening.

strings.text: これまでにクラブで体験してきたことに相対するように日常が本当につまらなく感じられていた。
strings.translated: Set against everything I had experienced at the Club up until now, everyday life felt genuinely dull.

strings.text: クラブにいる以外の時間には、あまり楽しいことが存在していない気がした。
strings.translated: It seemed like there was very little that was enjoyable in the hours I spent outside the Club.

strings.text: クラブの外ほとんど平凡な人か平凡を装う人しかいない。
strings.translated: Outside the Club, there were almost nothing but ordinary people, or people pretending to be ordinary.

strings.text: そんな人達がクラブの外で私に刺激や癒しを与えてくれる訳でもない。
strings.translated: Those kinds of people weren't about to offer me any stimulation or comfort outside the Club either.

strings.text: ただ、クラブの中だけは違っていた。
strings.translated: But inside the Club, it was different.

strings.text: 外では平凡を装っているかもしれない人も、クラブの中では違っていた。
strings.translated: Even people who might be pretending to be ordinary on the outside were different inside the Club.

strings.text: あの時、園田に誘われるままにクラブの扉をくぐっていなければ、そんな平凡な人達の中の退屈な日常の中だけに身を没していたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I hadn't stepped through the Club's door when Sonoda invited me that day, I might have remained submerged entirely in the dull, everyday world of those ordinary people.

strings.text: 私も、少しだけ平凡より抜きん出ただけの存在であることに甘んじながら。
strings.translated: Content to be just slightly above average myself -- nothing more.

strings.text: そうなる前にクラブの存在を知ることができたのは、悪くはなかったと思える。
strings.translated: I think it wasn't a bad thing that I came to know of the Club's existence before that happened.

strings.text: あそこになら非凡な誰かいて、非凡な体験をもたらしてくれる。
strings.translated: In that place, there was always someone extraordinary, someone who could bring extraordinary experiences.

strings.text: 私と直接の会話がなくても、誰かの話を聞きながら本を読んだりして過ごすことができる。
strings.translated: Even without directly conversing with anyone, I could spend the time listening to others' conversations while reading a book.

strings.text: 孤独でもなければ必要以上に干渉されることもない。
strings.translated: Neither lonely, nor intruded upon more than necessary.

strings.text: 嫌なことは嫌といえる。
strings.translated: I could say no to what I didn't want.

strings.text: そんな空間が、今の私には必要だったのかもしれない
strings.translated: Perhaps that kind of space was what I needed right now.

strings.text: クラブの部屋には、見知った顔が何人かいた。
strings.translated: There were several familiar faces in the Club's room.

strings.text: 性格の軽い男の子。
strings.translated: A boy with a breezy personality.

strings.text: いつも笑っている女の子。
strings.translated: A girl who was always smiling.

strings.text: かなり、セックスに依存している男の子。
strings.translated: A boy who was quite heavily dependent on sex.

strings.text: 他にも派手な服を着た、学校では言葉を交わすことも滅多にないようなタイプの女の子の姿もあった。
strings.translated: There were also girls in flashy clothes -- the type I would rarely exchange a word with at school.

strings.text: 相変わらずの光景。
strings.translated: The same scene as always.

strings.text: クラブの雰囲気が変わってなくて、私は少しだけ安心感を覚えた。
strings.translated: The atmosphere of the Club hadn't changed, and I felt a small measure of relief at that.

strings.text: ここが妙な変化を、急激な変化をしてしまったら、私は自分の行き場を見失ってしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: If this place were to change strangely, drastically -- I might lose my sense of where I belonged.

strings.text: そうならないようにこのクラブが存在していてくれることは、悪くはないことだった
strings.translated: The fact that this Club existed to prevent that from happening was not a bad thing at all.

strings.text: 誰も座っていないソファーを見つけて、私はそこに腰を下ろした。
strings.translated: I found an empty sofa and lowered myself onto it.

strings.text: 誰かと話したいとか、セックスしたいとか、そんなふうに思ってたわけじゃない。
strings.translated: It wasn't as though I wanted to talk to someone, or have sex, or anything like that.

strings.text: ただ、今日は家に帰っても夜まで１人だから、何となくそれを寂しいと感じたのかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: It was just that today I'd be alone until night even if I went home, and maybe I felt a vague loneliness about that.

strings.text: 自分が１人ではないという絶妙な距離感を感じられるこの空間が、結局のところ私は好きなのだろう。
strings.translated: I suppose I simply like this space -- the way it offers just the right sense of distance to remind me that I'm not alone.

strings.text: それがなににも変えがたいと思っているからこそ、こうしてこのクラブに通ってしまうのだろう。
strings.translated: Because I feel that nothing else can replace that, I keep coming back to this Club like this.

strings.text: 今日のように鬱屈した気持ちのままここに来てしまうと、改めてそれを感じることができた。
strings.translated: Coming here on a day like today, with this gloomy feeling weighing on me, I was able to feel that all over again.

strings.text: 不意に話しかけてくる人がいたとしても私が会話を続ける意思を見せなければ、そのまま無理に会話を続けようとしないのも、このクラブの人達の良いところだった。
strings.translated: Another good thing about the people in this Club was that even if someone happened to speak to me out of the blue, they wouldn't force the conversation to continue if I showed no interest in keeping it going.

strings.text: おかげで、私は自分の時間を持つことができる。
strings.translated: Thanks to that, I'm able to have time to myself.

strings.text: 好きなだけ考えて、好きなだけ本を読んで、好きなだけに耳に入ってくる話を聞くことができた。
strings.translated: I could think as much as I liked, read as much as I liked, and listen to whatever conversations drifted into my ears.

strings.text: 当たり前だけど、みんな自分の好きに過ごしている。
strings.translated: It goes without saying, but everyone here spends their time however they please.

strings.text: 誰かと喋ったり、勉強をしたり、本を読んだり、セックスをしたり…。
strings.translated: Talking with someone, studying, reading, having sex...

strings.text: 今日は特に激しく絡んでいる人達がいて、部屋の隅にいる男女が荒々しく体を動かしていた
strings.translated: Today there were people entangled particularly intensely, and a man and woman in the corner of the room were moving their bodies roughly.

strings.text: 女性のほうの声には聞き覚えがあった。
strings.translated: I recognized the woman's voice.

strings.text: 私のよく知る声だった。
strings.translated: It was a voice I knew well.

strings.text: その声のした方をよく見てみると、女装した桧垣君が男の人と交わっている。
strings.translated: Looking more carefully in the direction of that voice, I saw Hishiki-kun, dressed as a woman, entwined with a man.

strings.text: このクラブでは、彼は女の子として扱われている。
strings.translated: In this Club, he is treated as a girl.

strings.text: たぶん、瑛さんはこのクラブの中でも、わかりやすいほどに救われた人物の１人だ。
strings.translated: Akira-san is probably one of the most visibly saved people even within this Club.

strings.text: 学校で見てるよりも、このクラブにいるときのほうが彼女は活き活きとしている
strings.translated: She seems far more alive when she's here in the Club than when I see her at school.

strings.text: 紗英子「救い…か
strings.translated: Saeko「...Salvation, huh.」

strings.text: 何気なく部屋の中を見回していると、ちょうどドアを開けて入ってくる人影があった
strings.translated: I was idly scanning the room when the door opened and a figure stepped inside.

strings.text: 意外だったのは、それが白坂大智さんと神村愛さんだったことだ。
strings.translated: What surprised me was that it was Daichi Shiraka-san and Ai Kamimura-san.

strings.text: あの２人がクラスメイトだというのは知ってたけど、２人でクラブに来るような仲だったなんて…。
strings.translated: I knew those two were classmates, but I had no idea they were close enough to come to the Club together...

strings.text: でも、救いを求めて来たにしては、白坂さんの表情は驚きに満ちていた
strings.translated: Still, for someone who had come seeking salvation, Shiraka-san's expression was filled with shock.

strings.text: 彼の視線の先にあるのは…男と交わる瑛さんの姿…。
strings.translated: What his gaze was fixed on was... Akira-san's figure, entwined with a man...

strings.text: あの反応からすると、今初めて瑛さんのことを知ったのかもしれなかった
strings.translated: Judging by that reaction, he might have just learned about Akira-san for the very first time.

strings.text: 確かに瑛さんがいっているように、一旦、学校の中での救いは様子を見ながら進めて、先ずは、このクラブでの救いを与えるという方法も悪くはない。
strings.translated: Indeed, as Akira was saying, it wasn't a bad approach to first watch how things developed with the rescue inside school, and in the meantime give her the salvation that the Club could offer.

strings.text: むしろ、そのほうが手っ取り早そうだったし、湯沢さんや藤原さん達がここまで来る可能性もゼロに等しいはずだ。
strings.translated: If anything, that seemed like the more straightforward path, and the chances of Yuzawa-san or Fujiwara-san coming all the way here were practically zero.

strings.text: それで学校での生活がどうなるかはわからないけど、少なくともクラブの中ではいじめられない時間を作ってあげることができる
strings.translated: What would happen with her school life as a result, I couldn't say -- but at the very least, we could give her time within the Club where she wouldn't be bullied.

strings.text: 瑛さんが当然のようにいっていることに、ここまで来て私はふと考え込んでしまった。
strings.translated: Having come this far, I found myself suddenly lost in thought over what Akira was saying so matter-of-factly.

strings.text: 戸田さんをここに連れて来て救うということは、もはや生徒会の活動を大きく外れた行為といえる。
strings.translated: Bringing Toda-san here and saving her was already an act that had strayed far beyond the scope of student council activities.

strings.text: それなのに、瑛さんは自分から率先して、彼女に声をかけることを選んでいた。
strings.translated: And yet, Akira had chosen, of her own initiative, to reach out and speak to her.

strings.text: 何故？
strings.translated: Why?

strings.text: どうして、他人のためにそこまで動こうと思えるのか？
strings.translated: How could she bring herself to go that far for someone else's sake?

strings.text: 学校の外での行動になるのに、何のためらいもないのだろうか？
strings.translated: Didn't she have any hesitation, even knowing this would mean acting outside of school?

strings.text: 戸田さんを救うことは、瑛さんにとってどれほどの意味があるのだろうか？
strings.translated: Just how much meaning did saving Toda-san hold for Akira?

strings.text: …と、そこまで考えて、私はふと小野田さんが白坂さんをクラブに引き入れたことを思い出した。
strings.translated: ...Having thought that far, I suddenly recalled that Onoda-san had drawn Shirasaka-san into the Club.

strings.text: 彼女は、どうしてそこまでやったのだろう？
strings.translated: Why had she gone that far?

strings.text: 県外の人間を引越してこさせてまで、どうして救おうと思ったのだろう？
strings.translated: Why had she wanted to save her so badly that she'd had someone move in from another prefecture?

strings.text: それに小野田さんが白坂さんをクラブへと誘い、そして救いの名の元に変えてしまっていたことが私の頭の中で引っかかる。
strings.translated: And it nagged at me -- the fact that Onoda-san had invited Shirasaka-san into the Club and, in the name of salvation, had changed her.

strings.text: そして、それ以前に小野田さんが白坂さんに救いの手を差し伸べてからの日々が楽しそうに見えてもいた。
strings.translated: And before all that, the days since Onoda-san had extended her hand to save Shirasaka-san had seemed genuinely happy ones.

strings.text: もし、私にも小野田さんと同じように、いや、それ以上の手際で戸田さんを救うことができたら？
strings.translated: What if I could save Toda-san with the same skill as Onoda-san -- no, with even greater finesse?

strings.text: それは今の退屈を払拭してくれるかもしれない、という考えが内心に沸きあがってくる。
strings.translated: The thought welled up inside me that this might be something to sweep away my current boredom.

strings.text: そう…私が戸田さんをクラブへと≪誘／いざな≫って、それで彼女を変えてしまうことができたとしたら…。
strings.translated: Yes... if I could lure Toda-san into the Club, and in doing so change her completely...

strings.text: 小野田さんがしたように、誰かの人生を大きく揺り動かして、支配して、影響を与えることができたとしたら…。
strings.translated: Just as Onoda-san had done -- if I could greatly shake someone's life, dominate it, leave my mark upon it...

strings.text: そんな「遊び」
strings.translated: That kind of "fun"

strings.text: ができたとしたら…？
strings.translated: If I could play that kind of "game"...?

strings.text: だとしたら…と思い巡らせると、私もそれを試してみたくなってしまっていた
strings.translated: When I let my thoughts wander to that possibility... I found myself wanting to try it.

strings.text: 紗英子ちゃん忙しいでしょう？」
strings.translated: You're busy, aren't you, Saeko?」

strings.text: 瑛さんは私の考えに思い至りもしなかったようだ。
strings.translated: Akira didn't seem to have considered what I was thinking at all.

strings.text: ただ、私のことを心配してくれている
strings.translated: She's simply worried about me.

strings.text: 湯沢さんを悪い意味で刺激することにもなりそうだし」
strings.translated: It also seems like it could provoke Yuzawa-san in a bad way.」

strings.text: 瑛さんを説得するためのいいわけでもあるけれど、事実でもある。
strings.translated: It was also an excuse to persuade Akira, but it was also the truth.

strings.text: 学校での瑛さんは大抵の女の子に好感を抱かれる。
strings.translated: At school, Akira tends to be well-liked by most girls.

strings.text: それは湯沢さんも例外ではなくて、「憧れの桧垣先輩」
strings.translated: Yuzawa-san was no exception to that -- "the admired Higaki-senpai" --

strings.text: が、自分を差し置いて戸田さんに声をかけたとなれば、彼女の憎しみはいや増すかもしれない
strings.translated: if it got out that she had approached Toda-san instead of her, Yuzawa-san's resentment might only grow stronger.

strings.text: 瑛さんは少し驚いた様子だったけど、私の話の内容には納得してくれたようだった
strings.translated: Akira seemed a little surprised, but she appeared to accept what I was saying.

strings.text: そう答えると、私は瑛さんを安心させるように笑顔を浮かべてみせた。
strings.translated: With that answer, I put on a smile to reassure Akira.

strings.text: でも、その笑顔の本当の意味は違っていた。
strings.translated: But the true meaning behind that smile was something different.

strings.text: 楽しいことが、退屈をしのげることがはじまるかもしれない。
strings.translated: Something fun, something to stave off boredom, might be about to begin.

strings.text: その予感にささやかな喜びを感じ、それが私を微笑ませていた
strings.translated: I felt a quiet joy at that premonition, and it was that which made me smile.

strings.text: 友佳「ただいまー」
strings.translated: Yuka「I'm back~」

strings.text: 瑛さんとの話を終えてぼんやりと過ごしていると、白坂さんと小野田さんが部屋に入ってきた。
strings.translated: After my conversation with Akira had ended and I was idly passing the time, Shirasaka-san and Onoda-san came into the room.

strings.text: クラブから出かけて戻ってきた２人は、クラブの外で誰ともしれない男を相手に身体を交えてきた後かもしれない。
strings.translated: The two of them had gone out from the Club and returned -- and they may well have just finished letting their bodies be used by some unknown man out there in the world.

strings.text: そんな雰囲気すら漂わせているように感じられる。
strings.translated: They seemed to carry that very atmosphere about them.

strings.text: あの２人はいつも楽しそうだ。
strings.translated: Those two always look like they're having fun.

strings.text: 学校でもクラスも学年も違うのによく一緒にいて、常に何かの話をしながら笑っている。
strings.translated: They're in different classes and different years at school, yet they're always together, always laughing while talking about something or other.

strings.text: そして…あの２人が共に強姦事件の被害者だという話は、私も聞いていた。
strings.translated: And... I had heard the story too -- that those two had both been victims of a rape.

strings.text: 一時は相当絶望しただろうに、今はあんなにも晴れやかな笑顔を浮かべることができているのは、やはりこのクラブの影響なのだろうか。
strings.translated: They must have been utterly devastated for a time, and yet now they could wear such bright, radiant smiles -- was that really the influence of this Club?

strings.text: でも、彼女達は本当の意味で救われたのだろうか？
strings.translated: But had they truly been saved, in any real sense?

strings.text: 強姦事件の恐怖や苦痛を、本当の意味で乗り越えることができたのだろうか？
strings.translated: Had they truly been able to overcome the fear and pain of what had been done to them?

strings.text: それができたのなら、それは彼女達にとっては喜ばしい話なのかもしれないけど、私にはどうにも拭えない違和感があった。
strings.translated: If they had, then perhaps that was something to be glad of for their sake -- but I couldn't shake a certain unease that simply wouldn't go away.

strings.text: 私がまったく救われてはいない、とはいわない。
strings.translated: I won't say that I haven't been saved at all.

strings.text: でも、常に満足するほどに救われているかと問われれば、まだそこまでは救われきっていないとも答えると思う。
strings.translated: But if asked whether I feel saved enough to be fully satisfied, I think I would answer that I haven't quite reached that point yet.

strings.text: そう思うと、彼女達はただこのクラブが、そして、ここで与えられたセックスの快楽が過去の強姦事件の記憶を紛らわせているだけなんじゃないか、と思えた。
strings.translated: Thinking that, it seemed to me that those two were simply letting this Club -- and the pleasure of the sex given to them here -- distract them from the memories of what had happened to them.

strings.text: もしも、そうだったとしたら…あの２人はあまりにも単純だ。
strings.translated: If that were the case... those two were far too simple.

strings.text: でも、私はそんなに単純ではいられなかった。
strings.translated: But I couldn't be that simple.

strings.text: だから悩まされ、考え続けてしまう。
strings.translated: And so I was tormented, and kept on thinking.

strings.text: そして、そんな苦しみを味わえるのは、結局のところ私のような人間だけだったのかもしれない
strings.translated: And perhaps the only ones who could ever taste that kind of suffering were, in the end, people like me.

strings.text: 美桜「ああ…すっごく楽しかった
strings.translated: Mio「Ahh... that was so much fun.

strings.text: 友佳「なんか面白いおじさんだったね
strings.translated: Yuka「He was kind of a funny old man, wasn't he.

strings.text: 美桜「本当に。
strings.translated: Mio「He really was.

strings.text: ……ふふっ。
strings.translated: Hehe.

strings.text: 友佳がお風呂に入ってるときにね、おちんちんが小さいのをずーっと気にしてて、「大丈夫かな？」
strings.translated: When Yuka was in the bath, he kept worrying the whole time about how small his thing was, asking, "Is it okay?"

strings.text: って聞いてくるの。
strings.translated: He kept asking me that.

strings.text: ちょっとかわいかった
strings.translated: It was kind of cute.

strings.text: 友佳「ほんと？
strings.translated: Yuka「Really?

strings.text: あははっ！
strings.translated: Ahaha!

strings.text: そんなの全然気にしないのにねぇ
strings.translated: Like, nobody even cares about that at all, you know.

strings.text: 美桜「ねぇ？
strings.translated: Mio「Right?

strings.text: あんなおじさんなのに……男の人っておかしいわね
strings.translated: And he's such an old man too... men are so strange, aren't they.

strings.text: そんなやりとりをしながら小野田さんは白坂さんのことをじっと見つめていた
strings.translated: As they exchanged those words, Onoda-san kept her gaze fixed quietly on Shiraka-san.

strings.text: 美桜「…何？」
strings.translated: Mio「...What?」

strings.text: 白坂さんは、そんな小野田さんの視線に気付いたのか、小首を傾げて問いかける
strings.translated: Shiraka-san must have noticed Onoda-san's gaze, because she tilted her head slightly and asked.

strings.text: 友佳「良かった。
strings.translated: Yuka「I'm glad.

strings.text: 美桜が元気になってくれて」
strings.translated: I'm glad you've gotten your energy back, Mio.」

strings.text: そういって小野田さんは、慈愛に満ちたといっても差し支えないような笑顔を浮かべ、白坂さんへと向けた
strings.translated: Saying that, Onoda-san turned toward Shiraka-san with a smile that could only be described as full of tender affection.

strings.text: 美桜「友佳のおかげよ。
strings.translated: Mio「It's all thanks to Yuka.

strings.text: まるで、１０年来の親友のように話す２人。
strings.translated: The two of them talked like friends of ten years.

strings.text: そこには、誰も侵すことのできない領域があるような、そんな空気を漂わせていた
strings.translated: There was an air between them of a space no one else could enter.

strings.text: 白坂さんが嬉しそうなのはわかるけど、それ以上に小野田さんが嬉しそうにしているのは何故なのだろう？
strings.translated: I could understand why Shiraka-san looked happy, but why was Onoda-san looking even happier than her?

strings.text: やはり、自分の力で誰かを救えたということが、変えることができたということが、そんなにも幸せに感じることだったのだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it truly that fulfilling -- the fact that she had saved someone through her own efforts, that she had been able to change something?

strings.text: そんなことを思いながら、私は再び戸田さんのことを思い出す。
strings.translated: Thinking such things, I found myself once again recalling Toda-san.

strings.text: 彼女を救ってあげるということは、もしかして、あの２人のような関係になると言うことなのだろうか。
strings.translated: Could saving her mean, perhaps, becoming the kind of relationship those two had?

strings.text: もしも、そうだとしたら、さすがに私には無理かもしれないという気がしてくる。
strings.translated: If that were the case, I was beginning to feel that it might be beyond what I was capable of.

strings.text: 誰かとあんなふうに仲良くすることが、それほどに他人を信用することが、私にできるのだろうか、という思いが頭を過ぎっていった。
strings.translated: The thought drifted through my mind -- could I really get that close to someone, could I really trust another person to that degree?

strings.text: とにかく、私の目的は今の満たされない心の中を満たすこと。
strings.translated: In any case, my goal was to fill the emptiness inside me that remained unsatisfied.

strings.text: 戸田さんのことは、その目的を達成するための手段に過ぎないのだ。
strings.translated: Toda-san was nothing more than a means to achieve that goal.

strings.text: 彼女と本当に仲良くなったり、なんでもいい合えるような関係になるのが目的ではない。
strings.translated: My purpose was not to truly become close to her, or to reach the kind of relationship where we could say anything to each other.

strings.text: 戸田さんの一件で、どれだけ私が満たされるかはわからない。
strings.translated: I had no idea how much satisfaction the Toda-san affair would bring me.

strings.text: もしかすると、満たされずに一歩も近づけないかもしれない。
strings.translated: It was possible I might come away unsatisfied, without making even a single step forward.

strings.text: でも、今はそれでいい。
strings.translated: But that's fine for now.

strings.text: 他にこれといってやることもないのだから、やってみるだけの価値はあるはずだった。
strings.translated: Since there was nothing else in particular for me to do, it had to be worth at least trying.

strings.text: それに、大して難しいことでもない。
strings.translated: Besides, it wasn't all that difficult.

strings.text: 戸田さんに声をかけて、このクラブへと連れて来るだけ。
strings.translated: All I had to do was approach Toda-san and bring her to this Club.

strings.text: それだけのことなのだから…。
strings.translated: That was all there was to it...

strings.text: 連れてくれば園田も手助けしてくれるだろうし、これといった心配事はなかった。
strings.translated: Once I brought her, Sonoda would surely help as well, so there was nothing in particular to worry about.

strings.text: さて、明日はどうやって戸田さんに声をかけて、ここまで誘おうか…。
strings.translated: Now then -- how should I approach Toda-san tomorrow and invite her here...?

strings.text: 親身になって説得するか、それとも生徒会長という立場を利用して強引に連れて来るか。
strings.translated: Should I persuade her earnestly and sincerely, or use my position as student council president to bring her in by force?

strings.text: その時の戸田さんの反応をひとつひとつ考えていると、なんだかこうやって考えていることすらも楽しくなってきてしまった。
strings.translated: As I thought through each possible reaction Toda-san might have, I found that even just sitting here thinking about it was starting to feel enjoyable.

strings.text: 今から私が１人の人間の人生を変えようとしているのだと思うと、久しく味わっていない興奮がわき上がってきた。
strings.translated: When I considered that I was about to change one person's life, an excitement I hadn't tasted in a long time welled up inside me.

strings.text: 果たして、私は満たされて、その時、園田の言う「真の救いの扉」
strings.translated: Would I truly be fulfilled -- and at that moment, would what Sonoda called "the door to true salvation"

strings.text: とやらは私の前に現れるのだろうか？
strings.translated: actually appear before me?

strings.text: そんな期待と興奮を胸に抱きながら、私は柔らかく微笑んでいた。
strings.translated: Holding such anticipation and excitement in my chest, I smiled softly.

strings.text: ああ、明日、学校に行くのが本当に楽しみだ
strings.translated: Ah, I was truly looking forward to going to school tomorrow.

strings.text: 美桜「はぁ
strings.translated: Mio「Haa...」

strings.text: クラブの人達とのセックスを終えて、私は部屋の隅にある椅子に腰かけた。
strings.translated: After finishing sex with the Club members, I sat down in a chair in the corner of the room.

strings.text: こっちに引越して来て以来、毎日がすごく充実している。
strings.translated: Ever since I moved to this town, every day has felt so fulfilling.

strings.text: 友佳には本当に感謝してるし、園田先生にもすごく感謝していた
strings.translated: I'm truly grateful to Yuka, and I was deeply grateful to Sonoda-sensei as well.

strings.text: ここの生活にはもう慣れた？
strings.translated: Have you gotten used to living here yet?

strings.text: 美桜「ええ、だいぶ慣れたわ。
strings.translated: Mio「Yes, I've gotten quite used to it.

strings.text: 私よりも、大智のほうがちゃんとやってるか心配なくらいよ
strings.translated: I'm more worried about whether Daichi is managing properly than about myself.

strings.text: あなたをここに連れて来て、本当に正解だった」
strings.translated: Bringing you here was absolutely the right call.」

strings.text: 日々、確実に救われていく私を見て、友佳は本当に嬉しそうだった。
strings.translated: Watching me be saved a little more each day, Yuka looked genuinely happy.

strings.text: 彼女は人のためになる事をするのが本当に好きな性格をしてるみたいだった。
strings.translated: She really seemed to be the kind of person who loves doing things for others.

strings.text: どうして彼女のような人間が、あんな事件の被害者になってしまったのか。
strings.translated: Why did someone like her have to become the victim of something like that.

strings.text: 考えても仕方ないことだけど、そう思わずにはいられなかった
strings.translated: It's pointless to think about, but I couldn't help feeling that way.

strings.text: 園田「友佳君、ちょっといいかな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Yuka-kun, do you have a moment?」

strings.text: なんでしょうか？
strings.translated: What is it?

strings.text: 園田「すまないが、私の部屋まで来てくれるかな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Sorry to trouble you, but could you come to my room?」

strings.text: 友佳「わかりました」
strings.translated: Yuka「Of course.」

strings.text: 友佳と話をしていると、園田先生が声をかけてきた。
strings.translated: While I was talking with Yuka, Sonoda-sensei called out to her.

strings.text: わざわざ話す場所を変えるなんて珍しい。
strings.translated: It's unusual for him to go out of his way to change locations to talk.

strings.text: 友佳にどんな話があるんだろう
strings.translated: I wonder what he has to say to Yuka.

strings.text: 友佳「ごめん。
strings.translated: Yuka「Sorry.

strings.text: ちょっと行ってくるわね
strings.translated: I'll be right back.

strings.text: 美桜「うん、ここで待ってるから
strings.translated: Mio「Sure, I'll wait here.」

strings.text: どんな話か気になったけど、呼ばれてるのは友佳だけなんだから私まで一緒に行くわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: I was curious what it was about, but since it was only Yuka who was called, I couldn't very well go along too.

strings.text: 話せる内容ならあとで話してくれるだろうし、それを楽しみにすることにした
strings.translated: If it was something she could share, she'd tell me afterward, and I decided to look forward to that.

strings.text: 美桜「楽しみに、か…」
strings.translated: Mio「"Looking forward to it," huh...」

strings.text: 心の中にある余裕を感じて、私は小さな声でつぶやいた。
strings.translated: Sensing a certain ease within my heart, I murmured softly to myself.

strings.text: この街に引越して来て以来、自分がどんどん元気になっているのがわかる。
strings.translated: Ever since I moved to this town, I can feel myself getting better and better with each passing day.

strings.text: 今では強姦事件のこともあまり思い出さなくなって、辛い記憶が楽しい時間で上書きされてしまったような気分だった。
strings.translated: By now I rarely think about the rape anymore -- it was as if the painful memories had been overwritten by all the happy times.

strings.text: それどころか、私を犯した男の人に対しても、何だか哀れみのような気持ちさえ持ってしまっている。
strings.translated: More than that, I even found myself feeling something like pity toward the man who violated me.

strings.text: あの人は知らないんだ。
strings.translated: He doesn't know.

strings.text: 世の中には本当の意味での救いがあって、それを理解するととても幸せになれるってことが…。
strings.translated: That there is true salvation in this world, and that understanding it can make you truly happy...

strings.text: 幸せを知らないからあんな行動に出て、自分の人生を穢していくしか生きる術を持たないんだって…。
strings.translated: That because he doesn't know happiness, he could only act the way he did -- defiling his own life, with no other way to live...

strings.text: 普通はこんなふうには思えないんだろうけど、クラブによって目覚めた私には過去はただ単に過ぎ去った出来事でしかなくなっていた
strings.translated: Most people probably couldn't think this way, but for me, awakened by the Club, the past had become nothing more than something that had simply passed.

strings.text: 美桜「不思議な人生…」
strings.translated: Mio「What a strange life...」

strings.text: 強姦事件に遭ったときは、この世の終わりという感じがしていた。
strings.translated: When the rape happened, it felt like the end of the world.

strings.text: 全ての希望を打ち砕かれて、早く死ぬことばかり考えていた。
strings.translated: All my hopes had been shattered, and all I could think about was dying as soon as possible.

strings.text: でも、まさか自殺サイトを巡っていた結果が、こんな未来に繋がるなんて…。
strings.translated: But to think that wandering through suicide sites would lead to a future like this...

strings.text: セックスの喜びも知ることができたし、自分がすごく満たされている感じがした。
strings.translated: I got to know the joy of sex, and I felt so deeply fulfilled.

strings.text: もう何も怖くない。
strings.translated: Nothing scares me anymore.

strings.text: 私は、これからの人生を幸せに過ごしていくことができる。
strings.translated: I can live the rest of my life in happiness.

strings.text: それをするだけの心の強さと、大きな支えを得ることができた。
strings.translated: I gained the strength of heart and the great support needed to do just that.

strings.text: クラブと、友佳と…そして、園田先生に出会えたことを、今は神様にでも感謝したい気分だった
strings.translated: The Club, Yuka... and Sonoda-sensei -- right now, I felt like I wanted to thank even God for having met them.

strings.text: 美桜「あとは、大智にも理解してもらえるといいんだけど…」
strings.translated: Mio「I just hope Daichi can come to understand too...」

strings.text: 当面の問題は、大智がクラブに来てしまったことだ。
strings.translated: The immediate problem is that Daichi ended up coming to the Club.

strings.text: しかも、私が先生とセックスしてるところを見てしまったものだから、クラブと先生に対する不信感が募ってしまっている。
strings.translated: On top of that, he happened to see me having sex with Sensei, so his distrust of both the Club and Sensei has only been growing.

strings.text: もう少し段階を踏めば、大智も理解しやすかったと思うのだけど
strings.translated: If we had taken things a little more step by step, I think Daichi would have found it easier to understand -- but...

strings.text: 美桜「どうやって説得しよう…あの様子だと、頭ごなしにここが悪いところだって言ってくるだろうし
strings.translated: Mio「How am I supposed to convince her... Knowing how she is, she'll probably just come in and tell me outright that this place is bad...

strings.text: 美桜「昔から自分の考えを変えない頑固なところがあるし…」
strings.translated: Mio「She's always been stubborn about never changing her mind...」

strings.text: 最近の一番の悩みの種かもしれない。
strings.translated: That might be my biggest worry lately.

strings.text: 果たして、大智を説得する方法はあるんだろうか。
strings.translated: I wonder if there's any way to convince Daichi.

strings.text: それとも、こういった問題も園田先生と話したほうがいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Or maybe I should talk to Sonoda-sensei about this kind of problem too.

strings.text: 身内のことで迷惑をかけるのも申し訳ないけど、放置した結果さらに問題が大きくなったら大変だ。
strings.translated: I'd feel bad troubling her with family matters, but if I just leave it alone and things get worse, that would be terrible.

strings.text: どうするのが一番良い方法なのか、もっと真剣に考えなければならないのかも知れなかった
strings.translated: I might need to think more seriously about what the best course of action is.

strings.text: 美桜「お帰りなさい
strings.translated: Mio「Welcome back.

strings.text: 美桜「友佳？」
strings.translated: Mio「Yuka？」

strings.text: 友佳が戻ってきたけど、明らかに様子がおかしかった。
strings.translated: Yuka came back, but something was clearly off about her.

strings.text: 心ここに在らずといった感じで、何だかぼんやりした表情を浮かべている
strings.translated: She had a kind of distant, dazed expression on her face, like her mind was somewhere else entirely.

strings.text: 美桜「友佳？
strings.translated: Mio「Yuka？

strings.text: どうしたの？
strings.translated: What's wrong?

strings.text: 友佳「私…どうしよう
strings.translated: Yuka「I... what should I do...

strings.text: 美桜「どうしようって…何があったの？
strings.translated: Mio「What do you mean, what should you do... what happened？

strings.text: 園田先生に、何を言われたの？
strings.translated: What did Sonoda-sensei say to you?

strings.text: 友佳「私、園田先生から…役目を与えられちゃった
strings.translated: Yuka「Sonoda-sensei gave me... a role.

strings.text: 美桜「役目？
strings.translated: Mio「A role？

strings.text: 役目って、もしかして認められた人にしか与えてもらえないっていうアレのこと？
strings.translated: A role -- could it be that thing, the one that's only given to people who've been recognized?
