strings.text: 友佳「それ。
strings.translated: Yuka「That's the one.

strings.text: それのこと。
strings.translated: That's the one.

strings.text: 私、園田先生から頼まれちゃったの
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei asked me to take it on.

strings.text: 私と話しながら、友佳の顔が徐々に喜びに満ち溢れていく。
strings.translated: As she talked with me, Yuka's face gradually filled with joy.

strings.text: それは、園田先生に信用してもらった証。
strings.translated: It was proof that Sonoda-sensei trusted you.

strings.text: クラブのために行動できるって認められた人にしか役目は与えられないって、以前友佳自身から聞いたことがある
strings.translated: I had heard from Yuka herself before that a role was only given to someone who had been recognized as someone who could act on behalf of the Club.

strings.text: 美桜「本当っ！
strings.translated: Mio「Really！

strings.text: 本当なのっ！
strings.translated: Really?!

strings.text: おめでとう、友佳っ！
strings.translated: Congratulations, Yuka!

strings.text: 友佳のすごさは私にもわかった。
strings.translated: Even I could see how amazing Yuka was.

strings.text: だって、これは誰もができることじゃない。
strings.translated: Because this isn't something just anyone can do.

strings.text: 園田先生から、友佳が信用してもらったから役目が与えられたのだ。
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei gave Yuka a role because she had earned her trust.

strings.text: 彼女のような人と友人でいられることが、私はとても誇らしかった
strings.translated: I felt so proud to be friends with someone like her.

strings.text: 美桜「どんな役目なの？
strings.translated: Mio「What kind of role is it？

strings.text: 園田先生からどんなことを頼まれたの？
strings.translated: What did Sonoda-sensei ask you to do?

strings.text: 友佳「ん～、どうしようかなぁ。
strings.translated: Yuka「Hmm~, I wonder if I should say.

strings.text: 大事な役目だしなぁ～
strings.translated: It is an important role after all~.

strings.text: 美桜「ええっ？
strings.translated: Mio「Eeh？

strings.text: 教えてくれたっていいじゃない
strings.translated: You could at least tell me, couldn't you?

strings.text: 友佳「う～ん、でもねぇ～
strings.translated: Yuka「Hmm~, but you see~...

strings.text: 美桜「お願い。
strings.translated: Mio「Please.

strings.text: ちょっとだけ。
strings.translated: Just a little.

strings.text: ヒント…ヒントは…？
strings.translated: A hint... a hint...?

strings.text: 友佳「あははははっ！」
strings.translated: Yuka「Ahahahahaha！」

strings.text: 友佳が楽しそうに笑った。
strings.translated: Yuka laughed happily.

strings.text: 私も楽しくて笑った。
strings.translated: I laughed too because I was having so much fun.

strings.text: こんなに楽しくていいのかなって、そう思わずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but think -- is it really okay to be this happy?

strings.text: これから先も、こんなふうにして過ごしていきたい。
strings.translated: I want to keep spending time like this going forward.

strings.text: クラブの人達と一緒に、楽しく笑い合いながら自分の生きる意味を見出していきたい。
strings.translated: Together with the people of the Club, laughing and enjoying ourselves, finding the meaning of my own life.

strings.text: そして、私もいつかは友佳みたいに役目を与えられて…そんな幸せな日が来るのを、想像せずには居られなかった
strings.translated: And someday, maybe I'll be given a role too, just like Yuka... I couldn't help but imagine that kind of happy day coming.

strings.text: 美桜「ただいま」
strings.translated: Mio「I'm home.」

strings.text: いつもより少し遅い時間になって、私は家に帰った。
strings.translated: It was a little later than usual when I got back home.

strings.text: 今日は本当に素晴らしい日だったから、いつもよりも気分が高揚してしまっている
strings.translated: Today had been such a wonderful day that I was in higher spirits than normal.

strings.text: 大智「お帰り」
strings.translated: Daichi「Welcome home.」

strings.text: 居間に入ると、大智が沈んだ表情で出迎えてくれた
strings.translated: When I walked into the living room, Daichi greeted me with a downcast expression.

strings.text: 美桜「遅くなってごめんね。
strings.translated: Mio「Sorry I'm late.

strings.text: すぐに夕飯の支度するから
strings.translated: I'll get dinner ready right away.

strings.text: 大智に何か言われる前に、家での仕事に取りかかる。
strings.translated: Before Daichi could say anything, I got to work on the household chores.

strings.text: 今日の献立はまだ考えていなかったから、冷蔵庫の中身と相談しながら決めなければならない。
strings.translated: I hadn't thought about what to make for dinner yet, so I'd have to figure it out based on what was in the fridge.

strings.text: 本当は、私としても大智にクラブについて理解してほしかったけど、今はまだ聞く耳を持ってくれていない。
strings.translated: Honestly, I wanted Daichi to understand about the Club too, but right now he still wasn't willing to listen.

strings.text: 最近は神村さんと一緒にいるみたいだから、彼女から説明してくれると助かるんだけど
strings.translated: It seemed like he'd been spending time with Kamimura-san lately, so it would help if she could explain things to him.

strings.text: 芽生「あっ、お姉ちゃん、帰ってたんだ
strings.translated: Mei「Oh, sis, you're back.」

strings.text: すぐに夕飯作るから
strings.translated: I'll make dinner right away.

strings.text: 大智と違って、芽生はいつでも元気だ。
strings.translated: Unlike Daichi, Mei was always full of energy.

strings.text: この様子だと、学校でも上手くいってるらしい。
strings.translated: From the look of things, she seemed to be doing well at school too.

strings.text: お父さんもお母さんも私が元気そうにしていると嬉しそうだし、本当に我が家の問題は大智だけだった
strings.translated: Mom and Dad always looked happy when they saw me seeming cheerful, and honestly, the only real problem in our household was Daichi.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん、今いいかな？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Hey, sis, do you have a minute?」

strings.text: 夕食を終えて部屋でのんびりと過ごしていると、大智がドアをノックしてきた。
strings.translated: After dinner, while I was relaxing in my room, Daichi knocked on the door.

strings.text: 何の話をしに来たのかはもちろんわかってる。
strings.translated: I obviously knew what he'd come to talk about.

strings.text: すんなりと理解してもらえるとは思ってないけど、話をするのを拒否するわけにもいかなかった
strings.translated: I didn't think he'd accept things easily, but I couldn't very well refuse to talk to him.

strings.text: 美桜「いいわよ
strings.translated: Mio「Sure.

strings.text: 私が許可すると、大智がゆっくりと部屋のドアを開けてきた。
strings.translated: When I gave him permission, Daichi slowly opened the door to my room.

strings.text: 表情は沈んだままで、何だか見ているだけで可哀想になってくる。
strings.translated: His expression was still downcast, and just looking at him made me feel sorry for him.

strings.text: クラブが良いところだって理解してくれたら、こんな顔をせずに済むのに
strings.translated: If only he could understand that the Club is a good place, he wouldn't have to make a face like that.

strings.text: 大智「訊きたいことがあるんだけど
strings.translated: Daichi「There's something I want to ask you.

strings.text: 美桜「訊きたいことって？
strings.translated: Mio「Something you want to ask?

strings.text: 大智「今日も…あのクラブに行ったの？
strings.translated: Daichi「Did you go to... that Club again today?

strings.text: 美桜「行ったわよ。
strings.translated: Mio「I did.

strings.text: 友佳と一緒に
strings.translated: Together with Yuka.

strings.text: 大智「男の人と…したの？
strings.translated: Daichi「Did you... do it with a man?

strings.text: 美桜「したわ。
strings.translated: Mio「I did.

strings.text: すごく優しい人だった」
strings.translated: He was a very kind person.」

strings.text: 隠しても意味はないから、はっきりと告げた。
strings.translated: There was no point in hiding it, so I told him plainly.

strings.text: 今日も男の人とセックスしたって、正直に答えた。
strings.translated: I answered honestly that I had sex with a man today too.

strings.text: もちろん、大智が納得してくれるとは思っていない。
strings.translated: Of course, I didn't think Daichi would accept it.

strings.text: 恥ずかしい姉だって、きっとそんなふうに思ってるんだろう。
strings.translated: He probably thought of me as some shameful sister.

strings.text: でも、そうした行為を経て私が救われてるのは事実だ。
strings.translated: But the fact is that I've been saved through those acts.

strings.text: 以前よりも前向きになれたし、男の人とも普通に話せるようになった。
strings.translated: I've become more positive than before, and I'm able to talk normally with men now.

strings.text: 大智もそれはわかってるはずなのに、どうして些細なことに縛られてしまうんだろう
strings.translated: Daichi should know that too -- so why does he let himself get tied down by such trivial things?

strings.text: 大智「変だと思わないのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Don't you think that's strange?

strings.text: そんな簡単に男に体を許して、普通じゃないって思わないの？
strings.translated: Letting a man have your body so easily like that -- don't you think that's not normal?

strings.text: 美桜「それを言うなら、私がされたことはもっと普通じゃないけど
strings.translated: Mio「If you're going to say that, what was done to me was even less normal.

strings.text: 大智「それとこれとは話が違うだろう
strings.translated: Daichi「That's a completely different matter.

strings.text: 美桜「同じよ。
strings.translated: Mio「It's the same.

strings.text: どちらも同じセックス。
strings.translated: Both are sex.

strings.text: ただ、自分が受け入れたセックスは、とても気持ち良くて満たされた気分になるの
strings.translated: It's just that sex you accept yourself feels really good and leaves you feeling fulfilled.

strings.text: 美桜「確かに一般的とはいえないかもしれない。
strings.translated: Mio「Sure, it might not be what you'd call typical.

strings.text: そんな事は私にだってわかってる
strings.translated: I know that as well as anyone.

strings.text: 美桜「でもね、大智。
strings.translated: Mio「But, Daichi.

strings.text: 私はあのクラブに行って、男の人達に優しくしてもらって…セックスっていいものなんだって感じるようになったから、こんなに元気になれたの
strings.translated: I went to that Club, and the men there were kind to me... and because I came to feel that sex is something good, I was able to get this much better.

strings.text: 大智「それは…そうかもしれないけど…」
strings.translated: Daichi「That's... maybe true, but...」

strings.text: やっぱり、大智は簡単には納得してくれないみたいだった。
strings.translated: It seemed like Daichi still wasn't going to be convinced so easily.

strings.text: 私が元気になった、つまりは救われたって事実があるのに、それを受け入れてくれない。
strings.translated: The fact that I had gotten better -- that I had been saved -- was right there, and yet he wouldn't accept it.

strings.text: 常識という壁が、理解することを阻んでるみたいだった
strings.translated: It was as if the wall of common sense was blocking him from understanding.

strings.text: 大智「姉さんは、ただヤリたいだけの男達に、都合良く利用されてるだけじゃないのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Aren't you just being used as a convenient toy by men who only want to get laid？

strings.text: 美桜「そう思いたくなるのはわかるけど、ただ性欲を満たすためだけで、人はあんなふうに優しくはなれないはずよ
strings.translated: Mio「I understand why you'd think that, but people can't be that gentle with someone just to satisfy their lust」

strings.text: 大智「そんなの、姉さんがそう思い込んでるだけじゃないか
strings.translated: Daichi「That's just you convincing yourself of that, isn't it」

strings.text: 美桜「全くもう…」
strings.translated: Mio「Honestly...」

strings.text: それこそ、大智がクラブのことを悪く思いたいだけなんだろうけど、本人はそれに気づいてないみたいだ
strings.translated: If anything, Daichi was the one who just wanted to think badly of the Club -- but he didn't seem to realize that himself.

strings.text: それを指摘することもできたけど、私が口を開くより早く携帯電話が鳴った。
strings.translated: I could have pointed that out, but before I could open my mouth, my cell phone rang.

strings.text: 画面に表示された名前は友佳。
strings.translated: The name on the screen was Yuka.

strings.text: それを見た瞬間、私は心臓が大きく鼓動したのを感じた
strings.translated: The moment I saw it, I felt my heart give a great thud.

strings.text: クラブから逃げ出した俺は、家に帰ってからというもの激しい自己嫌悪に陥っていた。
strings.translated: After fleeing the Club, I came home and fell into a deep spiral of self-loathing.

strings.text: 結局、何もできなかった。
strings.translated: In the end, I hadn't been able to do anything.

strings.text: せっかくクラブに行ったのに、現実を直視することができなくて逃げ出してしまった。
strings.translated: I'd gone all the way to the Club, but I couldn't face reality and ran away.

strings.text: しかも、神村さんをその場に残してだ
strings.translated: And on top of that, I'd left Kamimura-san behind.

strings.text: 大智「何やってんだよ、俺は…」
strings.translated: Daichi「What am I doing...」

strings.text: 必要以上に、自分を責めるつもりはない。
strings.translated: I didn't intend to blame myself more than necessary.

strings.text: 仲の良かったクラスメイトが女装して、男を相手にセックスしてたんだ。
strings.translated: A classmate I'd been close with had been cross-dressing and having sex with men.

strings.text: ショックを受けて当然だし、その場にいたくないって思うのも不思議なことではないはずだった。
strings.translated: It was only natural to be shocked, and wanting to get out of there wasn't strange at all.

strings.text: ただ、自分だけで逃げたのは最低の行為だ。
strings.translated: But running away on my own like that -- that was inexcusable.

strings.text: あの場には神村さんもいたんだから、せめて彼女は一緒に連れ出してくるべきだったのに…。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san had been there too, so at the very least I should have brought her out with me...

strings.text: あれから、神村さんはどうしただろう。
strings.translated: I wondered what had happened to Kamimura-san after that.

strings.text: あのままクラブに残ったんだろうか。
strings.translated: Had she stayed behind at the Club?

strings.text: 神村さんのことが気になって仕方なくて、俺はますます落ち込んでしまっていた
strings.translated: I couldn't stop worrying about Kamimura-san, and I found myself sinking deeper and deeper into despair.

strings.text: 大智「電話…してみるかな」
strings.translated: Daichi「Maybe I should... give her a call」

strings.text: 一緒にクラブのことを調べるという話になってから、神村さんの携帯電話の番号は教えてもらっていた。
strings.translated: Ever since we'd agreed to look into the Club together, she'd given me her cell phone number.

strings.text: もちろん、まだ一度としてかけたことはない。
strings.translated: Of course, I hadn't called it even once.

strings.text: そんな勇気を簡単に出せるような性格じゃないんだ。
strings.translated: I'm not the kind of person who can work up that kind of courage easily.

strings.text: でも、今日ばかりは電話をかけて確認しないと、俺が夜も眠れなくなってしまいそうだった
strings.translated: But today of all days, if I didn't call and check on her, I felt like I wouldn't be able to sleep at night.

strings.text: 大智「男だろ。
strings.translated: Daichi「It's a guy.

strings.text: しっかりしろよ
strings.translated: Pull yourself together.

strings.text: 携帯電話を手に取って、神村さんの番号にかける
strings.translated: I picked up my cell phone and dialed Kamimura-san's number.

strings.text: ちゃんと出てくれるか心配だったけど、３回くらいコールしたところで電話が繋がった
strings.translated: I was worried she might not pick up, but after about three rings, the call connected.

strings.text: 愛「もしもし
strings.translated: Ai「Hello」

strings.text: 大智「もしもし…白坂ですけど。
strings.translated: Daichi「Hello... this is Shirashiro. I mean, Shirasaka.

strings.text: 神村さん、今どこ？
strings.translated: Kamimura-san, where are you right now?」

strings.text: 愛「今は家だけど？
strings.translated: Ai「I'm at home right now, why？

strings.text: 大智「今日はごめん。
strings.translated: Daichi「Sorry about today.

strings.text: 置き去りにしちゃって
strings.translated: I left you behind.」

strings.text: 愛「気にしないで。
strings.translated: Ai「Don't worry about it.

strings.text: 私もすぐに出たから
strings.translated: I left right away too.」

strings.text: それならいいんだけど…」
strings.translated: That's a relief, then...」

strings.text: 神村さんの言葉に、少しだけホッとした。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san's words put me just a little at ease.

strings.text: 彼女の言葉がどこまで本当かはわからないけど、今は信じるしかないんだ。
strings.translated: I had no way of knowing how much of what she said was true, but right now I had no choice but to believe her.

strings.text: すぐに出たのなら、たぶん男とセックスしたりもしてないだろう。
strings.translated: If she'd left right away, then she probably hadn't had sex with any men either.

strings.text: 頭の中で想像していた嫌な光景が掻き消えていくのを感じて、俺は大きく息を吐いた
strings.translated: I felt the unpleasant images I'd been picturing in my head begin to fade away, and I let out a long breath.

strings.text: 愛「白坂君は大丈夫？
strings.translated: Ai「Are you okay, Shirasaka-kun？

strings.text: 気分が悪そうだったけど
strings.translated: You looked like you were feeling sick, though.

strings.text: 大智「俺は大丈夫だよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm fine.」

strings.text: あの時は…少し調子が悪かったけど」
strings.translated: Back then... I was just feeling a little off.」

strings.text: 本当に情けない姿を晒してしまった。
strings.translated: I had shown her such a pathetic side of myself.

strings.text: できることなら、神村さんの記憶から消えてほしかった。
strings.translated: If I could, I wanted her to erase it from her memory entirely.

strings.text: 今度、クラブに行くことがあったら、もっと強い意志を持たないと…。
strings.translated: Next time I go to the Club, I'll need to go in with a much stronger resolve...

strings.text: 神村さんを置き去りにして逃げるなんて、もう二度と在ってはならないことだった
strings.translated: Running away and leaving Kamimura-san behind -- that was something that could never happen again.

strings.text: 愛「白坂君にとって、やっぱりあのクラブは悪いところなの？
strings.translated: Ai「For you, Shirасака-kun, is the Club still a bad place?

strings.text: 大智「それは…そうだろ。
strings.translated: Daichi「That's... well, yeah.

strings.text: 俺には悪いところにしか見えない
strings.translated: It only looks bad to me.」

strings.text: 愛「どんなところが悪いと思うの？
strings.translated: Ai「What do you think is bad about it?

strings.text: 人前でセックスしてるところ？
strings.translated: Having sex in front of other people?

strings.text: 大智「それだけじゃないけど、それも大きな理由のひとつかな
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not the only reason, but it's one of the big ones.

strings.text: 愛「それじゃあ、セックスしなければいいところなの？
strings.translated: Ai「So then, if there were no sex, would it be a good place?

strings.text: 大智「ただみんなが集まって話をしてるだけなら、大きな問題はないと思う。
strings.translated: Daichi「If everyone were just gathering to talk, I don't think there'd be a major problem.

strings.text: でも、あのクラブはそれだけじゃない気がするんだ
strings.translated: But I get the feeling the Club is more than that.」

strings.text: 大智「もっと裏があるような…危険な感じがする
strings.translated: Daichi「It feels like there's something more going on behind it... something dangerous.

strings.text: 愛「つまり、勘？
strings.translated: Ai「So in other words, a hunch?

strings.text: 大智「まあ、そういう事になるけど…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Well, I guess that's what it comes down to...」

strings.text: ただの勘と言われてしまえば、それを否定することはできない。
strings.translated: If she called it just a hunch, I couldn't deny it.

strings.text: でも、危険だと思ってるものに関わらせたくないって考えるのは自然なことだ。
strings.translated: But it was only natural to not want someone involved with something I thought was dangerous.

strings.text: そのあたりのことは、神村さんはどう思ってるんだろう
strings.translated: I wondered what Kamimura-san thought about all that.

strings.text: 大智「神村さんはどうなんだ？
strings.translated: Daichi「What about you, Kamimura-san?

strings.text: クラブに対して全く危険とか感じてないのか？
strings.translated: Did she not feel any sense of danger toward the Club at all?

strings.text: みんなが救われてるのなら良い場所だと思うけど、時々本当に救われてるのかなって思う事もあるし
strings.translated: If everyone is being saved, then I think it's a good place, but sometimes I wonder if they're really being saved at all.」

strings.text: 愛「それに…私にはセックスがそんなにいいものには思えないから
strings.translated: Ai「And... sex doesn't seem like such a great thing to me either.

strings.text: 大智「それは、神村さんが普通の感覚を持ってるからだよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「That's because you have a normal sense of things, Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 普通の人はそう思って当然なんだと思う」
strings.translated: I think it's only natural for a normal person to feel that way.」

strings.text: 俺の感覚は間違ってない。
strings.translated: My instincts weren't wrong.

strings.text: それだけは胸を張って言えた。
strings.translated: That much I could say with confidence.

strings.text: だからこそ、神村さんを関わらせないようにしないといけないし、姉さんを引き離さないといけない。
strings.translated: That was exactly why I had to keep Kamimura-san from getting involved, and why I had to pull my sister away.

strings.text: そのためには、あのクラブの実態を暴いて、その証拠を掴むしかなかった
strings.translated: To do that, I had no choice but to expose the Club's true nature and get proof.

strings.text: 愛「物事って言うのは、悪く見ようと思えばいくらでも悪く見えるんじゃない？
strings.translated: Ai「Don't you think that if you want to see something in a bad light, you can always find a way to?

strings.text: 大智「…何の話？
strings.translated: Daichi「...What are you talking about?

strings.text: 愛「あのクラブで、非常識な事が行われてるのは事実だと思う
strings.translated: Ai「I do think it's a fact that outrageous things are happening at that Club.

strings.text: 愛「でも、その結果、救われてる人がいるのだとしたら…それでも、クラブは悪いところだって言える？
strings.translated: Ai「But if, as a result, there are people who are being saved... can you still say the Club is a bad place?

strings.text: 大智「それは…俺は、言えると思うけど
strings.translated: Daichi「That's... I think I can say that, yeah.

strings.text: 愛「もしも、白坂先輩をクラブから引き離して、先輩がまた部屋に引きこもるようになったり…たとえば自殺しようとしたら、白坂君はどうするの？
strings.translated: Ai「If you pulled Shirасака-senpai away from the Club and she started shutting herself in her room again... or, say, tried to kill herself -- what would you do, Shirасака-kun?

strings.text: 大智「そんな事にはならないように…するよ
strings.translated: Daichi「I'd make sure... that never happened.

strings.text: 愛「そう…それなら、もう私が言うことはない
strings.translated: Ai「I see... then I have nothing more to say.

strings.text: 神村さんの言葉が、胸に突き刺さったような気分だった。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san's words felt like they had pierced straight through my chest.

strings.text: クラブから引き離した結果、姉さんが前の状態に戻ってしまったとしたら…。
strings.translated: If pulling her away from the Club ended up sending my sister back to how she was before...

strings.text: そんな事にはならないって思いたいけど、もしもそうなってしまったとしたら、俺は後悔してしまうんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: I wanted to believe that would never happen, but if it did -- wouldn't I end up regretting it?

strings.text: たとえ非常識な行為が繰り返されていたとしても、あのクラブに通ってたほうが良かったんじゃないかって、そんなふうに思ってしまうんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Even if all those outrageous things kept happening there, wouldn't I find myself thinking it might have been better for her to keep going to that Club?

strings.text: 今まで考えないようにしてたけど、その可能性だって捨てきれないことは自覚しておくべきだった
strings.translated: I had been trying not to think about it until now, but I should have acknowledged that I couldn't rule out that possibility.

strings.text: 芽生「それでねっ、その子がねっ、すっごく喜んでくれたのっ！
strings.translated: Mei「And then, that girl, she was sooo happy about it!

strings.text: 美桜「そう、良かったわね
strings.translated: Mio「Oh, is that so. Good for you.

strings.text: 食事の席はいたって平穏だった。
strings.translated: The dinner table was perfectly peaceful.

strings.text: 芽生が学校であったことを話して、それを姉さんが穏やかな表情で聞いていた。
strings.translated: Mei talked about what had happened at school, and my sister listened with a calm expression on her face.

strings.text: まるで、あの事件が遭った以前の光景が戻ってきたかのようだ
strings.translated: It was as if the scene from before that incident had come back to us.

strings.text: 俺にとっても嬉しいことのはずなのに、気持ちが晴れないのはあのクラブの存在を知ってしまったからだ。
strings.translated: It should have been something that made me happy too, but the reason my heart wouldn't clear was because I had learned of that Club's existence.

strings.text: だからこそ、考えてしまう。
strings.translated: And that was exactly why I couldn't stop thinking about it.

strings.text: クラブのことを知らなければ、全て丸く収まったんだろうかって…。
strings.translated: I kept wondering... if I'd never found out about the Club, would everything have worked out fine.

strings.text: 俺が、クラブのことを忘れてしまえば、全部上手くいくんだろうかって
strings.translated: I kept wondering if, were I to just forget about the Club, everything would go smoothly.

strings.text: あんまり食べてないみたいだけど
strings.translated: She didn't seem to be eating much.

strings.text: 芽生「お兄ちゃん、いらないの？
strings.translated: Mei「Don't you want any, big brother?

strings.text: 大智「いや、考え事してただけ
strings.translated: Daichi「No, I was just lost in thought」

strings.text: 精一杯の笑顔を浮かべながら、食事の手を進める。
strings.translated: I put on the best smile I could manage and kept eating.

strings.text: そんな俺を、姉さんは嬉しそうな表情で見つめていて、それがすごく奇妙な感じだった。
strings.translated: My sister watched me with what looked like a happy expression, and it felt deeply strange.

strings.text: どうしてそんなふうに笑えるのか、俺にはわからなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't understand how she could smile like that.

strings.text: まだ、家族にはバレてないけど、俺達はセックスしてしまったんだ。
strings.translated: The family still hadn't found out, but she and I had had sex.

strings.text: 姉弟の関係で、やってはいけない事をやってしまったんだ。
strings.translated: We'd done something that siblings should never do.

strings.text: それなのに平然としていられる姉さんは、やっぱりどこか壊れてしまったようにしか見えなかった
strings.translated: And yet my sister could act so composed -- she still looked to me like something inside her had broken.

strings.text: 夕食後、自分の部屋に戻った俺は、今日何度目になるかわからない溜息を漏らしていた。
strings.translated: After dinner, back in my own room, I let out what must have been my hundredth sigh of the day.

strings.text: 姉さんと話したいような話したくないような、そんな気分だ。
strings.translated: I felt like I wanted to talk to my sister, and at the same time like I didn't.

strings.text: 話さなければならないことはたくさんあるはずなのに、話をするだけ無駄なんじゃないかってそんなふうに思う自分もいた。
strings.translated: There were so many things we needed to talk about, and yet part of me thought it would all be pointless.

strings.text: こんな状況に置かれて、精神的な疲労を感じない奴なんていないだろう。
strings.translated: There's probably no one who could be put in a situation like this and not feel mentally exhausted.

strings.text: たぶん、俺はよくやっている方だと思うんだけど、実際のところはどうなのかわからない。
strings.translated: I thought I was probably holding up pretty well -- but honestly, I had no way of knowing.

strings.text: 何かと比べたり誰かに判断してもらったりできないから、自分で自分を信じるしかなかった。
strings.translated: There was nothing to compare myself against, no one to judge me, so all I could do was believe in myself.

strings.text: 姉さんは今、自分の部屋にいるはずだ。
strings.translated: My sister should be in her room right now.

strings.text: 話をしようと思えば、いつでもすることができる。
strings.translated: If I wanted to talk to her, I could do it anytime.

strings.text: だから、あとは俺次第なんだ。
strings.translated: So it all came down to me.

strings.text: 姉さんと話をして、少しでも正気に戻さなければならないんだ。
strings.translated: I had to talk to my sister and bring her back to her senses, even just a little.

strings.text: そのためには、こうやって自分の部屋で溜息をついてる場合じゃないはずだった
strings.translated: For that to happen, I couldn't just keep sitting in my room sighing like this.

strings.text: 大智「行くか」
strings.translated: Daichi「Shall we go」

strings.text: うだうだ考えていて、姉さんが寝てしまったら話もできなくなる。
strings.translated: If I kept going back and forth and my sister fell asleep, I wouldn't be able to talk to her at all.

strings.text: そうなる前に姉さんの部屋まで行って、今までの事とこれからの事を話したかった
strings.translated: Before that happened, I wanted to go to her room and talk about everything that had happened and what came next.

strings.text: 自分の部屋を出て、姉さんの部屋の前まで移動する。
strings.translated: I left my room and made my way to the door of my sister's room.

strings.text: ドアの前に立つと、まず大きく深呼吸した。
strings.translated: Standing in front of the door, I took one long, deep breath first.

strings.text: ドアをノックするだけで、こんなに緊張するなんて…。
strings.translated: Just knocking on a door -- and I was this nervous...

strings.text: 正直、自分の部屋に戻りたい気分だったけど、ここで逃げるわけにはいかなかった
strings.translated: Honestly, I wanted to turn around and go back to my room, but I couldn't run away now.

strings.text: ごくりと息を呑んで、姉さんの部屋のドアをノックする。
strings.translated: I swallowed hard and knocked on my sister's door.

strings.text: ほんの少しだけ、姉さんが寝ていて返事がない事を期待してしまっていた
strings.translated: Just a small part of me was hoping she'd be asleep and there'd be no answer.

strings.text: 美桜「いいわよ」
strings.translated: Mio「Sure」

strings.text: 幸か不幸か、ドアの向こうから姉さんの声が返ってきた。
strings.translated: For better or worse, my sister's voice came back from the other side of the door.

strings.text: ここまで来たら、部屋の中に入るしかない。
strings.translated: Now that I'd come this far, there was nothing to do but go inside.

strings.text: どんな結果になるかわからなかったけど、俺は意を決してドアを開けた
strings.translated: I had no idea what the outcome would be, but I steeled myself and opened the door.

strings.text: 姉さんの部屋に入ると、緊張はますます高まってきた。
strings.translated: Stepping into my sister's room, my nerves only grew worse.

strings.text: 何を話せばいいのか一応は考えてきたはずなのに、一瞬それが頭から消えてしまった。
strings.translated: I'd thought through what I was going to say, but for a moment it all vanished from my head.

strings.text: 必死に最初の言葉を探して、動揺を隠しながら口を開いた
strings.translated: I desperately searched for the first words to say, and opened my mouth while hiding my agitation.

strings.text: 大智「今日も…あのクラブに行ったの？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Did you go to... that Club again today？」

strings.text: 答えなどわかりきった質問。
strings.translated: A question I already knew the answer to.

strings.text: でも、最初にこれを尋ねないわけにはいかなかった
strings.translated: But I couldn't not ask it first.

strings.text: 姉さんが、平然とした様子で答える。
strings.translated: My sister answered in a perfectly composed tone.

strings.text: こういう事を言うのに、もう何の躊躇いもないみたいだ。
strings.translated: She didn't seem to have any hesitation at all about saying something like that anymore.

strings.text: 姉さんは今日もセックスした。
strings.translated: My sister had sex again today.

strings.text: 俺の知らない誰かと…幸せそうに…。
strings.translated: With someone I didn't know... and she'd looked happy about it...

strings.text: そのことが、良いことなのか悪いことなのか、もう俺はよくわからなくなってしまっていた。
strings.translated: Whether that was a good thing or a bad thing -- I couldn't tell anymore.

strings.text: でも…それでも、このままでいい気はしなかったから、姉さんとの会話を必死に続けた
strings.translated: But... even so, I couldn't feel right about leaving things as they were, so I desperately kept the conversation going with my sister.

strings.text: こんな説明で納得できるわけがない。
strings.translated: There was no way I could accept that explanation.

strings.text: あの強姦事件もクラブでするのも、ただのセックスでしかないなんて…。
strings.translated: That the rape, and what she did at the Club -- that it was all just sex, nothing more...

strings.text: たぶん、こう言った考え方ができるから元気になることができただろうけど、それでも俺は今の姉さんを受け入れたくなかった。
strings.translated: Maybe being able to think that way was what had let her get better, but even so, I couldn't bring myself to accept the way my sister was now.

strings.text: 気持ち良ければそれでいい。
strings.translated: As long as it feels good, that's all that matters.

strings.text: 相手は弟でも構わない。
strings.translated: It doesn't matter if the other person is her own brother.

strings.text: そんな思考は、やっぱり異常としか言いようがないはずだった
strings.translated: That kind of thinking could only be called abnormal -- there was no other word for it.

strings.text: 姉さんが、呆れたように溜息を漏らす。
strings.translated: Sis let out a sigh, as if she'd given up on me.

strings.text: まるで、俺が何かの我儘を言ってるみたいな雰囲気だ。
strings.translated: Like I was the one throwing some kind of tantrum.

strings.text: どうして、そんなふうにしか受け取ってくれないんだ？
strings.translated: Why couldn't she see it any other way?

strings.text: 俺がこんなに心配してるってのが、どうしてわかってくれないんだ？
strings.translated: Why couldn't she understand how worried I was?

strings.text: もっと話をしようと思ったけど、それよりも先に姉さんの携帯電話が鳴って、俺との話はあっさりと打ち切られてしまった
strings.translated: I'd wanted to keep talking, but before I could, my sister's cell phone rang, and our conversation was cut short just like that.

strings.text: 美桜「はい、もしもし…うん…うん…そうなんだ。
strings.translated: Mio「Hello, yes... mm... mm... I see.

strings.text: でも、それって…これから！
strings.translated: But that means... right now?!

strings.text: 場所は？
strings.translated: Where?

strings.text: うん…うん…すぐに行くわ」
strings.translated: Okay... okay... I'll be right there.」

strings.text: 必要なことだけを話した様子で、姉さんが電話を切る。
strings.translated: She seemed to say only what needed to be said, then hung up the phone.

strings.text: いったい何の話なのか、俺にはさっぱりわからない。
strings.translated: I had no idea at all what the call had been about.

strings.text: でも、今から、場所は、なんて言葉が出てきた時点で、すごく嫌な予感はしていた
strings.translated: But the moment words like "right now" and "where" came up, I had a very bad feeling about it.

strings.text: 美桜「私、ちょっと出かけるから」
strings.translated: Mio「I'm going out for a bit.」

strings.text: 座っていた椅子から立ち上がって、姉さんはそう言った。
strings.translated: She stood up from her chair and said that.

strings.text: もうかなり遅い時間なのに、外出することに何の躊躇いもないみたいだった
strings.translated: Even though it was already quite late, she didn't seem to have any hesitation about going out.

strings.text: 大智「出かけるって、どこに？
strings.translated: Daichi「Going out -- where?

strings.text: 美桜「秘密
strings.translated: Mio「That's a secret.

strings.text: ちょっとおどけたように言って、姉さんが部屋を出て行く。
strings.translated: She said it with a little playful air and walked out of the room.

strings.text: 俺のことなんか、どうでもいいって言わんばかりの態度だ。
strings.translated: Like I didn't matter at all to her.

strings.text: だけど、こんな夜中に姉さんを外出させるわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: But I couldn't let my sister go out in the middle of the night like this.

strings.text: 家にいてほしかったし、どうしても外出するならせめて俺も一緒でないと心配でたまらなかった
strings.translated: I wanted her to stay home, and if she absolutely had to go out, I couldn't bear the worry unless I went with her.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん、待ってくれよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis, wait.

strings.text: 俺も行くから
strings.translated: I'm coming with you.」

strings.text: 美桜「来なくていいわ。
strings.translated: Mio「You don't need to come.

strings.text: 呼ばれてるのは、私だけなんだから
strings.translated: I'm the only one who was called.」

strings.text: 大智「クラブに関係してることなのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Is this something to do with the Club?

strings.text: 美桜「秘密って言ったでしょう
strings.translated: Mio「I told you, it's a secret.

strings.text: 大智「だったら、ますます行かせられるかよ」
strings.translated: Daichi「Then there's no way I'm letting you go.」

strings.text: 階段を下りようとした姉さんが前に立ちはだかる。
strings.translated: I stepped in front of her as she was about to go down the stairs.

strings.text: こんな時間に夜道を歩くなんて危ないし、クラブが関わってるなら絶対に行かせるわけにはいかなかった。
strings.translated: Walking the streets alone at this hour was dangerous, and if the Club was involved, there was absolutely no way I could let her go.

strings.text: どんな手を使ってでも…姉さんを、部屋に押し込めてでも妨害する。
strings.translated: Whatever it took -- even if I had to physically push her back into her room.

strings.text: 具体的にどんな内容の電話だったのかはわからないけど、これ以上姉さんが狂っていくのを黙って見ているわけにはいかなかった
strings.translated: I didn't know exactly what the call had been about, but I couldn't just stand by and watch my sister spiral further and further away.

strings.text: 美桜「大智は本当に人の話を聞かないんだから
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, you really never listen to anyone.

strings.text: 大智「それはこっちのセリフだ
strings.translated: Daichi「That's my line.

strings.text: 美桜「私のことを心配してくれるのは嬉しいけど、あまりやり過ぎると可愛くないわよ
strings.translated: Mio「I'm happy you're worried about me, but if you take it too far, it stops being cute.

strings.text: 大智「そんなふうに思ってもらおうとしてやってるんじゃないっ！
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not what I'm trying to make you think！

strings.text: 大智「姉さん、これ以上あのクラブに関わるのはやめてくれ。
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis, please stop getting any more involved with that Club.

strings.text: まともな姉さんに戻ってくれ
strings.translated: Please come back to being the normal you.」

strings.text: 美桜「まともって…」
strings.translated: Mio「Normal...」

strings.text: 姉さんが、呆れたように溜息をついて、珍しく不機嫌そうに目をつり上げた。
strings.translated: Sis let out a sigh like she'd given up, and for once her eyes narrowed with what looked like genuine irritation.

strings.text: 普段は穏やかな姉さんだからこそ、本気でイラついてるのがわかった
strings.translated: Because she was usually so calm, I could tell she was truly annoyed.

strings.text: 美桜「何か…本当にわかり合えないのかもしれないわね。
strings.translated: Mio「Maybe... we really just can't understand each other.

strings.text: 説明すれば、いつかは理解してくれるって思ってたけど
strings.translated: I thought if I explained, you'd come to understand someday.」

strings.text: 美桜「大智には今の私がまともじゃないように見えるのね？
strings.translated: Mio「To you, the way I am now looks like I'm not normal?

strings.text: 大智「そんなの…弟とあんな事しておいて…それで、普通に暮らしてるほうがおかしいだろ
strings.translated: Daichi「Of course it does... after doing that kind of thing with your own little brother... and then just living like everything's fine -- that's what's not normal.

strings.text: 美桜「そこだけ？
strings.translated: Mio「Just that one thing?

strings.text: そこだけを見て、私の全部がまともじゃないって決め付けるの？
strings.translated: Just that one thing -- and you're going to decide that none of me is normal?

strings.text: 頭がおかしくなってるって思うのね？
strings.translated: You think I've lost my mind?

strings.text: 美桜「あの時のことは、確かに私も急ぎすぎたって思う。
strings.translated: Mio「I do think I rushed things back then, it's true.

strings.text: 早過ぎることをしたって反省してる
strings.translated: I reflect on the fact that I did something too soon.」

strings.text: 美桜「でも、そこだけを見て今の私をまともじゃないって思ったり、あそこでしていることを悪いことだって決め付けるなんて
strings.translated: Mio「But to look only at that and decide I'm not normal now, or to just assume that what we do there is something wrong --

strings.text: 美桜「私にしてみれば、大智のほうがまともじゃないわ
strings.translated: Mio「As far as I'm concerned, Daichi is the one who isn't normal.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん…っ！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis...!」

strings.text: 衝撃的な言葉だった。
strings.translated: Those words hit me like a shock.

strings.text: まさか、姉さんのほうから俺がまともじゃないって言われるなんて、夢にも思ってなかった。
strings.translated: I never could have dreamed that Sis would be the one to tell me I wasn't normal.

strings.text: 本当にわかり合えないのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe we really couldn't understand each other.

strings.text: 俺が思ってた以上に、姉さんとの距離は開いてしまっていたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe the distance between Sis and me had grown far wider than I'd ever imagined.

strings.text: でも、それならどうしたらいいんだ？
strings.translated: But then -- what was I supposed to do?

strings.text: 姉さんのやってることを、俺は正しいとは思えない。
strings.translated: I couldn't bring myself to think that what Sis was doing was right.

strings.text: だから、こんな時間に外出させたくないし、クラブとの関わりも絶ってほしいと願っている。
strings.translated: That's why I didn't want her going out at this hour, and why I wished she would cut ties with the Club.

strings.text: だけど…そんなふうに感じてしまう俺のほうが、もしかするとまともじゃなくなってるんだろうか
strings.translated: But... was I the one who had lost my grip on normal, for feeling that way?

strings.text: 美桜「大智が私のことをまともじゃないって思うのなら、もうそれでもいい
strings.translated: Mio「If you think I'm not normal, then fine, have it your way.

strings.text: 美桜「でも、それならまともな私って何なの？
strings.translated: Mio「But then, what does it even mean for me to be normal?

strings.text: レイプされて部屋に引きこもって、毎日泣いて、食事もとらないで、自殺する事ばかり考えてるのがまともな私なの？
strings.translated: Is the normal me the one who got raped and shut herself in her room, crying every day, not eating, doing nothing but thinking about killing herself?

strings.text: 美桜「私なんて死ねばよかった？
strings.translated: Mio「Would it have been better if I had just died?

strings.text: 大智「誰もそんな事言ってないだろっ！
strings.translated: Daichi「Nobody said anything like that!」

strings.text: 美桜「だったら、もう私のことはほっといて。
strings.translated: Mio「If that's how you feel, then leave me alone.

strings.text: あんな酷い生活をするのがまともなんだったら、私はまともじゃなくていい
strings.translated: If living that awful life is what being normal means, then I don't want to be normal.」

strings.text: 美桜「まともじゃなくても、毎日が楽しくて、幸せで、笑って過ごせるならそれでいいの！
strings.translated: Mio「Even if I'm not normal -- as long as every day is fun, and I'm happy, and I can go through life smiling, that's enough!

strings.text: 俺だってそっちのほうがいい。
strings.translated: I wanted that too.

strings.text: 姉さんが、楽しそうで、幸せそうで、笑って過ごしているならそっちのほうがいいに決まっていた。
strings.translated: If Sis was having fun, if she seemed happy, if she was going through life with a smile -- of course that was better.

strings.text: いいに決まっていたけど、それを口に出すことはできなかった。
strings.translated: Of course it was better -- but I couldn't say it out loud.

strings.text: 口に出した瞬間、俺の中で何かが壊れてしまいそうで、それが怖かった
strings.translated: The moment I did, I felt like something inside me would break, and that terrified me.

strings.text: 美桜「いってきます。
strings.translated: Mio「I'm heading out.

strings.text: ついて来ないで
strings.translated: Don't follow me.」

strings.text: いつもより低い声で言って、姉さんが階段を下りていく。
strings.translated: She said it in a lower voice than usual and went down the stairs.

strings.text: でも、もう俺はそれを追いかけることもできなくて、ただただ廊下に立ち尽くす事しかできなかった。
strings.translated: But I couldn't chase after her anymore -- all I could do was stand there in the hallway, rooted to the spot.

strings.text: 何が正しいことなのか。
strings.translated: What was the right thing to do?

strings.text: どうするのが一番良いことなのか。
strings.translated: What was the best course of action?

strings.text: どっちがまともで、どっちがまともじゃないのか…全く考えがまとまらなかった。
strings.translated: Which of us was normal, and which of us wasn't... I couldn't sort out my thoughts at all.

strings.text: 何一つとして…正しいものが見つからなかった
strings.translated: Not a single thing... not one right answer could I find.

strings.text: 翌日。
strings.translated: The next day.

strings.text: なんとなく家に帰りたくなくて、ずいぶん長い間教室で過ごしてしまった。
strings.translated: Not really wanting to go home, I'd spent a long time lingering in the classroom.

strings.text: 教室にはもうほかの生徒の姿はなく、そのうち先生が見回りに来るだろう
strings.translated: There were no other students left, and before long a teacher would probably come around on patrol.

strings.text: 仕方なく、鞄をもって廊下に出る
strings.translated: With nothing else to do, I picked up my bag and stepped out into the hallway.

strings.text: と、丁度こちらに向かってくる人影に見覚えがあることに気が付いた
strings.translated: Just then, I noticed that the figure walking toward me was someone I recognized.

strings.text: 千喜「こんにちは…」
strings.translated: Chiki「Hello...」

strings.text: 同じ学校だったのか…。
strings.translated: She went to the same school...?

strings.text: 多分学校で会うのは初めてだったと思うけど、学年が違うんだろうか
strings.translated: I was pretty sure this was the first time we'd run into each other at school -- maybe we were in different years.

strings.text: 何にせよ、あのクラブの人間とはもう関わり合いになりたくなくて、適当な会釈でその横を通り過ぎた
strings.translated: Either way, I didn't want anything more to do with anyone from that Club, so I gave a vague nod and tried to walk past her.

strings.text: 千喜「あの…」
strings.translated: Chiki「Um...」

strings.text: が、声をかけられて、仕方なく立ち止まる
strings.translated: She called out to me, and I had no choice but to stop.

strings.text: 千喜「白坂君がクラブに来ないのは、私のせいですか？
strings.translated: Chiki「Is it my fault that you haven't been coming to the Club, Shirasaka-kun?

strings.text: 大智「いや……」
strings.translated: Daichi「No......」

strings.text: 思いもよらない言葉をかけられた。
strings.translated: Those were words I hadn't expected at all.

strings.text: 何を言いたいんだ？
strings.translated: What was she trying to say?

strings.text: 千喜「そう、ですか…。
strings.translated: Chiki「Is that... so...

strings.text: あの…私、何とも思ってませんから…。
strings.translated: Um... I don't think anything of it...

strings.text: …あっ、そうじゃなくて……勘違いしたりしてませんから
strings.translated: Ah, no, that's not what I meant... I'm not getting the wrong idea or anything.」

strings.text: 千喜「ええと…こんなふうに話しかけるのも、最初で最後にします。
strings.translated: Chiki「Um... I'll make this the first and last time I approach you like this.

strings.text: ただ…ひとつだけ、言いたいことがあって
strings.translated: I just... there's one thing I wanted to say.」

strings.text: 大智「…何？
strings.translated: Daichi「...What?

strings.text: 千喜「私、クラブにはもう、行かないことにしたんです。
strings.translated: Chiki「I've decided I won't be going to the Club anymore.

strings.text: だから…もうあそこで私に会うことはありませんから。
strings.translated: So... you won't be running into me there again.

strings.text: それだけ
strings.translated: That's all.」

strings.text: 千喜「えっ、あの……もう、大丈夫だって思えたから
strings.translated: Chiki「Ah, um... I just... felt like I was going to be okay.

strings.text: 大智「…どういうこと？
strings.translated: Daichi「...What do you mean?

strings.text: 千喜「白坂君は嫌だったと思うけど……私は、うれしくて…。
strings.translated: Chiki「I'm sure it was unpleasant for you, Shirasaka-kun... but for me, I was so happy...

strings.text: あなたとその…そういうこと……。
strings.translated: That you and I... did that sort of thing...

strings.text: あの時の事は、あまりハッキリとは覚えていないんですけど
strings.translated: I don't remember that time very clearly, but...」

strings.text: 千喜「私みたいなブスが白坂君みたいな…格好いい男の子とするなんて、普通じゃ絶対無理だから
strings.translated: Chiki「There's no way a plain girl like me could ever do that sort of thing with a good-looking guy like you, Shirasaka-kun, in normal life...

strings.text: 千喜「それで……何でか私、自分でもよくわからないんですけど、あのクラブのおかげで…自分も生きていていいんだって、思えたんです
strings.translated: Chiki「And so... I'm not really sure why myself, but... thanks to that Club, I was able to feel like... it was okay for me to be alive too.

strings.text: 千喜「おかしいですよね。
strings.translated: Chiki「It's strange, isn't it.

strings.text: 好きでもない……ううん。
strings.translated: With a man who doesn't even love me... no.

strings.text: 好かれてもいない男の人とのセックスで、なんて
strings.translated: To feel happy about sex with a man who doesn't even like me... how could I...」

strings.text: 千喜「でも、白坂君のおかげで、私は女なんだって……それでいつかきっと…私の事を好きになってくれる人に出会えるって思えたから
strings.translated: Chiki「But thanks to you, Shirasaka-kun, I felt like I really am a woman... and that someday, surely... I'd be able to meet someone who would come to love me.

strings.text: 千喜「だから私、あそこにはもう行きません。
strings.translated: Chiki「So I won't be going back there anymore.

strings.text: 何ができるかわからないけど……がんばって、少しでも綺麗になって
strings.translated: I don't know what I can do, but... I'm going to work hard, and become even a little bit prettier.」

strings.text: 千喜「あっ、すみません、勝手に……。
strings.translated: Chiki「Ah, I'm sorry, saying all this on my own...

strings.text: 私なんかがこんなこと…気持ち悪いですよね
strings.translated: Someone like me saying something like this... it's disgusting, isn't it.」

strings.text: 大智「いや……。
strings.translated: Daichi「No...

strings.text: 引き留められたりはしなかった？
strings.translated: Did she not get held back?」

strings.text: 園田先生も、皆も、喜んでくれました。
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei, and everyone else, were all happy for me.

strings.text: もしどうしても辛いことがあったら、いつでも戻ってきなさいって言ってくれました
strings.translated: They told me that if things ever got really hard, I could come back anytime.」

strings.text: 千喜「それじゃあ、失礼します。
strings.translated: Chiki「Well then, excuse me.

strings.text: 話しかけてごめんなさい。
strings.translated: I'm sorry for approaching you like this.

strings.text: …ありがとうございました
strings.translated: ...Thank you very much.」

strings.text: そう頭を下げて去っていく彼女の後姿を見ていると、やっぱり姉さんのことも暫くそっとしておいた方がいいのかもしれないと思わされた。
strings.translated: Watching her bow her head like that and walk away, I found myself thinking that maybe I should leave my sister alone for a little while longer too.

strings.text: そのうち姉さんも彼女のように、自分からあのクラブを出ていく日が来るのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe someday, my sister would leave that Club on her own, just like her.

strings.text: 出来れば一日も早く、そんな日が来てほしかった
strings.translated: If possible, I wanted that day to come as soon as possible.

strings.text: アイキャッチ２
strings.translated: Eyecatch 2

strings.text: クラブ女性Ａ「ふふふ
strings.translated: Club Woman A「Hehehe.

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｂ「ふふ
strings.translated: Club Woman B「Hehe.

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｄ「ふふふっ
strings.translated: Club Woman D「Hehehe.

strings.text: クラブ女性Ａ「見て、とっても幸せそう
strings.translated: Club Woman A「Look, she seems so incredibly happy.

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｃ「よかったね…本当によかった
strings.translated: Club Woman C「I'm so glad... truly so glad.

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｂ「すごかったね、すごく気持ちよさそうにしてた
strings.translated: Club Woman B「That was amazing, she looked like it felt so good.

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｄ「あのおじさんも喜んでたよね。
strings.translated: Club Woman D「That man seemed happy too, didn't he.

strings.text: すっごく幸せそうだった。
strings.translated: He looked so incredibly happy.

strings.text: この子があのおじさんを幸せにしたんだよね
strings.translated: It was this girl who made him happy, wasn't it.」

strings.text: 美桜「これが本当の救い…。
strings.translated: Mio「This is what true salvation is...

strings.text: 人を救い、人の愛に応えるということ
strings.translated: To save someone, and to answer their love.」

strings.text: 美桜「友佳…素晴らしかったわ…。
strings.translated: Mio「Yuka... you were wonderful...

strings.text: 今日の事は絶対に忘れない
strings.translated: I will never forget today.」

strings.text: クラブ女性Ａ「心から求められて、それに応えるって…すべてを捧げるって、こういう事なんだ
strings.translated: Club Woman A「To be desired from the bottom of someone's heart, and to answer that desire... to offer everything you have... so this is what that means.

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｃ「綺麗だね…。
strings.translated: Club Woman C「She's beautiful...

strings.text: 私もこんなふうになりたい
strings.translated: I want to be like that too

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｂ「私達もいつか…本当の救いにたどり着けるのかな？
strings.translated: Club Woman B「I wonder if we'll ever reach... true salvation someday？

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｄ「先生についていけば大丈夫だよ
strings.translated: Club Woman D「As long as we follow Sensei, everything will be fine

strings.text: 園田「さぁ、みんなで彼女を祝福しよう
strings.translated: Sonoda「Now then, let us all give her our blessing

strings.text: おめでとう
strings.translated: Congratulations.

strings.text: 美桜「…ありがとう
strings.translated: Mio「...Thank you

strings.text: 美桜「私も…いつか
strings.translated: Mio「Me too... someday

strings.text: 愛「疲れてるみたいね」
strings.translated: Ai「You look tired」

strings.text: 背後から声をかけられてはじめて、俺は廊下に立ち尽くしていたことに気が付いた。
strings.translated: -- Someone called out to me from behind, and only then did I realize I had been standing frozen in the hallway.

strings.text: 振り返るまでもなく声の主は明らかだった。
strings.translated: I didn't even need to turn around to know who it was.

strings.text: 神村さんだ。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 疑問だったのは、こんな時間まで学校で何をしていたのか、という事だ。
strings.translated: What puzzled me was what she was still doing at school at this hour.

strings.text: 神村さんは部活には所属していない。
strings.translated: She wasn't in any club.

strings.text: 補習を受けるような成績でもない。
strings.translated: Her grades weren't bad enough to need supplementary lessons.

strings.text: 星野さんと話でもしていたのか、他に何か用事があったのか、もしくは一度学校を出て戻ってきたとか？
strings.translated: Had she been talking with Hoshino-san, or did she have some other errand, or maybe she'd left school once and come back?

strings.text: それとも…俺が帰ろうとするのを待っていたんだろうか。
strings.translated: Or... had she been waiting for me to head home?

strings.text: でも、それを確かめる気にはなれなかった。
strings.translated: But I didn't feel like finding out.

strings.text: 神村さんの言う通り、俺は疲れていた。
strings.translated: Just as Kamimura-san said, I was tired.

strings.text: 姉さんのことと、自分がしてしまったことで頭がいっぱいで、睡眠もろくにとれていない。
strings.translated: My head was full of thoughts about Sis and what I had done, and I hadn't been getting nearly enough sleep.

strings.text: 精神的にも肉体的にも、くたくただ
strings.translated: I was exhausted, both mentally and physically.

strings.text: 大智「…ちょっとだけ」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Just a little」

strings.text: だけど、神村さん相手に弱音を吐くほど疲れ切ってはいなかった
strings.translated: But I wasn't so worn out that I'd let my guard down around Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 愛「これからどうするつもりなの？
strings.translated: Ai「What are you planning to do from here？

strings.text: 大智「…少し様子を見てみるのもいいのかもしれない、って……思った」
strings.translated: Daichi「...I thought... maybe it wouldn't hurt to watch things a little longer」

strings.text: 否定したかったことだけど……昨日姉さんと、それからさっき小西さんと話して出た結論はそれだった。
strings.translated: It was something I'd wanted to deny, but... after talking with Sis yesterday, and then with Konishi-san just now, that was the conclusion I'd reached.

strings.text: もしかしたらあそこは…やり方はおかしいけど、結局姉さんに必要な場所で、姉さんは救われたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe that place... the methods are wrong, but in the end it might be the place Sis needs, and maybe she really was saved there.

strings.text: そのことをもっとちゃんと考えてみるべきなのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe I should think about that more carefully.

strings.text: あそこがなかったら、姉さんはまだ引きこもっていて……姉さん自身が言っていた通り、死んでいたことだって考えられるんだ
strings.translated: Without that place, Sis would still have been shut in her room... and just as Sis herself had said, it's even possible she might have died.

strings.text: 愛「今日は行く？
strings.translated: Ai「Are you going today？

strings.text: 大智「今日は…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Today...」

strings.text: 神村さんが尋ねているのは、もちろんクラブのことだ。
strings.translated: What Kamimura-san was asking about was, of course, the Club.

strings.text: 正直、行きたくはないけど
strings.translated: Honestly, I didn't want to go, but...

strings.text: 大智「行くよ」
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm going」

strings.text: あそこが姉さんに必要だったとしても、さすがにただ放っておくことはできない。
strings.translated: Even if that place was something Sis needed, I still can't just leave things alone.

strings.text: 大智「もう一度……なるべく先入観を捨てて、よく見てみようと思ってる」
strings.translated: Daichi「One more time...... I want to try looking at it carefully, setting aside my preconceptions as much as I can」

strings.text: あそこが本当に悪い所なのかどうか。
strings.translated: Whether that place is truly a bad place or not.

strings.text: 少なくともセックスの強要はないみたいだし──そもそも本当に強要がないのかも、自分の目でちゃんと確かめよう
strings.translated: At least it doesn't seem like sex is being forced on anyone -- and whether there really is no coercion at all, I should confirm that with my own eyes.

strings.text: 愛「そう」
strings.translated: Ai「I see」

strings.text: 頷いた神村さんが何を考えているのかはよくわからなかった
strings.translated: I couldn't quite tell what Kamimura-san was thinking as she nodded.

strings.text: 愛「それじゃあ、行きましょうか
strings.translated: Ai「Well then, shall we go

strings.text: 街に出て、クラブへ向かう。
strings.translated: We headed into town and made our way to the Club.

strings.text: 今日は誰が来てるんだろう。
strings.translated: I wonder who's there today.

strings.text: 姉さん、桧垣、菱木さん、小野田さん、みんな来てるんだろうか。
strings.translated: Sis, Higaki, Hishiki-san, Onoda-san -- are they all there?

strings.text: 彼らに会ったらどんな態度を取ればいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: If I run into them, how am I even supposed to act?

strings.text: 頭の中ではそんな事ばかり考えてしまって、気分はますます暗くなっていく。
strings.translated: My head was filled with nothing but those kinds of thoughts, and my mood kept sinking darker and darker.

strings.text: 実際、今日は桧垣とはまともに話が出来ていない。
strings.translated: In fact, today I hadn't been able to have a proper conversation with Higaki at all.

strings.text: 色々なショックをまだ引きずっていた
strings.translated: I was still dragging around the weight of so many shocks.

strings.text: 愛「大丈夫？
strings.translated: Ai「Are you okay?」

strings.text: 顔色が悪いけど
strings.translated: You look pale, though...

strings.text: 大智「たぶん、大丈夫だと思う
strings.translated: Daichi「I think it'll probably be fine

strings.text: 愛「そう
strings.translated: Ai「I see.

strings.text: 神村さんも、一応は俺のことを心配してくれてるみたいだった。
strings.translated: It seemed like Kamimura-san was at least a little worried about me.

strings.text: こうやって協力してくれてるんだし、姉さんのためにも、まだ挫けるわけにはいかないんだ
strings.translated: She was cooperating with me like this, and for Sis's sake too, I couldn't afford to give up just yet.

strings.text: 愛「失礼します
strings.translated: Ai「Excuse me.

strings.text: 神村さんとクラブの奥に進むと、そこには昨日と同じ光景が広がっていた。
strings.translated: When I followed Kamimura-san deeper into the Club, the same scene as yesterday spread out before me.

strings.text: みんなが好きに過ごしていて、その中には当然セックスしてる人達もいる
strings.translated: Everyone was spending their time however they liked, and naturally that included people having sex.

strings.text: 部屋の隅のほうで、知らない男女が激しく交わっていた。
strings.translated: In the corner of the room, a man and woman I didn't know were going at it intensely.

strings.text: ２人とも服を脱いでるから、女の人の胸とか色々なところが見えてしまう。
strings.translated: Both of them had their clothes off, so I could see the woman's chest and all sorts of other things.

strings.text: 俺は思わず視線を外したけど、心臓は破裂せんばかりに鼓動していた
strings.translated: I instinctively looked away, but my heart was pounding like it was about to burst.

strings.text: 愛「白坂先輩、いるみたいね」
strings.translated: Ai「Looks like Shirasaka-senpai is here.」

strings.text: 神村さんの言葉に顔を上げる。
strings.translated: I looked up at Kamimura-san's words.

strings.text: 視線の先には、クラブの男と楽しげに会話をする姉さんの姿があった。
strings.translated: In the direction she was looking, I could see Sis chatting cheerfully with one of the Club's men.

strings.text: 今日は、小野田さんは来てないみたいだ。
strings.translated: Onoda-san didn't seem to be here today.

strings.text: いつも一緒なのに珍しいな
strings.translated: That was unusual -- they were always together.

strings.text: 愛「話さなくていいの？
strings.translated: Ai「Don't you want to talk to her?

strings.text: 昨夜、家から出ていこうとする姉さんと口論してから、まともな会話はできていない。
strings.translated: Since the argument last night when Sis was about to leave the house, we hadn't had a proper conversation.

strings.text: 今朝も芽生と３人で家を出たけれど、芽生と別れた後はあからさまに会話を避けられた。
strings.translated: This morning the three of us -- Sis, Mei, and I -- left the house together, but after we parted ways with Mei, Sis had obviously been avoiding talking to me.

strings.text: ここで話したところで、姉さんが聞く耳を持ってくれると思えない。
strings.translated: Even if I tried to talk to her here, I couldn't imagine Sis would be willing to listen.

strings.text: 思えないけど、何もしないのならここへ来た意味がない
strings.translated: I couldn't imagine it, but if I wasn't going to do anything, there was no point in coming here.

strings.text: それに、ただ座ってるだけなのも目立つ気がして、俺は意を決して姉さんのところに近づいていった
strings.translated: Besides, just sitting there doing nothing felt like it would stand out, so I steeled myself and walked over toward Sis.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis.

strings.text: 美桜「来てたのね
strings.translated: Mio「You came.

strings.text: 大智「少しだけ…話を聞いてほしいんだ
strings.translated: Daichi「I just... want you to hear me out for a bit.

strings.text: 美桜「…何？
strings.translated: Mio「...What?

strings.text: 大智「昨日、あの後…よく考えたんだけど、少し様子を見てみようと思ってる
strings.translated: Daichi「After yesterday... I thought it over a lot, and I've decided to try watching things for a while.

strings.text: 大智「姉さんの気持ちはよくわかった
strings.translated: Daichi「I understand how you feel now.

strings.text: 大智「…いや、多分俺には判らないっていうか…俺が思ってるよりずっと辛い思いをして、ここのおかげで楽になったんだってことは理解した
strings.translated: Daichi「...Well, I probably don't really understand -- but I get that you've been suffering a lot more than I ever imagined, and that this place has helped ease that pain.

strings.text: 大智「だから…もう一度一からよく見て、考え直してみる
strings.translated: Daichi「So... I'm going to start over from scratch, take a good look, and reconsider.

strings.text: 美桜「…そう
strings.translated: Mio「...I see.

strings.text: 美桜「……ありがとう」
strings.translated: Mio「......Thank you.」

strings.text: これで少しは、姉さんの信頼を取り戻せただろうか。
strings.translated: With that, maybe I'd managed to win back a little of Sis's trust.

strings.text: 姉さんを傷つけたことを許してもらえただろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe she'd forgiven me for hurting her.

strings.text: 気まずい空気を打ち消したくて、俺は話題を探した
strings.translated: Wanting to dispel the awkward air between us, I searched for something to talk about.

strings.text: 大智「今日は、小野田さんは…？
strings.translated: Daichi「Today, Onoda-san is...?

strings.text: 美桜「…来てないみたいね
strings.translated: Mio「...Doesn't look like she's here.

strings.text: 大智「今日は学校で別れたの？
strings.translated: Daichi「Did you two part ways at school today?

strings.text: 美桜「ううん、今日は学校にも来ていなかったみたい
strings.translated: Mio「No, it seems like she didn't come to school today either.

strings.text: 大智「病気？
strings.translated: Daichi「Is she sick?

strings.text: 美桜「どうかしら？
strings.translated: Mio「Who knows?

strings.text: 連絡もなかったから…」
strings.translated: She hasn't been in contact either...」

strings.text: 姉さんの答えに、妙な違和感を感じた。
strings.translated: There was something oddly off about Sis's answer.

strings.text: いつもの二人なら、連絡を取って確認したりしそうなものなのに
strings.translated: If it were those two as usual, I'd have expected them to reach out and check in with each other.

strings.text: 他校の男子生徒「白坂さん…ちょっといいかな？」
strings.translated: Male Student from Another School「Shirasaka-san... do you have a moment?」

strings.text: と、俺の思考を邪魔するように、知らない男が会話に割って入ってきた。
strings.translated: And then, as if to interrupt my train of thought, an unfamiliar guy cut into our conversation.

strings.text: 年は俺たちと同じくらい。
strings.translated: He looked about the same age as us.

strings.text: 違う学校のものらしき制服を着ている。
strings.translated: He was wearing what appeared to be a uniform from a different school.

strings.text: 場所がここでなければ、これから姉さんに告白でもしそうな態度だったけど
strings.translated: If we'd been anywhere else, his attitude would have made it look like he was about to confess to Sis.

strings.text: 姉さんは男にうなずいて、それから俺を見た
strings.translated: Sis nodded to the guy, then looked at me.

strings.text: 美桜「それじゃ…」
strings.translated: Mio「Well then...」

strings.text: 少し気まずそうな、俺を窺うような表情。
strings.translated: She wore a slightly awkward expression, glancing at me as if gauging my reaction.

strings.text: これから姉さんがこの男と何をするのか、そう考えたら辛いけど…ここで引き留めたら同じことの繰り返しだ
strings.translated: Thinking about what Sis was about to do with that man hurt -- but if I stopped her here, it would just be the same thing all over again.

strings.text: 大智「…うん、わかった
strings.translated: Daichi「...Yeah, I got it.」

strings.text: 美桜「じゃあ、また後でね
strings.translated: Mio「See you later, then.」

strings.text: 俺が頷くと、姉さんは少しほっとしたような表情で頷いて、男と一緒にパーティションの一つに入って行った
strings.translated: When I nodded, Sis gave a small nod back with a look of slight relief, then went into one of the partitions together with the guy.

strings.text: 溜息をつきながら、俺は元の場所に戻った。
strings.translated: With a sigh, I made my way back to where I'd been sitting.

strings.text: そこには、まだ神村さんが座っていて、物静かな目で俺のことを見ていた
strings.translated: Kamimura-san was still there, watching me with those quiet, still eyes.

strings.text: 愛「辛そうね
strings.translated: Ai「You look like you're struggling.」

strings.text: 大智「そうだな
strings.translated: Daichi「Yeah...」

strings.text: 本当にこれで正しいのか、俺にもまだ自信はない。
strings.translated: Whether this was really the right thing to do -- I still wasn't sure.

strings.text: やっぱり力づくでも姉さんを引き離すべきなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Should I just drag Sis away by force after all?

strings.text: それとも、自分がやってしまったことを明かしてでも、両親に相談するべきなのか…俺はどうしたらいいんだろう。
strings.translated: Or should I come clean about what I'd done and consult our parents...? What was I supposed to do?

strings.text: ここ最近毎日繰り返している問答に沈んでいると
strings.translated: I was sinking into the same questions I'd been asking myself every day lately, when --

strings.text: 心音「こんにちは
strings.translated: Kokone「Hello.」

strings.text: 突然、思わぬ光景が飛び込んできた。
strings.translated: Suddenly, an unexpected sight jumped out at me.

strings.text: なんでだ？
strings.translated: Why?

strings.text: どうして彼女がここに来る？
strings.translated: Why was she here?

strings.text: 大智「戸田さん！
strings.translated: Daichi「Toda-san!」
Kokone「......?」

strings.text: 思わず声を上げた俺を見て、戸田さんが少し考え、思いだしたような顔をする
strings.translated: She turned to look at me as I blurted that out, then paused for a moment -- like something had just come back to her.

strings.text: 心音「どうしてあなたが…？」
strings.translated: Kokone「Why are you here...?」

strings.text: それを聞きたいのはこっちの方だ
strings.translated: That's exactly what I wanted to ask her.

strings.text: 問い詰めようと口を開いたところで、更に見知った顔が現れた
strings.translated: Just as I opened my mouth to press her for answers, another familiar face appeared.

strings.text: 紗英子「あら
strings.translated: Saeko「Oh my.」

strings.text: 振り向いた戸田さんが、軽く頭を下げる
strings.translated: Toda-san turned around and gave a small bow.

strings.text: 大智「菱木さん、まさか…！
strings.translated: Daichi「Higaki-san, don't tell me...！

strings.text: 紗英子「ええ。
strings.translated: Saeko「Yes.」

strings.text: 私が声をかけたの。
strings.translated: I reached out to her.

strings.text: 彼女にも救いが必要そうだったから」
strings.translated: She seemed like someone who needed saving too.」

strings.text: 菱木さんは悪びれる様子もなくうなずいてみせた。
strings.translated: Higaki-san nodded without a hint of remorse.

strings.text: 俺のせいだ。
strings.translated: This was my fault.

strings.text: 俺が生徒会なんかに相談したから……俺はそんなことを頼みたかったわけじゃない…！
strings.translated: Because I went and consulted the student council... This isn't what I wanted at all...!

strings.text: 大智「戸田さん、すぐに帰るんだ。
strings.translated: Daichi「Toda-san, you need to go home right now.」

strings.text: ここは君が来るような場所じゃない
strings.translated: This isn't a place for you.」

strings.text: 心音「え……？
strings.translated: Kokone「Huh......？

strings.text: 紗英子「あなた、何のためにここにいるの？
strings.translated: Saeko「What are you here for？

strings.text: そんなことを言っていたら、追い出されるわよ
strings.translated: If you keep talking like that, you'll get thrown out.

strings.text: 大智「──っ！
strings.translated: Daichi「──...!」

strings.text: 紗英子「戸田さん、こっちよ
strings.translated: Saeko「Toda-san, come this way.」

strings.text: 菱木さんが部屋の奥に行って、俺の顔色を窺うようにしながら戸田さんもそれについて行く。
strings.translated: Higaki-san headed toward the back of the room, and Toda-san followed after her, glancing at my face as she went.

strings.text: 引き留めたかったのに、できなかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to stop her, but I couldn't.

strings.text: どうしていいのかわからなかった。
strings.translated: I didn't know what I was supposed to do.

strings.text: 今このクラブに反発して出入り禁止になるのもこまるけど、それ以上に自分の判断に自信が持てない
strings.translated: Getting banned from the Club by pushing back right now would be a problem -- but more than that, I just couldn't trust my own judgment anymore.

strings.text: 愛「彼女も救われたい人なのね
strings.translated: Ai「She's someone who wants to be saved too, isn't she.」

strings.text: 大智「救われたいって…よりによって、どうしてここで
strings.translated: Daichi「Wants to be saved... of all places, why here...」

strings.text: 愛「それだけ辛いことがあったんでしょう
strings.translated: Ai「Something must have hurt her that badly.」

strings.text: 愛「菱木さんがちゃんと導いてくれれば、彼女も救われるんじゃない？
strings.translated: Ai「If Higaki-san guides her properly, won't she be saved too？

strings.text: 白坂先輩みたいに
strings.translated: Just like Shirasaka-senpai...

strings.text: 大智「姉さんみたいにって
strings.translated: Daichi「Like what happened to Sis, you mean...」

strings.text: だんだんわからなくなってくる。
strings.translated: I was starting to lose track of things.

strings.text: 自分の考えに自信が持てなくなってくる。
strings.translated: I was losing confidence in my own thinking.

strings.text: 結局のところ、俺が理解してないのが悪いのか？
strings.translated: When it came down to it, was I the one in the wrong for not understanding?

strings.text: みんな救われようとしてて、実際救われたって感じてる人もいて、それなのに俺が認めようとしないのが悪いのか？
strings.translated: Everyone is trying to be saved, and some of them actually feel like they have been -- so is it wrong of me for refusing to accept that?

strings.text: 心身ともに疲れてしまって、俺は近くにあった椅子に腰かけた。
strings.translated: Exhausted in body and mind, I sank into a nearby chair.

strings.text: 自分の努力が全て無駄になってる気がする。
strings.translated: It felt like every effort I'd made had been for nothing.

strings.text: 意味のないことをしているような気がしてならない。
strings.translated: Like everything I was doing was meaningless.

strings.text: 戸田さんの連れて行かれた部屋の方を見る。
strings.translated: I looked toward the room Toda-san had been taken into.

strings.text: やっぱり彼女も…今日ではないにしても、いずれそうなってしまうんだろうか？
strings.translated: Would she end up the same way too... maybe not today, but eventually?

strings.text: でも…それで戸田さんが救われるのだとしたら
strings.translated: But... if that was what would save her --

strings.text: 姉さんと同じように、戸田さんもクラブに任せた方がいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Just like with Saeko-san, maybe I should leave Toda-san to the Club as well.

strings.text: 自分でも様子を見ようと結論付けたし、姉さんにもそう言ったけど、どうしてもそれが正しい事だと思えない。
strings.translated: I'd concluded on my own that I should wait and see, and I told Saeko-san the same -- but I just can't bring myself to believe that's the right thing to do.

strings.text: そう考えること自体が、俺の方が間違っているんだろうか。
strings.translated: Is the very fact that I think that proof that I'm the one who's wrong?

strings.text: 何とかしなければならないはずなのに、その方法が見つからない。
strings.translated: I know I have to do something, but I can't find a way to do it.

strings.text: 今まで以上に、自分の考えに自信が持てない。
strings.translated: More than ever before, I have no confidence in my own judgment.

strings.text: このまま、戸田さんのことは菱木さんに任せたほうがいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Should I just leave Toda-san in Higaki-san's hands and let things be?

strings.text: 何一つとして答えは出なくて、俺はただうなだれることしかできなかった
strings.translated: Not a single answer came to me, and all I could do was hang my head.

strings.text: 紗英子「また呼び出してしまってごめんなさい。
strings.translated:
Saeko「I'm sorry for calling you out here again.
What I want to talk about today is different from last time.」

strings.text: 今日はこの間の件とは違う話なの。
strings.translated: No.

strings.text: …ううん。
strings.translated: Maybe it's the same thing after all.

strings.text: 同じ話かしら
strings.translated: I nodded along, but I couldn't quite grasp what Higaki-senpai was trying to say.

strings.text: 頷いてはみたけれど、菱木先輩が何を言おうとしているのか、私にはよくわからなかった。
strings.translated: For the past few days, Yuzawa and the others hadn't said or done anything to me.

strings.text: ここ数日、湯沢さんたちからは何も言われていないし、されていない。
strings.translated: Could it be... that it was thanks to Higaki-senpai?

strings.text: もしかして…菱木先輩のおかげなんだろうか
strings.translated: Saeko「What was done to you, and what you've had to endure...」

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたが何をされて、何に耐えてきたのか……。
strings.translated: Saeko「I know all of it.」

strings.text: 私は知っているわ。
strings.translated: It must have been so hard for you.

strings.text: 辛かったでしょうね
strings.translated: Kokone「But...」

strings.text: 心音「いえ……悪いのは私ですから
strings.translated: Kokone「No... I'm the one at fault.」

strings.text: 紗英子「それは違うわ、戸田さん。
strings.translated: Saeko「That's not true, Toda-san.

strings.text: あなたには資格があるのよ
strings.translated: You have the right.」

strings.text: 心音「資格…？
strings.translated: Kokone「The right...?」

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたはとてもつらい目に遭ってきた。
strings.translated: Saeko「You've been through so much suffering.

strings.text: でもそれを誰にも打ち明けずに堪えて…そのうえ、あなたを酷い目に遭わせた彼女たちを許そうとした
strings.translated: And yet you bore it all without confiding in anyone... and on top of that, you tried to forgive the girls who put you through such terrible things.」

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたはとても優しくて、清らかな心を持った人。
strings.translated: Saeko「You are a very gentle person, with a pure heart.

strings.text: そんなあなたこそ救われる価値のある人だって、私は思うの
strings.translated: Someone like you is exactly the kind of person who deserves to be saved -- that's what I believe.」
Kokone「......?」

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたはこんなところで燻っているべき人じゃないわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「You shouldn't be smoldering away in a place like this.

strings.text: あんな人たちに虐げられて、それを当然だと受け入れるべきではないの
strings.translated: You shouldn't be oppressed by people like them, and you shouldn't have to accept that as something natural.」

strings.text: 心音「でも……」
strings.translated: Kokone「But that's all just a pipe dream.」

strings.text: でも、そんなのは夢物語みたいなもの。
strings.translated: There's no way a future exists where I'm not being bullied...

strings.text: 私がいじめられない未来なんてあるはずがないんだから…。
strings.translated: Changing a fate that's already been decided -- even Higaki-senpai couldn't do that, I'm sure.

strings.text: 定められた未来を変えるなんて、きっと菱木先輩だって無理。
strings.translated: No matter what anyone does, my misfortune won't change...

strings.text: 誰が何をしようと私の不幸は変わらない…。
strings.translated: But even so, is it just human nature to keep reaching out for salvation anyway?

strings.text: でも、それでも救いを求めてしまうのは、人間の性というものなんだろうか
strings.translated: She's not trying to make fun of me...?

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたには資格があるのよ、戸田さん
strings.translated: Saeko「You have the right, Toda-san.」

strings.text: 心音「資格
strings.translated: Kokone「The right...」

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたは本当の自分の姿に気づかなければいけないわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「You need to become aware of who you truly are.

strings.text: あなたがどれだけ価値のある人間か、それを知らないといけない
strings.translated: You need to know just how much worth you have as a person.」

strings.text: 心音「本当の…わたし
strings.translated: Kokone「The real... me...」

strings.text: 心音「あの……本当ですか？
strings.translated: Kokone「Um... is that really true?

strings.text: 私をからかおうとしてるんじゃなくて……？
strings.translated: She's not trying to make fun of me...?

strings.text: 紗英子「どうして私があなたをからかう必要があるの？
strings.translated: Saeko「Why would I ever need to make fun of you?」

strings.text: 紗英子「あなたさえよければ……私が所属している秘密のクラブに招待したいの。
strings.translated: Saeko「If you're willing... I'd like to invite you to the secret Club I belong to.

strings.text: どうかしら？」
strings.translated: What do you say?」

strings.text: 秘密のクラブ……！
strings.translated: A secret Club...!

strings.text: 私が？
strings.translated: Me?

strings.text: 本当に？
strings.translated: Really?

strings.text: あの生徒会長、菱木先輩と同じ、秘密のクラブに…？
strings.translated: The same secret Club as that student council president, Higaki-senpai...?

strings.text: 心音「あの、私……はい！
strings.translated: Kokone「Um, I... yes!

strings.text: 私、いきます！
strings.translated: I'll go!

strings.text: 紗英子「そう、よかった
strings.translated: Saeko「Good. I'm glad.」

strings.text: 紗英子「ハーブティーよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「It's herbal tea.

strings.text: 気持ちが落ち着くから」
strings.translated: It'll help calm you down.」

strings.text: 先輩に薦められるまま、私は白いティーカップに注がれたお茶に口をつけた。
strings.translated: At senpai's recommendation, I brought the tea poured into a white teacup to my lips.

strings.text: 甘いミルクティーに近い味で、とてもおいしい。
strings.translated: It tasted close to a sweet milk tea, and it was delicious.

strings.text: 身体の中がぽかぽかと温まっていくような感じがする
strings.translated: I could feel a gentle warmth spreading through my body.

strings.text: 心音「あの…ここって、どういうところなんですか？」
strings.translated: Kokone「Um... what kind of place is this?」

strings.text: 菱木先輩に連れて来られたのは、小さなビルにある部屋だった
strings.translated: The place Higaki-senpai had brought me to was a room in a small building.

strings.text: 紗英子「言ったでしょう？
strings.translated: Saeko「I told you, didn't I?

strings.text: 秘密のクラブよ。
strings.translated: It's a secret Club.

strings.text: 皆は『友愛クラブ』って呼んでるみたいね
strings.translated: 「Everyone seems to call it the 'Friendship Club.'」

strings.text: 紗英子「この先、あなたが望むなら、いつでも好きな時に来て構わないわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「From now on, if you wish, you're welcome to come here whenever you like.

strings.text: ただし…他言は無用よ
strings.translated: However... don't breathe a word of it to anyone.」

strings.text: 心音「好きに…」
strings.translated: Kokone「However I like...」

strings.text: そう言われても、特別な所はない感じだった。
strings.translated: Even being told that, it didn't feel like there was anything particularly special about it.

strings.text: さっきの部屋も、普通の塾みたいだったし…そういえば
strings.translated: The room from before looked like an ordinary cram school, too... come to think of it --

strings.text: 心音「あの、さっきの人は…」
strings.translated: Kokone「Um, that person from before...」

strings.text: たしか湯沢さん達にいじめられて泣いていた私に、声をかけてくれた男の人
strings.translated: He was the man who had spoken to me when I was crying after being bullied by Yuzawa and the others, if I remembered right.

strings.text: 紗英子「彼はまだはいって日が浅いから、まだ迷いがあるみたいね
strings.translated: Saeko「He hasn't been here long, so it seems he still has his doubts.」

strings.text: 紗英子「でも、彼があなたの事を私に教えてくれたのよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「But he's the one who told me about you.
