strings.translated: Saeko「Yes...」

strings.text: 私は園田の言葉に答えるように作り笑いを浮かべてみせる。
strings.translated: I let a practiced smile rise to my face, as if in answer to Sonoda's words.

strings.text: しかし、そうはいわれても結局は真の救いの扉とやらの手前から話を進めようともしないし、私もそこへと進んでいる実感はない。
strings.translated: Yet even so, he made no move to actually advance the conversation past the threshold of that so-called door to true salvation, and I had no sense that I was drawing any closer to it myself.

strings.text: そんな疑問を胸の内に抱いていると、園田がまるで心の中を読んだかのように言葉を続けてきた
strings.translated: As I held that question quietly within my chest, Sonoda continued speaking, as though he had read my very thoughts.

strings.text: 園田「紗英子君には、もっと広い世界が必要なのかもしれないね
strings.translated: Sonoda「Perhaps what you need, Saeko, is a wider world.」

strings.text: 紗英子「…広い世界？
strings.translated: Saeko「...A wider world?」

strings.text: 園田「クラブの中だけで満足できないのなら、さらに外の世界を見てみるといいんじゃないかな？」
strings.translated: Sonoda「If you cannot find satisfaction within the Club alone, perhaps it would be good to look at the world beyond it.」

strings.text: つまり、クラブの中でするだけじゃなくて、クラブの外ででもしてみればいい、とでもいいたいのだろう
strings.translated: In other words, he was probably trying to say: don't limit yourself to what happens inside the Club -- try doing it outside as well.

strings.text: 園田「他の子には薦めないが…君ならクラブで過ごすだけでは得られない幸せを、見つけることができると思うよ
strings.translated: Sonoda「I wouldn't suggest this to the others... but I believe you are someone who can find a happiness that cannot be obtained simply by spending time within the Club.」

strings.text: 紗英子「でも…」
strings.translated: Saeko「But...」

strings.text: そうはいわれても、このクラブの外でとなると、それには相当な危険がともなうように感じられた。
strings.translated: Even so, the idea of stepping outside this Club felt like it would come with considerable danger.

strings.text: そう思った私の口からは、飾ることなく躊躇の色を帯びた声が漏れてしまう
strings.translated: That thought slipped out of me unbidden -- a voice tinged with undisguised hesitation.

strings.text: 園田「もちろん、ただ無目的に街の中を歩けと言ってるんじゃない。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Of course, I'm not telling you to wander the streets aimlessly with no purpose.

strings.text: 私が言いたいのは、自分という存在をどう使うかなんだ
strings.translated: What I mean is -- how you choose to use your own existence.」

strings.text: 園田「クラブの中だけで使うのか、それともさらに広い世界で使うのか
strings.translated: Sonoda「Whether you use it only within the Club, or whether you use it in a wider world beyond.」

strings.text: 園田「君には恐らく、このクラブは狭すぎるんだろう。
strings.translated: Sonoda「For you, this Club is probably too small.

strings.text: 広い世界には危険も伴うが、それでも君なら乗り越えられると私は考えているんだ
strings.translated: The wider world carries its own dangers -- but even so, I believe you are someone who can overcome them.」

strings.text: 園田「もちろん、何か困ったことが起きたらいつでも相談しなさい
strings.translated: Sonoda「And of course, if anything troubling comes up, you can always come to me.」

strings.text: 園田「…私の言っていることがわかるかな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「...Do you understand what I'm saying?」

strings.text: 紗英子「わかる、気がします」
strings.translated: Saeko「I think... I understand.」

strings.text: 園田のいいたかったことの意味は、はっきりと理解できたわけじゃない。
strings.translated: I didn't fully grasp the exact meaning of what Sonoda was trying to say.

strings.text: でも、全然理解できなかったわけでもない。
strings.translated: But I didn't fail to understand it entirely, either.

strings.text: つまり、結局はクラブの中だけにとどまらず、クラブの外でもセックスをしてくるといい。
strings.translated: In short, the conclusion was: don't stay confined to the Club -- go out and have sex in the world beyond it as well.

strings.text: ということなんだろう。
strings.translated: That was what it came down to.

strings.text: 色々と抽象的に装飾され、それらしい言葉にはなっているけれども、園田がいわんとしているのはそういうことなんだとは理解できていた
strings.translated: It was dressed up in all sorts of abstract, high-sounding language, but I understood that was what Sonoda was getting at.

strings.text: 園田「多くのことを試すと良い。
strings.translated: Sonoda「It would be good to try many things.

strings.text: 今回のように新しいメンバーを連れて来ることも、自分を知るための方法のひとつだ
strings.translated: Bringing in a new member, as you did this time, is also one way of coming to know yourself.」

strings.text: 園田「行動することで何かが変わるかもしれないし、何も変わらないかもしれない。
strings.translated: Sonoda「By taking action, something may change -- or nothing may change at all.

strings.text: 何も変わらなかったとしても、それもまたひとつの経験だ
strings.translated: Even if nothing changes, that too is an experience in itself.」

strings.text: 園田「大丈夫。
strings.translated: Sonoda「It's all right.

strings.text: 今の紗英子君は、心音君を連れてくる前の紗英子君よりも、確実に一歩前に進んでいるよ
strings.translated: The Saeko standing here now has definitely taken one step forward compared to the Saeko who existed before bringing Kokone in.」

strings.text: 園田の口から私を高く評価する言葉が告げられる。
strings.translated: Words of high praise for me came from Sonoda's lips.

strings.text: ちょっと単純かもしれないけど、それにはやはり悪い気はしない
strings.translated: Maybe I'm just simple-minded, but even so, it didn't feel bad to hear.

strings.text: 園田「ゆっくりでいい。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Take your time.

strings.text: 確実な一歩を踏み出しなさい。
strings.translated: Take each step with certainty.

strings.text: その一歩のために長く悩むことがあっても、それは必要なことなんだから
strings.translated: Even if you spend a long time agonizing over that one step, that is a necessary part of the process.」

strings.text: 紗英子「はい
strings.translated: Saeko「Yes.」

strings.text: その後、私は園田と身体を交え、少しだけ発散する時間を過ごすことができた。
strings.translated: After that, I spent some time with Sonoda -- bodies entwined -- and was able to let off a little steam.

strings.text: 幸せになったとまではいえなかったけど、ストレスが解消された分、少しだけ心が軽くなった気がした。
strings.translated: I couldn't say I had become happy, exactly, but with the stress relieved, I felt as though my heart had grown just a little lighter.

strings.text: 急がなくていい。
strings.translated: No need to rush.

strings.text: ゆっくりでもいい。
strings.translated: It's fine to go slowly.

strings.text: そんなのは実の親からだっていわれたことがない気がする。
strings.translated: I don't think I had ever heard anything like that from my own parents.

strings.text: 自分のためであることは理解できていたけれども、私が先を進むことは親の求めを押し付けられているような気がしていたのも事実だ。
strings.translated: I understood that it was for his own purposes -- yet it was also true that moving forward had always felt to me like having my parents' demands pressed upon me.

strings.text: 私は私のために勉強してきてはいたけれども、それでも親の期待に応えようとしていたというのもなかった訳ではない。
strings.translated: I had studied for my own sake, yes -- but it wasn't as though there had been nothing in me that was also trying to live up to their expectations.

strings.text: だけど、今はそれが意味のあることだったのか疑問でもあった。
strings.translated: Now, though, I found myself wondering whether any of that had even meant anything.

strings.text: でも、そんなことも、今は、今、この瞬間はどうでもいいことのように感じられていた
strings.translated: But even that -- right now, in this moment -- felt like something that didn't matter at all.

strings.text: 学校での日常は平穏に過ぎていった。
strings.translated: The ordinary days at school passed by in peace.

strings.text: 戸田さんも自分のことは自分で解決できるようになったみたいで、もう私の出る幕はないみたいだった。
strings.translated: Toda-san seemed to have become capable of handling her own affairs on her own, and it looked like there was no longer any place for me to step in.

strings.text: それならそれでも構わない。
strings.translated: That was fine by me.

strings.text: 私に期待するような変化はもたらされなかったけれど、それでも手間が減ったのはいいことだ
strings.translated: The change I had hoped for hadn't come -- but even so, having one less thing to deal with was a good thing.

strings.text: 紗英子「さてと、今日は…」
strings.translated: Saeko「Now then, today...」

strings.text: 今日もクラブに行くことを考えはしたけれど、なんとなく気乗りがしなかった。
strings.translated: I had considered going to the Club again today, but somehow I just wasn't in the mood.

strings.text: 救われる、という言葉が頭に引っかかり続けているのもあるけれど、それ以上にクラブですら変化のない日々に埋没してきているようにも思えたからだ。
strings.translated: Part of it was that the word "salvation" kept snagging in my mind -- but more than that, it felt as though even the Club had become just another part of the unchanging days I was sinking into.

strings.text: 確かにクラブに行けば、思うままにゆったりとした時間を過ごしたり、刹那的な快楽に身を任せてストレスをその場限りとはいっても発散することだってできた。
strings.translated: It was true that if I went to the Club, I could spend my time there at a leisurely pace, doing as I pleased, or give myself over to fleeting pleasure and relieve my stress -- even if only for that moment.

strings.text: 紗英子「広い世界、ね…」
strings.translated: Saeko「A wider world, huh...」

strings.text: 園田の告げた言葉を思い出す。
strings.translated: I recalled the words Sonoda had told me.

strings.text: 私の本当の居場所はどこにあるのだろうか。
strings.translated: Where, truly, did I belong?

strings.text: クラブの外のどんな場所でなら、真の救いの扉とやらを見つけ出すことができるのだろうか？
strings.translated: In what place outside the Club could I find what he called the door to true salvation?

strings.text: そのことにこだわっているつもりはなかったけれど、やはり気にはなってしまう。
strings.translated: I hadn't meant to dwell on it -- and yet I couldn't help but think about it.

strings.text: そのことも織り込みながら色々と考えてみたけれど、どこが私の広い世界なのかがわからない。
strings.translated: I had tried turning it over in my mind from every angle, but I couldn't figure out where my "wider world" was supposed to be.

strings.text: 学校全体のことなのか、それとも街一つの規模が必要なのか、あるいはもっと大きな場所のことをいっているのか。
strings.translated: Was it the whole school? Or did it need to be the scale of an entire town -- or somewhere even larger than that?

strings.text: それとも自分の今の在り方を変える、ということなんだろうか？
strings.translated: Or did it mean changing the very way I exist right now?

strings.text: たとえば…芸能界に入るとか、犯罪者になってみるとか…。
strings.translated: For instance... entering show business, or becoming a criminal...

strings.text: 極端な考え方だったかもしれないけど、こういったものは常識にとらわれていては先へと進めない。
strings.translated: Those might have been extreme ideas, but with things like this, you can't move forward if you stay bound by common sense.

strings.text: とにかく、無茶な方法でもいいから色々と試してみて、なにかしらのきっかけをつかもうか、と思っていた。
strings.translated: Anyway, I had been thinking that even if the methods were reckless, I should try all sorts of things and grab hold of some kind of opening.

strings.text: とはいっても、どこへと向かい、なにから手を付ければいいのか？
strings.translated: But even so -- where was I supposed to go, and what was I supposed to start with?

strings.text: そのヒントさえも見当たらずにいた。
strings.translated: I couldn't find even a hint of an answer.

strings.text: でも、可能性がまったくのゼロともいい切れないような気はしていた。
strings.translated: Still, I couldn't quite bring myself to say the possibility was absolute zero.

strings.text: 仮定するなら、クラブで救われていると実感している人達は瞬間的には私よりもどこか前に進んでいる人達なのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Hypothetically speaking, the people who feel they've been saved by the Club might, in some fleeting sense, be further along than I am.

strings.text: それなら、彼らと深く接することで、真の救いの扉とやらへのヒントが得られたりするのではないだろうか。
strings.translated: If so, by connecting with them more deeply, perhaps I could find some hint toward what he called the door to true salvation.

strings.text: それは単なる希望にしか過ぎなかったけど、１人で考えていても埒が明かないのだし、この際だからなんでも試してみたほうがいいのかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: It was nothing more than wishful thinking -- but sitting here mulling it over alone wasn't getting me anywhere, and I figured it might be worth trying anything at this point.

strings.text: そういえば白坂美桜は強姦事件の被害者だと聞いている。
strings.translated: Come to think of it, I had heard that Shirасака Mio was a victim of a rape.

strings.text: そんなつらい体験をした彼女が、今ではとても明るい女の子になっている。
strings.translated: That girl, who had gone through such a painful experience, was now a very bright and cheerful person.

strings.text: 多分、彼女は自分が救われたと思っているだろうし、周りもそう思っている。
strings.translated: She probably believed she had been saved, and those around her likely thought the same.

strings.text: それは見ていても明らかなことだ。
strings.translated: That much was obvious just from watching them.

strings.text: だったら…そんな彼女と親密になれば、またなにか新しい発見があるかもしれない。
strings.translated: In that case... if I got close to her, maybe I'd discover something new.

strings.text: なら、試してみる価値はありそうだ
strings.translated: It seemed worth a try.

strings.text: 紗英子「あら？」
strings.translated: Saeko「Oh?」

strings.text: と、そんな考えごとをしていると、廊下の向こうから見覚えのある人物が歩いて来るのが見えた。
strings.translated: Just as I was lost in those thoughts, I noticed a familiar figure walking toward me from down the hallway.

strings.text: 直感的にわかる。
strings.translated: I knew it instinctively.

strings.text: 彼は、私に用があって来たのだ。
strings.translated: He had come here because he had something to say to me.

strings.text: おそらくは、戸田さんに関することで…。
strings.translated: Most likely, it had something to do with Toda-san...

strings.text: 彼の感情を一言で表すなら、怒り、だろう。
strings.translated: If I had to sum up his emotions in a single word, it would be: anger.

strings.text: きっと彼は私に対して怒っているはずだった。
strings.translated: He was surely angry at me.

strings.text: 怒っているからこそ、その原因となっているであろう戸田さんについての話があるはずだ
strings.translated: And precisely because he was angry, there must be something he wanted to say about Toda-san -- who was likely the cause of it.

strings.text: そう…白坂大智さんには
strings.translated: Yes... Shirasaka Daichi had...

strings.text: 大智「菱木さん、ちょっといいかな
strings.translated: Daichi「Hishiki-san, do you have a moment?」

strings.text: 後悔ばかりが募っていた。
strings.translated: All I felt was a mounting pile of regret.

strings.text: 戸田さんのことを、桧垣や菱木さんに話したのは完全に失敗だった。
strings.translated: Telling Higaki and Hishiki-san about Toda-san had been a complete mistake.

strings.text: どうしてこんな事になってしまったのか。
strings.translated: How had things come to this?

strings.text: 本当はどうすれば良かったのか。
strings.translated: What should I have done instead?

strings.text: 考えたところで答えは出ないけど、考えずにはいられなかった
strings.translated: Thinking about it wouldn't give me any answers -- but I couldn't stop thinking about it.

strings.text: 大智「戸田さん、どこにいるんだ」
strings.translated: Daichi「Where is Toda-san?」

strings.text: 昼休みの時間、俺は戸田さんのことを捜していた。
strings.translated: During the lunch break, I was searching for Toda-san.

strings.text: とにかく、まずは会わないといけない。
strings.translated: Whatever else, I had to see her first.

strings.text: 会って話をして、あのクラブから引き離さないといけない。
strings.translated: I had to meet her, talk to her, and pull her away from that Club.

strings.text: 本当は姉さんのことだけで手一杯なのに、次から次に問題が起こってしまう。
strings.translated: I was already more than overwhelmed just dealing with my sister -- and now problems kept coming one after another.

strings.text: 自分なりに努力はしてるつもりだけど、このままだと俺の頭までおかしくなってしまいそうだった
strings.translated: I was trying my best in my own way, but at this rate I felt like I was going to lose my mind.

strings.text: 理恵「ホント、何なの？
strings.translated: Rie「Seriously, what is her problem?

strings.text: 戸田の奴……ヘラヘラして気持ち悪っ！」
strings.translated: That Toda girl... smiling like an idiot, it's gross!」

strings.text: ──戸田？
strings.translated: -- Toda?

strings.text: 奈津美「心音ちゃん…本格的に頭がいっちゃったのかなぁ？
strings.translated: Natsumi「Kokone-chan... has she finally gone completely off the deep end?」

strings.text: 舞子「元々おかしいとは思ってたけど、あれほどとはね」
strings.translated: Maiko「I always thought something was off about her, but not to that extent.」

strings.text: 戸田さんを馬鹿にするような物言いをする３人の少女。
strings.translated: Three girls, speaking about Toda-san in a mocking, belittling way.

strings.text: なんとなく嫌な感じがした。
strings.translated: I felt a vague sense of unease.

strings.text: 証拠はないし、憶測でしかないけど、この３人が戸田さんをいじめているんじゃないだろうか？
strings.translated: I had no proof, and it was only speculation -- but weren't these three the ones bullying Toda-san?

strings.text: …少なくとも、今戸田さんの話をしているってことは、居場所を知っているだろうか。
strings.translated: ...At the very least, since they were talking about Toda-san right now, they probably knew where she was.

strings.text: その口ぶりだけでも話したい相手じゃない雰囲気だったけど、昼休みの時間は限られている
strings.translated: The way they talked made it clear they weren't the kind of people I wanted to deal with -- but lunch break time was limited.

strings.text: 大智「君達、戸田さんがどこにいるか知ってるのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Hey, do you know where Toda-san is?」

strings.text: 理恵「は？
strings.translated: Rie「Huh?

strings.text: 誰？
strings.translated: Who is he?

strings.text: 奈津美「心音ちゃんに何か用ですかぁ？
strings.translated: Natsumi「Do you have some business with Kokone-chan~?」

strings.text: 大智「いや、ちょっと……用事があって」
strings.translated: Daichi「No, just... I had something to take care of.」

strings.text: しまった。
strings.translated: Damn.

strings.text: 彼女を探す理由を、なにも考えていなかった。
strings.translated: I hadn't thought of any reason to be looking for her.

strings.text: 本当のことや、戸田さんがいじめられているらしいから、何て事を言えば事態を複雑にするだけだ。
strings.translated: Telling the truth, or saying something like "I heard Toda-san is being bullied" -- that would only make things more complicated.

strings.text: それくらいは俺にもわかっている
strings.translated: Even I understood that much.

strings.text: 理恵「戸田に？
strings.translated: Rie「With Toda?

strings.text: あんた、私達より先輩でしょ？
strings.translated: Hey, you're older than us, right?

strings.text: 先輩が何で心音のことなんか気にすんの？
strings.translated: Why does an upperclassman even care about Kokone?

strings.text: 舞子「…もしかして、戸田さんと付き合ってるとか？
strings.translated: Maiko「...Wait, are you two going out or something?」

strings.text: 奈津美「まっさかぁ～。
strings.translated: Natsumi「No waaay~.

strings.text: 心音ちゃんにこんな彼氏がいるはずないじゃな～い
strings.translated: There's no way Kokone-chan has a boyfriend like him~.」

strings.text: やっぱりこの３人が戸田さんをいじめているんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: More than that -- they might have just done something to her.

strings.text: それどころか、戸田さんに何かしてきたところなのかもしれない。
strings.translated: I had to find out where she was somehow... no, wait.

strings.text: なんとか居場所を聞き出さないと……いや、今戸田さんに何かしてきたなら、きっとこの先だ。
strings.translated: If they had just done something to her, she was probably just ahead.

strings.text: この間は特別実習棟のトイレだったけど、この先にあるのは…理科室の隣にもトイレがある。
strings.translated: Last time it was the bathroom in the special practical building -- and just up ahead there was... there's a bathroom next to the science room too.

strings.text: 昼休みならこのあたりも人通りは少ない
strings.translated: Around here, foot traffic would be sparse during lunch break.

strings.text: 大智「知らないならいいんだ。
strings.translated: Daichi「If you don't know, that's fine.

strings.text: 呼び止めてごめん
strings.translated: Sorry for stopping you.」

strings.text: これ以上関わっている時間も惜しくて、足を速める
strings.translated: Not wanting to waste any more time on them, I quickened my pace.

strings.text: 奈津美「あっ、行っちゃうのぉ～？
strings.translated: Natsumi「Oh, leaving already~?」

strings.text: 理恵「戸田によろしくぅ～
strings.translated: Rie「Say hi to Toda for us~.」

strings.text: 理恵「ふふっ」
strings.translated: Rie「Hehe.」

strings.text: 後ろから、女の子達の声が聞こえる。
strings.translated: Their voices followed me from behind.

strings.text: 人のことを馬鹿にして、楽しむことしかできない最低の連中だ。
strings.translated: The worst kind of people -- the only thing they know how to do is mock others and enjoy it.

strings.text: どうして、あんな奴らが笑っていられて、戸田さんみたいな女の子が涙を流さなければならないんだ。
strings.translated: Why is it that people like them get to keep laughing, while a girl like Toda-san has to cry?

strings.text: 戸田さんだけじゃない。
strings.translated: And it wasn't just Toda-san.

strings.text: 普通に生きてた姉さんはあんな目に遭って、どうして人をいじめるような連中がいつまでも笑ってられるんだろう。
strings.translated: My sister, who had just been living her normal life, had to go through what she went through -- so why do people who bully others get to keep smiling forever?

strings.text: やり場のない怒りに突き動かされるように、俺は駆けだした
strings.translated: Driven by an anger that had nowhere to go, I broke into a run.

strings.text: どうして、突然そんな質問が出てくるのか理解不能だった
strings.translated: I couldn't comprehend why such a question would suddenly come up.

strings.text: 大智「仲良くしてもらってるとは思うけど
strings.translated: Daichi「I think she's been kind to me...

strings.text: 円夏「そういう事じゃなくて、愛のことを１人の女の子として見てるかどうかってこと
strings.translated: Madoka「That's not what I mean -- I'm asking whether you see Ai as a girl, as in, one individual girl.

strings.text: 円夏「２人ともいい感じだって思ってたのに、最近の白坂君っていろんな女の子と仲良くしすぎじゃない？
strings.translated: Madoka「I thought you two were getting along really well, but lately don't you think you've been getting too friendly with all kinds of other girls?

strings.text: 円夏「聞いたよ？
strings.translated: Madoka「I heard, you know?

strings.text: Ｄ組の小西さんとか、生徒会長とか…今日は１年の教室まで行って女の子を探してたんでしょ？
strings.translated: Konishi-san from Class D, the student council president... and today you even went all the way to the first-years' classroom looking for girls, didn't you?

strings.text: 円夏「愛のこと、ただのクラスメイトとしか見てないなら仕方ないけど、そうじゃないなら気を付けたほうがいいと思うよ
strings.translated: Madoka「If you only see Ai as just a classmate, then I guess there's nothing to be done, but if that's not the case, I think you should be more careful.

strings.text: 大智「いや…そう言われても……」
strings.translated: Daichi「No... I mean, even if you say that...」

strings.text: 星野さんが言いたがってることは、俺にも何となく理解できた。
strings.translated: I had a vague sense of what Hoshino-san was trying to say.

strings.text: 要するに、神村さんのことを友達として心配してるらしい。
strings.translated: In short, it seemed she was worried about Kamimura-san as a friend.

strings.text: 最近、他の女の子と話す機会が増えたから、それで俺が軽い男だって誤解されたのかもしれなかった
strings.translated: Lately I'd had more chances to talk with other girls, so she might have gotten the wrong idea that I was some kind of player.

strings.text: 大智「別に、下心があってしてることじゃないんだ。
strings.translated: Daichi「It's not like I'm doing it with any ulterior motive.

strings.text: ちょっと…いろいろ事情があって
strings.translated: There's just... a lot of circumstances involved.

strings.text: 円夏「それって、他の女の子と話さないといけないことなの？
strings.translated: Madoka「Is it something that requires you to talk to other girls?

strings.text: 円夏「ふぅん…」
strings.translated: Madoka「Hmm...」

strings.text: 星野さんの視線は冷たい。
strings.translated: Hoshino-san's gaze is cold.

strings.text: 俺の言葉をすぐに信用してもらうのは難しいみたいだ。
strings.translated: It seems like getting her to believe me right away is going to be difficult.

strings.text: でも、全部本当のことなんだから信じてもらうしかない。
strings.translated: But since everything I said is the truth, I have no choice but to get her to believe me.

strings.text: 正確には、星野さんに信用してもらえなくても、今は大した問題じゃなかった。
strings.translated: To be more precise, even if Hoshino-san didn't believe me, it wasn't much of a problem right now.

strings.text: 今、俺の置かれた状況を考えれば、彼女に構ってる暇なんてあるはずがなかった
strings.translated: Given the situation I was in at the moment, there was no way I had time to spare worrying about her.

strings.text: 円夏「私さ、最近白坂君と愛が一緒にいるところ、よく見かけてたんだよね
strings.translated: Madoka「You know, lately I've been seeing you and Ai together a lot.

strings.text: 円夏「だから、てっきり２人は付き合ってるんだって思ってたんだけど
strings.translated: Madoka「So I just assumed the two of you were going out.

strings.text: 大智「いや、そんなんじゃないよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「No, it's nothing like that.

strings.text: 普通のクラスメイトだから」
strings.translated: We're just regular classmates.」

strings.text: 一時期はそんな期待を持ったりもしたけど、それが遠い昔のことに思える
strings.translated: There was a time when I had hopes like that, but it feels like that was a lifetime ago.

strings.text: 円夏「そうなんだ？
strings.translated: Madoka「Is that so?

strings.text: でも、白坂君は愛のこと嫌いじゃないよね？
strings.translated: But you don't dislike Ai, do you, Shirasaka-kun?

strings.text: 大智「それは……もちろん
strings.translated: Daichi「That's... of course not.

strings.text: 円夏「それなら…好きなら、誤解されるような事は避けたほうがいいと思うけど
strings.translated: Madoka「Then... if you like her, I think you should avoid doing things that might cause misunderstandings.

strings.text: 大智「まぁ……、うん」
strings.translated: Daichi「Well..., yeah.」

strings.text: とりあえずは、こう答えておくしかなかった。
strings.translated: For now, that was all I could say.

strings.text: 本当のことを言うのも疲れるし、信じてもらえるとも思えない。
strings.translated: I was too tired to tell the truth, and I didn't think she'd believe me anyway.

strings.text: 逆に信じてもらったりしたら、星野さんにクラブのことを知られてしまうことになる。
strings.translated: And if she actually did believe me, Hoshino-san would end up finding out about the Club.

strings.text: 彼女まで、あんな場所にはまるとは思えないけど、できるだけ関わりを増やすような真似は避けたかった
strings.translated: I didn't think she was the type to get caught up in a place like that, but I wanted to avoid doing anything that would draw more people in.

strings.text: 円夏「あ～あ、何か心配だなぁ。
strings.translated: Madoka「Ahh, I'm kind of worried.

strings.text: ぼやぼやしてると、小野田さんみたいにいなくなっちゃうかもしれないよ？
strings.translated: If you're not careful, she might disappear on you like Onoda-san did, you know?

strings.text: 大智「小野田さんみたいに？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Like Onoda-san?」

strings.text: 何だ？
strings.translated: What?

strings.text: 何の話なんだ？
strings.translated: What is she talking about?

strings.text: 小野田さんって、もしかして姉さんの友達の小野田さんのことなのか？
strings.translated: Onoda-san -- could she mean the Onoda-san who's friends with sis?

strings.text: 大智「それ、どういう事？
strings.translated: Daichi「What do you mean by that?

strings.text: 円夏「うん？
strings.translated: Madoka「Hmm?

strings.text: 知らないの？
strings.translated: You don't know?

strings.text: 小野田さんのこと。
strings.translated: About Onoda-san.

strings.text: あの子、家出しちゃったんだって
strings.translated: Apparently she ran away from home.

strings.text: 大智「家出？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Ran away from home?」

strings.text: そんな話は知らない。
strings.translated: I didn't know anything about that.

strings.text: 聞いたこともない
strings.translated: I'd never heard a word of it.

strings.text: 大智「小野田さんって、小野田友佳さんだよな？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Onoda-san -- that's Onoda Yuka-san, right?」

strings.text: 小野田さんは２年Ｃ組、星野さんと同じクラスのはずだ。
strings.translated: Onoda-san is in Class 2-C, the same class as Hoshino-san.

strings.text: いつも姉さんと一緒にいるから忘れていた
strings.translated: I'd forgotten because she's always with sis.

strings.text: 円夏「そう。
strings.translated: Madoka「That's right.

strings.text: 私のクラスの」
strings.translated: She's in my class.」

strings.text: 姉さんの友達の小野田さんだ。
strings.translated: It's sis's friend, Onoda-san.

strings.text: 彼女、家出したのか？
strings.translated: She ran away from home?

strings.text: 学校に来なくなっちゃってるのか？
strings.translated: She's stopped coming to school?

strings.text: でも、姉さんがそんな話をしたことは一度もない。
strings.translated: But sis has never once mentioned anything like that.

strings.text: 本当に家出なんてしてたら、きっと姉さんだって心配するはずなのに
strings.translated: If she really had run away, surely sis would be worried too.

strings.text: 円夏「何か悩みでもあったのかなぁ。
strings.translated: Madoka「I wonder if she had something troubling her.

strings.text: ちょっと浮いた感じはあったけど
strings.translated: She always seemed a little out of place.

strings.text: 円夏「愛も変わったところがあるし、白坂君もちゃんと見てないと
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai has her quirks too, so you'd better keep a proper eye on her, Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: またあとで！
strings.translated: I'll talk to you later!

strings.text: 円夏「あっ、ちょっと！」
strings.translated: Madoka「Ah, wait!」

strings.text: 星野さんとの話を打ち切って、俺は姉さんの教室へと走り出した。
strings.translated: I cut off my conversation with Hoshino-san and broke into a run toward sis's classroom.

strings.text: まだ信じられない。
strings.translated: I still couldn't believe it.

strings.text: 小野田さんが家出をしたとして、どうして姉さんはいつも通りにしてられるんだろう。
strings.translated: If Onoda-san had run away from home, why was sis acting like everything was normal?

strings.text: 考えられることはひとつしかない。
strings.translated: There was only one explanation I could think of.

strings.text: 姉さんは、小野田さんの行き先を知ってるからだ。
strings.translated: It was because sis knew where Onoda-san had gone.

strings.text: それ以外の可能性なんてあるはずなかった
strings.translated: There couldn't be any other possibility.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis.」

strings.text: 幸いなことに、教室に向かう途中で姉さんの姿を見つけることができた
strings.translated: Fortunately, I was able to spot sis on my way to her classroom.

strings.text: こんなところまでどうしたの？
strings.translated: What are you doing all the way out here?

strings.text: 大智「小野田さんが家出したって本当なのか？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Is it true that Onoda-san ran away from home?」

strings.text: 単刀直入に訊いた。
strings.translated: I asked her point-blank.

strings.text: 遠回しに訊く余裕なんてなかった。
strings.translated: I had no room to beat around the bush.

strings.text: 何かの間違いで会ってほしい。
strings.translated: I wanted it to be some kind of mistake.

strings.text: そうでなければ、姉さんが関わってる可能性はすごく大きくなる。
strings.translated: If it wasn't, then the chances of sis being involved were very high.

strings.text: これは、心の中でそんな事を考えていたけど、返ってきた答えは無情だった
strings.translated: I was thinking that in my heart, but the answer I got back was merciless.

strings.text: 美桜「ああ……そのこと。
strings.translated: Mio「Oh... that.

strings.text: 友佳なら大丈夫よ
strings.translated: Yuka is fine.

strings.text: 大智「もしかして、行き先を知ってるのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Do you know where she went?

strings.text: 美桜「知ってるって言うか…言葉では説明しにくいわ。
strings.translated: Mio「It's not so much that I know... it's hard to explain in words.

strings.text: 大智の知らないところに行っちゃったんだから
strings.translated: She's gone somewhere you don't know about.

strings.text: 大智「俺の知らないところ？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Somewhere I don't know about?」

strings.text: 姉さんは何を言ってるんだろう。
strings.translated: What is sis talking about?

strings.text: 何かの謎かけでもしてるつもりなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Does she think she's speaking in riddles?

strings.text: でも、とにかくこれで間違いはない。
strings.translated: But anyway, there's no mistake now.

strings.text: 姉さんは、小野田さんに関して何かを知ってるんだ。
strings.translated: Sis knows something about Onoda-san.

strings.text: もしかすると、彼女の家出の手助けをしたりしたんじゃないだろうか
strings.translated: Could it be that she even helped her run away?

strings.text: 美桜「大智、何か勘違いしてるかもしれないけど、友佳なら本当に大丈夫なの
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, you might be misunderstanding something, but Yuka really is fine.

strings.text: 美桜「彼女はひとつ上の段階に進んだの。
strings.translated: Mio「She's moved on to the next stage.

strings.text: でも、離れていても心は繋がってるから、私は平気
strings.translated: But even if we're apart, our hearts are connected, so I'm okay.

strings.text: 大智「どういうことだよ？
strings.translated: Daichi「What does that mean?

strings.text: 美桜「大智にはまだ理解できないでしょうね
strings.translated: Mio「You probably can't understand yet, Daichi.

strings.text: 大智「はっきり言ってくれよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「Just say it straight.

strings.text: 小野田さん、どこに行ったんだよ」
strings.translated: Where did Onoda-san go?」

strings.text: できるだけ周りに話を聞かれないようにしながら、俺は怒ったような声で言った。
strings.translated: I said it in an angry voice, trying as best I could not to let the people around us hear.

strings.text: 姉さんのことが理解できないし、小野田さんの家出を手助けしたりしたのならとんでもない行動だ。
strings.translated: I can't understand sis, and if she helped Onoda-san run away, that's an outrageous thing to do.

strings.text: 小野田さんの家族のこととか、そういうのは全然考えなかったんだろうか
strings.translated: Did she not think at all about Onoda-san's family and things like that?

strings.text: 美桜「言ったでしょう、大智には理解できないって。
strings.translated: Mio「I told you, Daichi -- you can't understand.

strings.text: 教えるわけにもいかないのよ。
strings.translated: I can't tell you either.

strings.text: あなたはまだその段階に達していないから
strings.translated: You haven't reached that stage yet.

strings.text: 美桜「でも、友佳のことも、私のことも、心配しなくていいから
strings.translated: Mio「But you don't need to worry about Yuka, or about me.

strings.text: 美桜「私もいつか、友佳の所に行くの。
strings.translated: Mio「I'm going to go to where Yuka is someday too.

strings.text: 本当に…すごく楽しみ
strings.translated: I'm really... really looking forward to it.

strings.text: 大智「いつか行くって…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Someday you're going to go...」

strings.text: それは、姉さんの家出宣言にも等しい言葉。
strings.translated: Those words were practically a declaration that sis was going to run away from home.

strings.text: 軽く聞き流すことのできない内容だったけど、姉さんはそれ以上の説明をしてくれなかった。
strings.translated: It wasn't something I could just brush off lightly, but sis wouldn't explain any further.

strings.text: 悪い夢を見ているかのようだった。
strings.translated: It felt like I was having a bad dream.

strings.text: そう思いたくて仕方なかった。
strings.translated: I desperately wanted to believe that.

strings.text: この人は…誰なんだ？
strings.translated: This person... who is she?

strings.text: 俺の知ってる姉さんは、どこへ行ってしまったんだ？
strings.translated: The sis I knew -- where did she go?

strings.text: あまりにも別人過ぎて、俺は言いようのない恐怖を感じていた。
strings.translated: She was so completely different that I felt an indescribable fear.

strings.text: 目の前にいる人が姉さんだなんて、思いたくないって気持ちが強くなっていた。
strings.translated: The feeling that I didn't want to believe the person in front of me was sis kept growing stronger.

strings.text: もしかすると、姉さんはもう元には戻らないんじゃないか。
strings.translated: Maybe sis was never going to go back to how she was.

strings.text: そんなふうに思わされる出来事だった
strings.translated: That was the kind of thing this incident made me feel.

strings.text: 円夏
strings.translated: Madoka

strings.text: 白坂君の言葉は、私には到底納得できなかった。
strings.translated: Shirasaka-kun's words were something I simply couldn't accept.

strings.text: 愛とは付き合ってないって言ってたけど、私には浮気の言い訳をしているようにしか感じられなかった。
strings.translated: He said he wasn't going out with Ai, but to me it sounded like nothing more than an excuse for cheating.

strings.text: だっておかしいじゃない。
strings.translated: Because it doesn't make sense, does it?

strings.text: 今まで誰にも…私以外には心を開かなかった愛が、初めて男の子と話すようになったんだから…。
strings.translated: Ai, who had never opened her heart to anyone... to no one but me, until now -- she had finally started talking to a boy for the first time...

strings.text: 白坂君にその気がなかったとしても、愛を引き付けるだけの何かをしたのは間違いないはずだった。
strings.translated: Even if Shirasaka-kun hadn't meant anything by it, there was no doubt he had done something that drew Ai in.

strings.text: もしも、愛を勘違いさせただけだったとしたら、私は白坂君のことを許せないかもしれなかった
strings.translated: If all he had done was give Ai the wrong idea, I wasn't sure I could ever forgive him.

strings.text: 円夏「あっ、愛」
strings.translated: Madoka「Ah, Ai.」

strings.text: 教室に戻っていると、ちょうど廊下を歩いている愛を見かけた。
strings.translated: As I was heading back to the classroom, I spotted Ai walking down the hallway.

strings.text: 白坂君の事はあんまり言いたくないけど、ここは親友として忠告するべきだよね。
strings.translated: I don't really want to say too much about Shirasaka-kun, but as her best friend, I should warn her.

strings.text: 愛が悲しむところなんて、私見たくないよ
strings.translated: I don't want to see Ai get hurt.

strings.text: 円夏「ちょっといいかな？
strings.translated: Madoka「Do you have a minute?

strings.text: 白坂君のことで、話があるんだけど
strings.translated: I need to talk to you -- about Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: 愛「白坂君のことで？
strings.translated: Ai「About Shirasaka-kun?

strings.text: 円夏「あんまり言いたくないんだけど、彼、ちょっと……気が多いのかも
strings.translated: Madoka「I don't really want to say this, but he might be a little... fickle.

strings.text: 愛「…気が多い？」
strings.translated: Ai「...Fickle?」

strings.text: この説明だと、純真な愛にはわからないかもしれない。
strings.translated: With this explanation, pure-hearted Ai might not understand.

strings.text: どうしよう。
strings.translated: What do I do?

strings.text: あんまり詳しい話をすると、愛に余計な知識を付けさせちゃうかもしれないんだけど…。
strings.translated: If I went into too much detail, I might end up giving Ai knowledge she didn't need...

strings.text: でも、事実を知らなくて、後で愛が傷つくよりはずっとマシだよね？
strings.translated: But it's so much better than her not knowing the truth and getting hurt later, right?

strings.text: 円夏「愛は知らないだろうけど、白坂君ね…最近、いろんな女の子と話してるみたいなの
strings.translated: Madoka「You probably don't know this, Ai, but Shirasaka-kun... it seems like he's been talking to all kinds of girls lately.

strings.text: 愛「話す必要があれば話すでしょうね
strings.translated: Ai「If he needs to talk to someone, he'll talk to them.

strings.text: 円夏「必要があればって言うか、あれは本人が話したいだけだと思うのよね
strings.translated: Madoka「It's not so much that he needs to -- I think he just wants to talk to them himself.

strings.text: 愛「…それで？」
strings.translated: Ai「...So?」

strings.text: 愛の反応は冷ややかだった。
strings.translated: Ai's reaction was cold.

strings.text: でも、私にはわかる。
strings.translated: But I can tell.

strings.text: これは強がってる時の愛だ。
strings.translated: This is how Ai acts when she's putting on a brave front.

strings.text: 白坂君が他の女の子と話してるって聞いて、内心はすごく動揺してるらしい。
strings.translated: Hearing that Shirasaka-kun is talking to other girls, she must be really shaken up inside.

strings.text: 無理もないよ。
strings.translated: I can't blame her.

strings.text: 愛だって、普通の女の子なんだから
strings.translated: Ai is just a normal girl, after all.

strings.text: 円夏「白坂君の事、もっとちゃんと捕まえてたほうがいいんじゃない？
strings.translated: Madoka「Don't you think you should keep a better hold on Shirasaka-kun?

strings.text: 愛「捕まえるも何も、そんな事する必要ないから。
strings.translated: Ai「There's nothing to keep a hold on -- I don't need to do anything like that.

strings.text: 私達は、そういう関係じゃないんだし
strings.translated: We're not in that kind of relationship.

strings.text: 円夏「愛、私には隠さなくていいんだってば。
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai, you don't have to hide it from me.

strings.text: 愛が白坂君の事、何とも思ってないわけないじゃない
strings.translated: There's no way you don't feel anything for Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: 円夏「よく話してるし、一緒にどこかに行ったりもしてるし…それに、よく白坂君のこと見てるじゃない。
strings.translated: Madoka「You talk to him a lot, you go places together... and you're always watching him.

strings.text: 私判ってるんだから
strings.translated: I know, okay.

strings.text: 愛「私が…？」
strings.translated: Ai「I... do?」

strings.text: 自分では気づいてないみたいで、愛は不思議そうな表情を浮かべた。
strings.translated: She seemed unaware of it herself, and Ai wore a puzzled expression.

strings.text: 白坂君の事をどう思ってるか、自分でわかってないみたいだ。
strings.translated: It looked like she didn't even know how she felt about Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: でも、恋愛経験の乏しい愛のことを考えると、それも仕方ないって思えてしまう。
strings.translated: But thinking about Ai and her lack of experience with romance, I couldn't help but feel that was understandable.

strings.text: たぶん、今、愛が抱いてる感情は初めてのものだ。
strings.translated: Probably, the feelings Ai is holding right now are something she's never felt before.

strings.text: 初めての恋心だから、自分でよくわかっていないんだ。
strings.translated: Because it's her first love, she doesn't understand it well herself.

strings.text: 親友の私だから、愛の本当の気持ちをわかってあげられる。
strings.translated: Because I'm her best friend, I can understand Ai's true feelings.

strings.text: 私しか愛の本当の気持ちはわかってあげられない。
strings.translated: Only I can understand Ai's true feelings.

strings.text: だから、私が愛の背中を押したり、悪い虫が寄って来ないようにしないといけなかった
strings.translated: That's why I had to be the one to give Ai a push, and to keep bad influences away from her.

strings.text: 円夏「とにかく、私には何でも相談してほしいの。
strings.translated: Madoka「Anyway, I want you to come to me with anything.

strings.text: これでも、少しは恋愛経験あるしね。
strings.translated: I do have at least a little experience with romance, you know.

strings.text: アドバイスしてあげられると思うから
strings.translated: I think I can give you some advice.

strings.text: 愛「…白坂君とは本当にそんな関係じゃないの。
strings.translated: Ai「...Shirasaka-kun and I really aren't in that kind of relationship.

strings.text: 彼のお姉さんのことについて、相談に乗ってただけだから
strings.translated: I've just been listening to him talk about his sister.

strings.text: 円夏「またそんな事言って…」
strings.translated: Madoka「There you go again, saying things like that...」

strings.text: 愛の話を聞きながら、思わず溜息を漏らしてしまう。
strings.translated: Listening to Ai talk, I couldn't help but let out a sigh.

strings.text: 白坂君の事、何とも思ってないはずがないのに、照れ隠しなんてしちゃって…。
strings.translated: There's no way she doesn't feel anything for Shirasaka-kun -- she's just hiding her embarrassment...

strings.text: でも、このままにさせてたら、白坂君を別の女の子に取られちゃうかもしれない。
strings.translated: But if I leave things like this, some other girl might steal Shirasaka-kun away from her.

strings.text: 愛にとっては初めての恋なんだから、そんな結果で終わらせたくはなかった
strings.translated: This is Ai's first love, so I didn't want it to end that way.

strings.text: 円夏「ねぇ、安心して。
strings.translated: Madoka「Hey, don't worry.

strings.text: 私も協力するから、何でも話して
strings.translated: I'll help you too, so tell me everything.

strings.text: 円夏「私達、親友じゃない。
strings.translated: Madoka「We're best friends, aren't we.

strings.text: こういう時に助け合わなくてどうするのよ
strings.translated: If we don't help each other at times like this, what's the point?

strings.text: 愛「親友…」
strings.translated: Ai「Best friends...」

strings.text: 小さくつぶやいて、愛が視線を床に落とした。
strings.translated: She murmured softly, and Ai let her gaze drop to the floor.

strings.text: 何かを考え込むようにして、自分がどうするべきか答えを出そうとしている
strings.translated: She seemed to be turning something over in her mind, trying to work out what she should do.

strings.text: 円夏「白坂君の事、いいなって思ってるんでしょう？」
strings.translated: Madoka「You like Shirasaka-kun, don't you?」

strings.text: 助けてあげたい。
strings.translated: I want to help her.

strings.text: 愛のためにできるだけのことをしてあげたい。
strings.translated: I want to do everything I can for Ai.

strings.text: だって、愛の親友は私だけなんだから…。
strings.translated: Because I'm the only best friend Ai has...

strings.text: 愛のことをわかってあげられるのは、私だけなんだから
strings.translated: I'm the only one who truly understands her.

strings.text: 円夏「愛、本当に何でも相談して
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai, really -- come to me with anything.

strings.text: 私、大切な用事があるから
strings.translated: I have something important I need to do.

strings.text: 円夏「えっ？
strings.translated: Madoka「Eh?」

strings.text: あ…愛…！
私の話を打ち切って、愛が教室を出て行く。
strings.translated: Cutting me off mid-sentence, Ai walked out of the classroom.

strings.text: 大切な用事って何？
strings.translated: What is this important thing she has to do?

strings.text: 白坂君のことよりも、大切なことなの？
strings.translated: Is it really more important than what's going on with Shirasaka-kun?

strings.text: 最近、親友の私にも愛の行動がわからない。
strings.translated: Lately, even I -- her best friend -- can't figure out what Ai is up to.

strings.text: 掴みきれない部分がある気がする。
strings.translated: There's a part of her I just can't seem to grasp.

strings.text: こんなふうに私を置いていくことなんて、それこそ白坂君が転校して来るまではなかったのに
strings.translated: She never used to leave me behind like this -- not until Shirasaka-kun transferred here.

strings.text: 円夏「親友として、愛のことは知っておかないと」
strings.translated: Madoka「As her best friend, I need to know what Ai is up to.」

strings.text: 愛には悪いと思ったけど、私はこっそりと後を尾けてみることにした。
strings.translated: I felt bad for Ai, but I decided to secretly follow her.

strings.text: 私の知らないところで、愛が何をやってるのか。
strings.translated: What was Ai doing when I wasn't around.

strings.text: 大切な用事って何なのか。
strings.translated: What was this important thing she had to do.

strings.text: 全部知っておきたかった
strings.translated: I wanted to know everything.

strings.text: 円夏「何…ここ…？」
strings.translated: Madoka「What is... this place...?」

strings.text: 愛の後を尾いて行くと、思わぬ場所にたどり着いてしまった。
strings.translated: Following after Ai, I ended up somewhere I never would have expected.

strings.text: ちょっと怪しい雰囲気が漂うこの建物に、愛は何の躊躇いもなく入ってしまった
strings.translated: This building had a faintly suspicious air about it, and yet Ai walked right in without a moment's hesitation.

strings.text: 円夏「危ないところ…じゃないよね？」
strings.translated: Madoka「It's not... a dangerous place... right?」

strings.text: 常識的に考えて、普通の女学生が入るような場所じゃないと思う。
strings.translated: By any reasonable standard, I don't think it's the kind of place a normal schoolgirl would enter.

strings.text: それなのに、愛はどうしてこんな場所に入って行ったんだろう。
strings.translated: And yet, why did Ai go into a place like this.

strings.text: 理由なんて全然わからなくて、私はしばらくその場で立ち尽くすしかなかった
strings.translated: I had no idea whatsoever, and for a while all I could do was stand there frozen on the spot.

strings.text: 円夏「ゲームセンター、じゃないよね？
strings.translated: Madoka「It's not an arcade, is it?

strings.text: カラオケ、とも違うみたいだし…」
strings.translated: It doesn't look like a karaoke place either...」

strings.text: 愛、こんなところで何してるんだろう。
strings.translated: What on earth is Ai doing in a place like this?

strings.text: しばらく待ってから、出てくるのかな？
strings.translated: Should I wait here a while and see if she comes back out?

strings.text: 出てきたら、ちゃんと説明してもらわないと…。
strings.translated: If she does come out, she'd better give me a proper explanation...

strings.text: やっぱり、こういう事は親友としてちゃんと知っておかないとね
strings.translated: This is exactly the kind of thing a best friend needs to know about.
Madoka「......」

strings.text: ５分、１０分、１５分…と、時間が過ぎていく。
strings.translated: Five minutes, ten minutes, fifteen minutes... time kept passing.

strings.text: 私は、ビルから少し離れたところで待っていたけど、愛が出て来る様子はなかった。
strings.translated: I waited a little ways from the building, but there was no sign of Ai coming out.

strings.text: もしかして、誰かと間違えてる？
strings.translated: Could I have mixed her up with someone else?

strings.text: 愛の後をついて行ったつもりだけど、途中からよく似た人を追いかけてたりしたのかな？
strings.translated: I thought I'd been following Ai, but maybe partway through I'd started chasing after someone who just looked a lot like her.

strings.text: 常識的に考えて、愛がこんな場所に入るわけがないし、間違えた可能性のほうが高いような気がしてきた
strings.translated: Thinking about it rationally, there was no way Ai would go into a place like this -- and it was starting to feel more and more likely that I'd made a mistake.

strings.text: 円夏「あと５分…あと５分だけ待ってみよう」
strings.translated: Madoka「Just five more minutes... I'll wait just five more minutes.」

strings.text: 愛が出て来ることを祈りながら、私はビルの出入口を見つめ続けた。
strings.translated: Praying that Ai would come out, I kept my eyes fixed on the building's entrance.
Five minutes, ten minutes, fifteen minutes...

strings.text: 愛は出て来ない。
strings.translated: Ai didn't come out.

strings.text: やっぱり、ここに入って行ったと思った人物は、よく似た別人だったのだろうか
strings.translated: Maybe the person I thought had gone inside really was just someone else who looked a lot like her.

strings.text: 円夏「でも、もしも愛だったら…」
strings.translated: Madoka「But what if it really was Ai...」

strings.text: このビルに入って行ったのが愛本人だとしたら、いったいどんな時があるのだろう。
strings.translated: If the person who had gone into this building really was Ai herself, then what on earth could be going on?

strings.text: そもそも、愛がこのビルに用事があって入って行ったのか、本当は来たくなかったけど来なければならない理由があったのか。
strings.translated: To begin with, had Ai gone into this building because she had business here -- or had she not wanted to come at all, but had some reason she had no choice?

strings.text: 前者なら問題ないけど、後者なら大問題だ。
strings.translated: If it was the former, there was no problem. But if it was the latter, that was a serious problem.

strings.text: では、後者の場合だったら、いったいどんな理由があるのだろう。
strings.translated: So if it was the latter -- what kind of reason could there possibly be?

strings.text: 来たくないのに来なければならない理由は、果たして何があるのだろう
strings.translated: What reason could there be that would make someone come somewhere they didn't want to come?

strings.text: 円夏「もしかして、誰かに脅されてるとか？」
strings.translated: Madoka「Could it be that someone is threatening her?」

strings.text: 最初に浮かんだのはそれだった。
strings.translated: That was the first thing that came to mind.

strings.text: 普通の人が来たくない場所に来るのは、誰かに命令されてる場合くらいじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: The only reason a normal person would go somewhere they don't want to go is if someone is ordering them to, isn't it.

strings.text: 愛も、何らかの理由があって誰かに脅されていて、それでこんなビルに入って行ったんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe Ai was being threatened by someone for some reason, and that's why she went into a building like this.

strings.text: そうだとしたら、愛の身が危ない。
strings.translated: If so, Ai is in danger.

strings.text: 今すぐ助けないと、何がどうなるかわかったものじゃない。
strings.translated: I have no idea what might happen if I don't help her right now.

strings.text: でも、私だけの力でどうにかなるものなの？
strings.translated: But can I do anything on my own?

strings.text: せめて、男の人の助けがあったほうがいいんじゃないの？
strings.translated: Wouldn't it be better to at least have a man's help with this?

strings.text: 正直、逃げ出したい気持ちでいっぱいだったけど、それをするわけにはいかなかった。
strings.translated: Honestly, I was overwhelmed with the urge to run away, but I couldn't do that.

strings.text: ここから逃げ出してしまったら、私は二度と愛の親友だって言えないような気がした
strings.translated: If I ran away from here, I felt like I could never call myself Ai's best friend again.

strings.text: ごくりと息を呑んで、私はビルに向かって歩き始めた。
strings.translated: Swallowing hard, I started walking toward the building.

strings.text: もちろん、周りに誰かいないかも確認しながら、できるだけ慎重に出入口へと近づいて行った。
strings.translated: Of course, I checked to make sure no one was around, and approached the entrance as carefully as I could.

strings.text: もしかすると、見張りの人間がいて、ビルに入る前に邪魔をされてしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: There might be someone standing watch who would try to stop me before I got inside.

strings.text: あるいは、捕まってしまう可能性もあるわけで、とにかく最大限の注意を払わなければならなかった
strings.translated: Or I might even get caught -- either way, I had to exercise the utmost caution.

strings.text: ビルの中には、息を殺すようにして入った。
strings.translated: I slipped inside the building, holding my breath.

strings.text: 背中を冷たいものが流れて、気を張ってないと涙が溢れて来てしまいそうな気分だった。
strings.translated: Something cold ran down my back, and I felt like tears might spill over if I let my guard down for even a moment.

strings.text: ここはどこなんだろう。
strings.translated: What is this place.

strings.text: 何をしてるところなんだろう。
strings.translated: What goes on here.

strings.text: 足音を立てないようにしながら階段を上がったけど、全然人の気配がしなかった
strings.translated: I climbed the stairs without making a sound, but there was no sign of anyone at all.

strings.text: 円夏「愛、本当にこんなところにいるの？」
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai, are you really in a place like this?」

strings.text: ちゃんと愛の後を尾いて来たはずなのに、だんだん自信がなくなってしまう。
strings.translated: I was sure I'd followed Ai here, but my confidence was slowly fading.

strings.text: やっぱり、途中でよく似た人を間違えてしまってたんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe I really had mixed her up with someone who looked like her partway through.

strings.text: 愛はとっくに家に帰っていて、私は大きなミスを犯してるんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe Ai had long since gone home, and I was making a huge mistake.

strings.text: そんな思考が頭をよぎったけど、愛のことを確かめないままにビルから出るわけにはいかなかった
strings.translated: That thought crossed my mind, but I couldn't leave the building without confirming whether Ai was here or not.

strings.text: 円夏「あれ？」
strings.translated: Madoka「Hm?」

strings.text: 人の話し声が聞こえたような気がして、私は階段の途中で足を止めた。
strings.translated: I thought I heard the sound of voices, and I stopped partway up the stairs.

strings.text: 誰かがいる。
strings.translated: Someone was there.

strings.text: しかも、１人じゃない。
strings.translated: And not just one person.

strings.text: 男の人も女の人もいて、楽しそうな笑い声なんかが聞こえて来ていた
strings.translated: There were men and women, and I could hear cheerful laughter drifting over.

strings.text: 円夏「あの部屋から…？」
strings.translated: Madoka「From that room...?」

strings.text: 私の目の前にある部屋のドア。
strings.translated: The door to the room right in front of me.

strings.text: 男女の声は、その向こう側から聞こえてくるみたいだった。
strings.translated: The voices of men and women seemed to be coming from the other side of it.

strings.text: いったい誰が何をやってるんだろう？
strings.translated: What was anyone doing in there?

strings.text: ここはどういう場所なんだろう？
strings.translated: What kind of place was this?

strings.text: 様々な疑問を胸に抱えたまま、私は意を決してそっとドアを開けた。
strings.translated: Holding a swirl of questions in my chest, I steeled myself and quietly opened the door.

strings.text: ドアの隙間から覗き込んで、その先にあった光景に思わず声を上げてしまった
strings.translated: Peering through the gap, I couldn't help but let out a sound at the sight that greeted me.

strings.text: 円夏「えっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Eh?!

strings.text: 視界に飛び込んできたのは、裸で抱き合う男女。
strings.translated: What leapt into my field of vision was a man and woman, naked and embracing each other.

strings.text: そういった経験のない私でも、彼らが何をしてるのかはすぐにわかる。
strings.translated: Even without any experience of that sort myself, I could tell immediately what they were doing.

strings.text: セックスだ。
strings.translated: Sex.

strings.text: 本物のセックスだ。
strings.translated: Real sex.

strings.text: 周りに人がいるのに、あの２人こんな場所でセックスしてる。
strings.translated: With people all around them, those two were having sex in a place like this.

strings.text: 頭が混乱した。
strings.translated: My mind went into a panic.

strings.text: 彼らのやってることの意味がわからなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't make sense of what they were doing.

strings.text: なんで？
strings.translated: Why?」

strings.text: どうして、人前であんな事してるの？
strings.translated: Why were they doing something like that in front of other people?

strings.text: 何かの見間違えじゃないかと思って、部屋の中の光景をしっかりと見る。
strings.translated: Thinking I might have seen it wrong, I looked carefully at the scene inside the room.

strings.text: たとえば、何かのドラマの撮影現場だったりとか、実はあれはテレビ画面に映った映像だとか…。
strings.translated: Maybe it was a drama filming set, or maybe what I was seeing was actually footage playing on a TV screen, or...

strings.text: 色々考えながら確かめてみたけど、どこからどう見ても現実だった。
strings.translated: I considered all sorts of possibilities as I checked again, but no matter how I looked at it, it was real.

strings.text: 家の中で裸になった男女が、周りの目を気にせずにセックスしていた
strings.translated: A naked man and woman inside the building were having sex without any concern for the people watching.

strings.text: 円夏「ど、どういう事？」
strings.translated: Madoka「W-what is going on?」

strings.text: あの人達は、罰ゲームでもしてるんだろうか？
strings.translated: Were those people playing some kind of penalty game?

strings.text: 人前でセックスしろって命令されたりしてるんだろうか？
strings.translated: Were they being ordered to have sex in front of others?

strings.text: でも、男のほうも女のほうもすごく嬉しそうで、とても誰かに強制されてやってる雰囲気じゃない。
strings.translated: But both the man and the woman looked so happy, and there was absolutely no atmosphere of being forced into it by anyone.

strings.text: 本人達が楽しんでるのは、私の目から見ても間違いなかった。
strings.translated: That they were enjoying themselves was beyond doubt, even from where I stood.

strings.text: それなら、ここはどういう場所なんだろう？
strings.translated: Then what kind of place was this?

strings.text: どうして、人前でセックスしてあの人達は平気なんだろう？
strings.translated: Why were those people okay with having sex in front of everyone?

strings.text: 絶対おかしい。
strings.translated: Something is definitely wrong.

strings.text: セックスしてる人達もそうだけど、それを見て平気な周りの人達も絶対におかしい。
strings.translated: Not just the people having sex, but the people around them watching without batting an eye -- they're all definitely wrong.

strings.text: でも、何でなの？
strings.translated: But why?

strings.text: なんでそんな場所に、いるの？
strings.translated: Why were they even in a place like this?

strings.text: どうしてこんなところに、愛がいるのよっ！
strings.translated: Why was Ai in a place like this?!

strings.text: 円夏「め、愛…」
strings.translated: Madoka「A... Ai...」

strings.text: 部屋の隅のほうに、愛の姿があった。
strings.translated: There, in the corner of the room, was Ai.

strings.text: ソファーに座ってくつろいでいて、ぼんやりと部屋の中を見回している。
strings.translated: She was sitting on a sofa, relaxed, gazing vaguely around the room.

strings.text: ここの人達に捕まってるわけじゃなさそうだけど、それならますます愛がこんな場所にいる理由がわからない。
strings.translated: She didn't seem to be held captive by the people here -- but that only made it harder to understand why Ai would be in a place like this.

strings.text: まさかとは思うけど、誰かに命令されたわけじゃなくて、愛自身の意思でこの場所まで来たって言うの？
strings.translated: Could it possibly be that she hadn't been ordered here by anyone, and had come to this place of her own free will?

strings.text: でも、そんなの信じられない。
strings.translated: But I couldn't believe that.

strings.text: そんなのあるはずがない。
strings.translated: That couldn't be.

strings.text: こんな異様な場所に、愛が自分から来るはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no way Ai would come to a place this strange on her own.

strings.text: ここへ来たのは、何かしらやむを得ない事情があるはずだ。
strings.translated: There had to be some unavoidable circumstance that had brought her here.

strings.text: 私はそれを知って、一刻も早くこんな場所から愛を連れ出してあげたかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to find out what it was and get Ai out of this place as quickly as possible.

strings.text: それは、愛の親友である私の義務のようなものだった
strings.translated: It felt like an obligation -- the obligation of me, Ai's best friend.

strings.text: 円夏「愛…愛…」
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai... Ai...」

strings.text: ドアの隙間から、愛に声をかける。
strings.translated: I called out to Ai through the gap in the door.

strings.text: 見えるかどうかわからなかったけど、軽く手を振って自分の存在をアピールした。
strings.translated: I wasn't sure if she could see me, but I waved my hand lightly to make my presence known.

strings.text: 愛の座ってる場所はドアから少し距離があるけど、ラッキーだったのは愛の顔がドアのほうに向いていること。
strings.translated: The spot where Ai was sitting was a little distance from the door, but the lucky thing was that her face was turned toward it.

strings.text: 手を振っていれば、いつかは視界の中に入るかもしれなかった
strings.translated: If I kept waving, maybe I'd eventually enter her field of vision.

strings.text: 円夏「愛…っ！」
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai...!」

strings.text: 部屋の中にいる他の人達に聞こえないようにしながら、ギリギリの声で愛の名前を呼ぶ。
strings.translated: Keeping my voice just barely audible so the others in the room wouldn't hear, I called Ai's name.

strings.text: 手の動きも激しくなっていたけど、それが幸いしたのか愛はついと私のほうに視線を向けてくれた
strings.translated: My hand movements had grown more frantic, and perhaps that helped -- Ai finally turned her gaze toward me.

strings.text: 愛の表情に、驚きの色が浮かぶ。
strings.translated: A look of surprise crossed Ai's face.

strings.text: 気付いてくれた。
strings.translated: She noticed me.

strings.text: 必死になって手を振っていると、愛がドアのほうへと近づいて来てくれた
strings.translated: As I waved desperately, Ai began to make her way toward the door.

strings.text: 愛「円夏、どうしてここに？」
strings.translated: Ai「Madoka, why are you here?」

strings.text: 部屋から出てきた愛が、驚きながら私に声をかけてくれた。
strings.translated: Ai came out of the room and spoke to me in surprise.

strings.text: やっぱり愛だ。
strings.translated: It really was Ai.

strings.text: 信じられないけど、愛がこんな場所にいた。
strings.translated: I couldn't believe it, but Ai had been in a place like this.

strings.text: どうしてなのかわからない。
strings.translated: I didn't understand why.

strings.text: でも、今はそれを話してる場合じゃない
strings.translated: But now wasn't the time to talk about that.

strings.text: 円夏「帰ろうっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Let's go home!

strings.text: こんなところいちゃダメだよっ！
strings.translated: You shouldn't be in a place like this!」

strings.text: 愛の手を掴んで、私はビルの外に引っ張り出そうとした。
strings.translated: I grabbed Ai's hand and tried to drag her out of the building.

strings.text: こんなところ１秒だって長くいたくない。
strings.translated: I didn't want to stay in a place like this for even one more second.

strings.text: あんな人達の中にいたら、愛がどうなるかわかったものじゃなかった
strings.translated: If Ai stayed surrounded by people like that, there was no telling what would happen to her.

strings.text: 愛「円夏、落ち着いて。
strings.translated: Ai「Madoka, calm down.

strings.text: 騒がないで
strings.translated: Don't make a scene.

strings.text: 円夏「早くっ、早く出ようよっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Hurry, let's get out of here!

strings.text: 愛、なんでこんなところにいるのっ？
strings.translated: Ai, why are you in a place like this?!」

strings.text: 落ち着いてなんかいられなかった。
strings.translated: There was no way I could stay calm.

strings.text: 早くここからでないと、部屋の中の人達に殺されるかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: If we didn't get out of here fast, the people in that room might kill us.

strings.text: ここがどんな場所かわかったわけじゃないけど、私にはそういう事をする人達のようにしか見えなかった。
strings.translated: I didn't fully understand what kind of place this was, but to me, these people looked like exactly the type who would do something like that.

strings.text: あの人達は絶対変だ。
strings.translated: Those people were definitely not right.

strings.text: 普通じゃないから、何をするかわからない人達だ。
strings.translated: They weren't normal -- there was no telling what they might do.

strings.text: 愛に良い影響があるとは思えなかったし、むしろ何か悪いことがあるんじゃないかって、そんなふうにしか思えなかった
strings.translated: I couldn't imagine Ai being here was doing her any good; if anything, I could only think that something bad must be going on.

strings.text: 円夏「愛っ、ほらこっち！
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai, come on, this way!

strings.text: 早く逃げないとっ！
strings.translated: We have to run, now!」

strings.text: 園田「何の騒ぎかね？
strings.translated: Sonoda「What's all this commotion?」

strings.text: 円夏「ひっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Eek!」

strings.text: 愛「園田先生…」
strings.translated: Ai「Sonoda-sensei...」

strings.text: どうやら騒ぎすぎてしまったみたいで、部屋の中から知らない男の人が出てきた。
strings.translated: It seemed I had made too much of a commotion, because a man I didn't recognize came out of the room.

strings.text: あまりにも怖くて、声が大きくなりすぎてたみたいだ。
strings.translated: I had been so terrified that my voice must have gotten too loud.

strings.text: …この人は誰だろう。
strings.translated: Who was this person?

strings.text: 愛は、『園田先生』って言ったけど、油断することはできない。
strings.translated: Ai had called him "Sonoda-sensei," but I couldn't let my guard down.

strings.text: こんな所の先生なんて、頭のおかしい人に決まってる
strings.translated: A teacher in a place like this had to be out of his mind.

strings.text: 愛「あの…これは
strings.translated: Ai「Um... this is...」

strings.text: 園田「どうやら、部外者が入り込んでしまったようだね
strings.translated: Sonoda「It seems an outsider has wandered in.」

strings.text: 円夏「な、何なんですか、あなたは…？」
strings.translated: Madoka「Wh-who are you...?」

strings.text: 質問してる間にも、部屋の中から人が出てきた。
strings.translated: Even as I was asking, more people came out of the room.

strings.text: ほとんどは若い男女で、私のことを不思議そうな目で見ている。
strings.translated: Most of them were young men and women, and they were all looking at me with curious eyes.

strings.text: この人達は何なの？
strings.translated: Who were these people?

strings.text: こんなところで何をしてるの？
strings.translated: What were they doing in a place like this?

strings.text: ものすごく怖かったけど、愛を置いて逃げるわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: I was terrified, but there was no way I could run and leave Ai behind.

strings.text: 幸いにして階段のほうに人影はないから、逃げようと思えば可能なはずだった
strings.translated: Fortunately, there were no figures near the stairway, so escaping should have been possible if I made a move for it.

strings.text: 円夏「愛っ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai!

strings.text: 逃げるよっ！
strings.translated: We're running!」

strings.text: 愛「あ…！
strings.translated: Ai「Ah...!」

strings.text: 私は、愛の手を取って一気に階段を下りようとした。
strings.translated: I grabbed Ai's hand and tried to dash down the stairs all at once.

strings.text: でも、ちゃんと意思疎通ができてなかったから、愛の体は全然動いてくれなかった
strings.translated: But since we hadn't properly communicated, Ai's body didn't move at all.

strings.text: 園田「…仕方ない。
strings.translated: Sonoda「...No help for it.

strings.text: 捕まえなさい
strings.translated: Seize her.」

strings.text: 円夏「あっ、きゃああっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Ah, kyaaah!」

strings.text: 最後の逃亡のチャンスを逃して、私は部屋の中にいた人達に捕まってしまった。
strings.translated: I missed my last chance to escape, and the people who had been in the room caught me.

strings.text: 手足を掴まれて、どうする事もできなくなってしまった。
strings.translated: They grabbed my arms and legs, and I was completely helpless.

strings.text: このままだと、２人とも殺されちゃう。
strings.translated: At this rate, we're both going to get killed.

strings.text: 取り返しのつかないことになってしまう。
strings.translated: This is going to turn into something irreversible.

strings.text: こんな事になるくらいなら、携帯電話で警察に通報しておけば良かった。
strings.translated: If it was going to come to this, I should have called the police on my cell phone.

strings.text: 今更、後の祭りでしかないけど、そういった方法を取ったほうがもっと安全なはずだった。
strings.translated: It's too late now, but that would have been the much safer option.

strings.text: 馬鹿っ！
strings.translated: Idiot!

strings.text: 私の馬鹿っ！
strings.translated: I'm such an idiot!

strings.text: そんな簡単なことに、何で気づかないのっ！
strings.translated: How could I not realize something so simple!

strings.text: これで、私だけじゃなくて愛まで殺されちゃったら、完全に私のせいじゃないっ！
strings.translated: If Ai ends up getting killed because of this, on top of me -- that's completely my fault!

strings.text: 園田「彼女は、愛君の友達かな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Is she a friend of yours, Ai?」

strings.text: 愛「…そうです。
strings.translated: Ai「...Yes.

strings.text: でも…彼女は誤解をしていて……。
strings.translated: But... she has a misunderstanding......

strings.text: 何でもないんです。
strings.translated: It's nothing.

strings.text: 私がちゃんと話しておきますから、帰らせてあげて下さい
strings.translated: I'll explain things to her properly, so please let her go.」

strings.text: 円夏「愛…」
strings.translated: Madoka「Ai...」

strings.text: 愛が私をかばってくれた。
strings.translated: Ai was covering for me.

strings.text: かばおうとしてくれてるのがわかった。
strings.translated: I could tell she was trying to protect me.

strings.text: でも、このまま私だけ外に出されるわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: But I couldn't just let myself be sent outside alone like this.

strings.text: こんなところに、愛を残してはおけない。
strings.translated: I couldn't leave Ai behind in a place like this.

strings.text: どうしよう？
strings.translated: What should I do?

strings.text: どうしたらいいんだろう？
strings.translated: What was I supposed to do?

strings.text: 必死に考えてみたけど、ここから愛と一緒に逃げ出す方法は全然浮かばなかった。
strings.translated: I racked my brain desperately, but I couldn't come up with any way to escape from here together with Ai.

strings.text: 頭の中にゲームオーバーって文字が浮かんで、目に涙が溜まってきた
strings.translated: The words "GAME OVER" floated up in my mind, and tears began to well up in my eyes.

strings.text: 円夏「お願い。
strings.translated: Madoka「Please.

strings.text: 愛を解放してあげて。
strings.translated: Let Ai go.

strings.text: この子にこんなところは合わないんです
strings.translated: This place doesn't suit her.」

strings.text: 園田「どうやら、この子は愛君を助けに来たらしい
strings.translated: Sonoda「It seems this girl came to rescue Ai.」

strings.text: 園田「だが、愛君の言うとおり、少々誤解があるようだ
strings.translated: Sonoda「But as Ai says, there appears to be some misunderstanding.」

strings.text: 円夏「誤解？
strings.translated: Madoka「Misunderstanding?」

strings.text: 園田「ちょうどいい。
strings.translated: Sonoda「How convenient.

strings.text: この子にも真実の愛と救いを教えてあげよう
strings.translated: Let us show this girl the truth of love and salvation as well.」

strings.text: 園田「君にも、本当の望みがあるはずだ。
strings.translated: Sonoda「You too must have a true desire.

strings.text: それを、私達が見つけ出してあげよう
strings.translated: Allow us to find it for you.」

strings.text: 円夏「な、何…？
strings.translated: Madoka「Wh-what...?

strings.text: 何する気なの？
strings.translated: What are you going to do?

strings.text: 怖い。
strings.translated: I was scared.

strings.text: この人達、普通じゃない。
strings.translated: These people aren't normal.

strings.text: 言葉で説明できないけど、私にはわかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't explain it in words, but I knew.

strings.text: この人達は危険だって、本能的に察することができた。
strings.translated: My instincts told me these people were dangerous.

strings.text: 本当に殺されるんじゃないかって、私はただただ恐怖に震えることしかできなかった
strings.translated: Terrified that I might actually be killed, all I could do was tremble with fear.」

strings.text: 円夏「な、何するつもりですか！
strings.translated: Madoka「Wh-what are you planning to do!

strings.text: はなしてっ！」
strings.translated: Let go of me!」

strings.text: 服を脱がされたまま吊るされて、私は必死になって声をあげる。
strings.translated: Stripped of my clothes and left hanging there, I desperately cried out.

strings.text: あの、園田って人はそんな私の言葉にも少しも動揺したそぶりも見せず、ただ……あのにこやかな笑顔で見つめてきている。
strings.translated: That man, Sonoda -- he didn't show even a flicker of reaction to my words, just... watching me with that pleasant smile of his.

strings.text: 必死になって身を捩らせて見るものの、縛られた手首は少しも緩むような様子は見られなかった。
strings.translated: I twisted my body around desperately, but the ropes binding my wrists showed no sign of loosening at all.

strings.text: 逆にますます手首に縄が食い込んで、痛みが増すようになるだけ。
strings.translated: If anything, the rope only dug deeper into my wrists, making the pain worse.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「星野くん……だったかな？」
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「You were... Hoshino, was it?」

strings.text: 園田が笑顔のまま、ゆっくりと私に歩み寄ってきた。
strings.translated: Sonoda approached me slowly, his smile never fading.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「そんなに暴れたら痛いだろう、手首に傷が残ってしまうよ？」
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「If you struggle like that, it'll hurt -- you'll leave marks on your wrists, you know?」

strings.text: 私を気遣うような口調で……それでいて、そんなつもりは一欠片も見えない言葉。
strings.translated: His tone sounded as if he were concerned about me... yet his words carried not even a fragment of that intention.

strings.text: 喉の奥から、小さく悲鳴が漏れそうになったのを、必死で飲み込んだ。
strings.translated: I desperately swallowed down the small scream that was about to escape from the back of my throat.

strings.text: 怖い……怖いけど、ここで弱気になったらダメなんだって気持ちが、ぎりぎりで私を支えてた。
strings.translated: I was scared... so scared, but the feeling that I couldn't afford to show weakness right now was barely holding me together.

strings.text: あのおかしな匂いの香は相変わらずずっと立ち込めていて……それも私を不安にさせる。
strings.translated: That strange-smelling incense kept drifting through the air as always... and that too was making me uneasy.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「私はね、きみに危害を加えようってつもりはないんだよ」
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「I have no intention of harming you, you know.」

strings.text: すぐ前まで園田が歩み寄り、私にゆっくり手を差し伸ばそうとしてくる
strings.translated: Sonoda stepped right up close to me, slowly reaching out his hand toward me.

strings.text: 円夏「嫌ぁっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「No...!

strings.text: や、やめてっ……！」
strings.translated: S-stop it...!」

strings.text: ぞっとする感覚に、思わず声が裏返ってしまっていた。
strings.translated: A shudder ran through me, and my voice cracked before I could stop it.

strings.text: それでも園田は動じることなく、私の体をやんわりと撫でた
strings.translated: Even so, Sonoda remained unfazed, gently running his hand over my body.

strings.text: 円夏「うっ……うぅっ……！
strings.translated: Madoka「Ugh... ngh...!

strings.text: 嫌悪感に肌が粟立ち、恐ろしさで気を失いそうになってしまうのを、必死に堪えた。
strings.translated: My skin crawled with revulsion, and I desperately fought the urge to faint from sheer terror.

strings.text: その段階で、私の恐怖は『何かをされる』というような漠然としたものではなく、『犯される』という、現実的なそれに変わってきていた。
strings.translated: By that point, my fear had shifted from something vague like "something might be done to me" to something far more concrete -- "I'm going to be violated."

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「……綺麗な体だね。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「...What a beautiful body.

strings.text: なにひとつ不自由や不幸を知らず、育ってきた体だ」
strings.translated: A body that has grown up never knowing hardship or misfortune.」

strings.text: それを知ってか知らずか、園田はただそのまま、私のお腹や腰のあたりを、ただ穏やかな手つきで触れてくるだけだった
strings.translated: Whether he knew that or not, Sonoda simply continued, touching my stomach and waist with nothing but a calm, unhurried hand.

strings.text: 円夏「い、いやぁっ……」
strings.translated: Madoka「P-please... no...」

strings.text: 声が震えるのを抑えられない。
strings.translated: I couldn't stop my voice from trembling.

strings.text: 弱気を見せたらダメだって、わかっているのに……。
strings.translated: I knew I couldn't let him see my weakness... and yet.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「ただ、それだけに……不幸な体だ」
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「But precisely because of that... it is an unfortunate body.」

strings.text: 笑みで細めた視線のまま、私の体に視線を這わせてくる。
strings.translated: His gaze, narrowed behind that smile, crawled slowly over my body.

strings.text: ぞくっとした嫌悪感と同時に、猛烈な恥ずかしさが襲い掛かってくる。
strings.translated: Along with a chilling wave of revulsion, a fierce, burning shame came crashing over me.

strings.text: 視線はだんだんと……私の一番隠したい、下半身にまで滑り落ちてきていた
strings.translated: His eyes drifted lower and lower... sliding down to the part of me I most wanted to hide -- between my legs.

strings.text: 円夏「や、やだぁっ……！
strings.translated: Madoka「D-don't...!

strings.text: みないでっ……」
strings.translated: Don't look...!」

strings.text: 太腿を必死に閉じ合わせるようにしてみせるものの、この状態だと大した抵抗なんかできない。
strings.translated: I desperately tried to press my thighs together, but in this state I couldn't manage much resistance at all.

strings.text: たぶん、他人事だったら、そのまま蹴飛ばしてやればいいとか思えたかもしれないんだろうけど……。
strings.translated: Maybe if it were happening to someone else, I could have thought -- just kick him -- but...

strings.text: いまや、恐怖で押しつぶされそうになっていた私には、到底そんなことはできっこないと思ってしまってた
strings.translated: By now, crushed under the weight of my own terror, I couldn't imagine being able to do anything like that.

strings.text: 円夏（愛……！
strings.translated: Madoka (Ai...!

strings.text: ）無駄とわかっていつつも、視線だけで彼女の姿を探す。
strings.translated: Even knowing it was pointless, I searched for her with just my eyes.

strings.text: もしかしたら……愛も同じような目にあっているんじゃないかって、それでもその時点での私は彼女を気遣う余裕があったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe... maybe Ai was being put through the same thing -- and yet, even then, I somehow still had enough room in my heart to worry about her.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「きみはまだまだ自分で自分を理解していないようだね。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「It seems you still don't understand yourself very well.

strings.text: この美しくて……不幸な体がそれを物語っている」
strings.translated: This beautiful... unfortunate body tells the whole story.」

strings.text: 閉じ合わされた太腿を割り裂くように、園田の手が差し込まれる
strings.translated: Sonoda's hand forced its way between my clenched thighs, prying them apart.

strings.text: 円夏「ひっ……！
strings.translated: Madoka「Ah...!

strings.text: な、何を言って……」
strings.translated: W-what are you saying...」

strings.text: 実際、園田の言葉そのものは、さっきから全く頭に入ってなかった。
strings.translated: In truth, Sonoda's words themselves hadn't been registering in my mind at all this whole time.

strings.text: そもそも私にはそんな余裕すらもなくなっていたのだけど……それでも、その言葉に応じるようにはしてみせている。
strings.translated: I didn't even have the mental space for that anymore -- and yet I was still making a show of responding to what he said.

strings.text: そうすれば、多少は時間が稼げるかもしれないと……。
strings.translated: If I did that, maybe I could buy a little time...

strings.text: そうしたところで、何か助けが得られるとは、思えなかったのだけど、それでも……。
strings.translated: Even though I couldn't believe that would actually get me any help -- still...

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「今から、きみにそのことを教えてあげよう。
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「Now, let me show you.

strings.text: きみが本当に望んでいることを」
strings.translated: What it is you truly desire.」

strings.text: 園田の手には、何だか分からない器具のようなものがあった。
strings.translated: In Sonoda's hand was something -- some kind of implement I couldn't identify.

strings.text: それを、私の下半身にゆっくりと近づけてくる
strings.translated: He slowly brought it closer to my lower body.

strings.text: 円夏「な、なにするのっ……！
strings.translated: Madoka「W-what are you doing...!

strings.text: やだっ……やだぁぁっ！」
strings.translated: Stop -- stop it, stop it!」

strings.text: 悲鳴を上げ、不自由な体を身じろぎさせて、必死に抵抗する。
strings.translated: I screamed, twisting my restrained body, resisting with everything I had.

strings.text: 腕に食い込む縄の痛みも、気にしてる場合じゃなかった。
strings.translated: There was no room to worry about the pain of the rope cutting into my arms.

strings.text: 円夏「ひうううぅぅっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「Hnnngh!

strings.text: 下半身に、今まで感じたことのない感覚が襲いかかる。
strings.translated: A sensation I had never felt before came crashing into my lower body.

strings.text: 一瞬、私はそこを……クリトリスをつねりあげられたんじゃないかって思った
strings.translated: For a moment, I thought he had -- that he had pinched my clitoris.

strings.text: 円夏「ひあああっ！
strings.translated: Madoka「hiaaah!

strings.text: やっ……やぁっ！
strings.translated: No... noooo!

strings.text: いたっ……いたいっ！」
strings.translated: It hurts... it hurts!」

strings.text: オナニーの時でさえ、やんわりとしか触れたことがない、その敏感な場所への強烈な刺激に、頭の中で火花のようなものがいくつも弾ける
strings.translated: Even during masturbation, I had only ever touched that sensitive place gently -- and now this intense stimulation sent sparks exploding through my mind, one after another.

strings.text: 円夏「ひっ……あっ……あぐっ……！
strings.translated: Madoka「Hih... ah... ugh...!

strings.text: ああっ……あぁっ……」
strings.translated: Aah... ahhh...」

strings.text: 鼻の奥がつんとして……涙がぽろぽろと溢れる。
strings.translated: A stinging sensation rose in the back of my nose... and tears spilled down my cheeks in a steady stream.

strings.text: 園田Ｈ「おやおや、まだ準備をし始めただけのことだよ？
strings.translated: Sonoda (H)「My, my -- and I've only just begun the preparations, you know?

strings.text: それでそこまで感じるなんて、やっぱり素質があったようだね」
strings.translated: To feel this much already from just that... it seems you really do have a natural gift for it.」

strings.text: 素養……？
strings.translated: A gift...?

strings.text: 感じる……？
strings.translated: Feel...?

strings.text: 準備……？
strings.translated: Preparations...?

strings.text: いくつもの疑問が混乱した頭の中に浮かぶものの、それを咀嚼して鑑みる余裕さえ、なかった
strings.translated: Any number of questions surfaced in my confused mind, but I didn't have the composure to chew on them or think them through.

strings.text: 円夏「あうぅっ……うっ……うぐっ……」
strings.translated: Madoka「Auugh... ugh... ungh...」

strings.text: どうにか下半身の猛烈な違和感、不快感、そして痛み……そういうのをやり過ごして、自分の体に視線が向けられるようになった
strings.translated: Somehow managing to push past the violent wrongness, the discomfort, and the pain in my lower body... I was finally able to turn my gaze toward my own body.

strings.text: 円夏「な、なに……？
strings.translated: Madoka「W-what...?

strings.text: なに……これっ……」
strings.translated: What... is this...」

strings.text: 私のそこ……クリトリスには、園田が手にした器具が張り付いていた。
strings.translated: There -- on my clitoris -- the implement Sonoda held in his hand had been attached.

strings.text: 化学の実験で使うような器具……スポイトか何かのようなもの。
strings.translated: Something like the kind of instrument used in a chemistry experiment... like a dropper or something similar.

strings.text: そこに何らかの機械のようなものがくっついたようなもの
strings.translated: With what appeared to be some kind of mechanical device attached to it.

strings.text: 円夏「なにこれっ……！
strings.translated: Madoka「What is this...!

strings.text: は、外してっ……はずしてよぉっ！」
strings.translated: T-take it off... take it off!」

strings.text: 股間の感覚から……それが、吸盤のようなものでくっついているというのはかろうじてわかった。
strings.translated: From the sensation in my groin... I could just barely tell that it was clinging on with something like a suction cup.

strings.text: もちろん、それがわかったところで……今の私には何をどうすることもできないことも
strings.translated: Of course, even knowing that... there was nothing I could do about it in my current state.

strings.text: 円夏「こ、こんなことっ……！
strings.translated: Madoka「D-doing something like this...!
