strings.text: 素直にそう答えたら、顔を上げた白坂君は少し悲しそうに笑った
strings.translated: When I answered honestly, Shiraka looked up and gave a slightly sad smile

strings.text: 不意に真剣な表情になった白坂君に、手を取られた。
strings.translated: Shiraka, his expression suddenly turning serious, took my hand.

strings.text: 白坂君の手のひらは私よりずっと大きくて、暖かい
strings.translated: Shiraka's palm was so much larger than mine, and warm

strings.text: 大智「君にはそのままでいてほしい
strings.translated: Daichi「I want you to stay just the way you are.

strings.text: 大智「もしかしたら俺たちが間違ってるのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Daichi「Maybe we're the ones who are wrong.

strings.text: 姉さんたちが正しいのかもしれない
strings.translated: Maybe my sister and the others are right.

strings.text: 大智「それでも俺は、神村さんには変わらないでほしい
strings.translated: Daichi「Even so, I don't want you to change, Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 私が答えあぐねていると、チャイムの音にはっとしたように白坂君が手を放した
strings.translated: As I struggled to find an answer, the chime rang and Shiraka let go of my hand with a start

strings.text: 大智「…ごめん
strings.translated: Daichi「...Sorry.

strings.text: 愛「…戻りましょう
strings.translated: Ai「...Let's head back.

strings.text: 大智「…ああ
strings.translated: Daichi「...Yeah.

strings.text: 大智「戸田さんと話してみるよ。
strings.translated: Daichi「I'll try talking to Toda-san.

strings.text: それから…姉さんとも。
strings.translated: And then... to my sister too.

strings.text: 何度でも話してみる
strings.translated: As many times as it takes.

strings.text: 大智「状況は変わらないかもしれないけど、俺にできることって言ったらそれくらいしかないから
strings.translated: Daichi「The situation might not change, but that's about all I can do.

strings.text: 大智「俺はまだ、諦めたくないから
strings.translated: Daichi「Because I'm not ready to give up yet.

strings.text: 愛「……円夏とも話してみてくれる？
strings.translated: Ai「...Will you talk to Madoka too?

strings.text: 大智「星野さんと？
strings.translated: Daichi「To Hoshino-san?

strings.text: 愛「心配なの。
strings.translated: Ai「I'm worried about her.

strings.text: またあそこに行くことがないように、白坂君からも話してみてくれる？
strings.translated: Could you talk to her too, Shiraka-kun -- to make sure she doesn't go back there again?

strings.text: 大智「わかった
strings.translated: Daichi「Got it.

strings.text: 心の奥に何か、チリチリと違和感のようなものを感じる。
strings.translated: Deep in my heart, I felt something -- a faint, prickling sense of unease.

strings.text: それが何なのか、私にはよくわからなかった
strings.translated: I couldn't quite tell what it was

strings.text: 円夏「…大事な話って？」
strings.translated: Madoka「...What's this important thing you want to talk about?」

strings.text: 何だか疑うような目付きで、星野さんが俺のことを睨んでくる。
strings.translated: Hoshino-san was glaring at me with a suspicious look in her eyes.

strings.text: ものすごく敵視されてるように見えるのは、俺の気のせいだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it just my imagination, or did she seem incredibly hostile toward me?

strings.text: いや、こんなので怯んじゃいけない。
strings.translated: No -- I couldn't let that shake me.

strings.text: 助けられる人から順々に助けていかないと、本当に何もかもが取り返しのつかないことになっちまうんだから
strings.translated: I had to help the people I could reach, one by one, or everything would truly become irreversible

strings.text: 大智「ええと……クラブのことで
strings.translated: Daichi「Um... it's about the Club.

strings.text: 円夏「クラブ…？
strings.translated: Madoka「The Club...?

strings.text: 何のこと？
strings.translated: What's that about?

strings.text: 大智「神村さんから聞いた。
strings.translated: Daichi「I heard it from Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 星野さんもあそこに行ったんだろ？
strings.translated: You went there too, didn't you, Hoshino-san?

strings.text: 円夏「愛から
strings.translated: Madoka「From Ai...

strings.text: 円夏「愛は、なんて言ってたの？
strings.translated: Madoka「What did Ai say?

strings.text: 大智「星野さんのことを心配してた。
strings.translated: Daichi「I was worried about you, Hoshino-san.

strings.text: あそこには二度と関わらないでほしいって。
strings.translated: I wanted to ask you never to get involved with that place again.

strings.text: 俺からも念を押してほしいって、頼まれたんだ
strings.translated: Ai asked me to make sure you understood that.

strings.text: 円夏「そう
strings.translated: Madoka「I see.

strings.text: 円夏「心配しなくても、あんなところ二度と行かないから
strings.translated: Madoka「You don't need to worry. I'm never going back to a place like that.

strings.text: 円夏「それより…愛はどうしてあんなところにいるの？
strings.translated: Madoka「More importantly... why is Ai at a place like that?

strings.text: 白坂君は知ってる？
strings.translated: Do you know about it, Shiraka-kun?

strings.text: 大智「…いや、俺も詳しい事は聞いてない
strings.translated: Daichi「...No, I haven't heard the details either.

strings.text: 円夏「そう…。
strings.translated: Madoka「I see...

strings.text: 白坂君は、お姉さんのためなんだよね？
strings.translated: You're doing it for your sister, right, Shiraka-kun?

strings.text: 円夏「他には…愛から何か聞いた？
strings.translated: Madoka「Is there anything else... that you heard from Ai?

strings.text: 私の事
strings.translated: About me.

strings.text: 大智「…いいや。
strings.translated: Daichi「...No.

strings.text: 特には
strings.translated: Nothing in particular.

strings.text: それならいいんだ」
strings.translated: Then that's fine.」

strings.text: 何だかよくわからないけど、どうも機嫌を直してくれたようだ
strings.translated: I wasn't quite sure what was going on, but it seemed like her mood had lifted somewhat.

strings.text: 円夏「私の事は心配しないで。
strings.translated: Madoka「Don't worry about me.

strings.text: それより、愛の事をよろしくね
strings.translated: Instead, please look after Ai.

strings.text: とりあえず、星野さんは大丈夫……なのか？
strings.translated: For now, Hoshino-san seemed to be okay... or was she?

strings.text: ……ひとまず、戸田さんとも話しに行くか
strings.translated: Either way, I should go talk to Toda-san next.

strings.text: 大智「戸田さん」
strings.translated: Daichi「Toda-san.」

strings.text: 翌日、俺は学校の授業が終わってから、戸田さんに会うために１年生の教室にやってきた。
strings.translated: The next day, after classes ended, I came to the first-year classroom to find Toda-san.

strings.text: 幸いにして戸田さんはまだ教室に残っていて、俺が呼ぶと笑顔で廊下まで出て来てくれた
strings.translated: Fortunately she was still there, and when I called out to her, she came out into the hallway with a smile.

strings.text: 心音「白坂先輩。
strings.translated: Kokone「Shiraka-senpai.

strings.text: …どうしたんですか？
strings.translated: ...What's the matter?

strings.text: 大智「少し話がしたいんだけど、いいかな？
strings.translated: Daichi「I was hoping we could talk for a bit -- is that okay?

strings.text: 心音「話？
strings.translated: Kokone「Talk?

strings.text: 何の話ですか？
strings.translated: What are you talking about?

strings.text: 大智「ええと…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Um...」

strings.text: ここで話してもいいんだろうか。
strings.translated: Is it okay to talk here?

strings.text: できれば、誰もいないところに移動したほうがいいんじゃないだろうか
strings.translated: Wouldn't it be better to move somewhere with no one around?

strings.text: 心音「もしかして、いじめのことですか？
strings.translated: Kokone「Is this about the bullying?

strings.text: 大智「うん、まあ
strings.translated: Daichi「Yeah, more or less.

strings.text: 心音「先輩。
strings.translated: Kokone「Senpai.

strings.text: 優しいんですね。
strings.translated: You're so kind.

strings.text: 心配してくれるなんて
strings.translated: To worry about me like that...」

strings.text: 大智「そりゃあ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Well, of course...」

strings.text: 本当はクラブとの関わりのほうが気になったんだけど、それを正直に言う勇気はなかった。
strings.translated: Honestly, what was really on my mind was her involvement with the Club -- but I didn't have the courage to say that outright.

strings.text: それに、イジメがどうなったのかも気にはなってたんだ。
strings.translated: Besides, I had been wondering what happened with the bullying too.

strings.text: この前は、もう大丈夫みたいなことを言ってたけど、本当に大丈夫なんだろうか
strings.translated: Last time, she'd said something like she was fine now, but was she really?

strings.text: 心音「でも、大丈夫です。
strings.translated: Kokone「But I'm okay.

strings.text: あれから何もありませんから
strings.translated: Nothing has happened since then.

strings.text: 心音「あの時いじめを受け入れて、それを昇華したことで、結果的にいじめがなくなったんです
strings.translated: Kokone「By accepting the bullying and transcending it, the bullying ended up stopping as a result.

strings.text: 大智「受け入れて…昇華する…？
strings.translated: Daichi「Accepting it... and transcending it...?

strings.text: 心音「はい。
strings.translated: Kokone「Yes.

strings.text: クラブで教えてもらったことが、私を変えてくれたんです。
strings.translated: What the Club taught me changed me.

strings.text: 本当の私に気づかせてくれたんです」
strings.translated: It made me realize who I truly am.」

strings.text: そういえば、前にもそんな事を言ってたような気がする。
strings.translated: Now that she mentioned it, I felt like she'd said something similar before.

strings.text: 戸田さんの表情はとても幸せそうで、嘘を言ってるようには見えないし、そんな事をする理由もないはずだ。
strings.translated: Toda-san's expression looked genuinely happy, and she didn't seem to be lying -- and there was no reason she would.

strings.text: 俺が、悪いものだと思ってるクラブに通うことによって、本当にイジメはなくなりつつあるらしい
strings.translated: It appeared that by going to the Club, which I thought of as something bad, the bullying really was fading away.

strings.text: 心音「菱木先輩と園田先生のおかげです。
strings.translated: Kokone「It's all thanks to Hishiki-senpai and Sonoda-sensei.

strings.text: 人と人との繋がりって言うか、真理みたいなものを教えてくださったんです
strings.translated: They taught me something like... the nature of human connection, or a kind of truth.

strings.text: 大智「…そう
strings.translated: Daichi「...I see.

strings.text: 心音「ふふっ、白坂先輩にはまだわかりませんよね。
strings.translated: Kokone「Hehe, you still don't get it, do you, Shiraka-senpai?

strings.text: 園田先生とも、あまり話したことないんでしょう？
strings.translated: You haven't really talked much with Sonoda-sensei either, have you?

strings.text: 大智「それは、ないけど
strings.translated: Daichi「Well, no, not really.

strings.text: 心音「白坂先輩も、是非園田先生と話してみてください。
strings.translated: Kokone「Please do try talking to Sonoda-sensei, Shiraka-senpai.

strings.text: きっと、新しい自分を発見することができますよ」
strings.translated: I'm sure you'll discover a new side of yourself.」

strings.text: 結果的にイジメがなくなったからか、戸田さんはあの園田って男のことを完全に信用してしまってるみたいだった。
strings.translated: Perhaps because the bullying had stopped as a result, Toda-san seemed to trust that man Sonoda completely.

strings.text: とてもじゃないけど、俺の言葉のほうを信用してもらえる雰囲気じゃない。
strings.translated: There was no way she'd believe my words over his -- the atmosphere made that perfectly clear.

strings.text: クラブは良くないところだって、言い出すこともできなかった
strings.translated: I couldn't even bring myself to say that the Club was a bad place.

strings.text: 心音「それじゃあ、私は今日もクラブに行きますから
strings.translated: Kokone「Well then, I'm heading to the Club again today.

strings.text: 大智「そう…なんだ
strings.translated: Daichi「Oh... is that so.

strings.text: 心音「白坂先輩もちゃんと来てくださいね。
strings.translated: Kokone「Make sure you come properly too, Shiraka-senpai.

strings.text: じゃないと、いつまでたっても何も変わりませんよ
strings.translated: Otherwise, nothing will ever change for you.

strings.text: さわやかな笑顔で言って、戸田さんが廊下を歩いていった。
strings.translated: With a bright smile, Toda-san turned and walked off down the hallway.

strings.text: 追いかけようかとも思ったけど、それができる雰囲気でもなかった。
strings.translated: I thought about going after her, but the atmosphere wasn't one that would allow it.

strings.text: やっぱりダメだ。
strings.translated: This is hopeless.

strings.text: とてもじゃないけど、俺が何を言ったところでクラブから引き離せるとは思えない。
strings.translated: No matter what I said, I couldn't imagine being able to pull her away from the Club.

strings.text: 戸田さんに関しては、単純に説得する以外の方法を見つける必要がありそうだった。
strings.translated: When it came to Toda-san, it seemed like I'd need to find some method other than simply trying to persuade her.

strings.text: たとえば、園田の信頼を崩すような証拠を突きつけるとか
strings.translated: Something like confronting her with evidence that would shatter her trust in Sonoda...

strings.text: 大智「証拠……証拠があれば…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Evidence... if I had evidence...」

strings.text: あそこまで園田のことを信用してしまっていたら、生半可な証拠じゃ信じてもらえないだろう。
strings.translated: If she'd already come to trust Sonoda that deeply, half-baked evidence wouldn't be enough to make her believe me.

strings.text: クラブのかなり深いところまで調べないと、戸田さんを助けるだけの情報は得られそうになかった。
strings.translated: Unless I dug into the Club's inner workings quite thoroughly, I wasn't going to get the kind of information I'd need to help Toda-san.

strings.text: 根本的に考え方を変える必要がある。
strings.translated: I needed to fundamentally change my way of thinking.

strings.text: 巻き込んだ責任だとか、そういうので自分の行動を決めても意味がない。
strings.translated: There was no point in deciding my actions based on things like a sense of responsibility for dragging her into this.

strings.text: 今の時点で、誰なら助けられそうなのか、まずはそれをはっきりさせなければならなかった
strings.translated: At this point in time, I first had to make it clear -- who was it that I could actually save?

strings.text: 放課後、邪魔の入らない所でゆっくり話したくて、俺は神村さんを喫茶店に呼び出していた
strings.translated: After school, wanting to talk somewhere without interruptions, I had called Kamimura-san out to a coffee shop.

strings.text: 大智「ひとつ、確かめたいことがあるんだ
strings.translated: Daichi「There's one thing I want to confirm.

strings.text: 大智「あのクラブが違法な組織だっていう証拠みたいなものはないのかな。
strings.translated: Daichi「Is there anything like proof that the Club is an illegal organization?

strings.text: 神村さんは、そういうの知らないか？
strings.translated: Do you know anything like that, Kamimura-san?

strings.text: 大智「たとえば……麻薬を扱ってるとか
strings.translated: Daichi「For example... like dealing in drugs.

strings.text: 大智「あそこ、いつもお香みたいなのを焚いてるだろう？
strings.translated: Daichi「They're always burning that incense-like stuff in there, right?

strings.text: あれに何か、麻薬的な成分が含まれてるんじゃないのか？」
strings.translated: Could that stuff contain some kind of narcotic component?」

strings.text: クラブにはじめていったときもそうだったけど、２度目に異様に具合が悪くなったのも、もしかしてあれのせいだったりするんじゃないだろうか
strings.translated: It was the same the first time I went to the Club, but the second time I felt strangely ill -- maybe that was the cause.

strings.text: 愛「それは
strings.translated: Ai「That...

strings.text: 愛「…白坂君の言う通り、そういう効果を狙って使っているものだと思う
strings.translated: Ai「...I think you're right that they're using it to achieve that kind of effect.

strings.text: 大智「やっぱり
strings.translated: Daichi「I knew it.

strings.text: 愛「でも、違法なものではないの。
strings.translated: Ai「But it's not illegal.

strings.text: たぶんそれを理由にしてあそこを告発するのは難しいと思う
strings.translated: I think it would probably be difficult to report them on those grounds.

strings.text: 大智「どういうこと？
strings.translated: Daichi「What do you mean?

strings.text: 愛「あれはただのお香だから…。
strings.translated: Ai「That's just ordinary incense...

strings.text: 麻薬として摂取しているわけじゃなくて、香りを嗅いでリラックスするためのものなの。
strings.translated: It's not being taken as a drug -- it's meant to be inhaled for relaxation.

strings.text: …少なくとも、そういう事になってる
strings.translated: At least, that's the official story.

strings.text: 愛「私も詳しいことはわからないけど、あのお香を違法だとする法律は今のところないみたい
strings.translated: Ai「I don't know the details either, but it seems like there's currently no law that makes that incense illegal.

strings.text: 大智「そうか……」
strings.translated: Daichi「I see...」

strings.text: それにしても、犯罪すれすれの危ないことをやっているのは確かなようだ。
strings.translated: Even so, it does seem clear they're doing things that skirt dangerously close to illegal.

strings.text: 他にも何かやっていたりするんじゃないか？
strings.translated: Could there be something else going on too?

strings.text: 大智「実際、本物の麻薬を扱っていたり、密売したりってことは？
strings.translated: Daichi「Actually, what about dealing in real drugs -- or trafficking them?

strings.text: 愛「……私の知る限りでは……ないと思う。
strings.translated: Ai「...As far as I know... I don't think so.

strings.text: すくなくとも、あの中では
strings.translated: At least, not within the Club itself.

strings.text: でも、ちゃんと調べたら何か出てくるんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: But if someone looked into it properly, wouldn't something turn up?

strings.text: 唯一、切り崩すことができるかもしれないところは、あのクラブの運営費だ。
strings.translated: The one place that might be possible to crack open is the Club's operating funds.

strings.text: 大通り沿いではないとは言えビルのフロアを貸し切ってるんだから、それなりにお金はかかってるはずだ。
strings.translated: It may not be on a main street, but they're renting out an entire floor of a building -- that has to cost a fair amount.

strings.text: でも、園田は頻繁にクラブに来ていて、自分自身が働いている様子はない。
strings.translated: But Sonoda is at the Club constantly, and there's no sign that he works himself.

strings.text: だったら、どこかにお金の流れがあるはずだ。
strings.translated: In that case, there has to be a money trail somewhere.

strings.text: 園田が働かなくてもいいように、何かしらの仕組みがあって、それがクラブを維持しているはずなんだ
strings.translated: There must be some kind of arrangement that lets Sonoda get by without working -- and that arrangement must be what's keeping the Club afloat.

strings.text: 大智「ポイントは…あのクラブをどうやって維持させてるか、だと思うんだ」
strings.translated: Daichi「The key point is... how they're keeping that Club afloat, I think.」

strings.text: クラブを設立したのは、あの園田と言う男。
strings.translated: The Club was founded by that man, Sonoda.

strings.text: 目的は本当の救いを見出すこと。
strings.translated: The stated purpose is to find true salvation.

strings.text: お金は取ってなくて、どんなふうに維持してるのかはわからない。
strings.translated: They don't charge fees, and I have no idea how they sustain themselves.

strings.text: まさか、みんなの寄付金で成り立ってるわけじゃないだろうし
strings.translated: Surely it can't be running on everyone's donations alone.

strings.text: 愛「会費みたいなものはないし、私も払ったことはないけど
strings.translated: Ai「There's nothing like membership fees, and I've never paid anything either.

strings.text: 大智「でも、みんなにお金を出せって言えば出しそうな雰囲気だよな
strings.translated: Daichi「But if he asked everyone to chip in, they'd probably do it -- that's the kind of atmosphere it has.

strings.text: 愛「出すかもしれないけど、それで長続きする？
strings.translated: Ai「They might pay, but would that really last?

strings.text: 大智「……しないだろうな」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Probably not.」

strings.text: ビルのフロアを貸し切ってるんだから、学生のちょっとした寄付金程度でまかない続けられるわけがない。
strings.translated: They're renting out an entire floor of a building -- there's no way a few small student donations could keep that going indefinitely.

strings.text: もっと大きくて安定した収入がなければ、あんなクラブを維持し続けることはできないはずだった
strings.translated: Without a larger, more stable source of income, there'd be no way to sustain a club like that.

strings.text: 大智「塾長とか言う園田って男は、いつもあそこに？
strings.translated: Daichi「This Sonoda guy -- the so-called headmaster -- is he always there?

strings.text: 愛「ええ……。
strings.translated: Ai「Yes...

strings.text: 私の知る限りは、１日中あそこにいるみたい
strings.translated: As far as I know, it seems like she's there all day.

strings.text: 愛「奥さんも、多分
strings.translated: Ai「His wife too, probably.

strings.text: 大智「奥さん？
strings.translated: Daichi「His wife?

strings.text: 愛「受付の女の人。
strings.translated: Ai「The woman at the reception desk.

strings.text: 園田静子さん」
strings.translated: Shizuko Sonoda.」

strings.text: 夫婦なのか…。
strings.translated: They're married...

strings.text: ということは他に事業をやってるわけじゃないのか？
strings.translated: So does that mean he isn't running some other business on the side?

strings.text: それともあそこで何か仕事をしていたりするのか？
strings.translated: Or could it be that he's doing some kind of work right there in that place?

strings.text: 大智「塾長の資金源って、心当たりはあるかな？
strings.translated: Daichi「Do you have any idea what the headmaster's source of funding might be?

strings.text: たとえば……作家だとか、芸術家とか……それとも、遺産を相続してるとか
strings.translated: For instance... maybe he's a writer, or an artist... or perhaps he inherited a fortune.

strings.text: 大智「大金持ち、って感じじゃないよな。
strings.translated: Daichi「He doesn't really give off the impression of being filthy rich.

strings.text: 着てる服なんかも、そんなに高級な感じはしないし
strings.translated: The clothes he wears don't look all that expensive either.

strings.text: 大智「じゃあ…それなら大きなスポンサーがついてるとか、塾長以外の誰かが稼いでるとかじゃないと…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Then... in that case, it would have to be some major sponsor backing them, or someone other than the headmaster bringing in the money...」

strings.text: いや、あんな乱れきったクラブにつくスポンサーがいるわけない。
strings.translated: No, there's no way anyone would sponsor a Club as depraved as that one.

strings.text: 人前でセックスできるような連中ばっかりなんだ。
strings.translated: The place is full of people who can have sex in front of others without a second thought.

strings.text: そんなところのスポンサーなんかしたら
strings.translated: If anyone sponsored a place like that--

strings.text: そこまで言って、俺はハッと息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: At that point, I caught my breath.

strings.text: 手っ取り早く金を稼ぐ方法が、ひとつあった。
strings.translated: There was one quick way to make money.

strings.text: あのクラブには、女の子がたくさんいる。
strings.translated: The Club had plenty of girls.

strings.text: 簡単にセックスしてくれる。
strings.translated: Girls who would sleep with you easily.

strings.text: これを利用しない手はないはずだ
strings.translated: There was no reason not to take advantage of that.

strings.text: 大智「まさか…」
strings.translated: Daichi「No way...」

strings.text: まるで、パズルのピースがはめ込まれたように、頭の中で様々なものが繋がっていく。
strings.translated: Like puzzle pieces snapping into place, everything started connecting in my mind.

strings.text: 簡単にセックスしてくれる女の子達がたくさんいるなら、そこに行きたいって考える男も世の中にはいるはずだ。
strings.translated: If there were plenty of girls who would sleep with you easily, there had to be men out there who would want to go to a place like that.

strings.text: もちろん、普通の社会で生きてるような人達じゃなくて、もっとヤバイところとか変わってるような人達なら、こう言ったクラブはむしろ歓迎するんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Of course, not the kind of people who live normal lives in regular society -- but people from shadier places, or more unusual types... they would probably welcome a club like this with open arms.

strings.text: そして、彼らはお金を払って好みの女の子とセックスする…。
strings.translated: And those men would pay money to have sex with whichever girl they liked...

strings.text: 女の子のほうも、セックスは相手に求められる幸せだとか感じてるみたいだから、嫌がることなくそれを受け入れる。
strings.translated: The girls, for their part, seemed to feel that being desired for sex was a kind of happiness -- so they would accept it without any resistance.

strings.text: 結果、女の子達がお金を稼いでそれがクラブに流れて、彼女達は園田の役に立ったと喜びを感じることになる。
strings.translated: As a result, the girls would earn money that flowed back into the Club, and they would feel a sense of joy at having been useful to Sonoda.

strings.text: 要するに…園田は、そそのかした女の子達に売春をさせてるんじゃないだろうか
strings.translated: In short... wasn't Sonoda using the girls he had manipulated to run a prostitution ring?

strings.text: 愛「白坂君？
strings.translated: Ai「Shiraka-kun?

strings.text: どうかしたの？
strings.translated: "What's wrong?"

strings.text: 大智「神村さん……クラブがどうやって維持されてるのか、本当に知らないのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san... do you really not know how the Club is being kept running?

strings.text: 愛「…どういう事？
strings.translated: Ai「...What do you mean?

strings.text: 大智「みんな、自分の体で客を取ってるんじゃないのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Isn't everyone taking clients with their own bodies?

strings.text: この反応だけで十分だ。
strings.translated: That reaction alone was enough.

strings.text: 俺の予想は間違ってない。
strings.translated: My guess wasn't wrong.

strings.text: あのクラブは、そういう方法で成り立ってるんだ。
strings.translated: That Club was being sustained by exactly that kind of arrangement.

strings.text: できれば外れててほしかったけど、もうその望みも潰えた
strings.translated: I had been hoping I was off the mark, but now even that hope was gone.

strings.text: 大智「そうなんだな？
strings.translated: Daichi「That's what's happening, isn't it?

strings.text: 愛「それは……私は、よくわからなくて
strings.translated: Ai「That is... I'm not really sure about that.

strings.text: 大智「あの園田って男は、みんなを救うとか言いながら、本当は金儲けのために利用してるんだな？
strings.translated: Daichi「That man Sonoda -- while claiming he's saving everyone, he's actually using them to make money, isn't he?

strings.text: 愛「確かに…お金はそういう方法で稼いでるかもしれないけど
strings.translated: Ai「It's true... they may be earning money that way, but--

strings.text: 大智「やっぱりか」
strings.translated: Daichi「So it's true after all.」

strings.text: 園田に対して、激しい怒りがわいてくる。
strings.translated: A fierce surge of anger rose up inside me toward Sonoda.

strings.text: まさか、そこまで無茶苦茶な事をしてるなんて…。
strings.translated: I never imagined he was doing something so utterly reckless...

strings.text: そして、ほんの少しだけ神村さんに対しても、俺に嘘をついていたことを追求したかった
strings.translated: And just a little -- I also wanted to confront Kamimura-san for having lied to me.

strings.text: 大智「どうして黙ってたんだ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Why did you keep quiet about it?

strings.text: 愛「黙ってたってわけじゃ…確証がなかったし、私はしたことないし
strings.translated: Ai「I wasn't exactly keeping quiet... I had no proof, and I've never done it myself.

strings.text: 大智「でも、可能性は有ったんだろう？
strings.translated: Daichi「But you knew it was a possibility, didn't you?

strings.text: だったら、あくまで可能性ってことで教えてくれたら良かったじゃないか
strings.translated: If that was the case, couldn't she at least have told me it was a possibility?

strings.text: 愛「それは……そうね。
strings.translated: Ai「That's... you're right.

strings.text: ごめんなさい」
strings.translated: I'm sorry.」

strings.text: 本当に反省しているようで、神村さんが肩を縮こまらせながら謝ってくる。
strings.translated: She seemed genuinely remorseful, Kamimura-san shrinking her shoulders as she apologized.

strings.text: 悪気はなかったってことなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Was it that she hadn't meant any harm?

strings.text: 隠そうとしたわけじゃなかったってことなんだろうか。
strings.translated: That she hadn't been trying to hide it?

strings.text: 神村さんが嘘や隠し事をしてたとは思いたくなかったけど、彼女の言葉も全面的に信用するわけにはいかないみたいだった。
strings.translated: I didn't want to think that Kamimura-san had been lying or keeping things from me, but it seemed like I couldn't fully trust her words either.

strings.text: 本人にその気はなくても、俺を混乱させる行動を取ってしまうのかもしれなかった。
strings.translated: Even without meaning to, she might end up doing things that threw me into confusion.

strings.text: それにしても…あのクラブが、売春の場所になってる可能性があるってことなのか…今まで十分にショックを受けたと思ってたけど、さらに大きなショックだった。
strings.translated: Even so... the Club might actually be a place of prostitution... I thought I'd already been shocked enough, but this was an even bigger blow.

strings.text: だって、クラブが売春の場所で、そこにいる人達が客を取らされてるってことは、姉さんも既にそれに参加してるかもしれないってことなんだ。
strings.translated: Because if the Club was a place of prostitution, and the people there were being made to take clients -- that meant my sister might already be part of it.

strings.text: 正直、想像するだけで虫唾が走ったし、姉さんもそこまではおかしくなってないはずだって祈らずにはいられなかった
strings.translated: Honestly, just imagining it made my skin crawl, and I couldn't help but pray that my sister hadn't gone that far off the rails.

strings.text: 大智「クラブがやらせてることは、売春だけなのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Is prostitution the only thing the Club is making people do?

strings.text: それとも、もっと……なにかヤバイ仕事をやらせたりしてるのか？
strings.translated: Or worse... was he making them do something even more dangerous?

strings.text: 大智「神村さん、君はどこまで知ってるんだ？
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san, how much do you actually know?

strings.text: 愛「私は…そんなに大したことは知らないから
strings.translated: Ai「I... don't really know all that much.

strings.text: 大智「そういえば…小野田さんが学校に来なくなったって聞いたけど、あれもクラブが関係してるんじゃないのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Come to think of it... I heard that Onoda-san stopped coming to school. Isn't the Club involved in that too?

strings.text: 愛「それは…」
strings.translated: Ai「That's...」

strings.text: この様子だと、神村さんが小野田さんの失踪について詳細を知ってるのは間違いない。
strings.translated: Judging by her reaction, there was no doubt that Kamimura-san knew the details of Onoda-san's disappearance.

strings.text: クラブのせいで、あるいはクラブのために姿を消したのはほぼ確定だった。
strings.translated: It was almost certain that she had vanished because of the Club -- or for the Club's sake.

strings.text: あまり騒ぎにならないのは、クラブはもちろん、学校も公にはしてないからだ。
strings.translated: The reason it hadn't caused much of a stir was that neither the Club nor the school had made it public.

strings.text: でも、当然親御さんは警察に捜索願は出してるだろうし、俺達の知らないところで誰かが捜してるはずなんだ。
strings.translated: But surely her parents would have filed a missing persons report with the police, and someone must be searching for her somewhere beyond our knowledge.

strings.text: それなのに、小野田さんの行方は≪杳／よう≫として知れない。
strings.translated: And yet, there was no trace of Onoda-san's whereabouts to be found.

strings.text: まるで、神隠しに遭ったみたいに、忽然と姿が消えてしまっていた
strings.translated: She had vanished without a trace, as if spirited away.

strings.text: 大智「姉さんに言われたんだ。
strings.translated: Daichi「My sister told me.

strings.text: 小野田さんは、俺の知らないところに行ったって
strings.translated: That Onoda-san had gone somewhere I don't know about.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん自身もいつかはそこへ行くって。
strings.translated: Daichi「That my sister herself would go there someday too.

strings.text: 小野田さんに、会える日が楽しみだって
strings.translated: That she was looking forward to the day she could see Onoda-san again.

strings.text: 大智「最初は、外国にでも言ったのかと思ったけど、クラブが関わってるならそんな簡単な話じゃないよな？」
strings.translated: Daichi「At first I thought maybe she'd gone abroad or something, but if the Club is involved, it can't be that simple, can it?」

strings.text: 話をしながら、俺の頭の中である可能性が導き出されていく。
strings.translated: As we talked, a certain possibility began to take shape in my mind.

strings.text: 小野田さんの失踪にクラブが関わっているとして、外国なんかに行かせたりするだろうか。
strings.translated: Assuming the Club was involved in Onoda-san's disappearance -- would they really send her somewhere like a foreign country?

strings.text: あのクラブは変なところだけど、それほど規模が大きいわけじゃない。
strings.translated: That Club was a strange place, but it wasn't exactly large in scale.

strings.text: それなのに、小野田さんを外国に行かせて何になるって言うんだ。
strings.translated: And yet, what would be the point of sending Onoda-san abroad?

strings.text: でも、もしも…そうじゃないとしたら…。
strings.translated: But if that wasn't it... if it was something else entirely...

strings.text: 外国じゃなくて、全然違う場所に行ったんだとしたら…。
strings.translated: If she hadn't gone abroad, but somewhere completely different...

strings.text: 考えられることとしては……たとえば……人身売買。
strings.translated: The possibilities that came to mind were... for example... human trafficking.

strings.text: それとも……まさか、もしかして
strings.translated: Or... no, surely not, could it be...

strings.text: 大智「もしかして、小野田さんは…死んだんじゃないのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「Could it be that Onoda-san... is dead?

strings.text: 神村さんは答えなかった。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san didn't answer.

strings.text: まさかそんな、漫画やドラマじゃあるまいし、そんなことが…………いや、姉さんの身に起こったことだってそうだ。
strings.translated: No way -- this wasn't some manga or TV drama -- something like that couldn't really... no, wait. What happened to my sister was just as unthinkable.

strings.text: 現実にはあるのだろうけど、自分にはかかわりのない世界の事だと思っていた。
strings.translated: I had believed that world existed in reality, but that it had nothing to do with me.

strings.text: でも違うんだ。
strings.translated: But I was wrong.

strings.text: そういう世界は確かに存在して、自分がまきこまれることもあるんだ
strings.translated: That world truly existed, and it was possible to get dragged into it yourself.

strings.text: 愛「もしも、そうだとしたら…白坂君は、どうするつもりなの？
strings.translated: Ai「If that were the case... what are you planning to do, Shiraka-kun?

strings.text: 大智「そんなの…警察に行くに決まってるだろ…！
strings.translated: Daichi「Something like that... of course I'd go to the police...!

strings.text: 神村さんが否定しなかったことで、小野田さんがもう死んでる可能性が高まってきた。
strings.translated: The fact that Kamimura-san hadn't denied it made the possibility that Onoda-san was already dead feel all the more real.

strings.text: クラブの仕事なのか、それ以外の理由なのかはわからないけど、あの人はもうこの世のどこにもいないんだ。
strings.translated: Whether it was because of the Club's work or some other reason, I didn't know -- but that person was no longer anywhere in this world.

strings.text: そして、神村さんも、姉さんも、クラブの他の人達もそのことを知ってる。
strings.translated: And Kamimura-san, my sister, and the others in the Club all knew that.

strings.text: 知ってるのに、この話が表に出て来ないのは、やっぱりクラブが深く関わってるからじゃないんだろうか。
strings.translated: The reason this hadn't come to light despite everyone knowing -- wasn't it because the Club was deeply involved?

strings.text: 本当に死人が出てるんだったら、とてもじゃないけど俺の手には負えない。
strings.translated: If someone had truly died, this was far beyond anything I could handle on my own.

strings.text: いや、本当は最初から俺の手に負えるものじゃなかったんだ。
strings.translated: No -- honestly, it had never been something I could handle on my own from the very beginning.

strings.text: あのクラブは、思ってた以上にヤバイところだったんだ。
strings.translated: That Club was a far more dangerous place than I had ever imagined.

strings.text: 姉さんのことを気遣って、俺だけでコソコソ動いてる場合じゃない。
strings.translated: This wasn't the time to be tiptoeing around on my own out of concern for my sister.

strings.text: 手遅れになれば、今度は姉さんが死んでしまうかもしれないんだ。
strings.translated: If I let it go too far, my sister might be the next one to die.

strings.text: もしかすると、父さんと母さんにも話をしたほうがいいのかもしれないな
strings.translated: Maybe I should talk to Dad and Mom about this too.

strings.text: 愛「警察がそんな話を信じると思う？
strings.translated: Ai「Do you think the police would believe a story like that?

strings.text: 大智「信じてもらわないといけないんだ。
strings.translated: Daichi「They have to believe it.

strings.text: 何度も説明して、ちょっとしたことでもいいから証拠みたいなものを見せて、警察に動いてもらうしかないだろ
strings.translated: I'll explain it as many times as it takes, show them whatever small pieces of evidence I can find, and get the police to act -- there's no other way.

strings.text: 愛「警察に信じてもらうまでに、白坂君が無事でいられると思う？
strings.translated: Ai「Do you think you'll still be safe by the time the police believe you?

strings.text: 大智「…それは脅してるのか？
strings.translated: Daichi「...Is that a threat?

strings.text: 愛「いいえ。
strings.translated: Ai「No.

strings.text: 思ったことを言っただけ」
strings.translated: I'm just saying what I think.」

strings.text: 神村さんは冷静で、何を考えているのか全く分からない。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san was calm, and I had no idea what was going through her mind.

strings.text: この間屋上でちょっと近くなったような気がした神村さんとの距離が、また遠くなってしまった気がする。
strings.translated: The distance between us that had seemed to close a little on the rooftop the other day felt like it had opened up again.

strings.text: 正直、今の段階では神村さんが敵なのか味方なのか判断することができない。
strings.translated: Honestly, at this point I couldn't tell whether Kamimura-san was an enemy or an ally.

strings.text: いつ裏切ったっておかしくはない存在なんだ。
strings.translated: She was someone who could betray me at any moment and it wouldn't be strange.

strings.text: 否定はしない。
strings.translated: She hadn't denied it.

strings.text: それは、肯定してるも同然だった。
strings.translated: That was as good as confirming it.

strings.text: クラブのために小野田さんを犠牲にしたのなら、邪魔な俺を殺そうとするのは当たり前だ。
strings.translated: If the Club had sacrificed Onoda-san, then trying to kill me -- someone in the way -- would be perfectly natural to them.

strings.text: もしかすると、俺は気づかないうちに自分の命が危ういところまで足を踏み入れてしまったのかもしれなかった
strings.translated: It was possible that without even realizing it, I had already stepped into a place where my own life was in danger.

strings.text: 大智「……警察に行くかどうかはもう少し考えてみる
strings.translated: Daichi「...I'll think a little more before deciding whether to go to the police.

strings.text: 大智「その前に……あのクラブのことをもう少し調べてみるよ」
strings.translated: Daichi「Before that... I'm going to look into that Club a bit more.」

strings.text: もしも、警察に行った場合、説得に時間をかけてる余裕はない。
strings.translated: If I went to the police, I couldn't afford to spend days trying to convince them.

strings.text: 何日も通うほどの余裕があると思えない。
strings.translated: I didn't think I had that kind of time.

strings.text: 決定的な証拠が必要だ。
strings.translated: I needed decisive proof.

strings.text: クラブの存在と、その悪事を証明できるものが必要だ。
strings.translated: Something that could prove the Club's existence and its crimes.

strings.text: それがなければ、すぐに警察を動かすことはできないだろう。
strings.translated: Without that, there was no way to get the police moving quickly.

strings.text: そして、両親に話すのもまだ控えたほうがいいのかもしれない。
strings.translated: And it was probably still better to hold off on telling my parents too.

strings.text: 俺が何を言ったところで、たぶん姉さんが否定してくる。
strings.translated: Whatever I said, my sister would probably just deny it.

strings.text: クラブの存在を信じさせる前に、俺の正気を疑われてしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: Before I could even get them to believe the Club existed, they might start questioning my sanity.

strings.text: 何の行動を起こすにしても、タイミングは慎重に考えなければならなかった
strings.translated: Whatever action I took, I had to think carefully about the timing.

strings.text: 愛「調べるって……どうするつもり？」
strings.translated: Ai「Look into it... what are you planning to do?」

strings.text: 物静かな目で見つめながら、神村さんがか細い声で尋ねてくる。
strings.translated: She fixed me with quiet, still eyes and asked in a thin voice.

strings.text: 彼女が何を考えてるのかわからなかったけど、やっぱり俺のことを心配してくれてるんだろうか。
strings.translated: I couldn't tell what she was thinking, but was she worried about me after all?

strings.text: 冷静に考えてみると、俺がクラブの連中から狙われた場合、神村さんも一緒に標的になってしまう可能性もあるんだろうか。
strings.translated: When I thought about it calmly -- if the Club's people came after me, there was a chance Kamimura-san would become a target along with me.

strings.text: さすがに、連中だって知っている。
strings.translated: They surely knew.

strings.text: 俺と神村さんが仲良くしてる姿は、たくさんの人に見られてしまっている。
strings.translated: Plenty of people had seen me and Kamimura-san together.

strings.text: 神村さんは、まだ悩んでる状態だけど、クラブからは裏切り者と見なされても不思議じゃなかった
strings.translated: She was still in a state of uncertainty, but it wouldn't be strange if the Club already considered her a traitor.

strings.text: 大智「……とりあえず、小野田さんの家族に話を聞いてみる
strings.translated: Daichi「...For now, I'll try talking to Onoda-san's family.

strings.text: 愛「…私も一緒に行く。
strings.translated: Ai「...I'll come with you.

strings.text: 協力するから…危険なことは
strings.translated: I want to help... just don't do anything dangerous.

strings.text: 大智「ああ、危ないことはしない
strings.translated: Daichi「Yeah, I won't do anything dangerous.

strings.text: 愛「約束よ」
strings.translated: Ai「Promise me.」

strings.text: そう言って、神村さんが少しだけ口元に笑みを浮かべた。
strings.translated: With that, Kamimura-san let a small smile touch the corner of her lips.

strings.text: こうやって話してると本当に普通の子なのに、どうしてあんなクラブに関わってしまったんだろう。
strings.translated: When we talked like this, she seemed like such a normal girl -- so how had she ever gotten mixed up with a club like that?

strings.text: 今はまだ無理だけど、必ず神村さんも救ってみせる。
strings.translated: It was impossible right now, but I would save Kamimura-san too, no matter what.

strings.text: あのクラブとの関係を断たせて、普通の日常に戻してやる
strings.translated: I would cut her ties with that Club and bring her back to an ordinary life.

strings.text: 俺は心の中で改めて決意すると、喫茶店の席を立った。
strings.translated: Renewing my resolve in my heart, I rose from my seat in the cafe.

strings.text: 日が落ちるまでは、まだもう少し時間があるはずだった
strings.translated: There was still a little time left before the sun went down.

strings.text: やはり、毎日の生活に大きな変化はなかった。
strings.translated: As expected, there was no great change in my daily life.

strings.text: 試しに…と、戸田さんをクラブへと引き込んではみたものの、それは私に期待していたような環境の変化や楽しさを与えてはくれなかった。
strings.translated: I had tried bringing Toda-san into the Club as an experiment, but it hadn't given me the change of environment or sense of enjoyment I had hoped for.

strings.text: 戸田さんは戸田さんで、勝手によろしくやっているし、そのことが彼女を変えていっている…いいかえれば救ってくれているようにも思えはした。
strings.translated: Toda-san was doing just fine on her own terms, and that seemed to be changing her -- in other words, it seemed to be saving her, in a way.

strings.text: ただ私は小野田さんが白坂先輩にしたように、誰かを自分の手の平の上で変えてみせ、そのことを楽しんでみたかっただけだ。
strings.translated: I had simply wanted to change someone in the palm of my hand, the way Onoda-san had done with Shirasaka-senpai, and take pleasure in that.

strings.text: そして、そのことが私自身の環境もよりいい方向へと変えてくれるかもと思っていた。
strings.translated: And I had thought that doing so might also change my own circumstances for the better.

strings.text: でも、私にもたらされた結果はそうではなかった。
strings.translated: But the result it brought me was not that.

strings.text: 園田がいっていたような真の救いの扉も、私の目の前には現れなかった。
strings.translated: The door to true salvation that Sonoda had spoken of never appeared before me either.

strings.text: 別にその真の救いの扉の存在を真に受けて、妄信的に追い求めていたという訳でもなかった。
strings.translated: It wasn't as though I had taken the existence of that door to true salvation at face value and was blindly chasing after it.

strings.text: けれど、その存在や意味が気にかかっていなかったといえば、それは嘘になる。
strings.translated: But if I said its existence and meaning hadn't weighed on my mind at all, that would be a lie.

strings.text: でも、そのことを純粋に追い求めるという気ではなかった。
strings.translated: Still, I wasn't in a frame of mind to pursue it purely for its own sake.

strings.text: もし、私が小野田さんのように誰かを救えたとしたなら、そこに近づけるかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I could save someone the way Onoda-san had, perhaps I might draw closer to it.

strings.text: それもまた環境の変化としかとらえていなかったけど、私はそれが欲しかった。
strings.translated: I had only seen that as another change of environment, but it was something I wanted.

strings.text: 園田は私だからこそ真の救いの扉を見付けることができるだろう、なんていっていたけど、それを真に受けて信じていた、というわけでもない。
strings.translated: Sonoda had said that because it was me, I would surely be the one to find the door to true salvation -- but I hadn't taken that at face value and believed it, either.

strings.text: それがどんなものであれ、それが変化にも徐々に慣れていって満たされなくなっていく私をあらためて満たしてくれるなら、変えてくれるなら。
strings.translated: Whatever it might be -- if it could fill me anew, if it could change me, when I had grown gradually accustomed to change and could no longer be satisfied by it.

strings.text: そんな思いがちょっとあっただけだ。
strings.translated: That was all -- just a small feeling like that.

strings.text: …しかし、その変化は訪れなかった。
strings.translated: ...But that change never came.

strings.text: いうならば、私は真の救いの扉とかいう存在には近づけていなかったのかもしれない
strings.translated: To put it plainly, perhaps I had not been drawing any closer to whatever that door to true salvation was supposed to be.

strings.text: 学校が終わってから、私はクラブにも行かず街中をさ迷い歩いた。
strings.translated: After school, I wandered the streets without going to the Club.

strings.text: どうすれば救いといいかえられるような環境の変化が、私を満たしてくれるなにかが見つかるのか。
strings.translated: How could I find a change in my circumstances that could be called salvation -- something that would fill me?

strings.text: なにをすれば自分がそこに到れるのか。
strings.translated: What would I have to do to get there?

strings.text: 最近は、そのことが頭の中にちらついて、それすらもストレスに感じるようになっていた。
strings.translated: Lately those thoughts kept flickering through my mind, and even that had started to feel like stress.

strings.text: 私は確実に一歩進んでいる。
strings.translated: I was definitely moving forward one step at a time.

strings.text: …と、園田はいっていたけど、いまいち実感として感じることはできていない。
strings.translated: ...Or so Sonoda had said, but I couldn't quite feel it as a reality.

strings.text: 本当に一歩進んでいるのか？
strings.translated: Was I really moving forward?

strings.text: 進んでいるとしても、それはどの程度の距離なのか？
strings.translated: Even if I was moving forward, how far had I actually gone?

strings.text: それを定量的に計り知る術は私にはなかった。
strings.translated: I had no way to measure that in any concrete terms.

strings.text: こんな風に悩ましくなるのも謎かけのように言葉を弄する園田のせいかもしれない。
strings.translated: I could even find myself thinking that this kind of anguish was Sonoda's fault -- the way he always played with words like some kind of riddle.

strings.text: とすら思える瞬間もある。
strings.translated: There were moments I genuinely felt that.

strings.text: そして、そんなことに煩わされることも悩ましかった
strings.translated: And being troubled by even that much was itself a source of distress.

strings.text: 紗英子「くだらない事ばっかり…」
strings.translated: Saeko「Nothing but trivial nonsense...」

strings.text: 周りを見てみると、くだらないことに楽しそうにしてる人達ばかりだ。
strings.translated: Looking around, all I could see were people happily absorbed in trivial things.

strings.text: よくわからないことで笑って、よくわからないことで騒いで、よくわからないことで楽しそうにして…。
strings.translated: Laughing at things that made no sense, making a fuss over things that made no sense, looking like they were having fun over things that made no sense...

strings.text: どうして、そんなふうになれるのだろう？
strings.translated: How could they be like that?

strings.text: それは無駄な時間と体力を使ってるだけなんじゃないか、と思えて、哀れみにも似た感情がわきあがってくる。
strings.translated: It seemed to me like they were just wasting their time and energy, and something close to pity welled up inside me.

strings.text: もしかしたら、他の人達からは私もそんな風に映っているのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe to other people, I looked exactly the same way.

strings.text: そんな虚無感すら覚えてしまう。
strings.translated: Even that kind of emptiness crept over me.

strings.text: それは孤独感や孤立感といってもいい感情なのかもしれない
strings.translated: It might have been an emotion that could just as well be called loneliness, or a sense of isolation.

strings.text: 紗英子「結局、あのクラブもどの程度の意味があったのかしら…」
strings.translated: Saeko「In the end, I wonder how much that Club even meant...」

strings.text: 所属当初から、瑛さん以外のクラブのメンバーに対してはいい印象を抱いてはいなかった。
strings.translated: From the very beginning, I had never had a good impression of the Club's members -- anyone except Akira.

strings.text: それぞれが好きなことをして、それで自分は救われたと思い込んでいる。
strings.translated: Each of them did whatever they pleased and convinced themselves that they had been saved by it.

strings.text: 現実から目を背けているだけだと気づかなくて、自分は前に進んでると錯覚している。
strings.translated: They couldn't see that they were only turning away from reality, and they were under the illusion that they were moving forward.

strings.text: そんな人達の中に混じっていても、私はやっぱり孤独だったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Even surrounded by people like that, I was probably still lonely in the end.

strings.text: 時には誰かと身体を交え、ストレスを発散し、刹那的に満たされることができたとしても、それは一過性のものに過ぎない。
strings.translated: Even if there were times I could intertwine my body with someone, release my stress, and feel a fleeting sense of fulfillment -- it was nothing more than something temporary.

strings.text: それでもまだ、クラブがない日常よりはマシだった。
strings.translated: Even so, it was still better than a daily life without the Club.

strings.text: 癒される時間、満たされる瞬間。
strings.translated: Time to be soothed, moments of fulfillment.

strings.text: 確かにそれらに救いを感じていなかったという訳ではない。
strings.translated: It's not as though I hadn't truly felt some salvation in those things.

strings.text: 大体、折々に話をし、時には身体を交わらせる園田の言葉に疑問がたくさんあった。
strings.translated: For the most part, Sonoda -- with whom I spoke from time to time and occasionally shared my body -- left me with many doubts about his words.

strings.text: あの男は、結局、救いの意味を相手の想像に預けるようなことしかいわない。
strings.translated: That man, in the end, never said anything beyond leaving the meaning of salvation up to the other person's imagination.

strings.text: そして、その中で行き詰まった時、告げられた真の救いの扉という思わせぶりな言葉。
strings.translated: And then, when I hit a wall within all of that, he dropped those suggestive words -- the door to true salvation.

strings.text: 振りかえれば、私はその言葉に振り回されていたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Looking back, I may have been at the mercy of those words all along.

strings.text: それでも…それでなにかが変わってくれるなら、より私を満たしてくれるなら。
strings.translated: Even so... if something could change because of them, if they could fill me more completely --

strings.text: そんな思いが私の中に存在していたのは偽りない事実だった
strings.translated: The fact that such feelings existed within me was an undeniable truth.

strings.text: クラブに順応した当初の私にとって、男達との交わりは新鮮だった。
strings.translated: When I first adapted to the Club, the intimacy with men was something new.

strings.text: 自分を受け入れてもらうことが、園田の言っていた救いだと錯覚してしまった。
strings.translated: I fell into the illusion that being accepted was the salvation Sonoda had spoken of.

strings.text: 不用意に誰かにしられることのないように注意を払いながらクラブに通い、安らぎや充実感を…救いともいえるものを感じとり、それを満喫していた。
strings.translated: I was careful not to let anyone find out carelessly, and I went to the Club, drawing in a sense of peace and fulfillment -- something that could be called salvation -- and I savored it.

strings.text: でも、すぐに気づいてしまった。
strings.translated: But I realized it quickly.

strings.text: こんなものは本当の救いじゃない、園田の告げる救いも虚構に過ぎないと理解してしまった。
strings.translated: This was not true salvation; Sonoda's promised salvation was nothing but a fiction.

strings.text: それは、もしかすると不幸なことだったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: That may have been an unfortunate thing.

strings.text: 気づかなければ、私も他の連中と同じようにかりそめの幸せに浸ることができたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: If I had never realized it, perhaps I too could have soaked in a borrowed happiness like all the others.

strings.text: だけど、疑念を抱き、気づいてしまってからは、それをなにも考えずに受け入れてしまうことに抵抗が少なからずあった。
strings.translated: But once I harbored doubts and saw through it, I felt no small resistance to accepting it all without thinking.

strings.text: それでも救いが、本当の意味での救いが欲しかった。
strings.translated: Even so, I wanted salvation -- salvation in the truest sense.

strings.text: 安らげる時間と場所、そして、充実感を得られること。
strings.translated: A time and place where I could rest, and a sense of fulfillment.

strings.text: クラブのみんなは救いの虚像に満足して、その中にとどまってしまってるから、相対して私が孤立し、孤独になってしまうのも仕方ないことだった。
strings.translated: Everyone in the Club was satisfied with the illusion of salvation and stayed within it -- so it was only natural that I, standing apart from them, became isolated and alone.

strings.text: でも、私が救われたと思ったことも事実だ。
strings.translated: But it is also true that I believed I had been saved.

strings.text: そして、その救いを求めてしまっていることも否定しきることはできずにいた
strings.translated: And I could not fully deny that I was still reaching for that salvation.

strings.text: 自分の行くべき場所が見つけられないまま、私はいつの間にかいかがわしさを漂わせる場所へとたどり着いていた。
strings.translated: Without finding the place I was supposed to go, I had wandered without realizing it into a part of the city that reeked of seediness.

strings.text: 夜のホテル街なんかに来たのは初めてだ。
strings.translated: It was my first time in a hotel district at night.

strings.text: 周りには今から明らかにセックスをしようとしてる男女が歩いていて、なんともいえない嫌悪感をつのらせていく。
strings.translated: Around me, couples who were clearly about to have sex walked by, and an indescribable sense of revulsion built inside me.

strings.text: 彼らも性の快楽に溺れて、自分が救われたと感じている人種なんだろうか。
strings.translated: Were they also the kind of people who drowned in sexual pleasure and felt themselves saved by it?

strings.text: あるいは、そういう場所にこそ、真の救いの扉とかいうものが隠されていたりするんだろうか
strings.translated: Or could it be that in a place like this, something like the door to true salvation was actually hidden?

strings.text: 試してみる価値はあるかもしれない。
strings.translated: It might be worth trying.

strings.text: 適当にその辺を歩いている男に声をかけて、ホテルに誘ってみるのもいいかもしれない。
strings.translated: It might not be a bad idea to call out to some random man walking by and invite him to a hotel.

strings.text: なにかが得られれば、それは今の私にとってなんらかの収穫にもなるだろう。
strings.translated: If I could get something out of it, it would at least be some kind of gain for me right now.

strings.text: こうやって、宛てもなく街をさ迷っているよりは、ずっと有意義な時間にできるかもしれない
strings.translated: It might be a far more worthwhile use of my time than wandering the streets aimlessly like this.

strings.text: 紗英子「苦し紛れね…」
strings.translated: Saeko「Desperation talking...」

strings.text: こんな思考がまともなはずはない。
strings.translated: There was no way this kind of thinking was sane.

strings.text: 意識しないようにしても、つい意識してしまう「真の救いの扉」
strings.translated: No matter how much I tried not to think about it, I kept coming back to it -- the "door to true salvation" --

strings.text: へのヒントも見つけられなくて、半分自暴自棄になってるだけだ。
strings.translated: I couldn't find even a hint of it, and I was just half-surrendering to recklessness.

strings.text: もちろん見知らぬ男と身体を交わらせることでなにも得られないとはいいきれなかったし、少し身体と心を休めたくなっていたのも事実だった。
strings.translated: Of course, I couldn't say with certainty that sleeping with a strange man would yield nothing -- and it was also true that I had been wanting to give my body and mind a little rest.

strings.text: もう、相手は誰でもいい。
strings.translated: At this point, it didn't matter who the other person was.

strings.text: 私を満足させてくれれば、それで構わない。
strings.translated: As long as he could satisfy me, that would be enough.

strings.text: ただ、せっかく自分から誘うんだったら、それなりに好ましい相手のほうがいい、とは思った
strings.translated: Still, if I was going to be the one doing the inviting, I thought it would be better to have someone at least somewhat agreeable.

strings.text: 紗英子「誰か…良さそうなのは
strings.translated: Saeko「Someone... who looks decent enough.

strings.text: 紗英子「…？」
strings.translated: Saeko「...?」

strings.text: まるで物色するように辺りを見回していた時、私は視界の端にあるモノを見つけた。
strings.translated: I was scanning my surroundings as if browsing for merchandise when I caught sight of something at the edge of my vision.

strings.text: 正確には、それはモノではなくて人間だった。
strings.translated: To be precise, it wasn't a something -- it was a someone.

strings.text: 古びた薄い服を着て、手入れのされてない汚らしい姿をした男。
strings.translated: A man wearing worn, thin clothing, unkempt and filthy in appearance.

strings.text: 人生の落伍者としか思えない彼に、私はなぜだか目を奪われてしまっていた
strings.translated: He looked like nothing but a dropout from life, and yet for some reason I couldn't take my eyes off him.

strings.text: 無意識のうちに、ごくりと息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: Without thinking, I swallowed hard.

strings.text: 胸の内が熱くなって、心臓の鼓動が早鐘を打つのが感じ取れる。
strings.translated: A warmth spread through my chest, and I could feel my heartbeat quickening into a rapid drumming.

strings.text: どうして、こんな感覚を抱いてしまうのだろう？
strings.translated: Why was I feeling something like this?

strings.text: なにかの間違いではないのか…？
strings.translated: Surely this had to be some kind of mistake...?

strings.text: 頭の中で様々なことを考えてみた。
strings.translated: I turned various thoughts over in my mind.

strings.text: でも、私の身体と衝動はまるで頭の中の疑問を抑えつけてしまうように高揚していく
strings.translated: But my body and my impulses surged with excitement, as if to suppress all the questions in my head.

strings.text: 紗英子「浮浪者…」
strings.translated: Saeko「A vagrant...」

strings.text: 当たり前の話だけど、彼にはなんの魅力も感じなかった。
strings.translated: Needless to say, I felt no attraction to him whatsoever.

strings.text: 汚い。
strings.translated: Dirty.

strings.text: 臭そう。
strings.translated: He probably smelled.

strings.text: 頭だってよくはないだろう。
strings.translated: He couldn't be very bright, either.

strings.text: そんな否定的な感想しか抱くことができなかった。
strings.translated: Those were the only negative impressions I could form of him.

strings.text: それなのに、私はその浮浪者をじっと見続けてしまった。
strings.translated: And yet, I kept staring at that vagrant.

strings.text: このまま通り過ぎて彼と別れることが、なんだかとてももったいないことのように感じてしまえる。
strings.translated: Walking past him and parting ways felt, somehow, like an unbearable waste.

strings.text: …彼にはどんな人生があったんだろう？
strings.translated: What kind of life had he lived?

strings.text: どうして、浮浪者なんかになってしまったんだろう？
strings.translated: How had he ended up as a vagrant?

strings.text: 観察しているだけでは、その答えにはたどり着けない。
strings.translated: Just watching him from a distance would never lead me to those answers.

strings.text: きっと一言二言では語れない人生の凋落の過程が、そこにはあるはずだ。
strings.translated: Surely there was a process of decline behind him -- one that couldn't be told in a word or two.

strings.text: 私とは全然違う転落してしまった人生が
strings.translated: A fallen life so utterly different from my own.

strings.text: 紗英子「ねぇ、そこのあなた」
strings.translated: Saeko「Hey, you there.」

strings.text: 浮浪者「ああ？」
strings.translated: Vagrant「Huh?」

strings.text: 私に声をかけられて、浮浪者の男は疲れたように顔を上げた。
strings.translated: When I called out to him, the vagrant tiredly lifted his face.

strings.text: 生気の無い表情だ。
strings.translated: His expression was hollow, devoid of life.

strings.text: この人に生きてる意味があるのか？
strings.translated: Was there any meaning left in this person's existence?

strings.text: そんな行き過ぎているとも思える疑問さえ感じてしまう。
strings.translated: Even a question as extreme as that crossed my mind.

strings.text: 浮浪者「何だぁ？
strings.translated: Vagrant「What is it?

strings.text: 紗英子「少し…私と話をしない？」
strings.translated: Saeko「Would you... talk with me for a bit?」

strings.text: 浮浪者「話ぃ？」
strings.translated: Vagrant「Talk?」

strings.text: 突然話しかけてきた私に、浮浪者は明らかな疑いの目を向けた。
strings.translated: The vagrant fixed me with an obvious look of suspicion when I suddenly spoke to him.

strings.text: もしかすると、浮浪者にちょっかいを出して暴行を加えようとする連中だと思われたのかもしれない。
strings.translated: He may have thought I was one of those people who pick on vagrants and assault them.

strings.text: でも、警戒する彼を油断させるのはそんなに難しいことじゃなかった。
strings.translated: But making him drop his guard wasn't that difficult.

strings.text: スカートを少しめくり上げるだけで、彼の態度は目に見えて変わった
strings.translated: All it took was lifting my skirt a little, and his attitude visibly changed.

strings.text: 紗英子「私、あなたにしか相談できないことがあるの。
strings.translated: Saeko「There's something I can only talk to you about.

strings.text: 良かったら話を聞いてくれない？」
strings.translated: Would you be willing to hear me out?」

strings.text: 浮浪者「…話を聞くなら、この奥でだ」
strings.translated: Vagrant「...If you want me to listen, it'll be back there.」

strings.text: 路地の奥を顎でさして、浮浪者は口元に小さな笑みを浮かべた。
strings.translated: He jerked his chin toward the back of the alley, and a small smile crept across the vagrant's lips.

strings.text: ビルとビルの隙間。
strings.translated: The gap between two buildings.

strings.text: 暗くて何も見えない。
strings.translated: Dark -- nothing visible.

strings.text: でも、その先には公園があったはずだ。
strings.translated: But there should have been a park beyond it.

strings.text: あまり人気のない公園…。
strings.translated: A park that didn't see much foot traffic...

strings.text: そんな場所に見知らぬ浮浪者と一緒に行くのはとても危険なことだとは思ったけど、私は自分を抑えることができなかった。
strings.translated: Going to a place like that with a strange vagrant was something I knew to be terribly dangerous -- but I couldn't stop myself.

strings.text: なるようになればいい。
strings.translated: Whatever happens, happens.

strings.text: 浮浪者に襲われるのなら、それこそ望むところだ。
strings.translated: If I was going to be attacked by a vagrant, that was exactly what I wanted.

strings.text: 私にとっての救いはなんなのか、それをちゃんと確かめられるかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps I could finally confirm for myself what salvation truly meant for me.

strings.text: 私にもあるはずの救いを、その先にあるという真の救いの扉を、それを早く自分の手にしたかった。
strings.translated: The salvation that should exist for me too, the door to true salvation said to lie beyond -- I wanted to take hold of it as soon as possible.

strings.text: そのためだったら、少し位の危険には怯もうとも逃げようともしない
strings.translated: For that, I would neither flinch nor flee from a little danger.

strings.text: 獣の檻にでも入ったような強烈な匂い。
strings.translated: An overwhelming smell, like stepping into a cage of beasts.

strings.text: 一瞬こんなところにのこのこやって来たことに後悔したけれど、それも本当に一瞬だった。
strings.translated: For a moment I regretted coming to a place like this so carelessly -- but it really was only a moment.

strings.text: 普通なら我慢できないこんな匂いも、１度思いきり胸に吸い込んでしまえば、私の中ももうその同じ獣の匂いで一杯になってしまう。
strings.translated: An odor like this would normally be unbearable, but once I breathed it in deeply, my own lungs filled with that same animal smell.

strings.text: そうすると、その臭ささえたちまち快感に変わっていく。
strings.translated: And then even the stench quickly transformed into pleasure.

strings.text: ホームレスＡ「ほ、本当に、いいのか？」

strings.translated: Because they taught me how to dominate my partner and control the sex, being with anyone wasn't painful at all.

strings.text: 自分の快感を追い求めればそれでいい。
strings.translated: All I had to do was pursue my own pleasure.

strings.text: それを楽しむことができれば、相手が今日みたいな中年でも全然構わなかった。
strings.translated: As long as I could enjoy that, it didn't matter at all if my partner was a middle-aged man like today.

strings.text: それにしても面白かったのは、湯沢さん達の態度だ。
strings.translated: What was interesting, though, was the attitude of Yuzawa and the others.

strings.text: 売春が終わって、良い機会を与えてくれたことに対するお礼を言うと、気持ち悪そうな表情をしながら去っていった。
strings.translated: When the prostitution was over and I thanked them for giving me such a good opportunity, they left with looks of disgust on their faces.

strings.text: 私のことが理解できなくて、困惑してるみたいだった。
strings.translated: They seemed confused, unable to understand me at all.

strings.text: 何か捨てゼリフは吐いてたけど、虚勢を張ってるのは間違いない。
strings.translated: They did throw out some parting words, but there was no doubt they were just putting on a brave front.

strings.text: そんな彼女達のことも、私は哀れにしか思うことができなかった。
strings.translated: I could only feel pity for girls like them.

strings.text: やっぱりあのクラブはすごい。
strings.translated: That Club really is something else.

strings.text: 人間関係をこんなに変えてしまうなんて、今までは想像もできなかったことだ。
strings.translated: That something like this could change my relationships with people so completely -- it was something I never could have imagined before.

strings.text: 私は救われた。
strings.translated: I was saved.

strings.text: いじめられなくなったのではなくて、いじめられても苦痛に感じることがなくなった。
strings.translated: It's not that the bullying stopped -- it's that even when I am bullied, I no longer feel any pain from it.

strings.text: それこそが、真の救いだって今ならはっきりと理解できる。
strings.translated: That, I can now say with certainty, is what true salvation really is.

strings.text: 救われて、一歩先へと進んで、本当の幸せを手に入れることができた。
strings.translated: I was saved, took a step forward, and was able to obtain real happiness.

strings.text: だからこそ、この幸せを湯沢さん達にも理解して欲しいんだけど
strings.translated: And that's exactly why I want Yuzawa-san and the others to understand this happiness too --

strings.text: 心音「そっか。
strings.translated: Kokone「I see.

strings.text: そのために、学校に行けばいいんだ」
strings.translated: So that's why I should go to school.」

strings.text: 私自身にとってはもう時間の無駄でしかない学校。
strings.translated: School -- something that's nothing but a waste of time for me personally.

strings.text: でも、湯沢さん達を救うためなら、確かにまだ行く価値はあるかもしれない
strings.translated: But if it's to save Yuzawa-san and the others, maybe it really is still worth going...

strings.text: 心音「みんなで幸せになればいいのに」
strings.translated: Kokone「I wish everyone could just be happy together.」

strings.text: 最近は本当にそう思う。
strings.translated: Lately, I really do feel that way.

strings.text: みんなで笑い合うことができれば、自然といじめなんてなくなっていくと思うのに…。
strings.translated: If everyone could laugh together, I think bullying would naturally disappear on its own...

strings.text: そもそも、湯沢さん達がいじめをするのも、他に幸せだと感じることがないからだ。
strings.translated: In the first place, the reason Yuzawa-san and the others bully is because they have nothing else in their lives that feels like happiness.

strings.text: 他に幸せなことがあれば、いじめなんてしようと思わないはずなのだ。
strings.translated: If they had other things that made them happy, they wouldn't even think about bullying.

strings.text: それなのに、彼女達にはそれしか喜びがないから虚しい行為で自分を慰めることしかできない。
strings.translated: And yet, because that's the only joy they have, they can only console themselves with hollow acts.

strings.text: そんなのは救いでも何でもないのに、虚しい行為に救いを求めている。
strings.translated: Even though there's no salvation in that whatsoever, they keep seeking salvation in hollow acts.

strings.text: 今日のことで、私はより一層確信を持つことができた
strings.translated: Through what happened today, I was able to feel an even stronger conviction.

strings.text: 心音「私が救ってあげなきゃ」
strings.translated: Kokone「I have to be the one to save them.」

strings.text: もしかすると、これは運命というものなのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Perhaps this is what they call fate.

strings.text: 私が湯沢さん達にいじめられてたのは、彼女達を救ってあげるためだったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe the reason Yuzawa-san and the others bullied me was so that I could save them.

strings.text: そう考えると、全部辻褄が合う。
strings.translated: When I think of it that way, everything falls into place.

strings.text: 全ては最初から決まってた事で、私は試練を乗り越えたんだ
strings.translated: It was all decided from the very beginning, and I overcame my trials.

strings.text: 美桜「すごいわ、戸田さん」
strings.translated: Mio「That's remarkable, Toda-san.」

strings.text: クラブの少女Ｂ「まだ来たばかりなのに、救いに対する理解が本当に深いのね」
strings.translated: Club Woman B「You've only just arrived, and yet your understanding of salvation is truly profound.」

strings.text: クラブの少女Ｃ「本当に素晴らしいわ。
strings.translated: Club Woman C「It really is wonderful.

strings.text: こうやってみんなが幸せになっていくのは本当にいいものね
strings.translated: Watching everyone find happiness like this... it truly is a beautiful thing.」

strings.text: クラブではみんなから褒められた。
strings.translated: Everyone at the Club praised me.

strings.text: あまりにも褒められすぎて、嬉しさと恥ずかしさから私はすごくハイテンションになってしまった。
strings.translated: I was praised so much that the joy and embarrassment sent me into a complete high.

strings.text: こんな幸せは、今まで味わったことがない。
strings.translated: I had never experienced happiness like this before.

strings.text: 誰かから認められるって言うのは、なんて素晴らしいんだろう。
strings.translated: Being recognized by someone -- just how wonderful a thing is that.

strings.text: クラブに通うようになって以来、私の周りは常に笑顔で満たされていた。
strings.translated: Ever since I started coming to the Club, my surroundings were always filled with smiling faces.

strings.text: みんなに感謝しよう。
strings.translated: I should be grateful to everyone.

strings.text: 全ての人に感謝しよう。
strings.translated: I should be grateful to all people.

strings.text: 湯沢さん達にだって感謝しよう。
strings.translated: I should even be grateful to Yuzawa-san and the others.

strings.text: そうすれば、きっともっと幸せになれるから…。
strings.translated: Because if I do, I'm sure I can become even happier...

strings.text: 幸せになるために、生きようって思うことができるから…。
strings.translated: Because it lets me feel like I want to live, in order to find happiness...

strings.text: クラブの少女Ｂ「あら…？」
strings.translated: Club Woman B「Oh...?」

strings.text: 見覚えのある人が入ってきた。
strings.translated: Someone familiar walked in.

strings.text: 以前、クラブの部屋の前で騒いでた人だ。
strings.translated: It was the person who had been making a scene in front of the Club room before.

strings.text: 確か、神村先輩のお友達だって聞いたけど
strings.translated: I believe I heard she was a friend of Kamimura-senpai's...

strings.text: 心音「もしかして、あの人も救われたいのかな…」
strings.translated: Kokone「I wonder... maybe she wants to be saved too...」

strings.text: 仲間がどんどん増えていく。
strings.translated: More and more companions keep joining.

strings.text: 救われる人が増えていく。
strings.translated: More and more people are being saved.

strings.text: そのことに、私は大きな喜びを感じていた。
strings.translated: I felt a deep joy in that.

strings.text: 本当の幸せがどういうものか、毎日理解を深めていくことができた
strings.translated: Every day I was able to deepen my understanding of what true happiness really is.

strings.text: 廊下を歩いていると、白坂君から声をかけられた
strings.translated: As I was walking down the hallway, Shirasaka called out to me.

strings.text: 突然の話に、私は嫌なものを感じずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: The sudden news left me unable to shake a sense of unease.

strings.text: 彼が大事な話なんて、今までにはなかった。
strings.translated: Him having something important to say -- that had never happened before.

strings.text: いったい何の話なんだろう
strings.translated: I wonder what it could possibly be about.

strings.text: 何のこと？」
strings.translated: What is this about?」

strings.text: 部活のこと？
strings.translated: Something about club activities?

strings.text: なんで白坂君が、私に？
strings.translated: Why would Shirasaka-kun come to me with this?

strings.text: 星野さんもあそこに行ったんだろ？」
strings.translated: Hoshino-san went there too, didn't she?」

strings.text: 愛から。
strings.translated: From Ai.

strings.text: あそこ…。
strings.translated: That place...

strings.text: それで、白坂君が何の話をしているのかに気が付いた
strings.translated: And with that, I realized what Shirasaka-kun was talking about.

strings.text: 円夏「愛から…」
strings.translated: Madoka「From Ai...」
Ai...

strings.text: 私があそこに行ったことを、白坂君に話したんだ
strings.translated: She told Shirasaka-kun that I had gone there.

strings.text: それならいいんだ
strings.translated: That's fine then.」

strings.text: 数十分後、私はクラブのビルの前に立っていた。
strings.translated: Several dozen minutes later, I was standing in front of the Club's building.

strings.text: 頭ではいけないってわかってるのに、私はまたこの場所に来てしまった。
strings.translated: My head knew I shouldn't come here, yet I had come to this place again.

strings.text: 危険なところだって理解してるはずなのに、もう一度来ずにはいられなかった。
strings.translated: I understood it was a dangerous place -- and yet I couldn't stop myself from coming one more time.

strings.text: だって仕方ない。
strings.translated: But I couldn't help it.

strings.text: 愛が関わってるんだから、それを見て見ぬふりはできない。
strings.translated: Ai was involved, so I couldn't just look the other way.

strings.text: 愛が来てたら連れ帰ろう。
strings.translated: If Ai was here, I would take her home.

strings.text: 来てなかったらすぐに逃げよう。
strings.translated: If she wasn't, I would leave immediately.

strings.text: そんな事を考えて、私はビルの中に入って行った
strings.translated: Thinking such things, I walked into the building.

strings.text: ビルの廊下は、相変わらず誰の姿もなかった。
strings.translated: The hallway of the building was, as always, completely empty.

strings.text: しんと静まり返っていて、人の気配と言うものがない。
strings.translated: Dead silent, with no sign of any human presence.

strings.text: もしかすると、部屋でセックスしたりもするから、あまり人気のないビルを使っているのだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe because they sometimes had sex in the rooms here, they used a building that didn't see much foot traffic.

strings.text: こういう事には詳しくないけど、それならクラブのあるフロアしか人がいないのも納得できた
strings.translated: I didn't know much about these things, but that would explain why there were only people on the floor where the Club was.

strings.text: 円夏「この階、だよね」
strings.translated: Madoka「This is the floor, right?」

strings.text: クラブのあるフロアまでやってきて、私は自然と耳を澄ませた。
strings.translated: When I reached the floor where the Club was, I naturally found myself straining my ears.

strings.text: やっぱり、この階だけは人の話し声とかが聞こえてくる。
strings.translated: Sure enough, only this floor had the sound of people talking drifting out.

strings.text: 既に誰かがセックスもしてるみたいで、微かな女の人の喘ぎ声が確認できた
strings.translated: It seemed like someone was already having sex, and I could just barely make out the faint sound of a woman's moaning.

strings.text: 部屋のドアを見つめてごくりと息を呑む。
strings.translated: I stared at the door and swallowed hard.

strings.text: 自分のやるべき事を、頭の中でもう一度繰り返した。
strings.translated: I ran through what I needed to do one more time in my head.

strings.text: 私の目的は、愛を助け出すこと。
strings.translated: My goal was to rescue Ai.

strings.text: もしも、部屋の中に愛がいたら、すぐに外に連れ出すこと。
strings.translated: If Ai was inside the room, I would get her out immediately.

strings.text: だから、まずはそっとドアを開けて、隙間から中の様子を伺えばいい。
strings.translated: So all I had to do was quietly open the door and peek through the gap to see what was going on inside.

strings.text: そうして、愛がいるかどうかを確認してから、次の行動を決めればいい
strings.translated: Then, after confirming whether Ai was there or not, I could decide what to do next.

strings.text: 円夏「大丈夫…大丈夫…」
strings.translated: Madoka「It's okay... it's okay...」

strings.text: 自分に言い聞かせながら、ゆっくりとドアノブに触れる。
strings.translated: Telling myself that, I slowly reached for the doorknob.

strings.text: そして、それを静かに回して…私は、そのドアを開けた
strings.translated: Then I turned it quietly... and opened the door.

strings.text: クラブの部屋の中に入って、私はまずそこで足を止めた。
strings.translated: I stepped inside the Club's room and stopped in my tracks right there.

strings.text: この時点で、頭の中で考えていた計画とは違うけど、そんなものはどうでも良かった。
strings.translated: At this point, things had already diverged from the plan I had worked out in my head -- but that didn't matter.

strings.text: 最終的な目的さえ達成できればいい。
strings.translated: As long as I could achieve the final goal, that was enough.

strings.text: 愛を助け出すことができれば、細かい部分にはこだわらない。
strings.translated: As long as I could get Ai out, I wouldn't worry about the details.

strings.text: ただ、ドアの前で立ち尽くした私には、部屋の中にいた人達の視線が一斉にそそがれていた。
strings.translated: But standing frozen in the doorway, I felt the gazes of everyone in the room fall on me all at once.

strings.text: 私のことを、ほとんどの人が不思議そうな表情で見ていた。
strings.translated: Almost everyone was looking at me with puzzled expressions.

strings.text: 部外者がいったい何をしに来たのか。
strings.translated: What on earth had an outsider come here for?

strings.text: そんなところで突っ立ってどうしたのか。
strings.translated: What was she doing just standing there like that?

strings.text: クラブの人達の頭に浮かんだのは、きっとそんな疑問だろう
strings.translated: Those were surely the questions running through the minds of the Club's people.

strings.text: ごくりと息を呑んで、部屋の中を見回す。
strings.translated: I swallowed hard and looked around the room.

strings.text: 幸いにしてと言うべきか、愛の姿はどこにも見当たらなかった。
strings.translated: For better or worse, Ai was nowhere to be found.

strings.text: これで用事は終わり。
strings.translated: That meant my business here was done.

strings.text: すぐに逃げなければ、何をされるかわからない。
strings.translated: I had to get out fast before something was done to me.

strings.text: それこそ、あっという間に捕まってしまって、この前のような事にならないとも知れなかった
strings.translated: If I didn't, I might be caught in an instant and end up in the same situation as before.

strings.text: 円夏「し、失礼しました」
strings.translated: Madoka「S-sorry to disturb you」

strings.text: ぺこりと頭を下げて、私は部屋のドアを閉めようとした。
strings.translated: I gave a small bow and moved to close the door.

strings.text: これ以上、ここにいる理由はない。
strings.translated: There was no reason to stay here any longer.

strings.text: 早く逃げて、早く安全なところまでいこう。
strings.translated: I needed to get away quickly and reach somewhere safe.

strings.text: そう思ってるはずなのに、私は何故だかドアを閉めることができなかった。
strings.translated: That was what I was telling myself -- and yet, for some reason, I couldn't bring myself to close the door.

strings.text: 体が動かない。
strings.translated: My body wouldn't move.

strings.text: まるで、部屋の中の何かに引きつけられているようなそんな感じだった。
strings.translated: It was as if something inside the room was pulling me in.

strings.text: これからどうしよう。
strings.translated: What should I do now?

strings.text: 私はどうすればいいんだろう。
strings.translated: What am I supposed to do?

strings.text: 危険な場所を目の前にして、私は体を動かすことができない。
strings.translated: Standing right in front of a dangerous place, I couldn't make my body move.

strings.text: 逃げることができないのではなく、体が逃げようとしていなかったこんなのは認めたくない。
strings.translated: It wasn't that I couldn't run -- my body simply wasn't trying to run. I didn't want to admit that.

strings.text: 私の意思じゃないって思いたかったけど、時間が経てば経つほどに現実の波が襲い掛かってきた。
strings.translated: I wanted to believe it wasn't my own will, but the longer time passed, the more the reality of it crashed over me.

strings.text: やっぱり、私はこの場所が忘れられなかったんだ。
strings.translated: After all, I hadn't been able to forget this place.

strings.text: あんな思いをしたのに、心のどこかでもう一度求めてしまっていた。
strings.translated: Even after everything I had felt here, some part of my heart had been longing to come back.

strings.text: こんなの絶対変なはずなのに、体は欲望か何かに忠実に動いてしまっている。
strings.translated: It was absolutely wrong -- and yet my body was moving faithfully in service of some desire or other.

strings.text: ここにとどまりたい。
strings.translated: I wanted to stay here.

strings.text: それが、私の中の隠された本音だった
strings.translated: That was the hidden truth buried inside me.

strings.text: 園田「やあ、また来てくれたのか
strings.translated: Sonoda「Well, you've come back again.」

strings.text: どうしようかと迷っていると、この間の男に声をかけられた。
strings.translated: While I stood there wavering over what to do, the man from before called out to me.

strings.text: 確かこのクラブの一番偉い人。
strings.translated: The one who was, if I remembered right, the most important person in this Club.

strings.text: そして、怖い人。
strings.translated: And someone frightening.

strings.text: 以前、私を捕まえるように命令したのも、この人だった
strings.translated: This was the person who had ordered them to restrain me before.

strings.text: 園田「さあ、遠慮はしないで。
strings.translated: Sonoda「Come now, don't be shy.

strings.text: こっちに入りなさい
strings.translated: Come on inside.」

strings.text: 円夏「あ、でも…私
strings.translated: Madoka「Ah, but... I...」

strings.text: 園田「美桜君、彼女にお茶を
strings.translated: Sonoda「Mio-kun, some tea for our guest, please.」

strings.text: 園田に背中を押されて、私は部屋の奥に押し込まれた。
strings.translated: Pushed along by Sonoda, I was ushered deeper into the room.

strings.text: また、前回みたいなことになってしまうんだろうか
strings.translated: Is this going to turn into the same thing as last time?

strings.text: 園田「よく来てくれたね。
strings.translated: Sonoda「I'm glad you came.

strings.text: 君には、もっとクラブのことを理解して欲しいと思っていたんだ
strings.translated: I was hoping you'd come to understand the Club a little better.」

strings.text: 園田「あの時はやむを得ずああいった形になってしまったが…今日はゆっくりと過ごしていってくれたまえ
strings.translated: Sonoda「Last time things ended up the way they did out of necessity... but today, please take your time and relax.」

strings.text: 私の予想とは裏腹に、園田はすごく優しくしてくれた。
strings.translated: Contrary to my expectations, Sonoda was incredibly kind to me.

strings.text: 園田だけでなく、クラブの人達も親しげに私に声をかけてくれた。
strings.translated: Not just Sonoda -- the Club members too spoke to me in a friendly, familiar way.

strings.text: 最初の時とは全然違う雰囲気。
strings.translated: The atmosphere was completely different from the first time.

strings.text: 私を犯した人もいるのに、まるで気にした様子もなく声をかけてきた。
strings.translated: Even the people who had violated me showed no sign of caring about that at all as they came to talk to me.

strings.text: 普通じゃないのはわかる。
strings.translated: I knew it wasn't normal.

strings.text: あんな事をしておいて、それが無かったかのように接してくるのだから、この人達がまともじゃないのは明らかだった。
strings.translated: Having done what they did and then acting as if it never happened -- it was obvious these people weren't right in the head.

strings.text: でも、不思議と嫌な気はしない。
strings.translated: And yet, strangely, I didn't feel bad about it.

strings.text: あんな事をされておきながら、私は彼らと話をするのが決して嫌ではなかった
strings.translated: Even after what had been done to me, I genuinely didn't mind talking with them.

strings.text: 円夏「あのっ、すみません！
strings.translated: Madoka「Um, excuse me!」

strings.text: 園田「うん？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Hmm?

strings.text: 何かな？
strings.translated: I wonder what she wants.

strings.text: 円夏「あの…愛は、ここは長いんですか？
strings.translated: Madoka「Um... has Ai been coming here long?」

strings.text: 園田「わりと長いほうだが…彼女とは、そういう話をしなかったのかい？
strings.translated: Sonoda「She's been around for quite a while... didn't she talk to you about any of that?」

strings.text: 円夏「何だか…話をするのも怖かったんで…」
strings.translated: Madoka「Somehow... I was scared to even talk to you...」

strings.text: 今のところ、クラブの話どころか、それ以外の話も愛とはできていない。
strings.translated: Right now, I hadn't been able to talk to Ai about anything -- let alone about the Club.

strings.text: 顔を合わせるのも躊躇ってしまって、今日は愛の教室に行かなかった。
strings.translated: I even hesitated to face her, and today I hadn't gone to Ai's classroom at all.

strings.text: こんな事じゃダメだって思ってるんだけど、自分の気持ちを簡単に切り替えることはできなかった
strings.translated: I knew this wasn't okay, but I couldn't just switch my feelings off so easily.

strings.text: 美桜「先生、お茶をご用意しました
strings.translated: Mio「Sensei, I've prepared your tea.」

strings.text: 園田「ああ、ありがとう
strings.translated: Sonoda「Ah, thank you.」

strings.text: 園田「さぁ、どうぞ
strings.translated: Sonoda「Here, please.」

strings.text: 円夏「は、はい
strings.translated: Madoka「Y-yes.」

strings.text: 園田「愛君とは、ずっと仲の良い友達だったのかな？
strings.translated: Sonoda「Have you and Ai-kun been close friends for a long time?」
