strings.translated: But if things stayed like this, my breath would stop and I might die too...

strings.text: まるで、おしっこに溺れたみたいになって
strings.translated: It was like drowning in pee.

strings.text: 愛（やだ…死にたくないっ…死にたく…ないよぅ…）だとしたら…方法はひとつしかなかった
strings.translated: (Ai) *I don't want this... I don't want to die... I don't want... to die...* In that case... there was only one way.

strings.text: 愛「んぐ、んぐぐ…っ、ごくっ…ごくっ…ごきゅ…っ」
strings.translated: Ai「Nguh, ngugh... gulp... gulp... gulp...」

strings.text: なんとか息ができるようになるために全部飲み込んでしまう。
strings.translated: I swallowed all of it just to be able to breathe again.

strings.text: それしか…生きる方法なんて思いつかなかった。
strings.translated: That was the only way... the only way I could think of to stay alive.

strings.text: 父「そうだ、その調子だ。
strings.translated: Father「That's it, that's the way.

strings.text: やればできるじゃないか
strings.translated: See, you can do it when you try.」

strings.text: 愛「んぐっ…ごくっ…ごくっ…ごくっ…」
strings.translated: Ai「Nguh... gulp... gulp... gulp...」

strings.text: 鼻の穴から、ノドから回ったおしっこが垂れ落ちる。
strings.translated: Pee that had gone up through my nostrils and down my throat dripped back out.

strings.text: つんとする痛みも、鼻が曲がってしまいそうな匂いも…いまはどうでもいい
strings.translated: The stinging pain, the smell that made my nose want to curl... none of it mattered right now.

strings.text: 愛（死にたくない…死にたくないっ…！
strings.translated: (Ai) *I don't want to die... I don't want to die...!*

strings.text: ）それだけを考えて、わたしはおしっこを飲み込んでいった
strings.translated: ） Thinking only that, I kept swallowing the pee.

strings.text: 学校では少し予想外の事が起こった。
strings.translated: Something slightly unexpected happened at school.

strings.text: 私のクラスに、白坂大智が転校してきたのだ。
strings.translated: Daichi Shiraka transferred into my class.

strings.text: 同じ学校になることは知っていたけど、まさかクラスメイトになるとは思っていなかった。
strings.translated: I had known we'd be at the same school, but I never imagined we'd end up as classmates.

strings.text: でも、これは幸運なこと。
strings.translated: Still, this was fortunate.

strings.text: これからのことを考えると、白坂大智とクラスメイトになれたのは、私にとって理想的な展開だった
strings.translated: Thinking about what lay ahead, having Daichi Shiraka as a classmate was an ideal development for me.

strings.text: 実際、白坂大智とはすぐに話ができる関係になった。
strings.translated: In fact, Daichi Shiraka and I were able to talk easily right away.

strings.text: 引越してきた初日に出会っていたことが、いい効果をもたらしてくれた。
strings.translated: Having met on the very day he moved in had worked in my favor.

strings.text: 彼は話しやすい人間だったし、警戒心も薄いため、様々な情報を聞き出すことができた。
strings.translated: He was easy to talk to, and his guard was low, so I was able to draw out all kinds of information.

strings.text: 家族のこと、これまでの生活のこと、家での過ごし方。
strings.translated: About his family, his life up until now, how he spent his time at home.

strings.text: そして、特に聞いてもいないのに、彼はよく自分のことを喋ってくれた。
strings.translated: And even without me particularly asking, he would often talk about himself.

strings.text: 私に対して、明らかな好意があるようだった
strings.translated: He clearly had feelings for me.

strings.text: たぶん、彼は幸せに育った人間なのだろう。
strings.translated: He was probably someone who had grown up happy.

strings.text: 相手を疑うこともないため、私のこともただのクラスメイトだと思っているのだろう。
strings.translated: Because he didn't suspect others, he likely saw me as just another classmate.

strings.text: 私にとっては、都合の良い人間だった。
strings.translated: For me, he was a convenient person.

strings.text: 扱いやすくて、話しやすくて、色々な意味で使えそうな人間だった。
strings.translated: Easy to handle, easy to talk to, and useful in a variety of ways.

strings.text: 彼のような人を、善良な人間って言うのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Someone like him might be called a good person.

strings.text: 良くも悪くも、ごく普通の人。
strings.translated: For better or worse, a perfectly ordinary person.

strings.text: 彼のことを知れば知るほどに、私の評価はそこに落ち着いていった。
strings.translated: The more I learned about him, the more my assessment settled on exactly that.

strings.text: まさか彼がクラブに関わって来るなんて、この時の私は想像もしていなかった
strings.translated: At the time, I never imagined he would become involved with the Club.

strings.text: 放課後、クラブに行くと白坂美桜の姿があった。
strings.translated: After school, when I went to the Club, Mio Shiraka was there.

strings.text: 隣には小野田さんもいて、どうやら上手く接触できたらしかった
strings.translated: Yuka Onoda was beside her, and it seemed the approach had gone smoothly.

strings.text: 美桜「本当にこんなところがあるんだ」
strings.translated: Mio「So a place like this really exists.」

strings.text: クラブに来た白坂美桜は、最初はとても驚いていた。
strings.translated: Mio Shiraka, upon arriving at the Club, was very surprised at first.

strings.text: クラブの存在は半信半疑だったようで、期待と不安の色を顔に浮かべていた
strings.translated: She had apparently been half-skeptical about the Club's existence, and her face showed a mix of hope and anxiety.

strings.text: そんなに緊張しなくていいから。
strings.translated: You don't have to be so nervous.

strings.text: 園田先生も、そう言ってたでしょ？
strings.translated: Sonoda-sensei said the same thing, didn't she?」

strings.text: 美桜「それはそうだけど…でも、本当に何をしてもいいの？
strings.translated: Mio「I know, but... is it really okay to do anything?」

strings.text: 友佳「何をしてもいいの。
strings.translated: Yuka「You can do anything you want.

strings.text: 自分のしたいことをするのが、ここの決まりなんだから」
strings.translated: Doing what you want to do is the rule here.」

strings.text: まるで、部活の先輩のように、小野田さんはちょっと偉そうに白坂美桜に説明していた。
strings.translated: Like a senior club member, Yuka explained things to Mio Shiraka with a slightly superior air.

strings.text: 彼女の言葉を借りるなら、誰かを救えることに酔っているような雰囲気だった。
strings.translated: To borrow her own words, she had an atmosphere of being intoxicated by being able to save someone.

strings.text: 実際、そうなのだろう。
strings.translated: And that was probably true.

strings.text: 誰かを救うことで、小野田さんはその人よりも上の立場であることを認識しているのだろう。
strings.translated: By saving someone, Yuka recognized herself as being in a position above that person.

strings.text: それは、知ってしまった人の幸せ。
strings.translated: That was the happiness of someone who had come to know.

strings.text: もう知らなかった頃に戻ることはできないから、本当の幸せを人に教えてあげることで、自分の幸せを実感しているのかもしれなかった
strings.translated: Because she could never go back to not knowing, perhaps she was affirming her own happiness by teaching others what true happiness was.

strings.text: 美桜「うん、私頑張ってみる
strings.translated: Mio「Yeah, I'll do my best.」

strings.text: このクラブの裏の顔をまだしらない白坂美桜は、ひとまずここに通うことを決めたようだった。
strings.translated: Mio Shiraka, who still didn't know the Club's hidden face, seemed to have decided for now to keep coming here.

strings.text: 実際、お金のかからないここは、学生には都合の良いたまり場だろう。
strings.translated: In practice, a place that cost nothing was a convenient hangout for a student.

strings.text: 彼女に、このクラブの存在はどんなふうに映ったのだろう。
strings.translated: How did the Club appear to her?

strings.text: このクラブにいる人達のことが、白坂美桜には幸せそうに見えただろうか。
strings.translated: Did the people here look happy to Mio Shiraka?

strings.text: 一度訊いてみたいとは思ったけど、実際にそれをすることはなかった。
strings.translated: I thought about asking her once, but never actually did.

strings.text: そんなことをしなくても、いずれは彼女自身の行動で答えを教えてくれるのがわかっていた
strings.translated: I knew that even without doing that, her own actions would eventually give me the answer.

strings.text: 白坂美桜の選んだ道
strings.translated: The path Mio Shiraka chose.

strings.text: 私が想像していたよりもずっと早く、彼女はセックスにのめり込んでいった。
strings.translated: Far sooner than I had imagined, she threw herself into sex.

strings.text: 強姦事件の被害者とは思えないほどに、白坂美桜はクラブで乱れるようになっていった。
strings.translated: Hard to believe she had been a rape victim -- Mio Shiraka began to lose herself at the Club.

strings.text: セックスは気持ちいいものだと認識して、自分から積極的に男を誘うようになっていった。
strings.translated: She came to understand that sex felt good, and started actively inviting men herself.

strings.text: 男を受け入れているときの白坂美桜の顔は、他のクラブのメンバー達と同じものになっていった。
strings.translated: The expression on Mio Shiraka's face when she was taking a man became the same as the other Club members.

strings.text: 心から幸せそうに笑って、自分は救われたと感じているようだった。
strings.translated: She smiled as though genuinely happy, seeming to feel that she had been saved.

strings.text: どうしてこんなふうに変われるのか。
strings.translated: How could someone change like this?

strings.text: どうしてこんなことに幸せを見つけることができるのか。
strings.translated: How could someone find happiness in something like this?

strings.text: ずっと白坂美桜の変化を見続けていたけど、やっぱり私にはわからなかった。
strings.translated: I had kept watching Mio Shiraka's transformation all along, but I still couldn't understand it.

strings.text: 何がそんなに幸せなのか、私には理解できなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't comprehend what was so happy about it.

strings.text: いつもこれだ。
strings.translated: It was always like this.

strings.text: 後から来た人達が、私より先に幸せを見つけていく。
strings.translated: People who came after me found happiness before I did.

strings.text: 救いを見出していく。
strings.translated: Found salvation.

strings.text: どうして、私にはわからないのだろう。
strings.translated: Why couldn't I understand?

strings.text: 救いを見出すことができないのだろう。
strings.translated: Why couldn't I find salvation?

strings.text: 今まで何度も思ってきた疑問を、私は白坂美桜の時も抱いていた
strings.translated: It was a question I had asked myself many times before, and I found myself asking it again with Mio Shiraka.

strings.text: 友佳「ねぇ、美桜。
strings.translated: Yuka「Hey, Mio.

strings.text: 今、幸せ？
strings.translated: Are you happy right now?」

strings.text: 美桜「ええ、とても幸せよ」
strings.translated: Mio「Yes, very much so.」

strings.text: そんな会話を交わす小野田さんと白坂美桜を、私は静かに見つめ続けた。
strings.translated: I quietly kept watching Yuka and Mio Shiraka as they exchanged those words.

strings.text: 彼女達が、これからどうなるのか…本当に救われているのか…それを確かめたかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to know what would become of them from here on... whether they were truly saved...

strings.text: そして、自分の姉がこんなふうになっていることを知ったら白坂君はどう思うのか…できる事なら、それも知りたかった
strings.translated: And I wanted to know, if possible, how Shiraka-kun would feel upon learning that his sister had ended up like this...

strings.text: そして、数日後。
strings.translated: And then, a few days later.

strings.text: クラブに向かう途中、白家君がお姉さんを尾行していることに気づいた私は、彼に真実を見せてみることにした
strings.translated: On my way to the Club, I noticed Daichi following his sister, and I decided to show him the truth.

strings.text: 自分の姉の変化に気づいてから、白坂君は私に協力を求めて来た。
strings.translated: After noticing the change in his sister, Shiraka-kun had come to me seeking help.

strings.text: どうやら、何とかして姉のことを助けたいと思っているらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed he was determined to do whatever he could to save her.

strings.text: でも、姉が怪しげなクラブと関わっている状況は、警察に駆け込むのも家族に相談するのも難しかったらしい。
strings.translated: But with his sister involved in a suspicious club, it seemed difficult for him to go to the police or consult his family.

strings.text: それは順当な反応だろう。
strings.translated: That was a reasonable reaction.

strings.text: まずは、自分の力で解決したい。
strings.translated: First, he wanted to resolve things on his own.

strings.text: それが、彼の希望のようだった
strings.translated: That appeared to be his wish.

strings.text: 私が、クラブでセックスしないことを告げると、白坂君は都合良く解釈したらしかった。
strings.translated: When I told him that I didn't have sex at the Club, Shiraka-kun seemed to interpret it in whatever way suited him best.

strings.text: 別に不思議なことじゃない。
strings.translated: That wasn't particularly strange.

strings.text: 自分の気持ちが落ち着くほうに、人間は物事を考える習性がある。
strings.translated: People have a habit of thinking about things in whichever way puts their own mind at ease.

strings.text: 白坂君だけでなく、学校のクラスメイトや先生、クラブの人達でさえそれは同じだった。
strings.translated: It wasn't just Shiraka-kun -- his classmates and teachers, even the people at the Club, were all the same.

strings.text: だから、白坂君の考え方も理解はできたし、使いやすい人だってことがすぐにわかった。
strings.translated: So I could understand his way of thinking, and I quickly realized he was someone easy to make use of.

strings.text: それにしても、この話を私にしてくるなんて…。
strings.translated: Even so, to bring this to me of all people...

strings.text: 一番話してはいけない人に話してしまったことを、白坂君は気づいていない。
strings.translated: Shiraka-kun had no idea he had confided in the very last person he should have.

strings.text: 不運と言うべきか、とにかく彼にとっては最悪の展開のはずだった。
strings.translated: Whether to call it bad luck or not, it should have been the worst possible development for him.

strings.text: もっとも、今はまだ本人がそれに気づいてないわけで、私はクラブの本当の姿を知っている。
strings.translated: Of course, he hadn't realized that yet, while I knew the Club's true nature.

strings.text: ある意味、最適な人間に声をかけたとも言えるわけだけど…。
strings.translated: In a sense, you could say he had reached out to exactly the right person...

strings.text: 何にしても下手に動かれると、すぐに取り込まれるか、潰されてしまうだろう。
strings.translated: Either way, if he moved carelessly, he would quickly be absorbed or crushed.

strings.text: 行方不明という扱いにして命を奪うのも、クラブにとってはそう難しくないことだった。
strings.translated: Making someone disappear and taking their life was not particularly difficult for the Club.

strings.text: 出来れば私は、もう少し彼の行動を見ていたかった。
strings.translated: If possible, I wanted to watch his actions a little longer.

strings.text: 強制的にその行く末を決めてしまうのではなく、彼の自由意思に任せてみたかった
strings.translated: Rather than forcibly deciding his fate, I wanted to leave it to his own free will.

strings.text: 悩むふりをしながら、私は彼の扱い方について考えた。
strings.translated: While pretending to deliberate, I thought about how to handle him.

strings.text: 少し意外な展開ではあったけど、都合が良かったとも言える。
strings.translated: It was a slightly unexpected turn of events, but you could also say it was convenient.

strings.text: 彼の決心は固い様子だし、無理に遠ざけて、見えない所で動かれるよりは、手元で様子を見たほうがお互いに安全かもしれない
strings.translated: His resolve seemed firm, and it might be safer for both of us to keep him close and observe him, rather than pushing him away and having him act somewhere out of my sight.

strings.text: でも、そんな噂があるから
strings.translated: But there are rumors like that.」

strings.text: 白坂君は怯えた様子で息を呑んだ。
strings.translated: Daichi seemed to catch his breath in fear.

strings.text: すごくやる気みたいだったけど、普通の人間ならこんなものだろう。
strings.translated: He had seemed very motivated, but that was about what you'd expect from an ordinary person.

strings.text: 家族のことは心配していても、我が身可愛さに見て見ぬふりをするなんてことは珍しくもない。
strings.translated: Even if they were worried about family, it wasn't unusual to turn a blind eye out of self-preservation.

strings.text: でも、ここで完全に引かれてしまうと、それはそれで彼の行動が予想しづらかった。
strings.translated: But if he pulled back completely here, his next actions would be harder to predict.

strings.text: 一番良いのは、何をするにしても私の目の届く範囲で行ってもらうことだった
strings.translated: The best outcome was for him to act within my sight, whatever he chose to do.

strings.text: 愛「約束ね
strings.translated: Ai「Promise me.」

strings.text: こうして、私は白坂大智と言う新しい観察対象を手に入れた。
strings.translated: And so, I had acquired a new subject of observation -- Daichi Shiraka.

strings.text: どうせ今までに見てきた人たちとそう変わりはないだろうけど。
strings.translated: He probably wouldn't be all that different from the people I had watched up until now.

strings.text: 園田には「問題ない」
strings.translated: Sonoda「No problem.」

strings.text: と報告して、暫く彼を自由にさせてみることにした。
strings.translated: That was what I reported to Sonoda, and I decided to let him move freely for a while.

strings.text: 彼がお姉さんのためにどこまでできるのか。
strings.translated: How far could he go for his sister's sake.

strings.text: ただの正義感だけの愚か者なのか、それとも、別の何かを持っているのか。
strings.translated: Was he nothing more than a fool driven by a sense of justice, or did he have something else within him.

strings.text: それを見届けてみたかった
strings.translated: I wanted to see that through to the end.

strings.text: 俺も…神村さんと一緒に行く」
strings.translated: I'll... go with you, Kamimura-san.」

strings.text: 数日後。
strings.translated: A few days later.

strings.text: 白坂君は、意を決したようにそう言ってきた。
strings.translated: Daichi said that to me, as though having made up his mind.

strings.text: クラブに行く。
strings.translated: Going to the Club.

strings.text: それは、自分の身の危険も理解した上で、彼が選んだ行動だった
strings.translated: That was the action he chose, with full understanding of the danger to himself.

strings.text: 狙い通りだった。
strings.translated: Just as I had planned.

strings.text: 私の想像した通りに、物事が動き始めていた。
strings.translated: Things were beginning to move exactly as I had imagined.

strings.text: 白坂君はクラブに関わる道を選んだ。
strings.translated: Daichi had chosen the path of involvement with the Club.

strings.text: 姉である白坂美桜のことを放っておけなくて、自ら危険な場所に飛び込んでしまった。
strings.translated: Unable to abandon his sister Mio Shiraka, he had thrown himself into a dangerous place of his own accord.

strings.text: 彼にはどうすることもできないのに、自分からそこに入り込んでしまった
strings.translated: There was nothing he could do, and yet he had walked right in.

strings.text: クラブの部屋に入って、白坂君はいきなり大きなショックを受けたようだった。
strings.translated: When Shiraka entered the Club's room, he seemed to be struck by an immediate, overwhelming shock.

strings.text: クラスメイトの桧垣瑛。
strings.translated: Akira Higaki -- his classmate.

strings.text: 彼の本当の姿を見て、ただただ絶句するしかないようだった
strings.translated: Seeing who Akira truly was, he could only stand there, speechless.

strings.text: 私と話してる間も、彼の苦悩が感じ取れた。
strings.translated: Even while talking with me, I could sense his anguish.

strings.text: 早くも後悔しているようで、顔には苦悶の表情を浮かべていた
strings.translated: He already seemed to be regretting it, his face twisted with an expression of distress.

strings.text: 覚悟が足りなかった。
strings.translated: He hadn't been prepared enough.

strings.text: 一言で言えば、そういう事。
strings.translated: In a word, that was it.

strings.text: クラブがどんなところか正しく認識していないままに関わるから、こういう事になってしまう。
strings.translated: Getting involved without properly understanding what kind of place the Club was -- that was why this happened.

strings.text: 私は、適度に白坂君を気遣いながら、彼が次にどんな行動を取るのかを予想し続けた。
strings.translated: I kept a moderate eye on Daichi while continuing to predict what he would do next.

strings.text: もっとも、その後の彼の行動は私の期待に沿うものではなかった。
strings.translated: Though, his subsequent actions didn't meet my expectations.

strings.text: 悲鳴混じりの声を上げて逃げ出してしまって、私としては物足りない結果に終わってしまった。
strings.translated: He let out a half-screaming voice and fled, leaving me with a rather unsatisfying result.

strings.text: でも、これで彼がどういう人間なのかわかった気がした。
strings.translated: But I felt I now understood what kind of person he was.

strings.text: 本当に普通の、善良な、それゆえに弱い人間であると言うことが私にも理解できた。
strings.translated: I could see that he was truly ordinary, good-natured, and therefore weak.

strings.text: 彼はこれからどうするのだろう。
strings.translated: What would he do from here?

strings.text: 家に逃げ帰って、いったい何を考えるのだろう。
strings.translated: Running home, what would he be thinking?

strings.text: 興味はあったけど、さすがにそれを知る術はなかった
strings.translated: I was curious, but I had no way of knowing that.

strings.text: 白坂君がクラブから逃げ出して少し後。
strings.translated: A little while after Daichi fled the Club.

strings.text: それを知った白坂美桜に声をかけられた。
strings.translated: Mio Shiraka, having heard about it, came to speak to me.

strings.text: 隣には当然のように小野田さんがいる
strings.translated: Yuka Onoda was beside her, naturally.

strings.text: 美桜「神村さん、大智を連れて来てくれたの？
strings.translated: Mio「Kamimura-san, you brought Daichi here?

strings.text: 信じられない。
strings.translated: I can't believe it.

strings.text: あんなに嫌がってたのに
strings.translated: He was so against it.」

strings.text: 愛「でも、すぐに帰ってしまって
strings.translated: Ai「But he left right away.」

strings.text: 美桜「いいのよ。
strings.translated: Mio「That's fine.

strings.text: ここに来たって言う事実が大事なんだから。
strings.translated: What matters is the fact that he came here.

strings.text: きっと大智の中で、何かが変わり始めてるんだわ
strings.translated: Something inside Daichi is surely starting to change.」

strings.text: 美桜「ありがとう。
strings.translated: Mio「Thank you.

strings.text: これからも、大智にいろいろと教えてあげてね
strings.translated: Please keep teaching Daichi all sorts of things from now on.」

strings.text: 友佳「それに、あなたも人のことばかりじゃなくて自分の救いを見出してね
strings.translated: Yuka「And you -- don't just focus on other people, find your own salvation too.」

strings.text: 友佳「もちろん、私にできることがあれば協力するから
strings.translated: Yuka「Of course, if there's anything I can do, I'll help.」

strings.text: 愛「…ありがとう
strings.translated: Ai「...Thank you.」

strings.text: 形だけのお礼を言って、私は彼女達から視線を外した。
strings.translated: I said a hollow thank-you and looked away from them.

strings.text: 感謝されるような事をした覚えはないし、しようとも思わない。
strings.translated: I had no memory of doing anything worth being thanked for, and no intention of doing so.

strings.text: それに、自分達が救われてるからと言って、それを他人に強要するような態度は決して褒められたものではないはずだった。
strings.translated: Besides, just because they felt saved didn't mean they should impose that on others -- that kind of attitude was hardly something to be praised.

strings.text: 彼女には、本当に救いの意味がわかってるのだろうか。
strings.translated: Did she truly understand the meaning of salvation?

strings.text: 何かを勘違いしてるだけなのではないだろうか。
strings.translated: Was she simply mistaken about something?

strings.text: 確かめられる方法があるのなら、そのあたりのことを確かめてみたかった
strings.translated: If there were a way to find out, I wanted to verify that.

strings.text: 小野田友佳は死んだ。
strings.translated: Yuka Onoda died.

strings.text: クラブのために、自ら進んで命を投げ出した。
strings.translated: She threw her own life away willingly, for the Club.

strings.text: それが、自分の幸せだと信じて…こうやって死ぬことこそが、自分にとっての救いだと疑わずに
strings.translated: Believing it was her happiness... never doubting that dying like this was her own salvation.

strings.text: 美桜「友佳…良かったね」
strings.translated: Mio「Yuka... I'm glad for you.」

strings.text: 小野田友佳に救われたはずの白坂美桜は、友人の死を温かく受け入れていた。
strings.translated: Mio Shiraka, who was supposed to have been saved by Yuka Onoda, accepted her friend's death warmly.

strings.text: 腹を裂かれ、血まみれで絶命している小野田友佳を見下ろしながら、とても幸せそうな表情を浮かべていた。
strings.translated: She looked down at Yuka Onoda -- her stomach split open, drenched in blood, dead -- with an expression of perfect happiness.

strings.text: 彼女にはわかるらしい。
strings.translated: She seemed to understand.

strings.text: これが、小野田友佳の救いだと、白坂美桜には理解できてるらしい。
strings.translated: That this was Yuka Onoda's salvation, Mio Shiraka seemed to grasp it.

strings.text: でも、本当にそうなのだろうか。
strings.translated: But was that really true?

strings.text: こんな事があっても、これが救いだと思えるのは、彼女達が既に壊れてしまってるからではないのだろうか。
strings.translated: Even after something like this, was it because they were already broken that they could call this salvation?

strings.text: それとも、やはりこんなふうに考えてしまう私こそが壊れてしまっているのか
strings.translated: Or was it, after all, me -- thinking like this -- who was the broken one?

strings.text: 小野田友佳の死体を見つめながら、私は白坂君の事を思った。
strings.translated: Staring at Yuka Onoda's corpse, I found myself thinking about Shiraka.

strings.text: この事実を知ったら、彼はどうするだろう。
strings.translated: If he learned the truth, what would he do?

strings.text: どんな行動を取るだろう。
strings.translated: What would he do?

strings.text: 興味はあったけど、さすがにこれを伝えるわけにはいかない。
strings.translated: I was curious, but there was no way I could tell him that.

strings.text: 少なくとも…今は
strings.translated: At least... not now.

strings.text: 救いの意味がわかった？」
strings.translated: "Do you understand the meaning of salvation?"

strings.text: 小野田友佳の死体を見つめながら考え事をしていると、白坂美桜が声をかけてきた
strings.translated: While I was lost in thought staring at Yuka Onoda's corpse, Mio Shiraka spoke to me.

strings.text: 美桜「友佳、幸せそうでしょう？
strings.translated: Mio「Yuka looks happy, doesn't she?

strings.text: 愛「…そうですね
strings.translated: Ai「...Yes, she does.

strings.text: 美桜「あんなふうに笑いながら、自分の役目のために死んでいきたいものね
strings.translated: Mio「I'd like to die like that too, smiling, for the sake of my own purpose.

strings.text: 美桜「そしたら、きっと自分の人生にも意味があったって思うことができるから
strings.translated: Mio「Because then, I think I'd be able to feel like my life had meaning.

strings.text: 愛「自分の人生に…意味
strings.translated: Ai「My life... meaning...

strings.text: 美桜「それを教えてくれた園田先生には本当に感謝しないと…」
strings.translated: Mio「I really have to be grateful to Sonoda-sensei for teaching me that...」

strings.text: 白坂美桜の園田に対する信仰心のようなものは、ますます深くなっていた。
strings.translated: Shiraka Mio's faith-like devotion toward Sonoda was growing deeper and deeper.

strings.text: おそらくは、もう彼の言うことはどんな事でも信じるだろう。
strings.translated: She would probably believe anything he said by now, no matter what it was.

strings.text: 疑いなど抱くはずもなく、命令すれば殺人だって犯すかもしれない。
strings.translated: Without a shred of doubt -- if he gave the order, she might even commit murder.

strings.text: 園田の本当の姿を知ったら、この人はどうするのだろう。
strings.translated: If she learned who Sonoda truly was, what would she do?

strings.text: 自ら命を絶ってしまうのだろうか。
strings.translated: Would she take her own life?

strings.text: それとも、園田の命を奪いにいくのだろうか。
strings.translated: Or would she go to take Sonoda's life?

strings.text: もしくは、それでも園田についていくのだろうか
strings.translated: Or would she follow Sonoda even still?

strings.text: 白坂君は、日増しに生気がなくなっていった。
strings.translated: Daichi was losing his vitality day by day.

strings.text: 毎日悩んで過ごしているのか、落ち込んだような表情を見せることが多くなっていった。
strings.translated: Whether he was spending every day tormented by worry, he was showing a downcast expression more and more often.

strings.text: 物悲しげな様子は、最初に会ったときの白坂君からは想像もつかない。
strings.translated: The air of quiet sadness about him was unimaginable compared to the Daichi I had first met.

strings.text: 下手をすれば衰弱死してしまうんじゃないかって、そんな雰囲気さえ感じられた
strings.translated: There was even a feeling that, if things went badly, he might waste away and die.

strings.text: 愛「疲れてるみたいね
strings.translated: Ai「You look tired.

strings.text: 大智「…ちょっとだけ
strings.translated: Daichi「...Just a little.

strings.text: 白坂君の言葉からは、迷いのようなものが感じられた。
strings.translated: From Shiraka-kun's words, I could sense something like hesitation.

strings.text: あまりにも多くのものを見すぎて、クラブの本質が見えなくなっているらしい。
strings.translated: He seemed to have seen too much, and lost sight of the Club's true nature.

strings.text: 以前は悪いところだと断言していたのに、最近ではそこにも疑問を感じるようになってきたらしかった。
strings.translated: He used to say without question that it was a terrible place, but lately he seemed to have begun doubting even that.

strings.text: でも、私にはただ単に自信をなくしているだけのように見える。
strings.translated: But to me, it just looked like he had simply lost confidence in himself.

strings.text: 自分の無力さを感じ取って、どうすればいいのかわからなくなっているだけのように見える
strings.translated: It looked like he had felt his own powerlessness and no longer knew what he should do.

strings.text: もしも、そうだとしたら…とても期待外れだった。
strings.translated: If that was the case... it was a great disappointment.

strings.text: もっとも、こういう結果になったとしても大きな驚きはない。
strings.translated: Though even if things turned out this way, it wasn't much of a surprise.

strings.text: 白坂君は普通の人で、できることは限られてたんだから、むしろこうなることが自然とも言える。
strings.translated: Daichi was an ordinary person with limited capabilities -- it was only natural that things would come to this.

strings.text: 何もできないのならそれでいい。
strings.translated: If he couldn't do anything, that was fine.

strings.text: いつもしているように扱えばいいだけの話だから。
strings.translated: I would just treat him the way I always did.

strings.text: どのみち、白坂君が本当にクラブをどうにかできると考えていたわけではないのだから、何かを期待するほうがおかしかったのだ。
strings.translated: In any case, I had never truly believed Daichi could actually do something about the Club, so it was strange to have expected anything at all.

strings.text: 絶望に打ちひしがれた彼がこの先どこまで何をできるのか、とりあえずはもう少し観察してみることにした
strings.translated: I decided to observe a little longer and see just how far he could go, crushed as he was by despair.

strings.text: 愛「ひぎいいいいぃぃぃぃっ！
strings.translated: Ai「Hiiiiiiigh!

strings.text: はぁっ、んぐぅっ、はあぁ…っ！
strings.translated: Hah--, ngh--, haah...!

strings.text: 男「どう！
strings.translated: Man「How's that!

strings.text: 痛い！
strings.translated: It hurts!

strings.text: い、いだいっ…いだいですぅっ…！」
strings.translated: I-it hurts...! It hurts so much...!」

strings.text: 正直をいえば痛いことは痛かったけど、わたしは悲鳴をあげないようにもできた。
strings.translated: To be honest, it did hurt, but I could have kept myself from screaming.

strings.text: 痛いからって声をあげるとますます疲れる。
strings.translated: Crying out because it hurt only made me more exhausted.

strings.text: それに痛いと悲鳴をあげたからって、お客さんはやめてくれることはないんだし。
strings.translated: And even if I screamed that it hurt, the customer was never going to stop.

strings.text: 愛「いだいいぃぃっ！
strings.translated: Ai「It hurts! It hurts so much!

strings.text: いだいですぅぅっ！」
strings.translated: It hurts so much...!」

strings.text: …こうして声をあげないと、余計に痛いことが続くってのもわかってた。
strings.translated: But I also knew that if I didn't cry out like this, the pain would just keep going even longer.

strings.text: 声をあげてお客さんを喜ばせないとまた怒られる。
strings.translated: If I didn't cry out and please the customer, I'd get scolded again.

strings.text: 怒られて、もっと痛いことをされる…。
strings.translated: Get scolded, and then have something even more painful done to me...

strings.text: だから、わたしは疲れるなんてことは忘れて、悲鳴をあげた
strings.translated: So I put aside any thought of exhaustion and screamed.

strings.text: 愛「んぎいいぃっ！
strings.translated: Ai「Nghiiiii!

strings.text: ぎいいいぃぃっ！
strings.translated: Giiiiiii!

strings.text: いだぁ、い、よぉ…っ」
strings.translated: It hurts, it, hurts so much...!」

strings.text: こうやって、お客さんが喜ぶようにしてさえいれば…その日はごはんをたべさせてもらえる…。
strings.translated: As long as I just made the customer happy like this... I'd get to eat that day...

strings.text: そんな自分でもおかしいとしか思えない考えが、わたしの中にはあった。
strings.translated: That kind of thought -- one that even I could only see as twisted -- lived inside me.

strings.text: でも、そうしないと…ごはんを食べて、痛みや苦しみに耐えながらでも寝ないと、わたしは生きていけない。
strings.translated: But if I didn't... if I didn't eat, and sleep even while enduring the pain and suffering, I couldn't go on living.

strings.text: 男「ありがとうございますでしょっ！
strings.translated: Man「Say thank you!

strings.text: ぶたれたらありがとうございますっ！
strings.translated: When you get hit, you say thank you!

strings.text: 常識でしょっ！」
strings.translated: That's just common sense!」

strings.text: どうやらこのお客さんは、わたしが普通の悲鳴をあげるのでは満足しないみたいだった。
strings.translated: It seemed this customer wasn't satisfied with me just screaming normally.

strings.text: 痛い目に遭わせて、それにお礼をいわせる。
strings.translated: He'd hurt me, and then make me thank him for it.

strings.text: それがこのお客さんにとって楽しくて気持ちいいことなんだろう。
strings.translated: That was what was fun and felt good to this customer, I suppose.

strings.text: だったら…わたしはそれにしたがうしかない。
strings.translated: If that was the case... I had no choice but to go along with it.

strings.text: 決してお礼をいえるようなことじゃないことにも、お礼をいわなければならない
strings.translated: I had to say thank you even for things that could never deserve any thanks.

strings.text: 愛「ぎひぃっ！
strings.translated: Ai「Ghiii!

strings.text: あ、ありがとぉ…ございまずぅっ…」
strings.translated: Th-thank... you... so mush...!」

strings.text: お客さんにいわれるまま、わたしはお礼もいうのだけど…それで鞭の手がとまるわけじゃない。
strings.translated: Just as the customer told me to, I said thank you... but that didn't make the whip stop.

strings.text: そんなの、とっくにわたしにはわかっていたのだけど…。
strings.translated: I had already known that for a long time, but...

strings.text: 男「感謝の気持ちでしょっ！
strings.translated: Man「Show some gratitude!

strings.text: 僕に買われて…感謝しているんでしょっ！
strings.translated: You were bought by me... you're grateful, aren't you!

strings.text: お客さんは、なおもわたしに無茶なことをいわそうと声を荒げた
strings.translated: The customer raised his voice even louder, trying to make me say something even more unreasonable.

strings.text: ひゃいいっ！
strings.translated: Hyaiii!

strings.text: かんしゃっ…かんしゃしてまずぅっ！
strings.translated: G-grateful... I'm so grateful...!

strings.text: うれっ…うれじいでずぅっ！」
strings.translated: I'm hap... I'm so happy...!」

strings.text: わたしはお客さんの求めにこたえるように、感謝していると口にする。
strings.translated: I said the words, that I was grateful, to answer what the customer wanted.

strings.text: …もちろん、感謝なんてひとかけらもない。
strings.translated: Of course, I didn't feel even a shred of gratitude.

strings.text: でも、そういわなければならなかった。
strings.translated: But I had to say it.

strings.text: 男「そうだよね？
strings.translated: Man「That's right, isn't it?

strings.text: キミみたいなクソチビ…無能でなぁーんの価値もない売れ残り、僕くらいしか買わないでしょっ！
strings.translated: A worthless little runt like you... a useless, completely valueless leftover -- I'm just about the only one who'd buy you!

strings.text: 次々と投げかけられる言葉も、実のところはほとんど、理解できてなんかなかった。
strings.translated: The words that came flying at me one after another -- honestly, I could barely understand most of them.

strings.text: ただ、その口調と言葉の汚さが、わたしのことを痛めつけようとしている、ということだけはわかる
strings.translated: I only understood that the tone and the ugliness of the words were meant to hurt me -- that much I could tell.

strings.text: 愛「ぅぎゃぁぁっ！
strings.translated: Ai「Ugyaaaa!

strings.text: あぎっ…ぎっ…は、はいぃっ…！
strings.translated: Agh... gh... y-yes...!

strings.text: その…とおりですぅっ…」
strings.translated: You're... right...!」

strings.text: もしも見当違いな返事をすれば？
strings.translated: What if I gave the wrong answer?

strings.text: そうしたらお客さんの責めはもっともっと激しくなることもわかってた。
strings.translated: I knew that if I did, the customer's punishment would only get worse and worse.

strings.text: だから、そういう…大事な部分だけは、聞き逃さないように、間違えないように…そうしてるだけだった。
strings.translated: So I just... made sure not to miss the important parts, not to get them wrong... that was all I was doing.

strings.text: でも、それが本当にあっているかどうかは正直、わからなかった。
strings.translated: But whether I was really getting it right -- honestly, I didn't know.

strings.text: 男「わかってるんなら、復唱でしょっ！
strings.translated: Man「If you understand, then repeat it back!

strings.text: ばしぃっ、と…おまんこに直接、鞭があたった
strings.translated: Smack -- the whip landed directly on my pussy.

strings.text: 愛「がぎゃああぁぁっ！
strings.translated: Ai「Gagyaaaa!

strings.text: ぎあっ…がっ…がはっ…、ひぃっ、んぎっひぃぃぃ…っ！」
strings.translated: Gah... ga... gah...! Hii! Nghiii...!」

strings.text: もちろん、こうして…間違いをなくそうとしたって、それでも理不尽に罰をうけることが当然あるのもしってる。
strings.translated: Of course, even trying like this to avoid mistakes -- I knew there would still be times I'd be punished for no reason at all.

strings.text: 最初は、それならそれで…がんばる必要なんかもないんじゃないかって思ったときもあった。
strings.translated: At first, I thought... if that's how it is, then maybe there's no point in even trying.

strings.text: でも、なにも反応しなければ、ほとんどのお客さんは怒って、ますますわたしをひどい目に遭わせる。
strings.translated: But if I gave no reaction at all, most customers would get angry and treat me even worse.

strings.text: そして、それを聞かされたお父さんやお母さんがわたしにお仕置きをした。
strings.translated: And then my father and mother, when they heard about it, would punish me.

strings.text: だから、わたしは思い付き半分、本当の悲鳴半分で声をあげて反応する
strings.translated: So I'd cry out and react -- half on instinct, half with real screams.

strings.text: 愛「め、めぐみはぁっ…んぐっ…む、むのうでぇっ…かちのない…くそちびですぅっ…ひぐっ…うぅぅぅ…っ」
strings.translated: Ai「M-Megumi is... ngh... u-useless... worthless... a stupid little runt...! Hic... uuuu...」

strings.text: お客さんにいわれるまま、わたしは復唱する。
strings.translated: Just as the customer told me to, I repeated the words back.

strings.text: 頑張っても頑張らなくてもひどいことをされるなら、頑張らない方が…っていうのが違うのも、すぐにわかった。
strings.translated: I quickly understood that "if I'm going to be treated terribly whether I try or not, then why bother trying" -- that thinking was wrong too.

strings.text: それじゃ、ただ単純に…いうことを守れなかった罰と、守ってもされる罰…そんな罰が二倍になるだけ。
strings.translated: That means... it's just simple... the punishment for not following the rules, and the punishment even when I do follow them... those two punishments just double up.

strings.text: だから、理不尽なことだったとしても…必死にがんばらなくてはいけない。
strings.translated: So even if it's completely unreasonable... I have to try my hardest anyway.

strings.text: 男「今日、買い手がつかなかったら、またごはんヌキなんでしょっ！
strings.translated: Man「If no buyer picks you today, you'll go without dinner again, won't you!

strings.text: じゃあ…うれしいよね、僕に叩かれて、うれしいよねっ！
strings.translated: So... you're happy, aren't you -- happy to be hit by me, you're happy, aren't you!

strings.text: また、鞭が振り下ろされる。
strings.translated: The whip came down again.

strings.text: もう、理不尽とかそんな話じゃなくて、単に…言葉の区切りで叩かれてるだけにも思えた
strings.translated: It no longer even felt like a matter of reason or unreason -- it just seemed like I was being struck at the pauses between his words.

strings.text: 愛「ぎいぃっ！
strings.translated: Ai「Giiih!

strings.text: ひゃいっ…うれひい…ですぅっ…。
strings.translated: H-hyai... I'm hap...py... sir...!

strings.text: もっと…もっとぶってくださぁいっ…」
strings.translated: More... please hit me more...」

strings.text: 男「ぶたれて嬉しいなんて…変態だよねっ！
strings.translated: Man「Happy to be hit... you're a pervert, aren't you!

strings.text: 変態のマゾブタだよね！
strings.translated: A perverted masochist pig, aren't you!

strings.text: まったくなんて子だ、この子は！
strings.translated: What a child, honestly, what a child she is!

strings.text: ぎゃっ…ぎゃぁっ！
strings.translated: Gyah... gyaaah!

strings.text: はいぃっ！
strings.translated: Y-yes!

strings.text: へんたいっ…んぐぐっ！
strings.translated: P-pervert...! Nghgh!

strings.text: めぐみはぁ…へんたいの、まぞぶたですぅっ！」
strings.translated: Megumi is... a pervert... a masochist pig...!」

strings.text: 変態はわかったけど、マゾブタというのはよくわからなかった。
strings.translated: I understood "pervert," but "masochist pig" I didn't really get.

strings.text: マゾっていうのが誰かからひどいことをされて、それを喜ぶような人だってことは教えられたような気がする。
strings.translated: I think someone had explained to me that "masochist" meant a person who had terrible things done to them and took pleasure in it.

strings.text: ブタっていうのは他人を罵る時や見下した扱いをする時に使うんだな、っていうのはなんとなくわかっていた。
strings.translated: I had a vague sense that "pig" was something people used to insult others or treat them with contempt.

strings.text: でも、その２つがくっつくのはしらなかった。
strings.translated: But I didn't know the two could be stuck together.

strings.text: 多分、このお客さんはわたしのことを痛さを気持ちよく感じる見下された存在だ、っていいたいんだろう。
strings.translated: This customer probably meant to say that I was a lowly creature who felt pain as pleasure.

strings.text: 別にそうだったとしても、わたしにはあんまり感じることはなかった。
strings.translated: Even if that was true, it didn't really mean much to me.

strings.text: どういわれたって、わたしの扱いがよくなることはないだろう、ってわかってたから。
strings.translated: Because I already knew that no matter what I was called, the way I was treated wasn't going to get any better.

strings.text: だったら、いいたいようにいわせておけばいいや、って思っていた。
strings.translated: So I figured -- just let them say whatever they want.

strings.text: 男「よぉし、じゃあご褒美ねっ！
strings.translated: Man「Alright then, here's your reward!

strings.text: 今度は「ご褒美」

strings.translated: Pretending to be troubled, I continued speaking in a trembling voice.

strings.text: 後悔しているような表情を浮かべると、白坂君は思った通り慰めてくれた。
strings.translated: When I put on an expression of regret, Shirasaka-kun comforted me just as I expected.

strings.text: 彼にとってはとんでもない事をしたはずなのに、私を責める様子は全くない。
strings.translated: Even though what had happened must have been unthinkable to him, he showed no sign of blaming me at all.

strings.text: 本当にどこまでもお人好しな性格をしていることが、この事からも容易に想像がついた。
strings.translated: From this alone, it was easy to imagine just how endlessly good-natured he was.

strings.text: しかも、彼の想像はそれだけに留まらなかった
strings.translated: And his imagination didn't stop there.

strings.text: 星野さんを巻き込みたくなかったんだな」
strings.translated: You didn't want to drag Hoshino-san into this.」

strings.text: 最初は、言われてることの意味がわからなかった。
strings.translated: At first, I didn't understand what he meant.

strings.text: 白坂君は納得したようにうなずいていたけど、どうしてそんな反応になるのか私には見当もつかなかった
strings.translated: Shirasaka-kun was nodding as if it all made sense, but I had no idea why he would react that way.

strings.text: そして、気づいた。
strings.translated: And then I understood.

strings.text: どうやら、私が後悔しているような様子を見せたことで、私は正常な人間だと判断したらしかった。
strings.translated: It seemed that because I had shown signs of regret, he had concluded that I was a normal person.

strings.text: 彼の解釈は決して間違いではない。
strings.translated: His interpretation wasn't entirely wrong.

strings.text: 私以外の人間であれば、その想像は正しかっただろう。
strings.translated: For anyone other than me, that assumption would have been correct.

strings.text: でも、私は違う。
strings.translated: But I was different.

strings.text: 私はこうなることを望んでいたのだから
strings.translated: I had wanted this to happen.

strings.text: 愛「…円夏にはきっと、あそこは必要ないから」
strings.translated: Ai「...Madoka probably doesn't need a place like that.」

strings.text: 白坂君が受け入れやすそうな嘘を織り交ぜながら、時々、自分の本当の気持ちを織り交ぜた。
strings.translated: I wove in lies that Shirasaka-kun would find easy to accept, and mixed in, here and there, my own true feelings.

strings.text: ずっとクラブには通ってるけど、私の心が満たされたことは一度もない。
strings.translated: I had been going to the Club all this time, but my heart had never once felt fulfilled.

strings.text: みんなと同じようにできないから、みんなと同じように感じることができなかった。
strings.translated: Because I couldn't do what everyone else did, I couldn't feel what everyone else felt.

strings.text: みんなのように人前でセックスして、快楽を貪ることが幸せだと思うことができない
strings.translated: I couldn't bring myself to think that having sex in front of others and wallowing in pleasure, the way everyone else did, was something to be happy about.

strings.text: どうしていいかわからなくて……」
strings.translated: I didn't know what to do...」

strings.text: どうして私はこうなってしまったのだろう。
strings.translated: Why had I ended up like this?

strings.text: どうして私はみんなと同じようになれなかったのだろう
strings.translated: Why couldn't I become like everyone else?

strings.text: 大智「…俺も、同じだよ」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Me too.」

strings.text: 自分の思考に沈んでいると、ふいに白坂君が呟いた。
strings.translated: Lost in my own thoughts, I was startled when Shirasaka-kun murmured that.

strings.text: …そう。
strings.translated: ...Yes.

strings.text: 根本的な問題は違うし、白坂君は真実を知らずにいるけど、私達はある意味似てると言えた。
strings.translated: Our fundamental problems were different, and Shirasaka-kun didn't know the truth, but in a sense, we were alike.

strings.text: どうにもならない壁に突き当たって、前に進めずにいる
strings.translated: Both of us had hit a wall we couldn't get past, unable to move forward.

strings.text: 愛「…わからない
strings.translated: Ai「...I don't know.

strings.text: 正直にそうこたえたら、白坂君は少し笑って…それから急に真剣な表情で、私の手を取った
strings.translated: When I answered honestly, Shirasaka-kun smiled a little... and then, suddenly serious, he took my hand.

strings.text: 私より一回り大きな、暖かい手のひらに包まれて、私はその言葉になんて答えればいいのか、わからなくなってしまった
strings.translated: Wrapped in his warm palm -- a hand a size larger than mine -- I no longer knew how I was supposed to answer him.

strings.text: 大智「…ごめん」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Sorry.」

strings.text: タイミングよく鳴ったチャイムに、白坂君がはっとして手を放す
strings.translated: The bell rang at just the right moment, and Shirasaka-kun startled and let go of my hand.

strings.text: 何事もなかったかのようにそう言いながら、私の中にははっきりとしない迷いが生じていた
strings.translated: He said it as though nothing had happened, but inside me, a vague and unresolved hesitation had taken root.

strings.text: 大智「ひとつ、確かめたいことがあるんだ」
strings.translated: Daichi「There's one thing I want to confirm.」

strings.text: 白坂君に変化が起こったのは、それから数日後の事だった。
strings.translated: The change in Shirasaka-kun came a few days after that.

strings.text: 喫茶店のテーブルで向かい合った私に対して、今まで溜まっていたものを吐き出すように言った。
strings.translated: Sitting across from me at a table in a cafe, he spoke as though releasing something that had been building up inside him for a long time.

strings.text: 一時期は自信をなくしているようにも見えたのに、何かがきっかけでクラブを何とかしようと言う意思が再燃したらしかった
strings.translated: For a while he had seemed to have lost his confidence, but something had reignited his determination to do something about the Club.

strings.text: 考えるふりをしながら、私は白坂君の決意を感じていた。
strings.translated: Pretending to think it over, I felt the resolve in Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: 今までとは違って、かなり本気のようだ。
strings.translated: Unlike before, he seemed quite serious this time.

strings.text: 適当に話を切ってごまかすことは出来そうになかった。
strings.translated: It didn't look like I could brush the conversation aside with some vague excuse.

strings.text: さて、これはどうしたものだろう。
strings.translated: Well, what was I to do about this?

strings.text: 強い決意をした白坂君を、私はどう扱えばいいのだろう。
strings.translated: How was I supposed to handle Shirasaka-kun now that he had made up his mind so firmly?

strings.text: 放置しておくと何をするかわからないから、表面上は協力しつつ上手くコントロールするしかなかった。
strings.translated: If I left him to his own devices, there was no telling what he might do -- so my only option was to appear cooperative on the surface while keeping him carefully under control.

strings.text: 嘘をつけば、どこからボロが出るかわからない。
strings.translated: If I lied, I had no idea where the cracks might show.

strings.text: 白坂君が本気で知りたがってる以上、話せるギリギリのところまで教えてあげるしかなかった。
strings.translated: Since Shirasaka-kun was genuinely determined to find out, I had no choice but to tell him as much as I safely could.

strings.text: もっとも、ここまで深く関わった彼にとっては、新しい収穫と言えるほどの内容はなかったかもしれないけど
strings.translated: Though for him, already involved this deeply, there may not have been much in what I said that counted as new information.

strings.text: 愛「私は…そんなに大したことは知らないから……」
strings.translated: Ai「I... don't really know all that much...」

strings.text: 表面上、私の知っていることを話して、白坂君を納得させることができた。
strings.translated: On the surface, I was able to tell him what I knew and satisfy Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: もちろん、本当はまだ隠していることがある。
strings.translated: Of course, in truth, there were still things I was hiding.

strings.text: 私のことや、園田のことは、まだ彼には教えなかった。
strings.translated: About myself, and about Sonoda -- I hadn't told him those things yet.

strings.text: 教えるべきではないという気持ちが、私の中にくすぶっていた
strings.translated: A feeling that I shouldn't tell him still smoldered inside me.

strings.text: さらに数日後、私と白坂君は小野田友佳の自宅に話を聞きに行くこととなった。
strings.translated: A few days later, Shirasaka-kun and I went to Yuka Onoda's home to hear what we could.

strings.text: もちろん、それを言い出したのは白坂君だ。
strings.translated: Of course, it was Shirasaka-kun who had suggested it.

strings.text: ほとんど他人同然の彼女のことを、彼は不思議なほどに気にかけていた。
strings.translated: He was concerned about her to a remarkable degree, even though she was practically a stranger to him.

strings.text: 幸いにして、私達は小野田友佳の母親から話を聞くことができた。
strings.translated: Fortunately, we were able to speak with Yuka Onoda's mother.

strings.text: 玄関先で生気を失ったような表情の母親の言葉に、白坂君は胸を痛めているようだった
strings.translated: Standing at the entryway, listening to the mother's words with the life drained from her face, Shirasaka-kun seemed to be hurting.

strings.text: あの子がどこへ行ってしまったのか、手がかりになるようなものも見つけられなかったの」
strings.translated: I couldn't find anything that might be a clue to where that girl had gone...」

strings.text: 話しながら、小野田友佳の母親は何度もすすり泣いた。
strings.translated: As she spoke, Yuka Onoda's mother sobbed repeatedly.

strings.text: 行方不明となった娘のことを、心から心配しているようだった
strings.translated: She seemed to be genuinely worried about her daughter, who had gone missing.

strings.text: 不思議な光景だった。
strings.translated: It was a strange sight.

strings.text: 一般的には当たり前なのかもしれないけど、たぶん私の母親はこんなふうにはならない。
strings.translated: It might be perfectly ordinary to most people, but my mother would probably never be like this.

strings.text: 普通の母親のいる普通の家庭。
strings.translated: A normal mother in a normal home.

strings.text: それが、小野田友佳の生活環境だった
strings.translated: That was the kind of environment Yuka Onoda had grown up in.

strings.text: 大智「書置きか…」
strings.translated: Daichi「A farewell note...」

strings.text: 小野田友佳の家からの帰り道、白坂君はぼんやりとした表情で考え事をしていた。
strings.translated: On the way back from Yuka Onoda's house, Shirasaka-kun walked with a distant expression, lost in thought.

strings.text: 母親からの情報だけで行方が掴めるはずがないのに、必死に何かの答えを導き出そうとしていた。
strings.translated: There was no way he could track down her whereabouts from his mother's information alone, yet he was desperately trying to work out some kind of answer.

strings.text: でも、それは無駄な努力。
strings.translated: But it was a futile effort.

strings.text: 小野田友佳は、既にこの世にいないのだから…。
strings.translated: Because Yuka Onoda was no longer in this world...

strings.text: 彼女はクラブのために自ら命を絶ち、その死体は処分された。
strings.translated: She had taken her own life for the Club, and her body had been disposed of.

strings.text: おそらく、小野田友佳の死体が発見されることはないだろう。
strings.translated: Most likely, Yuka Onoda's body would never be found.

strings.text: 行方不明のまま、事件は風化していくだろう。
strings.translated: The case would fade away, with her still listed as missing.

strings.text: この事実を白坂君が知ったら、彼はどう言った行動を取るのだろうか。
strings.translated: If Shirasaka-kun ever learned this truth, what would he do?

strings.text: それを見てみたかったが、私の口から真実を話すわけにはいかなかった
strings.translated: I wanted to see that -- but I couldn't be the one to tell him the truth.

strings.text: 何かを思いついたようで、白坂君は途中で私と別れた。
strings.translated: He seemed to have thought of something, and Shirasaka-kun parted ways with me partway through.

strings.text: もちろん、私は気づかれないように彼の後を追いかけた
strings.translated: Of course, I followed him without letting him notice.

strings.text: 本屋に行くというのは嘘で、本当は私を欺いて何かするつもりかと思ったのだけど、彼は素直に書店に入っていった。
strings.translated: He had said he was going to a bookstore, and I thought it might be a lie -- that he was trying to deceive me and do something on his own -- but he walked straight into a bookshop.

strings.text: 気づかれないように様子を窺っていると、白坂君が足を止めたのは心理学に関する本が並んだコーナーだった。
strings.translated: Watching from a distance so as not to be noticed, I saw Shirasaka-kun stop in front of a section lined with books on psychology.

strings.text: どうやら、宗教や洗脳に関する本を読むつもりらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed he intended to read about religion and brainwashing.

strings.text: 何冊かの本を取ってページを捲る彼の表情は真剣そのものだった
strings.translated: The expression on his face as he picked up several books and flipped through the pages was utterly serious.

strings.text: しばらく遠くから眺めていたけど、白坂君の行動は変わらなかった。
strings.translated: I watched from a distance for a while, but Shirasaka-kun's behavior didn't change.

strings.text: どうやら、本当にそういった本を読むのが目的だったらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed that reading those books really was his only purpose.

strings.text: 私は、放置していても問題ないと判断して、先にクラブに向かうことにした
strings.translated: I decided he was safe to leave on his own, and headed to the Club ahead of him.

strings.text: クラブには円夏の姿があった。
strings.translated: Madoka was at the Club.

strings.text: あれだけ怖がっていたはずなのに、どうやら自分だけでここへ来たようだった
strings.translated: She had seemed so frightened before, yet it appeared she had come here on her own.

strings.text: 円夏が気まずそうに返事をする。
strings.translated: Madoka answered with an awkward, uncomfortable look.

strings.text: この様子だと、このクラブでのセックスも体験したところらしい。
strings.translated: From the look of things, she had already experienced sex here at the Club.

strings.text: 園田の言葉に騙されて、肉体を開発され始めているようだった
strings.translated: It seemed she had been deceived by Sonoda's words and was beginning to have her body developed.

strings.text: 最後に奇妙な言葉を残して、円夏は部屋を出て行った。
strings.translated: Madoka left the room with those strange parting words.

strings.text: いったい何を考えているのか。
strings.translated: What on earth was she thinking?

strings.text: 私を助けるとはどういう意味なのか。
strings.translated: What did she mean by helping me?

strings.text: 白坂君のそれとは全く違ったもののような気がして、私は胸がざわつくのを感じた。
strings.translated: It felt like something entirely different from what Shirasaka-kun had meant, and I felt a restlessness stir in my chest.

strings.text: 円夏の言葉が耳の奥に残って、小さな苛立ちが胸の奥に生まれていた
strings.translated: Madoka's words lingered in the back of my ears, and a small irritation was born somewhere deep inside me.

strings.text: 愛「う…ぁ…あ…っ、いやぁ…っ！
思わずわたしは悲鳴混じりな声をあげながら、目の前に差し出されたお皿と、お母さん…そして、おじさんの顔を何度も見てしまっていた。
strings.translated: I let out a scream-laced cry before I could stop myself, my eyes darting back and forth between the plate set in front of me, my mother... and the man's face, over and over again.

strings.text: だって、これは
strings.translated: Because this was...

strings.text: 母／静子「どうしたの？
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「What's wrong?

strings.text: 愛ちゃん。
strings.translated: Ai.

strings.text: いつものように食べなさい」
strings.translated: Eat it like you always do.」

strings.text: お母さんはおじさんが居るせいか、にこにこと笑顔を浮かべたまま、わたしにそういう。
strings.translated: Perhaps because the man was there, my mother kept a smile on her face as she said that to me.

strings.text: でも…わたしの目の前にあるのは…。
strings.translated: But... what was in front of me was...

strings.text: 男「そうだよ、愛ちゃん。
strings.translated: Man「Come on, Ai.

strings.text: せっかくおじさんが用意したご馳走なんだから、笑顔で食べてほしいなぁ」
strings.translated: It's a special treat your uncle went out of his way to prepare, so I want to see you eat it with a smile.」

strings.text: おじさんはにこにこと笑いながら、わたしが目の前のそれに口を付けるのを楽しみにしているようだ
strings.translated: The man watched with a grin, clearly looking forward to seeing me put my mouth on the thing in front of me.

strings.text: 母／静子「そうよ、愛ちゃん。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「That's right, Ai.

strings.text: お客さんに失礼よ」
strings.translated: It's rude to our guest.」

strings.text: お母さんもおじさんの言葉に続けるように、わたしにそれを食べるようにうながしてくる
strings.translated: My mother followed the man's words, urging me to eat it.

strings.text: 愛「は、はい…」
strings.translated: Ai「Y-yes...」

strings.text: いつもご飯を食べる時の格好はこうだ。
strings.translated: This was always how it was when I ate.

strings.text: 床に置かれたお皿の前にはいつくばって、本物の犬みたいになって…それに顔を近づけた。
strings.translated: I got down on all fours in front of the plate placed on the floor, just like a real dog... and brought my face close to it.

strings.text: 顔を近づけて、鼻先にそれが近付くと、鼻の奥を突き刺すような、そして吐き気をもよおさせるにおいがわたしを痛めつける。
strings.translated: As my face drew near and it came close to the tip of my nose, a smell that stabbed deep into my nostrils -- a smell that made me want to retch -- assaulted me.

strings.text: 男「…へぇ、愛ちゃん、堂に入ってるなぁ」
strings.translated: Man「...Well, well, Ai-chan -- she's really got it down, hasn't she.」

strings.text: 這いつくばったまま、それに顔を近づけているわたしを見て、おじさんが珍しいものを見たとでもいいたいように言葉を発する
strings.translated: Still crawling on all fours with my face drawn close to it, the man spoke as if he were looking at something rare and curious.

strings.text: 母／静子「主人の教育方針ですのよ。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「It's my husband's approach to discipline.

strings.text: こうして、毎日毎日、自分の程度ともうしますか…身の程を知ることが大切と申していまして」
strings.translated: He says it's important to know one's... place, shall we say... one's station in life, and so every day, every day, we do this.」

strings.text: いつもわたしはこうやって食事するようにさせられている。
strings.translated: I was always made to eat this way.

strings.text: たべものは、いつもお父さんやお母さんの食べ残し。
strings.translated: The food was always whatever my father and mother had left over.

strings.text: それを床に這いつくばって床に置かれたお皿から食べる。
strings.translated: I ate it crawling on the floor from a plate set on the ground.

strings.text: でも、それはずっといいほう。
strings.translated: But that was far better than this.

strings.text: だって、今、わたしの目の前にあるのは…上にうんちの載せられたご飯だったから。
strings.translated: Because what was in front of me right now was... a bowl of rice with feces piled on top.

strings.text: 男「なるほど、毎日かぁ。
strings.translated: Man「I see, every day, huh.

strings.text: それは慣れもするよねぇ、愛ちゃんも」
strings.translated: You'd get used to it, wouldn't you, Ai.」

strings.text: お母さんの説明にうなずいてみせるおじさん。
strings.translated: The man nodded along to my mother's explanation.

strings.text: うなずきながらもおじさんは、わたしが目の前のご飯に…いいや、目の前のうんちに口を付けるのは今か今かと見つめている
strings.translated: Even as he nodded, he was watching intently, waiting for the moment I would put my mouth to the food -- no, to the feces -- in front of me.

strings.text: 母／静子「もちろん、学校では他の子たちにあわせるようにはさせてますのよ。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「Of course, at school I have her act like the other children.

strings.text: 今はほら…五月蝿いでしょう？
strings.translated: You know how it is these days... people make such a fuss.

strings.text: その辺…」
strings.translated: About that sort of thing...」

strings.text: 男「ははは、それはそうですなぁ。
strings.translated: Man「Hahaha, yes, I suppose that's true.

strings.text: 目に見えるところに傷でもあった日には、それこそ大変だ
strings.translated: If she had visible injuries, that would really cause trouble.

strings.text: 母／静子「ええ、ですから…しつけも大変ですの」
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「Yes, so... discipline is quite difficult.」

strings.text: お母さんとおじさんが話をしているけど、その中身はわたしの耳にはほとんど入ってこない。
strings.translated: My mother and the man were talking, but their words barely reached my ears.

strings.text: わたしの意識は、目の前のご飯皿にのっているうんちに縛り付けられているみたいになっていた。
strings.translated: My consciousness was fixed, as if bound, to the feces sitting on the plate in front of me.

strings.text: …これを、食べなければならない
strings.translated: ...I had to eat this.

strings.text: 愛「うぐっ…うぅ…っぷ」
strings.translated: Ai「Ugh... uuu... hup.」

strings.text: なんとか口を付けようと顔を近づけると、いやでもうんちの匂いが鼻を刺すように飛び込んできて…吐かないようにすることで精一杯だった。
strings.translated: As I steeled myself and brought my face close, the smell of the feces forced its way into my nose like a stab, and all I could do was fight not to vomit.

strings.text: これまでも、へんなものを食べさせられたことは何度もあった。
strings.translated: There had been many times before when I was made to eat strange things.

strings.text: 腐りかけた食べ物や、お客さんの精液やおしっこがかけられたものを同じように食べさせられたことは何度もある。
strings.translated: I had been made to eat food that was half-rotten, or things doused in a customer's semen or urine, in the same way, many times.

strings.text: だけど、ここまでのことは
strings.translated: But something like this --

strings.text: 母／静子「…愛ちゃん？」
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「...Ai?」

strings.text: わたしが躊躇していると、あたまの上からお母さんの声が浴びせられた。
strings.translated: As I hesitated, my mother's voice poured down from above my head.

strings.text: 柔らかくいっているように聞こえても、その中にわたしに逆らわせないようにしようという厳しさや恐さが隠されたその声

strings.text: 母／静子「食べ終わったら、ごちそうしてくださったお客さんにお礼をいわなくちゃ」
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「When you've finished eating, you have to thank the guest who treated you.」

strings.text: お母さんにそういわれるまま、わたしはおじさんのほうに顔を向けて
strings.translated: Doing as my mother told me, I turned my face toward my uncle and --

strings.text: 愛「あ、ありがとう…ご、ございまひゅ…」
strings.translated: Ai「Th-thank you... very... much...」

strings.text: どうにか笑顔をつくって、お礼をいった。
strings.translated: I somehow managed to form a smile and said my thanks.

strings.text: 気持ち悪さに歪んでしまっているだろう顔を、無理矢理にこわばらせるようにして作った笑顔。
strings.translated: A smile I forced onto a face that must have been twisted with nausea -- stiffened and shaped by sheer will.

strings.text: 心の中では、その笑顔でおじさんが満足してくれるか、それが恐くて仕方なかった
strings.translated: Deep inside, I was terrified -- terrified of whether that smile would be enough to satisfy my uncle.

strings.text: 母／静子「まぁ、愛ちゃんったら。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「My, Ai-chan.

strings.text: そんなに泣くほど感謝して…」
strings.translated: Crying that much just to show your gratitude...」

strings.text: お母さんはそういうけど、わたしはお礼をいう前から泣いている。
strings.translated: But I was already crying before I even said my thanks -- my mother knew that.

strings.text: お母さんだって、さっき、それをいっていた。
strings.translated: My mother had said it herself, just a moment ago.

strings.text: でも、そういう風にいった方がおじさんがもっと満足するだろう、って思ったんだろう。
strings.translated: But she must have thought that framing it that way would make my uncle even more satisfied.

strings.text: 男「いやー、そんなに喜んでもらえると、おじさんも頑張って出した甲斐があるってものだねぇ」
strings.translated: Man「Well now -- seeing you so happy about it makes it all worthwhile for your uncle, having worked so hard to produce it.」

strings.text: おじさんはすっかり満足したのか、本当に嬉しそうにわたしに声をかけてくる。
strings.translated: My uncle seemed thoroughly satisfied, and called out to me with what sounded like genuine delight.

strings.text: すごく優しく聞こえるその声。
strings.translated: That voice -- it sounded so gentle.

strings.text: いっていることは本当にひどいことなのに、怒られるよりはマシだと思うと優しく感じてしまった
strings.translated: What he was saying was truly awful, yet knowing it was better than being scolded made it feel gentle to me.

strings.text: 母／静子「ほら、愛ちゃん。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「Come on, Ai-chan.

strings.text: もっと笑って。
strings.translated: Smile more.

strings.text: 嬉しいなら笑うの。
strings.translated: If you're happy, you smile.

strings.text: わかるわよね
strings.translated: You understand, don't you.」

strings.text: 愛「え…えへっ…えへへっ…あは…ははは…」
strings.translated: Ai「Eh... ehe... ehehe... aha... hahaha...」

strings.text: わたしはお母さんにいわれるまま、作り笑いに笑い声をつけ加える。
strings.translated: Just as my mother told me, I added a laughing voice to my forced smile.

strings.text: 喉の奥から絞り出される笑い声は、とってもうんちくさい笑い声だ。
strings.translated: The laughter squeezed up from the back of my throat -- a laugh that smelled very much of feces.

strings.text: 男「それにしても…さっき言ってたおしおき…くい打ちでしたかな？
strings.translated: Man「Even so... that punishment you mentioned earlier... was it the stake, if I recall?

strings.text: ほら、おまんこに棒を突っ込んで…っていう。
strings.translated: You know, the one where you shove a rod into her little pussy...

strings.text: あれも楽しみだったんですがねぇ」
strings.translated: I was rather looking forward to that one.」

strings.text: おじさんがお母さんになにかをいっているようだ。
strings.translated: My uncle seemed to be saying something to my mother.

strings.text: でも、やっぱりわたしの耳にはなにをいっているかわからない
strings.translated: But still, I couldn't make out what they were saying -- it wasn't reaching my ears.

strings.text: 母／静子「あら、でしたら改めてお見せいたしましょうか。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「Oh, in that case, shall I arrange to show you again?

strings.text: すぐに主人に用意させますので」
strings.translated: I'll have my husband prepare it right away.」

strings.text: 二人が何かを話している、ということだけはわかったけど…そのときの私には
strings.translated: I could tell that the two of them were talking about something... but at that point, I --

strings.text: 母／静子「愛ちゃんも、それでいいわよね。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「That's fine with you too, isn't it, Ai-chan.

strings.text: お客さんに楽しんでもらえるなら、うれしいわよね
strings.translated: You'd be happy to let the guest enjoy himself, wouldn't you.」

strings.text: 愛「えへへっ…うれひい…でひゅっ…えへ、えへへ…」
strings.translated: Ai「Ehehe... I'm so happy... dehyu... ehe, ehehe...」

strings.text: なにも考えられずに、お母さんのいった「うれしい」
strings.translated: Unable to think of anything, I could only respond to the word "happy"

strings.text: という言葉にだけこたえる私。
strings.translated: that my mother had said.

strings.text: 頭の中までうんちでいっぱいになってしまっているようになっていた私には、そんな受け答えをすることしかできなかった
strings.translated: My head had become so full of filth that I was incapable of anything more than that kind of hollow reply.

strings.text: その後、私は１回目の転校をした。
strings.translated: After that, I transferred schools for the first time.

strings.text: 新しい学校で私はお父さんとお母さんの養女になった。
strings.translated: At the new school, I became the adopted daughter of Father and Mother.

strings.text: 「虐待されていたかわいそうな女の子をひきとった」
strings.translated: "We took in a poor girl who had been abused" --

strings.text: とお父さんは新しい先生に言った。
strings.translated: that was what Father told the new teacher.

strings.text: 「むごたらしい傷跡があるから、他の子の前で裸にさせないでほしい」
strings.translated: "She has terrible scars, so please don't undress her in front of the other children" --

strings.text: と。
strings.translated: he said.

strings.text: 私はお父さんに言われるままに頷き、お父さんに言われるままにお腹をめくって、傷跡を先生に見せた。
strings.translated: Just as Father told me to, I nodded, and just as Father told me to, I lifted my shirt and showed the teacher my scars.

strings.text: 先生はそれを見て顔を歪めた。
strings.translated: The teacher's face twisted when she saw them.

strings.text: 悲しそうな顔、だったと思う。
strings.translated: It looked like a sad expression, I think.

strings.text: 家に帰ったお父さんが言うには、「私を鞭で打った男の人が口裏をあわせてくれた」
strings.translated: When Father came home, he said that "the man who had whipped me had agreed to back up the story."

strings.text: らしい。
strings.translated: Apparently.

strings.text: あの男の人はちょうど私くらいの歳の生徒をもつ学校の先生だった。
strings.translated: That man happened to be a teacher at a school with students around my age.

strings.text: 大事な一人娘に酷い傷跡を残したのだから当然だ、とお父さんはお母さんに笑いながら語していた。
strings.translated: Father laughed as he told Mother it was only natural, since he had left such terrible scars on his precious only daughter.

strings.text: でもびっくりするほどのお金を払ってくれたから、転校の手間をかけるくらいの価値はあった、と、そう言ってまた笑った
strings.translated: But he laughed again and said that since the man had paid a surprisingly large sum of money, it had been worth the trouble of transferring schools.

strings.text: 本気で決意してから、白坂君は驚くほどクラブとの関わりを持っていった。
strings.translated: Once he had made up his mind in earnest, Shirasaka-kun became involved with the Club at a remarkable pace.

strings.text: まるで、クラブのことを本当に信じているように、ほぼ毎日顔を出すようになった。
strings.translated: As if he truly believed in the Club, he began showing up almost every day.

strings.text: 男女を問わずセックスに応じるようになったし、園田に対してもとても協力的になった。
strings.translated: He started accepting sex regardless of gender, and became very cooperative with Sonoda as well.

strings.text: 結果、園田からの信頼も得られているようで、クラブのための簡単な仕事を任されるようになっていった。
strings.translated: As a result, it seemed he had earned Sonoda's trust, and he began to be entrusted with simple tasks for the Club.

strings.text: もっとも、肉体的にも精神的にも疲労の色は隠せない。
strings.translated: Even so, the signs of physical and mental exhaustion were impossible to hide.

strings.text: 相当な無理をしているため、クラブ以外の場所では心が壊れたようにぼんやりとしていることが多くなっていった。
strings.translated: Because he was pushing himself so hard, outside of the Club he often seemed to drift about with a hollow look, as if his mind had broken.

strings.text: どうしてそこまでするのか。
strings.translated: Why go that far?

strings.text: 今の彼は、姉だけでなく、クラブの全員を救おうとしている。
strings.translated: Right now, he was trying to save not just his sister, but every single person in the Club.

strings.text: クラブは悪いところだと考えて、関わっている人間の全てを解放しようとしている。
strings.translated: He believed the Club was a bad place, and was trying to free everyone involved with it.

strings.text: それは、とても難しい事で、容易な事ではなくて、普通なら諦めてもおかしくないはずなのに、白坂君は決して自分の考え方を曲げなかった
strings.translated: It was an incredibly difficult thing -- not easy by any measure -- and normally anyone would have given up by now, yet Shirasaka-kun never once bent his convictions.

strings.text: 愛「みんなが解放されたら、あなたは救われるの？」
strings.translated: Ai「If everyone is freed, will you be saved?」

strings.text: 胸に浮かんだ疑問が口をついた。
strings.translated: A question that had risen in my chest slipped out of my mouth.

strings.text: ごく普通の学生だった彼が、同性の同級生との行為に及んでまで、みんなを助けようとしている。
strings.translated: An ordinary student until recently, he was going so far as to engage in acts with male classmates, all to help everyone.

strings.text: クラブを壊すことで、自分の目的を果たそうとしている。
strings.translated: He was trying to achieve his goal by destroying the Club.

strings.text: でも、今クラブに通っている大半の人達にとっては、白坂君の行動は余計なお世話のはずだ。
strings.translated: But for most of the people currently coming to the Club, Shirasaka-kun's actions would be nothing but unwanted interference.

strings.text: 自分ではない他人の勝手な考えによって、救いの場所を壊されたとしたら白坂君にどんな報復をするかわかったものではない。
strings.translated: If someone were to destroy their place of salvation based on another person's selfish ideas, there was no telling what kind of retaliation they might take against Shirasaka-kun.

strings.text: そして、白坂君はそれも理解した上で、自分の計画を前に進めているようだった
strings.translated: And yet, Shirasaka-kun seemed to be moving his plan forward with full understanding of that as well.

strings.text: 愛「私はどうしたら…」
strings.translated: Ai「What am I supposed to do...」

strings.text: 今のところ白坂君の行動は把握している。
strings.translated: For now, I have a grasp on Shirasaka-kun's movements.

strings.text: ある程度は、行動もコントロールすることができる。
strings.translated: To a certain extent, I can also control his actions.

strings.text: では、私は彼をどう使うべきなのか。
strings.translated: So then -- how should I make use of him?

strings.text: どんな目的のために、どんな行動を取らせるべきなのだろうか。
strings.translated: For what purpose, and toward what end, should I be directing his actions?

strings.text: 屋上でぼんやりとする白坂君の背中を見つめながら、私はそんなことを考えていた。
strings.translated: I was thinking about all of this as I stared at Shirasaka-kun's back, where he stood gazing absently on the rooftop.

strings.text: 実際のところ、明確な目的というのは浮かばない。
strings.translated: In truth, no clear objective comes to mind.

strings.text: 私はただ、白坂君がどこまでやれるのか、どんな結果を導いて来るのか、それを見たいだけだった。
strings.translated: I simply wanted to see how far Shirasaka-kun could go, and what kind of outcome he would bring about.

strings.text: クラブを否定する人がどんな未来を掴むのか、その結果で私の疑問も少しは解消されるのか、それを知りたかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to know what kind of future someone who rejected the Club would manage to grasp -- and whether that result might resolve even a little of my own doubts.

strings.text: 自分の立場を再確認して、私は屋上の白坂君に近づいて行った
strings.translated: Reaffirming my own position, I began to walk toward Shirasaka-kun on the rooftop.

strings.text: 愛「こんな所にいたの
strings.translated: Ai「So this is where you were.」

strings.text: 声をかけると、白坂君は黙ったまま私のほうを振り向いた。
strings.translated: When I called out to him, Shirasaka-kun turned to face me without a word.

strings.text: 疲れ果てた表情に、微かな笑みが浮かんだような気がした
strings.translated: A faint smile seemed to flicker across his exhausted expression.

strings.text: 強い決意を抱いていても、それが揺らぐことはあるようだった。
strings.translated: Even with a strong resolve, it seemed there were moments when it faltered.

strings.text: クラブの人達の幸せそうな姿が、白坂君の心に痛みを残しているのだろう。
strings.translated: The sight of the Club members looking happy must have been leaving a wound in Shirasaka-kun's heart.

strings.text: どんな理由があるにせよ、彼の行動はみんなを裏切ることだ。
strings.translated: Whatever his reasons, his actions were a betrayal of everyone around him.

strings.text: 周りからの信頼が強ければ強いほど、そのダメージは大きくなっていく。
strings.translated: The stronger the trust placed in him, the greater the damage would be.

strings.text: もちろん、白坂君はそれも覚悟したはずだけど、簡単に割り切ることはできないらしかった
strings.translated: Of course, Shirasaka-kun must have steeled himself for that too -- but it seemed he couldn't simply make peace with it.

strings.text: でも……頑張らないと」
strings.translated: But... I have to keep going.」

strings.text: 今のところ、諦めるつもりはないらしい。
strings.translated: For now, it seemed he had no intention of giving up.

strings.text: でも、こういうのは油断できない。
strings.translated: But this kind of thing couldn't be taken for granted.

strings.text: まだ大丈夫だと思っていて、突然心が折れることなど決して珍しくはないからだ。
strings.translated: It was never unusual for someone to think they were still fine, only to suddenly break.

strings.text: ましてや、今、白坂君の立たされた状況は、普通ではあり得ないほど過酷なものだ。
strings.translated: And the situation Shirasaka-kun had been placed in right now was harsh beyond anything ordinary.

strings.text: こんな会話をしている数時間後には、自分の目的を諦めてしまってもおかしくなかった。
strings.translated: It wouldn't have been strange at all if, just a few hours after this conversation, he gave up on his goal entirely.

strings.text: そろそろ救いの手を差し伸べるべきだろうか。
strings.translated: Should I reach out a helping hand soon?

strings.text: 差し伸べるとしたら、どんな形が良いのだろうか。
strings.translated: And if so, in what form?

strings.text: 頭の中で考えていると、白坂君がさらに言葉を続けた
strings.translated: As I was turning it over in my mind, Shirasaka-kun continued speaking.

strings.text: 大智「うちの爺さんと婆さんの家」
strings.translated: Daichi「My grandpa and grandma's house.」

strings.text: 白坂君なりの計画は進んでいるようだった。
strings.translated: It seemed Shirasaka-kun's own plan was moving forward.

strings.text: みんなを助けたいと思っていても、やっぱり姉の優先度は高いらしい。
strings.translated: Even though he wanted to help everyone, his sister's priority was still clearly higher.

strings.text: 夏休みの間、クラブに通えなくすると言うのは、確かに悪くない案だった。
strings.translated: Keeping her away from the Club for the duration of summer break -- that was genuinely not a bad idea.

strings.text: しかも、そんなことをされてしまっては、私も彼の行動が把握できなくなる。
strings.translated: And if that happened, I would lose track of his movements too.

strings.text: 彼だけでなく、白坂美桜の状態もわからなくなってしまう。
strings.translated: Not just his, but Shirasaka Mio's condition would become unknown to me as well.

strings.text: 今すぐに対処することはできないけど、これも放置することのできない問題だった。
strings.translated: I couldn't deal with it immediately, but this was also a problem I couldn't leave alone.

strings.text: 旅行の計画を潰すか、それとも私も誘ってもらうように仕向けるか…近いうちに方法を選ばなければならないようだった
strings.translated: Should I find a way to derail the travel plans, or maneuver myself into being invited along... it seemed I would need to choose a course of action before long.

strings.text: 大智「姉さんを騙してることになるから、ちょっと辛いな
strings.translated: Daichi「It means I'm deceiving my sister, so it's a little painful.」

strings.text: 白坂君の表情が、今にも泣きそうになる。
strings.translated: Shirasaka-kun's expression looked like he might burst into tears at any moment.

strings.text: 姉とのセックスを受け入れるというのは、彼にとって何よりも辛いことらしい。
strings.translated: Accepting sex with his sister seemed to be the most painful thing in the world for him.

strings.text: もっとも、それがどれほどの辛さなのかは私にはわからない。
strings.translated: Though just how painful that was, I couldn't really understand.

strings.text: 他人とするのと、姉とするのと、果たしてそこにどれほどの違いがあると言うのか。
strings.translated: Doing it with a stranger versus doing it with his own sister -- how great a difference could there truly be between the two?

strings.text: 具体的な感想を聞いてみたかったけど、さすがにそれを口に出すのは避けた。
strings.translated: I wanted to ask him for his honest impressions, but I thought better of actually saying that out loud.

strings.text: 重要なのは、白坂君の心が折れない事。
strings.translated: What mattered was that Shirasaka-kun's spirit didn't break.

strings.text: 様々な事に耐えているのはわかっていたけど、白坂美桜とのセックスに関してまでは頭が回らなかった。
strings.translated: I knew he was enduring all manner of things, but I hadn't thought far enough to consider the matter of sex with Shirasaka Mio.

strings.text: この様子だと、行為に及んだのは１回や２回ではないのだろう。
strings.translated: Judging by his state, it couldn't have been just once or twice that they had gone through with it.

strings.text: 目的を達するまで彼の心がもつのかどうか、私にとっては大きな不安だった
strings.translated: Whether his heart would hold out until he achieved his goal was a serious source of anxiety for me.

strings.text: 白坂君は強い口調で言った。
strings.translated: Shirasaka-kun said it in a firm tone.

strings.text: どうやら彼の中では、クラブは絶対的な悪と言う答えが出たらしい。
strings.translated: It seemed that within him, the answer had been settled -- the Club was an absolute evil.

strings.text: この先どんな事があっても、白坂君のこの考え方が変わることはないだろう。
strings.translated: Whatever happened from here on, that conviction of Shirasaka-kun's would never change.

strings.text: だからこそ、みんなのことを助けたいという気持ちは、以前にも増して強くなっているはずだった。
strings.translated: And precisely because of that, his desire to help everyone must have grown even stronger than before.

strings.text: 正直、驚きを隠せない。
strings.translated: Honestly, I couldn't hide my surprise.

strings.text: 最初に会ったときはごく普通の男の子だったのに、ここまで強い精神力を持ってるなんて思いも寄らなかった。
strings.translated: When I first met him he had been such an ordinary boy -- I never would have imagined he possessed this kind of mental strength.

strings.text: いつ心が折れるとも知れないと思う一方で、これほど強い精神力を持っている白坂君なら本当にクラブを壊してしまうかもしれない。
strings.translated: While thinking that his spirit might break at any moment, I also thought that a Shirasaka-kun with this much strength of will might actually destroy the Club for real.

strings.text: それは、私にとっていいことなのか、悪いことなのか…私の中では、期待とも不安とも言えない気持ちが渦巻いていた
strings.translated: Whether that would be good or bad for me... within me, something that was neither expectation nor anxiety swirled around.

strings.text: 白坂君の質問には迷った。
strings.translated: I hesitated at Shirasaka-kun's question.

strings.text: 今の彼に対して、私はどう答えるべきなのか。
strings.translated: How should I answer him right now?

strings.text: いや、そうではない。
strings.translated: No -- that wasn't it.

strings.text: 実際に私はどう思っているのか。
strings.translated: What did I actually think?

strings.text: どうしてあそこにいるのか。
strings.translated: Why was I there?

strings.text: 他の選択肢がなかったから？
strings.translated: Because there were no other options?

strings.text: 生き残るため？
strings.translated: To survive?

strings.text: それとも、もっと他の理由があるのだろうか。
strings.translated: Or was there some other reason?

strings.text: 自分の心を探るようにして答えを見つけ出そうとしたけど、その前に私達以外の声が聞こえてきた
strings.translated: I tried to search my own heart and find the answer -- but before I could, a voice other than ours reached me.

strings.text: 円夏「２人ともこんなところにいたんだ」
strings.translated: Madoka「Oh, you two were up here.」

strings.text: 屋上に姿を現したのは円夏だった
strings.translated: The one who appeared on the rooftop was Madoka.

strings.text: 茶化すような言葉。
strings.translated: A teasing remark.

strings.text: 私と白坂君がどんな話をしていたかなんて、円夏には想像もできていないだろう。
strings.translated: Madoka couldn't have imagined what kind of conversation Shirasaka-kun and I had been having.

strings.text: たぶん、私達が恋人同士のような会話を楽しんでいたと、そんな平和な考えが頭に浮かんでいるようだった
strings.translated: Probably some peaceful notion had floated into her head -- that we had been enjoying a conversation like a couple would.

strings.text: 白坂君に別れを告げて、私は円夏とともに校舎内へと戻った。
strings.translated: I said goodbye to Shirasaka-kun and returned inside the school building together with Madoka.

strings.text: 確かに昼食を一緒に摂る約束はしていたけど、このタイミングで来てくれたのはちょうど良かった。
strings.translated: We had made plans to eat lunch together, but her timing in showing up was actually convenient.

strings.text: 白坂君の質問に対する答えは、簡単には出そうにない。

strings.translated: Father (Sonoda)「Well, we'll squeeze a little more out of her, and at the end we can hand her off to those perverts for one last payday.」

strings.text: 身体を動かすのが億劫で、私は黙ってお父さんの話を聞いていた。
strings.translated: Moving my body felt like too much effort, and I lay there in silence, listening to Dad talk.

strings.text: 何も考えてはいなかった
strings.translated: I wasn't thinking about anything at all.

strings.text: 母／静子「でも…死体はどうするんですか？
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「But... what do we do with the body?

strings.text: お父さん、逮捕されちゃうんですか？
strings.translated: Dad... are you going to get arrested?

strings.text: 父／園田「馬鹿なこと言うな。
strings.translated: Father (Sonoda)「Don't be stupid.

strings.text: 矢野さんがな、山に工場を持ってるんだってよ。
strings.translated: Yano-san has a factory up in the mountains, apparently.

strings.text: 死体なんかそこに持ってけばなくなっちまう。
strings.translated: Take a body there and it just disappears.

strings.text: あとはまた名前を変えて引越しゃいい事だ
strings.translated: After that we just change our names and move again, simple as that.」

strings.text: 母／静子「そうなんですか
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「Is that so.」

strings.text: 父／園田「もう矢野さんに約束は取り付けてあるんだ。
strings.translated: Father (Sonoda)「I've already made arrangements with Yano-san.

strings.text: 売り時を逃さないようにしないとな
strings.translated: We can't afford to miss the right time to sell.」

strings.text: 父／園田「しかし、問題は次だな。
strings.translated: Father (Sonoda)「The problem is what comes next, though.

strings.text: お前は子供を仕込むにゃ薹が立ちすぎてるし、他の女に仕込むにしても今からじゃなぁ
strings.translated: You're too old to be raising another kid, and if we had to groom someone else it'd take too long from scratch.」

strings.text: 母／静子「はい…。
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「Yes...

strings.text: すみません
strings.translated: I'm sorry.」

strings.text: 父／園田「孤児院でも行って適当なのを見繕ってみるか…。
strings.translated: Father (Sonoda)「Maybe I'll head to an orphanage and pick out something suitable...

strings.text: それともまた馬鹿どもを騙す商売に戻るか
strings.translated: Or maybe go back to the business of swindling those fools.」

strings.text: ようやく起き上がるだけの力が出来て、私は起き上がって、隣のへ部屋のふすまに手をかけた
strings.translated: At last I found the strength just to get up, and I rose and reached for the sliding door to the next room.

strings.text: 父／園田「おう、起きたのか。
strings.translated: Father (Sonoda)「Oh, you're up.

strings.text: お前また糞したんだってな？
strings.translated: I heard you soiled yourself again?

strings.text: ろくに食ってもいないくせに糞だけは立派に漏らしやがって…さっさと風呂に入って来い。
strings.translated: You can't even eat properly but you still manage to shit yourself just fine... get in the bath already.

strings.text: 臭くてかなわん
strings.translated: The smell is unbearable.」

strings.text: 愛「…はい」
strings.translated: Ai「...Yes.」

strings.text: 私と入れ違いに、笑顔のお母さんが部屋に入って行った。
strings.translated: As I left, Mom passed me going the other way, smiling as she entered the room.

strings.text: 汚れた布団を片付けるんだろう
strings.translated: She was probably going to clean up the dirty bedding.

strings.text: 湯船にはまだお湯が残っていて、少しぬるいくらいだった。
strings.translated: The bathwater still had some warmth left in it -- just a little lukewarm.

strings.text: 暖かいうちに目が覚めてよかった。
strings.translated: It was good that I woke up while it was still warm.

strings.text: お湯を足したりしたら怒られるから、あるもので身体を綺麗にしないといけない
strings.translated: Adding more hot water would make Dad angry, so I had to clean myself with what was there.

strings.text: 身体を綺麗にして、ぬるい湯船につかりながら、私はぼんやりと考えた。
strings.translated: I cleaned my body and soaked in the lukewarm tub, letting my mind drift.

strings.text: 私は死ぬんだ。
strings.translated: I'm going to die.

strings.text: 今は生きているけど、いつか……そう遠くないうちに。
strings.translated: I'm alive now, but someday... before too long.

strings.text: 多分、近いうちに。
strings.translated: Probably soon.

strings.text: 私は死ぬ……多分楽には死なせてもらえないだろう。
strings.translated: I'm going to die... they probably won't let me die easily.

strings.text: いっぱい痛い思いをして、たくさん辛い目にあって、それから殺されるんだと思う。
strings.translated: I'll suffer a lot of pain, go through a lot of misery, and then they'll kill me. That's what I think.

strings.text: 私は死ぬ。
strings.translated: I'm going to die.

strings.text: お父さんが私をいらないと思ったら。
strings.translated: When Dad decides he doesn't need me anymore.

strings.text: 私はもう役に立たないと思ったら。
strings.translated: When he decides I'm no longer useful.

strings.text: 殺される。
strings.translated: I'll be killed.

strings.text: いつか必ず、その日が来る
strings.translated: Someday, without fail, that day will come.

strings.text: どうすれば……死なずにすむんだろう……どうしたら
strings.translated: How could I... avoid dying... what could I do...

strings.text: ずっとそのことばかりを考え続けた
strings.translated: I kept thinking about nothing else for a long, long time.

strings.text: 優衣「愛ちゃん、おはよう
strings.translated: Yui「Good morning, Ai-chan.」

strings.text: 愛「おはよう」
strings.translated: Ai「Good morning.」

strings.text: 次の日になっても、良い考えは浮かばなかった。
strings.translated: Even the next day, no good ideas came to me.

strings.text: どうすれば死なずにすむのか。
strings.translated: How could I avoid dying.

strings.text: どうしたら生きていられるのか
strings.translated: How could I keep living.

strings.text: 優衣「ねぇ愛ちゃん。
strings.translated: Yui「Hey, Ai-chan.

strings.text: 夏休みって、予定ある？」
strings.translated: Do you have any plans for summer break?」

strings.text: 優衣ちゃんは今日も楽しそうに、幸せそうに、私に話しかけてくる
strings.translated: Yui-chan spoke to me again today, cheerful and happy as always.

strings.text: 愛「夏休み…」
strings.translated: Ai「Summer break...」

strings.text: 私は夏休みまで生きていられるだろうか
