strings.translated: It was a relief that someone was there, but I had no idea who it was.

strings.text: さっきまで必死に謝ってたのに、今は全然別の人が近づいてきてるんじゃないかって、そんな予感にとらわれていた。
strings.translated: I had been desperately crying out just moments ago, but now I was gripped by a feeling that someone completely different might be approaching.

strings.text: もしも…もしも、そうだったら？
strings.translated: What if... what if that was the case?

strings.text: お兄ちゃんでもお姉ちゃんでもなくて、友達の人でもなくて、全然知らない人が入って来たら？
strings.translated: What if it wasn't my brother or my sister, not his friend either -- what if a total stranger walked in?

strings.text: その可能性を考えると、急に今まで声を出してたことが怖くなってしまった。
strings.translated: When I considered that possibility, I suddenly became frightened of all the noise I had been making.

strings.text: 誰？
strings.translated: Who are you?」

strings.text: 誰が来るの？
strings.translated: Who was coming?

strings.text: 知らない人だったら、どうしたらいいの？
strings.translated: What would I do if it was someone I didn't know?

strings.text: 不安に心が押しつぶされそうになって、私はその場から後ずさりした
strings.translated: My heart was being crushed under the weight of my anxiety, and I backed away from the door.

strings.text: 芽生「……っ」
足音が停まった。
strings.translated: The footsteps stopped.

strings.text: 私の部屋の前で止まって、鍵を開ける音が聞こえてきた。
strings.translated: They stopped right in front of my room, and I heard the sound of a key turning in the lock.

strings.text: 誰かが入ってくる。
strings.translated: Someone was coming in.

strings.text: それは、もう間違いない。
strings.translated: There was no doubt about it now.

strings.text: もしも、知らない人だったら、ここは完全に逃げ場がなかった。
strings.translated: If it was a stranger, there was absolutely nowhere to run in this room.

strings.text: どうか知ってる人でありますように…。
strings.translated: Please let it be someone I know...

strings.text: お兄ちゃんかお姉ちゃんでありますように…。
strings.translated: Please let it be my brother or my sister...

strings.text: 私は心の中で祈りながら、ドアがゆっくりと開く光景を見つめていた
strings.translated: I prayed silently as I watched the door slowly swing open.

strings.text: 男
strings.translated: Man

strings.text: 芽生「あ…」
strings.translated: Mei「Oh...」

strings.text: 男の人が入って来た。
strings.translated: A man walked in.

strings.text: 薄暗いからよくわからないけど、お兄ちゃんでもお姉ちゃんでもないのは確かだった。
strings.translated: It was dim, so I couldn't see clearly, but I was certain it was neither my brother nor my sister.

strings.text: 男の人は何も言わない。
strings.translated: The man said nothing.

strings.text: 部屋の中にいる私を確認して、じっと目を合わせてきた。
strings.translated: He confirmed I was in the room and held my gaze steadily.

strings.text: 誰だろう。
strings.translated: Who is this?

strings.text: 全然知らない人だ。
strings.translated: A complete stranger.

strings.text: 本当に会ったこともない人が入って来た。
strings.translated: Someone I have truly never met in my life just walked in.

strings.text: こういう場合は…どうしたらいいんだろう？
strings.translated: In a situation like this... what am I supposed to do?

strings.text: 芽生「えっ？」
strings.translated: Mei「Huh?」

strings.text: １人かと思ったら２人目が入ってきた。
strings.translated: I thought there was only one, but a second person came in.

strings.text: ２人目が入ってきたら、３人目が入ってきた。
strings.translated: And when the second came in, a third followed.

strings.text: えっ？
strings.translated: Eh?

strings.text: 何で？
strings.translated: Why?

strings.text: どうして、何人も入って来るの？
strings.translated: Why are so many people coming in?

strings.text: この人達、誰なの？
strings.translated: Who are these people?

strings.text: 私はさらに怖くなって、ベッドのほうまで後ずさりしてしまった。
strings.translated: I grew even more frightened and backed away toward the bed.

strings.text: 男Ａ「やあ、芽生ちゃんだっけ？
strings.translated: Man A「Hey, you're Mei-chan, right?

strings.text: 良かった。
strings.translated: Good.

strings.text: 目が覚めるのを待ってたよ」
strings.translated: We've been waiting for you to wake up.」

strings.text: 男Ｂ「結構長く寝てたから、このまま目覚めないんじゃないかって思っちゃったよ」
strings.translated: Man B「You were asleep for quite a while -- I was starting to think you might never open your eyes.」

strings.text: 男Ｃ「そうなったらなったで、やることやるだけだけどな」
strings.translated: Man C「If that had happened, we would've just done what we came to do anyway.」

strings.text: 男Ａ「いや、本当に起きてくれて良かったよ。
strings.translated: Man A「No, really, I'm glad you woke up.

strings.text: 薬が変なふうに作用したんじゃないかって思ったくらいだし
strings.translated: I was starting to wonder if the drug had reacted on you in some weird way.」

strings.text: 芽生「あの…？」
strings.translated: Mei「Um...?」

strings.text: 男の人達が話していることの意味がわからない。
strings.translated: I don't understand what these men are talking about.

strings.text: 薬って何？
strings.translated: What drug?

strings.text: どうして、そんなふうに笑ってるの？
strings.translated: Why are they smiling like that?

strings.text: この人達が、私をここに閉じ込めてた人達ってことでいいの？
strings.translated: Are these the people who locked me up in here?

strings.text: 男Ａ「はははっ、完全に硬直しちゃってるじゃん」
strings.translated: Man A「Hahaha, she's completely frozen stiff.」

strings.text: 男Ｂ「そりゃあ仕方ないって。
strings.translated: Man B「Well, can you blame her?

strings.text: いきなりこんなふうになって、怖くないわけないもんねぇ？」
strings.translated: Getting thrown into something like this out of nowhere -- of course she'd be scared, right?」

strings.text: 男Ｃ「でも、大丈夫だよ。
strings.translated: Man C「But don't worry.

strings.text: これからおじさん達が、楽しいこといっぱい教えてあげるからね
strings.translated: We're going to teach you all kinds of fun things from here on out.」

strings.text: 芽生「楽しい、こと…？」
strings.translated: Mei「Fun... things...?」

strings.text: この人達、何を言っているんだろう。
strings.translated: What are these people talking about?

strings.text: 私のこと、怒って閉じ込めてたんじゃないの？
strings.translated: Weren't they angry at me? Isn't that why they locked me up?

strings.text: あ、でも、車の中で寝たからって、この人が怒るのは変だよね？
strings.translated: But wait -- it would be strange for this person to be angry just because I fell asleep in the car, wouldn't it?

strings.text: それじゃあ…どうして…？
strings.translated: Then... why...?

strings.text: 本当に何がどうなってるの？
strings.translated: What on earth is going on?

strings.text: 芽生「あ、あの……どなたですか？」
strings.translated: Mei「U-um... who are you people?」

strings.text: 絞り出すような声で、私は一番の疑問を尋ねた。
strings.translated: I forced the words out in a strained voice, asking the question that was weighing on me most.

strings.text: この人達は誰なのか。
strings.translated: Who were these people?

strings.text: それがわからないと、今の状況も全くわからない。
strings.translated: Without knowing that, I couldn't make any sense of the situation I was in.

strings.text: でも、男の人達はニヤニヤと笑うばかりで、私の質問にすぐには答えてくれなかった。
strings.translated: But the men just kept grinning, and didn't answer my question right away.

strings.text: 男Ａ「さぁて、誰だろうねぇ？」
strings.translated: Man A「Hmm, now who could we be?」

strings.text: 男Ｂ「誰だと思う？
strings.translated: Man B「Who do you think?」

strings.text: 芽生「お兄ちゃんかお姉ちゃんの…知り合いの、人ですか？」
strings.translated: Mei「Are you... acquaintances of my brother or sister?」

strings.text: 男Ｃ「正解っ！
strings.translated: Man C「Correct!

strings.text: 大正解っ！
strings.translated: Absolutely correct!」

strings.text: 予想に反したことを言われて、私は思わず声を漏らしてしまった。
strings.translated: Their answer caught me off guard and I let out a small gasp.

strings.text: 正解？
strings.translated: Correct?

strings.text: 大正解？
strings.translated: Exactly right?

strings.text: お兄ちゃんかお姉ちゃんの、知り合いの人達なの？
strings.translated: They're acquaintances of my brother's or my sister's?

strings.text: どっちの？
strings.translated: Which one?

strings.text: 男の人だから、やっぱりお兄ちゃんの知り合いの人達なの？
strings.translated: They're men, so... are they really friends of my brother's?

strings.text: もしかして、友達なの？
strings.translated: Could they be his friends?

strings.text: そう考えると、少しだけ安心することができた。
strings.translated: Thinking that, I felt just a tiny bit relieved.

strings.text: でも、今度は違った疑問がわいてくる。
strings.translated: But then a different question started nagging at me.

strings.text: お兄ちゃんの友達の人達が、どうしてここにいるの？
strings.translated: Why would my brother's friends be here?

strings.text: どうして、私をこの部屋に閉じ込めてたの？
strings.translated: Why had they locked me in this room?

strings.text: 愛「…少し待ってて。
strings.translated: Ai「...Wait a moment.

strings.text: 今、体を綺麗にするから
strings.translated: I'll clean you up now.」

strings.text: そういうと、神村さんは俺の身体を拭きはじめてくれた
strings.translated: With that, Kamimura-san began to wipe down my body.

strings.text: 大智「神村さんは…？」
strings.translated: Daichi「What about you, Kamimura-san...?」

strings.text: 俺は身体を丁寧に拭かれながら、やや落ち着いた心持ちの中、神村さんに問いかけた
strings.translated: As she carefully wiped down my body, I asked Kamimura-san the question, my heart somewhat calmer now.

strings.text: 愛「私は大丈夫。
strings.translated: Ai「I'm fine.

strings.text: 何もされてないから」
strings.translated: Nothing was done to me.」

strings.text: 神村さんから返ってきた答えは、俺が想像していた最悪のものではない。
strings.translated: The answer she gave back was not the worst one I had imagined.

strings.text: そのことが、さらに俺の気持ちを落ち着かせてくれる。
strings.translated: That alone settled my feelings even further.

strings.text: なんだろう。
strings.translated: Something felt off, though.

strings.text: 何かおかしい気が
strings.translated: Something seemed strange...

strings.text: 大智「ここ…ここはどこなんだ…？
strings.translated:
Daichi「Where... where is this place...?
 Why... how did this...」

strings.text: どうして…こんな
strings.translated: How... why...

strings.text: 大智「うっ……くぅっ……」
strings.translated: Daichi「Ugh... ngh...」

strings.text: …でも、芽生は酷い目に遭わされた。
strings.translated: But Mei had been put through something terrible.

strings.text: その事実に変わりはなかった。
strings.translated: That fact hadn't changed.

strings.text: そのことが思い返されて、思わず言葉が詰まってしまった
strings.translated: The memory of it came rushing back, and the words caught in my throat before I could speak.

strings.text: 愛「しっかりして。
strings.translated: Ai「Pull yourself together.

strings.text: あと２週間あるのよ
strings.translated: There are still two weeks left.」

strings.text: 大智「２週間…？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Two weeks...?」

strings.text: 神村さんの発した想像だにしていなかった「２週間」
strings.translated: The words "two weeks" -- something I never could have imagined -- had just left Kamimura-san's lips.

strings.text: という言葉。
strings.translated: Those words.

strings.text: 俺はその言葉がなにを意味するのかいまいち理解することもできず、オウム返しするように神村さんへと問い返す。
strings.translated: I couldn't quite grasp what those words meant, and I found myself echoing them back to her like a parrot.

strings.text: しかし、神村さんはそんな問いには答えようとせず…黙ったまま俺の身体を拘束していたベルトを解きはじめた
strings.translated: But Kamimura-san made no attempt to answer that question... and in silence, she began undoing the belts that had been restraining my body.

strings.text: 愛「足と身体の拘束は解いておくから。
strings.translated: Ai「I'll undo the restraints on your legs and body.

strings.text: でも、腕はほどいてあげられない。
strings.translated: But I can't free your arms.

strings.text: ベッドから離すわけにはいかないの
strings.translated: I can't let you leave the bed.」

strings.text: 愛「トイレは…悪いけど、このバケツにしてね
strings.translated: Ai「For the toilet... sorry, but please use this bucket.」

strings.text: 愛「それから、食事はここに置いておくから
strings.translated: Ai「Also, I'll leave food here for you.

strings.text: 大智「神村さん…？
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san...?

strings.text: 神村さんがいったことやしたことはそれぞれに理解することができた。
strings.translated: I could understand each thing Kamimura-san had said and done.

strings.text: でも、なぜそうしたかという根本的なことが理解できずにいた。
strings.translated: But I couldn't grasp the fundamental reason why she had done any of it.

strings.text: その疑問が、思わず口をついて出そうになる。
strings.translated: That question was about to slip out of my mouth unbidden.

strings.text: …が、神村さんはそんな俺に構おうともせず、部屋から出て行こうとしていた
strings.translated: ...But Kamimura-san paid no attention to me and was already heading out of the room.

strings.text: 大智「待ってくれ！
strings.translated: Daichi「Wait!

strings.text: 神村さんっ！」
strings.translated: Kamimura-san...!」

strings.text: 必死に声をかけると、神村さんはドアの前で足を止めた。
strings.translated: I called out desperately, and Kamimura-san stopped in front of the door.

strings.text: そして、振り返って…うっすらと笑みを浮かべた
strings.translated: Then she turned around... and gave a faint smile.

strings.text: 愛「私を救ってくれるんでしょう？
strings.translated: Ai「You'll save me, won't you?

strings.text: その言葉だけを残して、神村さんは部屋を出て行ってしまった。
strings.translated: Leaving only those words behind, Kamimura-san walked out of the room.

strings.text: ドアが閉まり、室内には再び静寂が訪れる
strings.translated: The door closed, and silence returned to the space once more.

strings.text: 意味がわからない。
strings.translated: None of this makes any sense.

strings.text: 神村さんは…どうしたんだ？
strings.translated: What's gotten into Kamimura-san...?

strings.text: 一体、彼女になにがあったっていうんだ？
strings.translated: What on earth could have happened to her?

strings.text: もしかしたら姉さんや男達に脅されて…とは思ってみたたけれど、それとは少し違うような気がしてならない。
strings.translated: I wondered for a moment if maybe she'd been threatened by my sister or those men... but something about that didn't quite feel right.

strings.text: だったら、何故、どうして神村さんは…？
strings.translated: Then why -- why would Kamimura-san...?

strings.text: 大智「神村さんっ！
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san!

strings.text: 誰か！
strings.translated: Someone!

strings.text: いないのか！
strings.translated: Is anyone there!

strings.text: だいぶ時間が経った後で、俺は思い出したように神村さんの名前を呼んでみた。
strings.translated: After quite some time had passed, I tried calling out Kamimura-san's name, as if suddenly remembering to do so.

strings.text: 身を清められ、食事を取ることもできて、少しだけ気力も回復している。
strings.translated: I had been cleaned up, I'd been able to eat, and a little of my energy had returned.

strings.text: その気力が、俺にそうさせてくれていた。
strings.translated: That recovered energy was what allowed me to do it.

strings.text: どうしてこんな目に遭っているかは理解できないままだったけど、とにかくこのまま縛られている訳にはいかなかった。
strings.translated: I still couldn't understand why I was being put through this, but regardless, I couldn't just stay here tied up.

strings.text: …まだ、芽生は酷い目に遭っているに違いない。
strings.translated: ...Mei must still be going through something terrible.

strings.text: そう思うと一刻も早く助けに行かなければ、という思いが焦りと共にわきあがってくる。
strings.translated: When I thought about that, the urge to go help her as soon as possible welled up inside me, along with a growing sense of urgency.

strings.text: だからこそ、神村さんにはこの腕のベルトを解いてほしかった。
strings.translated: That was exactly why I needed Kamimura-san to undo the belts binding my arms.

strings.text: どんなに叫んでみても、神村さんが部屋へと姿を現すことはなかった。
strings.translated: No matter how much I shouted, Kamimura-san never appeared in the room.

strings.text: 俺は閉じられたまま動かないドアを呆然と見つめながら、今なにが起こっていたのかを考えていた。
strings.translated: I stared blankly at the door, closed and unmoving, and tried to think about what was happening right now.

strings.text: 最後の神村さんの表情と言葉。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san's expression and words at the end.

strings.text: あれは何を意味してるんだろう。
strings.translated: What could those have meant?

strings.text: 俺に期待してる？
strings.translated: She's expecting something from me?

strings.text: 救ってくれる？
strings.translated: "You'll save me"?

strings.text: この状況で？
strings.translated: In this situation?

strings.text: 一体、なにをいってるんだろう。
strings.translated: What on earth is she talking about?

strings.text: 自分を救ってほしいと思うのならば、せめてこのベルトを解いて、俺を自由の身にしてほしかった。
strings.translated: If she wanted to be saved, then at the very least I wished she would undo these belts and set me free.

strings.text: だが、そうはならなかった。
strings.translated: But that wasn't what happened.

strings.text: それができない理由があるんだろうか？
strings.translated: Was there some reason she couldn't do that?

strings.text: もしかして、この部屋は別の部屋から監視されてたりするのだろうか？
strings.translated: Could it be that this room was being watched from another room somewhere?

strings.text: そう考えれば、一応の辻褄は合うように思えた。
strings.translated: If I thought about it that way, it seemed to more or less add up.

strings.text: 神村さんも俺のことを助けたいと思ってたのかもしれないけれど、監視されてるからできなかったんじゃないだろうか。
strings.translated: Maybe Kamimura-san had wanted to help me too, but couldn't because she was being watched.

strings.text: でも…それにしてはあの表情と言葉が取りつくろった演技のようなものだとは思えない。
strings.translated: But... even so, that expression and those words didn't seem like any kind of forced performance.

strings.text: 今まで知らなかった神村さんの一面を見てしまったような気がして、俺は動揺を抑えることができなかった。
strings.translated: I felt as though I had glimpsed a side of Kamimura-san I had never known before, and I couldn't suppress my unease.

strings.text: そうこう動揺しながらも考えている内に、俺は一つの考えにいたっていた。
strings.translated: Even as I kept turning it over in my mind in that unsettled state, I had arrived at one conclusion.

strings.text: 結局、今、ここに頼れるのは自分だけしかいない。
strings.translated: In the end, the only one I could rely on right now was myself.

strings.text: 改めて、それを思い知った気分だった。
strings.translated: I felt as though I had been made to understand that all over again.

strings.text: 誰かに助けなんて求められない。
strings.translated: I couldn't ask anyone for help.

strings.text: だから、自分でなんとかするしかない。
strings.translated: So I had no choice but to manage on my own.

strings.text: やるしかない。
strings.translated: I just had to do it.

strings.text: なんとかしてこの部屋を脱出して、芽生を助けるしかない。
strings.translated: I had to find some way to escape this room and save Mei.

strings.text: でも、実際のところどうやって脱出したらいいんだろう。
strings.translated: But practically speaking, how was I supposed to escape?

strings.text: それに、芽生はどこにいるんだろう。
strings.translated: And where was Mei, anyway?

strings.text: この建物にいると思ってたけど、モニターに映像が表示されただけで、本当はどこにいるのか全くわからない。
strings.translated: I had assumed she was somewhere in this building, but all I had was footage on a monitor -- I had absolutely no idea where she actually was.

strings.text: もしかすると、ここから何キロメートルも離れた場所にいるかもしれないんだ。
strings.translated: She could be several kilometers away from here, for all I knew.

strings.text: 仮にそうだとしたら
strings.translated: If that were the case, then --

strings.text: 不意に部屋のモニターに電源が入ったようだった。
strings.translated: Suddenly, it seemed like the monitor in the room had switched on.

strings.text: 画面は真っ黒なままだったけど、なにかの音がスピーカーから聞こえてきた
strings.translated: The screen stayed pitch black, but some kind of sound began coming through the speakers.

strings.text: なんだろう…？
strings.translated: What is that...?

strings.text: 水の音…？
strings.translated: The sound of water...?

strings.text: しばらくすると、突然、モニターに画像が表示された
strings.translated: After a while, an image suddenly appeared on the monitor.

strings.text: 大智「風呂場…？」
strings.translated: Daichi「A bathroom...?」

strings.text: どうして、こんな場所が映し出されたんだ？
strings.translated: Why would a place like this be showing up on screen?

strings.text: 他に見るものもなく、モニターにしばらく視線を向けていると、そのスピーカーから姉さんと芽生の声が聞こえてきた
strings.translated: With nothing else to look at, I kept my gaze on the monitor for a while -- and then, from the speakers, I heard the voices of my sister and Mei.

strings.text: 私は目を覚ました芽生を後ろから抱きかかえるようにして湯船の中にいた。
strings.translated: I was holding Mei, who had woken up, from behind in the bathtub.

strings.text: 芽生はその身体を乱暴に扱われたショックから立ち直っているはずもなく、ただ小さく震えている
strings.translated: There was no way she had recovered from the shock of having her body treated so roughly -- she was just trembling faintly.

strings.text: 少しは落ち着いた？
strings.translated: Have you calmed down a little?

strings.text: 私の問いかけに芽生は言葉を返してこなかった
strings.translated: Mei gave no reply to my question.

strings.text: 美桜「そうよね…でも、大丈夫よ」
strings.translated: Mio「I know... but it's okay.」

strings.text: 私はつとめて優しく声をかけながら、その震えている芽生の身体を少しだけ自分へと抱き寄せる。
strings.translated: I kept my voice as gentle as I could while drawing Mei's trembling body just a little closer to mine.

strings.text: 芽生の身体が私の身体に触れ、さっきよりも広く肌越しにその震えが伝わってきた
strings.translated: Her body touched mine, and her trembling reached me through our skin even more than before.

strings.text: 美桜「ね、お姉ちゃんがこうしててあげるから
strings.translated: Mio「Here, I'll stay with you like this, okay?

strings.text: 芽生「う、うん…」
strings.translated: Mei「Y-yeah...」

strings.text: どうにかして振り絞られたような芽生の声は小さく、そしてやはり震えている
strings.translated: Mei's voice, somehow wrung out of her with great effort, was small -- and still trembling.

strings.text: 美桜「恐かった？
strings.translated: Mio「Were you scared?

strings.text: 芽生「うん、恐かった…今でも…恐い…」
strings.translated: Mei「Yeah, I was scared... even now... I'm still scared...」

strings.text: 恐くないはずはなかっただろう
strings.translated: There was no way she wasn't frightened.

strings.text: 美桜「お姉ちゃんもそうだったのよ
strings.translated: Mio「I was the same way, you know.

strings.text: 芽生「…え？」
strings.translated: Mei「...Huh?」

strings.text: 私の言葉に脅えたように、びくっと緊張するような身震いをさせる芽生
strings.translated: At my words, Mei gave a startled flinch, tensing up as if frightened.

strings.text: 美桜「お姉ちゃんもね、芽生と…同じような目にあったの
strings.translated: Mio「I went through... the same kind of thing as you, Mei.

strings.text: 芽生「え、え…？」
strings.translated: Mei「Eh, eh...?」

strings.text: 芽生は私の唐突な言葉を受けとめきれていないようだ。
strings.translated: She didn't seem able to take in my sudden words.

strings.text: それは無理もないことだと思う。
strings.translated: That was understandable, I thought.

strings.text: 今、芽生の頭の中では先ほどまでの行為が思い返されているのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Right now, inside Mei's head, she might be replaying what had just happened to her.

strings.text: でも、それを私と結びつけて考えるほどの精神的な余裕は今の芽生にはないだろう
strings.translated: But Mei didn't have the mental composure right now to connect that with me.

strings.text: 美桜「芽生は覚えてるかな？
strings.translated: Mio「Do you remember, Mei?

strings.text: お姉ちゃんがお引越しの前に入院していたこと
strings.translated: That Sis had been hospitalized before the move...

strings.text: 芽生「うん…覚えてるよ…」
strings.translated: Mei「Yeah... I remember...」

strings.text: 私はそう答えた芽生の身体を、そっと撫ではじめる。
strings.translated: I began to gently stroke Mei's body as she answered me.

strings.text: 優しく、その肌の震えをそっと押さえていくように
strings.translated: Tenderly, as if quietly stilling the trembling of her skin.

strings.text: 美桜「あれ、芽生には交通事故だっていってたけど、本当はちがったの。
strings.translated: Mio「I told you back then it was a traffic accident, but that wasn't the truth.

strings.text: お姉ちゃんもね、さっきの芽生みたいに…男の人に
strings.translated: I was... just like you just now, Mei... a man...

strings.text: 芽生「お姉ちゃん…も…？」
strings.translated: Mei「Sis... too...?」

strings.text: 私の言葉の意味を確かめるかのように、芽生は問いかけてきた
strings.translated: As if to confirm the meaning of my words, Mei asked me.

strings.text: 男の人にね、無理矢理…痛くて、気持ち悪いことをされたの。
strings.translated: A man... forced himself on me... it was painful, and it was horrible.

strings.text: でもね、それは違ったの
strings.translated: But -- it was different.

strings.text: 芽生「違ったって…お姉ちゃんも痛かったんでしょ？
strings.translated: Mei「Different... it hurt you too, didn't it?

strings.text: 気持ち悪かったんでしょ？」
strings.translated: It felt horrible, didn't it?」

strings.text: 私が最後に付け加えた否定の言葉を、芽生は理解できないとでもいうように…いいえ、理解できないまま問いを重ねる
strings.translated: As if she couldn't understand -- no, without being able to understand -- the denial I had added at the end, Mei pressed on with her question.

strings.text: 美桜「そう、違ったの。
strings.translated: Mio「Yes, it was different.

strings.text: 今から考えると…あれはいいことだったんだ、って。
strings.translated: Looking back on it now... I've come to think it was a good thing.

strings.text: そう思えるようになったの
strings.translated: I've been able to feel that way.

strings.text: 芽生「わからない…私、わからないよ…は…あぁ…っ
strings.translated: Mei「I don't understand... I don't understand at all... ha... aah...

strings.text: 美桜「そうね…芽生にはまだわからないかもね。
strings.translated: Mio「I know... you probably can't understand yet, Mei.

strings.text: でも、多分、お姉ちゃんみたいにわかるようになるとおもうわ」
strings.translated: But I think you'll come to understand, just like I did.」

strings.text: 私はそういいながら、芽生が漏らした吐息の意味を理解しつつ、その芽生の肌をゆっくりと撫で回していく。
strings.translated: As I said that, I understood the meaning of the sigh Mei had let out, and slowly ran my hands over her skin.

strings.text: 多分、この湯船のお湯の中に入れた薬も、そして、芽生が寝ている間に飲ませた薬もそろそろ効いてきた頃だろう
strings.translated: The drug I had put into the bathwater, and the drug I had made her swallow while she slept -- they were probably starting to take effect by now.

strings.text: 芽生「あんな…痛いの、気持ち悪いの、私…それがいいことだなんて…ん、んん…っ
strings.translated: Mei「Something like that... something so painful, so horrible... I can't think that's a good thing... nn, mmm...

strings.text: 美桜「…くすぐったい？」
strings.translated: Mio「...Does it tickle?」

strings.text: 私は芽生の疑問には答えず、今、芽生が持っているであろう感覚を意識させようと問いかける
strings.translated: I didn't answer Mei's question -- instead I asked her something to make her aware of the sensation she was probably feeling right now.

strings.text: 芽生「…ちょっと、くすぐったい、かな？
strings.translated: Mei「...A little... ticklish, I guess?

strings.text: は、ああ…んっ、んん…っ」
strings.translated: Ha, aah... nn, nn...」

strings.text: 頭越しに芽生の顔を見ると、表情はうつろなままだったけど、その頬は赤みを帯び始めていた
strings.translated: Looking at Mei's face from above her head, her expression was still vacant, but her cheeks had begun to flush red.

strings.text: 美桜「こうやってお姉ちゃんに触られるの、気持ち悪い？」
strings.translated: Mio「Does it feel gross, being touched by me like this?」

strings.text: そういいながら私はその手を芽生のなだらかな曲線を描く胸へと這わせていく
strings.translated: As I said that, I let my hand trail over Mei's gently curving chest.

strings.text: 芽生「ん、ちょっと…くすぐったいけど、あ、ん…ふぅ、気持ち…悪くはないかな
strings.translated: Mei「Nn, a little... ticklish, but, ah, nn... huu, it doesn't... feel gross, I guess.

strings.text: 美桜「ふふっ、こうやってお姉ちゃんが芽生のこと、綺麗にしてあげるからね」
strings.translated: Mio「Hehe, I'll make you all clean like this, okay?」

strings.text: 綺麗に。
strings.translated: Clean.

strings.text: 多分、芽生はそれを汚れてしまった自分のことを洗ってくれている程度にしか考えないかもしれない。
strings.translated: Mei probably only thought of it as me washing away the filth that had been done to her.

strings.text: でも、それは違う。
strings.translated: But that wasn't it.

strings.text: 私は芽生の心の奥底の扉をそっと開けて、その中から芽生自身の悦びを引き出そうとしている。
strings.translated: I was gently opening the door deep inside Mei's heart, trying to draw out her own pleasure from within.

strings.text: それが…芽生を新しく、そう、綺麗なものに変えてくれるだろうという思いをこめていた
strings.translated: That was... what I meant when I said it would change Mei into something new -- yes, something clean.

strings.text: 芽生「き…れい…に？
strings.translated: Mei「...Clean... ly?

strings.text: は…ああ…っ、ん、んんふぅ…っ。
strings.translated: Ha... aah...!, nn, nnhuu...

strings.text: お姉ちゃん…なんだか変…変だよう…」
strings.translated: Sis... something feels strange... strange...」

strings.text: 芽生は私の指先が胸の上を這うように撫でるのに反応して甘い吐息を漏らしながら、それまでしらなかったのかもしれない感覚に戸惑ってもいるようだ
strings.translated: Mei let out a sweet sigh in response to my fingertips gliding and stroking across her chest, and she seemed to be bewildered by sensations she may never have known before.

strings.text: 美桜「どう変なの？
strings.translated: Mio「What kind of weird?

strings.text: 芽生「なんだか、お姉ちゃんに触られてると…身体が…ぞくぞくってして、むずむずってして…」
strings.translated: Mei「Somehow... when you touch me, sis... my body gets all... tingly and squirmy...」

strings.translated: When Dad and Mom weren't around, the two of them always talked like this, and there was no room for me to join in.

strings.text: …というより、そのつもりはなかった。
strings.translated: ...Or rather, I had no intention of joining.

strings.text: でも、それでいい。

strings.text: 今更、疎外感を覚えたりすることもない。
strings.translated: I no longer felt any sense of being left out.

strings.text: 姉さんと芽生が楽しそうにしてるなら、俺にとってはそれが一番安心できることなんだから
strings.translated: If my sister and Mei were having fun, that was the most reassuring thing in the world to me.

strings.text: 美桜「でも、芽生は本当に運が良かったわよね。

strings.text: こんなに若いうちから、真実を知ることができたんだから

strings.text: セックスって気持ちいいからすっごく好き！
strings.translated: Sex feels so good, I absolutely love it!

strings.text: お姉ちゃん、教えてくれてありがとう

strings.translated: Mei「We can all have sex together as a family. We're so happy.

strings.translated: Mio「We are.

strings.translated: Daichi「...Yeah.」

strings.text: あまり深くは考えずに俺は短く返事をした
strings.translated: I answered briefly, without thinking too deeply about it.

strings.text: 家族みんなで気持ち良くなれる。
strings.translated: The whole family can feel good together.

strings.text: 家族みんなで幸せになれる。
strings.translated: The whole family can be happy together.

strings.text: そのことに不満なんてあるはずがない。
strings.translated: There was no reason to be dissatisfied with that.

strings.text: 不満なんてあったら、俺の心がどうなってしまうかわかったものじゃなかった
strings.translated: If I were dissatisfied, I had no idea what would become of my mind.

strings.text: 食後の時間は、一番くつろげる一時だった。
strings.translated: The time after dinner was the most relaxing part of the day.

strings.text: 自分の部屋のベッドの上でのんびり寝転がっていると、なにも考えずに済む。
strings.translated: Lying stretched out on my bed in my own room, I didn't have to think about anything.

strings.text: 疲れた身体も休めることができた。
strings.translated: My tired body could rest.

strings.text: こんな時間こそ永遠に続いてほしかった。
strings.translated: I wanted this kind of time to last forever.

strings.text: ずっと、こうしていられればいいのに…という思いが浮かんでは消えていく
strings.translated: The thought -- I wish I could stay like this forever -- rose and faded, rose and faded.

strings.text: 大智「永遠に、か…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Forever, huh...」

strings.text: 現実問題、永遠なんてものはあり得ない。
strings.translated: Realistically speaking, forever isn't something that can actually exist.

strings.text: どんな事にも、どこかで終わりはやってくる。
strings.translated: Everything comes to an end somewhere, eventually.

strings.text: それがいつ訪れるかはわからない。
strings.translated: There's no telling when that end will arrive.

strings.text: でも、その終わりが訪れるまでの間は、穏やかに過ごしていたい。
strings.translated: But until that end does come, I wanted to spend my days in peace.

strings.text: どうでもいいことには関わらずに、家族がなにも心配せずに笑って過ごしているのを眺めていられるなら、俺の人生はもうそれでよかった。
strings.translated: As long as I could stay out of things that didn't matter and watch my family laugh and live without a worry in the world, that was enough for my life -- more than enough.

strings.text: それ以上、なにかを望もうとも思えなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't bring myself to wish for anything beyond that.

strings.text: なにも起きないから、こうやって穏やかに過ごすことができる。
strings.translated: Because nothing happens, I'm able to spend my days like this, in quiet calm.

strings.text: もしかすると、これこそが、この瞬間こそが俺にとっての救いなのかもしれない
strings.translated: Perhaps this -- this very moment -- is what salvation means for me.

strings.text: 大智「これでいいんだ」
strings.translated: Daichi「This is fine.」

strings.text: 部屋の天井を見つめながら、俺はまるで自分に言い聞かせるようにつぶやいた。
strings.translated: Staring up at the ceiling of my room, I murmured as if trying to convince myself.

strings.text: 多分、ずっとこのままなんだろう。
strings.translated: It would probably stay like this forever.

strings.text: 大きな変化はなくて、姉さん達のいうがままに生きていくだけ。
strings.translated: No big changes -- just living as my sister and the others directed.

strings.text: なにも考えずにすむ。
strings.translated: No need to think about anything.

strings.text: なにも心配せずにすむ。
strings.translated: No need to worry about anything.

strings.text: なにも苦悩しない。
strings.translated: No suffering.

strings.text: そんな楽な人生が送れると思うと、案外、俺は恵まれてるのかもしれない
strings.translated: When I thought that I could live such an easy life, I figured I might actually be pretty fortunate.

strings.text: 芽生「お兄ちゃん
strings.translated: Mei「Big brother.

strings.text: 美桜「まだ起きてる？
strings.translated: Mio「Are you still awake?

strings.text: 姉さんと芽生が俺の部屋に入ってきた。
strings.translated: My sister and Mei came into my room.

strings.text: なんの用なのかは考えるまでもないし、聞くまでもない。
strings.translated: I didn't need to think about why, and I didn't need to ask.

strings.text: 姉と妹とのセックス。
strings.translated: Sex with my sister and my little sister.

strings.text: まだ、完全に慣れた訳ではなかったけれど、それも時間の問題なのかもしれない。
strings.translated: I hadn't completely gotten used to it yet -- but maybe it was only a matter of time.

strings.text: じきに、流されるままにこんなことにも慣れてしまうのだろう。
strings.translated: Before long, I would drift along and grow accustomed to this too.

strings.text: 慣れてしまって…なにも考えなくてすむようになるのだろう。
strings.translated: I would get used to it... and stop having to think about anything.

strings.text: そうなれば…もっと日々が楽になってくれるだろう
strings.translated: Once that happened... the days would probably become even easier to bear.

strings.text: 翌日、俺はいつもと変わらず普通に登校した。
strings.translated: The next day, I went to school just as I always did.

strings.text: いつも通り教室に入って、いつも通り自分の席に着く。
strings.translated: I walked into the classroom as usual and sat down in my usual seat.

strings.text: 最近は誰も話しかけて来ないから、教室にいるのも気楽なものだった
strings.translated: Lately no one talked to me, so being in the classroom was actually a comfortable thing.

strings.text: 当て処もなく窓の外を眺めながら、ぼんやりとしつつ過ごす。
strings.translated: Being able to go through the day without thinking about anything was the greatest happiness I had right now.

strings.text: なにも考えずに過ごせるのは、今の俺にとっての一番の幸せだ。
strings.translated: I just wanted today to pass by without incident, same as always.

strings.text: このまま、今日も１日がなにごともなく過ぎればいい。
strings.translated: Nothing happening was the greatest happiness of all.

strings.text: なにも起こらないのは、なによりも幸せなことだ。
strings.translated: I had come to feel that deeply over the course of summer vacation.

strings.text: 俺は夏休みの間にそう実感していた。
strings.translated: What mattered wasn't being bound by the uncertain framework people called common sense -- it was learning to live quietly so that nothing would happen.

strings.text: 大切なのは不確かな常識という枠に縛られることじゃなく、なにごとも起こらないように静かに生きていくことなんだって、ようやく理解することができていた
strings.translated: I had finally come to understand that.

strings.text: 大智「…おはよう」
strings.translated: Daichi「...Good morning.」

strings.text: 教室に入って来た神村さんに挨拶されて、俺は同じように返事をする。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san came into the classroom and greeted me, and I returned it in kind.

strings.text: 最近はほとんど挨拶ばかりで、会話らしい会話をしていない。
strings.translated: Lately it had been almost nothing but greetings -- we hadn't had anything resembling a real conversation.

strings.text: 彼女がなにを考えているのか、俺にはもうわからなかった。
strings.translated: I no longer had any idea what she was thinking.

strings.text: …いや、一度だって彼女の考えがわかったことはなかったか
strings.translated: ...No, had I ever once understood what she was thinking?

strings.text: 神村さんのほうも会話する気はないみたいで、そのまま自分の席へと行ってしまう。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san didn't seem to have any interest in conversation either, and she walked straight to her own seat.

strings.text: …こんな結果を望んでたわけじゃないのにな。
strings.translated: It's not like this was the outcome I wanted.

strings.text: …どうしてこうなってしまったんだろうって、考えることはやめようと思っているのに、つい考えてしまう瞬間がある。
strings.translated: I keep telling myself to stop wondering how things ended up this way -- and yet there are moments when I can't help but think about it.

strings.text: 今さら考えてみたところで、なんとかできる訳でも、後戻りしてやり直せる訳でもないのに。
strings.translated: Even if I think about it now, there's no fixing it, no going back and starting over.

strings.text: 先生「席に着け～。
strings.translated: Teacher「Everyone back to your seats~.

strings.text: ホームルーム始めるぞ」
strings.translated: Homeroom is starting.」

strings.text: やがて、先生が教室に入って来て朝のホームルームが始まった。
strings.translated: Before long, the teacher came into the classroom and morning homeroom began.

strings.text: これといって俺が気にかけるような特別な話はなかったけれど、強いていえば星野さんが夏休みの間に家出し、今も帰っていないと告げられていた。
strings.translated: There was nothing in particular that caught my attention -- except, if anything, we were told that Hoshino-san had run away from home during summer vacation and still hadn't come back.

strings.text: それ以前に失踪した小野田さん同様、なにか知ってることがあれば教えてほしい、と先生は呼びかけていたけれど、もちろん真相を話すことはしない。
strings.translated: Just like Onoda-san, who had disappeared before her, the teacher asked if anyone knew anything -- but of course, I said nothing about the truth.

strings.text: 小野田さんや星野さんが死んだことが明らかになるかどうかなんて、俺にはどうでもいいことだった。
strings.translated: Whether or not it ever came to light that Onoda-san and Hoshino-san were dead was something I couldn't care less about.

strings.text: 多分、皆も同じだろう。
strings.translated: Everyone else probably felt the same way.

strings.text: 星野さんが失踪扱いのままでも、死んだって判明しても、自分の人生に大きな影響を及ぼすことはない。
strings.translated: Whether Hoshino-san stayed listed as a missing person or was confirmed dead, it wouldn't have any great impact on anyone's life.

strings.text: 人は冷たいというかもしれない。
strings.translated: Some might call that cold.

strings.text: でも、これが今の俺にとっての最善の…一番楽な考え方だった
strings.translated: But this was the most comfortable way of thinking -- the easiest way for me right now.

strings.text: 神村さんはどうなんだろう。
strings.translated: I wondered about Kamimura-san, though.

strings.text: 自分の友達だった彼女を死へと追いやったのに、俺と同じようになにも感じてないんだろうか…？
strings.translated: She had driven her own friend to her death -- did she feel nothing, just like me...?

strings.text: 一般的にいわれるような後悔とか、そういうのは一欠片ほども持ち合わせてはいないのだろうか。
strings.translated: Did she not have even a single fragment of what people would normally call regret?

strings.text: 少しだけそんなことを考えてはみたけれど、それがわかったところでなんの意味もない。
strings.translated: I let myself think about it for just a moment, but even if I found the answer, it wouldn't mean anything.

strings.text: そう思うと考えるだけ無駄だったと、その疑問をすぐに頭から振り払っていた。
strings.translated: Thinking that, I realized it was a waste to even wonder, and I quickly shook the question from my mind.

strings.text: 余計なことはしなくていい。
strings.translated: No need to do anything unnecessary.

strings.text: いつも通りでいい。
strings.translated: Just keep going the way I always do.

strings.text: そうすれば、きっと今日も穏やかな時間が過ぎていく。
strings.translated: If I did that, surely today too would pass by in quiet calm.

strings.text: 何事もない平穏な時間が流れていく。
strings.translated: A peaceful stretch of time with nothing happening would flow on by.

strings.text: 人から見たら退屈かもしれない。
strings.translated: To others it might look boring.

strings.text: どうでもいいような１日が終わって、またどうでもいいような１日がはじまって…それが繰り返されていく
strings.translated: One unremarkable day ends, another unremarkable day begins... and that cycle just keeps repeating.
Daichi「...?」

strings.text: 不意に、廊下のほうから大きな悲鳴が聞こえた。
strings.translated: Suddenly, a loud scream came from out in the hallway.

strings.text: さすがに、怪訝な表情を浮かべてしまう。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but let a puzzled look cross my face.

strings.text: 学校内で悲鳴が聞こえるなんて、ただ事じゃない。
strings.translated: Hearing a scream inside the school -- this was no ordinary thing.

strings.text: 先生もクラスメイト達も、何事かと廊下を覗き込んでいた。
strings.translated: The teacher and my classmates were all peering out into the hallway, wondering what was going on.

strings.text: 俺も、それに釣られるように…その人の流れに埋没していくように、廊下でなにが起こっているのかを見てみることにした
strings.translated: As if drawn along by them -- as if being swallowed up into the flow of people -- I decided to look and see what was happening out in the hallway.

strings.text: 廊下を覗き込んだ瞬間、思わず声が出た。
strings.translated: The moment I peered out into the hallway, a sound escaped me involuntarily.

strings.text: 一体、なにが起こってるのか、咄嗟に理解することができなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't immediately grasp what on earth was happening.

strings.text: それは赤い線だった。
strings.translated: It was a red line.

strings.text: 大量の赤い液体が、ぐねぐねと廊下に曲がった線を引かれていた。
strings.translated: A massive amount of red liquid had traced a winding, twisting line down the hallway.

strings.text: 最初は赤いペンキで誰かがいたずら描きでもしたかと思ったけれど、そんな物がここにある訳がない。
strings.translated: At first I thought someone had been scrawling graffiti with red paint, but there was no reason for anything like that to be here.

strings.text: その赤い跡が血のようにも思えた。
strings.translated: That red trail looked almost like blood.

strings.text: だけど、それはペンキ以上にあり得ないことだ。
strings.translated: But that was even more impossible than paint.

strings.text: あり得ないことだったはずなのに、その赤い線の先に佇んでみえたのは
strings.translated: It should have been impossible -- and yet, standing at the end of that red line was--

strings.text: 大智「桧垣…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Higaki...」

strings.text: さすがに声が漏れた。
strings.translated: I couldn't help but let a sound escape me.

strings.text: 完全に動揺を押し殺すことができなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't completely suppress the shock that hit me.

strings.text: 廊下の中央にいたのは…桧垣。
strings.translated: Standing in the middle of the hallway was... Higaki.

strings.text: 女子の制服を身に着けて、両手や太ももを血まみれにしながら歩いていた。
strings.translated: Dressed in a girl's school uniform, walking with both hands and thighs soaked in blood.

strings.text: 一体、なにがあったのか…。
strings.translated: What on earth had happened...?

strings.text: それを瞬時に理解した奴はいないだろう。
strings.translated: There probably wasn't a single person who understood it in that instant.

strings.text: 俺だって、桧垣の身になにが起こったのかはわからなかった
strings.translated: Even I had no idea what had happened to Higaki.

strings.text: 瑛「はぁ…はっ……これが…本当の私なの
strings.translated: Akira「Ha... hah... this is... the real me.

strings.text: 瑛「私…本当の女の子に…なれた……」
strings.translated: Akira「I... I became... a real girl......」

strings.text: 廊下はおびただしい量の血で汚れていて、その血の線はどうやら生徒会室の方から伸びているようだった。
strings.translated: The hallway was stained with an enormous amount of blood, and the trail of it seemed to stretch all the way from the direction of the student council room.

strings.text: あちこちから悲鳴が上がっていて、先生達もどうすればいいのかわからないといったふうに愕然と立ち尽くしていた
strings.translated: Screams were rising from everywhere, and the teachers stood frozen in stunned disbelief, clearly at a loss for what to do.

strings.text: 瑛「…みんな…見て……っ…これが、本当の私……」
strings.translated: Akira「...Everyone... look......! This is... the real me......」

strings.text: 頬も血で汚しながら、桧垣は嬉しそうに笑っていた。
strings.translated: With blood smeared across her cheeks too, Higaki was smiling -- looking genuinely happy.

strings.text: 廊下から教室をぐるりと見回して、目に涙を溜め、それを流しながら喜んでいた。
strings.translated: She swept her gaze from the hallway around to the classrooms, tears welling in her eyes, letting them spill as she rejoiced.

strings.text: スカートの中からはいまだに血が滴っているようだ。
strings.translated: Blood still seemed to be dripping from beneath her skirt.

strings.text: そのことに気付いて、ようやくその内側でなにが起こったのかを理解できた。
strings.translated: Noticing that, I finally understood what had happened inside.

strings.text: 桧垣の言葉をそのまま受け取るなら…あいつは自分で性器を切り落としたんだ。
strings.translated: Taking Higaki's words at face value... she had cut off her own genitals.

strings.text: 自分についていた男性器を切り落とすことで、自分が男であるという事実をその身体と心から切り離したんだ。
strings.translated: By cutting away the male organ she had been born with, she had severed the fact of her maleness from both her body and her heart.

strings.text: そんなことをしたって、実際に桧垣が女の子になれる訳じゃないのに…。
strings.translated: Even if she did something like that, it didn't actually make Higaki a girl...

strings.text: でも、あいつは信じたんだ。
strings.translated: But she believed it.

strings.text: その方法なら、そうすれば自分が望んでいた女の子になれるって…。
strings.translated: That with that method -- that by doing that -- she could become the girl she had always wanted to be...

strings.text: 本当になりたかった自分になれるって
strings.translated: That she could become the self she had truly wanted to be.

strings.text: 瑛「あ…」
strings.translated: Akira「Ah...」

strings.text: 小さく声を漏らして、桧垣が足を止めた
strings.translated: With a small sound escaping her lips, Higaki stopped walking.

strings.text: しばらく薄笑いを浮かべながら立ち尽くした後、いきなり桧垣はその場に倒れ込んだ
strings.translated: After standing there for a while with a faint smile on her face, Higaki suddenly collapsed right where she stood.

strings.text: あちこちから、さらに大きな悲鳴が上がる。
strings.translated: Screams erupted from all around, growing louder.

strings.text: 同時に、先生が慌てて桧垣に駆け寄る。
strings.translated: At the same time, a teacher rushed frantically to Higaki's side.

strings.text: 学校の中はもう恐慌状態で、ほとんどの生徒は教室から恐怖の表情でその光景を見つめるか、半狂乱に悲鳴をあげることしかできていなかった
strings.translated: The school had fallen into a state of panic, and most of the students could only stare at the scene from their classrooms with expressions of terror, or scream themselves half-mad.

strings.text: 桧垣がどうしてこんな事をしたのか、俺にはわかる。
strings.translated: I understood why Higaki had done something like this.

strings.text: どういうつもりで性器を切り落としたのか、あのクラブに通ってる人間なら理解することができる。
strings.translated: Anyone who had been going to that Club would be able to understand what she had intended by cutting off her genitals.

strings.text: でも…桧垣、これで良かったのか？
strings.translated: But... Higaki, was this really okay?

strings.text: これで満足なのか？
strings.translated: Was this enough to satisfy you?

strings.text: ものすごく痛かっただろう。
strings.translated: It must have hurt so much.

strings.text: 痛いだけじゃない。
strings.translated: And it wasn't just the pain.

strings.text: すごく苦しかっただろう。
strings.translated: It must have been so agonizing.

strings.text: 切ることも、そう思い悩んだことも。
strings.translated: Both the act of cutting, and all the torment of having thought it through to that point.

strings.text: それなのに、笑顔を浮かべていられたのは、やっぱり幸せだったからなのか？
strings.translated: And yet -- the fact that she could still wear a smile through all of it... was it because she was truly happy?

strings.text: ああまでして、やっと幸せになれたのか。
strings.translated: After going that far, had she finally found happiness.

strings.text: それが久方に心に痛みを覚える程、気になって仕方なかった…。
strings.translated: It bothered me so much it was almost painful -- a pain in my heart I hadn't felt in a long time...

strings.text: …なあ、桧垣。
strings.translated: Hey, Higaki.

strings.text: おまえは今、幸せなのか？
strings.translated: Are you happy right now?

strings.text: その日、学校はそのまま臨時休校になった。
strings.translated: That day, school was dismissed early and closed for the time being.

strings.text: 俺達はすぐに家に帰されて、学校自体が閉鎖された。
strings.translated: We were sent home immediately, and the school itself was shut down.

strings.text: この数ヶ月の間に、小野田さんが失踪し、星野さんが失踪し、桧垣がこんな事件を起こしたのだから、しばらくは臨時休校が続くかもしれない。
strings.translated: With Onoda-san's disappearance, Hoshino-san's disappearance, and now Higaki's incident all happening within the past few months, the temporary closure might go on for a while.

strings.text: これを、ラッキーだと思う奴もいるのかもしれないけど、俺の胸にはただただ虚しさだけが込み上げていた
strings.translated: Some people might have considered that lucky, but all I felt welling up inside me was a hollow emptiness.

strings.text: そのまま真っ直ぐに家に帰る気分にもなれず、俺はクラブへと顔を出した。
strings.translated: I wasn't in the mood to go straight home, so I stopped by the Club instead.

strings.text: 同じ考えの奴は何人かいたようで、既に部屋の中には俺と同じ学校の生徒が数人くつろいでいた。
strings.translated: A few others seemed to have had the same idea -- several students from my school were already lounging around inside.

strings.text: 学校であんなことがあったのに、彼らの顔には笑顔が浮かんでいる。
strings.translated: Even after what had happened at school, their faces wore smiles.

strings.text: 桧垣はクラブのメンバーだったけれど、あいつのことなんかどうでもいいということなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Did they just not care about Higaki at all?

strings.text: 俺はそんなことをおぼろげに想像しながらソファーに腰かけたけど、耳に飛び込んできた会話は、それとはまったく正反対のものだった。
strings.translated: I was vaguely wondering about that as I sank into a sofa, but the conversation that reached my ears was the complete opposite of what I'd imagined.

strings.text: クラブ男性Ａ「いや、本当に良かったよな」
strings.translated: Club Man A「No, really, I'm so glad for her.」

strings.text: クラブ女性Ａ「彼女、とっても幸せそうだったわね」
strings.translated: Club Woman A「She looked so happy, didn't she?」

strings.text: 桧垣の話をしているとも思えなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't even imagine they were talking about Higaki.

strings.text: でも、彼らは確かに桧垣のことを話題にしていて、しかも全員が嬉しそうな表情さえ浮かべていた。
strings.translated: But they were definitely talking about her -- and every single one of them was wearing an expression of genuine joy.

strings.text: クラブ男性Ｂ「瑛ちゃん、ずっと悩んでたしなぁ」
strings.translated: Club Man B「Akira had been struggling with this for so long.」

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｂ「やっと救われる方法を見つけられたのね」
strings.translated: Club Woman B「She finally found the way to be saved.」

strings.text: クラブ男性Ｃ「だけど、あれすごかったな」
strings.translated: Club Man C「Still, that was something else.」

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｃ「血がいっぱい出て…綺麗だったわよね
strings.translated: Club Woman C「All that blood... it was beautiful, wasn't it?」

strings.text: これでいいのだろうか？
strings.translated: Is this feeling right?

strings.text: この感覚が正しいのだろうか？
strings.translated: Is this feeling right?

strings.text: 持たないようにしていた疑問が首をもたげてくるのがはっきりとわかった。
strings.translated: I could clearly feel a doubt I had been trying not to have raising its head.

strings.text: 俺にはもう、何が普通なのかわからなかった。
strings.translated: Were the people who could look at Higaki in that state and feel glad about it truly the ones who had been saved?

strings.text: あの状態の桧垣を見て良かったと感じられる彼らは、やっぱり真に救われた人間だからなんだろうか。
strings.translated: Club Man A「She's admirable.

strings.text: クラブ男性Ａ「彼女は立派だよ。
strings.translated: She won her girl's body through her own strength.」

strings.text: 自分の力で、望んでいた女の子の身体を勝ち取ったんだ」
strings.translated: Club Woman A「I'd like to be like that someday, too.」

strings.text: クラブ女性Ａ「私達も、あんなふうになりたいものね」
strings.translated: Club Man B「I'm sure Sonoda-sensei would be pleased.」

strings.text: クラブ男性Ｂ「きっと園田先生も喜ぶだろうなぁ」
strings.translated: Club Woman B「Akira probably would have wanted Sonoda-sensei to see it, if she could have.」

strings.text: クラブ女性Ｂ「瑛さん、できれば園田先生にも見てほしかったでしょうね」
strings.translated: I couldn't do it.

strings.text: 無理だった。
strings.translated: It was impossible.

strings.text: 流石にいくら受け流そうとしても、彼らの感覚にはついていけなかった。
strings.translated: No -- I didn't need to keep up.

strings.text: いや、ついていく必要はなくて、そういうものなんだと受け入れればいいだけの話だ。
strings.translated: I just needed to accept it as the way things were.

strings.text: …そのはずだ。
strings.translated: ...That's how it was supposed to be.

strings.text: 桧垣は幸せだった。
strings.translated: Higaki was happy.

strings.text: そういうものなんだって、俺も思うようにすれば、そう受け入れてしまえばよかったんだ。
strings.translated: If I just told myself that's how it is, if I just accepted it... that was all I needed to do.

strings.text: …ただ、それだけのことだ
strings.translated: ...That was all.

strings.text: 今日はやっぱり、家に帰ろう
strings.translated: I should just go home today, after all.

strings.text: 大智「…？
strings.translated: Daichi「...?」

strings.text: 廊下に出た俺の前を、菱木さんが通り過ぎた。
strings.translated: As I stepped out into the hallway, Hishiki-san walked past me.

strings.text: 奇妙だったのは、彼女がクーラーボックスのようなものを持っていたことだった。
strings.translated: What was strange was that she was carrying something like a cooler box.

strings.text: そして、真っ直ぐに塾長室へと向かって行く
strings.translated: And she was heading straight for the director's office.

strings.text: 何だろう。
strings.translated: What is it?

strings.text: クーラーボックスの中身が、妙に気になってしまう。
strings.translated: I can't help feeling strangely curious about what's inside that cooler box.

strings.text: あの中には何が入ってるんだろう。
strings.translated: What could be in there?

strings.text: どうして、今日みたいな事件が起こった日に限って、菱木さんまで普段とは違うことをしてるんだろう
strings.translated: Why is it that on a day when something like today's incident happens, Hishiki-san of all people is doing something out of the ordinary too?

strings.text: 紗英子「…何？」
strings.translated: Saeko「...What?」

strings.text: 俺の視線に気が付いたのか、菱木さんに声をかけられた
strings.translated: She must have noticed my gaze, because Hishiki-san spoke to me.

strings.text: 大智「いや、何となく
strings.translated: Daichi「No, just... nothing in particular.」

strings.text: 紗英子「これの中身が気になるの？
strings.translated: Saeko「Are you curious about what's inside this?」

strings.text: 大智「…少し」
strings.translated: Daichi「...A little.」

strings.text: 俺は包み隠そうともせず、正直に答えた
strings.translated: I answered honestly, without trying to hide it.

strings.text: 紗英子「構わないわよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「I don't mind.

strings.text: 気になるのなら、入ってきたら
strings.translated: If you're curious, come on in.」

strings.text: 特に嫌がった様子も見せずそう言って、菱木さんが塾長室に入って行く。
strings.translated: Without showing any particular reluctance, she said that and went into the director's office.

strings.text: 俺も黙ってその後を追う
strings.translated: I followed silently behind her.

strings.text: 愛「あら」
strings.translated: Ai「Oh my.」

strings.text: 塾長室に入ると、そこには神村さんが待っていた。
strings.translated: When I entered the director's office, Kamimura-san was waiting inside.

strings.text: 何で彼女がここにいるんだ？
strings.translated: Why was she here?

strings.text: やっぱり園田はもういなくて、そのことをみんなに話したのか？
strings.translated: As expected, Sonoda was already gone -- had she told everyone about it?

strings.text: それとも、菱木さんにだけ…？
strings.translated: Or just Hishiki-san...?

strings.text: 紗英子「持って来たわよ
strings.translated: Saeko「I brought it.」

strings.text: 愛「ご苦労様」
strings.translated: Ai「Good work.」

strings.text: 菱木さんは、神村さんにクーラーボックスとデジタルカメラを手渡していた。
strings.translated: Hishiki-san was handing the cooler box and a digital camera to Kamimura-san.

strings.text: これから、そのカメラでなにかを撮影するつもりなんだろうか？
strings.translated: Were they planning to photograph something with that camera?

strings.text: クーラーボックスの中身も見当がつかなくて、俺は部屋の隅で突っ立っているしかなかった
strings.translated: I had no idea what was in the cooler box either, and I had no choice but to stand there in the corner of the room.

strings.text: 紗英子「そんなところにいないで、座ったらどう
strings.translated: Saeko「Don't just stand there in the corner -- why don't you sit down?」

strings.text: 大智「それは…？」
strings.translated: Daichi「That is...?」

strings.text: 菱木さんに促され、ソファーに座る代わりに尋ねる
strings.translated: Prompted by Hishiki-san, I ask instead of taking a seat on the sofa.

strings.text: 愛「桧垣君のおちんちん」
strings.translated: Ai「Higaki-kun's penis.」

strings.text: 想像もしていなかった言葉が、神村さんの口から告げられた
strings.translated: Words I never could have imagined came from Kamimura-san's mouth.

strings.text: 大智「桧垣のって…えっ？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Higaki's... what?」

strings.text: どうしてそんな物をもって来たのか、全く理解できなかった
strings.translated: I had absolutely no idea why she would have brought something like that here.

strings.text: 大智「何で…そんな物
strings.translated: Daichi「Why... would you have something like that?」

strings.text: 愛「こういうのを欲しがるお客さんがいるの。
strings.translated: Ai「There's a customer who wants something like this.

strings.text: もうお金は受け取ってあるわ
strings.translated: I've already received the payment.」

strings.text: 大智「お金…」
strings.translated: Daichi「Money...」

strings.text: 思わぬ言葉に、俺はただ驚くことしかできなかった
strings.translated: Faced with those unexpected words, all I could do was stand there in shock.

strings.text: 紗英子「信じられない？
strings.translated: Saeko「Hard to believe?

strings.text: そんな物を欲しがる人間がいるなんて
strings.translated: To think there were people out there who would want something like that...

strings.text: 大智「そりゃあ…信じろってほうが
strings.translated: Daichi「Well... asking me to believe it is a bit...」

strings.text: 紗英子「世の中、そういう人間もいるってことよ。
strings.translated: Saeko「There are people like that in this world.

strings.text: 切断されたばかりのペニスなんて、レアなアイテムだし…。
strings.translated: A freshly severed penis is a rare item, after all...

strings.text: 持ち主が桧垣さんとあれば、なおさらでしょう
strings.translated: And given that the owner was Higaki-san, that makes it all the more so.」

strings.text: 大智「この事、桧垣は…？
strings.translated: Daichi「Does Higaki know about this...?」

strings.text: 紗英子「ある程度は合意の上よ」
strings.translated: Saeko「She agreed to it, to a degree.」

strings.text: 菱木さんが呆れたように笑う。
strings.translated: Hishiki-san laughed as if exasperated.

strings.text: この表情は俺に向けられているのか、それとも桧垣に向けられているのか。
strings.translated: Was that expression directed at me, or at Higaki?

strings.text: どちらにしても神村さんと菱木さんのやっていることは、今の俺の感覚からしてととても酷いことだと感じられた。
strings.translated: Either way, what Kamimura-san and Hishiki-san were doing felt deeply cruel by any measure of feeling I still had.

strings.text: この事を桧垣が知ったら…どう思うんだろう。
strings.translated: If Higaki found out about this... what would she think?

strings.text: 悲しむんだろうか。
strings.translated: Would she be sad?

strings.text: それとも、クラブの役に立ったって喜ぶんだろうか。
strings.translated: Or would she be glad to have been of use to the Club?

strings.text: 股間を血まみれにしながら、恐らくは激痛に耐えながら、それでも笑顔を浮かべていた桧垣のことを思うと、あいつの扱われ方があまりにも切なく思えた
strings.translated: When I thought of Higaki -- her crotch soaked in blood, enduring what must have been excruciating pain, and still forcing a smile -- the way she was being treated felt unbearably heartbreaking.

strings.text: 紗英子「それにしても、学校でやる必要はあったの？
strings.translated: Saeko「Even so, did she have to do it at school?

strings.text: リスクが高すぎると思うけど
strings.translated: I think the risk was far too high, though.

strings.text: 愛「お客さんの要望なの。
strings.translated: Ai「It was the customer's request.

strings.text: それに、リスクは好きでしょう？
strings.translated: Besides, you like risk, don't you?」

strings.text: 紗英子「まあ、面白い見世物ではあったわね」
strings.translated: Saeko「Well, it was quite a spectacle.」

strings.text: そんなことをいって、菱木さんが小さく肩をゆらす。
strings.translated: Saying that, Hishiki-san gave a small shake of her shoulders.

strings.text: それは笑いだったのか、それとも溜め息だったのか。
strings.translated: Was it a laugh, or a sigh?

strings.text: そうは思案してみても、それを理解したいとは思えなかった。
strings.translated: Even as I wondered, I found I had no desire to understand it.

strings.text: でも、このやりとりでわかったこともあった。
strings.translated: But this exchange did tell me something.

strings.text: 過去がどうあれ、今このクラブの舵を取っているのは恐らく神村さんで、菱木さんはどうやらそれを知っていて、対等の立場で話してるようだ
strings.translated: Whatever the history, the one steering the Club now was probably Kamimura-san, and Hishiki-san apparently knew that and was speaking to her as an equal.

strings.text: 愛「彼は、ちゃんと準備した上でやってくれたんでしょう？
strings.translated: Ai「He went through with it properly prepared, didn't he?」

strings.text: 遺書のようなものは用意してくれたし、ちゃんとトイレにも寄ってくれたから。
strings.translated: She prepared something like a will, and she made sure to stop by the restroom.

strings.text: 切り落としたものをトイレに流したように見えるんじゃないかしら
strings.translated: It probably looks like she flushed what she cut off down the toilet.」

strings.text: 紗英子「それで、これ、確認する？
strings.translated: Saeko「So -- do you want to check it?」

strings.text: 菱木さんの言葉に、神村さんが小さくうなずく。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san gave a small nod at Hishiki-san's words.

strings.text: それを確認して、菱木さんはデジタルカメラを塾長室のモニターに繋いだ。
strings.translated: Confirming that, Hishiki-san connected the digital camera to the monitor in the director's office.

strings.text: やがて画面に表示されたものは…女子の制服を着た桧垣だった。
strings.translated: What appeared on the screen was... Higaki, dressed in a girl's school uniform.

strings.text: 場所は……たぶん生徒会室だ。
strings.translated: The location was... probably the student council room.

strings.text: 桧垣はカメラの前に置いたパイプ椅子に座り、股間を大きく広げて陰茎の根元をきつく縛ると、カメラに笑顔で語りかけながら、ナイフで自分の陰茎を切り落とし始めた。
strings.translated: Higaki sat in a folding chair placed in front of the camera, spread her legs wide, tied the base of her penis tightly, and then -- smiling at the camera -- began to cut off her own penis with a knife.

strings.text: 痛みに顔を顰め、歯を食いしばり、涙を流しながら、必死に笑顔を取り繕って……これで女になれるのだと、園田やクラブに感謝の言葉を述べながら、先に陰茎を、次いで陰嚢を切り落として見せた
strings.translated: Wincing in pain, gritting her teeth, tears streaming down her face, desperately maintaining a smile... declaring that this would make her a real girl, offering words of gratitude to Sonoda and the Club, she cut off first the penis, then the scrotum, and showed them to the camera.

strings.text: モニターの映像を見ながら、俺は胸にちりちりするものを感じていた。
strings.translated: Watching the footage on the monitor, I felt something prickling in my chest.

strings.text: 桧垣は、これでよかったんだろうか。
strings.translated: Had this really been okay for Higaki?

strings.text: 自分がこういう扱いを受けてるということを、あいつは知ってたんだろうか。
strings.translated: Did she know she was being treated this way?

strings.text: どうでもいい事のはずなのに、何故だか色々と考えてしまっていた
strings.translated: It should have been none of my concern, and yet for some reason I couldn't stop thinking about it.

strings.text: 大智「…何？」
strings.translated: Daichi「...What?」

strings.text: 考え事をしていると、菱木さんが俺の顔を見つめていた
strings.translated: Lost in thought, I noticed Hishiki-san was staring at my face.

strings.text: 紗英子「何も言わないのね
strings.translated: Saeko「You're not going to say anything.」

strings.text: 大智「言う必要なんかないだろ
strings.translated: Daichi「There's nothing I need to say.」

strings.text: 紗英子「…そう」
strings.translated: Saeko「...I see.」

strings.text: そう言って、菱木さんが小さく肩をすくめる。
strings.translated: Saying that, Hishiki-san gave a small shrug.

strings.text: 彼女が何を考えてるのかは、俺にはわからない。
strings.translated: I had no idea what she was thinking.

strings.text: 無気力な俺のことを心の中で笑ってるのか、それとも、それ以外の意味があったのか。
strings.translated: Was she laughing at me inside for my apathy, or did it mean something else?

strings.text: それを尋ねてみたい気はしたけれど、実際にその答えを聞くのには抵抗感があった。
strings.translated: I felt like asking her, but I resisted actually hearing the answer.

strings.text: 多分…恐いのだろう。
strings.translated: Probably... I was afraid.

strings.text: その答えがどんなものであったとしても
strings.translated: No matter what that answer might be.

strings.text: 紗英子「とにかく、これで私の仕事は終わりね
strings.translated: Saeko「Anyway, that's my job done.」

strings.text: 愛「ええ、お疲れ様
strings.translated: Ai「Yes, good work.」

strings.text: 紗英子「それじゃ、あとは自由に過ごさせてもらおうかしら
strings.translated: Saeko「Well then, I think I'll spend the rest of the time as I please.」

strings.text: 紗英子「そうだ。
strings.translated: Saeko「Oh, that's right.

strings.text: 白坂さんを借りてもいい？」
strings.translated: Would it be alright if I borrowed Shirasaka-san?」

strings.text: どういう風の吹き回しか、いきなり菱木さんが神村さんにそう尋ねた
strings.translated: Out of nowhere, Hishiki-san suddenly asked Kamimura-san that.

strings.text: 愛「…どうして私に訊くの？
strings.translated: Ai「...Why are you asking me?」

strings.text: 紗英子「訊いたほうがいいのかと思ったから
strings.translated: Saeko「I thought it would be better to ask.」

strings.text: 愛「ご自由にどうぞ。
strings.translated: Ai「Do as you like.

strings.text: 私のものじゃないんだし
strings.translated: He's not mine.」

strings.text: 紗英子「それじゃあ遠慮なく
strings.translated: Saeko「Well then, I won't hold back.」

strings.text: 俺には尋ねようともしないで、菱木さんは今後の予定を決めたみたいだった。
strings.translated: Without even bothering to ask me, Hishiki-san seemed to have decided on her plans.

strings.text: 一体、俺になにをさせるつもりなのか。
strings.translated: What on earth was she intending to make me do?

strings.text: 俺とセックスでもするつもりなのか。
strings.translated: Was she planning to have sex with me?

strings.text: もし、そうだとしても、俺に断る理由はなかった
strings.translated: Even if that were the case, I had no reason to refuse.

strings.text: 紗英子「少し準備があるから、後で連絡するわ。
strings.translated: Saeko「I have a few preparations to make, so I'll contact you later.

strings.text: 携帯、近くに置いておいてね
strings.translated: Keep your phone close.」

strings.text: そう言って、菱木さんは楽しそうに笑った。
strings.translated: Saying that, Hishiki-san laughed with what seemed like genuine enjoyment.

strings.text: 彼女の表情から、ろくでもないことを考えてるのは容易に想像がついた
strings.translated: From her expression, it was easy to imagine she was thinking of something thoroughly indecent.

strings.text: クラブで随分長い時間を過ごした後、俺は自宅に戻った。
strings.translated: After spending a considerable amount of time at the Club, I returned home.

strings.text: 菱木さんからの連絡はすぐにあるかと思ったのに、夕食を摂る時間になっても携帯電話が呼び出し音を鳴らすことはなかった。
strings.translated: I had expected to hear from Hishiki-san soon, but even as dinnertime came around, my phone never rang.

strings.text: もしかして、忘れてしまったんだろうか。
strings.translated: Had she forgotten?

strings.text: 何か急な用事でも入って、今日はしようと思っていたことができなくなってしまったのだろうか。
strings.translated: Had something urgent come up, making it impossible to do what she'd planned for today?

strings.text: それならそれで問題なかった。
strings.translated: If so, that was fine.

strings.text: だけど、念のために一応携帯電話は持ち歩くようにした。
strings.translated: Still, just in case, I made sure to keep my phone on me.

strings.text: 夕食を終えて、自分の部屋で気怠さに身を任せるように過ごしながら、俺は様々な可能性について思いを巡らせていた。
strings.translated: After dinner, lounging in my room in a kind of listless haze, I turned over various possibilities in my mind.

strings.text: 菱木さんの性格を考えると、真夜中に連絡が来てもおかしくはない。
strings.translated: Knowing Hishiki-san's personality, it wouldn't be strange for her to contact me in the middle of the night.

strings.text: それこそ、俺が…家族の皆が寝静まるような時間になってから電話が鳴ることも考えられた。
strings.translated: It was entirely conceivable that the call would come after everyone in the family had gone to sleep.

strings.text: だから、今のうちに寝ておこうかとも考えはじめていた
strings.translated: So I had started thinking I should get some rest while I could.

strings.text: 美桜「大智、今いい？
strings.translated: Mio「Daichi, you free right now?」

strings.text: 芽生「エッチしよう」
strings.translated: Mei「Let's have sex.」

strings.text: 俺の予定なんか全く気にもせずに、姉さんと芽生が部屋に入って来た。
strings.translated: Without any regard for my plans whatsoever, Mio and Mei walked into my room.

strings.text: でも、今日は菱木さんとの予定がある。
strings.translated: But today I had plans with Hishiki-san.

strings.text: だから、今から体力を消耗するのは避けたい
strings.translated: So I wanted to avoid draining my energy before then.

strings.text: この後用事があるんだ
strings.translated: I've got something to do later.」

strings.text: 芽生「えーっ
strings.translated: Mei「Awww.」

strings.text: 体を休めておきたいんだ
strings.translated: I want to save my strength.」
