strings.text: その気持ちと、これからのことを彼女とちゃんと話し合いたかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to talk with her properly about those feelings, and about what comes next.

strings.text: 電話に出てくれるかわからなかったけど、出てくれるまで何度もかけるつもりだった
strings.translated: I didn't know if she'd pick up, but I was prepared to call as many times as it took until she did.

strings.text: 愛「もしもし…」
strings.translated: Ai「Hello...」

strings.text: 何度目かの呼び出し音の後、神村さんの声が聞こえてきた
strings.translated: After several rings, I heard Kamimura-san's voice.

strings.text: 大智「もしもし、俺。
strings.translated: Daichi「Hello, it's me.

strings.text: 白坂だけど
strings.translated: Shirasaka.

strings.text: 愛「何？
strings.translated: Ai「What?

strings.text: 大智「俺…君の事が好きだ
strings.translated: Daichi「I... like you.

strings.text: 愛「…それで？
strings.translated: Ai「...And?

strings.text: 大智「俺は君の力になりたい。
strings.translated: Daichi「I want to be there for you.

strings.text: 君の事を助けたい
strings.translated: I want to help you.

strings.text: 男手があると助かるわ。
strings.translated: Having a man around would help.

strings.text: 私一人じゃクラブをまとめきれないから
strings.translated: I can't hold the Club together on my own.

strings.text: 大智「そんな話じゃないんだ。
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not what I'm talking about.

strings.text: そうじゃなくて、俺……」
strings.translated: That's not it -- I...」

strings.text: 心は決まって、伝えたいことはいっぱいあるのに、上手く言葉が出てこない。
strings.translated: My mind is made up, and there's so much I want to say, but the words won't come out right.

strings.text: どういえば伝わるだろう？
strings.translated: How do I say it so she'll understand?

strings.text: どうしたらやり直せるんだろう
strings.translated: How do I make things right again?

strings.text: 大智「俺はまだ、君を救いたいと思ってる。
strings.translated: Daichi「I still want to save you.

strings.text: あのクラブから、君を救い出したいと思ってるから
strings.translated: I want to get you out of that Club.

strings.text: 愛「何の話？
strings.translated: Ai「What are you talking about?

strings.text: …一度やったくらいで彼氏にでもなったつもり？
strings.translated: You think sleeping with me once makes you my boyfriend or something?

strings.text: 大智「そういうわけじゃ
strings.translated: Daichi「That's not what I--

strings.text: 大智「とにかく、会って話そう。
strings.translated: Daichi「Anyway, let's meet and talk.

strings.text: 電話だと
strings.translated: Over the phone it's--

strings.text: 俺の話をさえぎって、神村さんは電話を切ってしまった。
strings.translated: She cut me off mid-sentence and hung up.

strings.text: 彼女が、こんな態度を取るのは珍しい気がする。
strings.translated: It felt unusual for her to act this way.

strings.text: 話の途中で電話は切られてしまったけれど、でも、そのことに…垣間見えた神村さんの感情の表れに、俺は一筋の希望を見出せたような予感がしていた
strings.translated: The call had ended before we could finish talking, but even so -- in that very fact, in the glimpse of emotion I'd caught from Kamimura-san, I felt like I'd found a thin thread of hope.

strings.text: 本当はもう少し色々話したかったんだけど、なにもかもが思った通りにいく訳がない。
strings.translated: I'd wanted to say so much more, but nothing ever goes exactly the way you plan.

strings.text: 今は自分にやれるだけのことをするしかなかった。
strings.translated: For now, all I could do was everything within my power.

strings.text: この時間なら、まだクラブにいるだろうか。
strings.translated: At this hour, would she still be at the Club?

strings.text: まずは確認してみよう。
strings.translated: I'd check there first.

strings.text: そして、クラブにいなかったら神村さんの家に行ってみよう。
strings.translated: And if she wasn't at the Club, I'd go to Kamimura-san's place.

strings.text: 今は考えるより行動すべきだ。
strings.translated: Right now I needed to act, not think.

strings.text: 何かをすれば何かに繋がる。
strings.translated: Do something, and it leads to something else.

strings.text: そう信じて前に進もう
strings.translated: Believing that, I pushed myself forward.

strings.text: 部屋を出ると、姉さんと鉢合わせた。
strings.translated: When I stepped out of my room, I ran into my sister.

strings.text: ちょうどいい。
strings.translated: Perfect timing.

strings.text: 俺は階段を下りながら、出かけることを伝えた
strings.translated: I told her I was heading out as I made my way down the stairs.

strings.text: 大智「ちょっと外に出てくる
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm heading out for a bit.

strings.text: 美桜「どこに行くの？
strings.translated: Mio「Where are you going?

strings.text: 大智「クラブ
strings.translated: Daichi「The Club.

strings.text: 両親にはコンビニに行くと伝えて、俺は家の外に出た。
strings.translated: I told my parents I was going to the convenience store, and stepped outside.

strings.text: 神村さんはいるだろうか。
strings.translated: Would Kamimura-san be there?

strings.text: いたとしたら、ちゃんと話ができるだろうか。
strings.translated: And if she was, would I actually be able to talk to her properly?

strings.text: 歩いてる間にも不安が押し寄せてきたけれど、俺はそれを振り払うようにしながらクラブへと向けて歩きはじめた
strings.translated: Anxiety kept washing over me as I walked, but I shook it off and started making my way toward the Club.

strings.text: 途中でいても立ってもいられずに走ったおかげで、クラブの入居しているビルには思いのほか早く着いた。
strings.translated: Partway there, I couldn't stand it anymore and broke into a run, which meant I reached the building housing the Club sooner than expected.

strings.text: 塾長室の窓には微かな明かりが見える。
strings.translated: A faint light was visible in the window of the director's office.

strings.text: きっと神村さんだ
strings.translated: It had to be Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 塾長室まで一気に駆け上がる。
strings.translated: I sprinted up to the director's office in one go.

strings.text: ここで逃げられたら、ちゃんと話をする機会は二度とないかもしれない
strings.translated: If she slipped away here, I might never get another chance to talk to her properly.

strings.text: 部屋に飛び込むと、まだ神村さんはそこにいて、どこか冷めた表情で俺を迎えた
strings.translated: I burst into the room -- Kamimura-san was still there, and she met me with an expression that was somehow cold and distant.

strings.text: 愛「何しに来たの？
strings.translated: Ai「What did you come here for?

strings.text: 大智「君と話しに来た
strings.translated: Daichi「I came to talk to you.

strings.text: 愛「馬鹿馬鹿しい…」
strings.translated: Ai「How ridiculous...」

strings.text: とても不快そうに、そして吐き捨てるように神村さんは、そういった。
strings.translated: With obvious disgust, as if spitting out the words, Kamimura-san said that.

strings.text: 神村さんの表情にはありありと嫌悪感が浮かんでいて、まるで怒ったように俺のことをにらみ付ける。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san's face was openly twisted with contempt, and she glared at me as if she were furious.

strings.text: そんな彼女を見るのは初めてだった。
strings.translated: I had never seen her like that before.

strings.text: これが、彼女の本当の姿なのかもしれない。
strings.translated: Maybe this was her true self.

strings.text: 何でも静かに受け流していたのは、偽りの姿だったのかもしれない。
strings.translated: The way she had always quietly let everything slide -- maybe that had been a mask.

strings.text: でも、だからこそちゃんと話し合いたい。
strings.translated: But that was exactly why I wanted to talk things through properly.

strings.text: 目の前に現れた本当の神村愛と、これからのことを話し合いたい
strings.translated: I wanted to talk about what comes next with the real Kamimura Ai, standing right in front of me.

strings.text: 愛「わかってるの？
strings.translated: Ai「Do you understand?

strings.text: 全部私がやったって言ってるのよ？
strings.translated: I'm telling you I did all of it -- do you understand?

strings.text: 大智「わかってるよ
strings.translated: Daichi「I understand.

strings.text: 愛「全然わかってない！
strings.translated: Ai「You don't understand at all!

strings.text: 私がみんなを不幸にして、私が殺したの！
strings.translated: I made everyone miserable -- I killed them!

strings.text: 愛「小野田さんも、桧垣君も、円夏も……他にもみんな、全員！
strings.translated: Ai「Onoda-san, Higaki-kun, Madoka... and everyone else, every single one of them!

strings.text: 私がやらせたの！
strings.translated: I made them do it!

strings.text: 愛「園田だって私があなたを利用してハメてやったの！
strings.translated: Ai「And Sonoda -- I used you to set him up!

strings.text: 私がお父さんを殺したの！
strings.translated: I killed my father!

strings.text: 愛「そんな私を助ける？
strings.translated: Ai「And you still want to help me?

strings.text: 何から救うっていうの？
strings.translated: What exactly are you saving me from?

strings.text: 全部…全部私がやったのに……！
strings.translated: It was all... all my doing...!

strings.text: 大智「もうこんなことはやめよう
strings.translated: Daichi「Let's stop all of this.

strings.text: 愛「やめる…？
strings.translated: Ai「Stop...?

strings.text: やめてどうするの？
strings.translated: Stop and then what?

strings.text: どう…どうしろっていうの？
strings.translated: What... what am I supposed to do?

strings.text: 今更後戻りなんて出来るはずないでしょう？
strings.translated: There's no way I can go back now, is there?

strings.text: 大智「今からでもやり直せる！
strings.translated: Daichi「It's not too late to start over!

strings.text: 愛「そんなわけない！
strings.translated: Ai「That's impossible!

strings.text: なかったことになんてできない！
strings.translated: I can't just make it all disappear!

strings.text: 大智「やってみなきゃわからないだろう？
strings.translated: Daichi「You won't know unless you try.

strings.text: 大智「俺も手伝うから
strings.translated: Daichi「I'll help you.

strings.text: 愛「何で？
strings.translated: Ai「Why?

strings.text: あんた馬鹿じゃないの？
strings.translated: Are you stupid or something?

strings.text: なんで諦めないの？
strings.translated: Why won't you give up?

strings.text: なんでそんなにしつこいのよ。
strings.translated: Why are you so damn persistent.

strings.text: 全部私が悪いって言ってるでしょう？
strings.translated: I'm telling you it's all my fault!

strings.text: 大智「俺は、君の事が好きだ
strings.translated: Daichi「I... like you.

strings.text: 愛「まだわからない！
strings.translated: Ai「You still don't get it!

strings.text: あんたが見ていたのは全部幻想！
strings.translated: Everything you saw was an illusion!

strings.text: 騙されてたの！
strings.translated: You were being deceived!

strings.text: あんたの勝手な妄想を私に押し付けないで！
strings.translated: Don't project your selfish delusions onto me!

strings.text: 大智「今は違う。
strings.translated: Daichi「Not anymore.

strings.text: 本当の君を知ってるよ
strings.translated: I know the real you now.

strings.text: 愛「嘘！
strings.translated: Ai「Liar!

strings.text: あんただってやりまくったくせに！
strings.translated: You did it too -- over and over again!

strings.text: 射精したくせに！
strings.translated: You came inside me!

strings.text: 今更綺麗事言わないでよ！
strings.translated: Don't give me that self-righteous garbage now!

strings.text: 愛「あんたにそんなこと言う資格はない！
strings.translated: Ai「You have no right to say something like that to me!

strings.text: あんたなんかに、人を好きになる資格なんてないの！
strings.translated: Someone like you has no right to love anyone!

strings.text: 愛「あんたなんか、苦しんでのたれ死ねばいいんだ！
strings.translated: Ai「Someone like you should just suffer and die in a ditch!

strings.text: 今までになく感情的になって、神村さんが叫ぶ。
strings.translated: More emotional than she had ever been, Kamimura-san screams.

strings.text: 罵倒する言葉は、何だか自分自身に言ってるようにも聞こえた。
strings.translated: The words she hurled as insults somehow sounded like she was saying them to herself.

strings.text: この人は、どれだけ苦しんだんだろう。
strings.translated: How much had this person suffered?

strings.text: どれだけ悲しんだんだろう。
strings.translated: How much had she grieved?

strings.text: 助けを求めても誰も助けてくれない絶望感を、いったい何度味わったんだろう
strings.translated: How many times had she tasted that despair -- of crying out for help and having no one answer?

strings.text: 愛「いいこと教えてあげる。
strings.translated: Ai「Let me tell you something.

strings.text: さっき、あなたのお姉さんに命令したの
strings.translated: A little while ago, I gave your sister an order.

strings.text: 愛「あなたを殺しなさいって
strings.translated: Ai「I told her to kill you.

strings.text: 愛「馬鹿みたい。
strings.translated: Ai「How pathetic.

strings.text: いまだに園田が生きてるって信じて…私からのメールを疑いもしないで。
strings.translated: She still believes Sonoda is alive... she didn't even question an email from me.

strings.text: 園田の命令なら、あの女は何でも聞くの
strings.translated: If it's Sonoda's orders, that woman will do anything.

strings.text: 愛「そんなふうにしたのは、この私なの！」
strings.translated: Ai「And the one who made her that way -- is me!」

strings.text: 神村さんが叫ぶ。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san screams.

strings.text: 必死になって叫んでいる。
strings.translated: She's screaming desperately.

strings.text: 俺のことを怒らせようと、その怒りで自分に反発させようと、自分から遠ざけようとしているのは明白だ。
strings.translated: It's obvious she's trying to make me angry, trying to make me push back against her out of that anger, trying to drive me away from her.

strings.text: でも、俺は負けない。
strings.translated: But I won't lose.

strings.text: 神村さんを救うと誓ったんだ。
strings.translated: I swore I would save Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 彼女のためならなんでもするって決めたんだ。
strings.translated: I decided I would do anything for her.

strings.text: 突然、背中に重い衝撃を感じた。
strings.translated: Suddenly, I felt a heavy impact against my back.

strings.text: 何が起こったんだ…？
strings.translated: What's happening...?

strings.text: 理解できないまま、脚の力が抜けて、俺はその場に崩れ落ちた
strings.translated: Without understanding what had happened, the strength left my legs and I crumpled to the floor.

strings.text: ／美桜「どういうこと？」
strings.translated: /Mio「What does this mean?」

strings.text: 聞き覚えのある声が聞こえた
strings.translated: I heard a familiar voice.

strings.text: 大智「姉…さん……？」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis... sis...?」

strings.text: 背中の熱さが、徐々に痛みへと変わっていく。
strings.translated: The heat in my back was gradually turning into pain.

strings.text: 激しい痛みに燃えるように熱くなった部分から、痺れるような感覚が拡がっていく。
strings.translated: From the spot burning with intense pain, a numbing sensation began to spread outward.

strings.text: 増していく痛みをこらえながら、声の主を…姉さんの姿をかろうじて動く目と首の動きだけで探す
strings.translated: Fighting through the mounting pain, I searched for the source of that voice -- for my sister -- using only the faint movement of my eyes and neck.

strings.text: 美桜「今の話…どういう事なの？」
strings.translated: Mio「That conversation just now... what does it mean?」

strings.text: ゆらりとした足取りで、姉さんが神村さんへと近付いていく。
strings.translated: With unsteady steps, my sister approached Kamimura-san.

strings.text: その手には、血に濡れた……俺を刺した包丁が握られたままだ
strings.translated: In her hand, still gripped tight, was a kitchen knife wet with blood -- the knife she had used to stab me.

strings.text: 愛「聞いていたんでしょう？
strings.translated: Ai「You were listening, weren't you?

strings.text: 愛「園田はもういない。
strings.translated: Ai「Sonoda is gone.

strings.text: あいつは死んだの。
strings.translated: He's dead.

strings.text: 私が代わりにメールを出して、みんなに指示を出していたの。
strings.translated: I sent the emails in his place, and gave everyone their instructions.

strings.text: 最初から、ずっと
strings.translated: From the very beginning. The whole time.

strings.text: 大智「やめろ……！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Stop it...!」

strings.text: 力を振り絞ってそう告げても、２人とも俺に見向きもしない
strings.translated: Even as I forced out those words with every last bit of strength I had, neither of them spared me a glance.

strings.text: 大智「くっ……っ…！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Gh...! ...!」

strings.text: クソッ！
strings.translated: Damn it!

strings.text: クソッ……！
strings.translated: Damn it...!

strings.text: 全身がしびれたように重くて、背中の、腰のあたりから、どくどくと熱い何かが流れ出ていくような気がする
strings.translated: My whole body felt heavy and numb, and from my back -- somewhere around my lower back -- I could feel something hot flowing out, pulse by pulse.

strings.text: 美桜「そんなの嘘よ。
strings.translated: Mio「That's a lie.

strings.text: だって私は、ちゃんと園田先生からメールを受け取ったんだもの
strings.translated: Because I properly received emails from Sonoda-sensei myself.

strings.text: 愛「信じられないのなら何度でも言ってあげる。
strings.translated: Ai「If you can't believe me, I'll say it as many times as it takes.

strings.text: 園田は死んだ。
strings.translated: Sonoda is dead.

strings.text: あのメールは私が書いたの
strings.translated: I wrote those emails.

strings.text: 愛「美桜くん、残念だが大智くんはまた私たちを裏切ろうとしているようだ。
strings.translated: Ai「Mio, I'm afraid it seems Daichi is trying to betray us again.

strings.text: せめて君の手で彼を誤った考えから解き放ってあげなさい
strings.translated: At least free him from his misguided thinking with your own hands.

strings.text: 愛「ふふっ…ばっかみたい。
strings.translated: Ai「Heheh... how stupid.

strings.text: あんたたちは最初から騙されてたの。
strings.translated: You were all being deceived from the very start.

strings.text: 救いだの、愛だの、下らない詭弁にまんまと乗せられて
strings.translated: Salvation, love -- you swallowed every last bit of that worthless sophistry hook, line, and sinker.

strings.text: 愛「あんただって本当はわかってるんでしょう？
strings.translated: Ai「You already know the truth deep down, don't you?

strings.text: セックス狂いの馬鹿な女が金儲けに利用されただけなのよ！」
strings.translated: You were just a sex-crazed fool who got used for someone else's profit!」

strings.text: 薄笑いを浮かべながら、神村さんははっきりとそういった。
strings.translated: With a thin smile on her face, Kamimura-san said it plainly.

strings.text: まるで、目の前の姉さんの中から、なにかの感情を引き出そうとするかのように、わざと直接的な言葉をぶつけているようにしか聞こえなかった。
strings.translated: It only sounded like she was deliberately hurling those blunt words to draw out some emotion from my sister standing before her.

strings.text: それがなにを招こうとしているのか…。
strings.translated: What was she trying to bring about...?

strings.text: 痛みにかき回される俺の思考の中に、一つの不吉な…破滅的な予感が過ぎっていく。
strings.translated: Through the haze of pain churning my thoughts, one dark... catastrophic premonition flashed through my mind.

strings.text: 姉さんは呆然と神村さんのことを見つめている。
strings.translated: My sister stood there, staring blankly at Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 自分に向けられた言葉を信じているのか信じてないのか、どちらとも取れる、その表情
strings.translated: That expression of hers -- impossible to tell whether she believed the words aimed at her or not.

strings.text: 美桜「でたらめ言わないで…そんなの…信じない」
strings.translated: Mio「Stop saying nonsense... I don't... believe that.」

strings.text: …姉さんは、神村さんの言葉を信じなかった。
strings.translated: ...My sister did not believe Kamimura-san's words.

strings.text: いや、信じられなかったのだろう。
strings.translated: No -- she couldn't bring herself to.

strings.text: それを信じてしまえば…園田の死を受け入れることになってしまう。
strings.translated: Because if she did... she would have to accept Sonoda's death.

strings.text: それが、姉さんにはできなかった
strings.translated: That was something my sister could not do.

strings.text: 美桜「だって、メールが来たんだもの。
strings.translated: Mio「Because I got emails.

strings.text: 園田先生から、ちゃんとメールは来たんだもの
strings.translated: I properly received emails from Sonoda-sensei.

strings.text: 美桜「だったら、園田先生は生きてるはずでしょう？
strings.translated: Mio「So that means Sonoda-sensei is alive, doesn't it?

strings.text: あなたが、園田先生をどこかに隠したんでしょう？
strings.translated: You're the one who hid Sonoda-sensei somewhere, aren't you?

strings.text: 美桜「返して…園田先生を、返してよ…」
strings.translated: Mio「Give him back... give Sonoda-sensei back...」

strings.text: 切先から俺の血が滴る包丁を、姉さんがぎゅっと握り締める。
strings.translated: My sister grips the kitchen knife tightly -- the blade dripping with my blood.

strings.text: 嫌な予感が現実のものになろうとしている。
strings.translated: My worst fear is on the verge of becoming reality.

strings.text: それだけは…それだけは、絶対にさせる訳にはいかない
strings.translated: Not that... I absolutely cannot let that happen.

strings.text: 大智「姉さん…やめるんだ…！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis... stop...!」

strings.text: 脚には力が入らない。
strings.translated: My legs won't respond.

strings.text: 辛うじて動く腕に渾身の力を込めて、２人に這い寄る。
strings.translated: I pour every last ounce of strength into my barely-functioning arms and drag myself toward the two of them.

strings.text: 姉さんを落ち着かせようと手を伸ばす
strings.translated: I reach out, trying to calm my sister down.

strings.text: 大智「うぐっ！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Ugh...!」

strings.text: 姉さんの手にしていた包丁が、差し伸べた俺の腕を切り裂いた
strings.translated: The knife in my sister's hand slashed across my outstretched arm.

strings.text: 大智「ぐあッ…！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Gah...!」

strings.text: 側頭から強い衝撃を受けて、世界が反転し、明滅する
strings.translated: A powerful blow struck the side of my head, and the world flipped upside down, flickering in and out.

strings.text: 美桜「邪魔しないで…邪魔、するなぁっ！
strings.translated: Mio「Don't get in the way... don't you DARE get in my way!

strings.text: そう叫びながら、姉さんが神村さんに向かっていく。
strings.translated: Screaming that, my sister lunges toward Kamimura-san.

strings.text: 神村さんは、迫り来る姉さんから、自分に向けられた明らかな害意から逃げようとしない。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san makes no attempt to flee from my sister bearing down on her -- from the unmistakable murderous intent aimed straight at her.

strings.text: やめろ…っ！
strings.translated: Stop... stop it...!

strings.text: 逃げろ…っ！
strings.translated: Run... run away...!

strings.text: そう叫びたいのに、俺の喉からは痛みにうめく声どころか、情けない吐息しか漏れ出てこない。
strings.translated: I want to scream those words, but from my throat comes not even a groan of pain -- only a pathetic, ragged breath.

strings.text: 歪んだ視界の中、姉さんはそのまま駆け込むように突っ込んでいって
strings.translated: Through my warped, distorted vision, my sister charges forward, throwing herself at her --

strings.text: 神村さんの腹部に、深々と包丁を突き立てた
strings.translated: -- and drove the knife deep into Kamimura-san's abdomen.

strings.text: 愛「…っ！
神村さんの口からくぐもった声が漏れるのと同時に、２人の体が床に倒れ込んだ。
strings.translated: A muffled sound escaped Kamimura-san's lips, and at the same moment, the two of them collapsed to the floor.

strings.text: 周りにあったものが巻き込まれるように落ちて、そのうめき声をほとんどかき消してしまう
strings.translated: Things around them were swept up and fell, nearly drowning out the sound of that groan entirely.

strings.text: 美桜「返せっ！
strings.translated: Mio「Give him back!

strings.text: 園田先生を返せっ！
strings.translated: Give Sonoda-sensei back!

strings.text: 姉さんは何度も包丁を振り下ろし、彼女の身体へと突き立てる
strings.translated: My sister brought the knife down again and again, plunging it into her body.

strings.text: 返せっ！
strings.translated: Give him back!

strings.text: 美桜「返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せ返せッッ！
strings.translated: Mio「Give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back give him back!!

strings.text: 半狂乱になりながら、姉さんは神村さんの身体を何度も何度も刺し、切りつけていく。
strings.translated: Half out of her mind, my sister stabbed and slashed at Kamimura-san's body over and over and over again.

strings.text: 暗闇でもわかるくらいに血が飛び散るのが俺の目に見え、皮膚と肉の切り裂かれる音が俺の耳の中に響く
strings.translated: I could see blood spraying -- visible even in the darkness -- and the sound of skin and flesh being torn apart echoed inside my ears.

strings.text: 大智「や
strings.translated: Daichi「S--

strings.text: やめろ」
strings.translated: "Stop,"

strings.text: と、いいたかったけれど、その声さえも出てはくれない。
strings.translated: is what I wanted to say, but even that voice won't come out.

strings.text: なにもいえないまま、なにもできないまま、俺の目の前で神村さんの身体は…ずたずたに凶刃に貫かれていく
strings.translated: Unable to say anything, unable to do anything, right before my eyes, Kamimura-san's body is... torn apart, run through again and again by that murderous blade.

strings.text: 大智「ぁ……っ……」
strings.translated: Daichi「A... ah...」

strings.text: どうして……目の前の惨劇に、助けたかった人が抵抗もせずに命を尽きさせていく光景に、それをとめることができなかったという悔いに…時間が凍っていた
strings.translated: Why... faced with the carnage before me, watching the person I wanted to save give up her life without even a struggle, consumed by the regret that I couldn't stop it... time had frozen.

strings.text: それは、どれくらい続いていたのだろうか…。
strings.translated: How long had it gone on...?

strings.text: 執拗なまでに神村さんの身体を刺し続けていた姉さんは、ようやくその手を止めた。
strings.translated: My sister, who had been stabbing Kamimura-san's body with relentless obsession, finally stilled her hand.

strings.text: 彼女の身体を貫いていた包丁を引き抜くと、大きく背中を仰け反らせた
strings.translated: She wrenched the knife free from the body it had been buried in, and arched her back sharply.

strings.text: 美桜「園田先生、仇は取りましたっ！
strings.translated: Mio「Sonoda-sensei, I've avenged you!

strings.text: 友佳、先生、今逢いに行くからっ！
strings.translated: Yuka, Sensei -- I'm coming to see you now!

strings.text: 美桜「ふふっ、ふ、ふっ…あはははははははははははははははははははははははははははっ！
strings.translated: Mio「Hehe, heh, heh... ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!

strings.text: 姉さんは笑っていた。
strings.translated: My sister was laughing.

strings.text: 笑いながら、もう一度、手にした包丁を振り上げて
strings.translated: Laughing, she raised the knife in her hand one more time --

strings.text: 美桜「げぶっ！
strings.translated: Mio「Gbuh!

strings.text: 俺の目の前で、姉さんの身体がゆっくりと倒れていく。
strings.translated: Before my eyes, my sister's body slowly crumples to the ground.

strings.text: 鮮血を吐きながら、それでも微かに笑うような声を漏らしながら
strings.translated: Coughing up bright red blood, and yet still letting out a faint sound like a smile --

strings.text: 大智「あ…あ…」
strings.translated: Daichi「A... ah...」

strings.text: 俺は重い身体を引きずりながら、何とか二人の元へと近付いていく。
strings.translated: I drag my heavy body along the floor, somehow managing to crawl toward the two of them.

strings.text: なんでこんなことに…？
strings.translated: Why did it come to this...?

strings.text: 俺が悪いのか？
strings.translated: Is it my fault?

strings.text: また俺が余計な事をしたから、だからこうなったのか？
strings.translated: Was it because I did something unnecessary again -- is that why it came to this?

strings.text: 止めたかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to stop it.

strings.text: 助けたかった。
strings.translated: I wanted to save her.

strings.text: こんなことになって欲しくなかった。
strings.translated: I never wanted it to come to this.

strings.text: 床を這い、２人へと近づきながら視界が熱く歪んでいく。
strings.translated: As I crawled across the floor toward the two of them, my vision blurred and burned with heat.

strings.text: ２人がどうなったかなんて火を見るよりも明らかだったけど、それでも≪一縷／いちる≫の望みを捨てきれずに、痛みも忘れて前へと進んだ
strings.translated: What had become of them both was clearer than fire -- and yet I couldn't bring myself to abandon that last thread of hope, and I pushed forward, forgetting even the pain.

strings.text: 大智「姉さんっ…！
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis...!

strings.text: 大智「姉さん……」
strings.translated: Daichi「Sis...」

strings.text: 姉さんは…既に息絶えていた。
strings.translated: My sister... was already dead.

strings.text: 鬼のような形相で、本懐を遂げたとばかりに満足そうな笑顔を浮かべたまま。
strings.translated: Her face twisted like a demon's, and yet wearing a satisfied smile -- as if she had accomplished everything she had set out to do.

strings.text: こんな人じゃなかった。
strings.translated: She wasn't like this.

strings.text: もっと穏やかで、優しくて……こんな人じゃなかったのに…。
strings.translated: She was gentler, kinder... she was never like this...

strings.text: どうして
strings.translated: Why...

strings.text: 愛「かはッ…！
strings.translated: Ai「Kah...!

strings.text: 大智「神村さん…！」
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san...!」

strings.text: まだ、生きてる。
strings.translated: She's still alive.

strings.text: 神村さんは生きてる…！
strings.translated: Kamimura-san is still alive...!

strings.text: 何とか身体を起こして、神村さんを抱き起こす。
strings.translated: Somehow I pushed myself up and lifted Kamimura-san into my arms.

strings.text: どうすればいい？
strings.translated: What do I do?

strings.text: 止血……どうすれば血は止まるんだ？
strings.translated: Stop the bleeding... how do I stop the bleeding?

strings.text: 愛「ふ、ふ…私…には…お似合い、の
strings.translated: Ai「Heh, heh... this is... what I... deserve.

strings.text: 大智「喋らなくていいっ！
strings.translated: Daichi「Don't talk!

strings.text: 今、き、救急車…救急車を、呼ぶから…」
strings.translated: Right now, I'll -- I'll call an ambulance... I'm calling an ambulance...」

strings.text: そうだ、救急車…携帯、携帯は
strings.translated: That's right, an ambulance... my phone, where's my phone --

strings.text: 愛「馬鹿……間に合う、わけ…」
strings.translated: Ai「Stupid... there's no... way you'll make it...」

strings.text: 神村さんの声が弱くなっていく。
strings.translated: Kamimura-san's voice was growing weaker.

strings.text: その体温が失せていくような気がする
strings.translated: I could feel the warmth draining from her body.

strings.text: 大智「…なぁ！
strings.translated: Daichi「...Hey!

strings.text: 待ってくれ……死ぬなよ…！」
strings.translated: Wait... don't die...!」

strings.text: やめてくれよ。
strings.translated: Please stop.

strings.text: 頼むから、それだけは
strings.translated: I'm begging you, anything but that --

strings.text: 大智「死ぬなっ！
strings.translated: Daichi「Don't die!

strings.text: 俺が、君を救うからっ！
strings.translated: I'll save you -- I'll save you!

strings.text: 君のためなら何だってするからっ！
strings.translated: I'll do anything for you!」

strings.text: 愛「ふふっ
strings.translated: Ai「Heheh...

strings.text: 大智「俺が…俺が君を救う…っ！
strings.translated: Daichi「I will... I will save you...!

strings.text: 助けてみせるから！
strings.translated: I'll show you I can save you!

strings.text: 何でもするから！
strings.translated: I'll do anything!

strings.text: だから…死ぬなっ……頼むよ……！
strings.translated: So... don't die... please...!」

strings.text: 愛「最後、まで…馬鹿ね
strings.translated: Ai「Stupid... to the very... end.

strings.text: 大智「神村さん、俺は…！
strings.translated: Daichi「Kamimura-san, I...!

strings.text: 愛「私に…救い、は…ないの
strings.translated: Ai「There is no... salvation... for me.

strings.text: 吐息と共に神村さんの肩が小さくゆれた。
strings.translated: With a faint breath, Kamimura-san's shoulders gave a small shudder.

strings.text: それきり、神村さんは動かなくなった。
strings.translated: After that, Kamimura-san stopped moving.

strings.text: 目は開いたままだった。
strings.translated: Her eyes remained open.

strings.text: 口からは血が流れ続けていた
strings.translated: Blood continued to flow from her mouth.

strings.text: やり直したい。
strings.translated: I want to start over.

strings.text: 叶うことなら、全部…最初からやり直したい。
strings.translated: If it were possible -- all of it... I want to start over from the very beginning.

strings.text: 今度は間違えないから。
strings.translated: This time I won't make the same mistakes.

strings.text: もっと頑張るから。
strings.translated: This time I'll try harder.

strings.text: きっと正しい選択をするから。
strings.translated: I'll make the right choice this time, I promise.

strings.text: だから、誰か……神様、どうか
strings.translated: So please... someone... God, I beg you --

strings.text: 大智「ああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああああっ！
strings.translated: Daichi「

strings.text: 目を開けたとき、俺の視界に広がっていたのは白い天井だった。
strings.translated: When I opened my eyes, what spread across my field of vision was a white ceiling.

strings.text: 窓から差し込む光は暖かくて、何だか穏やかな夢の世界にいるような感覚だった
strings.translated: The light streaming in through the window was warm, and I had the strange feeling of being in some peaceful dream world.

strings.text: 父親「大智？
strings.translated: Father「Daichi?

strings.text: 大智っ！
strings.translated: Daichi!

strings.text: 声のしたほうを見ると、父さんが俺を見下ろしていた。
strings.translated: When I looked toward the voice, my father was looking down at me.

strings.text: 何だか色々な表情が混ざっていて、喜んでるのか悲しんでいるのか怒ってるのか、よくわからなかった。
strings.translated: All sorts of emotions were mixed together on his face -- I couldn't quite tell if he was happy, or sad, or angry.

strings.text: 父親「わかるか？
strings.translated: Father「Do you recognize me?

strings.text: 父さんのことがわかるか？
strings.translated: Do you know who I am?

strings.text: 大智「そりゃあ…わかるよ」
strings.translated: Daichi「Of course... I understand.」

strings.text: 父親「そうか。
strings.translated: Father「I see.

strings.text: よかった…」
strings.translated: Thank goodness...」

strings.text: 父親「い、今っ、母さんと先生も呼んでくるから、ちょっと待ってなさいっ！
strings.translated: Father「I-I'll go get your mother and the doctor right now, so just wait a moment!

strings.text: そういいながら、父さんが部屋を出て行く。
strings.translated: Saying that, Dad left the room.

strings.text: 母さんはわかるけど……先生って何だ？
strings.translated: Mom makes sense, but... what does he mean by "the doctor"?

strings.text: まさか、園田…？
strings.translated: Could it be... Sonoda...?

strings.text: 園田のことを言ってるのか…？
strings.translated: Is he talking about Sonoda...?

strings.text: 一瞬、そんなことを考えてしまったけれど、自分のいる場所を、目の前の光景を考えると、自然とその答えは導き出された
strings.translated: For a moment I found myself thinking that, but when I considered where I was and what I could see in front of me, the answer came naturally on its own.

strings.text: 大智「ここ…病院……」
strings.translated: Daichi「This place... a hospital...」

strings.text: 目を開けて、かなりの時間が経ってから、俺は自分が病院のベッドの上にいることをようやく理解した。
strings.translated: A considerable amount of time had passed since I opened my eyes before I finally understood that I was lying in a hospital bed.

strings.text: 背中と腕には鈍い痛みがあって、あの出来事が夢ではなかったと、否応なくそれも理解させられた。
strings.translated: There was a dull pain in my back and arm, and that too made me understand, whether I liked it or not, that those events had not been a dream.

strings.text: 母親「大智っ！
strings.translated: Mother「Daichi!

strings.text: ５分もしないうちに、必死の剣幕で母さんが部屋に飛び込んできた。
strings.translated: In less than five minutes, Mom came bursting into the room with a desperate look on her face.

strings.text: それくらい危険な状態だったんだろう。
strings.translated: I must have been in that dangerous a state.

strings.text: 医師「気分はどうですか？
strings.translated: Doctor「How are you feeling?

strings.text: 大智「背中が…痛いです」
strings.translated: Daichi「My back... hurts.」

strings.text: 医師「まだ痛みは取れないと思います。
strings.translated: Doctor「I don't think the pain will go away just yet.

strings.text: その怪我…なにがあったかは、自分でわかっているかな？
strings.translated: That injury... do you understand yourself what happened?」

strings.text: 大智「…たぶん、わかってると思います
strings.translated: Daichi「...I think I probably do.」

strings.text: 父さんと母さん、そして病院の医師の話を聞いて、俺は少しずつ受け入れるしかない現実を認めていった。
strings.translated: After listening to what my father, mother, and the hospital doctor had to say, I slowly came to accept the reality I had no choice but to face.

strings.text: あの後、ビルの警備員が見回りに来て塾長室の惨状に気づき、警察と救急に通報したらしい。
strings.translated: Apparently, after everything, a building security guard had come on his rounds, noticed the carnage in the director's office, and called the police and an ambulance.

strings.text: そのおかげで俺は一命を取り留めることができたが、姉さんと、神村さんは……間に合わなかった。
strings.translated: Thanks to that, I had managed to survive -- but my sister, and Kamimura-san... they hadn't made it in time.

strings.text: それは説明されなくてもわかっていた。
strings.translated: I already knew that without being told.

strings.text: 何にせよ、俺たちの事件をきっかけに、クラブに捜査の手が入った。
strings.translated: In any case, our incident had triggered an investigation into the Club.

strings.text: あのパソコンの中のデータや、他にも発見されたものが証拠となって、園田静子は逮捕されたらしい。
strings.translated: The data on that computer, along with other evidence that was discovered, had apparently led to the arrest of Sonoda Shizuko.

strings.text: 多分、これでよかったんだと思う
strings.translated: I think, all things considered, that was probably for the best.

strings.text: でも、まだひとつだけ、気になることがあった
strings.translated: But there was still one thing that weighed on my mind.

strings.text: 大智「芽生……」
strings.translated: Daichi「Mei...」

strings.text: 病室に付き添う家族の中に、芽生の姿がなかった
strings.translated: Among the family gathered in the hospital room, Mei was nowhere to be seen.

strings.text: 大智「芽生は？
strings.translated: Daichi「Where's Mei?」

strings.text: 父親「芽生は…」
strings.translated: Father「Mei...」

strings.text: 父さんは言葉をにごした。
strings.translated: Dad let his words trail off.

strings.text: けど、その後、ぽつぽつと語りはじめた。
strings.translated: But after that, he began to speak haltingly.

strings.text: 両親が俺に付きっきりになっている間、親戚のところに預けられていた芽生は、昨日の夜中に親戚の家を抜け出した。
strings.translated: While our parents had been staying by my side without leaving, Mei, who had been left with relatives, had slipped out of their house in the middle of last night.

strings.text: そして……誰か、複数の男に乱暴されて怪我をして、今朝方その身柄が保護され、今は同じ病院に入院しているということだった。
strings.translated: And then... she had been assaulted by someone -- multiple men -- and was injured, and early this morning she had been taken into protective custody and was now hospitalized in the same hospital.

strings.text: 母さんが最初、ここにいなかったのは…つまり、そういうことらしかった。
strings.translated: The reason Mom hadn't been here at first... that was apparently what it came down to.

strings.text: そして、そんな芽生は…そのショックですっかりおかしくなってしまっている、と父さんが辛そうに告げる。
strings.translated: And as for Mei... she had been completely broken by the shock of it, Dad told us, his voice heavy with pain.

strings.text: 父親「私達が仕事にかまけて、ちゃんとおまえ達のことを見ていてやれなかったばっかりに…」
strings.translated: Father「All because we were so caught up in work and couldn't keep a proper eye on you two...」

strings.text: 母親「ごめんなさい……ごめんねぇ…」
strings.translated: Mother (Shizuko)「I'm sorry... I'm so sorry...」

strings.text: 父さんは泣いていた。
strings.translated: Dad was crying.

strings.text: 母さんもずっと泣いていた
strings.translated: Mom had been crying the whole time.

strings.text: 大智「ちがっ…違うんだ、そうじゃない……」
strings.translated: Daichi「No... that's not it, that's not what I mean...」

strings.text: ２人が悪いわけじゃない。
strings.translated: It's not their fault.

strings.text: きっと、姉さんも、神村さんも…誰も悪くないんだ。
strings.translated: It wasn't Sis's fault, or Kamimura-san's... it wasn't anyone's fault.

strings.text: あれは…父さんにも、母さんにも、俺にも、誰にもどうにかすることなんてできなかったんだ。
strings.translated: That... there was nothing Dad, or Mom, or me, or anyone could have done.

strings.text: …いや、違う。
strings.translated: No, that's wrong.

strings.text: 黙っていた俺が悪いんだ
strings.translated: It's my fault for staying silent.

strings.text: 大智「ごめん…ごめんなさい…っ！」
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm sorry... I'm so sorry...!」

strings.text: 誰も助けられなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't save anyone.

strings.text: 俺は何もできなかった。
strings.translated: I couldn't do anything.

strings.text: それどころか、全てが悪い方に進んで……俺が悪いんだ
strings.translated: On top of that, everything kept going from bad to worse... it's my fault.

strings.text: 大智「おっ…俺がいるからっ、俺は大丈夫だからっ…！」
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm... I'm here, I'm okay...!」

strings.text: 俺にはまだ父さんと母さんがいる。
strings.translated: I still have Dad and Mom.

strings.text: そして、姉さんを失い、芽生を壊され……二人にはもう、俺しか残っていないんだ。
strings.translated: And they've lost Sis, and had Mei broken... I'm all they have left.

strings.text: 俺がしっかりしないといけない。
strings.translated: I have to hold myself together.

strings.text: 俺までおかしくなってしまったら…きっと俺が両親だったら、そんなの絶対に耐えられない。
strings.translated: If I fell apart too... if I were my parents, I know I could never bear that.

strings.text: だから、痛む身体で必死に両親の手を取って、もう一度言った
strings.translated: So, with my aching body, I desperately took both their hands and said it once more.

strings.text: 大智「俺がいるから
strings.translated: Daichi「I'm here.」

strings.text: 私に救いはない
strings.translated: There is no salvation for me.

strings.text: 私は救いなど求めていない
strings.translated: I am not seeking salvation.

strings.text: 私を救うと言ってくれて
strings.translated: You told me you would save me.

strings.text: 普通の女の子のように抱いてくれて
strings.translated: You held me like I was just an ordinary girl.

strings.text: 嬉しかった
strings.translated: I was happy.

strings.text: そう言ったら、あなたは苦しむだろうか
strings.translated: If I told you that, would it cause you pain?

strings.text: みなさま！
strings.translated: Everyone!

strings.text: この度は「フラテルニテ」
strings.translated: この度は「フラテルニテ」

strings.text: をご購入いただき誠にありがとうございます！
strings.translated: Thank you so very much for your purchase!

strings.text: 今回、白坂芽生・菱木紗英子・戸田心音－３名の一部原画を担当いたしました。
strings.translated: This time, I was in charge of some of the original artwork for Mei Shiraka, Saeko Hishiki, and Kokone Toda -- three characters in total.

strings.text: また、グラフィッカーとしても随分と痛いそうなものからうんちまで彩色しましたよー！
strings.translated: As a graphic artist, I also handled coloring for quite a range of things, from some rather painful-looking content all the way to poop!

strings.text: 企画・原案－はましま薫夫先生、監督－阿久津亮先生のもと、いつもとは違ったお仕事でしたので、とても新鮮でした。
strings.translated: Working under Planner/Original Concept -- Kaoru Hamashima-sensei and Director -- Ryo Akutsu-sensei, this was a different kind of job from what I usually do, so it felt very fresh.

strings.text: 今後ともＣＬＯＣＫＵＰ作品をよろしくお願いいたします！
strings.translated: Please continue to support CLOCKUP titles going forward!

strings.text: それでは　ノシ
strings.translated: Until next time -- o/

strings.text: スタッフコメント_たくろう
strings.translated: Staff Comment -- Takurou

strings.text: スタッフコメント滝

strings.translated: Comment Illustration -- Mario

strings.text: スタッフコメント＠はましま
strings.translated: Staff Comment -- @Hamashima

strings.text: このたびはお買い上げ誠にありがとうございます！
strings.translated: Thank you so very much for your purchase!

strings.text: 今回は実写グラフィック使用なのが最初に決まっていたので、それに合わせた色味やキャラデザを行うということで、いろいろやったことのない事にチャレンジできてとても楽しかったです。
strings.translated: Since it was decided from the start that this title would use live-action photography for its graphics, I got to take on all sorts of challenges I'd never tried before -- adjusting color tones and character designs to match that aesthetic -- and it was a lot of fun.

strings.text: 仕上げに関しても今までのやり方＋新しい試みもできいい勉強になりました。
strings.translated: In terms of finishing work as well, I was able to combine my usual methods with new approaches, and it was a great learning experience.

strings.text: 表現・仕上げの研究は今後も色々とチャレンジしたい所存です。
strings.translated: I intend to keep experimenting with expression and finishing techniques going forward.

strings.text: 原画に関しては愛全般、痛々しいの・うんこ・フェラ・特殊エロなどをメインに担当いたしました。
strings.translated: As for the original artwork, I was mainly in charge of Ai overall, as well as the painful content, the poop, the fellatio, and the more unusual erotic scenes.

strings.text: 痛い系に関してはもっと色々と描きたい部分もありましたが、世の中の荒波には抗えないという大人の事情もありました。
strings.translated: For the painful content in particular, there were parts where I wanted to draw even more, but there are adult circumstances in this world that one cannot fight against.

strings.text: でもその中で工夫して見せていくためにももっと努力しなければなあとしみじみと力不足を感じております。
strings.translated: Still, I feel keenly -- and with some humility -- that I need to work harder to find creative ways to show things within those constraints.

strings.text: いたらない部分も多々あるかと思いますが、今後もできる限り精進していきたいと思っておりますので、応援していただければ幸いです
strings.translated: There will no doubt be many areas where I fell short, but I intend to keep doing my best going forward, so I would be grateful for your continued support.

strings.text: でございます。
strings.translated: Indeed.

strings.text: 格差社会なんて言葉が巷に浸透して久しいもんで、みなさん色々と苦労が絶えないようでございますな。
strings.translated: It has been quite some time since the phrase "class divide" worked its way into everyday conversation, and it seems everyone continues to have their share of hardships.

strings.text: なんでも某所からの情報によりますと、本作の登場人物にも人気不人気というやつが出ているとかいないとかで。
strings.translated: According to information from a certain source, it appears that among the characters in this title, some have proven more popular than others -- or so they say.

strings.text: キャラクタービジネスというのはこれでなかなか因果なもんでございます
strings.translated: The character business is a rather ironic thing, when you think about it.

strings.text: 一説によると、今回の不人気キャラは生徒会長を勤めていらっしゃる、えーと、ここではＳさんとしておきましょうか。
strings.translated: According to one theory, the least popular character this time around is the student council president -- let's call her "S-san" here, shall we.

strings.text: 「ショップ様の予約特典で一件も採用事例が無かった」
strings.translated: She had the misfortune of not being selected as a bonus item by a single shop for their pre-order exclusives.

strings.text: という憂き目を見た彼女をなんとか応援してみようかと、ない知恵を絞ってテーマソングをこしらえてみました。
strings.translated: In an effort to somehow cheer her on, I wracked my meager brain and put together a theme song for her.

strings.text: これが彼女への応援歌となり、ひいては彼女の人気に少しでも貢献できればという所存であります。
strings.translated: It is my sincere hope that this song will serve as an anthem of support for her, and perhaps contribute even a little to her popularity.

strings.text: では
strings.translated: And so --

strings.text: 針山１
strings.translated: Harizama 1

strings.text: みなさんこんにちは！
strings.translated: Hello everyone!

strings.text: ＣＬＯＣＫＵＰで広報部長兼慰安部長をつとめております、≪針山迅侑／はりやまじんゆう≫と申します。
strings.translated: I am Jinyuu Hariyama, serving as Head of Public Relations and Head of Hospitality here at CLOCKUP.

strings.text: をご購入いただき、誠にありがとうございます！
strings.translated: Thank you so very much for purchasing this title!

strings.text: ２０１４年３月に針山が入社してから初めて発売されるタイトルということで、私もスタッフ日記での広報に、スタッフの皆様の慰安にと頑張ってまいりました
strings.translated: As this is the first title to be released since Hariyama joined the company in March 2014, I have done my best to handle publicity through the staff blog and to look after the well-being of our staff members.

strings.text: 針山２
strings.translated: Harizama 2

strings.text: 毎日うんこまみれで働いている私にふさわしく、イベントＣＧの約８％がうんこというゲームでございますが、気に入っていただければ幸いです。
strings.translated: In keeping with my daily life of working elbow-deep in poop, this is a game in which approximately 8% of the event CGs feature poop -- and I hope you enjoyed it.

strings.text: 至らない部分も多々あったことと思いますが、これからもＣＬＯＣＫＵＰを何卒よろしくお願いいたします！
strings.translated: I'm sure there were many areas where we fell short, but we hope you will continue to support CLOCKUP going forward!

strings.text: をご購入いただき、誠にありがとうございます。
strings.translated: Thank you so very much for your purchase!

strings.text: ディレクター阿久津です。
strings.translated: I am Director Akutsu.

strings.text: 今回はディレクションの他に、主にシナリオを担当しました。
strings.translated: This time, in addition to directing, I was primarily in charge of the scenario.

strings.text: シナリオの担当範囲としては、プロットの作成と全体の監修です。
strings.translated: My responsibilities on the scenario side included creating the plot and supervising the overall work.

strings.text: 実際のシナリオ執筆分担は、通常シーンを和泉さんに、Ｈシーンの大半を神堂さんにお願いしました。
strings.translated: For the actual scenario writing, I asked Izumi-san to handle the regular scenes, and Shindo-san to handle the majority of the H-scenes.

strings.text: 穂波さんには芽生のＨシーン中盤以降をお願いしました。
strings.translated: I asked Honami-san to handle the latter half of Mei's H-scenes and beyond.

strings.text: また、開発終期でシナリオの手直しをかなり手伝っていただきました。
strings.translated: They also helped out considerably with scenario revisions during the latter stages of development.

strings.text: 昏式さんには瑛のＨシーンをお願いしました。
strings.translated: I asked Konshiki-san to handle Akira's H-scenes.

strings.text: 瑛をお任せしたのは作業範囲的に丁度折り合いがつく量だったからで、他意はありません。
strings.translated: The reason I entrusted Akira to them was simply that the workload fit neatly within the scope of what was available -- there was no other intention behind it.

strings.text: でも瑛をちゃんと健気な女の子として書いていただけたので、お任せして良かったです。
strings.translated: But since they wrote Akira properly as an earnest, endearing girl, I'm glad I left it in their hands.

strings.text: Ｔｅａｍ．Ｎ．Ｇ．Ｘさんには紗英子のＨシーンの中盤以降、紗英子ＥＮＤ以外の部分をお願いしました。
strings.translated: I asked Team.N.G.X-san to handle the latter half of Saeko's H-scenes and beyond, excluding the Saeko END.

strings.text: 絵的な担当範囲としては、はましまさんには全立ち絵・デザイン・色彩設計等と、イベントＣＧでは愛の全てと、その他のグロ・フェラ・多人数シーンを。
strings.translated: In terms of the visual workload, I asked Hamashima-san to handle all character sprites, design, color direction, and so on, as well as all of Ai's event CGs, along with the gore, fellatio, and group scenes.

strings.text: むなしさんには心音、紗英子、瑛の一部を。
strings.translated: I asked Munashi-san to handle Kokone, Saeko, and part of Akira.

strings.text: たくろうさんには美桜、円夏、通常イベントの一部を。
strings.translated: I asked Takurou-san to handle Mio, Madoka, and part of the regular event scenes.

strings.text: 滝さんには芽生、美桜、円夏、ＢＡＤＥＮＤなどを少しずつ、十重さんには紗英子を、まりおさんには瑛をお願いしました。
strings.translated: I asked Taki-san to handle a little of Mei, Mio, Madoka, and the BAD ENDs; Tooe-san to handle Saeko; and Mario-san to handle Akira.

strings.text: 今回はいろいろと予想外のアクシデントが多い開発で、お見苦しい点も多々お見せいたしましたが、それでもなんとか楽しめる内容にはできたかな…と思っています。
strings.translated: This was a development cycle with many unexpected accidents of various kinds, and I'm sure there were quite a few unsightly moments along the way -- but even so, I do think we managed to put together something enjoyable...

strings.text: いかがだったでしょうか。
strings.translated: I hope you felt the same.

strings.text: これからもＣＬＯＣＫＵＰならびに阿久津を見捨てずまたお付き合いいただければ幸いです
strings.translated: I would be most grateful if you would continue to support CLOCKUP and Akutsu going forward, without giving up on us.
